notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: July 24th
notes.content:
Here's a rundown of the major updates in today's patch!

[list][b][*]Zombie Hero Rebalance (Beta) Exclusive Map Weapon Supply Event[/b]
Weapons based on the day of the week will be available for use in Zombie Hero Rebalance (Beta) exclusive maps during the event period.

[b][*]Mileage Auction Event[/b]
You can access the auction during the event from the Mileage Auction button at the bottom of the lobby screen.

[b][*]3,000 Mileage Auction Event! (7/24 - 8/6)[/b]
Sometimes great deals on listings will appear! You could become the lucky winner of an item at a special cost of 3,000 Mileage!

[b][*]Nexon 30th Anniversary Fireworks Event I (07/24 - 08/21)[/b]
Pop fireworks that appear in the lobby during the event period to earn rewards. (Regardless of color)[/list]

Check out the following sections for more information.

[h1]---------- Details ----------[/h1]


[h3]New Event Weapon Electron-III[/h3]

[list][*]Electron-III
[list][*]An SMG that fires a total of 80 energy rounds. Its Special Feature allows the use of special ammo that charges automatically upon firing and can be used on your immediate surroundings, or fired towards your desired target. [/list][/list]


[h3]Zombie Hero Rebalance (Beta) Exclusive Map Weapon Supply Event (7/24 - 8/7)[/h3]
Weapons based on the day of the week will be available for use in Zombie Hero Rebalance (Beta) exclusive maps during the event period.

[list][*] Primary Weapon: Failnaught/Hyper Gaebolg/Devastator
[*] Secondary Weapon: Lightning Fury
[*] Melee Weapon: Demolition Hammer/Spell Lance Scarlet Rose/Holy Sword Divine Order
[*] Equipment: Hellhound/Satellite Mine/Trinity Grenade[/list]

[list][*]Notice
[list][*]Zombie Hero Rebalance (Beta) Exclusive Maps: Rebalanced Dust, Rebalanced Assault, Rebalanced Italy
[*] You'll get one Primary Weapon, Secondary Weapon, Melee Weapon, and Equipment based on the probabilities for each.
[*] Trial Weapons can only be used in Zombie Hero Rebalance (Beta) Exclusive Maps.
[*] Regardless of when you receive them, the available weapons will change every day at midnight.[/list][/list]


[h3]Mileage Auction Event (7/24 - 8/6)[/h3]
You can access the auction during the event from the Mileage Auction button at the bottom of the lobby screen.

[list][*]Auction Details
[list][*]Auction Time: 1 hour for all items
[*] Number of Listings: 2 (Can be increased based on VIP rank)
[*] Market Price of Items: Lowest bids and direct purchase prices are shown on the Auction House when listing an item.
[*] Item Display: Items with the lowest bid or direct purchase price are displayed first.
[*] Auction Filters: You can search by bid/direct purchase price, enhancement level, and weapon name.
[*] Sell-to-System Feature: When an auction is unsuccessful, you'll have the opportunity to use the sell-to-system feature.
[*] Auction Hours: 24 Hours (12:00 AM - 11:59 PM). When the auction is over, all currently listed items will be canceled.[/list][/list]

[list][*]Other Details
[list][*]Remaining time is shown in 5-minute increments for listed auction items.
[*] You can only bid on one item at a time.
[*] Regular auction items will be listed with an additional 30% fee included in the initial bidding price.
[*] If an item listed for auction is not sold, the item will be returned.
[*] Items listed for auction can be purchased immediately at the direct purchase price.
[*] If you list an item for auction, you cannot withdraw it until the auction's duration has ended.
[*] The item you listed may be shown on the bid page.
[*] When listing an item, you can easily check the actual amount you will receive under the Net Reward section.
[*] Some recently released weapons cannot be listed at auction.[/list][/list]


[h3]3,000 Mileage Auction Event! (7/24 - 8/6)[/h3]
Sometimes great deals on listings will appear! You could become the lucky winner of an item at a special cost of 3,000 Mileage!

[list][*]Time / Special Items
[list][*]Sat, Sun 9:30 PM: Epic Decoder Reward Box (Epic Decoder x5)
[*] Mon - Fri 9:30 PM: Transcendence Decoder Reward Box (Transcendence Decoder x5)[/list][/list]

[list][*]Other Details
[list][*]The 3,000 Mileage Auction items only appear at specific times.
[*] After the 3,000 Mileage auction is over, participants who haven't won will have their 3,000 Mileage refunded.
[*] 3,000 Mileage bids can be made 10 minutes after the special auction begins.
[*] Claim contents by clicking Obtain after winning.
[*] You cannot win multiple rewards during the event.[/list][/list]


[h3]Part Weapon Open Information[/h3]

[list][*]Part Weapon Expansion
[list][*]MG3 Gold Edition 
[*] AS50
[*] AS50 Pink Gold
[*] If the damage level of the base weapon is lower than the standard, it will be adjusted to the part's target weapon's standard. (Including the shop value)[/list][/list]


[h3]Login Supplies Event (7/24 - 8/20)[/h3]
Logging in during the event will give you daily and cumulative rewards!

[list][*]Daily Login Rewards: Daily Weapons Supply
[list][*]Daily Supply Contents
[*] You'll get all four of the following items: Dual Sword Phantom Slayer (1 Day), M3 Black Dragon (1 Day), Barrett M95 White Tiger (1 Day), and M249 Phoenix (1 Day).
[*] Two Rare, Unique, or Transcendence weapons (1 Day) have a chance of appearing in the Daily Supply.
[*] One Transcendence Class (1 Day) has a chance to be included.
[*] You will receive all the contents of the Daily Attendance Reward Box.[/list][/list]

[list][*]Details
[list][*]Transcendence Classes (1 Day): Dorothy Dark Knight, Flora Paladin, Transcendence Ji Yoon Choi, Transcendence Yuri, Sonya Lycanthrope, Elizabeth Crimson Hunter, Transcendence Michaela, Transcendence Fernando, Transcendence Blair, and Rose Phoenix
[*] Daily Attendance Reward Box: Damage Display (1 Day), Killer Display (1 Day), Penalty and Loss Invalidation, and Rare Decoder (x3)
[*] All weapons and classes from the Daily Supply are bound and cannot be used for Auction/Disassembly/Family Storage (Extension X).[/list][/list]

[list][*]Total Rewards
[list][*]5 Days: NEGEV NG-7 Ajax (20 Days) & Cumulative Attendance Reward Box x1
[*] 10 Days: Magnum Shooter (20 Days) & Cumulative Attendance Reward Box x1
[*] 15 Days: Trinity Grenade (20 Days) & Cumulative Attendance Reward Box x1
[*] 15 Days: Lightning Fury (20 Days) & Cumulative Attendance Reward Box x1[/list][/list]

[list][*]Details
[list][*]Cumulative Attendance Reward Box contents: C4 Countdown Room Host (5 Days), Shorten Respawn Time (5 Days) Lucky Gunslinger (5 Days), Daily Mission Difficulty Change x15, Exploration Slot Expansion Coupon (7 Days)
[*] Attendance rewards will be delivered as rewards instead of Daily/Cumulative Attendance Reward Box items.
[*] Rewards can be claimed immediately after logging in, and rewards are available until midnight every day.[/list][/list]


[h3]Mission Chain Renewal Information[/h3]

[list][*]Changes to Mission Chain Individual Mission Rewards
[list][*]The Stage 3 Mileage Shop Mission's reward is changed to Dual Sword Infernal Hunter.
Those who have completed the Stage 3 Mission after 7/10 will be given a Dual Sword Infernal Hunter (Permanent) separately during 7/24 maintenance.[/list][/list]

[h3]Shop New Items and Changes[/h3]

[list][*]Silver Tiger Weapon Paint (Applicable weapon added)
[list][*]Applicable weapons: Special Duck Foot Gun + Satellite Mine[/list][/list]

[h3]Nexon 30th Anniversary Fireworks Event I (07/24 - 08/21)[/h3]
Pop fireworks that appear in the lobby during the event period to earn rewards. (Regardless of color)

[list][*]Items Given from Fireworks
[list][*]Event Decoder
[*] Unique Decoder
[*] 200 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon
[*] 100 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon
[*] 50 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon
[*] Grade 5 Parts Reward Box
[*] Grade 4 Parts Reward Box
[*] 1000 Mileage Coupon
[*] 500 Mileage Coupon
[*] Damage -1 Dehancement Material
[*] Weight -1 Dehancement Material
[*] Accuracy -1 Dehancement Material
[*] Fire Rate -1 Dehancement Material
[*] Recoil -1 Dehancement Material
[*] Ammo -1 Dehancement Material
[*] Random -1 Dehancement Material
[*] Exploration Success Rate-Up +20%
[*] Exploration Success Rate-Up +10%
[*] Zombie Scenario Add-On Rate Box
[*] Zombie Damage Meter (7 Days)
[*] You can only receive each reward once per day per account.[/list][/list]


[h3]Nexon 30th Anniversary Fireworks Event II (07/24 - 08/21)[/h3]
Pop red fireworks that appear in the lobby during the event period 30 times to earn rewards.

[list][*]Rewards
[list][*]Event Decoder x10
[*] Dehancement Material Parts Rate Box x1
[*] You can only receive each reward once per day per account.[/list][/list]


Other Information
[olist][*]Coastal Palace Map Loading Tooltip location has been adjusted. 
[*] Fixed an issue where classes were getting stuck in a specific location on the Nostalgia map. 
[*] Fixed an issue where the MK48's Enhancement Damage was not being applied in Zombie Mode, Zombie Scenario Mode. 
[*] Fixed an issue in Zombie Scenario Season 6 Pursuit: Ep. Carlito map where killing the boss and then the player dying made it unclearable. 
[*] Fixed an issue in Zombie Scenario Season 3 Pursuit: Enemy Behind where the boss was getting stuck in the ground and was not moving.
[*] Transcendence Class Karin's Zombie Scenario skill effect has been changed. 
[*] Fixed an issue where the Transcendence Class Millia's outline was incorrectly displayed in Original, Team Deathmatch, and Gun Deathmatch modes when Display Ally Outlines was checked in Options. 
[*] Fixed an issue where switching weapons while firing Dual Kriss (Refined) and MG36 (Refined) did not reset their recoil. 
[*] Fixed an issue where bot zombies were not reviving in Studio Zombie Mode. 
[*] Fixed an issue where using an Emote with Transcendence Class Angelina did not properly display it. 
[*] Fixed an issue where applying Silver Tiger Weapon Paint to Special Duck Foot Gun Silver Tiger made it show unpainted on the Inventory Shop Model. 
[*] Fixed an issue where there was a low chance that Assign Class time was not being displayed properly. 
[*] Fixed an issue where Season Pass Nameplate (19) was skewed to the right.
[*] Fixed some incorrectly written shop values. 
[list][*] - Only the shop values were fixed. Actual balance values are unaffected. 
[*]  - Affected weapons: MG3, MG3 Xmas Edition, DESERT MG3 
[*]  - Changed Categories: Zombie, Zombie Scenario Damage section's shop value.[/list][/olist]

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/6af10d30b3005f147ead1fa7a1f273b8132e9a6b.jpg[/img]
[b]Attention Survivors,[/b]

2024-7-24 9:20A.M. CEST Update:
The maintenance for July 10th has been completed. Thank you for your patience throughout.
----------------------------------------------

Maintenance has been extended by One hour.
We apologize for the inconvenience this may cause, and will bring the servers up as soon as possible.
--------------------------------------------------------

We're going to perform a regular maintenance today, July 24th 2024, at 4:00 A.M. CEST. All servers during this period will be unavailable and we are anticipating the maintenance to conclude at around 8:30 A.M. CEST. Please refer below for more details on the maintenance.

[h1][b]Time Frame[/b][/h1][list][*]Wednesday, July 24th, 2024
[*]SEA (UTC+7): 9:00 A.M. – 2:30 P.M.
[*]CEST: 4:00 A.M. – 9:30 A.M.
[*]ET: 23rd, 10:00 P.M. – 24th, 03:30 A.M.
[*]PT: 23rd, 7:00 P.M. –  24th, 00:30 P.M.
[*][i][b]Note[/b]: Please note that the estimated length of time for each maintenance is subject to change without notification.[/i][/list]

[h1][b]Maintenance Details[/b][/h1]
[list][*]New Content & Events.[/list]
Thank you for your understanding and support in advance.

- The CSN:S Team

notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: July 10th
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/53f2861cac2ad81ce3fc22be129305ae3b6d7cfa.jpg[/img]

Here's a rundown of some of the major updates in today's patch!

[list][b][*]Windwalker Celebration Daily Play Event (7/10 - 8/7)[/b]Obtain Windwalker Fragments by logging in and playing for 30 minutes during the event period. The more login days, the greater the reward stages.

[b][*]New Refined Weapon Giveaway (7/10 - 7/24)[/b]Get new classic weapon just by playing!

[b][*]Zombie Hero Rebalance (Beta) Exclusive Map Weapon Supply Event (7/10 - 7/24)[/b]Weapons based on the day of the week will be available for use in Zombie Hero Rebalance (Beta) exclusive maps during the event period.

[b][*]Bonus Disassembly Event (7/10 - 7/24)[/b]Participate in the Bonus Disassembly Event by clicking "Bonus Disassembly" at the bottom of the Lobby. During the event, 10 players can select the weapons they want to disassemble, with one lucky player receiving extra mileage. Participants can get 500 mileage for each weapon they disassemble.

[b][*]New Weapon Paint Promotion (7/10 - 8/7)[/b]Once the promotion ends, the 2 new weapon paints will be permanently available from the Weapon Paints Decoder planned to release on 8/7.

[b][*]New Transcendence Class (Millia and Karin) Promotion (7/10 - 8/7)[/b]Two new Transcendence Classes (Millia and Karin) will make a special appearance in Class Decoders and Premium Class Decoders during the event.

[b][*]Transcendence Weapon Promotion (7/10 - 8/7)[/b]Drakar I and Drakar III will make a special appearance during the event in the [Drakar Decoder][/list]

Check out the following sections for more information.

[h1]---------- Details ----------[/h1]

[h2]Update Information[/h2]

[h3]Zombie Hero Rebalance (Beta) Announcements[/h3]
[list][*]Zombie Hero Rebalance (Beta) Changes
[list][*]Evolved Reinforced Host Zombie's duration increased
[*] When the Human Team wins several times in a row, the number of Evolved Reinforced Hosts will increase
[*] Removed First Aid Kit drops when a zombie dies
[*] Changed Human Movement Speed applied from Morale Boost only applies when there's an Evolved Reinforced Host Zombie present
[*] Damage reduction, knockback, and reduced stun when using Enraged Reinforced Host Zombie's skills have been buffed.
[*] Enraged Reinforced Host Zombie's duration increased
[*] Changed First Aid Kit drops when Evolved Reinforced Host Zombie dies to Special Supply Box drop[/list][/list]


[h3]New Weapon Information[/h3]
[list][*]New Weapon List
[list][*]Dual Kriss (Refined)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/b8caec4a406ae309c393dce3255408901e796c36.png[/img]
[*] MG36 (Refined)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/39128df2115f2520fbc421be2e138c0e900f685c.png[/img]
[*] The 2 Refined weapons are new weapons that can be enhanced up to +8, can equip parts, and can be used within New Classic and New Classic (Zombie) weapon restrictions.[/list][/list]


Event Information

[h3]Windwalker Celebration Daily Play Event (7/10 - 8/7)[/h3]
Obtain Windwalker Fragments by logging in and playing for 30 minutes during the event period. The more login days, the greater the reward stages.

[list][*]Cumulative Login Reward
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/fc4a6c98e4561ecff70f92fe18227e1a05faf146.png[/img]
[list][*]1 Day: Windwalker Fragment x1 + Point Transcendence Decoder x1 + Point Class Decoder x1 + 500 Mileage Coupon x1
[*] 2 Days: Windwalker Fragment x1 + Point Transcendence Decoder x1 + Point Class Decoder x1 + 500 Mileage Coupon x1
[*] 3 Days: Windwalker Fragment x2 + Point Transcendence Decoder x2 + Point Class Decoder x2 + 500 Mileage Coupon x2
[*] 4 Days: Windwalker Fragment x2 + Point Transcendence Decoder x2 + Point Class Decoder x2 + 500 Mileage Coupon x2
[*] 5 Days: Windwalker Fragment x3 + Point Transcendence Decoder x3 + Point Class Decoder x3 + 500 Mileage Coupon x3
[*] 6 Days: Windwalker Fragment x3 + Point Transcendence Decoder x3 + Point Class Decoder x3 + 500 Mileage Coupon x3
[*] 7 Days: Windwalker Fragment x6 + Point Transcendence Decoder x4 + Point Class Decoder x4 + 500 Mileage Coupon x4
[*] 8 Days: Windwalker Fragment x6 + Point Transcendence Decoder x4 + Point Class Decoder x4 + 500 Mileage Coupon x4
[*] 9 Days: Windwalker Fragment x8 + Point Transcendence Decoder x5 + Point Class Decoder x5 + 500 Mileage Coupon x5
[*] 10 Days: Windwalker Fragment x8 + Point Transcendence Decoder x5 + Point Class Decoder x5 + 500 Mileage Coupon x5
[*] 11 Days: Windwalker Fragment x10 + Point Transcendence Decoder x6 + Point Class Decoder x6 + 500 Mileage Coupon x6
[*] 12 Days: Windwalker Fragment x10 + Point Transcendence Decoder x6 + Point Class Decoder x6 + 500 Mileage Coupon x6[/list][/list]

[list][*]Misc.
[list][*]The amount of Windwalker Fragments that can be earned during the event period will be limited to 60.
[*] Once you receive a Windwalker (Permanent), you'll no longer receive any Windwalker Fragments.
[*] New and returning players get 2 times the Windwalker Fragments. (Up to 120)
[*] All Windwalker Fragments will be removed during maintenance on 8/7.[/list][/list]


[h3]Windwalker Fragment Collection Event (7/10 - 8/7)[/h3]
Participate in special missions during the event period to get Windwalker Fragments.

[list][*]Participation
[list][*]Earn 1 Windwalker Fragment for every 8 Kill Points by zombie kills or assists as a human, or infections as a zombie in Zombie Mode (up to 16 Windwalker Fragments per day).
[*] Earn 2 Windwalker Fragments each time you clear 1 session by reaching 100 Kill Points in Zombie Scenario mode on Hard difficulty or higher (up to 16 Windwalker Fragments per day).
[*] Every 10 minutes of playtime: 2 Windwalker Fragments (up to 4 per day)
[*] Maximum Special Mission Points: 20 (per day)[/list][/list]

[list][*]How to Earn Kill Points
[list][*]Zombie Kills as a Human: 3 Points (bots excluded)
[*] Zombie Assists as a Human: 1 Point (bots excluded)
[*] Human Infections as a Zombie: 4 Points (bots excluded)
[*] Human Infection Assists as Zombie: 0 Points[/list][/list]

[list][*]Misc.
[list][*]You can obtain up to 20 Windwalker Fragments per day.
[*] Once you receive a Windwalker (Permanent), you'll no longer receive any Windwalker Fragments.
[*] All Windwalker Fragments will be removed during maintenance on 8/7.
[*] You can earn playtime in all modes, including Studio Mode.
[*] Besides playtime, in-game missions do not count towards participation in Studio Mode.
[*] You can only participate in rooms with 3 or more players.
[*] Autohunt kills are excluded regardless of mode.
[*] Compatible Zombie Modes: Zombie Classic / Zombie Mutant / Zombie Hero / Zombie Z / Zombie Evolution
[*] Excluded Zombie Scenario Maps: Double Gate / Lost City / Survival: Trap / Survival: Groundwater / Pursuit: Chaos
[*] You must play for at least 5 minutes to get credit for Zombie Scenario mode missions.[/list][/list]


[h3]Windwalker Acquisition Event (7/10 - 8/7)[/h3]
Collect 300 Windwalker Fragments during the event to obtain the Windwalker (Permanent)!

[list][*]Reward per # of Fragments
[list][*]First Login: Windwalker (1 Day)
[*] 20 Fragments: Windwalker (15 Days) + Rare Decoder x5
[*] 50 Fragments: Event Decoder x5 + Zombie Damage Meter (7 Days)
[*] 100 Fragments: Unique Decoder x10 + Grade 4 Parts Reward Box x5
[*] 150 Fragments: Event Decoder x10 + 50 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x5
[*] 200 Fragments: Class Decoder x10 + 100 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x5
[*] 250 Fragments: Transcendence Decoder x10 + 200 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x5
[*] 300 Fragments: Windwalker (Permanent)
[*] Event Decoders can be used until midnight of the day they were obtained and are removed afterwards.[/list][/list]

[list][*]Windwalker
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/ee2aad7ed8708a478c50f6b347a0b275185e94b2.png[/img]
[list][*]A Secondary Weapon that uses 40-shuriken cartridges. It can either launch the shurikens to deal damage in an area, or deal damage in a cone in front of you.[/list][/list]


[h3]New Refined Weapon Giveaway (7/10 - 7/24)[/h3]
Get new classic weapon just by playing!
Reach 30 minutes of playtime every day during the event period to receive new Zombie Classic weapons and other fabulous rewards!

[list][*]Rewards per Playtime
[list][*]1x: Rare Decoder x5 + 50 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x1
[*] 2x: Rare Decoder x7 + 50 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x2
[*] 3x: Rare Decoder x10 + 100 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x1 + Dual Kriss (Refined) (Permanent)
[*] 4x: Event Decoder x5 + 100 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x2
[*] 5x: Event Decoder x10 + 200 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x2 + MG 36 (Refined) (Permanent)[/list][/list]

[list][*]Misc.
[list][*]Can be earned up to 1x a day.
[*] You can only participate in rooms with 3 or more players.
[*] Event Decoders can be used until midnight of the day they were obtained and are removed afterwards.[/list][/list]


[h3]Zombie Hero Rebalance (Beta) Exclusive Map Weapon Supply Event (7/10 - 7/24)[/h3]
Weapons based on the day of the week will be available for use in Zombie Hero Rebalance (Beta) exclusive maps during the event period.

[list][*]Primary Weapon: Failnaught/Hyper Gaebolg/Devastator
[*] Secondary Weapon: Lightning Fury
[*] Melee Weapon: Demolition Hammer/Spell Lance Scarlet Rose/Holy Sword Divine Order
[*] Equipment: Hellhound/Satellite Mine/Trinity Grenade[/list]

[list][*]Misc.
[list][*]You'll get one Primary Weapon, Secondary Weapon, Melee Weapon, and Equipment based on probabilities for each.
[*] Trial Weapons can only be used in Zombie Hero Rebalance (Beta) Exclusive Maps.
[*] Regardless of when you receive them, the available weapons will change every day at midnight.[/list][/list]


[h3]Zombie Hero Rebalance (Beta) Exclusive Map Play Event (7/10 - 7/24)[/h3]
You can receive rewards by completing the following conditions in Zombie Hero Rebalance (Beta) Maps during the event period.

[list][*]Conditions / Rewards
[list][*]Reach 60 minutes played on Rebalanced Dust/Rebalanced Assault/Rebalanced Italy maps and score 60 kill points to earn Zombie Hero Supply Box x1 (Contains one of 71 weapons including Devastator, Holy Sword Divine Order, and Lightning Fury 
based on probabilities for each.)[/list][/list]

[list][*]Misc.
[list][*]Zombie Hero Supply Box can be collected only once per account.[/list][/list]


[h3]Zombie Hero Rebalance (Beta) Exclusive Map Guides Event (7/10 - 7/24)[/h3]
Share your tips for the Rebalance maps and win Steam Gift Cards!
For more information, please check the Notice.


[h3]New and Returning Players Welcome Event Returns! (7/10 - Permanent)[/h3]
The New and Returning Players Welcome Event is back, welcoming all new and returning players to Counter Strike Online! Stay logged in for 10 minutes during the event to earn rewards!

[list][*]Daily Rewards
[list][*]Day 1: Event Decoder x1 + 500 Mileage
[*] Day 2: Event Decoder x2 + 1,000 Mileage
[*] Day 3: Event Decoder x3 + 1,500 Mileage
[*] Day 4: Event Decoder x4 + 2,000 Mileage
[*] Day 5: Event Decoder x5 + 2,500 Mileage
[*] Day 6: Event Decoder x6 + 3,000 Mileage
[*] Day 7: Event Decoder x7 + Transcendence Weapon Pass (2 Days)[/list][/list]

[list][*]Misc.
[list][*]Rewards can be earned only once per account.
[*] Only new or returning players (more than 30 days of inactivity) can participate in this event.
[*] Event Decoders can be used until midnight of the day they were obtained and are removed afterwards.[/list][/list]


[h3]Bonus Disassembly Event (7/10 - 7/24)[/h3]
Participate in the Bonus Disassembly Event by clicking Bonus Disassembly at the bottom of the Lobby. During the event, 10 players can select the weapons they want to disassemble, with one lucky player receiving extra mileage. Participants can get 500 mileage for each weapon they disassemble.

[list][*]Details
[list][*]Weekdays and Weekends - 2:00 PM – 6:00 PM CEST
[*] Minimum Participation Mileage: 5,000
[*] Some items will be adjusted based on the weapon rarity.
[*] Table ranks are ordered highest value first.
[*] Weapon criteria are determined the day the Bonus Disassembly Event starts. If the weapon's rank changes, its value in the Bonus Disassembly Event will also change.
[*] New items for disassembly: Pulse Reactor, Windwalker, Dual Kriss (Refined), MG36 (Refined)[/list][/list]


[h3]Al-Hijra Event (7/10 - 7/24)[/h3]
Complete missions during the event to earn rewards.

[list][*]Event Participation Requirements
[list][*]Log-in to earn an Event Decoder (once per day)
Earn 1 point each time you play for 20/40/60 minutes (up to 3 points per day).[/list][/list]

[list][*]Point Rewards
[list][*]3 Points: Rare Decoder x10
[*] 9 Points: Unique Decoder x8
[*] 15 Points: Unique Premium Decoder x5
[*] 18 Points: 10,000 Mileage Coupon x3
[*] 21 Points: Class Decoder x5
[*] 27 points: Transcendence Decoder x7
[*] 30 Points: Moonlight Evening Nameplate (300 Days) x1
[*] 33 points: Transcendence Decoder x10
[*] 36 Points: Class Decoder x10[/list][/list]

[list][*]Misc.
[list][*]Can participate in Studio Mode 
[*] Can participate in Laboratory Mode
[*] Player Requirement: 3
[*] You can earn up to 3 points a day.
[*] Cumulative reward can be obtained only once per account.[/list][/list]

[h3]Mission Chain Returns (7/10 - 1/22)[/h3]
[list][*]Notice
[list][*]Contents of the guide will be updated.
[*] Mission Chain rewards consisting of 25 guides and 25 missions will be changed.
[*] You can only clear one stage (5 guides and 5 missions) of the Mission Chain a day.[/list][/list]

[list][*]Mission Final Completion Rewards (By Stage)
[list][*]Stage 1: Miracle Prism Sword (Permanent)
[*] Stage 2: Grade 5 Parts Reward Box (3)
[*] Stage 3: Rose Phoenix (Permanent)
[*] Stage 4: 3,000 Mileage Coupon (1)
[*] Stage 5: Dual Beretta Gunslinger (Permanent)
[*] Mission Final Completion Rewards: Star Chaser SR (Permanent) + Complete the Guide Medal + Player Settlement Support Box[/list][/list]

[list][*]Other Changes
[list][*]Banner Reward Weapons and Schedule will be updated.
[*] Added 'Not Applicable' to the inventory descriptions of any locked <Enhancement Material/Disassembly> items.
[*] Reward Notifications will be updated.
[*] Added content regarding the distribution of discount coupons for the upcoming season after reaching Season Pass 100.
[*] Added the phrase: 'You can clear one stage per day.'[/list][/list]


[h3]Login Supplies Event (7/10 - 7/23)[/h3]
Logging in during the event will give you daily and cumulative rewards!

[list][*]Daily Login Rewards: Daily Weapons Supply
[list][*]Daily Supply Contents
[*] Receive all four of the following items: Dual Sword Phantom Slayer (1 Day), M3 Black Dragon (1 Day), Barrett M95 White Tiger (1 Day), and M249 Phoenix (1 Day).
[*] Two Rare, Unique, or Transcendence weapons (1 Day) have a chance of appearing in the Daily Supply.
[*] One Transcendence Class (1 Day) has a chance to be included.
[*] You will receive all the contents of the Daily Attendance Reward Box.[/list][/list]

[list][*]Details
[list][*]Transcendence Classes (1 Day): Dorothy Dark Knight, Flora Paladin, Transcendence Ji Yoon Choi, Transcendence Yuri, Sonya Lycanthrope, Elizabeth Crimson Hunter, Transcendence Michaela, Transcendence Fernando, Transcendence Blair, and Rose Phoenix
[*] Daily Attendance Reward Box: Damage Display (1 Day), Killer Display (1 Day), Penalty and Loss Invalidation, and Rare Decoder (x3)
[*] All weapons and classes from the Daily Supply are bound and cannot be used for Auction/Disassembly/Family Storage (Extension X).[/list][/list]

[list][*]Total Rewards
[list][*]4 Days: Psychic Harmonium (10 Days) & Cumulative Attendance Reward Box x1
[*] 8 Days: NEGEV NG-7 Ajax (10 Days) & Cumulative Attendance Reward Box x1
[*] 12 Days: Lightning Fury (10 Days) & Cumulative Attendance Reward Box x1[/list][/list]

[list][*]Details
[list][*]Cumulative Attendance Reward Box contents: C4 Countdown Room Host (5 Days), Shorten Respawn Time (5 Days) Lucky Gunslinger (5 Days), Daily Mission Difficulty Change x15, Exploration Slot Expansion Coupon (7 Days)
[*] Attendance rewards will be provided directly as rewards instead of Daily/Cumulative Attendance Reward Box items.
[*] Rewards can be claimed immediately after game login, and rewards are available until midnight every day.[/list][/list]


Shop Update

[h3]New Weapon Paint Promotion (7/10 - 8/7)[/h3]
Once the promotion ends, the 2 new weapon paints will be permanently available from the Weapon Paints Decoder planned to release on 8/7.

[list][*]Gold Tiger Weapon Paint
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/6bf05504368e2cfa8879501ab525ecf56e13df4a.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/cbe2317995e3062f3fae895af2cbfbdc20a61a6a.png[/img]
[list][*]Show Weapon: Quantum Horizon[/list][/list]

[list][*]Silver Tiger Weapon Paint
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/a61984aea3df34e34662c3efa64a54470a63caaa.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/475cf9fb1df29039d83fe711e0bca3d174c9423a.png[/img]
[list][*]Show Weapon: Special Duck Foot Gun[/list][/list]


[h3]New Transcendence Class (Millia and Karin) Promotion (7/10 - 8/7)[/h3]
Two new Transcendence Classes (Millia and Karin) will make a special appearance in Class Decoders and Premium Class Decoders during the event.

[list][*]Probability
[list][*]Premium Class Decoder: Millia and Karin each have a 2% chance to appear.
[*] Class Decoder: Millia and Karin each have a 0.5% chance to appear.
[*] Acquiring Millia will automatically provide Pillow Fairy (Permanent).
[*] Acquiring Karin will automatically provide Small Ember (Permanent).[/list][/list]

[list][*]Millia
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/f090b17636377b63a5d899ec433160605c9ad188.png[/img]
[list][*]A fairy of sleep who was slumbering peacefully in her forest, until Karin dragged her into this world. She's happy being anywhere she can catch a nap, but she does think this new world is better for rest. It may seem like she's always dozing, but she works hard behind the scenes of a lot of situations.
[*] Transcendence Class CT
[*] Transcendence Class exclusive voices applied.
[*] Paired Weapon: Drakar Ⅰ, Ⅱ, Ⅲ
[list][*] - Increased <Tempest Slash> damage
[*]  - Decreased number of bullets hit needed to increase gun stage[/list]
[*] Zombie Scenario Skill: Rest Time
[list][*] - Increased Passive: Critical Strike slightly and decreased Damage Taken slightly when playing in Zombie Scenario mode with Karin (Connection effect applied, cannot be stacked).
[list][*]                 Applies the Heavy Steps Add-On Effect (This can be stacked, which increases the effect)
[*]                  Applies 8% Additional Damage for Elite zombies and 4% Additional Damage for Boss zombies.[/list][/list]
[list][*] - Active: Provides a buff that continuously heals you and allies, and grants a special barrier effect when activated.
[list][*]                  If the barrier breaks before it expires, it grants an Attack Power buff.
[*]                   If the barrier does not break, it grants an HP Recovery buff.[/list][/list]
[*] +10% EXP/Points

[*] In Zombie Scenario mode, this character has a higher max level than normal classes.
[*] This character adds 1 initial mutation in Zombie Z Mode.
[*] This character shows your current damage at the bottom of the screen.
[*] This character leaves a unique mark at the target location upon killing an enemy.
[*] Marks Zombies at 20% HP or below in Zombie Mode.[/list][/list]

[list][*]Karin
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/af536634f2dd69de28f1f272fd6e9663679e8e00.png[/img]
[list][*]A fairy who came to this world out of curiosity after watching Nyx and Skadi disappear. She said she's looking for a way back, but currently she's spending her days learning about the new world and dealing with the attention she receives. She's always creating commotions with her confidence, but little does she know that Millia is looking after her behind her back.
[*] Transcendence Class TR
[*] Transcendence Class exclusive voices applied.
[*] Paired Weapon: Drakar Ⅰ, Ⅱ, Ⅲ
[list][*] - Increased <Tempest Slash> damage
[*]  - Increased <Tempest Slash> attack range[/list]
[*] Zombie Scenario Skill: Baptism of Fire
[list][*] - Increased Passive: Critical Strike slightly and decreased Damage Taken slightly when playing in Zombie Scenario mode with Millia (Connection effect applied, cannot be stacked).
[list][*]                  Applies the Explosive Ammo Add-On Effect (This can be stacked, which increases the effect)
[*]                   Applies 8% Additional Damage for Elite zombies and 4% Additional Damage for Boss zombies.[/list][/list]
[*]  - Active: Provides an infinite ammo buff and special barrier effect.
[list][*]                  If the barrier breaks before it expires, it grants a movement speed buff.
[*]                   If the barrier does not break, it grants an Attack Power buff.[/list]
[*] +10% EXP/Points
[*] In Zombie Scenario mode, this character has a higher max level than normal classes.
[*] This character adds 1 initial mutation in Zombie Z Mode.
[*] This character shows your current damage at the bottom of the screen.
[*] This character leaves a unique mark at the target location upon killing an enemy.
[*] Marks Zombies at 20% HP or below in Zombie Mode.[/list][/list]


[h3]New Transcendence Class (Millia and Karin) Guaranteed Giveaway (7/10 - 8/7)[/h3]
Get two new guaranteed Transcendence Classes (Millia and Karin) based on how many Class Decoders and Premium Class Decoders are used during the event!

[list][*]Conditions and Rewards
[list][*]After reaching 150 Guaranteed Points earned by using a Decoder.
[*] After reaching 300 Guaranteed Points earned by using a Decoder.
[*] Select either: Millia+Pillow Fairy or Karin+Small Ember[/list][/list]

[list][*]Details
[list][*]One Guaranteed Point is awarded each time you use a Class Decoder.
[*] Three Guaranteed Points are awarded when you use a Premium Class Decoder.
[*] Guaranteed Giveaway rewards can only be collected once per account.
[*] Selecting Millia will automatically provide Pillow Fairy (Permanent).
[*] Selecting Karin will automatically provide Small Ember (Permanent).[/list][/list]


[h3]New Transcendence Class Medal Giveaway (7/10 - 8/7)[/h3]
When you own all items in the new Transcendence Classes set, you will receive the Transcendence Class medal.

[list][*]Conditions and Items
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/f414f15d14f8d6bcd98228495f6c04ae16835448.png[/img]

[h3]Class Decoder Package Sale Promotion (7/10 - 8/7)[/h3]
Two new Spray types + Class Decoder Package will be on sale during the event.

[list][*]Package Contents

[list][*]Decoder
[list][*]Drakar Decoder[/list][/list]

[list][*]Type: Primary Weapon (Unique)
[*] Description: A Viking-inspired tactical rifle that fires 60 rounds of 5.56mm bullets. Charge the gauge by hitting enemies and use it to increase the firearm's stage. Reloading will grant special ammo, and the firearm's stage will increase or decrease depending on the gauge amount. Use the special ammo to inflict damage to enemies in range for a short time.

[*] 85 mileage will be given for each Drakar Decoder removed.

[h3]Transcendence Weapon Guaranteed Giveaway (7/10 - 8/7)[/h3]

[list][*]Conditions

[*] Score 6 Kill Points by kills or assists (bots excluded for both) as a human in Zombie Mode: 1 Mission Point (up to 20 Mission Points per account)

[list][*]Cumulative Rewards

[list][*]Notice

[*] Playtime missions can be completed in all modes.

[h3]Drakar Upgrade Event (7/10 - 8/7)[/h3]
Based on the number of Drakar I's collected during the event, they will be upgraded to Drakar II or Drakar III (Permanent).

[list][*]Conditions
[list][*]Collect Drakar I (Permanent) x3 to obtain Drakar II (Permanent)
[*] Collect Drakar I (Permanent) x7 to obtain Drakar III (Permanent)[/list][/list]

[list][*]Drakar III
[list][*]Type: Primary Weapon (Unique-Part)

Reloading while the gauge is at max will increase the firearm's stage, however, if the gauge is not full, it will decrease instead. The weapon's performance changes every two stages, and reloading gives you special ammo that inflicts damage to enemies in range for a short time.[/list][/list]

notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: June 26th
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/05ac9bcd6186c50a6f36e12817fbaf0e5c4f5492.jpg[/img]
Here's a rundown of some of the major updates in today's patch!

[list][b][*]Extreme Challenge Event(6/26 - 7/10)[/b]Earn CP (CSO Event Coins) by completing missions during the event.

[b][*]Try The Counter Exchange CP Event! (6/26 - 7/10)[/b]Earn CP (CSO Event Coins) by completing missions during the event.

[b][*]Zombie Hero Rebalance (Beta) Exclusive Map Weapon Supply Event (6/26 - 7/10)[/b]Weapons based on the day of the week will be available for use in Zombie Hero Rebalance (Beta) exclusive maps during the event period.

[b][*]Summer Strike Decoder Released (6/26 - 7/10)[/b]Join the Summer Strike Decoder event in celebration of summer! Get Transcendence Weapons and Transcendence Classes![/list]

Check out the following sections for all the details.

[h1]---------- Details ----------[/h1]

[h2]Update Information[/h2]

[h3]Mode Changes[/h3]
[list][*]Zombie Hero Mode
[list][*]After the 2-week beta period, Zombie Hero Rebalance (Beta) has switched back to the original Zombie Hero mode. An exclusive Zombie Hero RebBeta) map will be released.[/list][/list]


[h3]New Map Information[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/2db666ec47678472371a6eabaed4a8f382b3eced.png[/img]
[list][*]Beachside Palace
[list][*]Location: Asian Palace
[*] Eligible Modes: Zombie (Zombie Classic, Zombie Mutant, Zombie Hero, Zombie Z, Zombie Evolution), Deathmatch (Deathmatch, Team Deathmatch, Deathmatch (AI), Team Deathmatch (AI)), Gun Deathmatch, All-Star, Original, Original (AI)[/list][/list]

[list][*]Zombie Hero Rebalance (Beta) Exclusive Map
[list][*]Eligible Mode: Zombie Hero
[*] Eligible Maps: 
[list][*]Rebalanced Dust 
[*] Rebalanced Assault 
[*] Rebalanced Italy[/list][/list][/list]


[h2]Event Information[/h2]

[h3]Extreme Challenge Event(6/26 - 7/10)[/h3]
Earn CP (CSO Event Coins) by completing missions during the event.

[list][*]Play Missions
[list][*]Earn 90 CP by reaching 3,000 Kill Points from zombie kills or assists as a human, or infections as a zombie in Zombie Mode (up to 500 CP per day).
[*] Earn 90 CP by clearing 150 sessions with 100 Kill Points in Zombie Scenario mode on Hard difficulty or higher (up to 25 sessions per day).
[*] Maximum CP Earned: 90 CP
[*] How to Earn Kill Points
[list][*]Zombie Kills as a Human: 3 Points (bots excluded)
[*] Zombie Assists as a Human: 1 Point (bots excluded)
[*] Human Infections as a Zombie: 4 Points (bots excluded)
[*] Human Infection Assists as Zombie: 0 Points[/list][/list][/list]

[list][*]Consecutive Attendance
[list][*]3-Day Consecutive Attendance: 10 CP
[*] 5-Day Consecutive Attendance: 10 CP
[*] 7-Day Consecutive Attendance: 30 CP
[*] Maximum CP Earned: 50 CP[/list][/list]

[list][*]Details
[list][*]Only one of the play mission rewards can be claimed. (Can earn up to 90 CP)
[*] Consecutive Attendance: Failing to check in on consecutive days will reset your progress.
[*] You can earn playtime in all modes, including Studio Mode.
[*] Besides playtime, in-game missions do not count towards participation in Studio Mode.
[*] You can only participate in rooms with 3 or more players.
[*] Autohunt kills are excluded regardless of mode.
[*] Compatible Zombie Modes: Zombie Classic / Zombie Mutant / Zombie Hero / Zombie Z / Zombie Evolution
[*] Excluded Zombie Scenario Maps: Double Gate / Lost City / Survival: Trap / Survival: Groundwater / Pursuit: Chaos
[*] You must play for at least 5 minutes to get credit for Zombie Scenario mode missions.[/list][/list]


[h3]Try The Counter Exchange CP Event! (6/26 - 7/10)[/h3]
Earn CP (CSO Event Coins) by completing missions during the event.

[list][*]New Items Added
[list][*]Wild Sheriff's Hat: Costs 5 CP/Unlocked at 160 CP/Can be exchanged once
[*] Nine-tailed Fox Ears: Costs 5 CP/Unlocked at 160 CP/Can be exchanged once
[*] Pirate Hat: Costs 5 CP/Unlocked at 160 CP/Can be exchanged once
[*] Wanderer's Veil Hat: Costs 5 CP/Unlocked at 160 CP/Can be exchanged once[/list][/list]

[list][*]How to Participate
[list][*]Earn 1 CP for every 15 Kill Points from zombie kills or assists as a human, or infections as a zombie in Zombie Mode (up to 8 CP per day).
[*] Clear 1 session after scoring 100 Kill Points in Zombie Scenario mode on Hard or higher: 1 CP (up to 8 CP per day)
[*] Every 20 minutes of in-game playtime: 1 CP (up to 2 CP per day)
[*] Earn 1 CP when you complete 2 of the following missions (up to 1 CP per day):
[list][*]Click on the Event Missions tab to check your Event Missions.
[*] Purchase a Point Transcendence Decoder or a Point Class Decoder from the Shop.
[*] Go on an Exploration once.[/list][/list][/list]

[list][*]How to Earn Kill Points
[list][*]Zombie Kills as a Human: 3 Points (bots excluded)
[*] Zombie Assists as a Human: 1 Point (bots excluded)
[*] Human Infections as a Zombie: 4 Points (bots excluded)
[*] Human Infection Assists as Zombie: 0 Points[/list][/list]

[list][*]Details
[list][*]You can earn up to 10 CP a day.
[*] Daily Missions reset every day at midnight.
[*] You can earn playtime in all modes, including Studio Mode.
[*] Besides playtime, in-game missions do not count towards participation in Studio Mode.
[*] You can only participate in rooms with 3 or more players.
[*] Autohunt kills are excluded regardless of mode.
[*] Compatible Zombie Modes: Zombie Classic / Zombie Mutant / Zombie Hero / Zombie Z / Zombie Evolution
[*] Excluded Zombie Scenario Maps: Double Gate / Lost City / Survival: Trap / Survival: Groundwater / Pursuit: Chaos
[*] You must play for at least 5 minutes to get credit for Zombie Scenario mode missions.
[*] All CP will be removed during maintenance on 7/10.[/list][/list]


[h3]Zombie Hero Rebalance (Beta) Exclusive Map Weapon Supply Event (6/26 - 7/10)[/h3]
Weapons based on the day of the week will be available for use in Zombie Hero Rebalance (Beta) exclusive maps during the event period.

[list][*]Available Weapons
[list][*]Primary Weapon: Failnaught/Hyper Gaebolg/Devastator
[*] Secondary Weapon: Lightning Fury/Laevateinn/Twin Hawk
[*] Melee Weapon: Demolition Hammer/Spell Lance Scarlet Rose/Holy Sword Divine Order
[*] Equipment: Hellhound/Satellite Mine/Trinity Grenade[/list][/list]

[list][*]Details
[list][*]You'll get one Primary Weapon, Secondary Weapon, Melee Weapon, and Equipment based on probabilities for each.
[*] Trial weapons are only available in Zombie Hero (Beta).
[*] Regardless of when you receive them, the available weapons will change every day at midnight.[/list][/list]


[h2]Shop update[/h2]

[h3]Summer Strike Decoder Released (6/26 - 7/10)[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/f9567e91c43de9a51747987b7130842ffb2e14cb.png[/img]
Join the Summer Strike Decoder event in celebration of summer! Get Transcendence Weapons and Transcendence Classes!

[list][*]Main Item Rates
[list][*]Hellhound (Permanent) 0.225% 
[*] Laevateinn (Permanent) 0.225% 
[*] Roy (Permanent) 0.225% [/list][/list]

[list][*]Misc.
[list][*]Please refer to the item rates announcement for details.
[*] Each unused Summer Strike Decoder will be replaced with 15 mileage on the day the promotion ends. [/list][/list]


[h2]Other Information[/h2]
1. Zombie Hero Rebalance (Beta) Changes
 - Changed the Zombie respawn effect color.
 - Added Zombie Rage Gauge UI flashing feature when evolving into an Enraged Reinforced Host.
 - Fixed the Evolved Reinforced Host Zombie icon error.
 - Fixed an error in which some weapons could inflict knockback/stun to Evolved Reinforced Host while using skills.
2. Fixed an error where equipped costumes were not displaying in Zombie Hero mode.

Here's a rundown of some of the major updates in today's patch!

[b][*]New Transcendence Weapon "Pulse Reactor" Promotion (6/15 - 7/10)[/b]The Pulse Reactor can drop from the Transcendence Premium Decoder and Transcendence Decoder during the event.[/list]

Check out the following sections for more information.

[h1]---------- Details ----------[/h1]

[h2]Update Information[/h2]
[h3]Zombie Hero Rebalance (Beta)[/h3]
Newly Evolved Zombies! Face the Humans!
Zombie Hero Rebalance Update!

The Zombie Rebalance will run as a beta test for 2 weeks.
During the beta period, there'll be a survey event to gather your opinions,
so we'd appreciate it if you could share your valuable feedback on the rebalance.
After the 2-week beta period, we'll switch back to the original Zombie Hero mode
and release a new Zombie Rebalancing exclusive map, so get ready!

For details, please refer to the Zombie Hero Rebalance (Beta) Preview.

[list][*]Evolved Reinforced Host Zombie
[list][*]A new zombie with otherworldly powers has appeared!
[*] It boasts a very high Defense, as well as immunity to knockback and stuns.
[*] Its skills are also greatly enhanced, making it a dangerous foe indeed.
[*] The Evolved Reinforced Hosts owe their extraordinary power to otherworldly energy, but have lost the ability to infect in return. Their attacks will inflict bleeding instead of infection.
[*] Humans suffering this new status must find First Aid Kits scattered across the map to stop the bleeding.
[*] The Evolved Reinforced Host is the first Host Zombie that appears when the round begins. After enough time passes, their otherworldly power will fade.[/list][/list]

[list][*]Enraged Reinforced Host Zombie
[list][*]This is a new type of zombie which evolves from the Reinforced Host via the Rage gauge.
[*] The Rage gauge starts draining as soon as the Enraged Reinforced Host emerges. It will return to the Reinforced Host state once the gauge is empty.
[*] While enraged, its HP and Armor are greatly increased, and it gains extremely strong defensive stats and skills.[/list][/list]

[list][*]Zombie Respawn Effect Enhancement
[list][*]Respawn effects for zombies have been enhanced!
[*] The respawn effect duration is increased, and zombies will also enjoy reductions to knockback, stuns, and damage taken.[/list][/list]

[list][*]Special Supply Boxes
[list][*]Special Supply Boxes will appear that give immediate access to the Sidekick Shop.[/list][/list]

[list][*]Automatic Rage Gauge Gains
[list][*]The Rage gauge will automatically fill as time passes.[/list][/list]


[h2]Event Information[/h2]

[h3]Zombie Rebalancing Survey Event (6/12 - 6/26)[/h3]
You'll be able to participate in a survey regarding the zombie balances added in this update. After the survey ends, 50 players who have provided valuable feedback will receive rewards.

[list][*]Reward: Transcendence Decoder x30 (50 players)[/list]
[list][*]Winner Announcement and Reward Distribution: 7/10[/list]


[h3]Zombie Hero (Beta) Weapon Supply Event (6/12 - 6/26)[/h3]
In celebration of Zombie Team Rebalancing (Beta) update, weapons based on the day of the week will be available for use in Zombie Hero (Beta) during the event period.

[list][*]Primary Weapon: Failnaught/Hyper Gaebolg/Devastator
[*] Secondary Weapon: Lightning Fury/Laevateinn/Twin Hawk
[*] Melee Weapon: Demolition Hammer/Spell Lance Scarlet Rose/Holy Sword Divine Order
[*] Equipment: Hellhound/Satellite Mine/Trinity Grenade[/list]

[list][*]Details
[list][*]You'll get one Primary Weapon, Secondary Weapon, Melee Weapon, and Equipment based on probabilities for each.
[*] Trial weapons are only available in Zombie Hero (Beta).
[*] Regardless of when you receive them, the available weapons will change every day at midnight.[/list][/list]


[h3]Login Supplies Event (6/12 - 7/9)[/h3]
Logging in during the event will give you daily and cumulative rewards!

[list][*]Daily Login Rewards: Daily Weapons Supply
[list][*]Daily Supply Contents
[*] Receive all four of the following items: Dual Sword Phantom Slayer (1 Day), M3 Black Dragon (1 Day), Barrett M95 White Tiger (1 Day), and M249 Phoenix (1 Day).
[*] Two Rare, Unique, or Transcendence weapons (1 Day) have a chance of appearing in the Daily Supply.
[*] One Transcendence Class (1 Day) has a chance to be included.
[*] You will receive all the contents of the Daily Attendance Reward Box.[/list][/list]

[list][*]Details
[list][*]Transcendence Classes (1 Day): Dorothy Dark Knight, Flora Paladin, Transcendence Ji Yoon Choi, Transcendence Yuri, Sonya Lycanthrope, Elizabeth Crimson Hunter, Transcendence Michaela, Transcendence Fernando, Transcendence Blair, and Rose Phoenix
[*] Daily Attendance Reward Box: Damage Display (1 Day), Killer Display (1 Day), Penalty and Loss Invalidation, and Rare Decoder (x3)
[*] All weapons and classes from the Daily Supply are bound and cannot be used for Auction/Disassembly/Family Storage (Extension X).[/list][/list]

[list][*]Total Rewards
[list][*]5 Days: Psychic Harmonium (20 Days) & Cumulative Attendance Reward Box x1
[*] 10 Days: NEGEV NG-7 Ajax (20 Days) & Cumulative Attendance Reward Box x1
[*] 15 Days: Trinity Grenade (20 Days) & Cumulative Attendance Reward Box x1
[*] 20 Days: Lightning Fury (20 Days) & Cumulative Attendance Reward Box x1[/list][/list]

[list][*]Details
[list][*]Cumulative Attendance Reward Box contents: C4 Countdown Room Host (5 Days), Shorten Respawn Time (5 Days) Lucky Gunslinger (5 Days), Daily Mission Difficulty Change x15, Exploration Slot Expansion Coupon (7 Days)
[*] Attendance rewards will be provided directly as rewards instead of Daily/Cumulative Attendance Reward Box items.
[*] Rewards can be claimed immediately after game login, and rewards are available until midnight every day.[/list][/list]


[h3]Try The Counter Exchange CP Event! (6/12 - 7/10)[/h3]
Earn CP by completing missions during the event.

[list][*]New Items Added
[list][*]Devastator: Costs 20 CP/Unlocked at 210 CP/Can be exchanged once
[*] Sparkling Shores Nameplate (300 Days): Costs 5 CP/Unlocked at 50 CP/Can be exchanged once
[*] Summer Hunting Zombie Spray: Costs 5 CP/Unlocked at 50 CP/Can be exchanged once
[*] Ice Cream Cone: Costs 5 CP/Unlocked at 50 CP/Can be exchanged once
[*] Lotus Leaf Rice Mask: Costs 5 CP/Unlocked at 50 CP/Can be exchanged once[/list][/list]

[list][*]How to Participate
[list][*]Earn 1 CP for every 15 Kill Points from zombie kills or assists as a human, or infections as a zombie in Zombie Mode (up to 8 CP per day).
[*] Clear 1 session after scoring 100 Kill Points in Zombie Scenario mode on Hard or higher: 1 CP (up to 8 CP per day)
[*] Every 20 minutes of in-game playtime: 1 CP (up to 2 CP per day)
[*] Earn 1 CP when you complete 2 of the following missions (up to 1 CP per day):
[list][*]Click on the Event Missions tab to check your Event Missions.
[*] Purchase a Point Transcendence Decoder or a Point Class Decoder from the Shop.
[*]  Go on an Exploration once.[/list][/list][/list]

[list][*]How to Earn Kill Points
[list][*]Zombie Kills as a Human: 3 Points (bots excluded)
[*] Zombie Assists as a Human: 1 Point (bots excluded)
[*] Human Infections as a Zombie: 4 Points (bots excluded)
[*] Human Infection Assists as Zombie: 0 Points[/list][/list]

[list][*]Details
[list][*]You can earn up to 10 CP a day.
[*] Daily Missions reset every day at midnight.
[*] You can earn playtime in all modes, including Studio Mode.
[*] Besides playtime, in-game missions do not count towards participation in Studio Mode.
[*] You can only participate in rooms with 3 or more players.
[*] Autohunt kills are excluded regardless of mode.
[*] Compatible Zombie Modes: Zombie Classic / Zombie Mutant / Zombie Hero / Zombie Z / Zombie Evolution
[*] Excluded Zombie Scenario Maps: Double Gate / Lost City / Survival: Trap / Survival: Groundwater / Pursuit: Chaos
[*] You must play for at least 5 minutes to get credit for Zombie Scenario mode missions.
[*] All CP will be removed during maintenance on 7/10.[/list][/list]


[h3]Updates to the New/Returning Weapon Supply Box[/h3]
Rewards will given to new and returning players upon logging in during the event.

[list][*]Welcome Supply Box (15 Days/Bound)
[list][*]Trinity Grenade
[*] Infinity Laser Fist
[*] Dual Beretta Gunslinger
[*] Hunter-Killer X-90 (Vampiric Part - Grade 6 + Gun Boost Part - Grade 6)
[*] Hunter-Killer X-12 (Speed Up Part - Grade 6 + Gun Boost Part - Grade 6)
[*] +6 Dual UZI (Damage +3/Ammo +3)
[*] +8 Winchester M1887 Xmas Edition (Damage +2/Weight +2/Fire Rate +2/Ammo +2), (Knockback Up Part - Grade 6 + Gun Boost Part - Grade 6)
[*] +8 M95 Xmas Edition (Damage +2/Accuracy +2/Recoil +1/Ammo +3), (Speed Up Part - Grade 6 + Gun Boost Part - Grade 6)
[*] Tomahawk Xmas Edition (Speed Up Part - Grade 6 + Knife Reach Part - Grade 6)[/list][/list]

[list][*]Details

[h3]Return of the New and Returning Player Welcome Attendance Event[/h3]
Rewards are given to new and returning players after staying logged in for 10 minutes during the event.

[list][*]Login Reward
[list][*]Day 1: Event Decoder x1 + 500 Mileage
[*] Day 2: Event Decoder x2 + 1,000 Mileage
[*] Day 3: Event Decoder x3 + 1,500 Mileage
[*] Day 4: Event Decoder x4 + 2,000 Mileage
[*] Day 5: Event Decoder x5 + 2,500 Mileage
[*] Day 6: Event Decoder x6 + 3,000 Mileage
[*] Day 7: Event Decoder x7 + Epic Weapon Pass (2 Days)[/list][/list]

[list][*]Details
[list][*]Rewards can be claimed once per account.
[*] Returning players are those who have not logged in for 30 days or longer.
[*] Event Decoders can be used until midnight of the day they were obtained and are removed afterwards.[/list][/list]


[h3]Lotus Leaf Rice Grenade Giveaway (6/12 - 6/26)[/h3]
In celebration of the Dragon Boat Festival, get a Lotus Leaf Rice Grenade on your first login during the event period.

[list][*]Obtainable Items
[list][*]Lotus Leaf Rice Grenade
[*] During the event, the Lotus Leaf Rice Grenade can be used for free, but it will be removed during the 6/26 maintenance.[/list][/list]


[h3]Lotus Leaf Rice Grenade Destruction Event (6/12 - 6/26)[/h3]
Get rewarded for killing 10 zombies with the Lotus Leaf Grenade in Zombie Mutant, Zombie Evolution, Zombie Hero, and Zombie Z modes, where the damage can vary greatly.
Damage: 50% chance for normal damage, 40% chance for 2x damage, and 10% chance for one-hit-kill damage

[list][*]Conditions / Rewards
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/4960831d3afb02dfd547473ab13ceb0adb12f216.png[/img]
[list][*]Get Outing Nameplate (300 Days) by killing 10 zombies with the Lotus Leaf Rice Grenade in Zombie Classic, Zombie Mutant, Zombie Evolution, Zombie Hero and Zombie Z modes.[/list][/list]

[list][*]Details
[list][*]Rewards can be claimed once per account for the Lotus Leaf Rice Grenade Destruction Event.
[*] Participation will only count in rooms with 3 or more players (includes Laboratory Mode, excludes Studio Mode).
[*] Autohunt kills are excluded regardless of mode.[/list][/list]


[h3]Eid al-Adha Event (6/12 - 6/26)[/h3]
Complete the missions during the event to earn rewards.

[list][*]Conditions / Rewards
[list][*]Earn 1 point each time you reach 10/20/30 minutes of playtime (up to 3 points per day).
[*] Earn Event Decoder x1 by reaching 30 minutes of playtime (up to once a day)[/list][/list]

[list][*]Point Rewards
[list][*]3 points: Rare Decoder x10
[*] 6 Points: Unique Decoder x8
[*] 9 Points: Unique Premium Decoder x5
[*] 15 Points: 10,000 Mileage Coupon x3

[*] 24 points: Transcendence Decoder x5

[*] 33 points: Transcendence Decoder x7

[list][*]Details
[list][*]Participation will only count in rooms with 3 or more players (includes Studio Mode and Laboratory).
[*] Each reward can only be claimed once per account.[/list][/list]


[h3]Eid al-Adha Celebration Mileage Auction (6/15 - 6/18)[/h3]
You can access the auction during the event from the Mileage Auction button at the bottom of the lobby screen.

[list][*]Permanent Auction Items Added: Roy, Romy[/list]

[list][*]Auction Details
[list][*]Auction Time: 1 hour for all items
[*] Number of Listings: 2 (Can be increased based on VIP rank)
[*] Market Price of Items: Lowest bids and direct purchase prices are shown in the Auction House when listing an item.
[*] Item Display: Items with the lowest bid or direct purchase price are displayed first.
[*] Auction Filters: You can search by bid/direct purchase price, enhancement level, and weapon name.
[*] Sell-to-System Feature: When an auction is unsuccessful, you'll have the opportunity to use the sell-to-system feature.
[*] Auction Hours: 24 Hours (12:00 AM - 11:59 PM). When the auction is over, all currently listed items will be canceled.[/list][/list]

[list][*]Other Details
[list][*]Remaining time is shown in 5-minute increments for listed auction items.
[*] You can only bid on one item at a time.
[*] Regular auction items will be listed with an additional 30% fee included in the initial bidding price.
[*] If an item listed for auction is not sold, the item will be returned.
[*] Items listed for auction can be purchased immediately at the direct purchase price.
[*] If you list an item for auction, you cannot withdraw it until the auction's duration has ended.
[*] The item you listed may be shown on the bid page.
[*] When listing an item, you can easily check the actual amount you will receive under the Net Reward section.
[*] Some recently released weapons cannot be listed at auction.[/list][/list]


[h2]Shop update[/h2]

[h3]New Transcendence Weapon "Pulse Reactor" Promotion (6/15 - 7/10)[/h3]
The Pulse Reactor can drop from the Transcendence Premium Decoder and Transcendence Decoder during the event.

[list][*]Pulse Reactor Drop Rate
[list][*]Transcendence Premium Decoder: 3%
[*] Transcendence Decoder: 0.45%[/list][/list]

[list][*]Pulse Reactor
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/82c8d279fcc6b2b8fe91c5fd1dd0012555e8420d.png[/img]
[list][*]An SMG equipped with an energy reactor and capacity of 75 projectiles. The reactor recaptures pulse energy to fire special ammunition for basic attacks and basic ammunition for special attacks. Basic attacks also deal reduced damage to additional enemies near the target.[/list][/list]


[h3]New Transcendence Weapon "Pulse Reactor" Guaranteed Giveaway (6/15 - 7/10)[/h3]
Depending on the number of Transcendence Premium Decoders and Transcendence Decoders used during the event, you may be guaranteed to receive the Pulse Reactor!

[list][*]Reward Threshold
[list][*]Upon Reaching 300 Guaranteed Points[/list][/list]

[list][*]Details
[list][*]Earn 6 Guaranteed Points each time you use a Transcendence Premium Decoder.
[*] Receive a Guaranteed Point each time you use a Transcendence Decoder.
[*] All unused Premium Transcendence Decoders will be removed and replaced with 500 mileage each during maintenance on 7/10.[/list][/list]


[h3]New Rotation Class Appearance Event (6/15 - 7/10)[/h3]
The classes below will be part of the new Rotation Group for the Class Decoder during the event.

Appearing Classes: Smile Mary/Immortal Eric/Lynn/Kai

[list][*]Details
[list][*]Upon winning with a rotating class, you will automatically obtain their exclusive costume.
[list][*]Winning Smile Mary will automatically provide Mary's Cube (Permanent).
[*] Winning Immortal Eric will automatically provide Eric's Hero Helmet (Permanent).
[*] Winning Lynn will automatically provide Black Dragon Mask (Permanent).
[*] Winning Kai will automatically provide Tactical Goggles (Permanent).[/list]
[*] The Rotation Group will be removed from the possible contents of the decoder once the event ends.
[*] The contents of the Rotation Group can change at any time.
[*] The Rotation Group is added to Class Decoders only during the event.[/list][/list]

[h3]Guaranteed Class Rotation Group Giveaway Event (6/15 - 7/10)[/h3]
Select a guaranteed Class from the Rotation Group based on Class Decoder usage during the event!

[list][*]Eligible Classes: Smile Mary/Immortal Eric/Lynn/Kai
[list][*]Each time you reach 150 points, you can choose 1 class from the Rotation Group.
[*] You'll get 1 Guaranteed Point each time you use 1 Class Decoder.
[*] Upon winning with a rotating class, you will automatically obtain their exclusive costume.[/list][/list]

notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: May 29th
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/950c0df3618e1ad8f19fbdf686c100f1143edb06.jpg[/img]

Here's a rundown of some of the major updates in today's patch!

Check out the following sections for more information.

[h1]---------- Details ----------[/h1]

[h2]Event Information[/h2]

[h3]Try The Counter Exchange CP Event! (5/16 - 6/12)[/h3]
Earn CP by completing missions during the event.

[list][*]New Item added
[list][*]Hamburger
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/84bc6e8c3ac9f814a2d4f89253a72a5933d09f1d.png[/img]
[*]Soda Cup
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/66aa07de9936b41cd93230bf62439823d218ba5e.png[/img]
[*]1,000 Mileage Coupon
[*]Transcendence Decoder
[*]Class Decoder[/list][/list]

[list][*]How to Participate
[list][*]Earn 1 CP for every 15 Kill Points by zombie kills or assists as a human, or infections as a zombie in Zombie Mode (up to 8 CP per day).
[*]Clear 1 session after scoring 100 Kill Points in Zombie Scenario mode on Hard or higher: 1 CP (up to 8 CP per day)
[*]Every 20 minutes of in-game playtime: 1 CP (up to 2 CP per day)[/list][/list]
[list][*]Earn 1 CP when you complete 2 of the following missions (up to 1 CP per day):
[list][*]- Click on the Event Missions tab to check your Event Missions.
[*]- Purchase a Point Transcendence Decoder or a Point Class Decoder from the Shop.
[*]- Go on an Exploration once.[/list][/list]

[list][*]How to Earn Kill Points
[list][*]Zombie Kills as a Human: 3 Points (bots excluded)
[*]Zombie Assists as a Human: 1 Point (bots excluded)
[*]Human Infections as a Zombie: 4 Points (bots excluded)
[*]Human Infection Assists as Zombie: 0 Points[/list][/list]

[list][*]Details
[list][*]You can earn up to 10 CP a day.
[*]Daily Missions are reset every day at midnight.
[*]You can earn playtime on all modes, including Studio Mode.
[*]Other than playtime, in-game missions do not count towards participation in Studio Mode.
[*]You can only participate in rooms with 3 or more players.
[*]Autohunt kills are excluded regardless of mode.
[*]Compatible Zombie Modes: Zombie Classic / Zombie Mutant / Zombie Hero / Zombie Z / Zombie Evolution
[*]Excluded Zombie Scenario Maps: Double Gate / Lost City / Survival: Trap / Survival: Groundwater / Pursuit: Chaos
[*]You must play for at least 5 minutes to get credit for Zombie Scenario mode missions.
[*]All CP will be removed during maintenance on 6/12.[/list][/list]

[h3]Extreme Challenge Event (5/29 - 6/12)[/h3]
Complete missions during the event period to earn CP (Counter-Strike Points).

[list][*]Play Missions
[list][*]Earn 90 CP by reaching 3,000 Kill Points from zombie kills or assists as a human, or infections as a zombie in Zombie Mode (up to 500 CP per day).
→ Zombie Kills as a Human: 3 Points (bots excluded)
→ Zombie Assists as a Human: 1 Point (bots excluded)
→ Human Infections as a Zombie: 4 Points (bots excluded)
→ Human Infection Assist as a Zombie: 0 Points

[*]Earn 90 CP by clearing 150 sessions with 100 Kill Points in Zombie Scenario mode on Hard difficulty or higher (up to 25 sessions per day).
* Can earn up to 90 CP through Play Missions[/list][/list]

[list][*]Consecutive Attendance
[list][*]3-Day Consecutive Attendance: 10 CP
[*]5-Day Consecutive Attendance: 10 CP
[*]7-Day Consecutive Attendance: 30 CP
* Can earn up to 50 CP through Consecutive Attendance[/list][/list]

[list][*]Notice
[list][*]Only one of the play mission rewards can be claimed. (Can earn up to 90 CP)
[*]Consecutive Attendance: Failing to check in on consecutive days will reset your progress.
[*]Only rooms with 3 or more players count toward these goals.
[*]Autohunt kills are excluded regardless of mode.
[*]Relevant Zombie Modes: Zombie Classic / Zombie Mutant / Zombie Hero / Zombie Z / Zombie Evolution
[*]Excluded Zombie Scenario Maps: Double Gate / Lost City / Survival: Trap / Survival: Groundwater / Pursuit: Chaos
[*]At least 5 minutes of playtime are required to complete Zombie Scenario mode missions.[/list][/list]

[h3]Bonus Disassembly Event (5/29 - 6/04 11:59 PM)[/h3]
Participate in the Bonus Disassembly Event by clicking "Bonus Disassembly" at the bottom of the Lobby. During the event, 10 players can select the weapons they want to disassemble, with one lucky player receiving extra mileage. Participants can get 500 mileage for each weapon they disassemble.

[list][*]Details
[list][*]Weekdays and Weekends - 2:00 PM – 6:00 PM CEST
[*]Minimum Participation Mileage: 5,000
[*]Some items will be adjusted based on the weapon's rarity.
[*]Table ranks are in the order of highest value first.
[*]Weapon criteria are determined the day the Bonus Disassembly Event starts. If the weapon's rank changes, its value in the Bonus Disassembly Event will be updated.
[*]New items for disassembly: Belial[/list][/list]



[h2]Shop Update[/h2]

[h3]Transcendence Weapon "Whip Sword" Promotion (5/29 - 6/12)[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/b306d0f548b23fa07a5fb3b8369900dd56c64d89.png[/img]
The Whip Sword can drop from the Transcendence Premium Decoder and Transcendence Decoder during the event.

[list][*]Whip Sword Drop Rate
[list][*]Transcendence Premium Decoder: 3%
[*]Transcendence Decoder: 0.45%[/list][/list]

[list][*]Whip Sword
[list][*]A sword made of smaller sword parts linked together in the form of a whip, increasing the weapon's attack speed and range. It has numerous attack combos that connect one attack to another, making it a very versatile weapon for the battlefield.[/list][/list]

[list][*]Notice
[list][*]All unused Transcendence Premium Decoders will be removed during maintenance on 6/12.
[*]500 mileage will be awarded in return for each Transcendence Premium Decoder removed in this manner.
[*]Transcendence Decoder is always available for sale.
[*]Transcendence Premium Decoder is available for sale until maintenance on 6/12.
[*]Check for details in Decoder Rates on the web page after 5/29 maintenance.[/list][/list]

[h3]Whip Sword Guaranteed Giveaway (5/29 - 6/12)[/h3]
Depending on the number of normal and Premium Transcendence Decoders used, you may be able to receive the Whip Sword permanently!

[list][*]Reward Threshold
[list][*]Upon Reaching 300 Guaranteed Points[/list][/list]

[list][*]Details
[list][*]Earn 6 Guaranteed Points each time you use a Transcendence Premium Decoder.
[*]Receive a Guaranteed Point each time you use a Transcendence Decoder.
[*]All unused Premium Transcendence Decoders will be removed and replaced with 500 mileage each during maintenance on 6/12.[/list][/list]


[h2]Other Fixes[/h2]
[list][*]The products in [Shop] - [Recommended] have now been updated.
[*]Fixed an issue when using Sandalphon, Belial caused the other weapon to stop attacking.
[*]Fixed an animation issue where the cartridge case was ejected when switching from bolt action sniper rifles to other weapons.
[*]Fixed an issue where the Health-up part did not work properly when a user became a sidekick in the Zombie scenario.

[list][*]Evita
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/9f887e765e00374817a8aeb7ee429795c07c7ca1.png[/img]
[list][*]The popular and charming cheerleader known as Evita has a secret: she's actually a special agent for the government! Directed to find and locate the super soldier Angelina, one of Douglas Jacob's pet projects, Evita went deep undercover as a cheerleader for one of Angelina's favorite sports teams in order to meet her, all to no avail. However, one day Evita gets lucky and runs into Angelina while being chased by agents of Kronos and is finally able to make contact.
[*]Transcendence Class CT

[*]Paired Weapon: Tyrant's Mace
[list][*] Increased Left-Click / Right-Click Damage

[*]Zombie Scenario Skill: Cheerleading By Example
[list][*] Passive: Movement Speed is slightly increased and Damage Taken is slightly decreased when playing in Zombie Scenario mode with Angelina (Connection effect applied, cannot be stacked).
[*] Applies the Shadow Blade Add-On Effect (This can be stacked, which increases the effect)
[*] Increases attack power against Elite and Boss monsters.
[*] Active: Grants you and any nearby allies Movement Speed Increase and a special barrier in Zombie Scenario modes. If the special barrier is broken while a skill is being cast, you will receive invincibility and a Movement Speed duration increase for a certain amount of time.[/list]
[*]+10% EXP/Points
[*]In Zombie Scenario mode, this character has a higher max level than normal classes.
[*]This character adds 1 initial mutation in Zombie Z Mode.
[*]This character displays your current speed at the bottom of the screen.
[*]This character leaves a unique mark at the target location upon killing an enemy.
[*]Marks Zombies at 20% HP or below in Zombie Mode.[/list][/list]

[list][*]Angelina
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/a417d657eb7c8c82da27a2391704b32cea7778f2.png[/img]
[list][*]As a child, Angelina lost her parents in the war and had to join the army to survive. During her time there, she was invited to come back to America with Douglas Jacob, who was visiting the war zone as part of his relief organization. His wealth and her incredible beauty quickly propelled the former soldier on the path to fame and stardom, but in exchange for Jacob's sponsorship, Angelina was coerced to take a special Kronos-developed serum. However, thanks to a unique gene structure that prevents the virus from mutating within her, Angelina awakened from her operation as a powerful Super Soldier.

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/25890ddfbdd32e1f4898f22efaed01d37127a2ae.jpg[/img]
Here's a rundown of some of the major updates in today's patch!

[list][b][*]Spring Fling Event (04/30 - 05/15)[/b]
Time to smell the flowers and feel the warm breeze! Spring is just around the corner!

[b][*]Mileage Auction Event (4/30 - 5/15)[/b]
You can access the auction during the event from the Mileage Auction button at the bottom of the lobby screen.

[b][*]Family Nameplate Creation Request Event (4/30 - 5/15)[/b]
Show your family pride to receive an exclusive Nameplate!

[b][*]Sandalphon/Belial Promotion (4/30 – 5/29)[/b]
During this special event, Sandalphon and Belial will appear in Epic Decoders!

[b][*]Tyrant's Mace Resale Promotion (4/30 – 5/29)[/b]
The Tyrant's Mace can drop from Transcendence Premium Decoders and Transcendence Decoders during this event.[/list]

Check out the following sections for more information.

[h1]---------- Details ----------[/h1]

[h2]Event Information[/h2]

[h3] Spring Fling Event (04/30 - 05/15)[/h3]
Time to smell the flowers and feel the warm breeze! Spring is just around the corner!

[list][*]Participation / Rewards
[list][*]Stay logged in for 30 minutes/60 minutes: 1 point (up to 2 points a day)
[*]Every 20 minutes/40 minutes of playtime: 1 point (up to 2 points a day)
[*]Use any type of Decoder: 1 point (up to 1 point a day)
[*]Go on an Exploration: 1 point (up to 1 point a day)
[*]Place a bid, list an item for sale, or directly purchase an item from the Mileage Auction House: 1 point (up to 1 point a day)
[*]Enhance or disassemble an item, paint a weapon, equip or combine a part: 1 point (up to 1 point a day)
[*]Every 6 Kill Points scored in Zombie Mode: 1 point (up to 15 points a day)
[*]Clear 1 session in Zombie Scenario mode on Hard or higher: 3 points (up to 15 points a day)
[*]Maximum Daily Mission Points: 20 (per day)[/list][/list]

[list][*]How to Earn Kill Points
[list][*]Zombie Kills as a Human: 3 Points (bots excluded)
[*]Zombie Assists as a Human: 1 Point (bots excluded)
[*]Human Infections as a Zombie: 4 Points (bots excluded)
[*]Human Infection Assists as Zombie: 0 Points[/list][/list]

[list][*]Point Rewards
[list][*]20 Points: Rare Decoder x3 + Zombie Scenario Add-On Rate Box x10
[*]40 Points: Rare Decoder x5
[*]60 Points: Unique Decoder x3 + 50 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x3
[*]100 Points: Unique Premium Decoder x1 + 100 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x5
[*]120 Points: Event Decoder x5
[*]140 Points: 10,000 Mileage Coupon + Italian Chicken Nameplate (300 Days)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/564ec7df3ff603bd88c2bb765bb253385a439128.png[/img]
[*]160 Points: Old-Time Costume Box x1
[*]180 Points: Feline Hat (Permanent)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/8328ba08c79c4dd367c96b5ca3b813bbf36dff30.png[/img]
[*]200 Points: Class Decoder x7 + Event Decoder x3
[*]220 Points: Transcendence Decoder x7 + Event Decoder x3
[*]240 Points: 100 Weapon Enhancement EXP x5
[*]260 Points: Grade 5 Parts Reward Box x5[/list][/list]

[list][*]Details
[list][*]The pileup rewards above can be only be obtained once per Nexon ID.
[*]Earn up to 20 points a day!
[*]Kill Points you've earned will reset every midnight.
[*]You can earn playtime on all modes, including Studio Mode.
[*]Other than playtime, in-game missions do not count towards participation in Studio Mode.
[*]You can only participate in rooms with 3 or more players.
[*]Autohunt kills are excluded regardless of mode.
[*]Compatible Zombie Modes: Zombie Classic / Zombie Mutant / Zombie Hero / Zombie Z / Zombie Evolution
[*]Excluded Zombie Scenario Maps: Double Gate / Lost City / Survival: Trap / Survival: Groundwater / Pursuit: Chaos
[*]You must play for at least 5 minutes to get credit for Zombie Scenario mode missions.
[*]Event Decoders can be used until midnight of the day they were obtained and are removed afterwards.[/list][/list]


[h3] Mileage Auction Event (4/30 - 5/15)[/h3]
You can access the auction during the event from the Mileage Auction button at the bottom of the lobby screen.

[list][*]Permanent Auction Items Added: Ismael, Ethan, Satellite Mine[/list]

[list][*]Auction House Quality-of-Life Improvements
[list][*]Upper Price Limit for Parts adjusted
[*]Lower Price Limit set
[*]Reverse Auction for Classes added
[*]Detailed Search for Weapons added
[*]Auction House History added
[*]Unlisting Items now available 
[*]Item Labels added
[*]Transaction Price Listing added
[*]For more details, please refer to the Auction House Quality-of-Life Update notes.[/list][/list]

[list][*]Auction Details
[list][*]Auction Time: 1 hour for all items
[*]Number of Listings: 2 (Can be increased based on VIP rank)
[*]Market Price of Items: Lowest bids and direct purchase prices are shown on the Auction House when listing an item.
[*]Item Display: Items with the lowest bid or direct purchase price are displayed first.
[*]Auction Filters: You can search by bid/direct purchase price, enhancement level, and weapon name.
[*]Sell-to-System Feature: When an auction is unsuccessful, you'll have the opportunity to use the sell-to-system feature.
[*]Auction Hours: 24 Hours (12:00 AM - 11:59 PM). When the auction is over, all currently listed items will be canceled.[/list][/list]

[list][*]Other Details
[list][*]Remaining time is shown in 5-minute increments for listed auction items.
[*]You can only bid on one item at a time.
[*]Regular auction items will be listed with an additional 30% fee included in the initial bidding price.
[*]If an item listed for auction is not sold, the item will be returned.
[*]Items listed for auction can be purchased immediately at the direct purchase price.
[*]If you list an item for auction, you cannot withdraw it until the auction's duration has ended.
[*]The item you listed may be shown on the bid page.
[*]When listing an item, you can easily check the actual amount you will receive under the Net Reward section.
[*]Some recently released weapons cannot be listed at auction.[/list][/list]


[h3] 1,000 Mileage Auction Event! (4/30 - 5/15)[/h3]
Throughout the event, rare items selling for 1,000 Mileage will appear.

[list][*]Times / Items
[list][*]3:00 PM (CEST) : Epic Decoder x3 
[*]4:00 PM (CEST) : Transcendence Decoder x3 
[*]8:00 PM (CEST) : Epic Decoder x3
[*]9:00 PM (CEST) : Transcendence Decoder x3[/list][/list]

[list][*]Details
[list][*]The auction house items listed above only appear at specific times.
[*]These items will appear within the first 10 minutes of each auction hour. Bidding lasts for 10 minutes.
[*]Players who lost the auction will be refunded 1,000 Mileage after the auction closes.
[*]Click Obtain to claim your rewards after you've won.[/list][/list]


[h3] Family Nameplate Creation Request Event (4/30 - 5/15)[/h3]
Show your family pride to receive an exclusive Nameplate!
Please refer to the Related Announcement for more details.


[h3] Goodbye Season 18 Double-Up Event (4/30 - 5/8)[/h3]
Earn double Season Badges from daily and weekly missions during the event.


[h2]Shop Update[/h2]

[h3] Sandalphon/Belial Promotion (4/30 – 5/29)[/h3]
During this special event, Sandalphon and Belial will appear in Epic Decoders!

[list][*]Weapon Rates
[list][*]Sandalphon: 0.175%
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/36ba671029d23d30be514331838020f6b3801b60.png[/img]

[*]Belial: 0.175%
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/9d46037d35b02087036928581914e9f3b46b7070.png[/img]
[*]Once a relic of the heavens, this corrupted weapon now resides in the demonic realm. Can be used to attack enemies at close or far range or to summon demonic beings.[/list][/list]


[h3] Sandalphon/Belial Guaranteed Giveaway (4/30 – 5/29)[/h3]
Get Guaranteed Points when you use Epic Decoders during the promotion!

[list][*]Conditions and Rewards
[list][*]Each time you reach 300 points, you can choose one of the following weapons:
[*]Sandalphon/Belial/Devastator/Failnaught/Laevateinn/Lightning Fury[/list][/list]

[list][*]Details
[list][*]You'll earn 1 Guaranteed Point each time you use 1 Epic Decoder.
[*]Rewards are earned every 300 points. You can select weapons at 300 points, 600 points, 900 points, and so on.[/list][/list]


[h3] Sandalphon/Belial Crafting Event (4/30 – 5/29)[/h3]
Receive the Sandalphon or the Belial during the event if you purchase the Belial blueprint with one of these weapons in your inventory.

[list][*]Crafting Instructions
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/1f5155a67e715b10fe7894cd51b659774e58138f.png[/img]
[list][*]Sandalphon (Permanent) can be obtained by using the Belial blueprint while both the Belial (Permanent) and the Belial blueprint are in your inventory.
[*]Belial (Permanent) can be obtained by using the Belial blueprint while both the Sandalphon (Permanent) and the Belial blueprint are in your inventory.
[*]Either the Belial (Permanent) or the Sandalphon (Permanent) can be obtained using the Belial blueprint while the Belial (Permanent), the Sandalphon (Permanent), and the Belial blueprint are in your inventory.[/list][/list]

[list][*]Details
[list][*]Using the Belial blueprint will remove it from your inventory.
[*]Use the Belial blueprint after purchasing to craft either the Sandalphon (Permanent) or Belial (Permanent).
[*]It can only be crafted once per account.
[*]If you have not used the Belial blueprint during the event, they will be used automatically on the 5/29 (Wed) maintenance. (Conditions and rewards are same as above)[/list][/list]


[h3] Tyrant's Mace Resale Promotion (4/30 – 5/29)[/h3]
The Tyrant's Mace can drop from Transcendence Premium Decoders and Transcendence Decoders during this event.

[list][*]Tyrant's Mace Drop Rate
[list][*]Transcendence Premium Decoder: 3%
[*]Transcendence Decoder: 0.45%[/list][/list]

[list][*]Tyrant's Mace (Melee Weapon)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/d9e395dfedf92d9024b044a5a1bdcc9b761e2745.png[/img]
[list][*]An iron mace imbued with the power of the Ice Tyrant. It accumulates energy depending on time passed or damage inflicted. Once the gauge has been filled, you can deliver a merciless attack on any enemies in front of you.[/list][/list]


[h3] Tyrant's Mace Guaranteed Giveaway (4/30 – 5/29)[/h3]
Depending on the number of Premium and normal Transcendence Decoders used, you may be guaranteed to receive the Tyrant's Mace permanently!

[list][*]Reward Threshold
[list][*]Upon Reaching 300 Guaranteed Points[/list][/list]

[list][*]Details

[*]One Guaranteed Point is given every time you use a Transcendence Decoder.[/list][/list]

[list][*]Fixed an issue where the recoil of the PP-19 Bizon (Refined) wouldn't reset during use.[/list]
