notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: April 17th
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/0f7d87e0f0852a08130e5408091482a67f08bc7e.jpg[/img]

Here's a rundown of some of the major updates in today's patch!

Check out the following sections for more information.

[list][b][*]Hidden Panda Points Event (4/17 - 4/30)[/b]
That adorable panda is bound to show up...so don't miss out! Collect points to receive items for him and his friends!

[b][*]Classic Weapon Giveaway (4/17 - 4/30)[/b]
Reach 30 minutes of playtime every day during the event period to receive new Zombie Classic weapons and other fabulous rewards!

[b][*]Zombie Hero: Random Rules Event (4/17 - 4/30)[/b]
Zombie Hero mode is about to get even wilder! Rules will now change every round during the event!

[b][*]Bonus Disassembly Event (4/17 - 4/29 11:59 PM)[/b]
Participate in the Bonus Disassembly Event by clicking "Bonus Disassembly" at the bottom of the Lobby. During the event, 10 players can select the weapons they want to disassemble, with one lucky player receiving extra mileage. Participants can get 500 mileage for each weapon they disassemble.

[b][*]Transcendence Weapon Promotion: Cousteau (4/17 - 4/30)[/b]
Cousteau will now drop from normal and Premium Transcendence Decoders![/list]

[h1]---------- Details ----------[/h1]

[h2]Update Information[/h2]

[h3] Graphical Update[/h3]
The title, logo (BI), loading screen, background wallpaper and library icon have been updated.

[h3]Zombie Z mode and Zombie Hero mode have been updated.[/h3]
[list][*]Zombie Z Mode
[list][*]The HP for Minor Zombies has been increased from 15,000 to 18,000.[/list][/list]

[list][*]Zombie Hero Mode
[list][*]The Max HP for Minor Zombies has been increased from 15,000 to 18,000.
[*]The amount of Host Zombies at the beginning of each round has been increased.[/list][/list]

[h3]The Bonus Disassembly system has been improved.[/h3]
A random waiting system has been added.

[h3]Other Improvements[/h3]
[list][*]Improved Entry Screen
[list][*]The Lobby and Studio selection screens have been removed, instead reconnecting back to the lobby.[/list][/list]

[list][*]Updated Lobby Navigation Menu
[list][*]Zombie Mode will stay the same for 30 days for players starting or returning to the game.
[*]Recommended Mode has been changed to Zombie Hero Mode for existing players.[/list][/list]

[list][*]Reduced New & Returning Player Pop-Ups
[list][*]The number of log-in pop-ups have been reduced to allow faster entry into the game. (First log-in only)[/list][/list]

[list][*]Added Pop-up Options on Log-in
[list][*]Pop-ups shown after logging in will now have an option to not be displayed without new information.[/list][/list]

[list][*]Season Pass Pop-Up Display
[list][*]Checking the 'Do Not Show Until Next Season' box will prevent the pop-up from displaying until the next season begins. 
[*]Click on the Season Pass icon at the bottom right side of the screen to view information about season rewards.[/list][/list]

[list][*]Mission Chain Pop-up Display
[list][*]Checking the "Do Not Show Until Next Mission Chain" box will prevent the pop-up from displaying until the next mission chain begins.
[*]View Mission Chain information from [Missions] > [Go to Mission Chain] at the top of the screen.[/list][/list]


[h2]Event Information[/h2]

[h3]Hidden Panda Points Event (4/17 - 4/30)[/h3]
That adorable panda is bound to show up...so don't miss out! Collect points to receive items for him and his friends!

[list][*]Conditions / Rewards
[list][*]Daily Log-in: 2 points (once daily)
[*]Every 5 minutes of playtime: 1 point (up to 10 points a day)
[*]Score either a zombie kill or a human infection a total of 2 times, or score 6 assists (excluding bots): 2 points (up to 40 per day)
[*]Clear a session after scoring 100 Kill Points in Zombie Scenario mode on Hard difficulty or higher: 5 points (up to 40 per day)
[*]* Maximum Daily Mission Points possible per day: 50 points[/list][/list]

[list][*]Daily Rewards
[list][*]Each time you collect 50 Points in a day: Event Decoder x1[/list][/list]

[list][*]Point Rewards
[list][*]50 Points: Rare Decoder x5 + 100 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x10
[*]150 Points: Unique Decoder x5 + 200 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x10
[*]250 Points: Bamboo Spray (Permanent) + Event Decoder x5
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/e20c20a7f000730984d2210ebe2e462a50d664f9.png[/img]
[*]350 Points: Panda Nameplate (300 Days) + Random -1 Dehancement Material x10
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/9d0bdc85da8820939fc9bd934e50444f24eba059.png[/img]
[*]450 Points: Bamboo Font (300 Days) + Class Decoder x3
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/f316e41b67f117a886807998c0ba05b271b7d3a9.png[/img]
[*]500 Points: Transcendence Decoder x2 + Event Decoder x8
[*]550 Points: Transcendence Decoder x5 + Class Decoder x7
[*]600 Points: Season Badge x100
[*]650 Points: Season Badge x100[/list][/list]

[list][*]Details
[list][*]Pileup rewards can be obtained only once per account.
[*]You can earn up to 50 points a day.
[*]You can earn playtime on all modes, including Studio Mode.
[*]Other than playtime, in-game missions do not count towards participation in Studio Mode.
[*]Only rooms with 3 or more players count toward these goals.
[*]Autohunt kills are excluded regardless of mode.
[*]Relevant Zombie Modes: Zombie Classic / Zombie Mutant / Zombie Hero / Zombie Z / Zombie Evolution
[*]Excluded Zombie Scenario Maps: Double Gate / Lost City / Survival: Trap / Survival: Groundwater / Pursuit: Chaos
[*]At least 5 minutes of playtime are required to complete Zombie Scenario mode missions.
[*]Event Decoders can be used until midnight of the day they were obtained and removed afterwards.[/list][/list]

[h3]Classic Weapon Giveaway (4/17 - 4/30)[/h3]
Reach 30 minutes of playtime every day during the event period to receive new Zombie Classic weapons and other fabulous rewards!

[list][*]Conditions and Rewards
[list][*]1x: Rare Decoder x5 + 50 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x1
[*]2x: Rare Decoder x5 + 50 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x2
[*]3x: Rare Decoder x5 + 50 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x3 + Select 3 Advanced Weapon Selection Box x1
[*]4x: Rare Decoder x7 + 100 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x1
[*]5x: Rare Decoder x7 + 100 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x2

[*]7x: Rare Decoder x10 + 200 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x1
[*]8x: Rare Decoder x20 + 200 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x2 + Select 3 Advanced Weapon Selection Box x1[/list][/list]

[list][*]Select 3 Advanced Weapon Selection Box contents (Choose 1 of 3)
[list][*]Hunting Dagger (Refined) (Permanent)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/b5fe06302cf7f4fb526b80319d36bcd385d6b090.png[/img]
[*]PP-19 Bizon (Refined) (Permanent)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/e5a05f49db9cbbe1ba50e4d69a34c0503280dee2.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/f7338380fdbfcd17831159472924374fae5e5412.png[/img][/list][/list]

[list][*]Rewards can only be claimed once per day per account.
[*]Only rooms with 3 or more players count toward these goals.
[*]All unused Select 3 Advanced Weapon Selection Boxes will be removed during maintenance on 4/30.[/list][/list]

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/e1998d3a4c6abf93de44bf47ab3aa163d26117d0.jpg[/img]

Greetings from the CSN team!
We're announcing two new events that will take place on the Official CSN Discord server. Get terrific gifts just by joining the server and writing how-to guides for the game!

[b][h2] Join the Official CSN Discord Event[/h2][/b]
[u][h3]How to Participate[/h3][/u][list]
[*] Join the Official Discord server to receive a Join Coupon in the Join Gift channel.
[*] Official Discord [url=https://discord.gg/wxPMUTHBP5][Link][/url]
[/list]

[u][h3]Event Duration[/h3][/u][list]
[*] 4/11 (Thu) - [u][b]Until further notice[/b][/u]
[/list]

[u][h3]Event Reward[/h3][/u][list]
[*] Counter-Strike Nexon Joining the Official Discord Gift (Zombie Beginner Weapon Set (7 Days) + Event decoder x3)
[/list]

[u][h3]Details[/h3][/u][list]
[*] Players who have already joined the Discord server can still receive this reward.
[*] The coupon code can only be used once per account.
[*] Please use the coupon before it expires on [u][b]12/31/2025.[/b][/u]
[*] Unredeemed coupons may become unusable after the event ends. 
[/list]


[b][h2]CSN Guide Writing Event[/h2][/b]
[u][h3]How to Participate[/h3][/u][list]
[*] 1) Write a how-to guide and post it in the Official Discord's #csns_walkthrough channel.
Official Discord #csns_walkthrough Channel [url=https://discord.com/channels/776686511429124107/1227909552159064136][Link][/url]

 *[Required] Make sure posts on the #csns_walkthrough channel pertain to a how-to guide. 
 *When writing a how-to guide, you'll have a higher chance to win if you upload a video you created yourself to YouTube with the hashtags #CSN and #Counter Strike. Don't forget to share the URL!

 If you're having trouble deciding what topic you should write about, consider one of the following:

[b]Short Ideas[/b]
①	Things you didn't know when you first started the game.
②	Information that is difficult to know because it isn't explained in-game or is otherwise hard to find.
③	Any other useful information that you want to highlight.

[b]Detailed Ideas[/b]
①	Strategy as Human on certain maps. (Detailed map guide + your strategy)
②	Strategy as Zombie on certain maps. (Detailed map guide + your strategy)
③	Recommended modes and tips on playing them.
④	Recommended classes (Human or Zombie) and tips on how to use them to win.
⑤	Guides on recommended weapons and how best to use them. 
 
[*] 2) Root for the best and most useful guides by reacting to them with a 👍emoji! (You can vote for multiple guides)
[/list]

[u][h3]Event Duration[/h3][/u][list]
[*] 4/11 (Thu) - 4/23 (Tue)
[/list]

[u][h3]Event Rewards[/h3][/u][list]
[*] Guide Writing Rewards (24 winners)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/c2eaeb2d1c2a66ea286fbfa58d89293fae3c4c42.jpg[/img]


[*] Cheering Participation Reward (10 winners): Event Decoder x1
* 10 people who have cheered by leaving a 👍 emoji on a useful guide will be selected from a raffle and awarded an Even Decoder.
[/list]

[u][h3]Winner Announcement Schedule[/h3][/u][list]
[*] Winners will be announced in #notices channel of the Official Discord server on 5/10 (Fri).
[/list]

[u][h3]Details[/h3][/u][list]
[*] It is recommended to write your guides in English to reach the most players. However, there are no penalties against writing your guide in other languages!
[*] Any guides you write may be used in the creation of future official CSNS content. By participating in this event, you agree to these terms.
[*] There is no limit to the number of guides you can write. You are allowed to contribute multiple times.
[*] Posts in channels other than the one designated for the event will not count toward participation.
[*] If you plagiarize or write a guide unrelated to CSNS, you may be removed from the event without warning.
[*] You will not receive any participation rewards if your content does not relate to the event.
[*] You may be excluded from the winner's raffle if the guide you've posted is removed after participating.
[*] Stealing or copying other people's video guides or creating controversial content may result in your disqualification from the event and the cancellation of prizes without warning.
[*] If a guide that includes a video becomes a winner, additional verificiation may be necessary to determine that it is original content. 
[*] Video guides set to Private will not be eligible for the raffle.
[*] You'll have one chance to win per Discord account when rooting for guides. The number of emojis you leave doesn't affect your chances.
[/list]

[list][b][*]Springtime Costume Event (4/3 - 4/17)[/b]This spring, complete missions to earn costumes...or just buy new ones from the shop!

[b][*]Lebaran Celebration Mileage Auction Event (4/8 - 4/15 11:59 PM)[/b]Let's celebrate Lebaran with a MIleage Auction! It's only available for a limited time, so don't miss out!

[b][*]Lebaran Celebration Auction Event (4/8 - 4/15 11:59 PM)[/b]At certain times during the event, rare items selling for 1,000 Mileage will appear.

[b][*]Steam FPS FEST Celebration Event (4/10 - 4/23 11:59 PM)[/b]Use 30 items for free during the event. 

[b][*]New Transcendence Class Promotion (4/3 - 4/30)[/b]Two new Transcendence Classes, Xiaoming and Gladius, are now available in Class Decoders and Premium Class Decoders.

[b][*]New Transcendence Class Guaranteed Giveaway (4/3 - 4/30)[/b]Get two new guaranteed Transcendence Classes (Xiaoming and Gladius) based on how many Class Decoders and Premium Class Decoders are used during the event!

[b][*]New Transcendence Class Medal Giveaway[/b]When you own all items in the new Transcendence Classes set, you will receive the Transcendence Class medal.

[b][*]Class Decoder Package Sale Promotion (4/3 - 4/30)[/b]Two new Spray types + Class Decoder Package will be on sale during the event.

[b][*]Spray Details[/b]There are two new sprays available in addition to an adjustment in price.[/list]

Check out the following sections for more information.

[h1]---------- Details ----------[/h1]

[h2]Event Information[/h2]

[h3]Springtime Costume Event (4/3 - 4/17)[/h3]
This spring, complete missions to earn costumes...or just buy new ones from the shop!

[list][*]Daily Log-in: 2 points (once daily)

[*]* Maximum Daily Mission Points possible per day: 50 points[/list][/list]

[list][*]Point Rewards

[*]100 Points: Zombie Scenario Add-On Rate Box x10 + 100 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x3

[*]250 Points: Stir-fried Noodle Hat (Permanent) + Zombie Damage Meter (7 Days) x1[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/2cc3e107f7c28e65a1677ba1af65120e6803a267.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/ad579d2f0e66464194b6636178230b7b6e48b8ad.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/6f9587e9a528a1e598410081f594d468fab34f84.png[/img]

[*]650 Points: Grade 5 Parts Reward Box x5[/list][/list]

[list][*]Details
[list][*]Pileup rewards can be obtained only once per account.
[*]You can earn up to 50 points a day.
[*]You can earn playtime on all modes, including Studio Mode.
[*]Other than playtime, in-game missions do not count towards participation in Studio Mode.
[*]Only rooms with 3 or more players count toward these goals.
[*]Autohunt kills are excluded regardless of mode.
[*]Relevant Zombie Modes: Zombie Classic / Zombie Mutant / Zombie Hero / Zombie Z / Zombie Evolution

[h3]Lebaran Celebration Mileage Auction Event (4/8 - 4/15 11:59 PM)[/h3]
Let's celebrate Lebaran with a MIleage Auction! It's only available for a limited time, so don't miss out!

[list][*]Auction Details

[h3]New Transcendence Class Promotion (4/3 - 4/30)[/h3]
Two new Transcendence Classes, Xiaoming and Gladius, are now available in Class Decoders and Premium Class Decoders.

[list][*]Xiaoming
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/9900f99ed97acced7ff09c6b09697c749a6f2358.png[/img]
[list][*]Type: Class
[*]Description: Xiaoming is an innocent, but hard-working, girl who works at a dumpling restaurant. One day while on a routine delivery, Xiaoming finds who appears to be a homeless man lying unconscious on the ground. When she decides to help him, her once-boring life takes an exciting and unexpected turn. After the man recovers, Xiaoming takes him back to her restaurant, where she learns his name is Gladius. Although she tries to get him back on his feet with a delivery job, all he wants to do is hide in the shadows and eat endless dumplings! Even though she could care less about his past or strange way of speaking, Xiaoming is thrilled that she finally has someone to play with.

While on a routine mission with the Foreign Legion, Gladius suffered massive injuries from the blast of an unexpected explosion. The incident forced him to reluctantly agree to join Dr. Rex's Super Soldier project, where he was injected with the genes of a wolf, which saved his life but gave him a feral personality. [h3]New Transcendence Class Guaranteed Giveaway (4/3 - 4/30)[/h3]
Get two new guaranteed Transcendence Classes (Xiaoming and Gladius) based on how many Class Decoders and Premium Class Decoders are used during the event!

[list][*]Conditions and Rewards
[list][*]After reaching 150 Guaranteed Points earned by using a Decoder.
[*]After reaching 300 Guaranteed Points earned by using a Decoder.
[*]Select either: Xiaoming + Dumpling Fairy or Gladius + Fairy Wolfmother

[*]Selecting Gladius will automatically provide you with Fairy Wolfmother (Permanent).

[h3]New Transcendence Class Medal Giveaway[/h3]
When you own all items in the new Transcendence Classes set, you will receive the Transcendence Class medal.

[list][*]Conditions and Items
[list][*]Collect Xiaoming, Gladius, Dumpling Fairy, and Fairy Wolfmother to earn the Express Delivery medal.[/list][/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/7c3dea28f45978e26ee4a7d23cda5740d4ff7c05.png[/img]
[list][*]Honor Points: 10
[*]Description: A medal given to those who have obtained Xiaoming, Gladius, Dumpling Fairy, and Fairy Wolfmother (Permanent).
[*]This medal can be obtained once per account.[/list][/list]

[h3]Class Decoder Package Sale Promotion (4/3 - 4/30)[/h3]
Two new Spray types + Class Decoder Package will be on sale during the event.

[list][*]Items in this Package
[list][*]Class Decoder Xiaoming Package: SD Xiaoming Spray (Permanent) + Class Decoder x5
[*]Class Decoder Gladius Package: SD Gladius Spray (Permanent) + Class Decoder x5
[*]Can be purchased once per account.
[/list][/list]

[h3]Spray Details[/h3]
There are two new sprays available in addition to an adjustment in price.

[list][*]New Sprays
[list][*]SD Xiaoming Spray (Permanent)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/5049a5ee3ad72b3387340e24002b4aad609d27ca.png[/img]
[*]SD Gladius Spray (Permanent)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/65bada231e7b49ce8ced8e165f0562b49d8d4982.png[/img]
[/list][/list]

[list][*]Spray Price Change
[list][*]Starting on 4/3, the price of all sprays sold in the Shop will be $1.59.[/list][/list]


[h2]Other Fixes[/h2]
[list][*]The products in Shop - Recommended have been updated.
[*]Fixed an issue where the Studio Scenario TX mode would incorrectly move you to the waiting room in certain situations.
[*]Fixed an issue where the cooldown would not be applied after players used the Sylphid's Gale Blast attack.
[*]The Sylphid's Fierce Wind attack now strikes up to three targets simultaneously.
[*]Increased the attack range of the Sylphid's Fierce Wind and Gale Blast improving their ability to hold back an enemy, and decreased the leap range and knockback of Gale Blast.
[*]The Slyphid's base Movement Speed has been increased. 
[*]Fixed an issue where the spirit summoned by the Sylphid's Gale Blast ability was able to attack through walls.
[*]Fixed an issue with spirits appearing incorrectly or not appearing at all while using the Sylphid.
[*]A 300 second cooldown will now be applied whenever sending in-game messages.
[*]Fixed an issue that caused whisper settings for Ban Lists to be applied incorrectly.[/list]

notes.title: [Event] Studio #Fairytale Theme Contest
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/d4ab9228dde3746ecb9798d1f533d518a563a812.jpg[/img]

Show off your creative skills in this Fairytale-themed Studio contest! 
Participate now to receive the 1st place prize and Steam gift card!

[b][h2]Event 1: Celebratory Studio Contest[/h2][/b]
[u][h3]Event Schedule[/h3][/u][list][*] Application Period: 3/20 – 4/17
[*] Finalists Announced: 4/30
[*] Player Vote: 4/30 - 5/14
[*] Winners Announced: 6/12
[*] Medal and Trophy Theme Packs Sent Out: 7/12[/list]

[u][h3]How to Participate[/h3][/u][list][*] Step 1: Create a Studio Creation Mode map
[*] Step 2: Register a thumbnail image and map description
[*] Step 3: Add "#fairytale" to the map's title
[*] Step 4: Leave a comment to this post including your In-game Nickname, Map name, Steam ID, Steam Profile Link
[/list]

[u][h3]Conditions[/h3][/u][list][*] 10 finalists will be selected based on creativity, number of recommendations, number of cubes earned, use of new blocks and script diversity, utilization of content, and relevance to the subject.
[b][*] If you make promotional video for YouTube, there will be extra points. [/b][*] There is no limit on how many times you can enter, and a single player can win multiple/duplicate prizes.[/list]

[u][h3]Prizes[/h3][/u][list][*] 1st: Transcendence Decoder x300 + Trophy Theme Pack + Excellent Creator Medal
[*] 2nd: Transcendence Decoder x200 + Trophy Theme Pack + Excellent Creator Medal
[*] 3rd: Transcendence Decoder x100 + Trophy Theme Pack + Excellent Creator Medal
[*] 4th - 10th: Transcendence Decoder x50 + Trophy Theme Pack + Excellent Creator Medal
[*] All participants (with +10 map play counts and +3 recommendations): 5,000 Mileage + Contest Participation Medal[/list]

[u][h3]Notice[/h3][/u][list][*] Only maps created on or after 3/20 will be able to participate.
[*] Your award may be revoked if you're not the owner of the account.
[*] You must include the #fairytale tag in the map title in order to have a valid contest entry.
[*] Entries must be original creations made within the contest period. Any awards will be revoked and you may be banned from future events if your entry includes content that: violates the game's terms and conditions, is plagiarized in any way, or violates the rights of 3rd parties.
[*] Entries containing sexually suggestive or violent images exceeding the standards of the game may be deleted immediately.
[*] If there are no entries fitting the selection criteria after evaluation, there may be no winning entry, or the award may be changed.
[*] If you have already obtained the Excellent Creator Medal, another one will not be given.
[*] Using new blocks (device, character, and device block) will award extra point, but they are not necessary to win prizes.
[*] Please submit your entries only if you agree to all of the above.[/list]


[b][h2]Event 2: Celebratory Studio Contest- Steam Gift Card Giveaway![/h2][/b]
[u][h3]Studio Event schedule[/h3][/u][list][*] Application Period: 3/20 – 4/17
[*] Gift Card Winners Announcement: 4/30
[*] Personal Information Collection: 4/30 - 5/14 
[*] Gift Card Distribution: 6/12[/list]

[u][h3]Conditions[/h3][/u][list][*] Earn more than the total of 10 points within the criteria below
[list][*] Map design - Is it unique, creative and not repetitive? (1-5)
[*] Functionality - Does the map have good FPS? Does everything work? (1-5)
[*] Map gameplay - Is it fun? Is it too hard? Or perhaps too easy? (1-5)
[*] Story - Does it have cool stories or narratives? Or just shoot and win? (1-5)
[/list][/list]

[u][h3]Prize[/h3][/u][list][*] 10$ Gift Card (50 people)
[list][*]Once you claim the gift card, it will automatically be converted the amount to your country's currency.[/list][/list]

[u][h3]Notice[/h3][/u][list][*] Gift cards are provided via raffle, and are only available to contest entries that have met the prerequisite requirements.
[*] You must include the #fairytale hashtag in the map title in order to have a valid contest entry.
[*] If there are less than 50 entries, all participants that met the requirements will receive the gift and no additional raffles will be held.
[*] Multiple winnings are not allowed (one player cannot win with 2 or more contest entries)
[*] Studio maps that have been entered in the past are excluded from the prize raffle.
[*] Entries must be original creations made within the contest period. Any awards will be revoked and you may be banned from future events if your entry includes content that: violates the game's terms and conditions, is plagiarized in any way, or violates the rights of 3rd parties.
[*] If you fail to deliver your personal information within the announced period, you will be removed from the raffle without notification.[/list]

notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: March 20th
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/0d6d6e8e975a58f6f3c97b533cd727d7d497340f.jpg[/img]

Here's a rundown of some of the major updates in today's patch!

[list][b][*]New Map Available[/b]Pipeline

[b][*]Training Ground (Hideout) Update[/b]
[b][*]Studio Mode Update[/b]A new Hide and Seek map using Fairy Tale themed Blocks called Fairy Tale Land has been released.

[b][*]Daily Bonus Box Event (3/20 - 4/17)[/b]Complete missions every day during the event to earn a Bonus Box! 

[b][*]New and Returning Player Welcome Attendance Event[/b]
[b][*]Login Supplies Event (3/20 - 4/16)[/b]Logging in during the event will give you daily and cumulative rewards!

[b][*]Transcendence Weapon Promotion: Sylphid (3/20 - 4/17)[/b]Sylphid will now drop from Premium and normal Transcendence Decoders!

[b][*]Sylphid Guaranteed Giveaway (3/20 - 4/17)[/b]Depending on the number of Premium and normal Transcendence Decoders used, you may be guaranteed to receive the Sylphid permanently![/list]

Check out the following sections for more information.

[h1]---------- Details ----------[/h1]

[h2]Update Information[/h2]

[h3]New Map Available[/h3]
[list][*]Pipeline
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/ac5f801434b213fc1c79e63e0bbdf1f6b13ea737.png[/img]

[*]Eligible Modes: Team Deathmatch, Team Deathmatch (AI), Deathmatch, Deathmatch (AI), Gun Deathmatch, Zombie, Zombie Classic, Zombie Mutant, Zombie Hero, Zombie Z, Zombie Evolution, Super Soldier, and All-Star.[/list]

[h3]Training Ground (Hideout) Update[/h3]
[list][*]Quality-of-Life Improvements
[list][*]Purchase weapons anywhere you like by pressing the B key!
[*]Summon a target anywhere in the firing lane by pressing the V key. Moving bots have also been added.
[*]Removed unnecessary objects on the map and improved traveling routes.[/list][/list]

[list][*]New Features
[list][*]Inspect parts and enhancements for your currently equipped weapon by pressing P.
[*]Added popular spots and structures in the Hideout map.[/list][/list]

[h3]Studio Mode Update[/h3]
[list][*]New Studio Hide and Seek Map!
[list][*]A new Hide and Seek map using Fairy Tale themed Blocks called Fairy Tale Land has been released.[/list][/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/17fcb359e63a20174b28aa3f252bb8aac8abc4a8.png[/img]
[list][*]Studio - Fairy Tale Theme Decoration Block Updates
[list][*]36 standard, 34 decorative, and 14 device blocks have been added.
[*]You can view the new blocks in Creation Mode without adding a separate theme pack.[/list][/list]

[h3]Improvements[/h3]
[list][*]Always On Missions Update
[list][*]The end dates and durations for some Always On Missions have been updated and now have more information about scheduling.[/list][/list]

[list][*]Gift Delivery Improvements
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/30be623c61787866fc1780d1f1e31708360a7bd9.jpg[/img]
[list][*]You can now manage Receive Gifts through the My Ban List at the bottom of Lobby.
[*]Allow Friends/Family Only: accept gifts only from players registered as friends/family.
[*]Allow All: accept gifts from all players.
[*]Block All: refuse accept gifts from all players, including friends/family.
[*]> The default is Allow Friends/Family Only. Please change it to Allow All if you want to receive gifts from all players.
[*]> You cannot receive gifts from players who have either blocked you or have been blocked by you.[/list][/list]


[h2]Event Information[/h2]

[h3]Daily Bonus Box Event (3/20 - 4/17)[/h3]
Complete missions every day during the event to earn a Bonus Box! 

[b]Conditions / Rewards[/b]
[list][*]Mission 1
[list][*]40 minutes of playtime: 1 Bonus Box (Once Daily)
[*]Complete two sessions after reaching 100 Kill Points in Zombie Scenario mode on Hard difficulty or higher: 1 Bonus Box (Once Daily).[/list][/list]

[list][*]Mission 2
[list][*]Clear two tasks from the list below: 1 Bonus Box (Once Daily)
[*]1: Click on the Event Missions tab to check your Missions.
[*]2: Purchase a Point Transcendence Decoder or a Point Class Decoder from the Shop.
[*]3: Go on a single Exploration.[/list][/list]

[list][*]Mission 3
[list][*]Obtain three Bonus Boxes and log in the next day: 1 Event Decoder (Once Daily)[/list][/list]
[list][*]Bonus Box Contents: (one of the following)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/9a9f61494738ac1862c2017a58462862b2d6b70d.png[/img]

[list][*]50 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x1
[*]100 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x1
[*]200 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x1
[*]50 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x3
[*]100 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x3
[*]200 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x3
[*]50 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x5
[*]100 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x5
[*]200 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x5
[*]Random -1 Dehancement Material x1
[*]Random -1 Dehancement Material x3
[*]Random -1 Dehancement Material x5
[*]Grade 3 Parts Reward Box x1
[*]Grade 4 Parts Reward Box x1
[*]Grade 5 Parts Reward Box x1
[*]Grade 3 Parts Reward Box x3
[*]Grade 4 Parts Reward Box x3
[*]Grade 5 Parts Reward Box x3
[*]Grade 3 Parts Reward Box x5
[*]Grade 4 Parts Reward Box x5
[*]Grade 5 Parts Reward Box x5
[*]300 Mileage Coupon x1
[*]500 Mileage Coupon x1
[*]1,000 Mileage Coupon x1
[*]300 Mileage Coupon x3
[*]500 Mileage Coupon x3
[*]1,000 Mileage Coupon x3
[*]300 Mileage Coupon x5
[*]500 Mileage Coupon x5
[*]1,000 Mileage Coupon x5[/list][/list]

[list][*]Bonus Box Rewards
[list][*]3 Bonus Boxes: Rare Decoder x3
[*]9 Bonus Boxes: Rare Decoder x5
[*]15 Bonus Boxes: Unique Decoder x5
[*]21 Bonus Boxes: Unique Premium Decoder x1
[*]30 Bonus Boxes: Class Decoder x7
[*]33 Bonus Boxes: Transcendence Decoder x7[/list][/list]

[list][*]Details
[list][*]Bonus Boxes can be earned up to three times a day.
[*]All unused Bonus Boxes will be removed during maintenance on 4/17.
[*]Pileup rewards can be collected only once per account.
[*]Only rooms with 3 or more players count toward these goals.
[*]You can earn playtime on all modes, including Studio Mode.
[*]Other than playtime, these missions do not count towards participation goals in Studio Mode.
[*]Excludes Zombie Scenario: Survival: Double Gate / Survival: Lost City / Survival: Trap / Survival: Groundwater / Pursuit: Chaos
[*]At least 5 minutes of playtime are required to complete Zombie Scenario mode missions.
[*]Event Decoders can be used until midnight of the day they were obtained and removed afterwards.[/list][/list]

[h3]New and Returning Player Welcome Attendance Event[/h3]
After the 3/20 maintenance, rewards will be updated as follows:

[list][*]Conditions / Rewards
[list][*]Day 1: Point Transcendence Decoder x1 + Points Class Decoder x1 + 500 Mileage
[*]Day 2: Point Transcendence Decoder x2 + Points Class Decoder x2 + 1,000 Mileage

[h3]Login Supplies Event (3/20 - 4/16)[/h3]
Logging in during the event will give you daily and cumulative rewards!

[list][*]Daily Login Rewards: Daily Weapons Supply
[list][*]Daily Supply Contents
[*]Receive all four of the following items: Dual Sword Phantom Slayer (1 Day), M3 Black Dragon (1 Day), Barrett M95 White Tiger (1 Day), and M249 Phoenix (1 Day).

notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: March 13th
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/2bfe2ab7ee615148b8a2ea50a0d152216d7fd167.jpg[/img]

Here's a rundown of some of the major updates in today's patch!

[list][b][*]Return of the Time Bomb Safe Event (3/13 - 4/3 11:59 PM)[/b]Log in every day to receive a Time Bomb Safe but be sure to open it before it explodes!

[b][*]Time Bomb Safe Event (3/13 - 4/3 11:59 PM)[/b]The more Safes you earn, the more rewards you'll collect!

[b][*]Mileage Auction Event[/b]You can access the auction during the event from the Mileage Auction button at the bottom of the lobby screen.

[b][*]Steam Spring Sale Event (3/13 - 3/20)[/b]This spring save up to 99% off on Decoder Supply Boxes! 

[b][*]Transcendence Class Guaranteed Giveaway (3/13 - 4/3)[/b]Get two Transcendence Classes (Blue Rabbit Mirage and Alpaca Anemone) based on the number of Class Decoders and Premium Class Decoders used during the event![/list]

Check out the following sections for more information.

[h1]---------- Details ----------[/h1]

[h2]Event Information[/h2]

[h3]Return of the Time Bomb Safe Event (3/13 - 4/3 11:59 PM)[/h3]
Log in every day to receive a Time Bomb Safe but be sure to open it before it explodes!

[list][*]Conditions
[list][*]Earn 1 Time Bomb Safe for logging in each day.[/list][/list]

[list][*]Time Bomb Safe Contents (Contains one of the following items. The probability of receiving each varies by item.)
[list][*]Ismael (Permanent)
[*]Ethan (Permanent)
[*]Roy (Permanent)
[*]Romy (Permanent)
[*]Ismael (15 Days)
[*]Ethan (15 Days)
[*]Roy (15 Days)
[*]Romy (15 Days)
[*]Rare Decoder x1
[*]Event Decoder x1
[*]200 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x1
[*]100 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x1
[*]Random -1 Dehancement Material x1
[*]Grade 5 Parts Reward Box x1
[*]Grade 4 Parts Reward Box x1 
[*]Grade 3 Parts Reward Box x1 
[*]500 Mileage Coupon x1
[*]300 Mileage Coupon x1
[*]100 Mileage Coupon x1
[*]Zombie Damage Meter (7 Days) x1[/list][/list]

[list][*]Details
[list][*]Since Time Bomb Safes can only be opened the next day, the last chance to earn one is on 4/2.
[*]All Time Bomb Safes will be removed at 11:59 PM on 4/3. Additionally, rewards can only be collected until 11:59 PM on 4/3.[/list][/list]

[h3]Time Bomb Safe Event (3/13 - 4/3 11:59 PM)[/h3]
The more Safes you earn, the more rewards you'll collect!

[list][*]Safes Earned / Rewards
[list][*]3 Safes: Rare Decoder x5 + Zombie Scenario Add-On Rate Box x5
[*]6 Safes: Unique Decoder x5 + 100 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x5
[*]9 Safes: Transcendence Weapon Pass (3 Days) + Class Decoder x3 + Event Decoder x5
[*]12 Safes: Transcendence Weapon Pass (3 Days) + Transcendence Decoder x3 + Event Decoder x5
[*]15 Safes: Transcendence Weapon Pass (3 Days) + Transcendence Decoder x2 + Class Decoder x7
[*]18 Safes: Unique Decoder Supply Box (15 Days) + Rare Decoder Supply Box (15 Days)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/5c052872e3a372d2956533e9d4bfb5a37b725504.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/5a46558dac67a9fd57a8a9112cd066bda23bcd9f.png[/img]
[*]21 Safes: Grade 5 Parts Reward Box x5 + 200 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x5[/list][/list]

[list][*]Details
[list][*]Rewards can only be obtained once per account.
[*]Rare and Unique Decoder Supply Boxes are opened immediately when collected. You will receive two Decoders each day you log in. You will not receive Decoders on days you did not log in.
[*]Event Decoders can be used until midnight of the day they were obtained.[/list][/list]


[h3]Mileage Auction Event (03/13 - 03/19 23:59:59)[/h3]
You can access the auction during the event from the Mileage Auction button at the bottom of the lobby screen.

[list][*]Details
[list][*]Item Rank: Premium (All other weapons are Normal Rank)
[*]Auction Time: 1 hour (All items)
[*]Number of Auction Listings: 2 (This number increases based on your VIP rank)
[*]Pricing Details: Current Auction House prices, such as Lowest Bid and the Direct Purchase, can be referenced when listing an item.
[*]Items Displayed: Only items with lowest bid or direct purchase price are displayed
[*]Auction Settings: You can search by bid/direct purchase price, enhancement level, and weapon name.
[*]Sell-to-System Feature: When an auction is unsuccessful, you have the opportunity to use the sell-to-system feature.
[*]Auction Hours: 00:00 AM - 11:59 PM (When the auction hours end, currently listed items will be canceled)[/list][/list]

[list][*]Details
[list][*]The remaining time is shown in 5-minute increments for listed auction items.
[*]You can only bid for 1 item at a time.
[*]Regular auction items will be listed with a 30% fee included in the initial bidding price.
[*]If an item listed on the auction is not sold, the item will be returned.
[*]Items listed on the auction can be purchased immediately at the direct purchase price.
[*]If you list an item, you cannot cancel it until the auction is over.
[*]Items you have listed will be shown on the bid page.
[*]When listing an item, you can easily check the actual amount you will receive under the Net Reward section.
[*]Some recently released items cannot be placed for auction.[/list][/list]


[h2]Promotions[/h2]

[h3]Steam Spring Sale Event (3/13 - 3/20)[/h3]
This spring save up to 99% off on Decoder Supply Boxes! 
For more information, please visit the[url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/273110/announcements/detail/4133813065577859736] Promotions page.[/url]


[h3]Transcendence Class Promotion (3/13 - 4/3)[/h3]
Two Transcendence Classes, Blue Rabbit Mirage and Alpaca Anemone, are now available in Class Decoders and Premium Class Decoders.

[list][*]Blue Rabbit Mirage
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/899d66393f899f88197560de25ce4f9652bf1ad8.png[/img]
[list][*]Mirage is a famous virtual streamer with a lively personality on the VR platform Chrono World, who enjoys chatting with her fans in cute outfits. In reality, she is a timid but accomplished hacker who accidentally stumbled upon suspicious records having to do with Chrono World. Ever since, Mirage has been trying to contact Aegis Institute while avoiding those who are hunting her down for what she uncovered.
[*]Paired Weapon: Magnum Launcher
[list][*]Earn special rounds every time you left-click fire a certain amount of times.
[*]Using right-click increases the number of special rounds that are fired.
[*]A direct hit with this special round will have increased damage in Zombie and Zombie Scenario modes.[/list]

[*]Zombie Scenario Skill: Saber Protocol
[*]Passive: Critical Rate and Movement Speed is increased when playing in Zombie Scenario mode together with Alpaca Anemone.
[list][*](Connection effect applied, cannot be stacked).
Applies the Addict Add-On Effect (Which can be stacked, increasing the effect).[/list]

[*]Active: Applies Invincible to yourself and any nearby allies for a certain amount of time in Zombie Scenario mode.
[list][*]While Invincible, steal a certain amount of damage done to enemies to yourself.

[*]Transcendence Class exclusive voices are applied.
[*]+10% EXP/Points
[*]In Zombie Scenario mode, this character has a higher max level than normal classes.
[*]This character adds one initial mutation in Zombie Z Mode.
[*]This character displays your current damage at the bottom of the screen.
[*]Marks enemies at or below 20% HP.
[*]This character leaves a unique mark at the target location upon killing an enemy.[/list][/list][/list]

[list][*]Alpaca Anemone
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/822db48252d382ee984b21cccf8ded961747efe0.png[/img]
[list][*]Anemone, a pro gamer on the VR platform Chrono World, is renowned for her skill in the world of competitive gaming. Unlike her older twin sister Mirage, she's both strong and sociable. She is dedicated to protecting Mirage after she learned that the developer behind Chrono World is part of a suspicious conspiracy.
[*]Paired Weapon: Magnum Launcher
[list][*]Using right-click will fire special rounds out in 3 rows.
[*]Direct hits with Special Ammo will have increased damage, but any Explosion Damage will be reduced in Zombie and Zombie Scenario modes.[/list]

[*]Zombie Scenario Skill: Valorous Energy
[*]Passive: Critical Rate and Movement Speed is increased when playing in Zombie Scenario mode together with Blue Rabbit Mirage.
[list][*](Connection effect applied, cannot be stacked).
[*]Applies the Free Market Add-On Effect (Which can be stacked, increasing the effect).[/list]

[*]Active: Applies a barrier to yourself and any nearby allies for a certain amount of time.
[list][*]Attack power is increased for a certain amount of time (First at a significant amount, then reduced as time passes).[/list]

[*]Transcendence Class exclusive voices are applied.
[*]+10% EXP/Points
[*]In Zombie Scenario mode, this character has a higher max level than normal classes.
[*]This character adds one initial mutation in Zombie Z Mode.
[*]This character displays your current damage at the bottom of the screen.
[*]Marks enemies at or below 20% HP.
[*]This character leaves a unique mark at the target location upon killing an enemy.[/list][/list]


[h3]Transcendence Class Guaranteed Giveaway (3/13 - 4/3)[/h3]
Get two Transcendence Classes (Blue Rabbit Mirage and Alpaca Anemone) based on the number of Class Decoders and Premium Class Decoders used during the event!

[list][*]Conditions and Rewards
[list][*]After reaching 150 Guaranteed Points earned by using a Decoder.
[*]After reaching 300 Guaranteed Points earned by using a Decoder.
[*]Select either Blue Rabbit Mirage and Giant Carrot, or Alpaca Anemone and Alpaca Keyring.[/list][/list]

[list][*]Details
[list][*]One Guaranteed Point is awarded each time you use a Class Decoder.
[*]Three Guaranteed Points are awarded when you use a Premium Class Decoder.
[*]Selecting Blue Rabbit Mirage will automatically give you the Giant Carrot (Permanent).
[*]Selecting Alpaca Anemone will automatically give you the Alpaca Keyring (Permanent).
[*]Guaranteed Giveaway rewards can only be collected once per account.[/list][/list]


[h2]Other Fixes[/h2]
[list][*]Fixed an issue where the item purchase limit for the Mileage Shop wasn't being updated.
[*]Fixed an issue where some class selection windows were not displayed.[/list]

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/bb57242a8cac676456cd7181174445d3625430fd.jpg[/img]

Here's a rundown of some of the major updates in today's patch!

[list][b][*]New Zombie Scenario Season 9-1 Map[/b]Pursuit: The Trap of Arrogance

[b][*]New Medals[/b]Six new medals have been added.

[b][*]New Zombie Scenario Map - Pursuit: The Trap of Arrogance Play Event (2/27 - 3/13)[/b]Try the new Zombie Scenario map and earn great rewards!

[b][*]Earn Medals and Reap the Rewards! (2/27 - 4/3)[/b]Don't miss out on the amazing rewards you'll receive every time you earn a unique Medal during the event!

[b][*]Random Weapon Zombie Hero Event (2/27 - 3/13)[/b]Test how skilled you really are in Zombie Hero Mode with randomized weapons!

[b][*]Spring Event (2/27 - 3/13)[/b]Put some step into your Spring with these brand new rewards! 

[b][*]Nyepi Holiday Play Event (3/9 - 3/12)[/b]Log in during the event and claim your Lucky Raffle Ticket!

Check out the following sections for more information.

[h1]---------- Details ----------[/h1]

[h2]Update Information[/h2]

[h3]New Zombie Scenario Season 9-1 Map[/h3]
[list][*]Pursuit: The Trap of Arrogance
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/c360bcc23436da7f46cf47116b7e4d2449a47cfe.png[/img]
[list][*]Douglas Jacob has captured the laboratories at Aegis Institute with a surprise ambush. Refusing to stand by and do nothing, Jennifer and Dr. Soi arm themselves and begin their plans to retake the facilities.
[*]You can find more information in the Zombie Scenario 9-1 Preview.[/list][/list]


[h3]New Medals[/h3]

[list][*]Perfect Soldier
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/b165526543b9178ad2472d7e81a4f7e01e71adc5.png[/img]
[list][*]Complete a full clear of Zombie Scenario alone 30 times without dying.[/list][/list]

[list][*]Feast of Swords
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/337fb53f1f0ed101ed5b482d5dc86ee55031af25.png[/img]
[list][*]Complete a full clear of Zombie Scenario with two or more people 30 times using only Melee Weapons.[/list][/list]

[list][*]Eternal Class
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/84dc48de42ee454e0c4451d54a73162a4598787e.png[/img]
[list][*]Complete 100 Human Infections when Zombie HP is at 2,000 or less.[/list][/list]

[list][*]Worker C
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/64ffef8dbf8419c6fdf56b3471de6dab9fc4474c.png[/img]
[list][*]Complete Zombie Scenario - Pursuit: The Trap of Arrogance map (Normal or higher) 100 times.[/list][/list]

[list][*]Notice

notes.title: [Update] Event Patch Notes: February 6th
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/629280d74c2f7942bb6147dc627fb60cc4565cbf.png[/img]
Here's a rundown of some of the major updates in today's patch!

[list][b][*] New Year Holiday Play Event (2/6 – 2/27)[/b]Pick up New Year Supply Boxes to earn rewards while celebrating the new year!

[b][*] Catch the New Year Blue Dragon! Event (1) (2/6 - 2/27)[/b]2024 is the year of the Blue Dragon! It's your year to catch it and earn rewards!

[b][*] Stingray Kite Carnage (2/6 – 2/27)[/b]Hit Stingray Kites during the event to get the Honor Medal!

[b][*] Crossbow Classic Login Event (2/6 - 2/27)[/b]Log in to claim the new weapon and play the game to obtain Enhancement Material!

[b][*] New Year Gift Event (2/6 - 2/27)[/b]Receive the following rewards by staying logged in for 5 minutes during the event period.

[b][*] Mileage Auction Event (2/6 – 2/20)[/b]The new year begins with a Mileage Auction! Auctions only last a limited time, so don't miss out!

[b][*] Special Mileage Auction Event (2/6 – 2/20)[/b]Become the winner of the special item that appears at a specific time.

Check out the following sections for more information.[/list]

[h1]---------- Details ----------[/h1]

[h3]New Year Holiday Play Event (2/6 – 2/27)[/h3]
Pick up New Year Supply Boxes to earn rewards while celebrating the new year!

[list][*]Participation & Rewards
[list][*]Earn a Lucky Pouch each time you log in (1 a day)
[*]Earn a Lucky Pouch for reaching 5 / 10 / 20 / 30 / 40 / 50 / 60 minutes of game play (up to 7 a day)
[*]Earn a Lucky Pouch for obtaining a Supply Box in Zombie Hero / Zombie Z modes (up to 2 a day)
[*]Earn a Lucky Pouch or obtaining a Point Box in Zombie Scenario mode in Normal or above (up to 2 a day)[/list][/list]

[list][*]Lucky Pouch Contents (Chance to get 1 of these items)
[list][*]Rare Decoder x1
[*]Event Decoder x1
[*]Unique Decoder x1
[*]50 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x1
[*]100 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x1
[*]200 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x1
[*]Exploration Success Rate-Up +10% x1
[*]Exploration Success Rate-Up +20% x1
[*]Grade 3 Parts Reward Box x1 
[*]Grade 4 Parts Reward Box x1 
[*]Grade 5 Parts Reward Box x1
[*]Random -1 Dehancement Material x1
[*]100 Mileage Coupon x1
[*]200 Mileage Coupon x1
[*]1000 Mileage Coupon x1
[*]Zombie Scenario Add-On Rate Box x1
[*]Zombie Damage Meter (7 Days)[/list][/list]

[list][*]Notice
[list][*]You can obtain up to 10 Lucky Pouches per day regardless of the mission.
[*]Excludes Zombie Scenario: Double Gate / Lost City / Survival: Trap / Survival: Groundwater / Pursuit: Chaos
[*]Participation only counts in rooms with three or more players (excludes Studio, includes Laboratory Modes).
[*]All Lucky Pouches will be removed during maintenance on 2/27.
[*] The Event Decoder can be used until midnight on the day it is obtained.
[*]Supply Boxes (Zombie Mode) and Point Boxes (Zombie Scenario) will appear as Lucky Pouches during the event until the 2/15 maintenance.[/list][/list]

[h3]Catch the New Year Blue Dragon! Event (1) (2/6 - 2/27)[/h3]
2024 is the year of the Blue Dragon! It's your year to catch it and earn rewards!

[list][*]Participation & Rewards
[list][*]Catch a Blue Dragon in the waiting room/lobby to obtain Lion Mask Hat (1 Day) or Lucky Pouch Spray (1 Day)[/list][/list]

[list][*]Notice
[list][*]You can participate in this event up to twice a day.[/list][/list]


[h3]Catch the New Year Blue Dragon! Event (2) (2/6 - 2/27)[/h3]
Get even more rewards for catching more Blue Dragons!

[list][*]Participation & Rewards
[list][*]Catch 100 Blue Dragons in the waiting room/lobby to earn the New Year Hunter Medal & Event Decoder x10 & 100 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x5[/list][/list]

[list][*]Notice
[list][*]You can only participate in this event once per account.
[*]Players who already possess the New Year Hunter medal cannot receive another one, but they can still claim the rest of the rewards.
[*]The Event Decoder can be used until midnight on the day it is obtained.[/list][/list]


[h3]Stingray Kite Carnage (2/6 – 2/27)[/h3]
Hit Stingray Kites during the event to get the Honor Medal!

[list][*]Participation & Rewards
[list][*]Hit 300 Stingray Kites to earn [Honor] Killer K Medal + Transcendence Decoder x10.[/list][/list]

[list][*]Notice
[list][*]Players who already possess the Killer K medal cannot receive another one, but they will still receive the Transcendence Decoder reward.
[*]Maps with Stingray Kites: Mouse Hole, Survival: Double Gate, Survival: Trap, and Survival: Lost City
[*]You can claim your reward once you kill 300 Stingray Kites during the event.
[*]Eligible Modes: All modes excluding bot modes (but includes Laboratory mode)[/list][/list]

[h3]Crossbow Classic Login Event (2/6 - 2/27)[/h3]
Log in to claim the new weapon and play the game to obtain Enhancement Material!

[list][*]Weapon Giveaway
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/a3561b567dd2e652b2ecec3c3b5581732f393024.png[/img]

[list][*]Reward
[list][*]Failnaught (7 Days)
[*]Holy Sword Divine Order (7 Days)
[*]Lightning Fury (7 Days)[/list][/list]

[list][*]Notice
[list][*]The reward can only be earned once per account.[/list][/list]


[h3]Mileage Auction Event (2/6 – 2/20)[/h3]

[list][*]Permanent Auction Item Added
[list][*]Anemone
[*]Mirage
[*]Norinco Type 86s
[*]Bomb Boost Part - Grades 1 - 6
[*]Bomb Self-Shield Part - Grades 1 - 6[/list][/list]

[list][*]Auction Details
[list][*]Item Rank: Premium (All weapons except for premium are Normal Rank)
[*]Auction Time: 1 hour for all items
[*]Number of Listings: 2 (Can be increased based on VIP rank)
[*]Market Price of Items: When listing an item, you can check the current Auction House market price (Lowest bid and direct purchase prices).
[*]Item Display: Only items with the lowest bid or have a direct purchase price are displayed.
[*]Auction Settings: You can search by bid/direct purchase price, enhancement level, and weapon name.
[*]Sell-to-System Feature: When an auction is unsuccessful, you'll have the opportunity to use the sell-to-system feature.
[*]Auction Hours: 24 Hours (12:00 AM – 11:59 PM) - When auction hours end, currently listed items will be canceled.[/list][/list]

[list][*]Notice
[list][*]Premium Line Changes: 
[*][Added] Anemone, Mirage, Bomb Boost Part - Grade 6, Bomb Self-Shield Part - Grade 6
[*][Removed] Boss David Black, Leader Soi, Rage Down Part - Grade 6, Armor Break Part - Grade 6
[*]Lower Price Limit: 700 / Upper Price Limit: None

[*]You can only bid on one item at a time.
[*]Regular auction items will be listed with a 30% fee included in the initial bidding price.
[*]If an item listed for auction is not sold, the item will be returned.
[*]Items listed for auction can be purchased immediately at the direct purchase price.
[*]If you list an item for auction, you cannot withdraw it until the auction's duration has ended.
[*]The item you listed may be shown on the bid page.
[*]When listing an item, you can easily check the actual amount you will receive under the Net Reward section.
[*]Some recently released weapons cannot be listed at auction.[/list][/list]


[h3]Special Mileage Auction Event (2/6 – 2/20)[/h3]
Become the winner of the special item that appears at a specific time.

[list][*]Special Auction time
[list][*]12:00 PM / Transcendence Red Dragon Cannon Gold
[*]1:30 PM / Transcendence Magnum Drill Gold[/list][/list]

[list][*]Notice
[list][*]Auction items only appear at specific times.
[*]Bidding Time: 60 minutes of public bid, then 10 minutes of private bid.[/list][/list]


[h2]Other Changes[/h2]
[olist][*]In order to prevent macro use, making a set trade in the auction house will require new authentication.
[*]Antarctic Base map's playable area has been adjusted and some objects have been removed.
[*]The value of the Rolling Vulcan shop has been adjusted and the Rolling Thunder's condition was changed from 3 to 1 Hero Energy.
[*]Fixed an issue in zombie mode where if a zombie dies while using their skill where they would continuously inflict damage on a human. 
[*]Fixed an issue where dying while using Aksha's Absorb skill and then reviving would display the skill UI as unactivated. 
[*]Fixed typos on Ismael, Idol Miho, and Spell Lance Scarlet Rose item descriptions. 
[*]Fixed an issue in specific situations where ending the session would not close the notification window. 
[*]Fixed an issue in zombie scenario mode where Infinite Ammo would be applied to a different firearm.
[*]Fixed an issue in classic mode where the Nata Knife Hero would inflict an incorrect amount damage.
[*]Fixed an issue for some weapon paints where the textures would display incorrectly.
[*]Fixed an issue where using the decoder would not provide any mileage.
[list][*]Mileage that was not correctly distributed will be given out upon maintenance.[/list][/olist]

notes.title: New year's greeting from CSN:S Team
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/0281799281f1edd7c9c809839809b0de6e98b1be.png[/img]

[b]Greetings from the dev team for Counter-Strike Nexon: Studio.[/b]

We can't believe it's already 2024!

We hope that you've made lots of progress with your New Year's resolutions and all the plans you've made for this year.
We'd like to give our thanks to everyone who spent time playing Counter-Strike Nexon: Studio last year.
We are looking forward to another great year and plan to work even harder to show you what your support means to us.

During 2024 we are planning to make a variety of changes which include improving a few outdated systems that were built years ago,
implementing some new balance changes that should make things more interesting for our players,
and continue to listen to your all your feedback and suggestions.


Finally, we've prepared a small gift to enjoy while you play Counter-Strike Nexon: Studio this year.
We look forward to seeing you in 2024, where we will work hard to bring you new challenges and even more fun!

[list][*]How to Earn Kill Points
[list][*]Zombie Kills as a Human: 3 Points (bots excluded)
[*]Zombie Assists as a Human: 1 Point (bots excluded)
[*]Human Infections as a Zombie: 4 Points (bots excluded)

[list][*]Notice
[list][*]Hyper Gaebolg Fragments stack, and you can collect up to a maximum of 300. (Any amount that exceeds this will not be collected)
[*]Hyper Gaebolg Fragments will be removed on the day the event ends.
[*]You can acquire up to 20 Hyper Gaebolg Fragments per day through special mission rewards.
[*]Hyper Gaebolg Fragments will be removed on the day the event ends.

Season badges are given immediately based on the login time for daily missions during the season.

[list][*]Login Time / Season Badge
[list][*]30 min: x5
[*]60 min: x10
[*]120 min: x20
[*]Daily missions reset every day at midnight.
[*]You cannot use a difficulty change item on [Event] missions.[/list][/list]

[h3]Zombie Scenario Golden Zombie Kill Event (1/24 - 5/15)[/h3]
Earn rewards by killing Golden Zombies when you play Zombie Scenario during the Season 18.

[list][*]Total Amount / Rewards
[list][*]Accumulate 1, 2, 3, 5, 7, and 10 kills to obtain rewards 
[*]Obtainable Items (Select 1): Zombie Scenario Add-On Selection Box x2 / Guaranteed Transcendence Class Box / 100 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x4 / Random -1 Dehancement Material x10 / 2,000 Mileage / Old-time Zombie Costume Box / Golden Zombie Weapon Box[/list][/list]

[list][*]Notice
[list][*]Zombie Scenario Add-On Selection Box Contents: 20 of Reinforced Attack, Extended Magazine, Tide Turner, Shadow Blade, Survival Instincts, Explosive Ammo, Free Market, Weakness Analysis, Titan's Will, Regeneration, Swiftfoot, and Capital Add-Ons.
[*]Hitting the Golden Zombie once counts as killing it once.
[*]Each reward is given only once per account.
[*]Up to 3 can be defeated per day.
[*]Guaranteed Transcendence Class Box, Old-time Zombie Costume Box, and Golden Zombie Weapon Box's reward items are binding items.
[*]Unused Guaranteed Transcendence Class Boxes, Old-time Zombie Costume Boxes, and Golden Zombie Weapon Boxes will be removed on the day that the event ends.
[*]The Golden Zombies have a chance to appear when playing for more than 3 minutes in rooms on Normal difficulty or higher.
[*]Bound items cannot be used as Auction, Disassembly, or Family Storage items.[/list][/list]

[h3]Login Supplies Event Guide (1/24 - 2/26)[/h3]
When you check-in for attendance during the event, you'll get daily and cumulative rewards.

[list][*]Login Reward

[list][*]Daily Supply Contents
[list][*]Earn all 4: Dual Sword Phantom Slayer (1 Day), M3 Black Dragon (1 Day), Barrett M95 White Tiger (1 Day), and M249 Phoenix (1 Day)
[*]There is a chance that 2 rare, unique, or transcendence weapons (1 Day) will be provided.

[*]All weapons and classes from the Daily Supply are bound and cannot be used for Auction/Disassembly/Family Storage (Extension X).[/list]

[*]Total Login Days / Rewards
[list][*]5 Days: Psychic Harmonium (20 Days) + Cumulative Attendance Reward Box
[*]10 Days: NEGEV NG-7 Ajax (20 Days) + Cumulative Attendance Reward Box
[*]15 Days: Trinity Grenade (20 Days) + Cumulative Attendance Reward Box
[*]20 Days: Dread Nova (15 Days) + Cumulative Attendance Reward Box

[*]Attendance rewards will be provided directly as rewards instead of Daily/Cumulative Attendance Reward Box items.
[*]Rewards can be claimed immediately after game login, and rewards are available until midnight every day.[/list][/list][/list]

[h3]100% Achievement Event[/h3]
Get rewards to celebrate the Steam Achievement update.

[list][*]Rewards
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/5258af9e23043efd3babdd4bda6c571b62c0fc9b.png[/img]

[h3]Achievement Box Giveaway[/h3]
Get rewards every time you get 15 Steam Achievements.

[list][*]Rewards
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/27a347f032443eb60dec4500d8c4518c584485d9.png[/img]

[h2]Other Information[/h2]
[olist][*]An icon will be displayed for Creation Map contest winner.

notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: January 17th
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/4fc67bc7215bece254b4b82a694735612374a257.jpg[/img]

Here's a rundown of some of the major updates in today's patch!

[list][b][*]New Year's Luck! Event (01/17- 01/31)[/b]
Get ready for lots of luck and good fortune in 2024!

[b][*]Good-Bye Season 17 Double Badges Event (01/17- 01/24)[/b]
Earn double Season Badges from daily and weekly missions during the event.

[b][*]Transcendence Class Promotion (01/17 -02/06)[/b]
Two Transcendence Classes, Special Agent Mei and Pyromaniac Yuri, are now available in Class Decoders and Premium Class Decoders.

[b][*]Transcendence Weapon Promotion: Satellite Mine/Laevateinn (01/17 - 02/06)[/b]
Satellite Mine and Laevateinn will now drop from Premium and normal Transcendence Decoders![/list]

[h1]---------- Details ----------[/h1]

[h2]Update Information[/h2]

[h3]Zombie Z Event Mode (01/17 - 02/06)

[list][*]Zombie Z Event Mode Information
[list][*]Zombie Z Event Mode is only playable on Dust, Assault, and Estate maps.
[*]There are only seven rounds and Karma/Morale Boost is unavailable.[/list][/list]

[list][*]Notice
[list][*]You cannot earn EXP from combat during the Zombie Z Mode event, but instead gain six levels every round, up to level 40.
[*]Weapons and zombies available change based on your level.
[*]Using Mutation Points will allow you to choose from one of three random mutations.
[*]Choosing an already obtained mutation will increase its level and improve its power. When a mutation reaches level 6 (maximum level), the power will increase drastically or additional abilities will be given.
[*]Mutations are given in order and divided into one of two groups (A/B) each time you spend points. Each group can earn up to five of the eight mutations.
[*]A hidden mutation may sometimes appear when certain mutations reach max level.[/list][/list]


[h2]Event Information[/h2]

[h3]New Year's Luck! Event (01/17- 01/31)[/h3]
Get ready for lots of luck and good fortune in 2024!

[list][*]How To Earn Charms
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/294d7f606d047519cee4083deedc617a65b9906e.png[/img]
[list][*]15 minutes of playtime: 3 Rare Decoders (once a day).
[*]30 minutes of playtime: 1 Event Decoder + 2 Good Luck Charms (once a day).
[*]60 minutes of playtime: 1 Class Decoder + 2 Good Luck Charms (once a day).
[*]90 minutes of playtime: 2 Good Luck Charms (once a day).[/list][/list]

[list][*]In-game Missions
[list][*]Score a total of 30 Kill Points Zombie Mode: 2 Good Luck Charms (up to 6 per day)
[*]Score 100 Kill Points in Zombie Scenario mode on hard or higher, then clear it: 1 Good Luck Charm (up to 6 per day)[/list][/list]

[list][*]How to Earn Kill Points
[list][*]Zombie Kills as a Human: 3 Points (bots excluded)
[*]Zombie Assists as a Human: 1 Point (bots excluded)
[*]Human Infections as a Zombie: 4 Points (bots excluded)
[*]Human Infection Assists as Zombie: 0 Points[/list][/list]

[list][*]Rewards for Total Charms Collected
[list][*]10 Good Luck Charms: Rare Decoder x10
[*]20 Good Luck Charms: Unique Decoder x5 + Rare Decoder x5
[*]35 Good Luck Charms: Event Decoder x5 + Rare Decoder x15
[*]60 Good Luck Charms: Unique Premium Decoder x2 + Rare Decoder x10
[*]80 Good Luck Charms: Event Decoder x5 + Rare Decoder x10
[*]100 Good Luck Charms: Transcendence Decoder x5 + Unique Premium Decoder x5
[*]120 Good Luck Charms: Transcendence Decoder x5 + Class Decoder x5
[*]130 Good Luck Charms: Transcendence Premium Decoder x3 + Class Premium Decoder x6 + Event Decoder x10[/list][/list]

[list][*]Notice
[list][*]You can earn up to 12 Good Luck Charms a day, per Nexon account.
[*]You cannot collect more than 130 Good Luck Charms.
[*]All remaining Good Luck Charms will be removed during maintenance on 2/6/24.
[*]All unused Transcendence Premium Decoders and Premium Class Decoders will be removed during maintenance on 2/6/24. Each Transcendence Premium Decoder will be replaced with 500 Mileage and each Premium Class Decoder will be replaced with 50 Mileage.
[*]Each cumulative reward can be earned only once per Nexon account.
[*]You can earn playtime on all modes, including Studio Mode.
[*]Credit will only be granted in rooms with three or more players (excludes Studio Mode).
[*]Autohunt kills are excluded regardless of mode.
[*]Compatible Zombie Modes: Zombie Classic / Zombie Mutant / Zombie Hero / Zombie Z / Zombie Evolution
[*]Excluded Zombie Scenario Maps: Double Gate / Lost City / Survival: Trap / Survival: Groundwater / Pursuit: Chaos
[*]You must play for at least 5 minutes to get credit for Zombie Scenario mode missions.
[*]The Event Decoders can be used until midnight on the day it is obtained.[/list][/list]


[h3]Good-Bye Season 17 Double Trouble Event (01/17- 01/24)[/h3]
Earn double Season Badges from daily and weekly missions during the event.


[h2]Shop Update[/h2]

[h3]Transcendence Class Promotion (01/17 -02/06)[/h3]
Two Transcendence Classes, Special Agent Mei and Pyromaniac Yuri, are now available in Class Decoders and Premium Class Decoders.

[list][*]Special Agent Mei
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/75b6df5a437352efa682fef3d0d304808bc76231.png[/img]
[list][*]Background: Mei is a Chinese-born special agent who works for the Intelligence Agency and is trained in high-level combat. Most recently, she had been assigned to assist a fellow agent, but has found this difficult. In a turn of events that wrecked her resume, Mei has been unable to track her target due to their masterful disguise. When she discovered that the troublesome pyromaniac that had been terrorizing the world was actually the agent that she had been told to support, Mei became extremely conflicted, but carried on. Still struggling to find the pyromaniac agent, she eventually received intel that they had met up with David's company, so now Mei is on the move again to finally provide support.
[*]Paired Weapon: Dual Sword Phantom Slayer
[list][*]Feast's activation time has been decreased, and damage increased.[/list]
[*]Zombie Scenario Skill: Special Agent's Stance
[list][*]Passive: Damage dealt to the boss is increased when playing alongside Pyromaniac Yuri (Connection effect applied, cannot be stacked). Buff effect is amplified if the connection effect is active, and Pyromaniac Yuri or Special Agent Mei is in the same room (up to 2 players). [/list]
[*]Trap Evasion's Add-On effect is applied by default.
[*]Active: Uses Conceal in Zombie Scenario, which will obscure you. Your HP will slowly recover during this time, but inflicting damage on an enemy will reveal you. Once Conceal is disabled, your movement speed will return to normal, and a set amount of HP will be restored immediately for you and your allies within a set range.
[*]Transcendence Class exclusive voices are applied.
[*]+10% EXP/Points
[*]In Zombie Scenario mode, this character has a higher max level than normal classes.
[*]This character adds one initial mutation in Zombie Z Mode.
[*]This character displays your current damage at the bottom of the screen.
[*]Marks enemies at or below 20% HP.
[*]This character leaves a unique mark at the target location upon killing an enemy.[/list][/list]

[list][*]Pyromaniac Yuri
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/f0ed63fef3b67d8e25da7d00298fec62ccdb1e06.png[/img]
[list][*]Background: A mysterious girl with an amazing talent for handling explosives, Yuri is known for working exclusively on more destructive activities. Although she successfully completes most of her missions, she once unintentionally injured Jennifer while on an assignment. Yuri is a master of disguise and can infiltrate any location to get the job done, but recently, she has been on the run from Mei, who has been persistently chasing her after Yuri had planned on using David Black and his company but ended up exposing her current whereabouts to Mei. Now, the two of them find the chase and each other’s company to be getting exhausting.
[*]Paired Weapon: Dual Beretta Gunslinger
[list][*]Gun Kata's damage is now unaffected by distance, rather than decreasing the farther away your target is.
[*]Gun Kata's damage has been increased[/list]
[*]Zombie Scenario Skill: Blow It Up
[list][*]Passive: Damage dealt to the boss is increased when playing alongside Special Agent Mei (Connection effect applied, cannot be stacked). Buff effect is amplified if the connection effect is active, and Pyromaniac Yuri or Special Agent Mei is in the same room (up to 2 players).  [/list]
[*]Giant's Feet's Add-On effect is applied by default.
[*]Active: Applies explosion damage within a set range around you in Zombie Scenario (Not applicable to objects).
[*]Damage of allies within the explosion range is increased for a set duration.
[*]Explosive Ammo is loaded in your magazines, which explode at set intervals.
[*]Transcendence Class exclusive voices are applied.
[*]+10% EXP/Points
[*]In Zombie Scenario mode, this character has a higher max level than normal classes.
[*]This character adds one initial mutation in Zombie Z Mode.
[*]This character displays your current damage at the bottom of the screen.
[*]Marks enemies at or below 20% HP.
[*]This character leaves a unique mark at the target location upon killing an enemy.[/list][/list]


[h3]Transcendence Class Guaranteed Giveaway (01/17 -02/06)[/h3]
Get two guaranteed Transcendence Classes (Special Agent Mei and Pyromaniac Yuri) based on the number of Class Decoders and Premium Class Decoders used during the event!

[list][*]Conditions and Rewards
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/933fc4adfa1334a7141cef6da1b24c92b456040d.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/591c21162cc35c396c7f068e579616f56b870bc7.png[/img]
[list][*]Upon reaching 150 Guaranteed Points from Decoder use.
[*]Upon reaching 300 Guaranteed Points from Decoder use.
[*]Select either: Special Agent Mei + Mikey Panda or Pyromaniac Yuri + Bomb Bot[/list][/list]

[list][*]Notice
[list][*]One Guaranteed Point given each time you use a Class Decoder.
[*]3 Guaranteed Points are given when you use a Class Premium Decoder.
[*]Selecting Special Agent Mei will automatically provide Mikey Panda (Permanent).
[*]Selecting Pyromaniac Yuri will automatically provide Bomb Bot (Permanent).
[*]Guaranteed Giveaway rewards can be granted once per account.[/list][/list]


[h3]Transcendence Weapon Promotion: Satellite Mine/Laevateinn (01/17 - 02/06)[/h3]
Satellite Mine and Laevateinn will now drop from Premium and normal Transcendence Decoders!

[list][*]Satellite Mine/Laevateinn Drop Rate
[list][*]Transcendence Premium Decoder: 3%
[*]Transcendence Decoder: 0.45%[/list][/list]

[list][*]Satellite Mine
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/9bd598e8eb7cf0c209457c9d9a85251451467278.jpg[/img]
[list][*]Description: A special mine armed with cutting-edge satellite technology. It can either seek nearby enemies on its own or be manually detonated. When activated, it creates a zone that hinders enemy movement, then calls down a laser bombardment that only harms enemies after a short delay.[/list][/list]

[list][*]Laevateinn
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/d3651be67321ae24dfe290155a1477b568473cbf.png[/img]
[list][*]A pistol that holds 50 rounds of 5.7mm explosive ammo that explodes when it hits the target. When you fire beyond a certain number of rounds, a special feature becomes available.
[*]Special Feature: Electric Area. Right-clicking after the gauge is charged 25% removes the Slow debuff on self, deals a set amount of damage to enemies approaching the area, and pushes them back.
[*]Special Feature: Paralysis Area. Right-clicking after the gauge is charged 100% removes the Slow debuff on self, disables the attacks/skills/movement of enemies within the area, and pushes them back. A set portion of the damage dealt is restored as HP. (Attack/skill/movement disabling and AoE HP leeching features do not work in certain modes).[/list][/list]


[h3]Satellite Mine/Laevateinn Guaranteed Giveaway (01/17 - 02/06)[/h3]
Depending on the number of Premium and normal Transcendence Decoders used, you Mei be guaranteed to receive the Satellite Mine/Laevateinn permanently!

[list][*]Reward Thresholds
[list][*]Upon Reaching 300 Guaranteed Points[/list][/list]

[list][*]Notice
[list][*]6 Guaranteed Points each time you use 1 Transcendence Premium Decoder.
[*]1 Guaranteed Point each time you use 1 Transcendence Decoder.
[*]All unused Premium Transcendence Decoders will be replaced with 500 mileage each and removed during maintenance on 02/06/24.[/list][/list]

notes.title: [Notice] Studio #Fitness Theme Contest: Player Vote Announcement
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/16d6a1d12d5b46ba0d1114bf27f1f46c25655698.jpg[/img]

[b]Greetings Survivors![/b]

In the[url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/273110/announcements/detail/3730728845613758540] November 1st announcement,[/url] we announced the beginning of another Studio Map Contest. 
It’s time to let your voices be heard and help us pick the winners! The winners will be selected based on 50% player votes and 50% on CSNS Team’s internal score.

[h3][url=https://forms.gle/2cX96MKiCq5UJHuJ7]Go Vote! <----- Click![/url][/h3]
