notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: December 27th
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/356215264fa06dd9452c9f57c23c110f32e695d6.jpg[/img]

Here's a rundown of some of the major updates in today's patch!

[list][b][*]Login Supplies Event (12/27 - 01/30 11:59)[/b]
[b][*]Adieu, 2023! Collect the Dragon Orbs for the Year of the Dragon Event (12/27 - 1/17)[/b]Say your goodbyes to year 2023! Welcome the year of the Dragon by collecting Dragon Orbs and earn plenty of rewards!

[b][*]Zombie Scenario Playthrough Event (12/27 - 2/27)[/b]Play through Zombie Scenario Seasons 1 - 8 and earn rewards!

[b][*]New Year's Hot Streak Event (12/30 8 PM – 1/2 11 PM)[/b]Hot Streak event will be available from 8 PM to 11 PM every day during the event period.

[b][*]New Year's Welcome Play Event (12/30 12 AM – 1/1 11 PM)[/b]Reach 24 minutes of playtime during the event to obtain 2024 Mileage and 1 Lucky Raffle Ticket!

[b][*]New Year's Raffle Event (12/30 12:00 AM - 1/1 11:59 PM)[/b]Players who earned the Lucky Raffle Ticket during the event can enter the New Year's Raffle.

[b][*]The New and Returning Players Welcome Event has Returned! (12/27 - 03/13)[/b]New and Returning Players Welcome Event returns at the end of 2023! Welcome new and returning players!

[b][*]Find the Zombie Event (1/10 12:00-1/23 11:59)[/b]You can participate via the Find the Zombie event button at the bottom of the Lobby screen.

[b][*]Find the Zombie Bullet Giveaway (1/10 12:00 - 1/23 11:59)[/b]Locked and loaded! Before you take down those zombies, you're going to need some ammo!

[b][*]Bullet Pileup Reward Giveaway (1/10 12 AM - 1/23 11:59 PM)[/b]Keeping collecting bullets, and the rewards will be delivered with a BANG!

[b][*]Daily Bullet Collection Event (1/10 12 AM - 1/23 11:59 PM)[/b]Keep collecting bullets to get your own reward![/list]

[h1]---------- Details ----------[/h1]

[h2]Update Information[/h2]

[h3]Zombie Z Update Information[/h3]

[list][*]New Mutations Added
[list][*]Rage Bomb: Increased Zombie Bomb damage based on missing HP.
[*]Danger Sprint: Increased Movement Speed based on missing HP.[/list][/list]

[list][*]Zombie Enhancement per round
[list][*]The effectiveness of Zombie Skills will be enhanced each round.[/list][/list]

[list][*]Zombie Z Mode Gun Level Adjustments
[list][*]Drakar I: 10 → 13
[*]Ancient Berserker: 15 → 17
[*]AK47 Paladin: 17 → 16
[*]AK47 Royal Knight: 17 → 16
[*]Starlight Sword: 17 → 19
[*]FG Launcher: 17 → 19
[*]Laser Storm: 18 → 19
[*]M4A1 Dark Knight: 19 → 17
[*]M4A1 Shadow Knight: 19 → 17
[*]Drakar II: 21 → 28
[*]Gran Bird Cannon: 29 → 30
[*]Drakar III: 32 → 38
[*]Barrett M95 White Tiger: 32 → 30
[*]Death Eater: 35 → 36
[*]Gungnir: 36 → 35
[*]Dark Star: 36 → 35
[*]Failnaught: 37 → 36
[*]`Spell Lance Scarlet Rose: 38 → 36[/list][/list]


[h3]In-game Improvements[/h3]

[list][*]The Karma perk change that was applied in the laboratory is now effective in the official mode
[list][*]1. Karma System
- Separate Karma Gauges, Zombie Karma Perk Change, Human Karma Sub Perk Change
[*]2. Zombie Skill Revamp
[*]3. Human Hero/Sidekick Change[/list][/list]

[list][*]Nameplate Font Shadow Effect added
[list][*]A shadow effect has ow been added to medal names, player nicknames, and family names[/list][/list]

[list][*]Vampiric Part Grade 1 to 6 Balance Adjustment
[list][*]Previous: 1x HP Recovery amount cannot exceed x% of max HP
[*]After: 1x the accumulated HP Recovery amount cannot exceed x% of max HP
[*]The calculation used for Vampiric Part's HP recover limit that once determined individual damage now calculates total damage accumulated instead.[/list][/list]

[list][*]System Revamp
[list][*]Order of the pop-ups upon log-in has been improved (in the following order: Studio Guide, Season Pass, Announcement, Login Supplies, and finally, Mission Chain)
[*]Weapon rank is now displayed in Scenario Buy Menu
[*]Auto-scroll for the quest description window has been added
[*]An icon will now display when client network is unstable.
[*]Weapon restriction options have been improved (weapon category restrictions option added)[/list][/list]


[h2]Event Information[/h2]

[h3]Adieu, 2023! Collect the Dragon Orbs for the Year of the Dragon Event (12/27 - 1/17)[/h3]
Say your goodbyes to year 2023! Welcome the year of the Dragon by collecting Dragon Orbs and earn plenty of rewards!

[list][*]How to Participate
[list][*]Daily Log-in: 6 Dragon Orbs (once per day)
[*]Clear 2 Daily Missions: 10 Dragon Orbs (once per day)
[*]Every 10 minutes of playtime: 1 Dragon Orb (up to 4 per day)
[*]Every 6 Kill Points by kills, assists as a human, or infections as a zombie in Zombie Mode: 2 Dragon Orbs (up to 30 per day)
[*]Score 100 Kill Points in Zombie Scenario mode on hard or higher, then clear it: 5 Dragon Orbs (up to 30 daily per account)
[*]Each time you reach 10 minutes of playtime: : 1 Dragon Orb (up to 4 daily per account)
[*]Daily Mission - Max Dragon Orbs Acquired Per Day: 50[/list][/list]

[list][*]How to Earn Kill Points
[list][*]Zombie Kill as a Human: 3 Points (bots excluded)
[*]Zombie Assist as a Human: 1 Point (bots excluded)
[*]Human Infection as a Zombie: 4 Points (bots excluded)
[*]Human Infection Assist as Zombie: 0 Points[/list][/list]

[list][*]Daily Rewards
[list][*]Collect 40 Dragon Orbs: 1 Exploration Support Box (once per day)[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/1691b91e42df3a0fcce4885491a3374f2b31466e.png[/img][/list][/list]
[list][*]Exploration Support Box Contents
[list][*]Exploration Slot Expansion Coupon (1 Day)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/7a7e81b4791c681291a82875a1758cf906e4681a.png[/img]
[*]Exploration Success Rate-Up +10% x2
[*]Exploration Success Rate-Up +20%
[*]Exploration Level Enhancement EXP Coupon x5[/list][/list]

[list][*]Cumulative Rewards
[list][*]x50: Rare Decoder x5 + Zombie Scenario Add-On Rate Box x5
[*]x100: Unique Decoder x3 + 50 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x3
[*]150: Event Decoder x5
[*]x250: Shiho's Pink Wave Nameplate (300 Days) + 100 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x5
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/70b4c219b935550346dcef562aa958cf74375bc7.png[/img]
[*]x350: Unique Decoder x3 + Transcendence Weapon Pass (5 Days)
[*]x450: 10,000 Mileage Coupon
[*]x500: Class Decoder x7
[*]x550: Transcendence Decoder x10
[*]x600: Random -1 Dehancement Material x5
[*]x650: Grade 5 Parts Reward Box x5[/list][/list]

[list][*]Notice
[list][*]You can earn up to 50 Dragon Orbs a day.
[*]Pileup rewards can be collected only once per account.
[*]All unused Exploration Support Boxes will be removed during maintenance on 1/17/2024.
[*]You can earn playtime on all modes, including Studio Mode.
[*]Other than playtime, missions do not count towards participation in Studio Mode.
[*]You can only participate in rooms with 3 or more players.
[*]Autohunt kills are excluded regardless of mode.
[*]Compatible Zombie Modes: Zombie Classic / Zombie Mutant / Zombie Hero / Zombie Z / Zombie Evolution
[*]Excluded Zombie Scenario Maps: Double Gate / Lost City / Survival: Trap / Survival: Groundwater / Pursuit: Chaos
[*]You must play for at least 5 minutes to get credit for Zombie Scenario mode missions.
[*]The Event Decoders can be used until midnight on the day it is obtained.[/list][/list]

[h3]Find the Zombie Event (1/10 12:00-1/23 11:59)[/h3]
You can participate via the Find the Zombie event button at the bottom of the Lobby screen.

[list][*]How to Participate
[list][*]Click the Find the Zombie event button at the bottom of the lobby screen.
[*]Among a group of 16 characters (12 zombies, 4 humans), find and hit the zombies using the right bullets.
[*]Get these bullets from the Find the Zombie Bullet Giveaway.
[*]Hitting a zombie will increase your reward by 1 and allow you to take an additional shot. Hitting a human will decrease your reward by 1 and reset the Find the Zombie in progress.
[*]The reward grade can be increased up to a High Class Gold Box if you hit enough zombies in a row, and you can claim the current reward by clicking "Surrender."
[*]Click "Automatic Fire" to quickly proceed through one game.[/list][/list]

[list][*]What is "Automatic Fire"?
[list][*]Proceed by randomly firing in a game.
[*]You must have more than 1 bullet to continue.
[*]If you are in the Claim Reward state, you must claim your reward to use this feature.
[*]※ Temporary items obtained from the Silver Box last for a fixed amount of time. Bound weapons obtained from the Gold Box cannot be used for Auction/Disassembly/Family Storage.[/list][/list]

[list][*]Blue B-Box
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/b47ed8a3c6aba753a00a59cc91dc86ea7914d4da.png[/img]
[list][*]Contents (Select 1): BALROG-I BLUE, BALROG-Ⅲ BLUE, BALROG-V BLUE, BALROG-VII BLUE, BALROG-IX BLUE, BALROG-XI BLUE[/list][/list]

[list][*]2019 Transcendence Class Selection Box
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/6d83c56ba59fc99d19d22ea5938d675e4922bce2.png[/img]
[list][*]Select one of these permanent items: Axion, Aetheris, Medea, Kalael, Pink Heart Shiho, Black Rose Miho, Queen, or Cyborg.
[*]You won't receive exclusive costumes from selecting a class in this Selection Box.[/list][/list]

[list][*]Special Transcendence Weapon Box
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/252b98e669c4f2f1ab8c2789fd7adcc7b30bae7a.png[/img]
[list][*]Select one of these permanent items: SKULL-T9, Magnum Shooter, SG552 Cerberus, Laser Ripper, Twin Hawk, or Demolition Hammer[/list][/list]

[list][*]Notice
[list][*]Reward grade will be reset upon claiming the current reward by clicking "Surrender."
[*]The grade can be increased up to a High Class Gold Box, and players can earn better rewards by consecutively hitting zombies.
[*]Temporary items obtained from the Silver Box last for a fixed duration. Bound weapons obtained from the Gold Box cannot be used for Auction/Disassembly/Family Storage
[*]If you own both event and purchased bullets, event bullets will be consumed first.
[*]Click on "Claim Reward" to receive reward items.
[*]Chance to Find a Zombie: Remaining Zombies / Remaining Slots (Example: If there are 10 zombies left and 14 slots left → 10/14, there is about 71% chance to find a zombie.)
[*]All unused Old-Time Weapon Paint Selection Boxes will be removed during maintenance on 7/12.
[*]All unused Blue B Boxes will be removed during maintenance on 7/12.
[*]All unused Mystery Boxes will be removed during maintenance on 1/23.[/list][/list]


[h3]Find the Zombie Bullet Giveaway (1/10 12:00 - 1/23 11:59)[/h3]
Locked and loaded! Before you take down those zombies, you're going to need some ammo!

[list][*]Conditions and Items
[list][*]Earn 20 bullets each for playtime at 15min / 30min / 45min
[*]Earn 30 bullets each for playtime at 60min / 75min / 90min
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/c08d50698385151aa6766202ac462dcb6cae90c7.png[/img]
[/list][/list]

[list][*]Notice
[list][*]Each account can obtain up to 150 bullets per day.
[*]Participation will only count in rooms with three or more players (includes Studio and Laboratory Modes).
[*]All unused Find the Zombie bullets will be removed on 1/23 11:59 PM[/list][/list]


[h3]Bullet Pileup Reward Giveaway (1/10 12 AM - 1/23 11:59 PM)[/h3]
 Keeping collecting bullets, and the rewards will be delivered with a BANG!

[list][*]Total Bullets / Rewards
[list][*]x1,050: Transcendence Decoder x2
[*]x1,200: Transcendence Decoder x4
[*]x1,350: Transcendence Decoder x7 + Find the Zombie Event Nameplate (300 Days)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/46d4f4c942e7cf371d6e3fe37c41c74c87ba49fa.png[/img]
[/list][/list]


[h3]Daily Bullet Collection Event (1/10 12 AM - 1/23 11:59 PM)[/h3]
Keep collecting bullets to get your own reward!

[list][*]Daily Total Bullets / Rewards
[list][*]x45: Event Decoder x1[/list][/list]

[list][*]Notice
[list][*]Obtain up to one a day per account.
[*]Participation will only count in rooms with three or more players (includes Studio and Laboratory Modes).[/list][/list]


[h3]Zombie Scenario Playthrough Event (12/27 - 2/27)[/h3]
Play through Zombie Scenario Seasons 1 - 8 and earn rewards!

[list][*]How to Participate
[list][*]Score 100 kills in Zombie Scenario mode on normal or higher and clear all maps from Season 1 through 8 to earn the Veteran Nameplate (Permanent)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/f7760e427f2f8db1e304bdc75c091a7593f6f226.png[/img]
[/list][/list]

[list][*]Notice
[list][*]Eligible Mode: Zombie Scenario Season 1 - Season 8.
[*]You can clear each season and map in any order to participate in the event.
[*]You can only participate in the event in rooms with 3 or more players.
[*]Participation rewards can be obtained only once per account.[/list][/list]


[h3]New Year's Hot Streak Event (12/30 8 PM – 1/2 11 PM)[/h3]
Hot Streak event will be available from 8 PM to 11 PM every day during the event period.

[list][*]Hot Streak Event
[list][*]You have a chance to obtain an additional 100% EXP + 1 Hot Streak Event Weapon[/list][/list]

[list][*]Hot Streak Event Weapons
[list][*]Lightning Fury, Trinity Grenade, Dual Beretta Gunslinger, Devastator, Holy Sword Divine Order, NEGEv NG-7 Ajax, Satellite Mine, Dark Star, and Blazing Nova
[*]Hot Streak Event weapons are removed at 11:00 PM the day they are obtained.[/list][/list]


[h3]New Year's Welcome Play Event (12/30 12 AM – 1/1 11 PM)[/h3]
Reach 24 minutes of playtime during the event to obtain 2024 Mileage and 1 Lucky Raffle Ticket!

[list][*]Notice
[list][*]Event participation only counts in rooms with three or more players (All modes, including Studio Mode).
[*]You can obtain the Mileage reward once daily per account.
[*]Lucky Raffle Ticket will be removed at 11:59 PM on the day they are obtained.[/list][/list]


[h3]New Year's Raffle Event (12/30 12:00 AM - 1/1 11:59 PM)[/h3]
Players who earned the Lucky Raffle Ticket during the event can enter the New Year's Raffle.

[list][*]Raffle Rewards
[list][*]Daily 9:30 PM : Ismael + Failnaught (Permanent)
[*]Daily 10:00 PM : Ethan + Failnaught (Permanent)[/list][/list]

[list][*]Notice
[list][*]Player must own the Lucky Raffle Ticket and be logged in during the time of raffle to enter.
[*]Ismael + Failnaught x1 and Ethan + Failnaught x1 will be raffled every day during the event.
[*]You cannot win multiple times.
[*]Lucky Raffle Ticket will be removed at 11:59 PM on the day they are obtained.[/list][/list]


[h3]The New and Returning Players Welcome Event has Returned! (12/27 - 03/13)[/h3]
 New and Returning Players Welcome Event returns at the end of 2023! Welcome new and returning players!

[list][*]Mission Completion Challenge
[list][*]Clear 3 Daily Missions every day: 500 Mileage (once per day)[/list][/list]

[list][*]Mission Completion Challenge Total Completion Reward
[list][*]1 Day: Sonya Lycanthrope Pass (7 Days) + Exploration Success Rate-Up 10% x5 + 50 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x2
[*]2 Days: Magnum Shooter (3 Days) + 50 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x3
[*]3 Days: [Bound] MG3 (30 Days) + SKULL-T9 (5 Days) + Demolition Hammer (5 Days) + Twin Hawk (5 Days) + Zombie Scenario Add-On Rate Box x5 + Grade 4 Parts Reward Box x3
[*]4 Days: SG552 Cerberus (5 Days) + Laser Ripper (5 Days) + Random -1 Dehancement Material x7
[*]5 Days: Twin Hawk (10 Days) + SKULL-T9 (10 Days) + Demolition Hammer (10 Days) + Grade 5 Parts Reward Box x5 + 100 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x2
[*]6 Days: Twin Hawk (15 Days) + SKULL-T9 (15 Days) + Demolition Hammer (15 Days) + Transcendence Weapon Pass (1 Day) + Class Decoder + 100 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x5
[*]7 Days: Player Welcome Box + Twin Hawk (20 Days) + SKULL-T9 (20 Days) + Demolition Hammer (20 Days) + Class Pass (7 Days)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/f8c993e97ee81eccebb791d4e93e0a823ef9cc7e.png[/img]
[/list][/list]

[list][*]Player Welcome Box Contents (Select and choose one from the contents)
[list][*]Magnum Shooter
[*]SG552 Cerberus
[*]Laser Ripper[/list][/list]

[list][*]Notice
[list][*]Cumulative rewards are given only once per account.
[*]Only new or returning players (with 30 days or more of inactivity) can participate in this event.
[*]All unused Player Welcome Boxes will be removed during maintenance on 3/13/2024.[/list][/list]


[h3]Login Supplies Event Guide (12/27 - 01/30 11:59)[/h3]

[list][*]Login Rewards
[list][*]Daily Weapons Supply
[*]Dual Sword Phantom Slayer (1 Day) & M3 Black Dragon (1 Day) & Barrett M95 White Tiger (1 Day) & M249 Phoenix (1 Day)
[*]2 types out of Rare, Unique, or Transcendence provided according to probabilities + 1 Transcendence Class (1 Day) provided according to probabilities + all contents of Daily Attendance Reward Box provided.
[*]Transcendence Classes (1 Day): Dorothy Dark Knight, Flora Paladin, Transcendence Ji Yoon Choi, Transcendence Yuri, Sonya Lycanthrope, Elizabeth Crimson Hunter, Transcendence Michaela, Transcendence Fernando, Transcendence Blair, and Rose Phoenix
[*]Daily Attendance Reward Box: Damage Display (1 Day), Killer Display (1 Day), Penalty and Loss Invalidation x1, Rare Decoder x3
[*]All weapons and classes from the Daily Supply are bound and cannot be used for Auction/Disassembly/Family Storage (Extension X).[/list][/list]

[list][*]Cumulative Rewards
[list][*]5 Days: Psychic Harmonium (20 Days) + Cumulative Attendance Reward Box
[*]10 Days: Negev NG7 Ajax (20 Days) + Cumulative Attendance Reward Box
[*]15 Days: Trinity Grenade (20 Days) + Cumulative Attendance Reward Box
[*]20 Days: Dread Nova (15 Days) + Cumulative Attendance Reward Box
[*]25 Days: Divine Blaster (15 Days) + Cumulative Attendance Reward Box
[*]Cumulative Attendance Reward Box contents: C4 Countdown Room Host (5 Days), Shorten Respawn Time (5 Days) Lucky Gunslinger (5 Days), Daily Mission Difficulty Change x15, Exploration Slot Expansion Coupon (7 Days)[/list][/list]

[list][*]Notice
[list][*]Attendance rewards will be provided directly as rewards instead of the Daily/Cumulative Attendance Reward Box items.
[*]Rewards can be claimed immediately after logging in and are available until midnight every day.[/list][/list]


[h2]Other Information[/h2]
[list][*]Tattoos have been added to the Enhancement Materials in the Exploration system.
[*]Fixed an issue where hitting a female bot would trigger sounds meant for a male bot. 
[*]Removed the brand names from some Upgrade Blocks in Studio Mode.
[*]Fixed an issue in the Studio Creation tab where the number of maps would not display correctly if more than 100 were created.
[*]The Studio Lua Scripts have been updated so "StopPlayerControl" will now immediately cancel any command currently being inputted.
[*]Fixed an issue where the Healing Device Block would malfunction in Studio Team Deathmatch mode. 
[*]Fixed an issue where the player could get stuck on a Studio Fitness - Neon Block.
[*]Fixed an issue where AIs holding certain weapons would not attack after AI Class Appearance and Weapon changes. 
[*]Fixed an issue in some Zombie Modes where setting the maximum player count to two and playing against the AI would automatically end the session. 
[*]Fixed an issue where Regular/Special Enhancement Material descriptions would be displayed incorrectly. 
[*]Fixed an issue where the recoil of the AK-47 60R Classic wouldn't reset during use. 
[*]Fixed an issue where applying Miracle Prism Sword Moonlit Night Weapon Paint would display the inventory image differently than before. 
[*]Fixed an issue where the animation of the Heavy Zombie Trap activating would not display in Zombie Scenario mode. 
[*]Fixed the issue where the additional rounds of the NEGEV NG7 Ajax were not unlimited in Zombie Scenario mode. 
[*]Fixed an issue where you could purchase Cannon ammo in Zombie Scenario Defense: Center.[/list]

notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: December 13th
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/84103b87502888b7c032808a02adb1d68bcb4d70.jpg[/img]

Here's a rundown of some of the major updates in today's patch!

[list][b][*]Collecting Cookies Event (12/13 - 12/27)[/b]Collect Cookies during missions to earn tons of rewards! Stock up now for a warm and cozy winter!

[b][*]AK-47 60R Classic Giveaway (12/13 - 1/17)[/b]Earn rewards by playing for 10 minutes during the event.

[b][*]New and Returning Players Welcome Event (12/13 - 12/27)[/b]Welcome, new and returning players!

[b][*]Christmas Celebration Mileage Auction Event (12/13 - 12/26 11:59 PM)[/b]You can access the auction from the Mileage Auction button at the bottom of the lobby during the event.

[b][*]Metal Arena Old-Time Class and Spell Lance Scarlet Rose Special Auction Event! (12/13 - 12/26 11:59 PM)[/b]Sometimes great deals on listings will appear! You could become the lucky winner of an item at a amazingly low Mileage cost!

[b][*]New Transcendence Class Promotion (12/13 - 1/17)[/b]Idol Shiho and Idol Miho will make a special appearance in Class Decoders and Premium Class Decoders during the event.

[b][*]Transcendence Weapon Hauteclere Promotion (12/13 - 1/17)[/b]The Hauteclere can drop from Transcendence Premium Decoders and Transcendence Decoders during the event.[/list]

[h1]---------- Details ----------[/h1]

[h2]Update Information[/h2]

[h3]New Enhancement Weapon Guide[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/78129b0b88e4c9557a4d52a03260544c256c8592.png[/img]
[list][*]AK-47 60R Classic
[list][*]Type: Rifle
Description: An assault rifle that uses 60 rounds of 7.62mm ammo. Comes equipped with a scope that enables high accuracy and excellent damage. It was modified to respond to zombies in various situations.[/list][/list]

notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: November 29th
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/79a8dbc2bd2dc6ad5f904a6f7e812a135f6f6bae.jpg[/img]

Here's a rundown of some of the major updates in today's patch!

[list][b][*]Collect Metal Points Event (11/29 - 12/13)[/b]The Metal Arena has returned! Earn Metal Points and collect great rewards every day![/list]

[h1]---------- Details ----------[/h1]

[h2]Update Information[/h2]

[h3]Metal Arena Opening Announcement[/h3]

[list][*]Return of the Arena Medal 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/fdcde35815229d0b7309c351259d30e3b50c9063.png[/img]
[list][*]Condition: Play Metal Arena for 30 minutes to receive the medal[/list][/list]

[list][*]Notice
[list][*]Metal Arena is an event mode that can only be played for a limited time.
[*]The end of the Metal Arena mode will be announced in a separate update.
[*]Apart from the new Return of the Arena medal, existing Metal Arena medals cannot be collected during the event.[/list][/list]


[h3]Mode Improvements[/h3]

[list][*]Display Damage Fonts
[list][*]The advanced settings for Original / Team Deathmatch / Original (AI) / Team Deathmatch (AI) rooms now have an option to Display Damage Fonts.
Original mode can now display damage fonts.[/list][/list]
 
[list][*]Expanded Set Weapon Storage Slots
[list][*]Weapon slots have been increased from 9 to 12 and a issue was fixed where the shortcut key would not function properly after the 7th page.[/list][/list]
 
[list][*]Human Teams can now be changed in Original (AI) and Team Deathmatch (AI) modes.
[list][*]The Maintain AI Player Team option allows humans to play on different teams.[/list][/list]
 
[list][*]Gun Deathmatch Weapon Fixes
[list][*]Lv. 16 Newcomen removed
[*]Lv. 20 Rock Breaker added[/list][/list]
 
[list][*]Studio Improvements
[list][*]The maximum number of maps has been increased to 120.
[*]Added the ability to send Background Music Blocks / BGM (Scen_S8E2_main, Scen_S8E3_boss., Scen_S8E4_boss).
[*]Added a Ghost option to Player Settings and the ability to check Area Triggers while in Ghost mode.
[*]New speed setting added (X5).
[*]New Weapon Spawner weapons have been added. (M2, MP40, M1 Garand, M1918 BAR, and M1911 A1.)
[*]A skip blocking feature has been added. When enabled this ensures that cutscenes cannot be accidentally skipped.[/list][/list]
 
[list][*]Added Class-Only Voice Blocking
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/83266258269a2499bcb34024b8d05db9f9782a60.jpg[/img]
[list][*]A Mute tab has been added to the far right of the chat window.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/5e16aeacb77d71c11c7148a3278f0c305d553475.jpg[/img]
[*]Pressing the Mute tab will display the Class-Only Voice Blocking window.
[*]Checking the box to the left of the player list will mute that player's voice.
[list][*]* AI is not displayed on the list.
[*]* Pressing Block All Radio Voices will block all players on the list (excluding yourself).
[*]* Any blocked players will have their voice muted by default.
[*]* This setting only applies to a single session and is reset when you start a new game.[/list][/list][/list]

[list][*]Option to Shorten Enhancement Cutscenes
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/776d2296d090dc201786383ceef04c614119c211.jpg[/img]
[list][*]A feature that shortens cutscenes which play after weapon enhancement has now been added.
[*]Click on Shorten Enhancement Cutscene at the top of the Enhance button to turn this feature on. (Any changed settings will be saved until next login.)[/list][/list]
 
[list][*]Saved Night Vision Goggles Settings
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/815b008a776ebaccc5df0b0240652e973e236473.jpg[/img]
[list][*]The settings for Night Vision Goggles will be the same until the session ends. It will only be reset after logging in again or continuing on to the next session. (Zombie Evolution excluded.)

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/87560bae09806d8a1fa86889e3d15c64fb3acd04.jpg[/img]

Here's a rundown of some of the major updates in today's patch!

[list][b][*]11 Minutes! 11 Points! 111 Kills! Event (11/15 - 11/29)[/b]Earn 11 points during the mission and play 11 minutes at a time to get great rewards! Enjoy a reward-packed November!

[b][*] Random Weapon Zombie Hero Event (11/15 - 11/29)[/b]During this event, you can play the Random Weapon Zombie Hero mode! We've got newly-added popular weapons, epic weapons, and even epic edition weapons! Test your luck!

[b][*] Black Friday Lucky Transcendence Weapon Box Promotion (11/15 - 11/29)[/b]To celebrate Black Friday, we are selling a Lucky Transcendence Weapon Box with 20 Transcendence Weapons!

[b][*] Transcendence Weapon Photon Launcher Promotion (11/15 - 12/13)[/b]The Photon Launcher can drop from Transcendence Premium Decoders and Transcendence Decoders during the event.

[b][*] Transcendence Class Guaranteed Giveaway (11/15 - 12/13)[/b]Get guaranteed 2 new Transcendence Classes (Skadi and Nyx) based on how many Class Decoders and Premium Class Decoders are used during the event![/list]

[h1]---------- Details ----------[/h1]

[h2]Event Information[/h2]

[h3]11 Minutes! 11 Points! 111 Kills! Event (11/15 - 11/29)[/h3]
Earn 11 points during the mission and play 11 minutes at a time to get great rewards! Enjoy a reward-packed November!

[list][*]How to Participate
[list][*]Daily Log-in: 2 points (once per day)
[*]Every 11 minutes of playtime: 1 point (up to 3 points per day)
[*]Every 8 Kill Points by kills or assists as a human, or infections as a zombie in Zombie Mode: 1 point (up to 11 points per day).
[*]Clear 1 session after scoring 111 Kill Points in Zombie Scenario mode on Hard or higher: 2 points (up to 11 points per day)
[*]Maximum Daily Points: 15[/list][/list]

[list][*]How to Earn Kill Points
[list][*]Zombie Kill as a Human: 3 Points (excluding bots)
[*]Zombie Assist as a Human: 1 Point (excluding bots)
[*]Human Infection as a Zombie: 4 Points (excluding bots)
[*]Human Infection Assist as a Zombie: 0 Points[/list][/list]

[list][*]Cumulative Rewards
[list][*]15 Points: Rare Decoder x5 + Miracle Prism Sword (11 Days / Speed Up Part - Grade 5 and Vampiric Part - Grade 5)
[*]30 Points: Unique Decoder x5 + Zombie Scenario Add-On Rate Box x5
[*]45 Points: Event Decoder x3 + Dual Sword Infernal Hunter (11 Days)
[*]60 Points: 100 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x5 + Experience Exchange Coupon Lv. 2 x5
[*]75 Points: Event Decoder x5 + Dual Sword Phantom Slayer (11 Days)
[*]105 Points: Transcendence Weapon Pass (3 Days) + Spell Lance Scarlet Rose (11 Days)
[*]120 Points: 10,000 Mileage Coupon
[*]135 Points: Class Decoder x4 + Holy Sword Divine Order (11 Days)
[*]150 Points: Class Decoder x6 + Moonlit Night Weapon Paint
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/49cfcccbbac8f10136a6d5be01840b15b73e7a22.png[/img]
[*]165 Points: Transcendence Decoder x7 + Miracle Prism Sword (Permanent)
[*]180 Points: Random -1 Dehancement Material x5
[*]195 Points: Grade 5 Parts Reward Box x5[/list][/list]

[list][*]Notice
[list][*]Moonlit Night Weapon Paint: Miracle Prism Sword Weapon Paint
[*]Earn up to 15 points a day!
[*]You can accumulate playtime on all modes. (Includes Studio Mode)
[*]Points can be collected only in rooms with 3 or more players.
[*]Compatible Zombie Modes: Zombie Classic / Zombie Mutant / Zombie Hero / Zombie Z / Zombie Evolution
[*]Excluded Zombie Scenario Maps: Double Gate / Lost City / Survival: Trap / Survival: Groundwater / Pursuit: Chaos
[*]You must play for at least 5 minutes to get credit for Zombie Scenario mode missions.
[*]The Event Decoders can be used until midnight on the day it is obtained.[/list][/list]


[h3]Random Weapon Zombie Hero Event (11/15 - 11/29)[/h3]
During this event, you can play the Random Weapon Zombie Hero mode! We've got newly-added popular weapons, epic weapons, and even epic edition weapons! Test your luck!

[list][*]Weapon Update
[list][*]Drakar I, Drakar II, Drakar III, Ignite-10, Twin Light Axes, M249 Ra, Dual Katana Anubis, Sapientia Anubis, and Thunderbolt Anubis[/list][/list]

[list][*]Featured Maps
[list][*]Italy, Assault, Dust, Abyss 2, and Estate[/list][/list]

[list][*]Notice
[list][*]When you're on the Zombie Team, your class will be selected randomly.
[*]When you're on the Human Team, your primary weapon, secondary weapon, melee weapon, and grenade will be selected randomly.
[*]Base game rules are the same as Zombie Hero.
[*]Available weapons are determined regardless of individual ownership.
[*]Armor distribution is fixed.
[*]When using the Supply Box (E key), the shop window will not work and instead another random weapon will be chosen.
[*]Human heroes cannot be selected in this event mode.[/list][/list]


[h2]Shop Update[/h2]

[h3]Black Friday Lucky Transcendence Weapon Box Promotion (11/15 - 11/29)[/h3]
To celebrate Black Friday, we are selling a Lucky Transcendence Weapon Box with 20 Transcendence Weapons!

[list][*]Drop Rate

[list][*]Photon Launcher

[list][*]Manufactured with a mysterious technology, this 30-round 12-gauge pump-action shotgun creates a photon zone wherever the special ammo strikes. Automatically delivers normal attacks to any enemies inside the photon zone.[/list][/list]

[h3]New Transcendence Weapon Photon Launcher Guaranteed Giveaway (11/15 - 12/13)[/h3]
Depending on the number of Transcendence Premium Decoders and Transcendence Decoders used during the event, you could receive a Photon Launcher (Permanent)!

[list][*]Conditions and Items
[list][*]You will receive a Photon Launcher (permanent) every time you reach 300 points.[/list][/list]

[list][*]Notice
[list][*]6 Guaranteed Points are earned each time you use 1 Transcendence Premium Decoder.
[*]1 Guaranteed Point each time you use 1 Transcendence Decoder.[/list][/list]


[h3]Skadi & Nyx Transcendence Class Promotion (11/15 - 12/13)[/h3]
Skadi and Nyx will make a special appearance in Class Decoders and Premium Class Decoders during the event.

[list][*]Skadi
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/b026ca23f8e757107f9af6de3e5fde7bfa8da231.png[/img]
[list][*]Background: A princess from another world transported to this world while looking for the frost flower. She was recruited alongside Nyx when they were found by the institute, freezing the first zombie she encountered. She is full of royal pride and is adapting to this world by speaking formally and trying to learn new customs. She is cooperating with the Aegis Institute to return to her original world. Wherever she treads freeze, regardless of the climate.
[*]Zombie Scenario Skill: Ice Queen's Grace
[*]Passive: If engaging in Zombie Scenario with Nyx, critical rate increases (Connection effect applied, cannot be stacked). / <Quick Rejoining> Add-On effect is applied by default.
[*]Active: (Zombie Scenario) Provides special barrier effects to self and nearby allies. / Increases movement speed for the duration of the barrier effects for self and nearby allies.

[*]+10% EXP/Points

[*]This character adds 1 initial mutation in Zombie Z Mode.
[*]This character displays your current damage at the bottom of the screen.
[*]Marks enemies at or below 20% HP.
[*]This character leaves a unique mark at the target location upon killing an enemy.[/list][/list]

[list][*]Nyx
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/5e850dc2b20868dc61e2a2d525776a0501d04c70.png[/img]
[list][*]Background: A dark elf shaman that serves Skadi who was transported to this world while seeking the frost flower. She was recruited because Skadi rushes into action, claiming that to do so is the obligation of royalty. She is satisfied with this world and its lack of class divides, and she dreams of sending Skadi back to their original world while remaining herself to enjoy the thrills of battle. She provided research support to the Kronos Institute to acquire emergency funds as well.
[*]Zombie Scenario Skill: The Black Ark
[*]Passive: If engaging in Zombie Scenario with Skadi, critical rate increases (Connection effect applied, cannot be stacked). / <Thorns> Add-On effect is applied by default.
[*]Active: (Zombie Scenario) Provides special barrier effects to self and nearby allies / Increases attack power for the duration of the barrier effects for self and nearby allies.
[*]Transcendence Class exclusive voices are applied.
[*]+10% EXP/Points
[*]In Zombie Scenario mode, this character has a higher max level than normal classes. This character adds 1 initial mutation in Zombie Z Mode.
[*]This character displays your current damage at the bottom of the screen.
[*]Marks enemies at or below 20% HP.
[*]This character leaves a unique mark at the target location upon killing an enemy.[/list][/list]


[h3]Transcendence Class Guaranteed Giveaway (11/15 - 12/13)[/h3]
Get guaranteed 2 new Transcendence Classes (Skadi and Nyx) based on how many Class Decoders and Premium Class Decoders are used during the event!

notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: November 1st
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/6fbf8bde69a823ec169045b26fb1f3de962f698e.jpg[/img]

Here's a rundown of some of the major updates in today's patch!

[list][b][*]Autumn Wooden Doll Event (11/1 - 11/15)[/b]
It's a reward inside a reward! Get your Wooden Doll now!

[b][*] Family Bonus Event[/b]
Gather up the family! Receive rewards based on the number of family members that are logged in and playtime accumulated.[/list]

[h1]---------- Details ----------[/h1]

[h2]Update Information[/h2]

[h3]New Zombie Scenario Season 8 Extra Map[/h3]
[list][*]Defense: Cordon
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/780532b445fbc290fd2b5c65be009039caeed39e.png[/img]
[*]Background: Aegis Institute's secret communications center has been discovered by Kronos! Surprised by the attack, the center's defense squad must protect the area against all odds![/list]


[h3]Zombie Scenario Changes[/h3]

[list][*]Elite Monster Balance Improvements
[list][*]Elite monsters from appearing during event cutscenes to damage players.
[*]Reduced the black hole range of elite monsters in Hard difficulty and higher.
[*]Reduced the amount of enhancements applied to elite monsters in Very Hard difficulty and higher.
[*]Reduced the Regeneration ability of elite monsters in Very Hard difficulty and higher.
[*]Increased the teleport cooldown ability of elite monsters in Very Hard difficulty and higher.
[*]Reduced the amount of clones of elite monsters in Hell difficulty and higher.
[*]Reduced the invincibility cooldown duration for elite monsters in all difficulties.[/list][/list]
 
[list][*]Abyss Difficulty
[list][*]Added Abyss difficulty for Pursuit: Ep. Carlito.[/list][/list]


[h3]Studio Mode Update[/h3]

[list][*]New Studio Sample Hide and Seek Map!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/0b75ecf2b1403c4f746c15639a3341aadcaa1e71.png[/img]
[list][*]The new Hide and Seek map, "Fitness Club," which utilizes fitness theme blocks, has been released.[/list][/list]

[list][*]Studio Fitness Theme Decoration Block Update
[list][*]A variety of new decoration blocks, including 3 devices and 53 decorations, have been added.
[*]You can view the new blocks via Creation Mode without adding a separate theme pack.[/list][/list]


[h3]Laboratory Mode Update[/h3]
Eligible Modes: Zombie Hero (Laboratory) / Zombie Hero (Laboratory)

[list][*]Resurrection Features Removed
[list][*]All resurrection features, including conditional resurrections, have been removed.[/list][/list]

[list][*]Max HP Updated
[list][*]The Hero's max HP and armor has been updated to 1200 and 500, respectively.[/list][/list]

[list][*]Hero/Sidekick Weapon Selection Times Updated
[list][*]The selection time for Hero/Sidekick weapons has been increased to 45 seconds.[/list][/list]


[h3]Fire Bomb Skill Changes[/h3]

[list][*]Fire Bomb Skill Balance Changes
[list][*]Adjusted appearance: Round 4
[*]Now the Fire Bomb will be weak in the early game, but stronger in later parts of Zombie Z mode.[/list][/list]
 
[list][*]Turning Fire Bombs OFF in the settings will also remove any HP Recovery due to Morale Boosts on the human team.[/list]


[h3]Zombie Hero / Z Mode Balance Improvements[/h3]

[list][*]Zombie Hero / Z Mode Gun Level Adjustments
[list][*]FG Launcher: 15 → 17
[*]Petrol Boomer: 13 → 15
[*]Electron-V: 18 → 20
[*]Hunter-Killer X-45: 5 → 9
[*]Laser Ripper: 12 → 14
[*]Ancient Berserker: 13 → 15
[*]Divine Blaster: 40 → 39
[*]Doom Blaster: 40 → 39
[*]Psychic Sizer: 37 → 36
[*]Gigantic Drill: 32 → 31
[*]Infernal Cannon: 26 → 25
[*]Starlight Rolling Shooter: 23 → 22
[*]Elemental Tracker: 20 → 19
[*]Coil Gun Splash: 19 → 18[/list][/list]

[list][*]Zombie Hero / Z Mode Zombie Level Adjustments
[list][*]Deimos: 31 → 29[/list][/list]


[h2]Event Information[/h2]

[h3]Autumn Wooden Doll Event (11/1 - 11/15)[/h3]
It's a reward inside a reward! Get your Wooden Doll now!

[list][*]Daily Mission
[list][*]Play for 35 minutes plus complete 1 special mission to earn one Wooden Doll.[/list][/list]

[list][*]Special Mission Conditions (Select one)
[list][*]Score a total of 30 Kill Points by kills or assists as a human (bots excluded), or by infections as a zombie (bots excluded).
[*]Clear 2 Zombie Scenario modes on Hard or higher after scoring 100 Kill Points.
[*]Clear 1 session of Zombie Scenario mode's new map, Defense: Center, on Hard or higher after scoring 100 Kill Points.[/list][/list]

[list][*]Wooden Doll 1 Contents (You will have a chance to receive one of the following items)
[list][*]Wooden Doll 2
[*]Event Decoder[/list][/list]

[list][*]Wooden Doll 2 Contents (You will have a chance to receive one of the following items)
[list][*]Wooden Doll 3
[*]Event Decoder
[*]Exploration Level Enhancement EXP Coupon x50
[*]50 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x10
[*]100 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x10
[*]200 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x10[/list][/list]

[list][*]Wooden Doll 3 Contents (You will have a chance to receive one of the following items)
[list][*]Mystery Box x1
[*]Random -1 Dehancement Material x30
[*]Exploration Level Enhancement EXP Coupon x200
[*]50 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x30
[*]100 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x30
[*]200 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x30[/list][/list]

[list][*]Mystery Box Contents (Select 1)
[list][*]Magnum Shooter (Permanent)
[*]SG552 Cerberus (Permanent)
[*]SKULL-T9 (Permanent)
[*]Laser Ripper (Permanent)
[*]Twin Hawk (Permanent)[/list][/list]

[list][*]Wooden Doll 1 Pileup Rewards
[list][*]x3: Unique Decoder x3
[*]x5: Unique Premium Decoder
[*]x7: Wooden Doll Spray + 500 Mileage Coupon
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/aa9bb33563682addaf8af70829940fe6a70c23c3.png[/img]
[*]x9: 100 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon (x10)
[*]x10: Class Decoder x7
[*]x11: Transcendence Decoder x7[/list][/list]

[list][*]Notice
[list][*]Open Wooden Doll 1 to receive Wooden Doll 2 or an Event Decoder.
[*]   Open Wooden Doll 2 to receive Wooden Doll 3 or other rewards.
[*]   Open Wooden Doll 3 to receive a Mystery Box or other rewards!
[*]You can earn one Wooden Doll a day per account.
[*]Wooden Dolls 1, 2, and 3 will be removed during the 11/15 maintenance.
[*]Mystery Boxes will not be removed.
[*]Pileup reward is limited to once per account.
[*]Playtime accumulation counts in all modes (including Studio Mode).
[*]Credit will only be granted in rooms with three or more players (excludes Studio Mode).
[*]Excludes autohunt kills regardless of mode.
[*]Eligible Zombie Modes: Zombie Classic / Zombie Mutant / Zombie Hero / Zombie Z / Zombie Evolution
[*]Excluded Zombie Scenario Maps: Double Gate / Lost City / Survival: Trap / Survival: Groundwater / Pursuit: Chaos
[*]You must play for at least 5 minutes to get credit for Zombie Scenario mode missions.
[*]Event Decoders can be used until midnight on the day it is obtained.[/list][/list]


[h3]Family Bonus Event[/h3]
Gather up the family! Receive rewards based on the number of family members that are logged in and playtime accumulated.

[list][*]Simultaneous Log-In Bonus Conditions
[list][*]2 or more players logged in: Magnum Launcher
[*]4 or more players logged in: Psychic Harmonium
[*]7 or more players logged in: NEGEV NG-7 Ajax
[*]10 or more players logged in: Spell Lance Scarlet Rose[/list][/list]

[list][*]Family Game Play Reward Conditions
[list][*]Reach 60 Hours: Rare Decoder x5
[*]Reach 80 Hours: Grade 5 Parts Reward Box x5
[*]Reach 100 Hours: Event Decoder x5
[*]Reach 120 Hours: 100 Weapon Enhancement EXP x5
[*]Reach 140 Hours: Class Pass (1 Day)[/list][/list]

[list][*]Notice
[list][*]Any weapons provided cannot be owned or disassembled.
[*]Rewards are based on the combined playtime of all family members.
[*]Playtime only counts in rooms with 2 or more players.
[*]Playing with family members gives an additional 10% accumulated playtime.
[*]Must contribute at least 1 hour of playtime to be eligible for rewards.
[*]Weekly playtime records reset every Monday at 12 AM.
[*]Players who log in after Monday at 12 AM are not eligible to receive the previous week's Family Time rewards.
[*]Rewards can be claimed once upon logging in within one week and are unavailable after that time.
[*]The Event Decoders can be used until midnight on the day it is obtained.[/list][/list]


[h3]Login Supplies Event Guide (11/1- 11/28)[/h3]

[list][*]Login Reward
[list][*]Daily Weapons Supply
[*]Dual Sword Phantom Slayer (1 Day) & M3 Black Dragon (1 Day) & Barrett M95 White Tiger (1 Day) & M249 Phoenix (1 Day)
[*]2 types out of Rare, Unique, or Transcendence provided according to probabilities + 1 Transcendence Class (1 Day) provided according to probabilities + all contents of Daily Attendance Reward Box provided.
[*]Transcendence Classes (1 Day): Dorothy Dark Knight, Flora Paladin, Transcendence Ji Yoon Choi, Transcendence Yuri, Sonya Lycanthrope, Elizabeth Crimson Hunter, Transcendence Michaela, Transcendence Fernando, Transcendence Blair, and Rose Phoenix
[*]Daily Attendance Reward Box: Damage Display (1 Day), Killer Display (1 Day), Penalty and Loss Invalidation x1, Rare Decoder x3
[*]All weapons and classes from the Daily Supply are bound and cannot be used for Auction/Disassembly/Family Storage (Extension X).[/list][/list]

[list][*]Cumulative Rewards
[list][*]5 Days: X-TRACKER (20 Days) + Cumulative Attendance Reward Box
[*]10 Days: Negev NG7 Ajax (20 Days) + Cumulative Attendance Reward Box
[*]15 Days: Trinity Grenade (20 Days) + Cumulative Attendance Reward Box
[*]20 Days: Lightning Fury (20 Days) + Cumulative Attendance Reward Box
[*]25 Days: Heaven Splitter (5 Days) + Cumulative Attendance Reward Box
[*]Cumulative Attendance Reward Box contents: C4 Countdown Room Host (5 Days), Shorten Respawn Time (5 Days) Lucky Gunslinger (5 Days), Daily Mission Difficulty Change x15, Exploration Slot Expansion Coupon (7 Days)[/list][/list]

[list][*]Notice
[list][*]Attendance rewards will be provided directly as rewards instead of the Daily/Cumulative Attendance Reward Box items.
Rewards can be claimed immediately after logging in and are available until midnight every day.[/list][/list]


[h2]Other Changes[/h2]
[olist][*]Zombie respawn times in Zombie Mode are no longer affected by death animations and will now have a fixed value.
[*]The respawn time for zombies in Zombie Mode will now be displayed at all times.
[*]SKULL-5 has been removed from New Classic Zombie Rules.
[*]When clicked, information under obtainable locations in the Encyclopedia will now display relevant event pages.
[*]Fixed an issue where clicking the MAX button on the item disassembly notification pop-up would cause it to operate abnormally.
[*]Fixed an issue that would cause you to leave the map on some maps.
[*]Changed some texture texts in the Annex map.
[*]Fixed an issue where invincibility from team swaps in team deathmatch would not be removed until death.
[*]Fixed an issue where the emote for Butler Faust would display on the muzzle of the gun during gameplay.
[*]Fixed an issue where button icons for inventory items that can't be disassembled were stuck in the ON position.[/olist]

notes.title: [Event] Studio #FITNESS Theme Contest
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/4a3cb6aafab25bc98b4ebc524b8693e2bebac3c5.jpg[/img]

Show off your creative skills in this fitness-themed Studio contest! 
Participate now to receive the 1st place prize!

[b][h2]Event : Celebratory Studio Contest[/h2][/b]
[u][h3]Event Schedule[/h3][/u][list][*] Application Period: 11/1 - 11/29
[*] Finalists Announced: 12/27
[*] Player Vote: 12/27 - 1/17
[*] Winners Announced: 2/6
[*] Medal and Trophy Theme Packs Sent Out: 2/6[/list]

[u][h3]How to Participate[/h3][/u][list][*] Step 1: Create a Studio Creation Mode map
[*] Step 2: Register a thumbnail image and map description
[*] Step 3: Add "#fitness" to the map's title[/list]

[u][h3]Conditions[/h3][/u][list][*] 10 finalists will be selected based on creativity, number of recommendations, number of cubes earned, use of new blocks and script diversity, utilization of content, and relevance to the subject.
[*] There is no limit on how many times you can enter, and a single player can win multiple/duplicate prizes.[/list]

[u][h3]Prizes[/h3][/u][list][*] 1st (2 people): Transcendence Decoder x300 + Trophy Theme Pack + Excellent Creator Medal
[*] 2nd (2 people): Transcendence Decoder x200 + Trophy Theme Pack + Excellent Creator Medal
[*] 3rd (2 people): Transcendence Decoder x100 + Trophy Theme Pack + Excellent Creator Medal
[*] 4th - 10th: Transcendence Decoder x50 + Trophy Theme Pack + Excellent Creator Medal
[*] All participants (with +10 map play counts and +3 recommendations): 5,000 Mileage + Contest Participation Medal[/list]

[u][h3]Notice[/h3][/u][list][*] Only maps created on or after 11/1 will be able to participate.
[*] Your award may be revoked if you're not the owner of the account.
[*] You must include the #fitness tag in the map title in order to have a valid contest entry.
[*] Entries must be original creations made within the contest period. Any awards will be revoked and you may be banned from future events if your entry includes content that: violates the game's terms and conditions, is plagiarized in any way, or violates the rights of 3rd parties.
[*] Entries containing sexually suggestive or violent images exceeding the standards of the game may be deleted immediately.
[*] If there are no entries fitting the selection criteria after evaluation, there may be no winning entry, or the award may be changed.
[*] If you have already obtained the Excellent Creator Medal, another one will not be given.
[*] Using new blocks (device, character, and device block) will award extra point, but they are not necessary to win prizes.
[*] Please submit your entries only if you agree to all of the above.[/list]

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/02408c91d8ae001b921956c3887587bffc5e75bd.jpg[/img]

Here's a rundown of some of the major updates in today's patch!

[list][b][*]Season 17: Egypt (10/04 - 1/24)[/b]For details, please refer to the Season 17 Pass Preview.

[b][*] Chuseok Moonlight Event (10/4 - 10/18)[/b]Participate in the event and earn lots of great rewards!

[b][*] Autumn Enhancement Item Giveaway (10/4 - 10/18)[/b]Receive rewards just by playing during the event!

[b][*] Holiday Mileage Auction Event (10/4 - 10/17)[/b]You can access the auction via the 'Mileage Auction' button at the bottom of the lobby during the event.

[b][*] Twin Light Axes/Twin Shadow Axes Promotion (10/4 - 11/15)[/b]During the promotion, Twin Light Axes and Twin Shadow Axes will make a special appearance in Epic Decoders![/list]

[h1]---------- Details ----------[/h1]

[h2]Update Information[/h2]

[h3]Releasing a New Map[/h3]
[list][*]New Map Extension
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/fbbcb9bb17818954fec80f109fc7423075094749.png[/img]
[*]Location: Extension Building Site
[*]Eligible Modes: Team Deathmatch, Team Deathmatch (AI), Deathmatch, Deathmatch (AI), Gun Deathmatch, Zombie, Zombie Classic, Zombie Mutant, Zombie Hero, Zombie Z, Zombie Evolution, Super Soldier, and All-Star.[/list]

[h3]Season 17: Egypt (10/04 - 1/24)[/h3]
For details, please refer to the Season 17 Pass Preview.

[list][*]Black Market Opens Early
[list][*]The Black Market will open early for players who reach Rank 100.
[*]Upon reaching Rank 100 on the current Season Pass, Season Missions will end while missions that offer Black Market Badges will refresh.
[*]New Items Added:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/a75f867bfac375f16b67cf9b4ca800c19bd3780b.png[/img]
 CSO Energy Drink, Laser Storm (Parts Applied), Avalanche TECH, Dart Pistol TECH, Crowbar Maverick TECH, and Cyborg Normal Zombie (Costume) [/list][/list]

[list][*]Season Pass Discount Coupon
[list][*]Description: This is a coupon that reduces the purchase price of the next Season Pass. The Discount Coupon is given to those who have reached Season Pass Rank 100.
[*]* Logging in during the following season will automatically redeem the coupon.

[*]Items listed for auction can be purchased immediately at the direct purchase price.
[*]If you list an item for auction, you cannot withdraw it until the auction's duration has ended.

notes.title: [Event] CSN:S 9th Anniversary Celebration Event
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/638eb2e490489f6e91890fc52fad6ba9b4ef1f45.jpg[/img]

Greetings Survivors!
CSN:S is now in its 9th year of service.                 
To show you our deep gratitude, we have prepared a variety of events and special discounts.


[h3]Event 1: CSN:S 9th Anniversary Celebration In-game Event[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/1c74b60734f20dee7d3a2f03dfdbc29d77a49b45.png[/img]
An opportunity to earn Event Decoders, Special Weapons, and Transcendence Decoders!
Play the game and receive plenty of rewards!
[url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/273110/announcements/detail/3657541007199053832]Please check the patch notes for more details.[/url]


[h3]Event 2: CSN:S 9th Anniversary Celebration Medal Giveaway[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/5cbf92a0c94bf60689fd0797db66e527679c66ba.png[/img]
We have prepared a special medal just for you.
Log in to the game to get your medal!


[h3]Event 3: CSN:S 9th Anniversary Celebration Anniversary Box Sale[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/d8d2bb7a34a5617bf1da66f2561bacee800739aa.png[/img]
Don't miss out on your chance to obtain Transcendence Enhanced Weapons, the new unique weapon, Ignite, and Special Item Epic Weapons at discounted prices!


[h3]Event 4: CSN:S 9th Anniversary Celebration Player Content Event[/h3]
Be sure to upload your fan art and any videos related to the 9 years you've spent with CSN:S!
We will be running a raffle to give out lots of great rewards, like Steam gift cards, Transcendence Decoders, and more!

notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: September 20th
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/1cc679d5fc930677c86e1b6befd6df3307704bf3.jpg[/img]

Here's a rundown of some of the major updates in today's patch!

[list][b][*]Back-to-School Name Stickers Event! (09/20 - 10/4)[/b]New semester has begun! Collect Name Stickers to obtain items like the Shy Light Zombie Nameplate and the Transcendence Decoder!

[b][*] Two New Parts Celebration Event (9/20 - 10/4)[/b]To celebrate the release of 'Bomb Boost' and 'Bomb Self-Shield', we've made it so you can get rewards simply by playing the game!

[b][*] CSN:S 9th Anniversary Event (09/20 - 10/4)[/b]It's the 9th Anniversary of CSN:S! Join the event and claim your rewards!

[b][*] CSN:S 9th Anniversary Box Sale (09/20 - 10/4)[/b]Come celebrate the 9th Anniversary of CSN:S with a special promotion![/list]

[h1]---------- Details ----------[/h1]

[h2]Update Information[/h2]

[h3]Zombie New Scenario 8-4 Map[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/3102dbc6c2117beb39fa5d3067ffe652e4c2283a.png[/img]
Survival: Isolation
Survivors of the Aegis Institute received intel that Super Soldiers and Kronos were meeting up and decided they must surprise them with an ambush. Instead, after arriving at the rendezvous point, the team gets surrounded by a horde of enemies.

[h3]New Part Information[/h3]
[list][*]Bomb Boost Part - Grades 1 - 6
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/84c7cd73672726356318bfadd5bc16939e88e38d.png[/img]
[list][*]Type: Part
[*]Content: A part that can be equipped on the bomb to enhance its performance.
[*]In Zombie Mode, a set percentage of the bomb's attack power will be increased, depending on the grade of the part.
[*]In Zombie Scenario, a set percentage of the bomb's attack power will be increased, depending on the grade of the part.
[*]* Bombs that can be equipped with parts have a Parts Emblem before the bomb's name.[/list][/list]

[list][*]Bomb Self-Shield Part - Grades 1 - 6
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/4f60ccad2515319eb7a0db9e89420ec7da1c1630.png[/img]
[list][*]Type: Part
[*]Content: A part that can be equipped on the bomb to enhance its performance.
[*]- In Zombie Mode, reduces the maximum set amount of damage done to self from equipped bombs, depending on the grade of the part (based on 100 Armor).
[*]- In Zombie Scenario, reduces the maximum set amount of damage done to self from equipped bombs depending on the grade of the part (based on 100 Armor).
[*]* Bombs that can be equipped with parts have a Parts Emblem before the bomb's name.[/list][/list]


[h2]Event Information[/h2]

[h3]Back-to-School Name Stickers Event! (09/20- 10/4)[/h3]
New semester has begun! Collect Name Stickers to obtain items like the Shy Light Zombie Nameplate and the Transcendence Decoder!

[list][*]Event Requirements / How to Participate
[list][*](Any mode) Get 1 Name Sticker for every 20 / 40 minutes of play time. (Up to 2 a day)
[*]Score 100 kills and clear the new Zombie Scenario map, Survival: Isolation, on Hard or higher difficulty to earn 3 Name Stickers (up to a maximum of 3 during the event).[/list][/list]
[list][*]Cumulative Rewards:
[list][*]x2: Rare Decoder x5 + Zombie Scenario Add-On Rate Box x5
[*]x4: Unique Decoder + Grade 3 Parts Reward Box x10
[*]x6: Unique Decoder x2 + 50 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x3
[*]x8: Unique Decoder x5
[*]x10: 10,000 Mileage Coupon + 50 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x5
[*]x12: Event Decoder x4 + Class Decoder
[*]x14: Shy Light Zombie Nameplate (300 Days) + 100 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x4
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/7d26a7712d0c0d51aba7f3d97a24dc371f62b82c.png[/img]
[*]x16: Class Decoder x3 + 50 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x5
[*]x18: 10,000 Mileage Coupon + 100 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x5
[*]x20: Event Decoder x6
[*]x22: Class Decoder x6
[*]x24: Transcendence Decoder x7
[*]x26: Season Badge x100[/list][/list]
[list][*]Notice
[list][*]Pileup reward is limited to once per account.
[*]Participation will only count in rooms with three or more players (including Studio Mode).
[*]At least 5 minutes of playtime are required to complete Zombie Scenario mode missions.
[*]Excludes auto hunt kills regardless of mode.
[*]Playtime missions can be completed in all modes.
[*]All Name Stickers will be removed during maintenance on 10/4.
[*]If you have obtained all Season Badges and cannot earn more, you will receive a Black Market Badge instead.
[*]The Event Decoder can be used until midnight on the day it is obtained.[/list][/list]


[h3]Two New Parts Celebration Event (09/20- 10/4)[/h3]
To celebrate the release of 'Bomb Boost' and 'Bomb Self-Shield', we've made it so you can get rewards simply by playing the game!
[list][*]Conditions / Rewards
[list][*]Reach 5 minutes of playtime to obtain one of each Grade 3 Part from the total of 18 available.[/list][/list]
[list][*]Notice
[list][*]Rewards are limited to one per account.
[*]Participation will only count in rooms with three or more players (including Studio Mode).[/list][/list]


[h3]Bonus Disassembly Event (09/20- 10/4)[/h3]
You can participate in the Bonus Disassembly Event by clicking "Bonus Disassembly" at the bottom of the Lobby. During the event, 10 players can select the weapons they want to disassemble, with one lucky player receiving extra mileage. Participants can get 500 mileage for each weapon they disassemble.
[list][*]Details
[list][*]Weekdays and Weekends - 1:00 PM - 5:00 PM CEST
[*]Minimum Participation Mileage: 5,000
[*]Some items will be adjusted based on the weapon's rarity.
[*]Table ranks are in the order of highest value first.
[*]Weapon criteria are determined the day the Bonus Disassembly Event starts. If the weapon's rank changes, its value in the Bonus Disassembly Event will be updated.
[*]New items for disassembly: Gravity Repulsor, M3 Azhi Dahaka, DESERT MG3, DESERT M2, DESERT SPAS-12, DESERT HAMMER, DESERT WA2000, DESERT M95, DESERT Dual Infinity Final, DESERT M60E4[/list][/list]


[h3]CSN:S 9th Anniversary Event (09/20- 10/4)[/h3]
It's the 9th Anniversary of CSN:S! Join the event and claim your rewards!
[list][*]Participation Requirements
[list][*]Log-in: Event Decoder
Play 10/20/30 minutes a day: 1 Point[/list][/list]
[list][*]Point Accumulation Rewards
[list][*]3 Points: Norinco Type 86S
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/b05fb3ff9bdcd52a88c59933aec904dcec1fc9ef.png[/img]
[*]9 Points: Rare Decoder x10
[*]15 Points: Unique Decoder x8
[*]18 Points: Unique Premium Decoder x5
[*]21 Points: 10,000 Mileage Coupon x3
[*]27 Points: Transcendence Weapon Pass (3 Days)
[*]30 Points: Class Decoder x10
[*]33 Points: Festival Nameplate (Permanent)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/1c74b60734f20dee7d3a2f03dfdbc29d77a49b45.png[/img]
[*]36 points: Transcendence Decoder x10[/list][/list]
[list][*]Notice
[list][*]Rewards are limited to one per account.
[*]You can earn up to 3 points a day.
[*]Eligible Zombie Modes: No mode restrictions
[*]You can participate in Studio Mode
[*]Player Requirement: 3 or more 
[*]Can participate in Laboratory Mode[/list][/list]


[h3]CSN:S 9th Anniversary Medal Giveaway (09/20 - 09/24)[/h3]
Log in to celebrate the CSN:S 9th Anniversary and claim your medal!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/5cbf92a0c94bf60689fd0797db66e527679c66ba.png[/img]
[list][*]Participation Requirements
[list][*]Log in during 9/20 - 9/24 to receive your permanent CSN:S 9th Anniversary Celebration Medal[/list][/list][list][*]Notice
[list][*]Rewards are limited to one per account.[/list][/list]


[h3]Good-Bye Season 16 Double-Up Event (09/20- 10/4)[/h3]
Earn double the amount of Season Badges from daily and weekly missions during the event.


[h2]Shop Update[/h2]

[h3]CSN:S 9th Anniversary Box Sale (09/20 - 10/4)[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/d8d2bb7a34a5617bf1da66f2561bacee800739aa.png[/img]
Come celebrate the 9th Anniversary of CSN:S with a special promotion!
[list][*]Products On Offer
[list][*]Transcendence Enhanced Weapon
[*]Ignite-10 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/e5261478a0290e453c4105e316445dad8ed230ef.png[/img]
[list][*]The latest release of Aegis Institute, the Ignite can swiftly take on multiple enemies.
[*]Ignition Blast: Right-click to detonate immediately, inflicting damage on enemies in front of you and reducing their movement speed for a short time.
[*]Probability: 1% [/list]
[*]Two 9th Anniversary Special Items (Void Avenger / Divine Blaster), Probability of Each: 0.075% [/list][/list]
[list][*]Notice
[list][*]Earn 15 mileage just for opening the box!
[*]Unused boxes will be automatically opened with their contents awarded during the 10/4 maintenance.[/list][/list]


[h3]CSN:S 9th Anniversary Box Discount Sale (09/20 - 10/4)[/h3]
9th Anniversary Celebration Boxes will be discounted up to 90%
[list][*]Discounted Content
[list][*]Anniversary Box x10: 90% Discount
[*]Anniversary Box x25: 54% Discount[/list][/list]
[list][*]Notice
[list][*]Each discounted product can only be purchased once per account.[/list][/list]


[h2]Misc.[/h2]
[olist][*]Fixed an issue in Zombie Scenario: Nexus Space Rift where you could travel across the map in an unexpected way.
[*]Fixed an issue in Zombie Mode where holding the Drakar and then dropping it would remove any mutations obtained by Karma.
[*]Fixed an issue where you would be transported to the waiting room when a creature was destroyed by a Fire Bomb.
[*]Fixed an issue in Zombie Z mode where you could purchase weapons in an unexpected way.
[*]Closed Random Transformation: Truth Uncovered, Random Transformation: End of Madness, and Exciting: Revenge maps.[/olist]

notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: September 6th
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/af70928fc220dce9e6c026faa37c65b6fc553b0b.jpg[/img]

Here's a rundown of some of the major updates in today's patch!

[list][b][*] Last Days of Summer Event (09/06 - 09/20)[/b]Let's say goodbye to the long summer by collecting lots of points and having lots of fun!

[b][*] New Transcendence Weapon Promotion (09/06 - 10/04)[/b]Drakar I and Drakar III will make a special appearance during the event in [Drakar Decoder]

[b][*] Drakar Coin Giveaway (09/06 - 10/04)[/b]Earn mission points during the event and collect Drakar Coins!

[b][*] Guaranteed Class Decoder Rotation Group Giveaway Event (9/6 - Until Next Transcendence Class Promotion)[/b]Select a guaranteed class from the rotation group based on Class Decoder usage during the event![/list]

[h1]---------- Details ----------[/h1]

[h2]Update Information[/h2]

[h3]Zombie Z Update Information[/h3]
[list][*]Fire Bomb Changes
[list][*]Damage has been slightly increased when Fire Bomb ends in Zombie Hero, Zombie Hero (Laboratory), Zombie Z, and Zombie Z (Laboratory) modes.
[*]Fire Bomb's HP has been slightly increased in Zombie Hero, Zombie Hero (Laboratory), Zombie Z, and Zombie Z (Laboratory) modes.
[*]The reduction to Movement Speed while inside the range of Fire Bomb has been slightly decreased in Zombie Hero, Zombie Hero (Laboratory), Zombie Z, and Zombie Z (Laboratory) modes.
[*]You can now obtain points and Karma by destroying the Fire Bomb in Zombie Hero, Zombie Hero (Laboratory), Zombie Z, and Zombie Z (Laboratory) modes.[/list][/list]

[h3]New Zombie Scenario Medal[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/acc36f3e75af8ff75f9cb9c951e31fa904dae303.png[/img]
[list][*]Zombie Scenario 8-4 Nexus Space Rift Medal
[*]Condition: Zombie Scenario - Clear Pursuit: Ep. Nexus Space Rift 100 times[/list]

[h3]Improvements[/h3]
[list][*] Some changes have been made to how the notification window is displayed.
[list][*]Removed permanent displays notifications (permanent weapons and other items will be displayed without the duration)
[*]Unused limited-time items: display the applicable duration (Ex: 1 Day, 3 Days, 6 Days)
[*]Items with an expiration date: display applicable dates (Ex: Expiration - 9/20/2023 at 4:00PM)[/list][/list]


[h2]New Events[/h2]

[h3]Last Days of Summer Event (09/06 - 09/20)[/h3]
Let's say goodbye to the long summer by collecting lots of points and having lots of fun!

[list][*]Participation Requirements / Obtainable Items
[list][*]Reach 30 / 40 minutes of playtime: 6 Points each (up to 12 points a day)
[*]Log-in: 3 Points (up to 3 points a day)
[*]Score 6 Kill Points by kills or assists (bots excluded for both) as a human in Zombie Mode: 1 Point (up to 15 points a day)
[*]Score 6 Kill Points by human infection (bots excluded) as a zombie in Zombie Mode: 2 Points (up to 15 points a day)
[*]Clear a Zombie Scenario mode on Hard or higher after scoring 100 Kill Points: 3 Points[/list][/list]

[list][*]How to Earn Kill Points
[list][*]Zombie Kill as a Human: 3 Points (excluding bots)
[*]Zombie Assist as a Human: 1 Point (excluding bots)
[*]Human Infection as Zombie: 3 Points (excluding bots)
[*]Human Infection Assist as Zombie: No Points[/list][/list]

[list][*]Daily Rewards
[list][*]Obtain 30 points every day to earn an Event Decoder[/list][/list]

[list][*]Total Point Rewards
[list][*]30 Points: Rare Decoder x3
[*]60 Points: Rare Decoder x5 + Zombie Scenario Add-On Rate Box x5
[*]90 Points: Unique Decoder x3 + Grade 4 Parts Reward Box x5
[*]150 Points: Unique Decoder x7 + 100 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x3
[*]210 Points: Class Decoder x3 + Summer Hunting Zombie Spray (Permanent)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/5c9f77df529c598c04d4a968c0687894d3e75ed2.png[/img]
[*]270 Points: Transcendence Decoder x2 + Transcendence Weapon Pass (3 Days)
[*]330 Points: Class Decoder x7
[*]360 points: Transcendence Decoder x5
[*]390 Points: Season Badge x100[/list][/list]

[list][*]Notice
[list][*]You can earn up to 30 points a day.
[*]Cumulative rewards are given once per account.
[*]Participation will only count in rooms with three or more players (excludes Studio Mode).
[*]Relevant Zombie Modes: Zombie Classic / Zombie Mutant / Zombie Hero / Zombie Z / Zombie Evolution
[*]Excluded Zombie Scenario Maps: Double Gate / Lost City / Survival: Trap / Survival: Groundwater / Pursuit: Chaos
[*]At least 5 minutes of playtime are required to complete Zombie Scenario mode missions.
[*]Excludes auto hunt kills regardless of mode.
[*]Playtime missions can be completed in all modes.
[*]All points will be removed during maintenance on 9/20.
[*]If you have obtained all Season Badges and cannot earn more, you will receive a Black Market Badge instead.
[*]The Event Decoder can be used until midnight on the day it is obtained.[/list][/list]


[h3]1st Daily Play Event (09/06 - 09/12 23:59:59)[/h3]
Earn rewards during the event with the following missions!

[list][*]Requirements
[list][*]Log in for 3 days during the event and play for 20 minutes each day to earn Event Decoder x3 + 3,000 Mileage Coupon[/list][/list]

[list][*]Notice
[list][*]Cumulative rewards are given once per account.
[*]Only rooms with 3 or more players count toward these goals.
[*]The Event Decoder can be used until midnight on the day it is collected.[/list][/list]


[h3]2nd Daily Play Event (09/13 at 12:00 AM - 09/20 before maintenance)[/h3]

[list][*]Requirements
[list][*]Log in for 3 days during the event and play for 20 minutes each day to earn Event Decoder x3 + 3,000 Mileage Coupon[/list][/list]

[list][*]Notice
[list][*]Cumulative rewards are given once per account.
[*]Only rooms with 3 or more players count toward these goals.
[*]The Event Decoder can be used until midnight on the day it is collected.[/list][/list]


[h3]Login Supplies Event Guide (9/6 - 10/4 11: 59: 59)[/h3]

[list][*]Login Reward
[list][*]Daily Weapons Supply
[*]Dual Sword Phantom Slayer (1 Day) & M3 Black Dragon (1 Day) & Barrett M95 White Tiger (1 Day)
[*]3 types all provided + 2 types out of Rare, Unique, or Transcendence provided according to probabilities + 1 Transcendence Class (1 Day) provided according to probabilities + all contents of Daily Attendance Reward Box provided.
[*]Transcendence Classes (1 Day): Dorothy Dark Knight, Flora Paladin, Transcendence Ji Yoon Choi, Transcendence Yuri, Sonya Lycanthrope, Elizabeth Crimson Hunter, Transcendence Michaela, Transcendence Fernando, Transcendence Blair, and Rose Phoenix
[*]Daily Attendance Reward Box: Damage Display (1 Day), Killer Display (1 Day), Penalty and Loss Invalidation x1, Rare Decoder x3
[*]All weapons and classes from the Daily Supply are bound and cannot be used for Auction/Disassembly/Family Storage (Extension X).[/list][/list]

[list][*]Cumulative Rewards
[list][*]5 Days: X-TRACKER (20 Days) + Cumulative Attendance Reward Box
[*]10 Days: Spell Lance Scarlet Rose (20 Days) + Cumulative Attendance Reward Box
[*]15 Days: Trinity Grenade (20 Days) + Cumulative Attendance Reward Box
[*]20 Days: Lightning Fury (20 Days) + Cumulative Attendance Reward Box
[*]25 Days: Heaven Splitter (5 Days) + Cumulative Attendance Reward Box
[*]Cumulative Attendance Reward Box contents: C4 Countdown Room Host (5 Days), Shorten Respawn Time (5 Days) Lucky Gunslinger (5 Days), Daily Mission Difficulty Change x15, Exploration Slot Expansion Coupon (7 Days)[/list][/list]

[list][*]Notice
[list][*]Attendance rewards will be provided directly as rewards instead of the Daily/Cumulative Attendance Reward Box items.
[*]Rewards can be claimed immediately after logging in and are available until midnight every day.[/list][/list]


[h2]Shop Update[/h2]

[h3]New Transcendence Weapon Promotion (09/06 - 10/04)[/h3]
Drakar I and Drakar III will make a special appearance during the event in [Drakar Decoder]

[list][*]Decoder
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/429d5f9baf4ee11675344f0374f4bf57b692977c.png[/img]
[list][*]Drakar Decoder
[*]You can exchange the Transcendence Decoders you own with Drakar Decoders during the event via [Crafting] - [Disassemble].[/list][/list]

[list][*]Drakar I
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/2000aa988df07008c128ae5218113868fe17fb92.png[/img]
[list][*]Type: Primary Weapon (Unique)
[*]Description: A Viking-inspired tactical rifle that fires 60 rounds of 5.56mm bullets. Charge the gauge by hitting enemies and use it to increase the firearm's stage. Reloading will grant special ammo, and the firearm's stage will increase or decrease depending on the gauge amount. Use the special ammo to inflict damage to enemies in rage for a short time.
[*]Drop Rate: 2.46%[/list][/list]

[list][*]Drakar III
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/5b07b35991b10f8896c9e2fedc0e172805ceeafc.png[/img]
[list][*]Type: Primary Weapon (Unique)
[*]Description: A Viking-inspired tactical rifle that fires 60 rounds of 5.56mm bullets, with enhanced performance from its predecessor, the Drakar II. Charge the gauge by hitting enemies. Reloading while the gauge is at max will increase the firearm's stage, however, if the gauge is not full, it will decrease instead. The weapon's performance changes every three stages, and reloading gives you special ammo that inflicts damage to enemies in range for a short time.
[*]Drop Rate: 0.45%[/list][/list]

[list][*]Notice
[list][*]All unused Drakar Decoders will be removed during maintenance on 10/4.
[*]85 mileage will be given for each Drakar Decoder removed.
[*]Drakar Decoders will keep their contents until the 10/4 maintenance.
[*]You can exchange the Transcendence Decoders you own with Drakar Decoders during the event via [Crafting] - [Disassemble].[/list][/list]


[h3]New Transcendence Weapon Guaranteed Giveaway (09/06 - 10/04)[/h3]
Use [Drakar Decoders] during the event to receive [Drakar Coins], which, depending on the amount, guarantees either Drakar I or Drakar III!

[list][*]Conditions
[list][*]Collect Drakar Coins x50 to receive Drakar I (Permanent) (once per account)
[*]Each time you collect Drakar Coins x300 (300/600/900/etc.), you will receive Drakar III (Permanent)[/list][/list]

[list][*]Notice
[list][*]For every Drakar Decoder you use, you'll receive a Drakar Coin.
[*]All Drakar Coins will be removed during maintenance on 10/04.

[list][*]Conditions

[*]Score 6 Kill Points by kills or assists (bots excluded for both) as a human in Zombie Mode: 1 Mission Point (up to 20 Mission Points per account)
[*]Score 6 Kill Points by human infection (bots excluded) as a zombie in Zombie Mode: 2 Mission Points (up to 20 Mission Points per account)

[list][*]How to Earn Kill Points

[*]Human Infection as Zombie: 3 Points
[*]Human Infection Assist as Zombie: 0 Points[/list][/list]

[list][*]Cumulative Rewards

[list][*]Notice
[list][*]Total Mission Points available during the event period: 50 Points
[*]Playtime missions can be completed in all modes.

[*]Participation will only count in rooms with three or more players (excludes Studio Mode).

[h3]Drakar Upgrade Event (09/06 - 10/04)[/h3]
Based on the number of Drakar I's collected during the event, they will be upgraded to Drakar II or Drakar III (Permanent).

[list][*]Conditions
[list][*]Collect Drakar I (Permanent) x3 to obtain Drakar II (Permanent)
[*]Collect Drakar I (Permanent) x7 to obtain Drakar III (Permanent)[/list][/list]

[list][*]Drakar II
[list][*]Type: Primary Weapon (Unique-Part)
[*]Description: A Viking-inspired tactical rifle that fires 50 rounds of 5.56mm bullets, with enhanced performance from its predecessor, the Drakar I. Charge the gauge by hitting enemies. Reloading while the gauge is at max will increase the firearm's stage, however, if the gauge is not full, it will decrease instead. The weapon's performance changes every two stages, and reloading gives you special ammo that inflicts damage to enemies in range for a short time.[/list][/list]

[list][*]Notice
[list][*]Collection rewards for each stage are given only once per account.
[*]Drakar I is not kept when upgrading it to the Drakar II or III.

[h3]Guaranteed Class Decoder Rotation Group Giveaway Event (9/6 - Until Next Transcendence Class Promotion)[/h3]

[*]Roy
[*]Romy

notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: August 23rd
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/74548df00c93cd27a561a4693399ef5f9a0ba54a.jpg[/img]

Here's a rundown of some of the major updates in today's patch!

[list][b][*] Collect Points and Beat the Heat! Event (8/23 - 9/6)[/b]Beat the heat by collecting Play Points and earn lots of great rewards!

[b][*] Chilseok Puzzle Collection Event (8/23 - 9/6)[/b]It's the day when the Cowherd and the Weaver Girl finally meet! Celebrate Chilseok by collecting puzzles to let the Cowherd and Weaver Girl cross the Magpie Bridge!

[b][*] Zombie Scenario New Map 8-4 Event (8/23 - 9/6)[/b]Experience the new Zombie Scenario and earn rewards during the event!

[b][*] End of Summer Event (8/23 - 9/6)[/b]Play during the event and earn rewards![/list]

[h1]---------- Details ----------[/h1]

[h2]Update Information[/h2]

[h3]Zombie New Scenario 8-4 Map[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/f932a4cc64d730dedbd4d26b325ec16815400249.png[/img]
[list][*]Pursuit: Nexus Space Rift
[list][*]David Black and his company successfully get in contact with Yuri, and they discuss meeting at the rendezvous point. She tells them about Kronos' secret laboratory and suggests that if they help her destroy it, she will consider joining them. David Black requests Alin and Dominique help her destroy the lab and provides the coordinates. When Alin and Dominique arrive at the rendezvous point, Yuri is nowhere to be found. Instead, they find a village filled with strange rifts.
[*]You can find detailed information in the [Zombie Scenario 8-4 Preview].[/list][/list]


[h3]New Zombie Scenario Medal[/h3]
[list][*]Season 8 Veteran Medal
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/cf67a1c59d92197444c7fecad12efabdee905cb4.png[/img]
[list][*]Condition: Clear all Zombie Scenarios for Season 8 (An Approaching Threat / Planned Tragedy / Abandoned Hound / Nexus Space Rift)[/list][/list]


[h2]Improvements[/h2]

[h3]Improved the <Notification> window to display and manage all rewards previously presented individually after logging in.[/h3]

[h3]<Reward History> tab has been added to the <Notification> window.[/h3]
[list][*]This records a history of various rewards and automatically removes them after a certain amount of time.
[*] (Rewards will be saved in your inventory like normal. Only the record of rewards will be stored and later removed.)

Beat the heat by collecting Play Points and earn lots of great rewards!

[list][*]Event Requirements / Obtainable Items

[*]Earn 1 point for every 8 Kill Points by kills or assists as a human, or infections as a zombie in Zombie Mode (up to 7 per day).

[*]Zombie Assist as a Human: 1 Point (excluding bots)

 It's the day when the Cowherd and the Weaver Girl finally meet! Celebrate Chilseok by collecting puzzles to let the Cowherd and Weaver Girl cross the Magpie Bridge!

[olist][*]Fixed an issue where players could not proceed in Zombie Scenario when moving the map, due to infinitely repeating player spawns.
[*]Fixed an issue in some Zombie Scenario maps where the player would improperly switch maps or skip entire sections.
[*]Removed the text of Ad Balloons that appear during in-game events.
[*]Added an Extend Duration category to the properties of an item.
[*]Enabled auto-scroll per item during chain purchases.
[*]Changed the "Such Potential" Honor Mission conditions from less than 15 activated mutations to less than 20.
[*]Fixed an issue where the reward condition for the "Such Potential" Honor Mission was set incorrectly.
[*]Fixed an issue where the Cosmic Armor would have a small chance not to activate in specific situations.
[*]Fixed an issue where bots would behave abnormally when AI Auto Balance was set to OFF in Team Deathmatch (AI) mode.
[*]Fixed an issue where the hand texture of some classes would display incorrectly when holding the Master Combat Knife.
[*]Fixed an issue where Vacation Alin's face texture would display incorrectly.
[*]Removed the Venom Guard skill use restriction in Hideout mode.
[*]Fixed an issue where the Hécate II Umbra would not display in the buy menu before the AWP match.
[*]Fixed an issue in Tutorial mode where rounds would not display as M4A1 ammo.
[*]Changed the number of the maximum players of Super Soldier mode.
[/olist]

notes.title: [Event] Zombie Scenario SPEEDRUN Event!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/81dfd73a08a1496261983b4ce51fc5f2948f85fa.jpg[/img]

Show off your skills in this Zombie Scenario Speedrun Event! 
Participate now to receive the 1st place prize and Steam gift card!

[b][h2]Event : Zombie Scenario Speedrun Event[/h2][/b]
[u][h3]Event Schedule[/h3][/u][list][*] Application Period: 8/23 – 9/5
[*] Winners Announced: 9/19
[*] Personal Information Collection: 9/19 - 10/3 
[*] Rewards Sent Out: 10/18[/list]

[u][h3]How to Participate[/h3][/u][list][*] Step 1: Record a video of clearing Zombie Scenario 8-4 on the 'Hard' difficulty and upload it to YouTube with the hashtags: #Zombie #CSNS_Speedrun.
[b][u]Recording until the clear results screen is required.[/u][/b]
[*] Step 2: Post the video on the official [url=https://discord.gg/ZY4tvFfcZh]Discord channel '#csns_Speedrun'[/url][/list]

[u][h3]Prize No.1[/h3][/u][list][*] 1st to 3rd place: 30 Transcendence Decoders + 30 Class Decoders
[*] All participants (For users who have uploaded a valid clear video): 5 event decoders[/list]
