notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/c24188cf84f8fc0328b7e258460316451ebdbd1b.jpg[/img]

Here's a rundown of some of the major updates in today's patch!

[list][b][*] Random Weapon Zombie Hero Event (8/9– 8/23)[/b]The perfect opportunity to play Random Weapon Zombie Hero!

[b][*] Ad Balloon Popping Event (8/9 - 9/6)[/b]Earn rewards based on how many ad balloons you pop during the event. (The number of times you attack a popped balloon is irrelevant; you receive credit for attacking it at least once.)

[b][*] Heat Wave Targets and Water Balloon Grenade Giveaway (8/9 - 8/23)[/b]Score zombie kills with the Water Balloon Grenade in Zombie Hero / Zombie Z / Zombie Mutant / Zombie Evolution to receive rewards

[b][*] August Holiday event (8/9 - 8/23)[/b]Log in during the event to receive rewards based on how many days you've logged in

[b][*] Transcendence Class Promotion (8/9 - 9/6)[/b]Two Transcendence Classes, Immortal Eric and Smile Mary, are now available in Class Decoders and Premium Class Decoders.

[b][*] Transcendence Weapon Promotion: Death Eater (8/9 - 9/6)[/b]Death Eater will now drop from Premium and normal Transcendence Decoders![/list]

[h1]---------- Details ----------[/h1]

[h2]Update Information[/h2]
[h3]Part Open Weapon Information[/h3]
[list][*]Part Weapon Expansion
[list][*]Star Chaser SR[/list][/list]


[h2]New Events[/h2]

[h3]Random Weapon Zombie Hero Event (8/9– 8/23)[/h3]
The perfect opportunity to play Random Weapon Zombie Hero!

[list][*]Featured Maps
[list][*]Italy/Assault/Dust/Abyss 2[/list][/list]

[list][*]Weapon Update
[list][*]Cousteau, Doom Blaster, Tyrant's Mace, Laser Storm, Avalanche TECH, Crowbar Maverick TECH, Dart Pistol TECH, AUG Guardians, Queen's SL8, Queen's Special Duck Foot Gun, Queen's Tomahawk, Ignite-7, Demolition Hammer, Gravity Repulsor, and M3 Azhi Dahaka[/list][/list]


[h3]Ad Balloon Popping Event (8/9 - 9/6)[/h3]
Earn rewards based on how many ad balloons you pop during the event. (The number of times you attack a popped balloon is irrelevant; you receive credit for attacking it at least once.)

[list][*]Popped Balloons / Rewards
[list][*]5: Grade 4 Parts Reward Box x10 + Season Badge x20
[*]10: Grade 5 Parts Reward Box x5 + Season Badge x30
[*]15: Unique Decoder x3+ 10,000 Mileage
[*]25: Event Decoder x3 + Season Badge x50
[*]35: Class Decoder x5 + 10,000 Mileage
[*]50: Transcendence Decoder x5 + Season Badge x100[/list][/list]

[list][*]Notice
[list][*]Each account can participate in the mission up to 5 times per day.
[*]Each account can only receive rewards once.
[*]Eligible Maps: Dust 2, Militia, Estate, Mouse Hole, Italy, Assault
[*]Participation will only count in rooms with 3 or more players (includes Laboratory Mode, excludes Studio Mode).
[*]The player that delivers the last hit to a popped ad balloon will receive +10% EXP/Points.
[*]The Event Decoder can be used until midnight on the day it is obtained.[/list][/list]


[h3]Ad Balloon Medal Event (8/9 - 9/6)[/h3]
Become a stone-cold ad balloon killer! Pop 300 ad balloons to earn medals and more!

[list][*]Conditions / Rewards
[list][*]Receive [Honor] Killer B Medal + Transcendence Decoder x10 for scoring 300 Kills of the Ad Balloon (depending on the last hit).[/list][/list]

[list][*]Notice
[list][*]Players who already possess the [Honor] Killer B medal cannot receive another one, but they will still receive the Transcendence Decoder reward.
[*]Only the player that delivers the final hit that pops the balloon will add it to their total kill count (for the purpose of this achievement).[/list][/list]


[h3]Heat Wave Targets and Water Balloon Grenade Giveaway (8/9 - 8/23/2023)[/h3]
Score zombie kills with the Water Balloon Grenade in Zombie Hero / Zombie Z / Zombie Mutant / Zombie Evolution to receive rewards
Water Balloon Grenade: 30% Damage + Knockback Probability

[list][*]Kills / Rewards
[list][*]1 Kill: 500 Mileage + Rare Decoder x3
[*]3 Kills: Zombie Damage Meter (7 Days) + Rare Decoder x5 + Unique Decoder x1
[*]5 Kills: Zombie Scenario Add-On Rate Box x5 + 100 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x5
[*]6 Kills: Grade 4 Parts Reward Box x5 + Unique Decoder x3
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/ef4d2fcc8e0fd5e4ff6080d584f5a67bc69dae2f.png[/img]
[*]7 Kills: Point Transcendence Decoder x10 + Point Class Decoder x10 + Event Decoder x3 + Great Vacation Nameplate (300 Days)[/list][/list]

[list][*]Notice
[list][*]Each account can participate in the mission up to 5 times per day.
[*]Each account can only receive rewards once.
[*]Participation will only count in rooms with three or more players (includes Laboratory mode and excludes Studio Mode).
[*]Excludes auto hunt kills regardless of mode.
[*]The Event Decoder can be used until midnight on the day it is obtained.[/list][/list]


[h3]August Holiday event (8/9 - 8/23[/h3]
Log in during the event to receive rewards based on how many days you've logged in:

[list][*]Rewards
[list][*]Reach 2 days of total login: Rare Decoder x5
[*]Reach 3 days of total login: Unique Decoder x5
[*]Reach 6 days of total login: Class Decoder x3
[*]Reach 7 days of total login: Event Decoder x5
[*]Reach 9 days of total login: Event Decoder x10
[*]Reach 10 days of total login: Transcendence Decoder x3
[*]Reach 11 days of total login: Class Decoder x5
[*]Reach 12 days of total login: Transcendence Decoder x5[/list][/list]

[list][*]Notice
[list][*]Each account can only receive rewards once.
[*]You will receive your rewards each time you log in.[/list][/list]


[h2]Shop Update[/h2]

[h3]Transcendence Class Promotion (8/9 - 9/6)[/h3]
Two Transcendence Classes, Immortal Eric and Smile Mary, are now available in Class Decoders and Premium Class Decoders.

[list][*]Immortal Eric
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/2be6331296434b42ea9734483d7dee4da00e8535.png[/img]
[list][*]Background story: After a near-death experience during a zombie attack, his wounds healed up and he returned with an incredible new power. As his superhuman self-recovery rate and physical strength granted him with the resources to compete with the zombies, he willingly fought the undead on the front lines to help others. Fitting his nickname, Immortal, he returns alive every time there is a rumor that he had died. It is known that he is not part of any organizations or groups, but that he does work with Smile Mary.
[*]Paired Weapon: Death Eater
[*]Paired Effect: Special Attack ammo recharge rate increase
[list][*]Hyperbeam: Fire a beam that deals damage to enemies ahead of you. Knocks zombies back in Zombie modes.[/list]
[*]Area duration skill
[list][*](Zombie Scenario) Passive: Passively restores HP and increases Defense
[*](Zombie Scenario) Active: Maximizes the HP recovery and Defense increase effects on self and nearby allies[/list]
[*]Connection buff skill
[list][*](Zombie Scenario) Playing with Smile Mary grants a chance to not take damage upon hit[/list]
[*]Add-On Feature
[list][*](Zombie Scenario) <Ironclad> Add-On effect is applied by default, and stacking it will increase only the 10% Decreased Damage effect[/list][/list][/list]


[list][*]Smile Mary
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/edcdb8f9cb80746aaf8bd54550a8382e0bc69667.png[/img]
[list][*]Background story: As the zombie invasion brought dangers to the everyday lives of the people, some of the general public began to awaken their special abilities. Mary is one of those, having the ability to control the aggression of zombies through psychokinesis, amplify the powers of allies, and control minds. Nobody approaches her as it is said that she could even read the minds of others, but there is a rumor that she sticks with Immortal Eric, another psychic.
[*]Paired Weapon: Death Eater
[*]Paired Effect: Special Attack max ammo increase
[list][*]Hyperbeam: Fire a beam that deals damage to enemies ahead of you. Knocks zombies back in Zombie modes.[/list]
[*]Area duration skill
[list][*]Passive: (Zombie Scenario) When you and your nearby allies are hit, this grants a chance to not take damage and instead increase damage for you and allies nearby
[*]Active: (Zombie Scenario) Maximizes the effects that grant a chance to not take damage and instead increase damage for you and allies nearby upon hit[/list]
[*]Connection buff skill
[list][*](Zombie Scenario) Playing with Immortal Eric grants a chance to not take damage upon hit[/list]
[*]Add-On Feature
[list][*](Zombie Scenario) <Deft Movement> Add-on effect is applied by default, and using the identical Add-on will stack.[/list][/list][/list]


[h3]New Transcendence Class Guaranteed Giveaway (8/9 - 9/6)[/h3]
Get guaranteed 2 Transcendence Classes (Immortal Eric and Smile Mary) based on how many Class Decoders and Premium Class Decoders are used during the event!

[list][*]Conditions and Rewards
[list][*]Upon reaching 150 Guaranteed Points from Decoder use.
[*]Upon reaching 300 Guaranteed Points from Decoder use.
[*]Select one from Immortal Eric + Eric's Hero Helmet or Smile Mary + Mary's Cube[/list][/list]

[list][*]Notice
[list][*]1 Guaranteed Point given each time you use 1 Class Decoder.
[*]3 Guaranteed Points given each time you use 1 Class Premium Decoder.
[*]Selecting Immortal Eric will automatically provide Eric's Hero Helmet (Permanent).
[*]Selecting Smile Mary will automatically provide Mary's Cube (Permanent).
[*]Guaranteed Giveaway rewards can only be received once per account.[/list][/list]


[h3]Transcendence Weapon Promotion: Death Eater (8/9 - 9/6)[/h3]
Death Eater will now drop from Premium and normal Transcendence Decoders!

[list][*]Death Eater Drop Rate
[list][*]Transcendence Premium Decoder: 3%
[*]Transcendence Decoder: 0.45%[/list][/list]

[list][*]Death Eater
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/638ee27eb3869435758bd358c74c2de383b17d0c.png[/img]
[list][*]Description: A shotgun developed with alien technology that can hit nearby targets simultaneously with its basic attacks. Its special attack, Hyper Beam, deals damage to enemies in front of the wielder.[/list][/list]


[h3]Death Eater Guaranteed Giveaway (8/9 - 9/6)[/h3]
Depending on the number of Premium and normal Transcendence Decoders used, you may be guaranteed to receive the Death Eater permanently!

[list][*]Reward Thresholds
[list][*]Upon Reaching 300 Guaranteed Points[/list][/list]

[list][*]Notice
[list][*]6 Guaranteed Points each time you use 1 Transcendence Premium Decoder.
[*]1 Guaranteed Point every time you use 1 Class Decoder.[/list][/list]

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/e9a0c33d6a80b85a074cd0318c75afdadaee77be.jpg[/img]

Here's a rundown of some of the major updates in today's patch!

[list][b][*] New Epic Secondary Weapon 'Gravity Repulsor' Promotion (7/26 - 9/6)[/b]The new Epic Secondary Weapon, Gravity Repulsor, will drop from Epic Decoders during the event.

[b][*] Resonance Energy Collection Event (7/26 - 9/6)[/b]Gather Resonance Energy from Epic Decoders and complete missions to earn more items!

[b][*] DESERT Weapon Giveaway (7/26 - 8/23)[/b]5 Original weapons reimagined with the DESERT concept! Don't miss the opportunity to obtain these new classic weapons by just playing the game!

[b][*] Epic Decoder Special Promotion (7/26 - 9/6)[/b]Epic Decoder chain purchases with increasing discounts are available during the event![/list]

[h1]---------- Details ----------[/h1]

[h2]Improvements[/h2]

[h3]Human HP Recovery Skill ON / OFF (Zombie Hero / Zombie Z Laboratory)[/h3]
Fixed it so the Human HP Recovery skill is OFF when the Fire Bomb is not used (or whenever Fire Bomb is not used in Zombie Z mode).           


[h2]New Events[/h2]

[h3]New Epic Secondary Weapon 'Gravity Repulsor' Promotion (7/26 - 9/6)[/h3]
The new Epic Secondary Weapon, Gravity Repulsor, will drop from Epic Decoders during the event.

[list][*]Epic Decoder
[list][*]Obtainable Items: Gravity Repulsor + Gravity Repulsor Nameplate
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/1c0837c7acc7d39ccfc66c5a71744f9bacfb081b.png[/img]
[*]Drop Rate: 0.35%

[list][*]Gravity Repulsor
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/5fdb1ba9298b49ed2c8a8f951887771175d1b7d7.png[/img]
[list][*]A weapon created with anti-gravity technology. Fires anti-gravity rounds to inflict damage over an area and sends out pulses around the player to protect them. You can also automatically charge the anti-gravity energy to leap and hover in air, and rapidly descend and inflict damage.[/list][/list]

[list][*]Gravity Repulsor Nameplate
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/11b0854ab364384b17554848d87aa3be7dd7ac1e.png[/img]
[list][*] An exclusive nameplate created to celebrate the release of the 2023 Epic weapon, Gravity Repulsor. This customizes how your name appears in the match lobby.[/list][/list]

[list][*]Resonance Energy Box
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/9295bd0c03b99e75c8452137fb7aaddcbe8a419f.png[/img]
[list][*]You have a chance to obtain 3 - 100 Resonance Energy by using a Resonance Energy Box.[/list][/list]

[list][*]Notice
[list][*]The Gravity Repulsor Nameplate is acquired upon obtaining a Gravity Repulsor.
[*]You will receive 1 Resonance Energy Box for each Epic Decoder used.
[*]You have a chance to obtain 3 – 100 Resonance Energy when using a Resonance Energy Box.
[*]All unused Epic Decoders will be removed and replaced with 100 Mileage each during maintenance on 9/6.
[*]Unused Resonance Energy will be removed and replaced with 15 Mileage each during maintenance on 9/6.
[*]All unused Black Rabbit's Galaxy Boxes will be removed and replaced with 30 mileage each during maintenance on 9/6.
[*]Enhanced weapons and weapons with parts attached that are obtained from Epic Decoders have their durations stacked with already owned weapons (with the same enhancement/parts).[/list][/list]

[h3]Resonance Energy Collection Event (7/26 - 9/6)[/h3]
Gather Resonance Energy from Epic Decoders and complete missions to earn more items!

[list][*]How to Obtain Resonance Energy
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/697699813ed95d5bda6d32976fcd11b768c83ac2.png[/img]
[list][*]Score 6 Kill Points with Kills, Assists, or Human Infections (excluding bots) in Zombie mode: Resonance Energy x1 (up to 20 per day)
[*]Clear Zombie Scenario mode on Hard or higher after scoring 100 Kill Points: Resonance Energy x3 (up to 25 per day)
[*]Reach 60 minutes of playtime in any mode: Resonance Energy x15 (up to 15 per day)
[*]You have a chance to obtain 3 – 100 Resonance Energy when using a Resonance Energy Box.[/list][/list]

[list][*]Notice
[list][*]How to Get Zombie Mode Kill Points: Zombie Kill as a Human: 3 Points (excluding bots) / Zombie Kill Assist as a Human: 1 Point/ Human Infection as Zombie: 3 Points (Excluding bots)/ Human Infection Assist as Zombie: 0 Points
[*]You can only obtain up to 30 Resonance Energy per day per account (excludes Resonance Energy obtained from Epic Decoders).
[*]The Resonance Energy Shop has a wide and exciting selection of items available for purchase with Resonance Energy. Resonance Energy will be deducted upon a purchase, but don't forget that you'll get bonus fragments with each item!
[*]Relevant Zombie Modes: Zombie Classic / Zombie Mutant / Zombie Hero / Zombie Z / Zombie Evolution
[*]Excludes Zombie Scenario: Survival: Double Gate / Survival: Lost City / Survival: Trap / Survival: Groundwater / Pursuit: Chaos
[*]At least 5 minutes of playtime are required to complete Zombie Scenario mode missions.
[*]Participation will only count in rooms with three or more players (excludes Studio Mode).[/list][/list]


[h3]Resonance Energy Shop Opening (7/26 – 9/6)[/h3]
You can purchase new Epic Weapons, Epic Edition Weapons, and other various items with Resonance Energy that you've acquired from Epic Decoders and completing missions.

[list][*]M3 Azhi Dahaka
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/8c3cba7cd51b7ac8cf92fc8d84f6613aeef396ca.png[/img]
[list][*] A shotgun imbued with the soul of a demonic dragon. Its basic attack is accompanied by dragon breath, which can be used to unleash a <Dragon Burst> on a marked target, and <Dragon Rising>, which summons the dragon to fight alongside you.[/list][/list]

[list][*]Repulsor Wing
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/cd0ff66da39e7e17460846b1906e6e669621d807.png[/img]

[list][*]Auction Feature / Content
[list][*]Auction Time: 1 hour for all items
[*]Number of Auction Listings: 2 (Increases based on VIP rank)
[*]Market Price of Items: When listing an item, you can check the current Auction House market price (Lowest bid and direct purchase prices).
[*]Item Display: Only items with the lowest bid or direct purchase price are displayed.
[*]Auction Settings: You can search by bid/direct purchase price, enhancement level, and weapon name.
[*]Sell-to-System Feature: When an auction is unsuccessful, you'll have the opportunity to use the sell-to-system feature.

[*]Items listed for auction can be purchased immediately at the direct purchase price.
[*]If you list an item for auction, you cannot withdraw it until the auction's duration has ended.
[*]The item you listed may be shown on the bid page.
[*]When listing an item, you can easily check the actual amount you will receive under the Net Reward section.
[*]Some recently released weapons cannot be listed at auction.[/list][/list]

notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: July 12th
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/48ff6c0adc8c9a100c0b0c1b19f0c2ee346f51cb.jpg[/img]

Here's a rundown of some of the major updates in today's patch!

[list][b][*]Daily Play Event (7/12 - 8/9)[/b]Log-in now to collect event pieces and find out how powerful the new Demolition Hammer is for yourself!

[b][*]Demolition Core Collection Event (7/12 - 8/9)[/b]Participate in special missions to collect Demolition Cores.

[b][*]Super Soldier Landing Event (7/12 - 7/26)[/b]Check out the Expert system and the SVP in Super Soldier Mode today!

[b][*]Al-Hijra Holiday Event (7/12 - 7/26)[/b]Complete the mission during the event to earn rewards.

[b][*]Bonus Disassembly Event (7/12 – 7/26)[/b]You can participate in the Bonus Disassembly Event by clicking "Bonus Disassembly" at the bottom of the Lobby. During the event, 10 players can select the weapons they want to disassemble, with one lucky player receiving extra mileage. Participants can get 500 mileage for each weapon they disassemble.[/list]

Check out the following sections for more information.

[h1]---------- Details ----------[/h1]

[u][h2]New contents[/h2][/u]

[h3]Super Soldier Mode Update Information[/h3]
 Experience superior combat like never before!
 For more information, please refer to the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/273110/announcements/detail/3684556169318885907][Super Soldier Mode Preview][/url].

[list][*]Super Soldier Mode Guide
[list][*]A PVP mode based on Team Deathmatch where humans compete against each other.
[*]Super Soldier players have powerful specs such as High HP and DEF, plus a double jump! Enhanced physical abilities and addition of skills make them formidable in any battle.
[*]Play strategically with the 4 experts: Fighter, Defender, Brawler, and Sniper.
[*]Each expert has specific skills.
[*]You can set hotkeys for each Expert through the Option / Skill Bar Settings.
[*]Collecting the S.V.P. Supply Box during the game will significantly enhance your Attack Power and Movement Speed.
[*]Player specs will be changed based on the Weapon Restriction Options.[/list][/list]


[h3]Zombie Hero and Zombie Z Update Information[/h3]

[list][*]Fire Bomb Options (Zombie Z, Zombie Z Laboratory, Zombie Hero, and Zombie Hero Laboratory)
[list][*]You can now turn on/off the use of Fire Bombs in Room Settings.
[*]Room Settings > Advanced Options
[*] (Fire Bomb will be 'on' when Zombie Restriction > Normal Zombies Only is selected)[/list][/list]

[list][*]Option added to restrict the amount of Zombie Z Mutations (Zombie Z and Zombie Z Laboratory)
[list][*]An option that limits the number of Mutations obtained in Zombie Z.
[*]Select 20, 25, 30, 35, or 40 in the drop-down menu in Room Settings.
[*]Selecting 20 will allow you to acquire a maximum of 20 Mutations. You cannot collect any more after reaching 20.
[*] (This amount does not include mutations increased by Class, etc.)[/list][/list]

[list][*]Added option for Mutation Restriction (Zombie Z and Zombie Z Laboratory)
[list][*]This is an option that removes up to 4 selected Mutations in Zombie Z.
[*]You cannot remove Mutations that are automatically provided at certain levels.[/list][/list]

[list][*]Damage from the end of Fire Bomb ending has been adjusted (Zombie Z, Zombie Z Laboratory, Zombie Hero, and Zombie Hero Laboratory)
[list][*]Damage from the end of Fire Bomb has been adjusted.[/list][/list]

[list][*]The projectile angle of Fire Bomb has been adjusted (Zombie Hero)
[list][*]The projectile angle of Fire Bomb has been adjusted.[/list][/list]


[h3]New Zombie Scenario Medals[/h3]
[list][*]Two New Zombie Scenario Medals have been added.
[list][*]Period: 7/12 after maintenance - Permanent[/list][/list]

[list][*]Grim Reaper
[list][*]Private Medal <Grim Reaper> has been added.[/list][/list]

[list][*]Treasure Trove
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/5df40abd2c1e1f266389ee7c592474e0117808f4.png[/img]
[list][*]Condition: Acquire 1 million points in Zombie Scenario drop box to obtain medals.[/list][/list]


[h3]Improvements[/h3]
[list][*]Added a feature that asks for changes upon receiving a new Nameplate.
[*]Added Weapon/Enhancement/Part/Paint information to <Mission Chain>.
[*]Added a feature that displays what restrictions are in place by hovering your cursor over the <Restrictions> in the lobby.[/list]


[u][h2]New Events[/h2][/u]

[h3]Daily Play Event (7/12 - 8/9)[/h3]
Log-in now to collect event pieces and find out how powerful the new Demolition Hammer is for yourself!

[list][*]How to Participate
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/255b5cd8754c928cee94d0f11c30f38a8c4bb9dc.png[/img]
[list][*]Reach 30 minutes of play to obtain a Demolition Core (up to a maximum of 60 during the event)[/list][/list]

[list][*]Cumulative Login Reward
[list][*]Day 1: Demolition Core, Point Transcendence/Class Decoder (x1 each), and 500 Mileage Coupon
[*]Day 2: Demolition Core, Point Transcendence/Class Decoder (x1 each), and 500 Mileage Coupon
[*]Day 3: Demolition Core x2, Point Transcendence/Class Decoder (x2 each), and 500 Mileage Coupon x2
[*]Day 4: Demolition Core x2, Point Transcendence/Class Decoder (x2 each), and 500 Mileage Coupon x2
[*]Day 5: Demolition Core x3, Point Transcendence/Class Decoder (x3 each), and 500 Mileage Coupon x3
[*]Day 6: Demolition Core x3, Point Transcendence/Class Decoder (x3 each), and 500 Mileage Coupon x3
[*]Day 7: Demolition Core x6, Point Transcendence/Class Decoder (x4 each), and 500 Mileage Coupon x4
[*]Day 8: Demolition Core x6, Point Transcendence/Class Decoder (x4 each), and 500 Mileage Coupon x4
[*]Day 9: Demolition Core x8, Point Transcendence/Class Decoder (x5 each), and 500 Mileage Coupon x4
[*]Day 10: Demolition Core x8, Point Transcendence/Class Decoder (x5 each), and 500 Mileage Coupon x5
[*]Day 11: Demolition Core x10, Point Transcendence/Class Decoder (x6 each), and 500 Mileage Coupon x6
[*]Day 12: Demolition Core x10, Point Transcendence/Class Decoder (x6 each), and 500 Mileage Coupon x6[/list][/list]

[list][*]Notice
[list][*]Rewards for cumulative log-in days are limited to once per account.
[*]Demolition Cores stack, and you can collect up to a maximum of 300. (Overages don't accumulate)
[*]All remaining Demolition Cores will be removed during maintenance on 8/9.[/list][/list]


[h3]Demolition Core Collection Event (7/12 - 8/9)[/h3]
Participate in special missions to collect Demolition Cores.

[list][*]How to Participate
[list][*]Earn 4 Demolition Cores by playing 10 minutes in Super Soldier Mode (up to 4 per day).
[*]Earn 1 Demolition Core for every 8 Kill Points by kills or assists as a human, or infections as a zombie in Zombie Mode (up to 16 per day).
[*]Earn 2 Demolition Cores for every 100 Kill Points in Zombie Scenario mode on Hard difficulty or higher (up to 16 per day).
[*]* You can acquire up to 20 Demolition Cores per day through special mission rewards.[/list][/list]

[list][*]How to Earn Kill Points
[list][*]Zombie Kill as a Human: 3 Points (excluding bots)
[*]Zombie Assist as a Human: 1 Point (excluding bots)
[*]Human Infection as Zombie: 3 Points
[*]Human Infection Assist as Zombie: 0 Points[/list][/list]

[list][*]Notice
[list][*]Cumulative rewards are given once per account.
[*]Relevant Zombie Modes: Zombie Classic / Zombie Mutant / Zombie Hero / Zombie Evolution / Zombie Z
[*]Excludes Zombie Scenario: Survival: Double Gate / Survival: Lost City / Survival: Trap / Survival: Groundwater / Pursuit: Chaos
[*]At least 5 minutes of playtime are required to complete Zombie Scenario mode missions.
[*]Participation in Special Missions will only count in rooms with 3 or more players (includes Laboratory Mode, excludes Studio Mode).
[*]Excludes auto hunt kills regardless of mode.
[*]Demolition Cores stack, and you can collect up to a maximum of 300. (Overages don't accumulate)
[*]All remaining Demolition Cores will be removed during maintenance on 8/9.[/list][/list]


[h3]Collect the Cores! Demolition Hammer Collection Event (7/12 - 8/9)[/h3]
Collect 300 Demolition Cores during the event to obtain the new weapon, the Demolition Hammer!

[list][*]Reward Conditions
[list][*]First Login: Demolition Hammer (1 Day)
[*]10 Cores: Demolition Hammer (15 Days) + Zombie Scenario Add-On Rate Box x5
[*]50 Cores: Rare Decoder x10 + Zombie Damage Meter (5 Days)
[*]100 Cores: Unique Decoder x10 + Grade 4 Parts Reward Box x5
[*]150 Cores: Event Decoder x10 + 50 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x5
[*]200 Cores: Class Decoder x10 + 100 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x5
[*]250 Cores: Transcendence Decoder x10 + 200 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x5
[*]300 Cores: Demolition Hammer (Permanent)[/list][/list]

[list][*]Demolition Hammer
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/0b19d9160ec733804c2d0aa532d83fa7e34152b6.png[/img]
[list][*]A melee weapon created using technology from the Aegis Institute. It is a heavy two-handed hammer, that is massive and imposing when held. Charging its gauge unleashes a powerful downward strike attack, and a follow up with its steel handle.[/list][/list]

[list][*]Notice
[list][*]Cumulative rewards are given only once per account.
[*]Demolition Cores stack, and you can collect up to a maximum of 300. (Overages don't accumulate and you cannot collect any more if you've already acquired the Demolition Hammer)
[*]All remaining Demolition Cores will be removed during maintenance on 8/9.
[*]The Event Decoder can be used until midnight on the day it is obtained.[/list][/list]


[h3]Super Soldier Landing Event (7/12 - 7/26)[/h3]
Check out the Expert system and the SVP in Super Soldier Mode today!

[list][*]Conditions
[list][*]Use an Expert Exclusive Skill 60 times in Super Soldier Mode to earn a Class Decoder
[*]Score 20 or more kills while SVP is active in Super Soldier Mode to earn a Transcendence Decoder.[/list][/list]

[list][*]Notice
[list][*]You can participate a maximum of once per account.
[*]Only rooms with 3 or more players count toward these goals.[/list][/list]


[h3]Super Soldier Mode Weapon Support Event (7/12 - 7/26)[/h3]
Use support weapons in the new Super Soldier Mode today!

[list][*]Conditions
[list][*]Write and enter 'True Super Soldier' in the chat window to obtain a Transcendence Temporary Weapon Box.[/list][/list]

[list][*]Temporary Transcendence Weapon Box Contents (Select 1)
[list][*]Spell Lance Scarlet Rose (1 Day)
[*]Psychic Harmonium (1 Day)
[*]Lightning Fury (1 Day)
[*]Barrett M95 White Tiger (1 Day)
[*]Dual Sword Phantom Slayer (1 Day)[/list][/list]

[list][*]Notice
[list][*]Rewards can only be obtained once a day per account.
[*]The Temporary Transcendence Weapon Box will be removed during maintenance on 7/26.[/list][/list]


[h3]Login Supplies Event Guide (07/12 - 07/25 11: 59)[/h3]
[list][*]Login Reward
[list][*]Daily Weapons Supply
[*]Dual Sword Phantom Slayer (1 Day) & M3 Black Dragon (1 Day) & Barrett M95 White Tiger (1 Day)
[*]3 types all provided + 2 types out of Rare, Unique, or Transcendence provided according to probabilities + 1 Transcendence Class (1 Day) provided according to probabilities + all contents of Daily Attendance Reward Box provided.
[*]Transcendence Classes (1 Day): Dorothy Dark Knight, Flora Paladin, Transcendence Ji Yoon Choi, Transcendence Yuri, Sonya Lycanthrope, Elizabeth Crimson Hunter, Transcendence Michaela, Transcendence Fernando, Transcendence Blair, and Rose Phoenix
[*]Daily Attendance Reward Box: Damage Display (1 Day), Killer Display (1 Day), Penalty and Loss Invalidation x1, Rare Decoder x3
[*]All weapons and classes from the Daily Supply are bound and cannot be used for Auction/Disassembly/Family Storage (Extension X).[/list][/list]

[list][*]Cumulative Rewards
[list][*]5 Days: X-TRACKER (20 Days) + Cumulative Attendance Reward Box
[*]10 Days: Negev NG7 Ajax (20 Days) + Cumulative Attendance Reward Box
[*]Cumulative Attendance Reward Box contents: C4 Countdown Room Host (5 Days), Shorten Respawn Time (5 Days) Lucky Gunslinger (5 Days), Daily Mission Difficulty Change x15, Exploration Slot Expansion Coupon (7 Days)[/list][/list]

[list][*]Notice
[list][*]Attendance rewards will be provided directly as rewards instead of the Daily/Cumulative Attendance Reward Box items.
[*]Rewards can be claimed immediately after logging in and are available until midnight every day.[/list][/list]


[h3]Al-Hijra Holiday Event (7/12 - 7/26)[/h3]
Complete the mission during the event to earn rewards.

[list][*]Event Participation Requirements
[list][*]Log in to earn an Event Decoder (once per day)
[*]Earn 1 point each time you play for 20/40/60 minutes (up to 3 points per day).[/list][/list]

[list][*]Point Accumulation Rewards
[list][*]3 Points: Rare Decoder x10
[*]9 Points: Unique Decoder x8
[*]15 Points: Unique Premium Decoder x5
[*]18 Points: 10,000 Mileage Coupon x3
[*]21 Points: Class Decoder x5
[*]27 points: Transcendence Decoder x7
[*]30 Points: Crescent Moon Nameplate
[*]33 points: Transcendence Decoder x10
[*]36 Points: Class Decoder x10[/list][/list]

[list][*]Notice
[list][*]Pileup reward is limited to once per account.
[*]You can earn up to 3 points a day.
[*]No mode restrictions.
[*]You can participate in Studio Mode.
[*]Can participate in Laboratory Mode.
[*]Player Requirement: 3[/list][/list]


[h3]Bonus Disassembly Event (7/12 – 7/26)[/h3]
You can participate in the Bonus Disassembly Event by clicking "Bonus Disassembly" at the bottom of the Lobby. During the event, 10 players can select the weapons they want to disassemble, with one lucky player receiving extra mileage. Participants can get 500 mileage for each weapon they disassemble.

[list][*]Details
[list][*]Weekdays and Weekends - 1:00 PM – 5:00 PM CEST
[*]Minimum Participation Mileage: 5,000
[*]Some items will be adjusted based on the weapon's rarity.
[*]Table ranks are in the order of highest value first.
[*]Weapon criteria are determined the day the Bonus Disassembly Event starts. If the weapon's rank changes, its value in the Bonus Disassembly Event will be updated.
[*]New items for disassembly: Demolition Hammer, Tyrant's Mace, Electron-V, Ignite-7[/list][/list]


[u][h2]Shop Update[/h2][/u]

[h3]Transcendence Weapon "Devastator" Promotion (7/12 - 8/9)[/h3]
Devastator is now available in Transcendence and Transcendence Premium Decoders!

[list][*]Devastator Drop Rate
[list][*]Transcendence Premium Decoder: 3%
[*]Transcendence Decoder: 0.45%[/list][/list]


[h3]Devastator Guaranteed Giveaway (7/12 - 8/9)[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/8c9d242296df7c78b84ea0eed6406237c1a41b07.png[/img]
Depending on the number of Premium and normal Transcendence Decoders used, you may be guaranteed to receive the Devastator permanently!

[list][*]Reward Thresholds
[list][*]Upon Reaching 300 Guaranteed Points[/list][/list]

[list][*]Notice
[list][*]6 Guaranteed Points each time you use 1 Transcendence Premium Decoder.
[*]1 Guaranteed Point each time you use 1 Class Decoder.[/list][/list]


[h3]Class Rotation Group Appearance Event (7/12 - Until Next Transcendence Class Promotion)[/h3]
The classes below will be part of the new Rotation Group for the Class Decoder during the event.

[list][*]Appearing Classes
[list][*]Anemone / Mirage / Roy / Romy[/list][/list]

[list][*]Notice
[list][*]Check Decoder Rate details after the 7/12 maintenance.
[*]The Rotation Group will no longer be available via the decoder once the event ends.

[h3]Guaranteed Class Decoder Rotation Group Giveaway Event (7/12 - Until Next Transcendence Class Promotion)[/h3]
Select a guaranteed class from the rotation group based on Class Decoder usage during the event!

[list][*]Conditions and Rewards
[list][*]Each time you reach 150 points, you can choose 1 of the following classes:
[*]Roy
[*]Romy
[*]Anemone
[*]Mirage[/list][/list]

[list][*]Notice

Thank you for your understandings and support.

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/a1aa5c0e85855144eccec0a3f8463fac93eb54aa.jpg[/img]

Here's a rundown of some of the major updates in today's patch!

[list][b][*]Lotus Leaf Rice Grenade Giveaway (6/28 - 7/12)[/b]Log in each day during the event to receive a Lotus Leaf Rice Grenade.

[b][*]Find the Zombie Event(6/28- 7/12)[/b]You can participate via the Find the Zombie event button at the bottom of the Lobby screen.

[b][*]Eid al-Adha Event (6/28 - 7/12)[/b]Complete the mission during the event to earn the fantastic costumes and rewards!

[b][*]Ignite-7 Promotion (6/28 - 7/12)[/b]This Unique Weapon will make a special appearance in Unique Decoders and Unique Premium Decoders during the event.

[b][*]1,000 Mileage Auction Event (6/28 - 7/4)[/b]During the auction period, a special item sold for 1,000 Mileage will appear at certain times.[/list]

Check out the following sections for more information.

[list][*]Auction Feature / Content
[list][*]Auction Time: 1 hour for all items
[*]Number of Auction Listings: 2 (Increases based on VIP rank)
[*]Market Price of Items: When listing an item, you can check the current Auction House market price (Lowest bid and direct purchase prices).
[*]Item Display: Only items with the lowest bid or direct purchase price are displayed.
[*]Auction Settings: You can search by bid/direct purchase price, enhancement level, and weapon name.
[*]Sell-to-System Feature: When an auction is unsuccessful, you'll have the opportunity to use the sell-to-system feature.
[*]Auction Hours: 24 Hours (12: 00: 00 AM – 11: 59: 59 PM) - When auction hours end, currently listed items will be canceled.[/list][/list]

[list][*]Notice
[list][*]The remaining time is shown in 5-minute increments for listed auction items.
[*]You can only bid on 1 item at a time.
[*]Regular auction items will be listed with a 30% fee included in the initial bidding price.
[*]If an item listed for auction is not sold, the item will be returned.
[*]Items listed for auction can be purchased immediately at the direct purchase price.
[*]If you list an item for auction, you cannot withdraw it until the auction's duration has ended.
[*]The item you listed may be shown on the bid page.
[*]When listing an item, you can easily check the actual amount you will receive under the Net Reward section.

notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: June 14th
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/d7c869f932500fb300e8a847bc11ef43272975e5.jpg[/img]

Here's a rundown of some of the major updates in today's patch!

[list][b][*]Season 16: Alice in Wonderland (06/14 - 10/04)[/b]For details, please refer to the Season 16 Pass Preview.

[b][*]Welcome Back Summer Event (06/14 – 06/28)[/b]Have some fun on the hot sand with the new Beach Ball!

[b][*]Zombie Scenario Golden Zombie Kill Event (06/14 - 10/04)[/b]Earn rewards by killing Golden Zombies when you play Zombie Scenario during Season 16.

[b][*]New Transcendence Class Promotion (6/14- 7/12)[/b]Two new Transcendence Classes, Blue Rabbit Mirage and Alpaca Anemone, are now available in Class Decoders and Premium Class Decoders.[/list]

Check out the following sections for more information.

[h1]---------- Details ----------[/h1]

[u][h2]Content Guide[/h2][/u]

[h3]New Map Information[/h3]
[list][*]Breezeway
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/e54854add92ef5f4b661dd2cc9e665473c4a8147.png[/img]
[list][*]Woods Near the Wind Farm
Eligible Modes: Team Deathmatch, Team Deathmatch (AI), Deathmatch, Deathmatch (AI), Gun Deathmatch, Zombie, Zombie Classic, Zombie Mutant, Zombie Hero, Zombie Z, Zombie Evolution, Zombie Darkness, and All-Star[/list][/list]

[h3]Zombie Mode Changes[/h3]
For details, please refer to the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/273110/announcements/detail/3650777268681837080][Laboratory Revamp Preview][/url]

[list][*]Zombie Laboratory (Zombie Z / Zombie Hero)
[list][*]The projectile arc of the Fire Bomb has been adjusted.
[*]Karma System Revamp
[*]Zombie Skill Revamp[/list][/list]

[list][*]Zombie Laboratory (Zombie Z)
[list][*]Fire Bomb is now available to use starting in round 3.[/list][/list]

[h3]Season 16: Alice in Wonderland (06/14 - 10/04)[/h3]
For details, please refer to the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/273110/announcements/detail/3673294633719571177]Season 16 Pass Preview.[/url]

[list][*]Black Market Opens Early
[list][*]The Black Market will open early for players who reach Rank 100.
[*]Upon reaching Rank 100 on the current Season Pass, Season Missions will end while missions that offer Black Market Badges will refresh.
[*]New Item Added: CSO Handheld, Ancient Keeper (Parts Applied), Ancient Berserker (Parts Applied), Ancient Bringer (Parts Applied)
[*]CSO Handheld
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/6a7b23fd47ec216cf6b96678dce43d90b24ba0c0.png[/img]
[/list][/list]

[list][*]Season Pass Discount Coupon
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/063234730f3ccc17520c126a330bbf5b7f49e4ea.png[/img]
[list][*]Description: This is a coupon that reduces the purchase price of the next Season Pass. The Discount Coupon is given to those who have reached Season Pass Rank 100.
[*]Logging in during the following season will automatically redeem the coupon.
[*] (For example, if you receive the Discount Coupon during Season 16, it will reduce the price of the Season 17 Pass.)
[*]If you do not log in during the following season, however, the coupon will be automatically removed.
[*] (For example, if you received the coupon in Season 16 but didn't log in during Season 17, the discount will not be applied if you returned during Season 18.)[/list][/list]

[list][*]Repurchasing Previous Season Passes
[list][*]A page where previous season items can be purchased will become available to those who reach Rank 100 on the Season Pass!

[h3]Good-Bye Season 15 Double-Up Event (5/31 – 6/14)[/h3]
Earn double the amount of Season Badges from daily and weekly missions during the event.


[h3]Holiday Mileage Auction Event (6/1 - 6/4)[/h3]
You can access the auction via the "Mileage Auction" button on the bottom of the lobby during the event.

[list][*]Auction Feature / Content
[list][*]Item Rank: Premium (All weapons except for premium are Normal Rank)
[*]Auction Time: 1 hour for all items
[*]Number of Auction Listings: 2 (Increases based on VIP rank)
[*]Market Price of Items: When listing an item, you can check the current Auction House market price (Lowest bid and direct purchase prices).
[*]Item Display: Only items with the lowest bid or direct purchase price are displayed.
[*]Auction Settings: You can search by bid/direct purchase price, enhancement level, and weapon name.
[*]Sell-to-System Feature: When an auction is unsuccessful, you'll have the opportunity to use the sell-to-system feature.
[*]Auction Hours: 24 Hours (12: 00: 00 AM – 11: 59: 59 PM) - When auction hours end, currently listed items will be canceled.[/list][/list]

[list][*]Notice
[list][*]The remaining time is shown in 5-minute increments for listed auction items.
[*]You can only bid on 1 item at a time.
[*]Regular auction items will be listed with a 30% fee included in the initial bidding price.
[*]If an item listed for auction is not sold, the item will be returned.
[*]Items listed for auction can be purchased immediately at the direct purchase price.
[*]If you list an item for auction, you cannot withdraw it until the auction's duration has ended.
[*]The item you listed may be shown on the bid page.
[*]When listing an item, you can easily check the actual amount you will receive under the Net Reward section.
[*]Some recently released weapons cannot be listed at auction.[/list][/list]

Log in each day during the event to receive a "Nightmare Key".

[list][*]Notice
[list][*]Nightmare Keys are an 1-Day item.
[*]You can only claim the key once a day per account.[/list][/list]

Defeat Teddy Terror on the Nightmare map during the event to earn additional rewards!

[h3]Blaster Blueprint Promotion (4/19 – 5/17)[/h3]
You can purchase the Divine Blaster blueprint during the promotion.
[list][*]Notice
[list][*]The Blaster blueprint can only be purchased by those who own the Doom Blaster (Permanent) or Divine Blaster (Permanent).
[*]It can only be purchased once per account.[/list][/list]


[h3]Transcendence Weapon Promotion: Satellite Mine/Laevateinn (4/19 – 5/17)[/h3]
Satellite Mine and Laevateinn will now drop from Premium and normal Transcendence Decoders!
[list][*]Satellite Mine/Laevateinn Drop Rate
[list][*]Transcendence Premium Decoder: 3%
[*]Transcendence Decoder: 0.45%[/list][/list]
[list][*]Satellite Mine
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/e454a78f866aaa8452bc3acdbe3f8534623333e0.png[/img]
[list][*]Description: A special mine armed with cutting-edge satellite technology. It can either seek nearby enemies on its own or be manually detonated. When activated, it creates a zone that hinders enemy movement, then calls down a laser bombardment that only harms enemies after a short delay.[/list][/list]
[list][*]Laevateinn
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/d3651be67321ae24dfe290155a1477b568473cbf.png[/img]
[list][*]A pistol that holds 50 rounds of 5.7mm explosive ammo that explodes when it hits the target. When you fire beyond a certain number of rounds, a special feature becomes available.
[*]Special Feature <Electric Area>: Right-clicking after the gauge is charged 25% removes the Slow debuff on self, deals a set amount of damage to enemies approaching the area, and pushes them back.
[*]Special Feature <Paralysis Area>: Right-clicking after the gauge is charged 100% removes the Slow debuff on self, disables the attacks/skills/movement of enemies within the area, and pushes them back. A set portion of the damage dealt is restored as HP. (Attack/skill/movement disabling and AoE HP leeching features do not work in certain modes).[/list][/list]


[h3]Satellite Mine/Laevateinn Guaranteed Giveaway (4/19 – 5/17)[/h3]
Depending on the number of Premium and normal Transcendence Decoders used, you may be guaranteed to receive the Satellite Mine/Laevateinn permanently!
[list][*]Reward Thresholds
[list][*]Upon Reaching 300 Guaranteed Points[/list][/list]
[list][*]Notice
[list][*]6 Guaranteed Points each time you use 1 Transcendence Premium Decoder.
[*]1 Guaranteed Point each time you use 1 Transcendence Decoder.
[*]All unused Premium Transcendence Decoders will be replaced with 500 mileage each and removed during the maintenance on 5/17 (Wed).[/list][/list]

[u][h2]Other Changes[/h2][/u]

[olist][*]Hardware Acceleration function's default value has been set to On.
[*]The existing VVIP Free Pass and VIP Free Pass names, appearance, and descriptions have been adjusted.
[*]Class Pass, a new Diamond rank reward, has been added.
[*]Fixed an issue where an abnormal texture would display after reloading the Heaven Splitter.
[*]Fixed an issue where equipping the UTS-15 Pink Gold would misalign the hand placement in 3rd Person POV. 
[*]Fixed an issue where shooting with the M4A1 Scope would display the flame from the barrel's cover.
[*]Fixed an issue where Pyromaniac Yuri and Special Agent Mei would look awkward while holding certain weapons. 
[*]Fixed the tattoo tooltip on the Encyclopedia to now display the related image. 
[*]Fixed an issue where the Arbalest's normal attacks would not properly display the effects in certain situations. 
[*]Fixed an issue where the reward pop-up window would not display the "Bound" text for bound items.
[*]Fixed an issue where the BGM would not play on the game result screen after ending a session. 
[*]Fixed an issue where certain accounts could not get the BGM to play when they'd run the client. 
[*]Fixed an issue where the AS50 and AS50 Pink Gold's accuracy values after enhancement were incorrectly set.
[*]Fixed an issue where you were able to report yourself in the lobby.
[*]Fixed an issue where the challenge mode would not supply the basic knife.
[*]Fixed an issue where the Divine Blaster and JANUS-11's shop values were not being displayed properly. 
[*]Fixed an issue where Morale Boost values were being displayed incorrectly depending on the time you acquired the Fanatic mutation.
[*]Fixed an issue where using the right-click attack of the Dual Beretta Gunslinger as Pyromaniac Yuri would make the damage decrease depending on range. 
[*]Fixed an issue where the Whip Sword's Special Feature was getting utilized for unusual gameplay tactics. 
[*]Fixed an map spawn error issue in Zombie Scenario Pursuit: Angra Nest. 
[*]Fixed the abnormal texture on the air in Zombie Scenario Pursuit: Last Clue.
[*]Fixed the levels of certain Zombie Z grenades:
[list][*]Heart Grenade: 26 -> 29
[*]Pumpkin Grenade & Rice Cake Grenade: 1 -> 15[/list]
[*]Special Agent May has now been revised to Special Agent Mei.[/olist]

notes.title: [Event] Studio #Underwater Theme Contest
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/5f62db8ca7b2e19bebd088ca7bce31139bf45f16.jpg[/img]

Show off your creative skills in this underwater-themed Studio contest! 
Participate now to receive the 1st place prize and Steam gift card!

[b][h2]Event 1: Celebratory Studio Contest[/h2][/b]
[u][h3]Event Schedule[/h3][/u][list][*] Application Period: 4/19 – 5/19
[*] Finalists Announced: 6/15
[*] Player Vote: 6/15 - 6/28
[*] Winners Announced: 7/12
[*] Medal and Trophy Theme Packs Sent Out: 7/12[/list]

[u][h3]How to Participate[/h3][/u][list][*] Step 1: Create a Studio Creation Mode map
[*] Step 2: Register a thumbnail image and map description
[*] Step 3: Add "#underwater" to the map's title[/list]

[u][h3]Conditions[/h3][/u][list][*] 10 finalists will be selected based on creativity, number of recommendations, number of cubes earned, use of new blocks and script diversity, utilization of content, and relevance to the subject.
[*] There is no limit on how many times you can enter, and a single player can win multiple/duplicate prizes.[/list]

[u][h3]Prizes[/h3][/u][list][*] 1st (2 people): Transcendence Decoder x300 + Trophy Theme Pack + Excellent Creator Medal
[*] 2nd (2 people): Transcendence Decoder x200 + Trophy Theme Pack + Excellent Creator Medal
[*] 3rd (2 people): Transcendence Decoder x100 + Trophy Theme Pack + Excellent Creator Medal
[*] 4th - 10th: Transcendence Decoder x50 + Trophy Theme Pack + Excellent Creator Medal
[*] All participants (with +10 map play counts and +3 recommendations): 5,000 Mileage + Contest Participation Medal[/list]

[u][h3]Notice[/h3][/u][list][*] Only maps created on or after 4/19 will be able to participate.
[*] Your award may be revoked if you're not the owner of the account.
[*] You must include the #underwater tag in the map title in order to have a valid contest entry.
[*] Entries must be original creations made within the contest period. Any awards will be revoked and you may be banned from future events if your entry includes content that: violates the game's terms and conditions, is plagiarized in any way, or violates the rights of 3rd parties.
[*] Entries containing sexually suggestive or violent images exceeding the standards of the game may be deleted immediately.
[*] If there are no entries fitting the selection criteria after evaluation, there may be no winning entry, or the award may be changed.
[*] If you have already obtained the Excellent Creator Medal, another one will not be given.
[*] Using new blocks (device, character, and device block) will award extra point, but they are not necessary to win prizes.
[*] Please submit your entries only if you agree to all of the above.[/list]


[b][h2]Event 2: Celebratory Studio Contest- Steam Gift Card Giveaway![/h2][/b]
[u][h3]Studio Event schedule[/h3][/u][list][*] Application Period: 4/19 – 5/19
[*] Gift Card Winners Announcement: 6/14
[*] Personal Information Collection: 6/14 - 6/28 
[*] Gift Card Distribution: 8/9[/list]

[u][h3]Conditions[/h3][/u][list][*] Earn more than the total of 10 points within the criteria below
[list][*] Map design - Is it unique, creative and not repetitive? (1-5)
[*] Functionality - Does the map have good FPS? Does everything work? (1-5)
[*] Map gameplay - Is it fun? Is it too hard? Or perhaps too easy? (1-5)
[*] Story - Does it have cool stories or narratives? Or just shoot and win? (1-5)
[/list][/list]

[u][h3]Prize[/h3][/u][list][*] 10,000 Won Gift Card (50 people)
[list][*]Once you claim the gift card, it will automatically be converted the amount to your country's currency.[/list][/list]

[u][h3]Notice[/h3][/u][list][*] Gift cards are provided via raffle, and are only available to contest entries that have met the prerequisite requirements.
[*] You must include the #underwater hashtag in the map title in order to have a valid contest entry.
[*] If there are less than 50 entries, all participants that met the requirements will receive the gift and no additional raffles will be held.
[*] Multiple winnings are not allowed (one player cannot win with 2 or more contest entries)
[*] Studio maps that have been entered in the past are excluded from the prize raffle.
[*] Entries must be original creations made within the contest period. Any awards will be revoked and you may be banned from future events if your entry includes content that: violates the game's terms and conditions, is plagiarized in any way, or violates the rights of 3rd parties.
[*] If you fail to deliver your personal information within the announced period, you will be removed from the raffle without notification.[/list]

notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: April 5th
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/52e9146b0a48e4378d81f02377e7a4f7447f3e13.jpg[/img]

Here's a rundown of some of the major updates in today's patch!

[list][b][*]April Fool's Day Celebration Spring Event (4/5 - 4/19)[/b]New items have arrived with Spring! Participate in the new event and earn new gear!

[b][*]Easter Celebration Costume Event (4/5 - 4/19)[/b]Participate in the event and earn lots of great rewards! 

[b][*]New Transcendence Class Promotion (4/5–5/3)[/b]Two new Transcendence Classes, Special Agent May and Pyromaniac Yuri, are now available in Class Decoders and Premium Class Decoders.[/list]

Check out the following sections for more information.

[h1]---------- Details ----------[/h1]

[u][h2]New Content[/h2][/u]

[h3]Map Added (4/5 - 4/19)[/h3]
[list][*]Chindren's Estate
[list][*]The existing Estate map has undergone a Easter Day renovation.[/list][/list]
[list][*]Castle Land
[list][*]A map with an amusement park theme.[/list][/list]


[u][h2]New Event[/h2][/u]

[h3]April Fool's Day Celebration Spring Event (4/5 - 4/19)[/h3]
New items have arrived with Spring! Participate in the new event and earn new gear!
[list][*]How to Participate
[list][*]Earn 2 points each time you score 2 kills or 6 assists as a human, or infect 2 humans as a zombie in Zombie Mode (up to 40 points per day, excludes bots).
[*]Earn 5 points each time you clear 1 session by reaching 100 Kill Points in Zombie Scenario mode on Hard difficulty or higher (up to 40 points per day).
[*]Earn 1 point each time you reach 5 minutes of playtime (up to 10 points per day).
[*]Earn 2 points each time you log in (once a day).
[*]* Each account can obtain up to 50 play points per day.[/list][/list]
[list][*]Event Rewards
[list][*]50 Points: Rare Decoder x3
[*]100 Points: Zombie Scenario Add-On Rate Box x10 + 100 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x3
[*]150 Points: Unique Decoder x3 + Exploration Success Rate-Up 10% x3
[*]250 Points: Plunger (Permanent) + Zombie Damage Meter (7 Days)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/71ee752503e93b75fe06a9c339bb4b16da5a5561.png[/img]
[*]350 Points: Cute SD Character's Nameplate (300 Days) + 10,000 Mileage Coupon
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/df2e6116612891f0201343d7a521b9b199e349fa.png[/img]
[*]450 Points: Spring Breeze (Light Zombie) Spray (Permanent) + 200 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x3
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/bb3f8205153d83077dd20dd86c0704e73cc818c4.png[/img]
[*]500 Points: Ice Cream Cone (Permanent)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/43a5a046153b077f557dc96c1cb135e82fbc094a.png[/img]
[*]550 Points: Class Decoder x6 + Event Decoder x5
[*]600 Points: Transcendence Decoder x6 + Event Decoder x5
[*]650 Points: Season Badge x100
[*]700 Points: Season Badge x100[/list][/list]
[list][*]Notice
[list][*]These rewards ares given only once per Nexon account.
[*]Relevant Zombie Modes: Zombie Classic / Zombie Mutant / Zombie Hero / Zombie Z / Zombie Evolution
[*]Excludes Zombie Scenario: Survival: Double Gate / Survival: Lost City / Survival: Trap / Survival: Groundwater / Pursuit: Chaos
[*]At least 5 minutes of playtime are required to complete Zombie Scenario mode missions.
[*]Participation will only count in rooms with three or more players (excludes Studio Mode).
[*]Excludes auto hunt kills regardless of mode.
[*]All remaining play points will be removed during maintenance on 4/19.
[*]The Event Decoder can be used until midnight on the day it is obtained.[/list][/list]


[h3]Easter Celebration Costume Event (4/5 - 4/19)[/h3]
Participate in the event and earn lots of great rewards! 
[list][*]How to Participate
[list][*]Earn 1 balloon by reaching 30 / 45 / 60 minutes of Total Login Time (up to 3 balloons per day)
[*]Earn 1 balloon by reaching 10 / 25 / 40 minutes of Total Playtime (up to 3 balloons per day)
[*]Earn 2 balloons by reaching 10 / 25 / 40 minutes of Total Playtime in the Easter Estate or Castle Land (up to 6 balloons per day)
[*]Earn 1 balloon by using any decoder (up to 1 balloon per day)
[*]Earn 1 balloon during Exploration (up to 1 balloon per day)
[*]Earn 1 balloon for clicking the Claim Reward on the Login Supplies window (up to 1 balloon per day)
[*]Earn 1 balloon by performing any of the following actions (up to 1 balloon per day): Weapon Enhancement / Disassembly / Part Equipment, Combination / Painting[/list][/list]
[list][*]Event Rewards
[list][*]60 Balloons: Balloon Nameplate (300 Days)
[*]80 Balloons: Propeller Hat (Permanent)
[*]110 Balloons: Cotton Candy (Permanent)[/list][/list]
[list][*]Notice
[list][*]You can obtain up to 10 balloons per day.
[*]All balloons are removed during maintenance on the day that the event ends.
[*]All rewards can be claimed only once per account.
[*]Eligible Modes: All
[*]Cannot participate in Studio Mode
[*]Can participate in Laboratory Mode
[*]Player Requirement: 3 [/list][/list]

[u][h2]Shop Update[/h2][/u]

[h3]New Transcendence Class Promotion (4/5–5/3)[/h3]
Two new Transcendence Classes, Special Agent May and Pyromaniac Yuri, are now available in Class Decoders and Premium Class Decoders.
[list][*]Special Agent May
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/75b6df5a437352efa682fef3d0d304808bc76231.png[/img]
[list][*]Background: May is a Chinese-born special agent who works for the Intelligence Agency and is trained in high-level combat. Most recently, she had been assigned to assist a fellow agent, but has found this difficult. In a turn of events that wrecked her resume, May has been unable to track her target due to their masterful disguise. When she discovered that the troublesome pyromaniac that had been terrorizing the world was actually the agent that she had been told to support, May became extremely conflicted, but carried on. Still struggling to find the pyromaniac agent, she eventually received intel that they had met up with David's company, so now May is on the move again to finally provide support.
[*]Paired Weapon: Dual Sword Phantom Slayer
[list][*]<Feast> activation time decreased and damage increased[/list]
[*]Zombie Scenario Skill: Special Agent's Stance
[list][*]Passive: Damage dealt to the boss is increased when playing alongside Pyromaniac Yuri (Connection effect applied, cannot be stacked). Buff effect is amplified if the connection effect is active, and Pyromaniac Yuri or Special Agent May is in the same room (up to 2 players). 
[*]<Trap Evasion> Add-On effect is applied by default.
[*]Active: Uses Conceal in Zombie Scenario, which will obscure you. Your HP will slowly recover during this time, but inflicting damage on an enemy will reveal you. Once Conceal is disabled, your movement speed will return to normal and a set amount of HP will be restored immediately for you and your allies within a set range.[/list]
[*]Transcendence Class exclusive voices are applied.
[*]+10% EXP/Points
[*]In Zombie Scenario mode, this character has a higher max level than normal classes.
[*]This character adds 1 initial mutation in Zombie Z Mode.
[*]This character displays your current damage at the bottom of the screen.
[*]Marks enemies at or below 20% HP.
[*]This character leaves a unique mark at the target location upon killing an enemy.[/list][/list]
[list][*]Pyromaniac Yuri
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/f0ed63fef3b67d8e25da7d00298fec62ccdb1e06.png[/img]
[list][*]Background: A mysterious girl with an amazing talent for handling explosives, Yuri is known for working exclusively on more destructive activities. Although she successfully completes most of her missions, she once unintentionally injured Jennifer while on an assignment. Yuri is a master of disguise and can infiltrate any location to get the job done, but recently, she has been on the run from May, who has been persistently chasing her after Yuri had planned on using David Black and his company but ended up exposing her current whereabouts to May. Now, the two of them find the chase and each other’s company to be getting exhausting.
[*]Paired Weapon: Dual Beretta Gunslinger
[list][*]<Gun Kata> damage is now unaffected by distance, rather than decreasing the farther away your target is.
[*]<Gun Kata> damage has been increased[/list]
[*]Zombie Scenario Skill: Blow It Up
[list][*]Passive: Damage dealt to the boss is increased when playing alongside Special Agent May (Connection effect applied, cannot be stacked). Buff effect is amplified if the connection effect is active, and Pyromaniac Yuri or Special Agent May is in the same room (up to 2 players).  
[*]<Giant's Feet> Add-On effect is applied by default.
[*]Active: Applies explosion damage within a set range around you in Zombie Scenario (Not applicable to objects).
[*]Damage of allies within the explosion range is increased for a set duration.
[*]Explosive Ammo is loaded in your magazines, which explode at set intervals.[/list]
[*]Transcendence Class exclusive voices are applied.
[*]+10% EXP/Points
[*]In Zombie Scenario mode, this character has a higher max level than normal classes.
[*]This character adds 1 initial mutation in Zombie Z Mode.
[*]This character displays your current damage at the bottom of the screen.
[*]Marks enemies at or below 20% HP.
[*]This character leaves a unique mark at the target location upon killing an enemy.[/list][/list]


[h3]New Transcendence Class Guaranteed Giveaway (4/5–5/3)[/h3]
Get 2 guaranteed new Transcendence Classes (Special Agent May and Pyromaniac Yuri) based on the number of Class Decoders and Premium Class Decoders used during the event!
[list][*]Conditions and Rewards
[list][*]Upon reaching 150 Guaranteed Points from Decoder use.
[*]Upon reaching 300 Guaranteed Points from Decoder use.
[*]Select either: Special Agent May + Mikey Panda or Pyromaniac Yuri + Bomb Bot[/list][/list]
[list][*]Notice
[list][*]1 Guaranteed Point given each time you use 1 Class Decoder.
[*]3 Guaranteed Points given each time you use 1 Class Premium Decoder.
[*]Selecting Special Agent May will automatically provide Mikey Panda (Permanent).
[*]Selecting Pyromaniac Yuri will automatically provide Bomb Bot (Permanent).
[*]Guaranteed Giveaway rewards can be granted once per account.[/list][/list]


[h3]New Transcendence Class Medal Giveaway (4/5 – Permanent)[/h3]
When you own all items in the new Transcendence Classes set, you will receive the Transcendence Class medal.
[list][*]Conditions and Items
[list][*]Collect Special Agent May, Pyromaniac Yuri, Mikey Panda, and Bomb Bot to earn the Spy medal.[/list][/list]
[list][*]Spy
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/677c4bab6a1eddc6034900289ba42d0da6c54f41.png[/img]
[list][*]Honor Points: 10
[*]The Spy medal doesn't have an event period limit and can be obtained after the 11/30 (Wed) maintenance.
[*]This medal can be obtained once per account.[/list][/list]


[u][h2]Other Information[/h2][/u]

[olist][*]Some auto aim weapons will no longer attack the Fire Bomb.
[*]Changed the amount of Karma gained from Zombie Kill/Assist.
[*]Fixed the issue where occasionally, the client would crash or players would be moved to the wait room while playing.[/olist]

notes.title: [Notice] Regarding recent server connection issue
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/5d6cb9c473099ceeec2e1ce8083edfe9b88b1364.jpg[/img]

Dear CSNS Fans,

Currently, there is a problem in some live servers which the game cannot be properly accessed. We would like to inform you that the Devs are clearly aware of this issue and are quickly checking to resolve it as soon as possible.

We apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused and thank you for your kind patience and understanding throughout. We're working to fix the issue and plan to release a patch on April 5th. Best Regards,
The CSNS Team

notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: March 22nd
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/7cf0df5c8e92cc3deb34540c584235e84250e9c8.jpg[/img]

Here's a rundown of some of the major updates in today's patch!

[list][b][*]Spring Seed Event (3/22 - 4/5)[/b]Grow the seed that you get upon your daily first login into a fruit to get all kinds of rewards!

[b][*]Transcendence Weapon Promotion: Cousteau (3/22 - 4/19)[/b]A new weapon, Cousteau, will now drop from Premium and normal Transcendence Decoders![/list]

Check out the following sections for more information.

[h1]---------- Details ----------[/h1]

[u][h2]New Content[/h2][/u]

[h3]Zombie Mode Changes[/h3]
[list][*]Zombie Scenario Mode
[list][*]Elite Monster Probability (%) slightly decreased
[*]Elite spawns will now stop in the sections of certain maps where you cannot use your weapon.[/list][/list]
[list][*]Zombie Hero Balance Categories Added
[list][*]Added Fire Bomb skill
[*]Adjusted knockback and stun whenever a Host Zombie appears.
[*]Human Recover HP skill
[*]HP recovery is restored according to the amount of Morale Boost.[/list][/list]
[list][*]Zombie Z Mode
[list][*]Weapon Unlock Level Changes
[list][*]Weapon/Change Level
[*]Pierrot Magic Bow: 22 -> 25
[*]FG Launcher: 10 -> 15
[*]Laser Storm: 20 -> 18
[*]Avalanche TECH: 8 -> 7
[*]Crowbar Maverick TECH: 8 -> 5
[*]Dart Pistol TECH: 3 -> 1[/list]
[*]EXP earned by zombies for infecting humans has been decreased.
[*]The way that Intellectual mutation acquires EXP has been changed. The in-game description has been updated to be more accurate.[/list][/list]
[list][*]Studio Mode Improvements
[list][*]HP value of the Monster Spawner Device has been increased ( HP is now identical to regular monsters)[/list][/list]


[h3]Convenience Updates[/h3]
[list][*]BGM Playlist
[list][*]Added a feature where you can preview and change the Lobby BGM in a playlist.
[*]This feature can be found in the [Options] - [Audio] - [Playlist] menu.[/list][/list]
[list][*]Grouped Missions and Search Feature
[list][*]Similar missions will now be displayed in groups.
[*]A new search feature has been added that can be found on the left side of [Go to Mission Chain] in the [Missions] page.
[*]The search feature will only display results that include the keywords found on mission or event titles and content.[/list][/list]
[list][*]Inventory Specific
[list][*]You can now choose multiple selectable rewards and review what you already own.[/list][/list]


[u][h2]Event Information[/h2][/u]

[h3]Spring Seed Event (3/22 - 4/5)[/h3]
Grow the seed that you get upon your daily first login into a fruit to get all kinds of rewards!
[list][*]Item Conditions and Rewards
[list][*]Seed: First Login / Rare Decoder X5
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/dc72c557cef64a25bea00d4f43c3a0127baf8801.png[/img]
[*]Sprout: Reach 20 minutes of playtime after getting a seed. / Event Decoder
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/1663ff2da149abb3c3940cc771fb37b4255a2604.png[/img]
[*]Fruit: Reach 20 minutes of play time in one of the missions below:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/ead9b4aee85513d4a6cdb1b67118a3d2ec9449d5.png[/img]
[olist]
[*] Score 10 Zombie Kills as a human, or 10 Human Infections as a zombie (bots excluded in both)
[*] Score 100 kills and clear 1 session in Hard or higher difficulty in the Zombie Scenario mode.
[*] Achieve 4 or more rounds where the Fire Bomb was used in Zombie Hero mode / Get Harvested Fruit + one of the following items based on their chance: Dragon Knight Kyrix (15 Days/Permanent), High Elf Natasha (15 Days/Permanent), Anemone (15 Days/Permanent), Mirage (15 Days/Permanent), Event Decoder (x2, x5, x10 and x20), Unique Decoder (x3), 100 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon (x3), 3,000 Mileage Coupon, 2,000 Mileage Coupon, Grade 5 Parts Reward Box, Rare Decoder (x3 and x5), Zombie Damage Meter (7 Days).
[/olist]
[*]Harvested Fruit
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/d5271bf96b2f1e7b3d6db6cfcac4ce6bf83edb2d.png[/img]
[list][*]3 Total: Unique Decoder x2 + Event Decoder x2
[*]5 Total: Transcendence Decoder + Class Decoder
[*]7 Total: Transcendence Decoder + Class Decoder x2
[*]9 Total: Transcendence Decoder x2 + Class Decoder x3
[*]12 Total: Transcendence Decoder x3 + Class Decoder x4
[*]14 Total: Season Badge x400[/list][/list][/list]
[list][*]Notice
[list][*]The Seed, Sprout, and Fruit items can all be used by pressing the Use button.
[*]The Seed and Sprout items can't grow into their next stages upon use.
[*]The Seed, Sprout, and Fruit items are all automatically removed every day at 11:59 PM, and the event resets.
[*]All Harvested Fruit items are removed during the maintenance on 4/5
[*]Cumulative Harvested Fruit rewards are given once per account.
[*]Participation will only count in rooms with three or more players (includes normal Laboratory mode play, excludes Studio Mode).
[*]For Zombie Scenario Mode, participation will only count when you play at least 10 minutes.
[*]Relevant Zombie Modes: Zombie Original / Zombie Mutant / Zombie Hero / Zombie Z / Zombie Evolution
[*]Excludes Zombie Scenario: Survival: Double Gate / Lost City / Survival: Trap / Survival: Groundwater / Pursuit: Chaos
[*]The Event Decoder can be used until before midnight on the day it is obtained.
[*]Transcendence Classes will be provided without the exclusive costume.[/list][/list]


[h3]Login Supplies Event Guide (3/22 – 4/18)[/h3]
[list][*]Login Reward
[list][*]Daily Weapons Supply
[*]Dual Sword Phantom Slayer (1 Day) & M3 Black Dragon (1 Day) 2 types all provided + 2 types out of Rare, Unique, or Transcendence provided according to probabilities + 1 Transcendence Class (1 Day) provided according to probabilities + all contents of Daily Attendance Reward Box provided
[*]Transcendence Classes (1 Day): Dorothy Dark Knight, Flora Paladin, Transcendence Ji Yoon Choi, Transcendence Yuri, Sonya Lycanthrope, Elizabeth Crimson Hunter, Transcendence Michaela, Transcendence Fernando, Transcendence Blair, and Rose Phoenix
[*]Daily Attendance Reward Box: Damage Display (1 Day), Killer Display (1 Day), Penalty and Loss Invalidation x1, Rare Decoder x3
[*]All weapons and classes from the Daily Supply are bound and cannot be used for Auction/Disassembly/Family Storage (Extension X).[/list][/list]
[list][*]Cumulative Rewards
[list][*]5 Days: X-TRACKER (20 Days) + Cumulative Attendance Reward Box
[*]10 Days: Negev NG7 Ajax (20 Days) + Cumulative Attendance Reward Box
[*]15 Days: Spell Lance Scarlet Rose (20 Days) + Cumulative Attendance Reward Box
[*]20 Days: Lightning Fury (20 Days) + Cumulative Attendance Reward Box
[*]25 Days: Dread Nova (10 Days) + Cumulative Attendance Reward Box
[*]Cumulative Attendance Reward Box contents: C4 Countdown Room Host (5 Days), Shorten Respawn Time (5 Days) Lucky Gunslinger (5 Days), Daily Mission Difficulty Change x15, Exploration Slot Expansion Coupon (7 Days)[/list][/list]
[list][*]Notice
[list][*]Attendance rewards will be provided directly as rewards instead of the Daily/Cumulative Attendance Reward Box items.
[*]Rewards can be claimed immediately after logging in and are available until midnight every day.[/list][/list]

[u][h2]Shop Update[/h2][/u]
[h3]Transcendence Weapon Promotion: Cousteau (3/22 - 4/19)[/h3]
A new weapon, Cousteau, will now drop from Premium and normal Transcendence Decoders!
[list][*]Cousteau Drop Rate
[list][*]Transcendence Premium Decoder: 3%
[*]Transcendence Decoder: 0.45%[/list][/list]
[list][*]Cousteau (Throwable Weapon)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/f1c4bf306bb1938fe376b87a4b76d017a9ed23be.png[/img]
[list][*]Description: A futuristic sentry gun that lands in a stealth state once thrown, and automatically attacks any enemies it detects with its sensors.
[*]Switch Attack Mode: <Right-click>
[*]Attack Mode: 
[list][*]<Exploshow> Self-destructs after detecting the enemy, inflicting explosion damage as well as damage over time.
[*] <Lente> Slows the targeted enemy and attacks them for a set amount of time before self-destructing.[/list][/list][/list]


[h3]Cousteau Guaranteed Giveaway (3/22 - 4/19)[/h3]
Depending on the number of Premium and normal Transcendence Decoders used, you may be guaranteed to receive the Cousteau permanently!
[list][*]Reward Thresholds
[list][*]Upon Reaching 300 Guaranteed Points[/list][/list]
[list][*]Notice
[list][*]6 Guaranteed Points each time you use 1 Transcendence Premium Decoder.
[*]1 Guaranteed Point each time you use 1 Transcendence Decoder.[/list][/list]


[h2][u]Misc[/u][/h2]
[olist][*]Fixed an issue where firing the mp5 with hardware acceleration turned on would add incorrect effects to the gun.
[*]Fixed an issue where, in certain situations, the loading screen for Zombie Scenario 8-3 Pursuit: Abandoned Hound's map would only display the first image.
[*]Fixed an issue where using the Transcendence Class buff skill while traveling to the next map in Zombie Scenario would not reset the skill.
[*]Fixed an issue where certain weapon's attacks would not damage the Fire Bomb. 
[*]Fixed an issue where the Fire Bomb would pass through certain objects.
[*]Fixed an issue where Quantum Horizon's Quantum Dive effect would display when activating Arbalest's Cosmic Armor.
[*]Fixed an issue where some classes would display an incorrect animation when switching to the Explosion Damage attack while attacking with Twin Hawk's Electric Field.
[*]Fixed an issue where switching from Special Attack to Normal Attack while using Laser Storm would only display the corresponding animation but not inflict the damage. 
[*]Fixed an issue where the Host alarm would appear in Zombie Classic mode.
[*]Fixed an issue where the client would crash after playing a certain studio map. 
[*]Removed the Supply Box and Parts from Tutorial mode.
[*]Fixed an issue where entering a new mode would inaccurately display room options from the previous mode. 
[*]Fixed an issue where system messages would disappear abnormally fast in Tutorial and Zombie Darkness modes.
[*]Fixed an issue where weapon paint would not be applied after applying the Cyborg Weapon Paint to the Dual Beretta Gunslinger and using its Special Feature.
[*]Fixed an issue during Exploration that would inaccurately sort low level players.
[*]Fixed an issue where hacks allowed abnormally high jumps.
[*]Changed the server region for Australia and New Zealand users.
[/olist]
