notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: March 8th
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/94358d72596306e4f63cc09e24d5d68568c1b6e3.jpg[/img]

Here's a rundown of some of the major updates in today's patch!

[list][b][*]New Semester Play Event (3/8 - 3/22)[/b]Earn rewards by reaching the playtime and play point goals during the event.

[b][*]Mileage Auction Event (3/8 - 3/14)[/b]Log in now to get the items you need!

[b][*]Transcendence Classes Kai/Lynn Promotion (3/8 - 4/5)[/b]Kai and Lynn will make a special appearance in Class Decoders and Premium Class Decoders during the event.

[b][*]Electron-V Promotion (3/8 - 3/22)[/b]This Unique Weapon will make a special appearance in Unique Decoders and Unique Premium Decoders during the event.[/list]

Check out the following sections for more information.

[h1]---------- Details ----------[/h1]

[u][h2]New Content[/h2][/u]

[h3]New Semester Play Event (3/8 - 3/22)[/h3]
Earn rewards by reaching the playtime and play point goals during the event.

[list][*]Daily Rewards and Conditions
[list][*]Reach 30 mins of playtime to earn Event Decoder + 1 Point
[*]Reach 60 mins of playtime to earn Event Decoder + 1 Point
[*]Get 10 Human Player Kills or 15 Zombie Player Kills (Excluding Bots) to earn 1 Point
[*]Clear 1 session of Zombie Scenario in Hard or higher after scoring 100 kills to earn 1 Point[/list]

[*]Cumulative Rewards and Conditions
[list][*]Score 9 Total Points to earn Unique Decoder x2 + Event Decoder x2
[*]Score 18 Total Points to earn Unique Decoder x3 + Transcendence Decoder x1 + Class Decoder x2
[*]Score 27 Total Points to earn Unique Decoder x5 + Transcendence Decoder x2 + Class Decoder x3
[*]Score 36 Total Points to earn 10,000 Mileage Coupon x2 + Transcendence Decoder x4 + Unique Decoder x5
[*]Score 42 Total Points to earn Season Badge x400[/list]

[*]Notice
[list][*]Cumulative rewards are given only once per account.
[*]You can obtain up to 3 play points a day per account.
[*]Relevant Zombie Modes: Zombie Classic / Zombie Mutant / Zombie Hero / Zombie Z / Zombie Evolution
[*]Excludes Zombie Scenario: Survival: Double Gate / Survival: Lost City / Survival: Trap / Survival: Groundwater / Pursuit: Chaos
[*]At least 5 minutes of playtime are required to complete Zombie Scenario mode missions.
[*]Participation will only count in rooms with three or more players (excludes Studio Mode).
[*]Excludes auto hunt kills regardless of mode.
[*]All remaining play points will be removed during maintenance on 3/22.[/list][/list]


[h3]Mileage Auction Event (3/8 - 3/14)[/h3]
Log in now to get the items you need!

[list][*]Auction Feature / Content
[list][*]Item Rank: Premium (All weapons except for premium are Normal Rank)
[*]Auction Time: 1 hour for all items
[*]Number of Auction Listings: 2 (Increases based on VIP rank)
[*]Market Price of Items: When listing an item, you can check the current Auction House market price (Lowest bid and direct purchase prices).
[*]Item Display: Only items with the lowest bid or direct purchase price are displayed.
[*]Auction Settings: You can search by bid/direct purchase price, enhancement level, and weapon name.
[*]Sell-to-System Feature: When an auction is unsuccessful, you'll have the opportunity to use the sell-to-system feature.
[*]Auction Hours: 24 Hours (12: 00: 00 AM – 11: 59: 59 PM) - When auction hours end, currently listed items will be canceled.[/list]

[*]Notice
[list][*]The remaining time is shown in 5-minute increments for listed auction items.
[*]You can only bid on 1 item at a time.
[*]Regular auction items will be listed with a 30% fee included in the initial bidding price.
[*]If an item listed for auction is not sold, the item will be returned.
[*]Items listed for auction can be purchased immediately at the direct purchase price.
[*]If you list an item for auction, you cannot withdraw it until the auction's duration has ended.
[*]The item you listed may be shown on the bid page.
[*]When listing an item, you can easily check the actual amount you will receive under the Net Reward section.
[*]Some recently released weapons cannot be listed at auction.[/list][/list]


[u][h2]Shop Update[/h2][/u]

[h3]Transcendence Classes Kai/Lynn Promotion (3/8 - 4/5)[/h3]
Kai and Lynn will make a special appearance in Class Decoders and Premium Class Decoders during the event.

[list][*]Kai
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/3a29f01b3b794ff76f8fe793a9b35ec80be9482c.png[/img]
[list][*]Description: After losing his parents in a sudden accident, a young child named William was taken into an orphanage with the help of Victor. There, he met Lynn, and together forged a sibling-like bond. After leaving the orphanage, William joined the Special Forces with Lynn and began assisting Victor, until he learned that his parents had died thanks to Victor's quarantine order to help reduce the spread of the virus. After learning the truth, William changed his name to Kai and swore a vow to make everyone who was involved with the death of his parents meet a painful end.
[*]Paired Weapon: Whip Sword
[*]Paired Effect: Decreases attack count required to use the Fall continuous attack for the Whip Sword by one.
[*]Exclusive Skill: Time for Revenge
[list][*]Passive: Increases damage dealt to Elite and Boss monsters.
Applies the Swiftfoot Add-On Effect (Can be stacked to increase the effect)
Increases damage when playing a Scenario with a Lynn character (Connection effect applied).
[*]Active: Generates a Smokescreen Grenade that neutralizes enemy attacks and briefly grants the Conceal effect (Conceal is removed upon taking damage).
Increased Critical Strike chance and Melee Weapon damage for a short time upon losing Conceal status.[/list][/list]

[*]Lynn
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/d047fb3f65545f8586737cb4b5eb429d652b9001.png[/img]
[list][*]Description: Lynn grew up in an orphanage after being rescued by Victor, who found her during a mission. She met William at the orphanage and followed him around like he was her older brother, and would later join Victor's Special Forces with him. One day, William left the unit without notice, and Lynn would later discover the shocking truth that he had become the terrorist known as Kai. Despite the devastating news, Lynn started to chase after Kai, hoping to turn him back to the right side.
[*]Paired Weapon: Whip Sword
[*]Paired Effect: Decreases attack count required to use the Decay continuous attack for the Whip Sword by one.
[*]Exclusive Skill: Silent Takedown
[list][*]Passive: Increases damage dealt to Elite and Boss monsters.
Applies the Revenge Add-On Effect (Can be stacked to increase the effect).
Increases damage when playing a Scenario with a Kai character (Connection effect applied).
[*]Active: Generates a Smokescreen Grenade that neutralizes enemy attacks and briefly grants the Conceal effect (Conceal is removed upon taking damage).
Increased attack evasion rate and Melee Weapon damage for a short time upon losing Conceal status.[/list][/list][/list]


[h3]Transcendence Classes Kai/Lynn Guaranteed Giveaway (3/8 - 4/5)[/h3]
Get 2 guaranteed new Transcendence Classes (Kai, Lynn) based on how many Class Decoders and Premium Class Decoders are used during the event!

[list][*]Conditions and Rewards
[list][*]Upon reaching 150 Guaranteed Points from Decoder use.
[*]Upon reaching 300 Guaranteed Points from Decoder use.
[*]Select one: Kai + Tactical Goggles OR Lynn + Dragon Mask
[list][*]Tactical Goggles
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/93ab5b2dbccd8393a4f2855a28c05f203ec866f0.png[/img]
[*]Dragon Mask
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/e53816e90ca46b8c088626fe6cfb4ce8b27a0be5.png[/img][/list][/list]
[*]Notice
[list][*]1 Guaranteed Point given each time you use 1 Class Decoder.
[*]3 Guaranteed Points given each time you use 1 Class Premium Decoder.
[*]Upon selecting Kai, automatically get the permanent exclusive costume, Tactical Goggles.
[*]Upon selecting Lynn, automatically get the permanent exclusive costume, Dragon Mask.
[*]Guaranteed Giveaway rewards can only be received once per account.[/list][/list]


[h3]Electron-V Promotion (3/8 - 3/22)[/h3]
This Unique Weapon will make a special appearance in Unique Decoders and Unique Premium Decoders during the event.

[list][*]Electron-V

notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: February 22nd
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/9cb9c6a513658c3d72490b51f880bd30e98c7c57.jpg[/img]

Here's a rundown of some of the major updates in today's patch!

[list]
[b][*]Content: New Zombie Scenario 8-3 Map Released[/b]Experience Ritsuka's story in the new Zombie Scenario!

[b][*] Content: Season 15: Cyborgs[/b]The theme for Season 15 is [Cyborgs], the future of humanity!

[b][*] Spring Fling Event (2/22 - 3/8)[/b]Participate in missions every day during the event to earn points!

[b][*] Transcendence Weapon "Whip Sword" Promotion (2/22 - 3/22)[/b]The Whip Sword can drop from the Transcendence Premium Decoder and Transcendence Decoder during the event.[/list]

Check out the following sections for more information.

[h1]---------- Details ----------[/h1]

[u][h2]New Content[/h2][/u]

[h3]Zombie New Scenario 8-3 Map[/h3]
[list][*]Pursuit: Abandoned Hound
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/740bcab1c1c5aa04ea1131fa1c7fe4ab0d4ab62d.png[/img]
[list][*]This is the tale of Ritsuka's return to the Asia Red Army's hideout.

[*]Ritsuka received the request from Douglas Jacob to stop David Black and Erica. She ambushed them, but the mission was a failure, forcing her to retreat to the Asia Red Army's hideout.
However, the Asia Red Army's hideout is in ruins, as if a full-blown war had happened.
Ritsuka investigated the area to assess what had happened there.
Uncontrollable zombies swarmed out of the hideout, with no trace of the Asia Red Army allies anywhere. Ritsuka found herself enraged as she approached the truth.

[*]You can find detailed information in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/273110/announcements/detail/3641759926135697835][Zombie Scenario 8-3 Preview][/url].[/list][/list]

[h3]Season 15: Cyborg [/h3]
For details, please refer to the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/273110/announcements/detail/3641759926135716419]Season 15 Pass Preview.[/url]

[list][*]Black Market Opens Early
[list][*]The Black Market will open early for players who reach Rank 100.
[*]Upon reaching Rank 100 on the current Season Pass, Season Missions will end while missions that offer Black Market Badges will refresh.
[*]New Item Added: CSO Pendant
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/b73f3091327385d2691e2e9c956029a9ecc91d9a.png[/img]
[/list]

[*]Repurchasing Past Season Passes
[list][*]A page where past season items can be purchased will become available to those who reach Rank 100 on the Season Pass!
[*]The page begins with the player's progress from the past season, and they can purchase Season Pass Ranks from the page to obtain items.
[*]Available Previous Season Passes: Seasons 9, 10, 11, 12, 13
[*]The Black Market can be accessed via the [Missions] menu after reaching Rank 100.
[*]All Black Market Badges you've obtained will disappear once a new season begins.[/list]

[*]Season Reward Weapons
[list][*]Dart Pistol TECH (Secondary Weapon)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/e4515819015f3fa727d27625ecbdb65aa5a8aa7d.png[/img]
[list][*]A pistol designed to fire 7 special darts. It may seem like a regular toy gun, but it has a hidden feature which will shock opponents, causing targets to suffer damage over time after being hit.[/list]

[*]Crowbar Maverick TECH (Melee Weapon)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/bcc96d1b2792ca8fb37f8dec448412a036fed332.png[/img]
[list][*]A crowbar, which is used to remove or dismantle nails and was redesigned by an unknown terrorist group. It is equipped with a taser that causes a stiffening effect, transforming it into a powerful melee weapon.[/list]

[*]Avalanche TECH (Primary Weapon)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/fddbfbda3dafdddd08c5d3750faf12d359707aba.png[/img]
[list][*]This machine gun, which fires 200 rounds of 7.62mm ammo, features a rapid-fire mode that can be used to mow down the enemy. It's created from unknown technology.[/list]

[*]Laser Storm (Primary Weapon)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/1a662b4e3996b0620398b484d084d35b8351c277.png[/img]
[list][*]A sub-machine gun that fires 45 rounds of 45.ACP ammo. It has very low recoil and a high rate of fire. It's made of an extremely light material through unknown means, which makes it highly portable. Normal attacks charge special rounds, which can be used for a special attack by right-clicking.[/list][/list]

[*]Zombie Costumes
[list][*]Cyborg Normal Zombie
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/ebf0ec03335ea5b55a75cfe2bc8fa044c42fa466.png[/img]
[*]Allows the use of Cyborg Zombie. This will change the appearance of your Cyborg Zombie.[/list]

[*]Weapon Paints
[list][*]Cyborg Weapon Paint
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/196f4e8aa7bc9678bfe7f926381f012537c73e7b.png[/img]
[*]Eligible Weapons: Dual Beretta Gunslinger, XM1014 Automatic Shotgun, Plasma Gun, Leviathan, TURBULENT-9[/list]

[*]Costumes
[list][*]Portable Nuclear Reactor (Back)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/c2f5de73eb65a84c8510f1c72577018eba29c876.png[/img]
[*]Holo-viewer (Waist)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/2a7144dde2c589e4bb24c8939da6e7e0aac97a1a.png[/img]
[*]Cyborg Mask (Head)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/d151a7b680c9bc6931c0d3053a5cda7286875d11.png[/img]
[/list]

[*]Spray
[list][*]SD Nyx Spray
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/802f5df488e9466cff1724125558b13f4307aa90.png[/img]
[*]SD Skadi Spray
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/2b5ea3c9366f32328c09545108ec072fd65b0c21.png[/img]
[*]Cyborg Awakening Spray
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/9116a0ff32650171de2ca1abe6ff4fa6c3657a8c.png[/img]
[/list]

[*]Nameplate
[list][*]Season Pass Nameplate (15)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/65602640ca36a730aff7734a28fa2381eb0e42bf.png[/img]
[/list]

[*]Damage Font
[list][*]Season Pass Font (15)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/8ae9833ee598bcbba166d3495e73b16550eeb0dc.png[/img]
[/list]

[*]Medal
[list][*]Season 15 Pioneer Medal (Pass)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/6ef7e9c3d94f7126744dfea1b70b2a25d1881f13.png[/img]
[*]Season 15 Conqueror Medal (Highest Rank Reached)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/257ef72127421aa1e84b0f0008e93ec8f32b7004.png[/img]
[/list][/list]


[h3]League Season 11 (2/22 - 5/31)[/h3]

[list][*]Notice
[list][*]Items have been added to the Achievement Shop.
[*]New Items Added: Clamp Nameplate, Green Curve Nameplate, Droplet Nameplate, and (Animated) Aurora Nameplate[/list][/list]


[h3]Zombie Mode Changes[/h3]

[list][*]Zombie Scenario Mode
[list][*]Abnormal events on some maps have been disabled
[*]Revised stressful elements by lowering the structure HP and decreasing device operation times on some maps
[*]Increased elite monster balance slightly based on difficulty
[*]Increased the appearance chance of elite monsters slightly, and made it no longer dependent on monster deaths[/list][/list]


[u][h2]New Events[/h2][/u]

[h3]Spring Fling Event (2/22 - 3/8)[/h3]
Participate in the missions every day during the event to earn points!

[list][*]Participation & Rewards
[list][*]Earn 1 point every time you reach 20 minutes of playtime (up to 3 points a day)
[*]Earn 1 point for each time you clear 1 session by reaching 100 Kill Points in Zombie Scenario mode on Hard difficulty or higher (up to 7 points a day).
[*]Earn 3 points for clearing 1 session in New Zombie Scenario Mode Pursuit: Abandoned Hound by reaching 100 Kill Points on Hard difficulty or higher (once a day).
[*]Earn 1 point by scoring a total of 8 Kill Points in Zombie Mode with Kill or Assist as a human, or Human Infection as a zombie, excluding all bots (up to 7 points a day).[/list][/list]

[list][*]Notice
[list][*]Each reward is given only once per account.
[*]Relevant Zombie Modes: Zombie Classic / Zombie Mutant / Zombie Hero / Zombie Z / Zombie Evolution
[*]Excludes Zombie Scenario: Double Gate / Lost City / Survival: Trap / Survival: Groundwater / Pursuit: Chaos
[*]At least 5 minutes of playtime are required to complete Zombie Scenario mode missions.
[*]Participation will only count in rooms with three or more players (excludes Studio Mode).
[*]Excludes auto hunt kills regardless of mode.
[*]All remaining play points will be removed during maintenance on 3/8.[/list][/list]


[h3]Season Badge Giveaway Event (2/22 - 6/14)[/h3]
Season badges are given immediately based on the login time for daily missions during Season 15.

[list][*]Login Time / Season Badge
[list][*]5 season badges for 30 minutes of login time
[*]10 season badges for 60 minutes of login time
[*]20 season badges for 120 minutes of login time[/list][/list]

[list][*]Notice
[list][*]Daily missions reset every day at midnight.
[*]You cannot use a difficulty change item on [Event] missions.[/list][/list]


[h3]Zombie Scenario Golden Zombie Kill Event (2/22 - 6/14)[/h3]
Earn rewards by killing Golden Zombies when you play Zombie Scenario during Season 15.

[list][*]Total Count - Obtainable Items 
[list][*]You can select 1 from the list by accumulating 1 / 2 / 3 / 5 / 7 / 10 Golden Zombie kills: Zombie Scenario Add-On Selection Box x2 / Transcendence Weapon Selection Box / Guaranteed Transcendence Class Box / 100 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x4 / Random -1 Dehancement Material x5 / 2,000 Mileage[/list][/list]

[list][*]Transcendence Weapon Selection Box Contents (Permanent/Bound)
[list][*]M4A1 Dark Knight
[*]AK-47 Paladin
[*]Warhammer Storm Giant
[*]Magnum Drill
[*]Desert Eagle Crimson Hunter
[*]SG552 Lycanthrope
[*]Blade Runebreaker
[*]Red Dragon Cannon
[*]Python Desperado[/list][/list]

[list][*]Guaranteed Transcendence Class Box Contents (Permanent/Bound)

[*]Transcendence Blair
[*]Transcendence Michaela
[*]Transcendence Yuri
[*]Transcendence Ji Yoon Choi
[*]Elizabeth Crimson Hunter
[*]Dorothy Dark Knight
[*]Flora Paladin

[list][*]Notice
[list][*]Zombie Scenario Add-On Selection Box Contents: 20 of Reinforced Attack, Extended Magazine, Tide Turner, Shadow Blade, Survival Instincts, Explosive Ammo, Free Market, Weakness Analysis, Titan's Will, Regeneration, Swiftfoot, and Capital Add-Ons.
[*]Hitting the Golden Zombie once counts as killing it once.
[*]Each reward is given only once per account.
[*]Up to 3 can be defeated per day.
[*]Transcendence Weapon Selection Box and Guaranteed Transcendence Class Box's reward items are bound items.

[h3]Zombie Scenario Golden Zombie Kill Medal Event[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/b37ade474d829cbb9c3afe129adf44810717b396.png[/img]
Earn a medal for scoring 100 Golden Zombie Kills.


[h3]Login Supplies Event Guide (2/22 – 3/21)[/h3]

[list][*]Login Reward
[list][*]Daily Weapons Supply
[*]Both Dual Sword Phantom Slayer (1 Day) and M3 Black Dragon (1 Day) provided + one of the Transcendence Enhancement or Part equipped Unique weapon (1 Day) randomly provided + all contents of Daily Attendance Reward Box provided

[list][*]Notice
[list][*]Attendance rewards will be provided directly as rewards instead of the Daily/Cumulative Attendance Reward Box items.
[*]Rewards can be claimed immediately after logging in and are available until midnight every day.[/list][/list]


[u][h2]Shop Update[/h2][/u]

[h3]Transcendence Weapon "Whip Sword" Promotion (2/22 - 3/22)[/h3]
The Whip Sword can drop from the Transcendence Premium Decoder and Transcendence Decoder during the event.

[list][*]Whip Sword Drop Rate
[list][*]Transcendence Premium Decoder: 3%
[*]Transcendence Decoder: 0.45%[/list][/list]

[list][*]Whip Sword
[list][*]A sword made of smaller sword parts linked together in the form of a whip, increasing the weapon's attack speed and range. It has numerous attack combos that connect one attack to another, making it a very versatile weapon for the battlefield.[/list][/list]

[list][*]Notice
[list][*]All unused Transcendence Premium Decoders will be removed during maintenance on 3/22 (Wed).
[*]500 mileage will be awarded in return for each Transcendence Premium Decoder removed in this manner.
[*]Transcendence Decoder is always available for sale.
[*]Transcendence Premium Decoder is available for sale until maintenance on 3/22 (Wed).
[*]Check for details in Decoder Rates on the web page after 2/22 (Wed) maintenance.[/list][/list]


[h3]Transcendence Weapon Whip Sword Guaranteed Giveaway (2/22 - 3/22)[/h3]
Depending on the number of Transcendence Premium Decoders and Transcendence Decoders used during the event, you could receive a Whip Sword! (Permanent)!

[list][*]Conditions and Items

[list][*]Notice
[list][*]6 Guaranteed Points are earned each time you use 1 Transcendence Premium Decoder.
[*]1 Guaranteed Point each time you use 1 Class Decoder.[/list][/list]

[/olist]

notes.title: [Notice] Happy New Year Letter from CSN:S Dev Team
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/ba14dcd64480829f34429b37d128de6f19ad2abb.jpg[/img]

[b]Hello, everyone. This is the Steam Dev team for Counter-Strike Nexon: Studio.[/b]

We'd like to greet our players as we welcome the 2023 new year.
A lot of things happened this year.

We were able to welcome the new year with our players as we're doing now, through the consistent support and constructive criticism loaded with the player's love for the game.
We showcased the new mode, Zombie Conquest, as a beta version in its development stage back in June, to gather your suggestions and opinions.

It was a very important time where we made note of all player reviews and suggestions,
but we are quite disappointed that we weren't able to provide a satisfactory experience because the Zombie Conquest beta version had many elements that were inadequate.

For team-based content like Zombie Conquest to be serviced with more stability,
we will use the many suggestions that you've sent us.

In addition to the improvements and updates that we made in December, we will continue to release more updates and improvements, so we ask for your continued support.
Also, more updates and improvements are scheduled for the popular mode among players, the Zombie Scenario, so please look forward that it as well.

Lastly, we'd like to thank you once again for your support over the year of 2022.
We'll be a development team that strives to match your support and expectations in the new year of 2023, and we wish you a happy new year!

notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: January 11th
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/d59ac2256ed872d10188045161d03cbb01aa82ff.jpg[/img]

Here's a rundown of some of the major updates in today's patch!

[list]
[b][*] Random Rules Zombie Hero Event (1/11 – 1/18)[/b]Enjoy Zombie Hero in a whole new and random way!

[b][*] Twin Hawk Event (1/11 – 2/8)[/b]Set your eyes on getting the Twin Hawk from this event! 

[b][*] Transcendence Class Promotion Event[/b]Roy and Romy are now available in Class Decoders and Premium Class Decoders![/list]

Check out the following sections for more information.

[h1]---------- Details ----------[/h1]


[u][h2]System[/h2][/u]

[h3]Random Rules Zombie Hero Event (1/11 – 1/18)[/h3]
Enjoy Zombie Hero in a whole new and random way! The rules change each round, so keep on your toes!
[list][*]Random Rules Zombie Hero Maps: Assault / Italy / Vertigo[/list]
[list][*]Notice
[list][*]Stay alert! The rules are announced 3 seconds before the start of each round.
[*]Keep track of the current rules by pressing the "L" key.[/list][/list]


[h3]Mission Chain Guide Update Information (1/11 – 07/12)[/h3]
The Mission Chain consists of 25 guides and 25 missions split into 5 stages.
You can only clear one stage (5 guides and 5 missions) of the Mission Chain a day.
[list][*]Completion Rewards (Stage and final rewards are separate from interim rewards from checking out the guides and the individual mission rewards):
[list][*]Stage 1: Hunter-Killer X-90 (Permanent)
[*]Stage 2: Dual Sword Infernal Hunter (Permanent)
[*]Stage 3: Transcendence Yuri (Permanent)
[*]Stage 4: Claymore Mine MDS (Permanent)
[*]Stage 5: Python Desperado (Permanent)
[*]Final Completion Rewards: Hunter-Killer X-12 (Permanent) + Complete the Guide Medal + CSer Settlement Support Box[/list][/list]
[list][*]Changes:
[list][*]1. Updated guides
[*]2. New guide for the added bound system plus relevant images
[*]3. Image and text revised in accordance with the VIP tab placement change
[*]4. Final Completion Reward CSNS Settling Support Weapon Box components changed
[*]- Part Weapon Selection Box -> replaced with Guided Parts Weapon Box[/list][/list]
[list][*]Guided Parts Weapon Box contents (All (Permanent) - Bound):
[list][*]Thunderbolt / Dual Infinity Final / Attack M950 / Hunter-Killer X-7 / Hunter-Killer X-90 / Hunter-Killer X-45 / Hunter-Killer X-15 / Broad Divine / Vendetta / SKULL-9 / Brick Piece S1451 / BALROG-IX / THANATOS-9 / Flame Jackhammer / BALROG-VII[/list][/list]

[u][h2]Events[/h2][/u]

[h3]Twin Hawk Daily Login Event (1/11 – 2/8)[/h3]
Collect Twin Hawk Pieces every day during the event. Earn more rewards per stage the more days you log in!
[list][*]Total Login Days / Rewards
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/1201505a459997ef4452c050c36421d314366b36.png[/img]
[list][*]1 Day: Twin Hawk Piece x1 + Point Transcendence Decoder x1 + Point Class Decoder x1 + 500 Mileage Coupon x1
[*]2 Day: Twin Hawk Piece x1 + Point Transcendence Decoder x1 + Point Class Decoder x1 + 500 Mileage Coupon x1
[*]3 Days: Twin Hawk Piece x2 + Point Transcendence Decoder x2 + Point Class Decoder x2 + 500 Mileage Coupon x2
[*]4 Days: Twin Hawk Piece x2 + Point Transcendence Decoder x2 + Point Class Decoder x2 + 500 Mileage Coupon x2
[*]5 Days: Twin Hawk Piece x3 + Point Transcendence Decoder x3 + Point Class Decoder x3 + 500 Mileage Coupon x3
[*]6 Days: Twin Hawk Piece x3 + Point Transcendence Decoder x3 + Point Class Decoder x3 + 500 Mileage Coupon x3
[*]7 Days: Twin Hawk Piece x6 + Point Transcendence Decoder x4 + Point Class Decoder x4 + 500 Mileage Coupon x4
[*]8 Days: Twin Hawk Piece x6 + Point Transcendence Decoder x4 + Point Class Decoder x4 + 500 Mileage Coupon x4
[*]9 Days: Twin Hawk Piece x8 + Point Transcendence Decoder x5 + Point Class Decoder x5 + 500 Mileage Coupon x5
[*]10 Days: Twin Hawk Piece x8 + Point Transcendence Decoder x5 + Point Class Decoder x5 + 500 Mileage Coupon x5
[*]11 Days: Twin Hawk Piece x10 + Point Transcendence Decoder x6 + Point Class Decoder x6 + 500 Mileage Coupon x6
[*]12 Days: Twin Hawk Piece x10 + Point Transcendence Decoder x6 + Point Class Decoder x6 + 500 Mileage Coupon x6[/list][/list]
[list][*]Notice
[list][*]You can acquire up to 60 Twin Hawk Pieces from the Daily Login Event.
[*]Rewards are earned upon reaching 30 minutes of playtime regardless of the mode.
[*]All Twin Hawk Pieces will be removed during maintenance on 2/8/2023.[/list][/list]


[h3]Clear special missions to collect Twin Hawk Pieces! (1/11 – 2/8)[/h3]
Participate in special missions throughout the event to collect Twin Hawk Pieces!
[list][*]Participation & Rewards
[list][*]Earn Kills/Assists as a human or Human Infections as a zombie in Zombie Mode to reach a total of 8 Kill Points: 1 Twin Hawk Piece (up to 16 per day)
[*]Clear a Zombie Scenario mode on Hard or higher reaching after reaching 100 Kill Points: 2 Twin Hawk Pieces (up to 16 per day)
[*]Reach 40 and 60 minutes of playtime: 2 Twin Hawk Pieces each (up to 4 per day)[/list][/list]
[list][*]How to Get Zombie Mode Kill Points
[list][*]Zombie Kill as a Human: 3 Points (excluding bots)
[*]Zombie Assist as a Human: 1 Point (excluding bots)
[*]Human Infection as Zombie: 3 Points (Excluding bots)
[*]Human Infection Assist as Zombie: 0 Points[/list][/list]
[list][*]Notice
[list][*]You can acquire up to 20 Twin Hawk Pieces per day from these Special Missions.
[*]Relevant Zombie Modes: Zombie Classic / Zombie Mutant / Zombie Hero / Zombie Z / Zombie Evolution
[*]Excludes Zombie Scenario: Survival: Double Gate / Survival: Lost City / Survival: Trap / Survival: Groundwater / Pursuit: Chaos
[*]At least 5 minutes of playtime are required to complete Zombie Scenario mode missions.
[*]Participation will only count in rooms with three or more players (excludes Studio Mode).
[*]Excludes auto hunt kills regardless of mode.
[*]All Twin Hawk Pieces will be removed during maintenance on 2/8/2023.
[*]You can obtain up to 300 Twin Hawk Pieces.[/list][/list]


[h3]Assemble your Twin Hawk piece by piece! (1/11 – 2/8)[/h3]
Collect 300 Twin Hawk Pieces during the event to receive a Twin Hawk (Permanent)!
[list][*]Total Accumulated: Rewards
[list][*]First Login Bonus: Twin Hawk (1 Day)
[*]10 Pieces: Twin Hawk (15 Days) + Zombie Scenario Add-On Rate Box x5
[*]50 Pieces: Rare Decoder x10 + Zombie Damage Meter (5 Days)
[*]100 Pieces: Unique Decoder (x10) + Grade 4 Parts Reward Box x5
[*]150 Pieces: Event Decoder x10 + 50 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x5
[*]200 Pieces: Class Decoder x10 + 100 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x5
[*]250 Pieces: Transcendence Decoder x10 + 200 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x5
[*]300 Pieces: Twin Hawk (Permanent)[/list][/list]
[list][*]Twin Hawk (Secondary Weapon)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/d3b0b90f5e8dda47aa32a7f300e8c665ce020426.png[/img]
[list][*]A pair of what are essentially mini-missile launchers that can be equipped on each arm. Each shot charges up energy, and charging a certain amount will activate its <Boost> state which increases attack power.[/list][/list]
[list][*]Notice
[list][*]These rewards can only be claimed once per account.
[*]All Twin Hawk Pieces will be removed during maintenance on 2/8/2023.
[*]You can obtain up to 300 Twin Hawk Pieces.
[*]The Event Decoder can be used until midnight on the day it is obtained.[/list][/list]


[h3]Bonus Disassembly Event (1/11 – 1/18)[/h3]
You can participate in the Bonus Disassembly Event by clicking "Bonus Disassembly" at the bottom of the Lobby. During the event, 10 players can select the weapons they want to disassemble, with one lucky player receiving extra mileage. Participants can get 500 mileage for each weapon they disassemble.
[list][*]Details
[list][*]Weekdays and Weekends - 1:00 PM – 5:00 PM CET
[*]Minimum Participation Mileage: 5,000
[*]Some items will be adjusted based on the weapon's rarity.
[*]Table ranks are in the order of highest value first.
[*]Weapon criteria are determined the day the Bonus Disassembly Event starts. If the weapon's rank changes, its value in the Bonus Disassembly Event will be updated.
[*]New items for disassembly: Cyclops, Twin Hawk, Hauteclere[/list][/list]


[h2][u]Shop Update[/u][/h2]

[h3] Roy & Romy Transcendence Class Promotion (1/11 – 1/18)[/h3]
Roy and Romy will make a special appearance in Class Decoders and Premium Class Decoders during the event.
[list][*]Roy
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/9b7db733b50d19815e7c33f95b48ddd7e735cfe3.png[/img]
[list][*]Romy's older brother. He got his quick thinking from his father, a former guard captain of Lost City, and his survival skills were essential in keeping Romy and himself safe. He once wished to become a soldier himself, but his hopes were dashed once the Lost City army collapsed. Nowadays, he dreams of having a normal office job, hoping to one day leave behind the mercenary work he need to make ends meet.
[*]Paired Effect: Area duration is increased when using Laevateinn's special feature.
[*]Exclusive Skill: Survival Book - Can use a skill that grants temporary invincibility to self and heals HP in Zombie Scenario.[/list][/list]
[list][*]Romy
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/3f45785aa153fedaa2bb2dd1d81ed03f7c5a13eb.png[/img]
[list][*]Roy's younger sister. Despite her dedication to her academic and domestic duties in the wake of her parents' deaths, she is still a cheerful, carefree girl. Following an explosion at the factory her brother had been deployed to, Romy armed herself and rushed to the battlefield. While she has no military experience, her father trained her in marksmanship. Between that and survival skills honed from living in the hell that is Lost City, Romy has proven herself to be more than just some schoolgirl.
[*]Paired Effect: Area duration is increased when using Laevateinn's special feature.
[*]Exclusive Skill: Crisis Breakthrough - Can use a skill that grants temporary invincibility to self and does area of effect damage in Zombie Scenario.[/list][/list]


[h3]Transcendence Class Guaranteed Giveaway (1/11 - 1/18)[/h3]
Get 2 guaranteed Transcendence Classes (Roy and Romy) based on how many Class Decoders and Premium Class Decoders are used during the event!
[list][*]Conditions and Rewards
[list][*]Upon reaching 150 Guaranteed Points from Decoder use
[*]Upon reaching 300 Guaranteed Points from Decoder use
[*]Select one: Roy + Roy's Keepsake Hat or Romy + Romy's Survival Pack[/list][/list]
[list][*]Roy's Keepsake Hat
[list][*]A keepsake from his father. He never wears it, but he won't go on a mission without it.[/list][/list]
[list][*]Romy's Survival Pack
[list][*]A pack containing everything essential to survival. The more experience you get, the more things you realize are essential.[/list][/list]

[list][*]Notice
[list][*]1 Guaranteed Point given each time you use 1 Class Decoder.
[*]3 Guaranteed Points given each time you use 1 Class Premium Decoder.
[*]If you receive Transcendence Class Roy (Permanent), Roy's Keepsake Hat (Permanent) is automatically granted as well.
[*]If you receive Transcendence Class Romy (Permanent), Romy's Survival Pack (Permanent) is automatically granted as well.
[*]Guaranteed Giveaway rewards can be granted only once per account.[/list][/list]

notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: December 28th
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/019b50ece90fc88dd3d4e0e7edcddefa001b34d3.jpg[/img]

Here's a rundown of some of the major updates in today's patch!

[list]
[b][*] Soft Snowflake Event (12/28 – 1/11)[/b]Complete missions during the event to collect Snowflakes! And look forward to Decoders as a bonus!

[b][*] Costume Distribution Project (12/28 – 1/11)[/b]Warm yourself up with some winter fashion!  The more points you earn the more rewards you get!

[b][*] New Transcendence Weapon Hauteclere Promotion (12/28 – 2/8)[/b]The Hauteclere can drop from Transcendence Premium Decoders and Transcendence Decoders during the event.
[/list]

Check out the following sections for more information.



[u][h2]System[/h2][/u]
[h3]Zombie Conquest (beta) Mode Improvements[/h3]

notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: December 14th
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/6744f0be36b4a91a17a1af78d37bccf6e32b6c48.jpg[/img]

Here's a rundown of some of the major updates in today's patch!

[list]
[b][*] Event: Laboratory Experience Event (12/14–12/28)[/b]Experience the Laboratory Mode, where Douglas Jacob's frightening experiment is taking place, and claim your rewards.

[b][*] Event: Winter Festival (12/14–12/28)[/b]Meet the requirements every day during the event to earn points.

[b][*] Event: Christmas Celebration Event (12/14 – 12/28)[/b]Spend the Christmas with Counter Strike Nexon: Studio! All kinds of gifts are waiting for you. 

[b][*] Event: Advent Calendar Event (12/14 – 12/28)[/b]Complete missions every day, and claim your rewards![/list]
Check out the following sections for more information.

[h1]---------- Details ----------[/h1]
 
[u][h2]New Content[/h2][/u]

[h3]Zombie Z Balance Changes [/h3]
[list][*]Zombie Z Level Changes
[list][*] Death Eater: 33 → 35
[*] Dual Sword Phantom Slayer: 30 → 32
[*] Petrol Boomer: 7 → 13
[*] Light Zombie: 6 → 12
[*] Venom Guard: 8 → 7
[*] Psycho: 10 → 15
[*] Stamper: 12 → 11[/list][/list]
[list][*]Zombie Z EXP Changes
[list][*]Humans will now earn EXP equal to the amount of HP they take off of the zombies.
EXP earned by zombies for infecting humans has been reduced early in the round. It will gradually increase during the round.[/list][/list]
[list][*]Challenge Reward + Changes
[list][*]The bonus EXP earned by Kills/Assists made with Random Purchase Weapons has been decreased (Kill 10,000 → 2,500. Assist 1,500 → 500).[/list][/list]

[u][h2]New Events[/h2][/u]

[list][*] Notice[list][*] Can participate once per account.
[*] Auto hunt in Laboratory Mode will not fulfill the requirements.
[*] The Event Decoder can be used until midnight on the day it is obtained.[/list][/list]

[*] Earn 2 points each time you score 2 kills or 6 assists as a human, or infect 2 humans as a zombie (max 30 points per day, excludes bots).

[*] Unique Decoder x2

notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: November 30th
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/b2d10ce9ec8176035cf59b11600d73a021b6d2df.jpg[/img]

Here's a rundown of some of the major updates in today's patch!

[list]
[*] [b]System: New Sky Garden Map Release[/b]
Explore the rooftop garden of Skyscraper.
 
[*] [b]Event: Find the Zombie (11/30–12/14)[/b]
Find the zombie, find plentiful rewards! 
 
[*][b] Promotion: New Transcendence Class Promotion (11/30–12/28)[/b]
Come meet Skadi the ice princess and Nyx the dark elf! 
 
[*] [b]Zombie Beginner Weapon Set Release[/b]
A new weapon set for new players![/list] 
Check out the following sections for more information.

[h1]---------- Details ----------[/h1]
 
[h2]New Content[/h2]
[h3][u]New Map Info[/u][/h3]
[list][*] Sky Garden
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/b1bf9ecf55d494aef66f85229466f488b11ec4db.jpg[/img]
- Location: Skyscraper Rooftop Garden
- Eligible Modes: Zombie Conquest (beta), Zombie Classic, Zombie Mutant, Zombie Hero, Zombie Z, Zombie Evolution, Team Deathmatch, Team Deathmatch (AI), Deathmatch, Deathmatch (AI), Gun Deathmatch, Zombie, All-Star[/list]


[u][h3]Zombie Conquest (beta) Mode Improvements[/h3][/u]
[list][*] Zombie Balance Fix
- Heavy Zombie: Awakening increases trap movement speed.
- Aksha: Awakening increases Movement Speed while using a skill.
- Light Zombie: Awakening increases Movement Speed while using Conceal.
- Blotter: Awakening increases Zombie Bomb damage.
- Stamper: Awakening increases Defense.

[*] Human/Zombie Awakening gauge charge rate adjusted.
- Human Base 1 and 2: Increased amount charged over time; decreased amount charged from Zombie Kills.
- Zombie Base 2 and 3: Increased amount charged over time; increased amount charged from taking damage.[/list]


[u][h3]Game Improvements[/h3][/u]
[list][*] Find the Zombie auto-play feature added.
[*] Method: Result window displayed each match.
[*] Animated Spray Improvements
[*] Registration effect added to editing Inventory Weapon/Class/Zombie order.
[*] Zombie Classic Studio Mode capacity expanded to 32 people[/list]


[u][h3]Weapon Enhancement Expansion[/h3][/u]
[list]
[*] Enhancement Weapon +5
- Crow-7 (Rate of Fire +2,  Ammo +3)
- Skull-6 (DMG +3, Ammo +2)[/list]


[h2]New Events[/h2]
[u][h3]Find the Zombie Event(11/30–12/14)[/h3][/u]You can participate via the Find the Zombie event button at the bottom of the Lobby screen.
[list][*] How to Participate
- Click the Find the Zombie event button at the bottom of the lobby screen.
- Among a group of 16 characters (12 zombies, 4 humans), find and hit the zombies using particular bullets.
- Get these bullets from the Find the Zombie Bullet Giveaway
- Hitting a zombie will increase the reward grade by 1 and allow you to take an additional shot. Hitting a human will decrease the reward grade by 1 and reset the Find the Zombie in progress.
- The reward grade can be increased up to a High Class Gold Box if you hit enough zombies consecutively, and you can claim the reward at it's current grade by clicking "Surrender."
- Click "Automatic Fire" to quickly and automatically proceed through one game.

[*] What is "Automatic Fire"?
- Proceed by randomly firing in a game.
- Must have more than 1 bullet to proceed.
- If you are in the Claim Reward state, you must claim the reward to use this feature.
 ※Temporary items obtained from the Silver Box last for a fixed duration. Bound weapons obtained from the Gold Box cannot be used for Auction/Disassembly/Family Storage.

[*] Reward Boxes
[table][tr][td]Class 1 - 4 Bronze Box 
(items have set drop rates)[/td]
[td]50 Mileage x1
100 Mileage x1
Zombie Scenario Add-On Rate Box x1
Zombie Damage Meter (7 Days)
Exploration Success Rate-Up +10% x1
Exploration Success Rate-Up +20% x1
Grade 4 Parts Reward Box x1
50 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x1
100 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x1
Random -1 Dehancement Material x1[/td][/tr]
[tr][td]Class 1 - 4 Silver Box
(items have set drop rates)[/td]
[td]Point Class Decoder x1
Point Transcendence Decoder x1
Rare Decoder x1
Grade 5 Parts Reward Box x1
Pink Heart Shiho (1 Day)
Black Rose Miho (1 Day)
Leader Soi (1 Day)
Super Soldier Jennifer (1 Day)

Infinity Laser Fist (1 Day)
Dual Sword Phantom Slayer (1 Day)
Barrett M95 White Tiger (1 Day)
200 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x1[/td][/tr]
[tr][td]Class 1 - 4 Gold Box
(items have set drop rates)[/td]

WA2000 +6 (Bound) (Rate of Fire 3/Ammo 3) (5 Days)
Hunter-Killer X-90 (Mnemonic Weapon Paint) x1
Hunter Killer X-12 (Permanent) - Grade 6 Gun Boost+ Grade 6 Power Up Equipped
Hunter Killer X-90 (Permanent) - Grade 6 Gun Boost+ Grade 6 Vampiric Equipped
Old-Time Series Weapon Paint Selection Box (Select 1) x1
Blade Frostbreaker +6 (Bound) (5 Days)

[tr][td]High Class Gold Box
(Receive All)[/td]

Blue B-Box (Select 1) x1[/table] [/td][/tr][/table]

[*] Blue B-Box
- Contents (Select 1): BALROG-I BLUE, BALROG-Ⅲ BLUE, BALROG-V BLUE, BALROG-VII BLUE, BALROG-IX BLUE, BALROG-XI BLUE

- Contents (Select 1): Old-Time BALROG-XI Weapon Paint, Old-Time CROW-11 Weapon Paint, Old-Time JANUS-11 Weapon Paint, Old-Time THANATOS-11 Weapon Paint, Old-Time TURBULENT-11 Weapon Paint, Old-Time SKULL-11 Weapon Paint

[*] Notice
- Reward grade will be reset upon claiming the current reward by clicking "Surrender."
- The grade can be increased up to a High Class Gold Box, and players can earn better rewards by consecutively hitting zombies.
- Temporary items obtained from the Silver Box last for a fixed duration. Bound weapons obtained from the Gold Box cannot be used for Auction/Disassembly/Family Storage 
- If you own both event and purchased bullets, event bullets will be consumed first.
- Click on "Claim Reward" to receive reward items.
- Chance to Find a Zombie: Remaining Zombies / Remaining Slots (Example: If there are 10 zombies left and 14 slots left → 10/14, there is about 71% chance to find a zombie.)
- All unused Old-Time Weapon Paint Selection Boxes will be removed during maintenance on 12/28 (Wed).
- All unused Blue B Boxes will be removed during maintenance on 12/28 (Wed).[/list]


[u][h3]Find the Zombie Bullet Giveaway Event (11/30–12/14)[/h3][/u]Locked and loaded! Before you go find those zombies, you're going to need some bullets! After accumulating 1 hour of daily playtime, earn 30 bullets every 15 minutes.

[list][*] Conditions and Obtainable Items
- Get 15 Find the Zombie bullets every 15 minutes of playtime

[*] Notice
- You can obtain up to 120 bullets a day per account.
- Participation will only count in rooms with three or more players (includes Studio and Laboratory Modes).
- All unused Find the Zombie bullets will be removed during maintenance on 12/14 (Wed).[/list]


[u][h3]Find the Zombie Bullet Pileup Event (11/30–12/14)[/h3][/u]Rewards for those who put in the effort and bullets to find the zombie!

[list][*] Bullet Total / Rewards
- 1680 / Transcendence Decoder x5 + Find the Zombie Event Nameplate (300 Days)

[*] Notice
- Cumulative rewards can only be obtained once per account.
- All unused Find the Zombie bullets will be removed during maintenance on 12/14 (Wed).[/list]

[u][h3]Marksman Training Project! (11/30–12/14)[/h3][/u]Collect empty shells during the event to supply bullets!
[list][*] How to Participate / Rewards
- Earn 2 shells (up to 30 a day, including 1-1 missions) every 2 Kills, 6 Assists, or 2 Human Infections (bots excluded) in Zombie Mode.
- Earn 5 shells (up to 10 a day) for completing Mission 1 in Zombie Conquest (beta).
- Earn 5 shells (up to 30 a day) for clearing 1 session by reaching 100 Kill Points in Zombie Scenario mode on Hard difficulty or higher.
- Earn 1 shell (up to 5 per account) every time you obtain a Zombie Mode Supply Box.

[*] Shell Total: Rewards
- 70 Shells: Zombie Scenario Add-On Rate Box x5 + Rare Decoder x5 + Exploration Success Rate-Up +10% x5
- 140 Shells: Unique Decoder x3 + 100 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x3
- 210 Shells: Event Decoder x5
- 280 Shells: Bullet x300 + Target Practice (Permanent) x1
- 350 Shells: Class Decoder x7
- 420 Shells: Transcendence Decoder x5 + Event Decoder x10 + 100 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x10
- 455 Shells: Bullet x100
- 490 Shells: Bullet x100

[*] Notice
- You can obtain up to 35 shells a day. The cumulative rewards can only be claimed once per account.
- Participation will only count in rooms with three or more players (excludes Studio Mode).
- The event includes Laboratory mode, but excludes auto hunt kills regardless of the mode.
- Relevant Zombie Modes: Zombie Classic / Zombie Mutant / Zombie Hero / Zombie Z / Zombie Evolution / Zombie Darkness
- Excludes Zombie Scenario: Survival: Double Gate / Survival: Lost City / Survival: Trap / Survival: Groundwater / Pursuit: Chaos
- At least 5 minutes of playtime are required to complete Zombie Scenario mode missions.
- All unused shells will be removed during maintenance on 12/14 (Wed).
- The Event Decoder can be used until midnight on the day it is obtained.
[/list]


[u][h3]New and Returning Player Welcome Event (11/30–12/14)[/h3][/u]Welcome, new and returning players!
[list][*] How to Participate / Rewards
- Reach 20 minutes of login time for 1 Event Reward Box (once a day).
- Earn 1 Event Reward Box every 1 Kill, 3 Assists, or 1 Human Infection (bots excluded) in Zombie Mode (once a day).
- Clear a Zombie Scenario on Easy or higher difficulty for 1 Event Reward Box (once a day).

[*] Notice
- Only new or returning players (longer than 30 days of inactivity) can participate in this event.
- You can obtain up to 3 Event Reward Boxes a day.
- Event resets every day at midnight (00:00).
- Participation will only count in rooms with three or more players (excludes Studio Mode).
- The event includes Laboratory mode, but excludes auto hunt kills regardless of the mode.
- All unused Event Reward Boxes will be removed during maintenance on 12/14 (Wed.)[/list]

[u][h3]Login Supplies Event Guide (11/30–12/27)[/h3][/u]
[list][*] Login Reward
- Daily Weapons Supply
- Both Dual Sword Phantom Slayer (1 Day) and M3 Black Dragon (1 Day) provided + one of the Transcendence Enhancement or Part equipped Unique weapon (1 Day) randomly provided + all contents of Daily Attendance Reward Box provided
- Daily Attendance Reward Box: Damage Display (1 Day), Killer Display (1 Day), Penalty and Loss Invalidation x1, Rare Decoder x3

[*] Cumulative Rewards
- 5 Days: X-TRACKER (20 Days) + Cumulative Attendance Reward Box
- 10 Days: Negev NG7 Ajax (20 Days) + Cumulative Attendance Reward Box
- 15 Days: Lightning Fury (20 Days) + Cumulative Attendance Reward Box
- 20 Days: Trinity Grenade (20 Days) + Cumulative Attendance Reward Box
- 25 Days: Dread Nova (10 Days) + Cumulative Attendance Reward Box
- Cumulative Attendance Reward Box contents: C4 Countdown Room Host (5 Days), Shorten Respawn Time (5 Days) Lucky Gunslinger (5 Days), Daily Mission Difficulty Change x15, Exploration Slot Expansion Coupon (7 Days)

[*] Notice
- Attendance rewards will be provided directly as rewards instead of the Daily/Cumulative Attendance Reward Box items.
- Rewards can be claimed immediately after logging in and are available until midnight every day.
[/list]

[h2]Shop Update[/h2]
[u][h3]New Transcendence Class Promotion (11/30–12/28)[/h3][/u]Two new Transcendence Classes, Skadi and Nyx, are now available in Class Decoders and Premium Class Decoders.

[list]
[*] Skadi
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/b026ca23f8e757107f9af6de3e5fde7bfa8da231.png[/img]
- Background: A princess from another world transported to this world while looking for the frost flower. She was recruited alongside Nyx when they were found by the institute, freezing the first zombie she encountered. She is full of royal pride and is adapting to this world by speaking formally and trying to learn new customs. She is cooperating with the Aegis Institute to return to her original world. Wherever she treads freeze, regardless of the climate.
- Zombie Scenario Skill: Ice Queen's Grace
[list][*] Passive: If engaging in Zombie Scenario with Nyx, critical rate increases (Connection effect applied, cannot be stacked). / <Quick Rejoining> Add-On effect is applied by default.
[*] Active: (Zombie Scenario) Provides special barrier effects to self and nearby allies. / Increases movement speed for the duration of the barrier effects for self and nearby allies.[/list]
- Transcendence Class exclusive voices are applied.
- +10% EXP/Points
- In Zombie Scenario mode, this character has a higher max level than normal classes.
- This character adds 1 initial mutation in Zombie Z Mode.
- This character displays your current damage at the bottom of the screen.
- Marks enemies at or below 20% HP.
- This character leaves a unique mark at the target location upon killing an enemy.

[*] Nyx
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/5e850dc2b20868dc61e2a2d525776a0501d04c70.png[/img]
- Background: A dark elf shaman that serves Skadi who was transported to this world while seeking the frost flower. She was recruited because Skadi rushes into action, claiming that to do so is the obligation of royalty. She is satisfied with this world and its lack of class divides, and she dreams of sending Skadi back to their original world while remaining herself to enjoy the thrills of battle. She provided research support to the Kronos Institute to acquire emergency funds as well.
[*] Zombie Scenario Skill: The Black Ark
[list][*] Passive: If engaging in Zombie Scenario with Skadi, critical rate increases (Connection effect applied, cannot be stacked). / <Thorns> Add-On effect is applied by default.
[*] Active: (Zombie Scenario) Provides special barrier effects to self and nearby allies / Increases attack power for the duration of the barrier effects for self and nearby allies.[/list]
- Transcendence Class exclusive voices are applied.
- +10% EXP/Points
- In Zombie Scenario mode, this character has a higher max level than normal classes. This character adds 1 initial mutation in Zombie Z Mode.
- This character displays your current damage at the bottom of the screen.
- Marks enemies at or below 20% HP.
- This character leaves a unique mark at the target location upon killing an enemy.
[/list]

[u][h3]New Transcendence Class Guaranteed Giveaway (11/30–12/28)[/h3][/u]Get 2 guaranteed new Transcendence Classes (Skadi and Nyx) based on the number of Class Decoders and Premium Class Decoders used during the event!

- Upon reaching 300 Guaranteed Points from Decoder use

[/list]


[u][h3]New Transcendence Class Medal Giveaway (11/30 – Permanent)[/h3][/u]When you own all items in the new Transcendence Classes set, you will receive the Transcendence Class medal.

[list][*] Conditions and Items

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/c9c13496853a162683f9d17d28e5b34ea5a65b1c.png[/img]

[u][h3]New Transcendence Decoder Group Addition Event (11/30 – The Next Transcendence Weapon Promotion)[/h3][/u]The classes below will be part of the new Rotation Group for the Transcendence Decoder during the event.

[u][h3]Transcendence Weapon Guaranteed Giveaway (11/30 – The Next Transcendence Weapon Promotion)[/h3][/u]Based on the number of Transcendence Premium Decoders and Transcendence Decoders used during the event, you will be guaranteed 1 weapon from the Rotation Group!

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/e8834d29a798fc4bf7cc11e73167d43ceb76c7bf.jpg[/img]

Here's a rundown of some of the major updates in today's patch!

[list][b]Event: Collect Sky Lanterns to Earn Great Gifts (11/16–11/30)[/b]
Collect Sky Lanterns to claim rewards! 

[b]Event: VIP Free Pass Promotion (11/16–11/30)[/b]
VIP Free Passes are now available as a Black Friday special! [/list]
Check out the Details section below for more information.


[h1]---------- Details ----------[/h1]

[h2]New Events[/h2]
[u][h3]Collect Sky Lanterns to Earn Great Gifts (11/16–11/30)[/h3][/u]Complete missions during the event to earn rewards.
[list][*] Event Conditions & Rewards
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/9d4c0f8e8e7fc1aa616f54aafeb40f94a0c531e9.png[/img]
- Reach 20 minutes of playtime to claim 300 Mileage (once a day).
- Reach 40 minutes of playtime to claim 500 Mileage (once a day).
- Receive 1 Sky Lantern for clearing 1 session of Zombie Scenario mode on Hard or higher after scoring 100 Kill Points. 
- Receive 1 Sky Lantern every 8 Kill Points (earned from kills, assists, and human infections in Zombie Mode).

[*] How to Earn Kill Points
- Zombie Kill as a Human: 3 Points 
- Zombie Assist as a Human: 1 Point 
- Human Infection as Zombie: 3 Points (excludes bots)
- Human Infection Assist as Zombie: 0 Points

[*] Bonus Rewards
- 5 Sky Lanterns: Rare Decoder x3 + Exploration Success Rate-Up 10% x3 
- 10 Sky Lanterns: Zombie Scenario Add-On Rate Box x3 + 100 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x3
- 15 Sky Lanterns: Unique Decoder x3 + Exploration Success Rate-Up 20% x3 
- 25 Sky Lanterns: Event Decoder x5
- 35 Sky Lanterns: Wink Emoji Banshee Spray (Permanent) x1
- 50 Sky Lanterns: Class Decoder x7
- 60 Sky Lanterns: Transcendence Decoder x5 + Event Decoder x10 + 100 Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon x10
- 65 Sky Lanterns: Season Badge x100
- 70 Sky Lanterns: Season Badge x100

[*] Notice
- You can only earn up to 5 Sky Lanterns per day.
- Participation will only count in rooms with three or more players (excludes Studio Mode).
- At least 5 minutes of playtime are required to complete Zombie Scenario mode missions.
- The event includes Laboratory mode, but excludes auto hunt kills.
- Relevant Zombie Modes: Zombie Classic / Zombie Mutant / Zombie Hero / Zombie Z / Zombie Evolution / Zombie Darkness
- Excludes Zombie Scenario: Survival: Double Gate / Survival: Lost City / Survival: Trap / Survival: Groundwater / Pursuit: Chaos
- All Sky Lanterns will be removed the day the event ends (11/30). [/list]


[h2]Shop Update[/h2]
[u][h3]VIP Free Pass Black Friday Special (11/16–11/30)[/h3][/u]Take advantage of this Black Friday special to experience the various benefits of the VIP Free Pass!
[list][*] Item Info
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/e5240294aff69415913c8219025e16d76edb9ba0.png[/img]
- VIP Free Pass (1 Day): Only 5 per account
- VIP Free Pass (7 Days): Only 3 per account
- VIP Free Pass (15 Days): Only 1 per account[/list]


[h2]Random One-Liners[/h2]
[h3][u]Cyclops Changes[/u][/h3]
[list][*] Changes to Special Features
- Previous: Using <Continuous Fire> or <Deceleration> spends special rounds. These rounds cannot be saved.
- New: <Continuous Fire (Right-Click)> now uses an exclusive gauge instead of special rounds. <Deceleration> still uses the special rounds.
- The exclusive gauge increases as the weapon is used or fired, and movement speed increases based on the gauge amount. Swapping weapons will not reset the gauge. Using <Continuous Fire> spends the gauge.
- Special rounds automatically charge over time. Swapping the weapon while special rounds are charged will spend the rounds to trigger the <Deceleration> feature.[/list]

[u][h3]Fixed an issue where players could return to the waiting room while the Zombie Scenario Pursuit: Evelyn's Test B was in progress.[/h3][/u]

[u][h3]Event End Notification[/h3][/u][list][*]Zombie Starter Package Event Ending Soon (- 11/30)[/list]

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/34183bc15fc4749dc123aeaf07a5e03a3dda3a1a.jpg[/img]

Here's a rundown of some of the major updates in today's patch!

[list][b]Content: Season 14: The Jungle[/b]

[b]Content: League Season 10(11/02 – 2/8)[/b]

Depending on the number of Transcendence Premium Decoders and Transcendence Decoders used during the event, you could receive a Cyclops (Permanent)! [/list]
Check out the Details section below for more information.


[h1]---------- Details ----------[/h1]

[h2]New Content[/h2]
[h3][u]Season 14: The Jungle[/u][/h3]For details, please refer to the Season 14 Pass Preview.
[list][*] Black Market Opens Early
- The Black Market will open early for players who reach Rank 100.
- Upon reaching Rank 100 on the current Season Pass, Season Missions will end while missions that offer Black Market Badges will refresh.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/e685d054b5a45caa7dda0f14f041cbcd86c775d8.png[/img]
- New Item Added: CSO Spray

[*] Repurchasing Past Season Passes
- A page where past season items can be purchased will become available to those who reach Rank 100 on the Season Pass!
- The page begins with the player's progress from the past season, and they can purchase Season Pass Ranks from the page to obtain items.
- Available Previous Season Passes: Seasons 9, 10, 11, 12
- The Black Market can be accessed via the [Missions] menu after reaching Rank 100.
- All Black Market Badges you've obtained will disappear once a new season begins.

[*] Season Reward Weapons
[list][*] Ancient Keeper
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/3ecdfb7606b1bdc76a34c7f3fc7da8c38cb2ad83.png[/img]
- A machine gun equipped with a mystical gem from an ancient civilization discovered deep within the jungle. Aside from the gem, this powerful weapon also holds 200 7.62mm rounds. It can transform into True Keeper mode, allowing its user to deal devastating damage upon landing a set amount of successful hits.

[*] Ancient Berserker
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/2ab58546a1f6f1ede64c714d4343005f10439a74.png[/img]
- A single-bladed sword that was likely a favorite of the warrior class of the ancient civilization discovered deep within the jungle. The sword is engraved with mystic patterns. Its long length allows its user to deliver powerful strikes against enemies.

[*] Ancient Bringer
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/3cca7f85c4d8ed69eaf544bed2fb3f8394724ea7.png[/img]
- A pistol that applies the mystical powers of the ancient civilization discovered deep within the jungle in the form of 50 rounds of 5.7mm explosive ammo. When a certain number of rounds is fired, a special feature becomes available.

[*] Weapon Paints
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/baccfdc95b7b082d4054411580efeccd848b4d35.png[/img]
- Lizard Weapon Paint
- Eligible Weapons: AWP, Rock Breaker, SKULL-1, Hunter-Killer X-12, Warhammer Storm Giant

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/9be25b0e76e2b60b540747a4f5ca16dfc3171ce7.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/2e77798cf90f4e6ed36962c86d84a985f35d8a50.png[/img]

- Season Pass Nameplate (14)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/02e1a98af862a600f3e8bf690c2ff0d9203e95e3.png[/img]

[*] Damage Font
- Season Pass Font (14)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/852aa59883875b695c2bfa54f485301febf8a1c8.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/e036d4f49a002224b865156ca6b915618779ae05.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/103daee79e477934a71eca7c59e2d9ed71d0a920.png[/img][/list][/list]

[h3][u]League Season 10 (11/02 – 2/8)[/u][/h3]
[list][*] Notice
- Items have been added to the Achievement Shop.
- New Nameplate Items Added: Wink Emoji Spray, Flustered Emoji Spray (Light Zombie), Bleh Emoji Spray (Light Zombie), Grin Emoji Spray (Light Zombie), Sad Emoji Spray (Light Zombie), Heart Emoji Spray (Light Zombie), Laugh Emoji Spray (Light Zombie), Angry Emoji Spray (Light Zombie), Wink Emoji Spray (Light Zombie), Pink Slash Nameplate, Zombie Mark Nameplate, (Animated) Subtle Ember Nameplate
[/list]

[u][h3]Studio Mode Update[/h3][/u]Studio Sample New Map Release! A new map showcasing the new decorations and devices in all their glory, "Yuri's New Secret Place," is getting released.
[list][*] Studio New Block Update
- A variety of new devices, characters, and decoration blocks have been updated. (24 devices, 2 characters, 22 decorations)
- You can view the new blocks via Creation Mode without adding a separate theme pack.

[*] Changes for previous devices
- Transport Block and Spike Wall Trap Block: You can now change the speed setting in Creation Mode.
- Ranking Board: Lap Time category added.
[/list]

[u][h3]Celebratory Studio Contest Info[/h3][/u]We're celebrating the new theme and blocks by holding a Studio Creation Mode map creation contest!
[list]
[*] Studio contest schedule
- Application Period: 11/2 – 11/30
- Finalists Announced: 12/28
- Player Vote: 12/28 – 1/11
- Winner Announcement & Awards: 1/25

[*] How to Participate
- Step 1: Create a Studio Creation Mode map
- Step 2: Register a thumbnail image and map description
- Step 3: Add "#partygame" to the map's title

[*] Criteria
- 10 finalists will be selected based on creativity, number of recommendations, number of cubes earned, use of new blocks and script diversity, utilization of content, and relevance to the subject.
- There is no limit on how many times you can enter, and a single player can win multiple/duplicate prizes.

[*] Prizes (evaluated based on creativity and popularity)
- 1st (2 people): Transcendence Decoder x300 + Trophy Theme Pack + Excellent Creator Medal
- 2nd (2 people): Transcendence Decoder x200 + Trophy Theme Pack + Excellent Creator Medal
- 3rd (2 people): Transcendence Decoder x100 + Trophy Theme Pack + Excellent Creator Medal
- 4th - 10th: Transcendence Decoder x50 + Trophy Theme Pack + Excellent Creator Medal
- All participants (with +10 map play counts and +3 recommendations): 5,000 Mileage + Contest Participation Medal

[*] Notice
- If you have already obtained the Excellent Creator Medal, another one will not be given.
- Using new blocks (device, character, and device block) will award extra point, but they are not necessary to win prizes.
- You can only enter each prize category once, and you cannot win the same prize more than once.
- Your award may be revoked if you're not the owner of the account.
- Your award may be revoked if the entry has nothing to do with the subject.
- The entries must be original creations, and your award will be revoked if the entry contains content in violation of the game's Terms and Conditions, contains plagiarized content, or violates the rights of 3rd parties in any way.
- Entries containing sexually suggestive or violent images exceeding the standards of the game may be deleted immediately.
- If there are no entries fitting the selection criteria after evaluation, there may be no winning entry, or the award may be changed.
- All legal responsibilities fall to whoever submitted the entry, should there be a dispute regarding the entry.
- The award may be revoked from contestants who have violated the Terms and Conditions or operational rules of CSNS during the contest or award periods.
- Please submit your entries only if you agree to all of the above.[/list]


[h2]New Events[/h2]
[u][h3]Autumn Leaves Event (11/2 – 11/16)[/h3][/u]Enjoy the autumn leaves and the cool breeze of fall!
[list]
[*] How to Participate / Reward
- Get 1 Autumn Leaves Box for reaching 15 / 30 / 40 minutes of playtime. (Up to 3 a day)
- Get 1 Autumn Leaves Box by reaching 8 kill points from kill/assist/infection at Zombie modes  (Up to 2 a day)

[*] How to Earn Kill Points
- Zombie Kill as a Human: 3 Points
- Zombie Assist as a Human: 1 Point
- Human Infection as Zombie: 3 Points (Excluding bots)
- Human Infection Assist as Zombie: 0 Points

[*] Notice
- You can earn up to 5 Autumn Leaves Boxes a day.
- All unused Autumn Leaves Boxes will be removed during maintenance on 11/16 (Wed).
- Participation will only count in rooms with three or more players (excludes Studio Mode).
[/list]

[u][h3]Autumn Leaves Event (2) (11/2 – 11/16)[/h3][/u]Gather the Autumn Leaves Boxes and claim even bigger rewards!
[list][*] Total Count: Rewards
- 5 Autumn Leaves Boxes: Unique Decoder x1 + Squirrel Ears (Permanent)
- 15 Autumn Leaves Boxes: Unique Premium Decoder x1 + Acorn Bag (Permanent)
- 30 Autumn Leaves Boxes: Event Decoder x2 + Squirrel Tail (Permanent)

- The Event Decoder can be used until midnight on the day it is obtained.[/list]

[u][h3]Login Supplies Event Guide (11/2 – 11/30)[/h3][/u][list][*] Login Reward
- Daily Weapons Supply
- Both Dual Sword Phantom Slayer (1 Day) and M3 Black Dragon (1 Day) provided + one of the Transcendence Enhancement or Part equipped Unique weapon (1 Day) randomly provided + all contents of Daily Attendance Reward Box provided
- Daily Attendance Reward Box: Damage Display (1 Day), Killer Display (1 Day), Penalty and Loss Invalidation x1, Rare Decoder x3[/list][list][*] Cumulative Rewards

- Cumulative Attendance Reward Box contents: C4 Countdown Room Host (5 Days), Shorten Respawn Time (5 Days) Lucky Gunslinger (5 Days), Daily Mission Difficulty Change x15, Exploration Slot Expansion Coupon (7 Days)
[/list][list][*] Notice
- Attendance rewards will be provided directly as rewards instead of the Daily/Cumulative Attendance Reward Box items.
- Rewards can be claimed immediately after logging in and are available until midnight every day.
[/list]


[h2]Shop Update[/h2]
[u][h3]New Transcendence Weapon Cyclops Promotion (11/2 – 11/30)[/h3][/u]The Cyclops can drop from Transcendence Premium Decoders and Transcendence Decoders during the event.
[list][*] Cyclops (Secondary Weapon)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/137f9a73253348d5d01610c5c92d6e1b785164a5.png[/img]
- The main features of this weapon are its two-dot aiming sight and its ability to slow down enemies when swapping weapons. Holding the weapon or firing basic rounds for a set amount of time will charge special rounds. These special rounds can be spent to use 2 types of <Special Features> in strategic ways.
[list][*] <Shooting Bonus>: Aim assist is applied to the enemy closest to the crosshair. Accurately aligning that enemy with the center of the aiming sight will deal additional damage.
[*] <Continuous Fire>: Hold down right-click to spend the special rounds to attack all enemies within the crosshair and increase movement speed.
[*] <Deceleration>: Swapping the weapon will spend all the special rounds in your possession to slow enemies in front of you. Stages will increase from Yellow > Blue > Pink, with each stage corresponding to an increase in range, slow duration, and slow amount. Successfully hitting an enemy in the final stage will cause them to fall and deal continuous damage.[/list][/list]

[u][h3]New Transcendence Weapon Cyclops Guaranteed Giveaway (11/2 – 11/30)[/h3][/u]Depending on the number of Transcendence Premium Decoders and Transcendence Decoders used during the event, you could receive a Cyclops (Permanent)!

- 1 Guaranteed Point each time you use 1 Transcendence Decoder.

[*] Cyclops Drop Rate
- Transcendence Premium Decoder: 3%
- Transcendence Decoder: 0.45%
[/list]

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/bdcc00a5c36e504a9db2e601214fa7fab3d350f1.jpg[/img]

[b]Dear CSNS Fans,[/b]

notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: October 5th
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/6f571647994f9864e309d096dfeaa7558dd93973.jpg[/img]

Here's a rundown of some of the major updates in today's patch!

[list][b]Content: New Zombie Scenario 8-2 Map Released[/b]
Experience the New Super Soldier Project of Kronos: Queen's Story of the Past in the new Zombie Scenario! 

[b]Event: Start the Firework Festival with a bang from the Firework Set! (10/5 – 10/19)[/b]
Play every day and collect Firework Sets to earn rewards! 

[b]Event: Epic Weapon Heaven Splitter Guaranteed Giveaway! (10/5 – 11/2)[/b]
Based on the amount of Epic Decoders used during the event, you could receive a Heaven Splitter (Permanent)!

[b]Event: Asura Hell Splitter Blueprint Promotion (10/5 – 11/2)[/b]
The Asura Hell Splitter is here! Purchase the Asura Hell Splitter blueprint for a guaranteed acquisition of the Asura Hell Splitter. [/list]
Check out the Details section below for more information.


[h1]---------- Details ----------[/h1]

[h2]New Content[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/8484053203ad3b47eb7e05e6b261a6a7a6430a51.jpg[/img]
[h3][u]Zombie New Scenario 8-2 Map [/u][/h3]Pursuit: Planned Tragedy
[list][*] New Super Soldier Project of Kronos: Queen's Story of the Past
[*] A sudden power outage resulted in all the doors of the laboratory's experimental wards to open. Experiments such as Queen and Cyborg ended up escaping in midst of the chaos, even succeeding in hijacking a helicopter for their escape. Meanwhile, lab researchers monitored them from within the lab. They put together a tracking unit to lure them to a secure location and forced a crash landing by knocking out the helicopter rotors. Still, the Queen and her fellow experiments wished only to escape, but as they tried to leave the lavish, lifeless neon city, they were met by a horde of zombies and other, new experiments. All the while, the Kronos researchers were watching. Now a new experiment begins.
[*] You can find detailed information in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/273110/announcements/detail/3311859113637627185][Zombie Scenario 8-2 Preview][/url].[/list]


[h3][u]Game Improvements [/u][/h3]
[list]
[*] Inventory Lock System
- Added a locking feature to prevent important items from being accidentally lost.
- Locking the item will prevent the item from being auto-filled in situations where the item would be spent, such as disassembly, Enhancement Material selection, and auction use.
- Some items (provided by default, event items, etc.)  will have restricted locking features.

[*] Enhancement Simplification
- Inserting EXP Material has been removed from the process. A feature that guides the player when a high rank weapon is inserted has been added.
- Enhancement Guide and result pop-up window has been improved.

[*] Zombie Scenario Player Experience Improvements
- An escape feature has been added to use in when a character is stuck within the map. If you are unable to move for a set period of time, [ESC > Map Escape] becomes activated, and you can use it to move to the spawn area.
- Fixed an issue where some Phobos wouldn't appear during Pursuit: Last Clue.

[*] 6 BGM is now added to the Music Block in Studio Mode.

[*] Other Changes
- Hitbox errors, unnatural modeling, and animations have been revised through class modeling and animation improvements.
- Please refer to [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/273110/announcements/detail/3300598937414642555][Developer's Letter][/url] for more details.[/list]



[h2]New Events[/h2]
[h3][u]Event: Mileage Auction Event (10/5 – 10/18)[/u][/h3]October opens with an open Mileage Auction! Log in now to get the items you need!
[list][*] Permanent Auction Item Added: Trinity Grenade

[*] Auction Feature / Content
- Item Rank: Premium (All weapons except for premium are Normal Rank)
- Auction Time: 1 hour for all items
- Number of Auction Listings: 2 (Increases based on VIP rank)
- Regarding the Market Price of Items:  When listing an item, you can check the current Auction House market price (Lowest bid and direct purchase prices)
- Item Display: Only items with the lowest bid or direct purchase price are displayed
- Auction Settings: You can search by bid or direct purchase price, enhancement level, and weapon name.
- Sell-to-System Feature: When an auction is unsuccessful, you'll have the opportunity to use the sell-to-system feature.
- Auction Hours: 24 Hours (12: 00: 00 AM – 11: 59: 59 PM) - When auction hours end, currently listed items will be canceled.

[*] Notice
- As the Trinity Grenade has been added, the M95 White Tiger has been removed from the premium.
- Lower Price Limit: 50,000 / Upper Price Limit: None
- The remaining time is shown in 5-minute increments for listed auction items.
- You can only bid on 1 item at a time.
- Regular auction items will be listed with a 30% fee included in the initial bidding price.
- If an item listed for auction is not sold, the item will be returned.

notes.title: Developer's Letter
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/1e95bcc7124a5a9f096f394742a7e968be908cc5.jpg[/img]

Hello. This is the Dev team for Counter-Strike Nexon: Studio. 
 
Thanks to the large amount of interest that players have shown in the various contents of Counter-Strike Nexon: Studio, we were able to consider the future direction of development in many ways. 
 
The 10/05 (Wed) patch content will be communicated with Counter-Strike players here, 
for us to create a Counter-Strike Nexon: Studio for everyone, together. 
 
Today, we'd like to introduce some improvements we have prepared in response  
to the opinions of Counter-Strike Nexon: Studio's fans. 
  
#Character Modeling Revision #Zombie Scenario Unstuck Feature #Inventory Lock Feature & Enhancement Simplification 

 
[u][b][h3]Character Modeling Revision [/h3][/b][/u][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/157e68920fe259daaeb3576361ac4b94844029b4.jpg[/img]
Character Modeling has been revised for this patch. 
Counter-Strike Nexon: Studio's playable teams are divided in to Counter-Terrorist (CT) and Terrorist (TR) sides. 
For some weapons, the character grip animation on the weapon will vary between the two teams. 
 

[b]<Weapon Grip Animation Differences Per Team> [/b]
  
The problem was that certain classes were using the team motions wrong. The model shown in the game  
and the model on the game server weren't matching, so there were issues with hit detection. 
  [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/3de23c5f833d17ffd4b0118c10b36a1858db8144.gif[/img]
<Before revision: Displayed appearance and the actual hitbox were misaligned, and shooting the target would not detect the hits>
  
To resolve this issue, we are going through the character modeling  
[b]and using a procedure where we are syncing the game server and in-game character models to be uniform. We began with the revision of human classes for now. 
After this update, we will be improving abnormal hitboxes. [/b]

 On another note,[b] the character animations of certain male and female classes will be improved to be more natural. [/b]The animations below are scheduled for improvement.

[b]<Male Class Fixes> [/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/e6c63efafae8863a43efb1cd278b3460576279b3.jpg[/img]
Aside from "Immortal Eric", who does not have the relevant issues, all classes were revised. 
 
[b]<Female Class Fixes>[/b]
Turtle neck issue 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/32fe058b29a79f781e84a13323119feae78951ac.jpg[/img]
  
Shoulder fix 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/5d3fde27e94d0069d85f6da44e858c5be5138007.jpg[/img]

Other joints 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/32fe058b29a79f781e84a13323119feae78951ac.jpg[/img]
Aside from the classes without the relevant issues listed below, all female classes were revised. 

1	Queen
2	Anemone
3	Mirage
4	Ismael
5	Romy
6	Agent Ritsuka
 
We are continuously improving the game to enhance its overall quality, and we will do our best to quickly address other similar issues that remain in the game. 
 
[h3][u]Introduction of Zombie Scenario Unstuck Feature [/u][/h3]
There were issues of being stuck in Zombie Scenario, where the player would have to leave the game and try again as they could not progress in the game while stuck. 
To resolve this issue, [b]we have added the Unstuck feature in this update that you can use when you are stuck for more than a short time.  [/b]
If you are stuck and unable to move for more than 5 seconds, the Map Escape button will be activated in the ESC menu. 
  [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/f1113fa8f0e211d614c3bf3876148970ecb0591a.jpg[/img]
  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/b1edfa8fe5bdafab773c12bb972a8e58ab7b0094.jpg[/img]
  
Pressing the Map Escape button will move the character to the current spawn point. The character will be moved to one of the spawn areas if they're stuck in the boss stage. 
   
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/1e938da501c613067347e22c04b83ed95975b178.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/26f2c40afd4750f2a6709dd15de1f16de1581e5a.jpg[/img]
Please note that there is a cooldown before you can use the feature again. 
 
[u][h3]Inventory Lock Feature & Enhancement Simplification [/h3][/u][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/dc8079c0734b7641b6ac31611f30df26652cf670.png[/img]
Weapons, classes, items, etc. are being utilized as a materials for other systems, after a variety of items and system were added to the game. 
We confirmed that there were many cases where players were losing their items unintentionally as materials while using these systems, and that this has been a great inconvenience to them. 
Some players have suggested that there should be a feature to lock important items so that they cannot be disassembled or used as materials.
So, [b]we have added a Lock feature where valuable items can be locked so that they cannot be lost as materials through disassembly or trade.  [/b]
 
Some event items or pass items were already unavailable for trade or to be used as materials, so those will be distributed in the locked state. 
We will continuously improve and enhance this feature to avoid instances where player assets are unintentionally lost. 
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/2064ac14c6858156cf04d08669a8f9b419ac8f6e.png[/img]
 
The existing Weapon Enhancement system is divided into 2 stages. One is where the Enhancement Material is added, and the other is the Enhancement attempt. So, it always required two clicks. 
There were some suggestions that this was inconvenient, so [b]we simplified them into a single click that takes care of both the material selection and the Enhancement attempt.  [/b]
Also, we added a step for weapons of high value, confirming that they have been selected as material, so that we can prevent a highly-valued weapon being accidentally used as material.  
 
 
We will continue to do our best to incorporate all of your suggestions and ideas to create a better gameplay experience for Counter-Strike Nexon: Studio. 
 
Thank you.

[u][h3]Transcendence Class ‘Ismael, Ethan’ Promotion (9/21 - 10/19)[/h3][/u]Two new Transcendence Classes (Ismael and Ethan) will make a special appearance in Class Decoders and Premium Class Decoders during the event.
