notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: December 1st
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/ed2fd24f004c33076a9c1fbac7487c3f88891124.jpg[/img]

Here's a rundown of some of the major updates in today's patch!
[list][b]Zombie Scenario Mode Update[/b]
Try the new Event Mode update and the new map Pursuit: Evelyn's Test B!

[b]Exploration System Improvement[/b]
Check out which of the Exploration System's rewards have been revamped!

[b]Family System Improvement[/b]
Check out the new Family System improvements, from achievements to storage!

[b]New Transcendence Class Promotion (12/1 - 12/29)[/b]
Meet the new Transcendence Classes, sibling survivors of the Lost City, Roy and Romy![/list]Check out the Details section below for more information.


[h1]---------- Details ----------[/h1]


[h2][New Content][/h2]

[u][h3]Zombie Scenario Mode Update[/h3][/u]
[b]Zombie Scenario New Event Mode Update (12/1 - 12/15)[/b]
[list][*]Random Transformation: End of Madness & Random Transformation: Truth Uncovered
[*]Information: Killing zombies on the event map during the event period grants a chance to drop gene orbs. Earning the orbs (4 types) fills the gauge, and once the orb gauge is full, press the T key to transform into a random monster.
- The 4 types of orbs have a chance to drop from all zombies.
- Earning an orb fills up one tick of the gauge and changes the color of the gauge to that of the orb.
- The more orbs of the same color you collect, the higher your chance of transforming into their respsective monster.\n- Red: Revanant. Green: Yeti. Blue: Dr. Rex. Yellow: Frozen Wrath
- Earning additional orbs after transforming grants a buff that lasts a particular period of time (once per 4 gene orbs).
- If you are having difficulty playing or don't like the selected monster, you can manually cancel the transformation by pressing the T key again.
- While transformed, you will transform back into a human upon death.
- Sitting down after transforming to a monster as certain classes can cause the bottom half of the body to be buried under ground.[/list]
[b]New Zombie Scenario Map - Pursuit: Evelyn's Test B[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/ccfb304aca5033910307523e9bd59bbe507f390f.png[/img]



[u][h3]Exploration System Improvement[/h3][/u]
[b]Exploration System Rewards Revamped[/b]
[list][*]Rate for exploration start availability changed for each difficulty.
- The difficulty been reduced so the standard class level 1 can run easy difficulty.
[*]Base Reward and Success Reward Changes and Additions
- Base Reward, which is granted regardless of success, now gives a Scenario Add-On and Part.
- For Decoder-related contents (weapons/class) from Success Rewards, it has now been changed to grant unlimited items for a small chance.
[*]Added Exploration Success Rate-Up +10%p item.
- 10%p success rate is added, regardless of the selected difficulty.
- You can buy this item at the Shop with points. An informative pop-up will appear, when you press the Explore button from the Exploration System, and you currently have a Rate-Up item.
[*]Exploration Pileup Progress Event Open
- Points are distributed when you receive exploration rewards.[/list]

[u][h3]Family System Improvement[/h3][/u]
[b]Family Achievement Improvement[/b]
[list][*]Family Rewards Revamped: Changed rewards to fit the current state of the game.
[*]Family Achievement Added: With the addition of new Modes and Scenarios, 9 new achievements have been added.
[*]Quality-of-Life Improvements: You can now exclude the achievements you can't pursue when viewing the achievements, and total points are provided in order to see your overall progress.[/list]
[b]Family Storage Improvement[/b]
[list][*]When listing enhancements/parts weapon, the portion listed without the enhancements/parts information can now be used with the enhancements/parts information.
[*]The method of viewing weapon enhancement information and part information in storage (outlines, tooltip, etc.) is now displayed the same way as personal inventory.[/list]
[b]Other Information[/b]
[list][*]Added Login rate information of the past week to Family Search List and Main Page.
- This information changes in real-time and it marks your attendance if you log in at least one out of the seven days.
- This information is also available on Family Search, so it can help determine which Family members have actually been active in the past week.
[*]If inappropriate actions are detected in certain gaming environments related to Family Storage, level or count limits can be implemented to limit item listings/usage.
[*]It's been decided that one of the Family Emblems is inappropriate so it's been changed to a different image.[/list]


[h2][New Events][/h2]

[u][h3]Playtime Pileup Event (12/1 - 12/15)[/h3][/u]You can get rewards for completing the following missions during the event. You also get various rewards based on the total number of completions.

[b]Daily Rewards[/b]
[list][*]Event Conditions / Rewards
- Obtain 500 mileage upon reaching 30 minutes of playtime
- Obtain Unique Decoder x3 upon reaching 60 minutes of playtime[/list]
[b]Cumulative Rewards[/b]
[list][*]Event Conditions / Rewards
- Total Playtime one time: Special Agent Criss (2 Days) + Boss David Black (2 Days)
- Total Playtime three times: Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon (100) x5 + Enhanced Weapon Selection Box x1
- Total Playtime five times: Drill Instructor Gerard (30 Days) + Private Erica (30 Days)
- Total Playtime seven times: Zombie Scenario Add-On x20
- Total Playtime nine times: Hunter-Killer X-90 (Permanent)(Gun Boost Part - Grade 6 + Vampiric Part - Grade 6).
- Total Playtime eleven times: VVIP Free Pass (5 Days)
- Total Playtime thirteen times: Class Decoder x10[/list]
[b]Notice[/b]
[list][*]Daily rewards can be obtained once a day per account.
[*]Cumulative reward can be obtained only once per account.
[*]You can earn the Cumulative reward upon reaching 30 minutes of playtime.
[*]Only rooms with 4+ players count toward the event.
[*]It counts in all modes, including Studio Mode.
[*]Enhanced Weapon Selection Box will be removed during maintenance on 12/15 (Wed.)[/list]

[u][h3]Mission Clear Event (12/1 - 12/15)[/h3][/u]You can get event rewards for completing the following missions during the event.

[b]Event Conditions / Rewards[/b]
[list][*]Complete Zombie Scenario Mode on Hard difficulty or higher 2 times for Event Decoder x1
[*]Transform into random monster once in the new Zombie Scenario Event Mode for Zombie Scenario Add-On Box x3

[u][h3]Mission Clear Pileup Event (12/1 - 12/15)[/h3][/u]You will receive rewards based on the number of Event Decoders used over the duration of the event.

[u][h3]Exploration Pileup Event (12/1 - Permanent)[/h3][/u]You can earn permanent Transcendence Weapons based on the exploration completed total points for each difficulty.

[u][h3]Free Daily Rewards Event (12/1 – 12/29)[/h3][/u]

[u][h3]New Transcendence Class Guaranteed Giveaway (12/1 - 12/29)[/h3][/u]You will be guaranteed to receive the two new Transcendence Classes based on the number of Class Decoders and Premium Class Decoders used during the event!

[b]Conditions and Obtainable Items[/b]
[list][*]Reach 150 / 300 guaranteed points and Select either Roy or Romy + Roy's Keepsake Hat or Romy's Survival Pack.[/list]
[b]Roy's Keepsake Hat[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/1deb91f380a537d62125884f3f73cf083bc038ba.png[/img]
[list][*]A keepsake from his father. He never puts it on his own head, but he won't go on a mission without it.[/list]
[b]Romy's Survival Pack[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/406ba1824d4223d50a61db84fa71f328c27f02e2.png[/img]
[list][*]A pack containing everything essential to survival. The more experienced you get, the more things you need to carry.[/list]
[b]Notice[/b]
[list][*]1 Guaranteed Points given each time you use 1 Class Decoder.
[*]3 Guaranteed Points given each time you use 1 Premium Class Decoder.
[*]If you receive Transcendence Class Roy (Permanent), his costume Roy's Keepsake Hat (Permanent) is automatically distributed.
[*]If you receive Transcendence Class Romy (Permanent), her costume Romy's Survival Pack (Permanent) is automatically distributed.

[u][h3]New Transcendence Class Medal Giveaway (12/1 - Permanent)[/h3][/u]When you own all items in the new Transcendence Classes set, you will receive the Transcendence Class medal.

[b]Conditions and Obtainable Items[/b]

[list][*][Honor] City Survivor Medal can be obtained after the 12/1 (Wed) maintenance without event period limit.
[*]The medal can be obtained only once per account.[/list]


[h2][Shop Update][/h2]

[u][h3]New Transcendence Classes, Roy & Romy Promotion (12/1 - 12/29)[/h3][/u]During the event, the drop rate of the two new transcendence classes from Class Decoders and Premium Class Decoders is four times higher!

[b]Roy and Romy Drop Rates[/b]
[list][*]Premium Class Decoder: 2% each
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/57ed2c6f23a582b6f905813e8db6117246d95e70.png[/img]

[b]Roy[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/9b7db733b50d19815e7c33f95b48ddd7e735cfe3.png[/img]
[list][*]Romy's older brother. His fast thinking and survival skills come from his father, a former guard captain of Lost City, and were essential to the siblings' survival. He wanted to become a soldier himself, but he was hugely disappointed when the Lost City army fell apart. Nowadays, he wishes to just be a normal salaryman, but is forced to do mercenary work to make ends meet.
[*]Paired Effect: Area duration is increased when using Laevateinn's special feature.

Even though she had to dedicate herself to school and housework after their parents passed away, she was still a cheerful, carefree girl. While she has no military experience, her soldier father trained her in marksmanship. Combined with survival instincts honed from living in the hell that is Lost City, Romy proves herself to be more than just some schoolgirl.

notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: November 17th
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/6f8105a9ddb886339a882e3af2f2b687220e9a40.jpg[/img]

Here's a rundown of some of the major updates in today's patch!
[list][b]Content: Part Open Weapon Added[/b]
You can now equip a part on Plasma Gun and SKULL-1!

[b]Promotion: Lucky Transcendence Weapon Box Promotion (11/17 - 12/1)[/b]
For Black Friday, the Lucky Transcendence Weapon Box, which contains a total of 20 types of Transcendence Weapons including 2 Special Weapons, will be sold! Only Transcendence Weapons (Permanent) appear in the Lucky Transcendence Weapon Box, so don't miss out!

[b]Promotion: Lucky Transcendence Weapon Box 1+1 Promotion (11/17 - 12/1)[/b]
The '1+1 Lucky Transcendence Weapon Box', which gives an additional Lucky Transcendence Weapon Box, will be sold! Don't miss out![/list]Check out the Details section below for more information.

[h1]---------- Details ----------[/h1]
 
[h2]New Content[/h2]

[h3]Part Open Weapon Added[/h3]
You can now equip a part on SKULL-1 and Plasma Gun.

[b]Part Open Weapon Added[/b]
[list][*]SKULL-1
[*]Plasma Gun[/list]
[b]Balance Adjustment[/b]
[list][*]SKULL-1's damage has increased in Zombie Scenario Mode.
[*]Plasma Gun's damage has increased in Zombie and Zombie Scenario Modes.[/list]
[b]Zombie Z Unlock Level Adjustments[/b]
[list][*]SKULL-1: Changed from level 1 to 14.
[*]Plasma Gun: Changed from level 1 to 14.[/list]


[h2]New Events[/h2]

[h3]1+1=11 Let's Play Together (11/17 – 12/1)[/h3]
If you earn a set amount of points during the event, you can earn rewards. New or returning players can collect the points more easily.

[b]Conditions[/b]
[list][*]New players or players that haven't logged-in for 30 days earn 10 points per 11 minutes of playtime.
[*]Players who have been playing the game regularly earn 5 points per 11 minutes of playtime[/list]
[b]Reward[/b]
[list][*]When you log in, you will receive a SKULL-1(15 Days) and a Plasma Gun (15 Days) equipped with parts.
[*]VIP Free Pass (3 Days) for reaching 100 points
[*]VVIP Free Pass (1 Day) for reaching 200 points
[*]Enhanced Weapon Selection Box x3 + Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon (200) x3 for reaching 300 points
[*]Transcendence Decoder x3 + Transcendence Enhanced Weapon Selection Box x3 for reaching 400 points[/list]
[b]Notice[/b]
[list][*]You can earn up to 30 points a day.
[*]Participation will only count in rooms with four or more players (includes Studio Mode).
[*]Any unused Transcendence Enhanced Weapon Selection Box and Enhanced Weapon Selection Box will be removed during maintenance on 12/1.[/list]

[h3]Special Mission Completion Event (11/17 - 12/1)[/h3]
Each day that you meet the conditions, you can receive various rewards such as a Transcendence Decoder.

[b]Event Condition and Rewards (Each condition can be met once per day)[/b]
[list][*]10 minutes of login time: 500 Mileage
[*]30 minutes of login time: Rare Decoder x5 + 2x EXP UP
[*]60 minutes of login time + complete 1 special mission: Event Decoder x1 + 1 Random Grade 4 Part
[*]90 minutes of login time + complete 1 special mission: Choose 1 from Season Badge x25, Unique Decoder x1, or 1500 mileage 
[*]120 minutes of login time + complete 1 special mission: Choose 1 from Season Badge x50 or Transcendence Decoder x1[/list]
[b]Special Mission (Can complete one of the following three missions per day)[/b]
[list][*]Score 10 Zombie kills or assists in Zombie Hero/Zombie Evolution/Zombie Z Modes (excluding bots and Studio Mode)
[*]Complete Zombie Scenario Mode on Hard difficulty or higher 2 times (excluding Double Gate, Lost City, Survival: Trap, and Survival: Groundwater)
[*]Complete Zombie Escape Mode 4 times (including Studio Mode)[/list]
[b]Notice[/b]
[list][*]Participation will only count in rooms with four or more players
[*]Certain maps from Zombie Scenario are excluded from the conditions.
[*]2x EXP UP item grants extra EXP for 3 hours starting from the time you get it, and the item disappears at midnight on the next day, regardless of how much time was left.[/list]

[h3]1÷1=11 Divide to Multiply Auction Event (11/17 – 11/30 23:59)[/h3]
During the event, you can use the Auction House, where players trade weapons and parts with one another. The Dual Beretta Gunslinger has been added as an auction item.
[list][*]Auction House Availability 00:00 - 23:59
[*]Added Auction Item: Dual Beretta Gunslinger[/list]

[h3]1,000 Mileage Auction Event (11/17 - 11/30 23:59)[/h3]
During the auction period, the Dual Beretta Gunslinger will appear as a special item at a particular time every day.

[b]Special Item Appearance Times[/b]
[list][*]The item has a chance of appearing between the following hours
- 11/17 15:00 - 16:00 (SEA : 9PM ~ 10PM)
- 11/18 21:00 - 22:00
- 11/19 2:00 - 3:00 (ET : 9PM ~ 10PM)
- 11/20 15:00 - 16:00 (SEA : 9PM ~ 10PM)
- 11/21 21:00 - 22:00
- 11/22 2:00 - 3:00 (ET : 9PM ~ 10PM)
- 11/23 5:00 - 6:00 (PT : 9PM ~ 10PM)
- 11/24 15:00 - 16:00 (SEA : 9PM ~ 10PM)
- 11/25 21:00 - 22:00
- 11/26 2:00 - 3:00 (ET : 9PM ~ 10PM)

- 11/28 21:00 - 22:00
- 11/29 2:00 - 3:00 (ET : 9PM ~ 10PM)
- 11/30 5:00 - 6:00 (PT : 9PM ~ 10PM)[/list][b]Notice[/b]
[list][*]After the special auction ends, the 1,000 mileage used for bidding will be refunded to those who did not win.

[h3]Lucky Transcendence Weapon Box Giveaway (11/17 - 12/1)[/h3]
You can receive a Lucky Transcendence Weapon Box x1 for reaching 11 total login days during the event. You can check the details of Lucky Transcendence Weapon Box at the Lucky Transcendence Weapon Box Promotion Announcement




[h2]Shop Update[/h2]

[h3]Lucky Transcendence Weapon Box Promotion (11/17 - 12/1)[/h3]
For Black Friday, the Lucky Transcendence Weapon Box, which contains a total of 20 types of Transcendence Weapons including 2 Special Weapons, will be sold. Only Transcendence Weapons (Permanent) appear in the Lucky Transcendence Weapon Box.

[h3]Zombie Starter Package Contents Update (11/7 - until next announcement)[/h3]

notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: November 3rd
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/e267ec13f8bcbaaeab357ea5cd9643e9fcde6d87.jpg[/img]

Here's a rundown of some of the major updates in today's patch!

[list][b]Content: Studio Mode Update[/b]
A Studio-version map of Zombie Escape! Experience escaping from the ruins riddled with deadly traps while being chased by zombies!

[b]Content: Zombie Escape Improvements[/b]
The fan favorite Zombie Escape returns with all-new improvements. Check It Out Now!
	
[b]Event: Studio Jungle Theme Contest[/b]
Our studio contest begins with the Studio Jungle Theme block update and Zombie Escape improvements! Please check the separate announcement. We hope you participate!

[b]Promotion: New Transcendence Weapon "Laevateinn" Release![/b]
This weapon holds 50 rounds of explosive ammo that explodes when it hits the target! Come check out this new Transcendence Weapon and all its special features![/list]
Check out the Details section below for more information.

[h1]---------- Details ----------[/h1]
 
[h2]New Content[/h2]

[h3]Studio Mode Update[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/a38ccc3c2f013871837e6540c87e4dcc18034f4f.png[/img]

[b] New Studio Zombie Escape Map [Ruins] Release![/b]
[list]
[*] A Studio-version map of the CSNS fan favorite Zombie Escape! Escape from the ruins riddled with deadly traps while being chased by zombies.
[*] Various trap devices exclusive to Studio Mode are placed in the map.[/list]
[b] Studio Block Update
[/b][list]
[*] New Jungle Theme decorations and device blocks have been added.
[/list]


[h3]Zombie Escape Improvements[/h3]

[b]Improvements[/b]
[list][*] Weapon Balance Improvements
[list]
[*] Added weapon restriction options (Original, New Original, etc.)
[*] Invincibility functionality on some weapons restricted
[*] Melee weapon and grenade balance changes (stun and knockback restriction)
[*] Humans respawn with previous weapon
[/list]
[*] Increased Zombie Selection Pool
[list]
[*] Added Heavy Zombie, Stamper zombie, and Banshee zombie
[*] Added zombie skills
Zombies have their skill cooldowns reduced when they take hits.
[*] Zombie Limit Possible
[/list]
[*] Other Improvements
[list]
[*] Zombie balance improvements
Infected zombie's HP becomes 30000 and Armor becomes 8000.
[*] Added various effects to the Zombie Escape Progress feature.
[*] Human Sprint Gauge: By landing hits on zombies, humans can fill up their Sprint gauge.
When striking a zombie within one notch of the leading zombie (on the Zombie Escape progress bar), it will start to fill up the Sprint gauge even more quickly.
[*] Zombie Buff: Zombies' stun and knockback resistance grows stronger with the Zombie Buff.
[list][*] When the leading human and the leading zombie become 4 or more notches apart on the Zombie Escape progress bar, zombies gain a buff to stun and knockback resistance.
[*] When a zombie who's 7 or more notches behind the leading zombie (on the Zombie Escape progress bar) respawns, they respawn closer to the leading zombie.[/list][/list][/list]


[h2]New Events[/h2]

[h3]Bonus Disassembly Event (11/3 - 11/17)[/h3]

Use the Bonus Disassembly System during the event to disassemble your weapons, and you might even get a few fully disassembled!

[list]
[*] Event Dates and Criteria
[list][*] Both Weekdays and Weekends - 13:00 – 17:00 CET (SEA: 19:00 – 23:00)
[*] Minimum Participation Mileage: 5,000[/list]

[*] Added New Items for Disassembly
[list][*] SG552 Cerberus
[*] Failnaught[/list][/list]


[h3]Play Zombie Escape Mode Event (11/3 - 11/17)[/h3]
You will receive rewards for successfully completing all the Zombie Escape Mode missions during the event!

[list]
[*] Conditions
[list][*] Successfully escape in the new Studio Jungle Theme map.
[*] Complete the session in a successful escape in other Zombie Escape maps 2 times[/list]
[*] Reward
[list][*] Receive Add-On x20 + Grade 5 Parts Reward Box x1[/list]
[*] Notice
[list][*] You can only make mission progress in rooms with four or more players (includes Studio Mode).
[*] Reward can be claimed once per account.[/list][/list]


[h3]New Transcendence Weapon Guaranteed Giveaway (11/3 - 11/17)[/h3]
Depending on the number of Transcendence Premium Decoders and Transcendence Decoders used during the event, you may be guaranteed to receive the Laevateinn!

[list]
[*] Conditions and Rewards
[list][*] You will receive a Laevateinn (Permanent) every time you reach 300 points.[/list]
[*] Notice
[list][*] 6 Guaranteed Points given each time you use 1 Transcendence Premium Decoder.
[*] 1 Guaranteed Point given each time you use 1 Transcendence Decoder.[/list][/list]


[h3]Autumn Leaves Box Collection Event (11/3 – 11/17)[/h3]
Receive abundant gifts and per-stage special rewards from Autumn Leaves Box based on the playtime you reach during the event.

[list]
[*] Daily Conditions and Rewards
[list][*] You will receive one Autumn Leaves Box every time you accumulate 10 minutes of playtime each day (Max of 6 times per day for 60 minutes).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/66204810ccd2d9e6d41203bab07e655d283b36c8.png[/img]
[/list]
[*] Pileup Conditions and Rewards
You can receive per-stage special rewards based on the total playtime you accumulate during the event.
[list][*] Stage 1 (total playtime 180 minutes): One of all content in the Autumn Leaves Box

notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: October 6th
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/7df18408e8a424eddcc262e907a0c75b57b38a43.jpg[/img]

Here's a rundown of some of the major updates in today's patch!
[list][b]Content: New Zombie Scenario Season 7 Map[/b]
Check out this new mission held in a virtual training ground!

[b]Content: Class Change System[/b]
Check out the in-game class change system, how to change, and the eligible modes!
	
[b]Promotion: New Transcendence Weapon "Failnaught" Release![/b]
Get the holy arrow firing, Failnaught now!

[b]Promotion: New Transcendence Classes Ismael and Ethan Release![/b]
A noble vampire-human hybrid and a righteous inquisitor who eliminates evil. Get them and their paired weapon Failnaught today![/list]Check out the Details section below for more information.


[h1]---------- Details ----------[/h1]
 
[h2]New Content[/h2]

[h3]New Zombie Scenario Season 7 Map[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/53e5a54f48b3bb17c14297e33a5cd6b93614462d.png[/img]

[b]Pursuit: Evelyn's Test A[/b][list][*] Another challenging virtual combat simulation held for only the bravest combatants.[/list]

[h3]Class Change System[/h3]

[b]In-game Class Change[/b]
[list][*] Class changing is now available for start of the next round.[/list]
[b]How to Change[/b]
[list][*] Use designated key(H) during the round to bring up the class selection window.
[*] Select your new class then select "Change Class Next Round".
[*] Your new class will be applied at the start of the next round.[/list]
[b]Eligible Modes[/b]
[list][*] Zombie, Zombie Original, Zombie Mutant, Zombie Hero, Zombie Z, Zombie Evolution, Zombie Escape, Zombie Darkness modes
[*] Reviving as a human from a zombie using Karma won't apply the class changes because it is not the next round.
[*] Zombie Z additional mutation feature change - Only 1 additional mutation can be acquired from the initial buff class selection phase.
[*] Classes with EXP/Points bonuses will be calculated by each class's playtime.[/list]

[h3]New Transcendence Class Medal Distribution[/h3]

[b]Conditions (Requires Permanent Version)[/b]
[list][*] Ismael
[*] Ethan
[*] Black Rose Shuriken
[*] Inquisitor's Hourglass[/list]
[b]Obtainable Items[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/54b6200efd4430ab3b25adc9c6c872c509b53a4e.png[/img]
[list][*] [Honor] The Hunter and The Inquisitor: A medal given to those who have obtained Ismael, Black Rose Shuriken, Ethan, and Inquisitor's Hourglass.[/list]　
[b]Notice [/b][list][*] The medal can be obtained only once per account.[/list]


[h2]New Events[/h2]

[h3]Free Daily Rewards Event (10/6 - 11/3[/h3]

[b]Daily Rewards[/b]
[list][*]Daily Weapons Supply
- Contents: 3 Transcendence Weapons (1 Day) + 1 Daily Attendance Reward Box[/list]
 [b]Cumulative Rewards[/b]
[list][*] 5 Days: M3 Black Dragon (15 Days) 
[*] 10 Days: Barrett M95 White Tiger (15 Days) 
[*] 15 Days: Magnum Launcher (15 Days)
[*] 20 Days: Dual Beretta Gunslinger (15 Days)
[*] 25 Days: Dread Nova (5 Days)[/list]
[b]Extra Cumulative Rewards Event[/b]
[list][*] Each time you receive cumulative rewards, you'll receive a Cumulative Attendance Reward Box.[/list]

[h3]Fireworks Crafting Festival! (10/6 – 10/20)[/h3]Earn rewards by creating firework sets from the three materials earned during the event! It's a blast!

[b]How To Earn Materials[/b]
[list][*] Fuse: Earn 1 every time you reach 30/40/60 minutes of playtime (up to 3 a day)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/2d01ae14e3bf8ba4d9fe1accde744ccb87e45ccd.png[/img]
[*] Spark: Earn 1 each time you clear one session of the new Zombie Scenario map on Hard or harder difficulty (up to 3 a day)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/772724f7d5dde53cdb55ce9d28cfe397dcc711d2.png[/img]
[*] Gunpowder: Earn 1 each time you score 5 zombie kills or 10 assists (excluding bots) in Zombie Z, Zombie Evolution, or Zombie Hero modes (up to 3 a day)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/1929be63c9ba435d7db52de1399a3527ec7082ff.png[/img][/list] 
[b]Creating Fireworks Sets and Rewards[/b]
[list][*] 1 Fuse + 1 Spark + 1 Gunpowder = 1 Fireworks Set
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/974cd544459ce824db2762c179ef75299fc8afed.png[/img]
[*] Obtain 1 Fireworks Set: Rare Decoder x5
[*] Pileup 2 Firework Sets: Grade 5 Parts Reward Box (x2)
[*] Pileup 3 Firework Sets: Event Decoder (x2) + Add-On Box (x5)[/list]
[b]Notice[/b]

While charging up, the Hunter's Eye activates, allowing you to learn the location of enemies within a certain distance and attack through obstacles. The default firing mode's auto-aim and stack effects, as well as the Hunter's Eye, will not be triggered in specific modes (Zombie/Human Scenario, Zombie Shelter, or Zombie Giant).

Her pride as nobility has become a twisted defense mechanism that leads her to sneer at everything. While she appears human, her vampiric blood gives her great physical abilities. She is the sole survivor of her family. Her parents were executed by the inquisitors when the townsfolk sold them out. She has joined a hunter's guild who highly value her abilities, making a living killing those who could be her brothers or sisters.

Infinite Ammo effect is applied during the duration of this buff (herself and allies). Allies within a certain distance get the buff, but the HP restoring skill is only applied to herself.[/list]

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/9721224a9e4eb423f1d43ae7108e3a727a7e3712.jpg[/img]

Here's a rundown of some of the major updates in today's patch!
[list][b]Content: Season 10: Steampunk[/b]
Grab your gear and begin your journey to a steampunk world that lies on the border between fantasy and reality: a place where past and future coexist!

[b]Content: Zombie Update[/b]
From Zombie Z mode unlock level adjustments to mutation balance updates, check out all the changes now!
	
[b]Event: Full Moon Festival[/b]
Make fun memories with friends and get massive rewards with all the Moon Festival events![/list]Check out the Details section below for more information.


[h1]---------- Details ----------[/h1]
 
[h2]New Content[/h2]

[h3]Season 10: Steampunk[/h3]
[b]Season Information[/b][list][*] The tenth season's theme is steampunk! For details, please refer to the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/273110/announcements/detail/2954912787241224481]Season 10 News Slides![/url][/list]
[b]Black Market Open Early[/b][list][*]Starting with Season 9, the Black Market will open early for players who reach Rank 100.
[*]When you reach Rank 100 on the Season Pass currently in progress, the Season Missions will end and missions you can get Black Market Badges from will start anew.
[*]New Item Added: CSN:S-Brand Hip Pack (Costume)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/5ef27158549e85af0024d6f4815084730fb0ee22.png[/img]
- A CSN:S-brand hip pack. Can be equipped on the waist.
[*]You can access the Black Market from the Mission menu. Players who have not reached Rank 100 can use the Black Market only during the off-season period.
[*]All Black Market Badges you've obtained will disappear when a new season begins.

[*]Growing Weapon
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/470dbcbe7ce9aa93429addde91ec6c89cacffc8b.png[/img]
- Gear-Bird Cannon Mk. 1: A powerful cannon that blasts a certain area in front. (Season 10 Reward Weapon - Growing Weapon Stage 1)

notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: August 25th
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/09277c946997b6fcec31dc007fc714c8f467f288.jpg[/img]

New Content and Events have been added!


[h2]New Content[/h2]

[h3]Information Accessibility and Player Quality-of-Life Improvements[/h3]Made improvements to areas that were inconvenient or lacking in information about the game. Also updated areas that can help players make the best use of the game’s features, as below. You can find details in the [Convenience Feature Updates and the Mission Chain System Preview].

[b]Hideout Improvements[/b][list][*]Hideout's base mode is changed to Zombie Z.
[*]Updates include adjustments to the Firing Range features, command help, expansion of the space next to the Firing Range, etc.[/list]
[b]Encyclopedia[/b][list][*] Various sorting filters, including Zombie Z unlock level, have been added.
[*]Information on parts, enhancement, ratings, etc. has been fleshed out.[/list]
[b]Event/Season Missions Unified Under the Missions Page[/b][list][*] Event details, which had previously been split between the Notifications page and the Missions page, have been unified under the Missions page.[/list]
[b]Mission Chain System - Tutorial Mission Added[/b][list][*]Added the Mission Chain system, consisting of 25 guides and 25 missions.
[*]You can only clear one Mission Chain stage (5 guides and 5 missions) per day.
[*]Per-Stage Completion Rewards
- Stage 1: Hunter-Killer X-90 (Permanent)
- Stage 2: Dual Sword Infernal Hunter (Permanent)
- Stage 3: Transcendence Yuri (Permanent)
- Stage 4: Claymore (Permanent)
- Stage 5: Python Desperado (Permanent)[/list]
[b]Mission Chain Final Completion Rewards[/b][list][*]Hunter-Killer X-12 (Permanent) + Complete the Guide Medal[/list]
[b]Notice[/b][list][*]The table above only shows the stage rewards and the final rewards. There are also interim rewards for checking out the guides, as well as rewards for completing the individual missions.[/list]
[b]Complete the Guide Medal[/b][list][*]Type: Medal
[*]Description: A token for those who have completed all the missions of the Mission Chain tutorial[/list]


[h2]New Events[/h2]

[h3]Random Weapon Zombie Hero Event (8/25 - 9/8)[/h3]During this event, you can play the Random Weapon Zombie Hero mode! Blast your foes with new weapons, popular weapons, and even +6 weapons! Test your luck!

[b]Featured Maps:[/b][list][*] Italy, Assault, and Dust[/list]
[b]New Weapons:[/b][list][*] Blazing Nova, Twin Shadow Axes, Astra, Satellite Mine, Blue Storm, Devastator, and Elemental Tracker[/list]
[b]Notice:[/b][list][*] When you're on the Zombie Team, your zombie class will be selected based on a set percentage chance for each class.
[*]When you're on the Human Team, each of your primary weapons, secondary weapons, melee weapons, and grenades will be selected based on a set percentage chance for each weapon/grenade.
[*]Base game rules are the same as those for Zombie Hero mode.
[*]The weapon list is provided by default, regardless of what each individual owns.
[*]Armor given will be fixed.
[*]When using a Supply Box (by pressing the E key), you will not enter the shop window. Instead, you will re-select another weapon, with the same percentage chances.
[*]Players cannot select human heroes in this event mode.[/list]

[h3]Burning Playtime Event (8/25 - 9/8)[/h3]During the event, based on the reward thresholds you meet each day, you can get earn for Stages 1-2, in that order.

[b]Conditions/Burning Rewards:[/b][list][*] 10 minutes of playtime: Stage 1
[*] 60 minutes of playtime: Stage 2[/list]
[b]Burning Rewards:[/b][list][*] Stage 1 (Select 1): Unique Decoder x1/Event Decoder x1/Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon (100) x1/3,000 mileage/Grade 4 Parts Reward Box x1
[*] Stage 2 (Select 1): Unique Decoder x2/Event Decoder x2/Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon (100) x2/4,000 mileage/Grade 4 Parts Reward Box x2[/list]
[b]Notice:[/b][list][*] Rewards can only be claimed once a day per account.
[*] Playtime only accumulates in rooms of 4 or more players.
[*] You can use the Event Decoder until before midnight on the day you obtain it.[/list]

[h3]Burning Login Event (8/25 - 9/8)[/h3]You can receive the following rewards based on the total number of days you log in during the event.

[b]Conditions/Cumulative Login Rewards (Select 1):[/b][list][*] 5 days and 10 days of cumulative logins, respectively: Transcendence Decoder x4/Class Decoder x5/Weapon Enhancement EXP Coupon (200) x3/10,000 mileage/Grade 5 Parts Reward Box x6[/list]
[b]Notice:[/b][list][*] Can only be claimed once per account.
[*] Cumulative login rewards can be claimed a total of 2 times during the event period.[/list]

[h3]JANUS IS BACK Event (8/25 - 10/6)[/h3]During the event, you can enjoy the JANUS series weapons in Zombie/Zombie Scenario modes with their enhanced specs.

[b]Weapons Affected by Event (balance changes apply only during the event period):[/b][list][*] JANUS-3: Damage in both normal mode and Janus Mode is increased.
[*] JANUS-1, JANUS-5, JANUS-7, and JANUS-11: Damage in both normal mode and Janus Mode is increased. Janus Mode's activation conditions are eased.
[*] JANUS-9: Damage in both normal mode and Janus Mode is increased. Janus Mode range is increased.[/list]
[b]Zombie Z Level Adjustments[/b][list][*]Due to the balance changes, the Zombie Z unlock levels for the JANUS series weapons will be changed during the event. (Unlock level adjustments only apply during the event period.)
- JANUS-1: 1 -> 7
- JANUS-3: 1 -> 4
- JANUS-5: 1 -> 17
- JANUS-7: 1 -> 19
- JANUS-9: 1 -> 3
- JANUS-11: 1 -> 10[/list]

notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: August 11th
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/5de839959ecc67f0b3a4ec67ed7e7324fefe1599.jpg[/img]

Here's a rundown of some of the major updates in today's patch!
[list][b]Content: New Zombie Scenario 7-4 Map[/b]
David and Erica learn the truth. Check out the next chapter of the story right now!

[b]Content: Studio Zombie Scenario Features[/b]
A mysterious benefactor drives Gerard to his limits. Track him down in Researcher's Log #7!
	
[b]Content: Zombie Z Season 2 Content Update[/b]
From mutation balancing to gameplay experience improvements — check out all the changes![/list]See the Details section below for more information.


[h1]---------- Details ----------[/h1]
 
[h2]New Content[/h2]

[u][h3]Zombie New Scenario 7-4 Map[/h3][/u][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/65697c7959978a96b439598e2c014daf0979f66a.png[/img]
[b]Pursuit: Truth Uncovered[/b]
[list][*] Information: David and Erica travel to the coordinates they found in the laboratory. When they arrive, they meet Gerard instead of Dr. Soi. Gerard tells them about the man behind Rex: Douglas, who was also behind Erica's abduction. After learning the truth, David and Erica find new resolve, even while Douglas' forces draw ever closer...

[*] For more details, see the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/273110/announcements/detail/2975177081638735896][Zombie Scenario Season 7-4 Preview][/url].[/list]

[u][h3]Studio Zombie Scenario Features[/h3][/u]
[b]Studio Zombie Scenario Update[/b][list][*] Play Mode rules added: Level Rules and Difficulty Rules
[*] Device added: Cutscene Camera device, Ranking Board features expanded
[*] For more details, see the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/273110/announcements/detail/2975177081638750640][Studio Zombie Scenario Update Preview][/url].[/list]
[b]Researcher's Log #7: The Search[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/052a5075e71378c0bd5458e7349649cd33a88444.png[/img]
[list][*] A mysterious figure with unknown motives approaches Gerard. Calling himself a friend, the figure drives Gerard to his limits... Track down this mystery man to learn his intentions and identity![/list]

[u][h3]Zombie Z Season 2 Content Update[/h3][/u]
[b]Mutation Balance Updates[/b]
[list][*] Rapid Reloader: Lowered the value added per round, so that the number of rounds it takes for auto-reload to trigger is now 17 rounds
[*] Gene Booster: Now guaranteed to get at Zombie Z Lv.30
[*] Endurance: Activation rate now increases when you upgrade Endurance to Lv. 2
[*] Incendiary Ammo: Increased the base damage of the fire that the Incendiary Ammo creates
[*] Contact Infection: Greatly reduced the base range, and removed the stun effect, for Contact Infection damage, but revised it so that it now increases in range as the round progresses.
[*] Drop Zone: Reduced the chance to make an enemy in the air fall
[*] Support Bombardment: Increased the chance for Support Bombardment to trigger
[*] Explosive Reaction: Reduced the increase, as the round progresses, in the damage required to create a Zombie Bomb
[*] Fireball: Increased the base damage; when Mutation Boost is activated, burst now fires 2 Fireballs
[*] Bomb Defense: Greatly increased the knockback resistance against Zombie Bomb; additionally, if you have the Bomb Defense mutation, it now reduces the screen shake from Zombie Bomb
[*] Supply Contamination: Increased the number of supply boxes you can infect
[*] Furiously Fast: Increased the remaining HP threshold for the mutation to activate, as the round progresses
[*] Poisonous Cloud: Increased the damage and duration, removed stun effect
[*] Darkness: Increased the skill gauge charge amount for Darkness Zombies
[*] Intellectual: Increased humans’ EXP rewards for zombie kills[/list]
[b]Mutation Distribution Method Changes[/b][list][*] Intellectual: Now given at Zombie Z Lv. 1 (if zombie revival restriction is applied)
[*] Specialist: Now given at Zombie Z Lv. 1 (if zombie infinite revival is applied)
[*] Fanatic: Now given at Zombie Z Lv. 20
[*] Gene Booster: Now guaranteed to be given at Zombie Z Lv.30[/list]
[b]Reinforced Challenge Reward + Rewards[/b][list][*]Increased the dollar, EXP, and Karma rewards from eliminating zombies with a weapon purchased through Challenge Reward +
- Kills: 20,000 dollars, 10,000 EXP, and 2x Karma
- Assists: 4,000 dollars, 1,500 EXP, and 2x Karma[/list]
[b]Revamp of “Automatically Improve Zombie” Balance settings[/b][list][*]Automatically Improve Zombie Balance settings will be applied by default. Details are as follows:
[*]For rooms with 30 or more players, the number of Host Zombies spawned will be 4
[*]If the Human Team wins, 1 additional Host Zombie will spawn in the next round
[*]When meeting the following conditions, 1 additional Host Zombie will be spawned:
- ① Human Team wins 2 times in a row

New Contents and Events have been added!


[h2]New Events[/h2]

[h3]Bonus Disassembly Event (7/28 - 8/11)[/h3]During the event, you can participate in the Bonus Disassembly Event by clicking the "Bonus Disassembly" button at the bottom of the Lobby screen. During the Bonus Disassembly Event,10 players can each put up the weapons they want to disassemble, and one player will get extra bonus mileage. Each participant can get 500 mileage for every weapon they disassemble.

[b]Details[/b][list][*]Both Weekdays and Weekends - 19:00 - 23:00 CEST
[*]Minimum Participation Mileage: 5,000
[*]Some items will be adjusted based on the weapon's rarity.
[*]Table's ranks are in the order of highest value first.
[*]Weapon criteria are determined on the day the Bonus Disassembly Event starts. If the weapon's rank changes, its value in the Bonus Disassembly Event will update for its adjusted value.[/list]
[b]Added new items for disassembly[/b][list][*]Twin Shadow Axes
[*]Astra
[*]Magnum Shooter
[*]Devastator
[*]Wind Tracker
[*]Fire Tracker
[*]Lighting Tracker
[*]Elemental Tracker
[*]Blue Storm
[*]Blazing Nova
[*]Satellite Mine[/list]
[b]Special Bonus Event[/b][list][*]To celebrate the release of the Twin Shadow Axes, we increased the chance to win Epic Weapons to be 2 times that for Transcendence Weapons during the event![/list]

[h3]Dark Fragment Collection Event (7/28 - 9/8)[/h3]Complete play missions to get Dark Fragments, which you can exchange for Epic Weapons, Epic Edition Weapons, and other items!

[b]How to Get Dark Fragments[/b] - You can only get up to 30 per day, regardless of which of the below methods you use. [list][*]Each time you score 2 kills or 6 assists, or infect 2 humans, in Zombie Hero/Zombie Z/Zombie Evolution modes, you will receive Dark Fragment x1 (max 20 a day, excludes bots).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/ab1cd2b1dcf139fc2bf0b3c16ac8037cffa061ff.png[/img]
[*]Each time you upgrade a mutation in Zombie Z mode, you will receive Dark Fragment x1 (max 5 a day). 
[*]Each time you clear 1 session of Zombie Scenario mode on Hard or higher difficulty, you will receive Dark Fragment x3 (max 25 a day).
[*]When you reach 60 minutes of playtime, you will receive Dark Fragment x15 (max 15 a day).[/list]
[b]Notice[/b][list][*]You can purchase various items from the Dark Fragment Shop with the Dark Fragments you obtain. Dark Fragments will be deducted when you make a purchase. Don't forget that, as noted in the Dark Fragment Shop Opening Event below, each item will give a certain number of fragments back as a rebate!
[*]You can obtain only up 30 Dark Fragments a day per account (excludes those from using Dark Fragment Boxes).
[*]Participation will only count in rooms with four or more players (excludes Studio Mode).
[*]For Zombie Scenario Mode, participation will only count when you play at least 5 minutes.[/list]

[h3]Dark Fragment Shop Opening Event (7/28 - 9/8)[/h3]You can use Dark Fragments to purchase Epic Weapons, Epic Edition Weapons, and other items from the Dark Fragment Shop!

[b]Astra[/b][list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/b0ea8de137a768a25ccabf737b5684d553c85966.png[/img]

If Astra is still out when it returns, then the projectile will be recovered; otherwise, it will be destroyed. Scoring a headshot with this weapon deals extra damage and also strikes nearby enemies.[/list]

notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: July 14th
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/0c8eed56017ef6d433e8a8b97d2aee5a6eea145e.jpg[/img]

Here's a rundown of some of the major updates in today's patch!
[list][b]Content: Zombie Z Season 2 Update[/b]
The evolution continues! Achieve greater power in Zombie Z!

[b]Content: Mileage Auction System Improvements[/b]
New options for people looking to buy weapons!
	
[b]Event: Get the New Weapon, Magnum Shooter (Permanent)[/b]
Collect Special Ammo and unlock the new weapon, Magnum Shooter (Permanent)!

[b]Promotion: New Transcendence Classes, Anemone & Mirage[/b]
One's a pro gamer, the other is an iconic virtual streamer (and hacker) from the VR platform Chrono World. Now available in Premium Class Decoders![/list]Check out the Details section below for more information.


[h1]---------- Details ----------[/h1]
 
[h2][New Contents][/h2]

[u][h3]Zombie Z Season 2 Update[/h3][/u]
[b]System Revamp[/b]
[list][*]Max level increased from 30 to 40!
[*]Zombies get greater dollar rewards for dealing damage and infecting targets.
[*]Boosted in-game rewards for playing as a zombie.
- Fixed an issue that prevented a zombie from getting dollar rewards for damage dealt immediately before being killed.[/list]
[b]Mutation Improvements[/b]
[list][*]Mutation Enhancement
- Certain mutations can now be enhanced to Lv. 2. Each player can have up to 5 Lv. 2 mutations.
- Press the P key to upgrade one random mutation to Lv. 2. The upgraded mutations will display in the HUD. Each upgrade costs in-game dollars.
- If you already have 5 Lv. 2 mutations, the newly upgraded mutation will randomly replace one of your existing Lv. 2 mutations.
[*]Mutation Boost System
- Mutation Boost lets you temporarily amplify the effects of a Lv. 2 mutation. Mutation Boost lasts for 5 seconds and has a 30 second cooldown.
[*]Added new mutations and improved existing mutations.
- [All] Early Adopter: Reduces all unlock levels by 1.
- [All] Discount Coupon: All purchase amounts in dollars are discounted by 10%.
- [Humans] Quick Change: Increases weapon swap speed.
- [Humans] Double Impact: Grants a low chance to apply damage one additional time.
- [Humans] Net Round: Grants a small chance for attacks to fire a net round.
- [Humans] Glass Cannon: Increases attack power, but also increases damage taken.
- [Humans] Busy Life: Increases attack power when you cannot use skills.
- [Humans] Emergency Escape: Escape into the air after taking what would have been a lethal blow.
- [Zombies] Mutant: Zombie gains an additional skill.
- [Zombies] Furiously Fast: Zombie becomes faster when its HP is low.
- [Zombies] Poisonous Cloud: Creates a cloud of lethal gas when a zombie dies.
- [Zombies] Aggressive Investment: Gain bonus dollars from infected targets.
- [Zombies] Hook Bomb: When a Zombie Bomb explodes, it pulls enemies in.
- [Zombies] Liberator: Increases your strength as you infect more humans.
- [Zombies] Fetch: Inflicting damage with a Zombie Bomb creates a zombie dog.
- [Zombies] Darkness: Allows rebirth as a Darkness Zombie.
- [Changed] Craftsmanship: Reduces skill cooldown.[/list]
[b]The zombies from Zombie 4: Darkness now appear in Zombie Z.[/b]

[b]Weapon purchase process and other gameplay improvements[/b]
[list][*]Added a recommended weapons page that shows recommended weapons for your level.
- This page appears where Bookmark used to be displayed in the purchase window.
[*]Check Weapon Recommendations system improvements
- Recommendations will be sorted and shown in the order of monthly purchase counts in Zombie Z mode, from high to low.
[*]Random Purchase improvements
- Challenge Reward + is added to Random Purchase. When you score kills with the weapon that is purchased, you will receive additional rewards.
- This bonus only applies to weapons purchased with Random Purchase (Challenging Reward +) early in the round. It ends when you swap weapons, if you get infected, or when the round ends.
[*]Advanced Random Purchase improvements
- Reduced the weapons pool for Advanced Random Purchase, increasing its usability.
[*]Added a checkbox to close the purchase window
- Added the option to toggle closing the purchase window pop-up on or off.
[*]HP bar display for attack target
- An HP bar will display for any enemy you hit directly and any enemy you target with your crosshair for 2 seconds or longer.[/list]

[u][h3]Mileage Auction System Improvement[/h3][/u][list][*]You can now place buy orders when you want to purchase a weapon
- Looking to Buy tab: Choose a weapon and list the price you want to buy it for.
- Eligible weapons: Regular auctionable items that haven't had any successful transactions in a while.
- Bidding: Potential sellers can browse bids in the Looking to Sell tab.
- The auction runs for 1 hour after the buy listing is posted. One seller is chosen from among those who offered to fulfill the bid and the transaction is completed.
- If the number of sellers exceeds a certain threshold within the 1 hour limit, the auction will end early.[/list]

[u][h3]New Transcendence Class Medal Distribution[/h3][/u]When you own all items in the new Transcendence Classes set, you will receive the Transcendence Class medal.

[b]Medal[/b]
[list][*][Honor] Twins
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/5b0fb596f2991e4c9a98f28ddc2b39e2c5581aa8.png[/img][/list]
[b]How to Obtain This Medal (Requires Permanent Version)[/b]
[list][*]Anemone
[*]Mirage
[*]VR HMD
[*]Drone[/list]
[b]Notice[/b]
[list][*]Each account can receive this reward only once.[/list]


[h2][New Events][/h2]

[u][h3]Free Daily Rewards Event (7/14 - 8/11)[/h3][/u]Join the battle every day to get rewards, get rewards for getting rewards, and get even more event rewards on top of that!

[b]Daily Rewards[/b]
[list][*]Daily Weapons Supply
- Contents: 2 Transcendence Weapons (1 Day) and 1 Daily Attendance Reward Box[/list]
[b]Cumulative Rewards[/b]
[list][*]5 Days: M3 Black Dragon (5 Days) 
[*]10 Days: M3 Black Dragon (10 Days) 
[*]15 Days: Magnum Launcher (5 Days)
[*]20 Days: Magnum Launcher (15 Days)
[*]25 Days: Gungnir (5 Days)[/list]
[b]Extra Cumulative Rewards Event[/b]
[list][*]Each time you get cumulative rewards (at 5/10/15/20/25 days), you'll receive a Cumulative Attendance Reward Box.[/list]

[u][h3]New and Returning Counter-Strike Fans Welcome Event (7/14 - 8/11)[/h3][/u]New and returning players will receive the following items, based on how many days they log in during the event period!

[b]Rewards (Rewards given based on the number of days logged in)[/b]
[list][*]Login Day 1: New User Package/Welcome Back Supply Box x1
[*]Login Day 2: CSer Settlement Support Weapon Box x1 + Special Ammo x20
[*]Login Day 3: VIP Free Pass (3 Days) + Special Ammo x40
[*]Login Day 4: Broad Divine +5 (30 Days) - Grade 6 Gun Boost + Grade 6 Heal Disruptor
[*]Login Day 5: VVIP Free Pass (1 Day)
[*]Login Day 6: Blade Runebreaker +6 (30 Days)
[*]Login Day 7: Hunter-Killer X-12 (180 Days) - Grade 5 Gun Boost + Grade 5 Speed Up

- Magnum Launcher (1 Day)

[*]CSer Settlement Support Weapon Box Contents

- Red Dragon Cannon +6 (15 Days)

- 1 of each type of Grade 5 part[/list]
[b]Notice[/b]

[u][h3]Special Ammo Collection Event (7/14 - 8/11)[/h3][/u]Collect Special Ammo during the event to unlock a permanent Magnum Shooter.

[b]Rewards[/b]
[list][*]Collect Special Ammo x0: Magnum Shooter (15 Days), granted upon login
[*]Collect Special Ammo x10: 1000 mileage
[*]Collect Special Ammo x20: Grade 4 Parts Reward Box x5

notes.title: [Event] Studio Middle Ages Concept Contest
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/adf21ad44ea3b03f5c555ec05c2ba40d9359e216.jpg[/img]

Create your own map using the Studio Middle Ages Theme that was updated today! Show off your creative skills through this Studio Contest and win up to 300 Transcendence Decoders, Medals of honor, a Trophy, and lots more! The map doesn't need to be Middle Ages just as long as you use the new Middle Ages-themed blocks so have fun and don't miss this one and only chance!

[u][h3]Event Schedule[/h3][/u][list][*]Application Period: 6/16 - 7/14
[*]Finalists Announced: 8/11
[*]Player Vote: 8/11 - 9/1 (All voting participants will receive 1,000 Mileage)
[*]Winners Announced: 9/8
[*]Medal and Trophy Theme Packs Sent Out: 9/8[/list]
[u][h3]How to Participate[/h3][/u][list][*]1. Create a map using the new Middle Ages-themed block and leave a comment on this event's Steam Announcement with the following information to participate. [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/273110/eventcomments/3073125301380265922/]SUBMIT ENTRY HERE![/url]
  - You must add the hashtag '#TheMiddleAges' to the map title to be accepted.
  - You can participate multiple times with multiple maps.

[*]2. You must include this in your Event Entry Comment:
  - Required: In-game Nickname (IGN), Map Name as it appears in the game.
  - Optional: Additional information, such as a brief introduction of the map, etc.[/list]
[u][h3]Evaluation Criteria[/h3][/u][list][*]1. One round of map review after the contest ends.
[*]2. We'll select finalists after an internal evaluation.
[*]3. The winners will be selected on a 50% player vote and 50% Dev Team score.
  - Entries will be rated based on original aspects and setups, as well as creative use of options.
  - Players may make multiple submissions and receive multiple rewards.[/list]
[u][h3]Prizes[/h3][/u][list][*]1st Place: 300 Transcendence Decoders
[*]2nd Place: 200 Transcendence Decoders
[*]3rd Place: 70 Transcendence Decoders
[*]4th - 10th Place: 30 Transcendence Decoders
[*]11th - 20th Place: 20 Transcendence Decoders[/list]
[u][h3]Additional Rewards[/h3][/u][list][*]All Prize Winners: Excellent Creator Medal + Trophy Theme Pack
[*]All Participants: Contest Participation Medal + 5,000 Mileage
[*]Rewards will only be given to maps with a play count of at least 10 and at least 3 recommendations.
[*]If you already have the Excellent Creator Medal, another one will not be given.[/list]

notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: June 16th
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/6b298765e499143705c277b54382abddbf0a47a9.jpg[/img]

Here's a rundown of some of the major updates in today's patch!
[list][b]Content: New Studio Map[/b]
We invite you to a battle for survival between zombies and humans in a medieval fortress!

[b]Content: Studio Block Update[/b]
New Middle Ages-themed decorations and device blocks have been added to Studio and Hide and Seek!
	
[b]Content: Zombie Update[/b]
Check out Zombie Mode balance changes and updated Zombie Z Mode weapon unlock levels.

[b]Promotion: New Transcendence Weapon "Devastator"[/b]
This new Transcendence Weapon is a heavy machine gun that uses .50 incendiary ammo. Its back-mounted magazine allows it to unleash an immense amount of firepower. Get it from the Transcendence Premium Decoder today![/list]Check out the Details section below for more information.


[h1]---------- Details ----------[/h1]
 
[h2][New Contents][/h2]

[u][h3]New Studio Map Information[/h3][/u]
[b]Medieval Fort[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/e4146d47c7415de1d7d2d4d4f46ab2d69315768d.png[/img] 
[list][*]A battle for survival between zombies and humans begins in this fortress from the Middle Ages. This map is a Studio Zombie Hero mode set in a Medieval Fort.[/list]

[u][h3]Studio Block Update[/h3][/u][b]New Middle Ages-themed decorations and device blocks have been added.[/b][list][*]You can find them in Studio and Hide and Seek.[/list]

[u][h3]Zombie Content Update[/h3][/u][b]1. Zombie Z Mode Unlock Level Adjustment[/b]
[list][*]Stun Rifle: 8 -> 10
[*]Stamper: 7 -> 8
[*]SKULL-5: 5 -> 3
[*]Ripper: 9 -> 8
[*]Tiamat MK-3: 8 -> 10
[*]Magnum Drill: 14 -> 13
[*]Poison Launcher: 8 -> 6
[*]Bear Fury Mk. 3: 24 -> 26
[*]Stinger: 24 -> 18
[*]Blistering Bolt Repeater: 26 -> 24
[*]M249 Phoenix: 21 -> 20
[*]Bouncer: 12 -> 10
[*]Blade Runebreaker: 18 -> 20
[*]Infinity Laser Fist: 22 -> 24
[*]Eternity Laser Fist: 22 -> 24
[*]Star Chaser SR: 18 -> 16
[*]Shining Heart Rod: 20 -> 18
[*]Starlight Rolling Shooter: 22 -> 24[/list]
[b]2. Zombie Mode Balance Changes[/b][list][*]When creating a Zombie Mode room, Remove Zombie Permanent Death is activated by default.
[*]Stat bonuses from Zombie limits have been adjusted.
[*]Individual Limit
  - 1 limit (HP and Armor: 0 / Damage Taken: 0 / Auto Recovery: 0)
  - 2 limits (HP and Armor: +1000 -> 0 / Damage Taken: 0 / Auto Recovery: +50 -> 0)
  - 3 limits (HP and Armor: +2000 -> +500 / Damage Taken: -3% -> 0 / Auto Recovery: +100 -> +50)
  - 4 limits (HP and Armor: +3000 -> +1,000 / Damage Taken: -10% -> -5% / Auto Recovery: +300 -> +100)
[*]Round Limit
  - When only Normal Zombies are available after using all zombies (HP and Armor: +3,000 -> +1,000 / Damage Taken: -10% -> -5% / Auto Recovery: +300 -> +100)
[*]In Zombie Z Mode, HP and Armor increases from the Zombie Limit is based on the player's level. (If you limit 4 zombies, it's +900 -> +300 at level 1 in Zombie Z Mode.)[/list]



[h2]New Events[/h2]

[u][h3]Transcendence Chest Giveaway (6/16 - 6/30)[/h3][/u]You can get daily/cumulative rewards for completing the following missions during the event!

[b]Daily Rewards (Can complete each only once a day)[/b][list][*]Reach 10 minutes of playtime: Transcendence Chest x1
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/ccd43b707d7645dc0ad51d6d4e95d5ddd05a57cd.jpg[/img]
[*]Reach 30 minutes of playtime: Transcendence Chest x1
[*]Reach 60 minutes of playtime: Transcendence Chest x1 + CSN:S Event Ticket x1 (once a day)
[*](Zombie Z/Zombie Hero/Zombie Evolution Mode) Score 10 zombie kills or 10 human infections (excluding bots): CSN:S Event Ticket x1 (once a day)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/1dc8d267930d34aea85ceab4ae952edb3cf308f8.png[/img]
[*]Complete Zombie Scenario Mode on Normal difficulty or higher: CSN:S Event Ticket x1 (once a day)
[*]Transcendence Chest: +0-9 Weapon (durational & permanent) and Devastator / Magnum Launcher / Dual Beretta Gunslinger have been added to this box, each with a difference chance to drop.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/8c9d242296df7c78b84ea0eed6406237c1a41b07.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/6b98d34948a5ead0709fd5ebbbcb3daafaaa8d20.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/8f74ce66a19e3a5df5b676f296d3b83554f02428.png[/img][/list][b]Cumulative Rewards[/b][list][*]Collect 9 CSN:S Event Tickets: Transcendence Chest x10 [based on full participation, 3 days]
[*]Collect 18 CSN:S Event Tickets: Transcendence Chest x15 [based on full participation, 6 days]
[*]Collect 27 CSN:S Event Tickets: Transcendence Chest x20 [based on full participation, 9 days]
[*]Collect 42 CSN:S Event Tickets: Transcendence Chest x30 [based on full participation, 15 days][/list]
[b]Notice[/b][list][*]Rewards can only be claimed once per account.
[*]Participation will only count in rooms with four or more players (includes Studio Mode).
[*]All unused CSN:S Event Tickets will be removed during the maintenance on 6/30 (Wed).
[*]All Transcendence Chests will be removed during the maintenance on 6/30 (Wed).
[*]You can obtain no more than 3 CSN:S Event Tickets per day.[/list]


[u][h3]New Zombie Studio Map Event (6/16 - 6/30)[/h3][/u]Get a Unique Decoder for playing 30 minutes in the new Studio map, Medieval Fort!

[b]Conditions[/b][list][*]Play a Medieval Fort map for 30 minutes[/list]
[b]Rewards[/b][list][*]Unique Decoder x1[/list]
[b]Notice:[/b][list][*]Each account can receive this reward only once.
[*]Counts in rooms with 4 or more players.[/list]


[u][h3]Studio Event Ticket Giveaway (6/16 - 7/14)[/h3][/u]
[b]Studio Creators can get event tickets that can be used to apply an event to one of their own map creations.[/b][list][*]The event runs for 30 days from the day the Creator uses the ticket on their map.
[*]Players who play the event map will be entered into a raffle.
[*]At the end of the event, 1 player will win the event raffle reward.[/list]
[b]Event Ticket Quantity[/b][list][*][NEW] Dual Sword Phantom Slayer Event Ticket - 10 tickets
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/782b24ded599c595e2267c4ffe9408de7a7739f6.png[/img][/list]
[b]Getting Event Tickets[/b][list][*]Creators who want event tickets should leave a comment on the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/273110/discussions/0/3073125301402288801/]Studio Promotion post in Steam Announcements[/url].
[*]Comment Guidelines
  - Note your map creation date, map's eligible modes, and a brief introduction of the map in the body of your comment.
[*]After a round of review, tickets will be sent based on the maps' quality and number of recommendations.[/list]
[b]Notice[/b][list][*]The CSN:S team will determine eligible entries and give items individually.
[*]Distribution Date: Maintenance on Wednesday, July 28th
[*]All unused event tickets will be removed during maintenance on Wednesday, September 1st.[/list]


[u][h3]Studio Theme Package Giveaway (6/16 - Permanent)[/h3][/u][b]You will receive 5 theme packages when you reach 30 minutes of playtime in Studio Creation Mode!
[/b]
[b]Theme Packaged Given[/b][list][*]China Theme Package
[*]Maple Theme Package
[*]Christmas Theme package
[*]Space Theme Package
[*]Soccer Theme Package[/list]
[b]Notice[/b][list][*]Each account can receive these items only once.
[*]You will not receive theme packages that you already own.[/list]


[u][h3]Free Daily Rewards Event (6/16 - 7/14)[/h3][/u]Join the battle every day to get rewards, get rewards for getting rewards, and get even more event rewards on top of that!

[b]Daily Rewards[/b][list][*]Daily Weapons Supply
  - Contents: 2 Transcendence Weapons (1 Day) and 1 Daily Attendance Reward Box[/list]
[b]Cumulative Rewards[/b][list][*]5 Days: M3 Black Dragon (5 Days) 
[*]10 Days: M3 Black Dragon (10 Days) 
[*]15 Days: Magnum Launcher (5 Days)
[*]20 Days: Magnum Launcher (15 Days)
[*]25 Days: Gungnir (5 Days)[/list]
[b]Extra Cumulative Rewards Event[/b][list][*]Each time you get cumulative rewards (at 5/10/15/20/25 days), you'll receive a Cumulative Attendance Reward Box.[/list]



[h2]Shop Update[/h2]

[u][h3]New Transcendence Weapon "Devastator" Promotion (6/16 - 7/14)[/h3][/u]Introducing the new Transcendence Weapon, Devastator! Now available in Transcendence and Transcendence Premium Decoders!

[b]From Transcendence Premium Decoders:[/b][list][*]Devastator: 3%
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/8c9d242296df7c78b84ea0eed6406237c1a41b07.png[/img][/list]
[b]From Transcendence Decoders:[/b][list][*]Devastator: 0.45%[/list]
[b]The following items are being sold during the promotion period:[/b][list][*]Transcendence Premium Decoder x1
  - Transcendence Premium Decoder x5
  - Transcendence Premium Decoder x10
[*]Transcendence Premium Decoder x30
[*]Transcendence Decoder x100[/list]
[b]Notice[/b][list][*]All Transcendence Premium Decoders will be removed during maintenance on 7/14 (Wed.).
[*]500 mileage will be given for each Transcendence Premium Decoder removed.
[*]Transcendence Decoders will not be removed.[/list]


[u][h3]New Transcendence Weapon "Devastator" Guaranteed Giveaway (6/16 - 7/14)[/h3][/u]Get Guaranteed Points when you use decoders during the event!

[b]Event Objectives[/b][list][*]6 Guaranteed Points given each time you use 1 Transcendence Premium Decoder.
[*]1 Guaranteed Point given each time you use 1 Transcendence Decoder.[/list]
[b]Rewards[/b][list][*]You will receive a Devastator (Permanent) every time you reach 300 points.
[*]For example, you'll get it at 300 points, 600 points, 900 points, and so on.[/list]
