notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: May 20th
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/eb469470628f3c82204ab355b75b2077542468b5.jpg[/img]

[previewyoutube=Xr5SURj6AhY;full][/previewyoutube]
Here's a rundown of some of the major updates in today's patch!
[list][b]Content: Season 9: Fantasy World[/b]
In CSN:S' ninth season, fantasy world we invite you to explore a fantasy world full of adventures!

[b]Content: League Season 5[/b]
The official league returns for a brand new season, Season 5!
	
[b]Content: Zombie Content Update[/b]
From the revamped Zombie Limit option to the updated Lobby UI, check out these new changes!

[b]Content: Inventory Improvement[/b]
The inventory system has been improved tooltips to extra information![/list]Check out the Details section below for details.



[h1]Details[/h1]

[h2]New Contents[/h2]

[u][h3]Season 9: Fantasy World[/h3][/u]In CSN:S' ninth season, fantasy world we invite you to explore a fantasy world full of adventures!

[b]1. Season Pass Changes[/b][list][*]Season Pass Reward Revamp
  - Starting with Season 9, Season Pass rewards have been revamped.
  - You'll now receive rewards for each rank of the Free Pass. For details, please refer to the reward table below.
  - You can now check the remaining uses and duration of reward items from the Season Pass reward screen.
[*]Black Market Early Access
  - Starting with Season 9, the Black Market will open early for players who reach Rank 100.
  - When you reach Rank 100 on the current Season Pass, the Season Missions will terminate, and you'll get access to new missions rewarding Black Market Badges.
  - You can access the Black Market from the [Mission] menu. Those who have not reached Rank 100 can only use the Black Market during the off-season.
  - All Black Market Badges you've obtained will vanish when a new season begins.[/list]
[b]2. Season Information[/b][list][*]A 'season' is a reward system that runs for a set period of time. Complete missions and events during a Season to earn Season Badges which raise your Season Rank. You'll receive rewards based on your rank throughout the season.[/list]
[b]3. Season Rank[/b][list][*]Season Ranks indicate how much progress players have made participating in missions and events in the game. You'll earn various rare rewards when you increase your Season Rank. Season Rank and Season Badges are specific to their respective season.[/list]
[b]4. Season Rewards[/b][list][*]Rewards are immediately distributed as you achieve new ranks each season.
[*]If you purchase a Season Pass, you'll get the Season Pass rewards in addition to the free rewards.
[*]Starting with the Season 9 Pass, season rewards will no longer be limited-time items.
[*]Growing Weapons: When you receive a weapon's new stage (from 1-4), you will get to keep the previous stage of the weapon.
  - 1. Wind Tracker: Season 9 Reward Weapon - Growing Weapon Stage 1
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/a73f78f8a53a0b5d362ba2042b851a40d87bd5a4.png[/img]
This rifle is enchanted with wind magic. While looking through the sniper scope, you can lock onto an enemy, then fire 2 guided wind missiles upon exiting the scope view.

  - 2. Fire Tracker: Season 9 Reward Weapon - Growing Weapon Stage 2 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/28e92ee4d1a9ce5872c14e429458395e499048f1.png[/img]
This rifle is enchanted with fire magic. While looking through the sniper scope, you can lock onto an enemy, then fire 4 guided flame missiles when you leave sniper mode.

  - 3. Lighting Tracker: Season 9 Reward Weapon - Growing Weapon Stage 3 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/c034f842dc932684cd6a5e92e48fdf0886f21411.png[/img]
This rifle is enchanted with lightning magic. While looking through the sniper scope, you can lock onto an enemy, then fire 6 guided lightning missiles upon exiting the scope view.

  - 4. Elemental Tracker: Season 9 Reward Weapon - Growing Weapon Stage 4 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/7bfd9f17483da540c2297f5168bf329e9767a6a9.png[/img]
This rifle is enchanted with the magic of multiple elements. While looking through the sniper scope, you can lock onto an enemy, then fire 10 guided elemental missiles upon exiting the scope view. Press the Forward Arrow Key twice while holding down the Shift Key to change elements.

[*]Zombie Costumes
  - 1. Orc Warrior Deimos: Season 9 Reward Zombie Skin 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/a21d38e457eba366f9c91f483b977f7f9c1e9a12.png[/img]
Allows you to change the appearance of your Deimos Zombie to that of an Orc Warrior.

  - 2. Dark Elf Witch Banshee: Season 9 Reward Zombie Skin 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/5cc49339ba5506a31cf97ecf870dfd1d2da9bbbb.png[/img]
Allows you to change the appearance of your Banshee Zombie to that of a Dark Elf Witch.

[*]Weapon Paints
  - 1. Dragon Knight Weapon Paint (Desert Eagle Crimson Hunter, Rail Cannon, SG550 Commando, Warhammer Storm Giant, Air Buster) 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/eca55e8b6fd31e3e5a9c89e729de8e9fcb5c405a.png[/img]
The 5 Season 9 Reward Weapon Skins

  - 2. High Elf Weapon Paint (Desert Eagle, Hunter-Killer X-12, Broad Divine, Vendetta, Spell Lance Scarlet Rose) 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/b6ad87a1b1a2d8841b126bd8ed66096cbc17b94b.png[/img]
The 5 Season 9 Reward Weapon Skins

[*]Costumes
  - 1. Dragon Knight Helmet, Seelie Tiara, Dragon Wings, Seelie Wings, Dragon Pet, and Forest Sprite
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/535f2c63885efe845849fea029e66227a2abd3fd.jpg[/img]
Season 9 Reward Costumes - 6 Fantasy-themed Outfits 

[*]Sprays
  - 1. Orc Warrior Deimos Spray, Dark Elf Witch Banshee Spray, Dragon Knight Kyrix Spray, High Elf Natasha Spray, Fantasy World Spray 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/4f41b114c045484dccc8b7818e146d2f80d71a61.jpg[/img]
Season 9 Reward Sprays - 5 Fantasy-themed Sprays. Fantasy World Sprays display a special effect when used.

[*]Medals
  - 1. Season 9 Trailblazer Medal (Pass)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/860db249db04854404d9161091362a2f697dedd7.png[/img]

  - 2. Season 9 Conqueror Medal (Highest Rank Reached) 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/5b95265f3834513f84a3b24162062384bb98717c.png[/img]
Season 9 Conqueror medal displays a special effect when equipped.[/list]

[u][h3]League Season 5[/h3][/u]
[b]1. League Season 5: The official league has reopened for Season 5.[/b]

[b]2. Changes (Compared to previous trial leagues)[/b][list][*]As we enter the new league period, the scores required to advance to each rank are changing.
  - Master: Top 100 players -> No Change
  - Diamond: 2700 -> 4000
  - Platinum: 1500 -> 2000
  - Gold: 750 -> 1000
  - Silver: 300 -> No Change
[*]The following previous league rewards were limited to the previous season, and will be removed. Achievement Point Box items will be added to the league rewards.
  - Zombie League Nameplate/Zombie League Spray
[*]Items have been added to the Achievement Shop.
  - 4 new nameplate items added: (Venom Sting Nameplate, Cluckin' Chicken Nameplate, (Animated) Pursuit Nameplate, and Violet Spot Nameplate)
[*]When handling individuals who have tied for league points, the first player to reach that point total will now take precedence. This may affect the overall rankings.
[*]It is no longer possible to get Zombie Scenario League Points from the following maps:
  - Double Gate, Lost City, Survival: Trap, and Survival: Groundwater
[*]Starting with the new official league, a "rest" period will be added after each league ends, as is currently the case with seasons.[/list]
[b]3. The League Fairness Monitoring System has been implemented[/b][list][*]A monitoring system has been implemented that checks in real-time for behaviors deemed atypical of normal gameplay. A penalty will be applied to obtaining Points and EXP (including League Points) for repeat offenders.
[*]You can now view your league status under My Info.
[*]You can now review the score and weapon loadouts for the top 500 players in the Hall of Fame.
[*]League Ranks: Master > Diamond > Platinum > Gold > Silver > Bronze
[*]* Master Rank can only be achieved through competition. You may drop down to Diamond Rank when competing within Master Rank.
[*]* There are no player count restrictions for obtaining League Points, however you will receive greater bonuses when playing with more people.
[*]* You cannot obtain League Points in private rooms with a password set.
[*]* You cannot obtain League Points if abnormal activity or cheating is detected, such as:
  - Inactivity and non-participation, as well as for killing or infecting inactive players.
  - Abnormal activity pertaining to Studio devices or map structures.[/list]
[b]4. Zombie League Rewards[/b][list][*]Master: Zombie League Master Zombification + Holy Sword Divine Order (20 Days) + Kalael (20 Days) + Medea (20 Days)
[*]Diamond: Achievement Point Box x2 + Lightning Fury (20 Days) + Private Erica (20 Days) + Female Student Light Zombie (20 Days)
[*]Platinum: Achievement Point Box x1 + Psychic Harmonium (20 Days) + Nurse Venom Sting (20 Days)
[*]Gold: Dual Beretta Gunslinger (20 Days) + Mummy Stamper (20 Days)
[*]Silver: VIP Free Pass (20 Days) + Chef Heavy Zombie (20 Days)
[*]Bronze: None
[*]Notice:
  - Zombie League Master Zombification: Changes the revival effect when you revive as a zombie in Zombie Mode. It is removed when the season ends or your rank drops.
  - The zombification is distributed to those of Master Rank, and is removed if your rank drops or the season ends.[/list]
[b]5. Zombie Scenario League Rewards[/b][list[[*]Master: Holy Sword Divine Order (20 Days) + Titan's Will Add-On x100 + Grade 6 Parts Reward Box x3
[*]Diamond: Achievement Point Box x2 + Lightning Fury (20 Days) + Weakness Analysis Add-On x75 + Grade 5 Parts Reward Box x5
[*]Platinum: Achievement Point Box x1 + Psychic Harmonium (20 Days) + Tide Turner Add-On x50 + Grade 4 Parts Reward Box x10
[*]Gold: Dual Beretta Gunslinger (20 Days) + Reinforced Attack Add-On x20
[*]Silver: VIP Free Pass (20 Days) + Capital Add-On x20
[*]Bronze: None[/list]
[b]6. Achievement Shop: Added 4 new nameplate items as achievement products[/b][list][*]Venom Sting Nameplate: Customizes how your name appears in the match lobby.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/55c26e693e46b5595164e98dddc486472711fc7e.png[/img]

[*]Cluckin' Chicken Nameplate: Customizes how your name appears in the match lobby.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/c33fd42b48f754b86741ab1e2d5e30d32d6c2641.png[/img]

[*](Animated) Pursuit Nameplate: Customizes how your name appears in the match lobby.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/a56b3473b9ef62f462cc3bc4c072811cf19a4075.png[/img]

[*]Violet Spot Nameplate: Customizes how your name appears in the match lobby.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/5b5538467d017b7c6cbfca7e242debff6e0c92b7.png[/img][/list]

[u][h3]Zombie Content Update[/h3][/u]
[b]1. Zombie Limit option update[/b][list][*]New limit option added: Aside from Normal Zombies, each Zombie can be used only once per round per player. If only Normal Zombies are remain as available zombies, their HP, Armor, Defense, and HP Recovery will increase.
  - HP and Armor: +3000/Defense: +10%/HP Recovery: +300
[*]Individual zombie limit changed: Increased the max number of individual zombie limits to 4. If you set individual zombie limits, the HP, Armor, Defense, and HP Recovery of all zombies will increase in proportion to the maximum number of zombies.
  - 1 limit: HP and Armor: +0/Defense: +0/HP Recovery: +0
  - 2 limits: HP and Armor: +1000/Defense: +0/HP Recovery: +50
  - 3 limits: HP and Armor: +2000/Defense: +3%/HP Recovery: +100
  - 4 limits: HP and Armor: +3000/Defense: +5%/HP Recovery: +200[/list]
[b]2. Zombie Karma update[/b][list][*]Zombie Stage 2 Karma: Upon using Karma, immediately transforms into a hero zombie class and becomes invincible for 6 sec.
[*]Zombie Stage 3 Karma: Upon using Karma, die and then revive as human after 3 sec. Can only be used after virus detoxification. (If all zombies revive as humans, the round ends in a Human Team victory.)[/list]
[b]3. Zombie balance update (skill update)[/b][list][*]Normal Zombie: Damage taken during Berserk reduced from 150% → 140%
[*]Deimos: Shock cooldown increased from 12 sec -> 15 sec
[*]Metatron: Movement Speed increases by 10% while using Immortality
[*]Psycho: Smokescreen's damage reduction amount reduced from 75% → 65%; Smokescreen cooldown increased from 15 sec → 20 sec; duration per each Smokescreen increased from 1.5 sec → 2 sec
[*]Jiangshi: Invincibility duration reduced from 5 sec → 4sec; invincibility cooldown increased from 15 sec → 18 sec
[*]Aksha: Absorb cooldown reduced from 20 sec → 16 sec, Knockback Resistance slightly increased
[*]Chaser: Defense slightly increased
[*]Rusty Wing: Defense slightly decreased [/list]
[b]4. Zombie Z Content[/b][list][*]If the Zombie Limit is set to Normal Zombies only, the Adaptability mutation will not appear.
[*]Fixed mutation added: Adaptability will be fixed as the 26th mutation given. (If the Zombie Limit is set to Normal Zombies only, you will get a different mutation.)
[*]Mutation Changes
  - Contact Infection: Changed so that the damage inflicted is in proportion to the max HP of the targeted human player
  - Endurance: Changed the default activation rate from 1% → 1.5%
  - Armored Advance: Defense increase per round - 1.5% → 1%
  - Speedy Crouch: Default Movement Speed increase - 50 → 40; Movement Speed increase per round - 5 → 6[/list]
[b]5. Lobby UI change[/b][list][*]With the Zombie Limit change, the limit setting UI has been updated.
[*]The "Death>Kill Rule" option has been moved under Extra Room Settings.
[*]The "Remove Zombie Permanent Death" option has been moved under the room settings.[/list]

[u][h3]Inventory Improvement[/h3][/u]
[b]1. Inventory Information[/b][list][*]You can now see information pertaining to the remaining slots in your inventory.
[*]The slot information displayed will not include inventory information that the player cannot manage directly, such as for PC cafe or VIP pass.
[*]From the inventory's model view, can now toggle the UI on/off by right-clicking the mouse icon on the top right of the model view.
[*]* There may be instances where Default items do not take up inventory slots, depending on how they are distributed. There may also be cases where items are distributed on the system level but do not appear in the inventory. Thus, the actual number of slots available differ slightly from what is displayed.[/list]
[b]2. Disassembly Information[/b][list][*]When you disassemble items in the disassembly page, icons will show which inventories are affected.
[*]Icon information: Weapons, Parts, Craft, Classes, Costumes, and Items
[*]The number of items you can disassemble at once has been increased from 9 to 99.
[*]A filter feature that allows you to check per each inventory category will be provided on the right of Select Items for Disassembly.
[*]* However, since there are minimum disassembly requirements, you can only change to quantities designated for each item.
[*]You can also batch-apply with Ctrl + drag or Ctrl + double-click.[/list]
[b]3. Pop-Up Information[/b][list][*]Added a feature to display icons in the Item Acquired pop-up, so that you know which inventory you need to make space in. You can see which inventory it will apply towards when your inventory is full.[/list]

[u][h3]Season Pass Reward Renewal[/h3][/u]Starting from Season 9, the Season Pass rewards and distribution method have been revised!

[b]Season Pass Reward Distribution Changes[/b][list][*]Distribution method changed from Season Random Box -> guaranteed item (individual item)
[*]Distribution method changed from Grades 3-4 Parts Random Boxes -> guaranteed item (individual item) sorted in the order of high player preference
[*]Distribution method changed from Grade 5 Parts Random Box -> guaranteed item (individual item) sorted in the order of release date
[*]The Mileage Box is a fixed reward, kept the same as before.[/list]


[h2]Events[/h2]

[u][h3][Trial] League 4 Wrap-Up (5/20 - Permanent)[/h3][/u]We will give league medals to players who maintain Master/Diamond ranks at the time the [Trial] Zombie League Season 4 ends.

[b]Medals Available[/b][list][*]Master League: Awarded upon ending the [Trial] Zombie League Season 4 in Master Rank.
[*]Diamond League: Awarded upon ending [Trial] Zombie League Season 4 in Diamond Rank.[/list]

[u][h3]League Season 5 Participation Event (5/20 - 6/2)[/h3][/u]If you reach Silver Rank or higher during the league period, you will be eligible to win a raffle reward!

[b]Distribution Criteria[/b][list][*]Reward distributed via raffle between players who reached Silver Rank
[*]Reward distributed via raffle between players who reached Gold Rank[/list]
[b]Rewards[/b][list][*]Silver Rank Reward: 50,000 mileage (200 players)
[*]Gold Rank Reward: Transcendence Decoder x10 (100 players)[/list]
[b]Notice[/b][list][*]You cannot more than one raffle.
[*]All rewards are distributed during the maintenance on Wednesday, June 2nd.[/list]

[u][h3]Daily (Monday - Sunday) Login Enhanced Event (5/20 - 6/2)[/h3][/u]You will get a reward every time you reach 10, 40, and 60 minutes of playtime each day during the event.

[b]Rewards[/b][list][*]10 minutes: Event Reward Box x1
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/6ed3741a2cb3d349549b33f9555f36fe7e26a095.png[/img]

[*]40 minutes: Event Reward Box x1
[*]60 minutes: Event Reward Box x1
[*](In Zombie Hero/Zombie Z/Zombie Evolution) score 5 zombie kills/human infections (excluding bots): Event Reward Box x1
[*]Clear a Zombie Scenario map on Normal or higher difficulty: Event Reward Box x1[/list]
[b]Notice[/b][list][*]You can participate in rooms with 4 or more players
[*]Time spent in Studio Mode does not count.
[*]Rewards can be obtained only once per account.
[*]Unused Event Reward Box items will be removed during maintenance on Wednesday, June 2nd.
[*]Event resets every day at midnight (24:00).[/list]

[u][h3]Weekend (Friday - Sunday) Login Enhanced Event (5/20 - 6/16)[/h3][/u]You will receive rewards when you meet each event condition on Friday-Sunday during the event!

[b]Conditions[/b][list][*]Upon logging in on Friday-Sunday, you'll receive your choice of reward (claiming is limited to once a day).
[*]Each week, when you log in on Friday-Sunday + reach 60 minutes of playtime, it is counted as 1 milestone completed. You will receive rewards based on the total number of millstone completions every week.
[*]Completion count resets each week.
  - Upon reaching 1 total completion for the week: Transcendence Decoder x1 + 1 of the 10 Season 9 paintable weapons (different chance to receive each weapon) 
  - Upon reaching 2 total completions for the week: Transcendence Decoder x1 + Dragon Knight Kyrix (3 Days)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/e5e1342c95c4f78f1fcd803e65b4c78afa1999d9.png[/img]

  - Upon reaching 3 total completions for the week: Transcendence Decoder x2 + High Elf Natasha (3 Days)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/41f645b8fd6a976aa9c6cb6951f0082d74079b7d.png[/img][/list]
[b]Event Dates[/b][list][*]5/21 (Fri.) - 5/23 (Sun.): Week 1 weekend 
[*]5/28 (Fri.) - 5/30 (Sun.): Week 2 weekend 
[*]6/4 (Fri.) - 6/6 (Sun.): Week 3 weekend
[*]6/11 (Fri.) - 6/13 (Sun.): Week 4 weekend[/list]
[b]Notice[/b][list][*]Only rooms with four or more players contribute to this milestone.
[*]Studio Mode ganes contribute toward this milestone. 
[*]Rewards can be obtained only once per account.[/list]

[u][h3]Free Daily Rewards Event (5/20 - 6/16)[/h3][/u]Join the battle every day to get rewards, get rewards for obtaining rewards, and get even more event rewards on top of that!

[b]Daily Rewards[/b][list][*]Daily Weapons Supply
  - Contents: 2 Transcendence Weapons (1 Day) and 1 Daily Attendance Reward Box[/list]
[b]Cumulative Rewards[/b][list][*]5 Days: M3 Black Dragon (5 Days) 
[*]10 Days: M3 Black Dragon (10 Days) 
[*]15 Days: Magnum Launcher (5 Days)
[*]20 Days: Magnum Launcher (15 Days)
[*]25 Days: Gungnir (5 Days)[/list]
[b]Extra Cumulative Rewards Event[/b][list][*]Each time you earn cumulative rewards (at 5/10/15/20/25 days), you'll receive a Cumulative Attendance Reward Box.[/list]

[u][h3]Season Badge Giveaway (5/20 - 8/11)[/h3][/u]During the season, you will receive Season Badges when you meet the login time requirements under Daily Missions!

[b]Reward Obtained per Condition[/b][list][*]Upon reaching 30 minutes of login time: Season Badge x5
[*]Upon reaching 1 hour of login time: Season Badge x10
[*]Upon reaching 2 hours of login time: Season Badge x20[/list]
[b]Notice[/b][list][*]Mission resets every day at midnight.
[*]An existing event, where you would receive a total of 30 Season Badges a day at every 30 minutes of login time, is moved and run under the Daily Mission system.
[*]You cannot use the difficulty change item on the event mission.[/list]

[u][h3]Zombie Scenario Golden Zombie Kill Reward Update (5/20 - 8/11)[/h3][/u]You will receive rewards by killing the Golden Zombie, which appears randomly when you play Zombie Scenario during the event! (Hitting the Golden Zombie once counts as killing it once.)

[b]Reward Given per Kill[/b][list][*]1 Kill: AK-47 Paladin
[*]2 Kills: M4A1 Dark Knight
[*]3 Kills: Lycanthrope
[*]5 Kills: Python Desperado
[*]7 Kills: Red Dragon Cannon
[*]10 Kills: AUG Guardian[/list]
[b]Notice[/b][list][*]You can only get credit for 3 kills per day.
[*]Each reward is given only once per account.
[*]The Golden Zombies randomly appear after playing for more than 3 minutes in rooms at regular difficulty or higher.[/list]

The CSN:S Team

notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: May 6th
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/4751e166def66f7f46ed91e62edfd057c234d09a.jpg[/img]

New events have been added!


[h2]Events[/h2]

[h3]THANATOS Returns Event (5/6 - Permanent)[/h3]

notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: April 21st
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/dc3fa6b220d44444e64bf5c917891a44d61d82eb.jpg[/img]

Here's a rundown of some of the major updates in today's patch!
[list][b]Content: Daily Mission Revamp[/b]
Daily Missions have been simplified and the Black Market is now available during the off-season!

[b]Content: Additional Zombie Scenario Improvements[/b]
Zombie Scenario is back with even more improvements.
	
[b]Content: Abyss Difficulty in Zombie Scenario Maps[/b]
Introducing an even new level of difficulty: Abyss! Monsters are tougher, stronger, and faster. Are you up to the challenge?

[b]Promotion: New Transcendence Class Promotion (4/21 - 6/2)[/b]
Meet the 2 new classes now available from Class/Premium Class Decoders![/list]Check out the Details section below for details.



[h1]Expanded Info[/h1]
 
[h2]New Contents[/h2]

[u][h3]Daily Mission Revamp[/h3][/u]Daily Missions have been simplified and the Black Market is now available during the off-season! For more details, please refer to the Daily Mission Revamp Preview.

[b]There are now 3 types of Daily Missions.[/b][list][*]Instead of choosing from many missions, now you just need to complete the 3 set missions.
[*]Daily Missions won't reset until you've completed them.
[*]Completed Daily Missions reset every day at midnight.[/list]
[b]Significant changes have been made to the Reset Daily Mission items.[/b][list][*]This item has been renamed to Daily Mission Difficulty Change.
[*]Using a Daily Mission Difficulty Change allows you to change a mission to high, normal, or low difficulty.
[*]When you change a mission's difficulty, you'll keep any progress you've already made. Use this when the going gets tough![/list]
[b]The Black Market is open for business.[/b][list][*]Before each new season begins, the Black Market will be open.
[*]Get Black Market Badges from Daily Missions and use them to buy items.

[*]Black Market Badge
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/34ae41fa94bd08003dbb24f671b9ab27416f512f.png[/img]
  - Type: Item
  - Description: Collect these badges and exchange them for items from the Black Market.
  - All Black Market Badges will disappear when a new season starts.

[*]CSN:S Brand Backpack
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/c23595142ef1a9cb079dfbacc5c99da57630b881.png[/img]
  - Type: Costume
  - Description: A CSN:S brand backpack. Can be equipped on the back.

[*]Black Market Items
  - Red Baron Weapon Paint (Permanent): Black Market Badge x300
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/1362c3f79e90de84f5e60b30c6631904bf75a13b.png[/img]
  - CSN:S Brand Backpack: Black Market Badge x300
  - Spring Flower Nameplate (3 Days): Black Market Badge x90
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/5faec65b72a08a28fa360fcb7a1f90fd124390ef.png[/img]
  - Spring Flower Font (1 Day): Black Market Badge x30
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/bda72203caacc3d55bd399b4d570bf406cfa4f63.png[/img]
  - Lusty Rose (5 Days): Black Market Badge x30
  - SAF Scout (5 Days): Black Market Badge x30
  - Dragon Tattoo (5 Days): Black Market Badge x30
  - Tiger Tattoo (5 Days): Black Market Badge x30
  - Daily Missions will award Season Badges during a season and Black Market Badges during the off-season![/list]

[u][h3]Additional Zombie Scenario Improvements 2[/h3][/u]
[b]New Add-Ons and Balance Changes[/b][list][*]New Add-Ons
  - Veteran's Help: When you equip this Add-On and drop a weapon on the ground on Very Hard or higher difficulty, the weapon will remain on the ground without disappearing. Only up to 1 weapon will remain.
  - Deft Movement: Grants a chance not to take damage when hit by an attack.
  - Abundant Returns: Obtain 1 additional Add-On after defeating elite monsters.
  - Healer: Whenever you heal yourself, nearby allies are also healed for a portion of the healing effect's value.
  - Revenger: Increases attack power each time an ally dies.
  - Group Tactics: Reduces damage taken for each nearby ally player.
  - Steel Physique: Increases maximum HP.

[*]Add-On Balance Changes
  - Ammo Reserves - Activation Rate: 5% → 7%
  - Reinforced Attack - Base Damage: 120 → 100
  - Quick Rejoining - Cooldown Reduction: 12% → 15%
  - Addict - Cooldown Reduction: 6 sec → 10 sec
  - Nouveau Riche - Base Dollar Obtained Increase: 150% → 200%
  - Trap Evasion - Activation Rate: 25% → 30%
  - Giant's Feet - Base Damage: 250 → 300

[*]Map Playlist Automatic Add-On Feature
  - When the map changes while you play a Map Playlist, your most recent Add-Ons will keep being used repeatedly until the Map Playlist ends. If you use up all of an Add-On in the middle of a Map Playlist, the other Add-Ons that you haven't used up will continue to be used.[/list]
[b]Elite Monster Balance Changes[/b][list][*]Monster Stat/Enhancement Effect Balance Adjustments
  - Attack Power Increase: Reduced the amount this increases the monster's attack power.
  - Spider Web: Weakened the movement speed reduction.[/list]

[u][h3]New Abyss Difficulty in Zombie Scenario[/h3][/u]
[b]New Zombie Scenario Difficulty Added[/b][list][*]Added the Abyss difficulty.
[*]Abyss is an even higher difficulty than the existing Inferno difficulty. Monsters will have greater attack power, HP, speed, etc.[/list]
[b]Information on Abyss Difficulty Map[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/e29eccafdb7c522187a06e4f63c83a15a31addf9.png[/img]
[list][*]Abyss 1 - First Contact
[*]With the addition of Abyss, Inferno difficulty will be available in all existing maps. You can see what difficulties are available in map selection.
[*]We plan to regularly add Abyss difficulty to more maps in the future.[/list]
[b]Inferno Difficulty Expanded[/b][list][*]Inferno difficulty, which was previously provided only for a limited number of maps, has been added to be playable on all maps. [/list]

[u][h3]Zombie Mode Update[/h3][/u]
[b]Season 8 Content Changes[/b][list][*]Zombie Boost Items Removed
  - Power-ups will no longer appear when a zombie dies.
[*]Revenge Bonus System Changes
  - Previous: You receive bonus points upon taking revenge.
  - Updated: You receive bonus Karma upon taking revenge.[/list]
[b]Unlock Level Changes[/b][list][*]Rail Buster: 2 -> 3
[*]TURBULENT-1: 6 -> 5
[*]SKULL-3: 3 -> 2
[*]TURBULENT-9: 6 -> 5
[*]Ethereal: 2 -> 1
[*]SKULL-4: 8 -> 5
[*]Dual UZI: 6 -> 5
[*]Awakening of the Zhu Bajie Minigun: 3 -> 1
[*]SPAS-12: 3 -> 2
[*]Ripper: 10 -> 9
[*]Black Dragon Cannon: 14 -> 11
[*]Stun Rifle: 14 -> 9
[*]Desert Eagle Crimson Hunter: 16 -> 14
[*]Blade Runebreaker: 16 -> 18
[*]X-TRACKER: 20 -> 18
[*]SG552 Lycanthrope: 20 -> 18
[*]AUG Guardian: 20 -> 18
[*]Eternity Laser Fist: 24 -> 22
[*]M249 Phoenix: 24 -> 21
[*]Blotter: 22 -> 20[/list]

[u][h3]Transcendence Class Medal Giveaway (4/21 - Permanent)[/h3][/u]When you own all of the items below, you will receive the Transcendence Class Medal!

[b]Medal[/b][list][*][Honor] Otherworld Denizen
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/37351472ec9cfb152b33f1578593e51a43c30241.png[/img][/list]
[b]How to Obtain This Medal (Requires Permanent Version)[/b][list][*]Dragon Knight Kyrix
[*]High Elf Natasha
[*]Natasha's Orb
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/7111fddc59be164e0888706b305c1262e2cca7f7.png[/img]
[*]Kyrix's Dragon Knight Shield
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/e46eaca4185a559e5a7a0bbe4c8abac1edbd1eb7.png[/img][/list]
[b]Notice[/b][list][*]Each account can receive this reward only once.[/list]


[h2]Events[/h2]

[u][h3]Class Preference Survey Event (4/21 - 5/5)[/h3][/u]We will hold a player preference survey regarding seasonal Transcendence Classes. A reward will be given to players who participate!

[b]Classes Targeted for Survey[/b][list][*]Transcendence Classes released in the past[/list]
[b]Reward[/b][list][*]Transcendence Decoder x1[/list]
[b]Survey Link[/b][list][*][url=https://forms.gle/YZvQogs9jTDMvYta7]https://forms.gle/YZvQogs9jTDMvYta7[/url][/list]
[b]Notice[/b][list][*]Survey participation and reward distribution is limited to once per account.
[*]Reward will be distributed during the maintenance on Thursday, May 6th.[/list]

[u][h3]Free Daily Rewards Event (4/21 - 5/19)[/h3][/u]Join the battle every day to get rewards, get rewards for getting rewards, and get even more event rewards on top of that!

[b]Daily Rewards[/b][list][*]Daily Weapons Supply
  - Contents: 2 Transcendence Weapons (1 Day) and 1 Daily Attendance Reward Box[/list]
[b]Cumulative Rewards[/b][list][*]5 Days: M3 Black Dragon (5 Days) 
[*]10 Days: M3 Black Dragon (10 Days) 
[*]15 Days: Magnum Launcher (5 Days)
[*]20 Days: Magnum Launcher (15 Days)
[*]25 Days: Gungnir (5 Days)[/list]
[b]Extra Cumulative Rewards Event[/b][list][*]Each time you get cumulative rewards (at 5/10/15/20/25 days), you'll receive a Cumulative Attendance Reward Box.[/list]

[u][h3]Off-Season Mission Rewards Event (4/21 - 5/19)[/h3][/u]Complete off-season Daily Mission during the event period and get rewards!

[b]Assignments[/b][list][*]For each day you clear 3 Daily Missions, you receive 1 Spring Flower Box.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/30b592485fcdc28751b5957064b5ef4d708022a4.png[/img]
[*]When you clear your first Daily Mission on weekends, you can choose one durational weapons and, in addition, obtain other functionality items.
  - Fridays: 4/23 and 4/30
  - Saturdays: 4/24 and 5/1
  - Sundays: 4/25 and 5/2[/list]
[b]Rewards[/b][list][*]Choose a 1-day weapon from the durational weapon list + receive all of the other items
[*]Reward can be obtained only once a day per account (Given only when you complete the Daily Mission for the first time)[/list]
[b]Notice:[/b][list][*]Unused Spring Flower Boxes will be removed with the patch on Wednesday, May 19th.
[*]Daily missions count only in rooms with 4 or more players.
[*]Rewards can be obtained only once per account.[/list]

[u][h3]Transcendence Class Guaranteed Giveaway (4/21 - 6/2)[/h3][/u]Earn Guaranteed Points when you use Class and Premium Class Decoders during the event.
[list][*]1 Guaranteed Point given each time you use 1 Class Decoder.
[*]3 Guaranteed Points given each time you use 1 Premium Class Decoder.[/list]
[b]Rewards[/b][list][*]Upon reaching 150 points: Choose either Dragon Knight Kyrix or High Elf Natasha
[*]Upon reaching 300 points: Choose either Dragon Knight Kyrix or High Elf Natasha 
  - Upon selecting Dragon Knight Kyrix, automatically get an exclusive costume (permanent)
  - Upon selecting High Elf Natasha, automatically get an exclusive costume (permanent)[/list]
[b]Notice:[/b][list][*]The selection pop-up window displays as soon as you reach the required points.
[*]Rewards from each stage can only be claimed once per account.[/list]


[h2]Shop[/h2]

[u][h3]Transcendence Class Promotion (4/21 - 6/2)[/h3][/u]Get the 2 new classes from Class/Premium Class Decoders during the promotion! Each has a 4x drop rate!

[b]New Class Rates[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/5159a8b279dc422bb7bb4308eec21abf947df32a.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/5508c188c09db344d83fa7580272e919b58343d3.png[/img]
[list][*]From Class Decoders - Dragon Knight Kyrix: 0.5%/High Elf Natasha: 0.5%
[*]From Premium Class Decoders - Dragon Knight Kyrix: 2.0%/High Elf Natasha: 2.0%[/list]
[b]Decoders Sold[/b][list][*]Class Decoders are on permanent sale. The following bundles are available at a discount:
  - Class Decoder x10 (3% discount)
  - Class Decoder x30 (5% discount)
[*]Premium Class Decoders are on sale from 4/21 until 6/2. The following bundles are available at a discount:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/fe922738070c97135efb99ba18ed248778fa2056.png[/img]
  - Premium Class Decoder x10 (3% discount)
  - Premium Class Decoder x30 (5% discount)

notes.title: [Notice] Regarding Probability Item Announcement
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/b6f7445dbfb588ce0bfa03b6731e7439cd7ae329.jpg[/img]

[b]Greetings from the Counter-Strike Nexon: Studio Team![/b]

We provide the rates for probability-based items on Steam and our website. In order to keep providing transparent service for our players, we're also releasing rates for the weapon enhancement system and season pass rewards below.

To begin, here is information on weapon enhancements and their rates.

Weapon enhancement is an in-game system that allows you to improve your weapons by enhancing them. Enhancement requires you to consume your spare weapons as "material" to upgrade the desired weapon. Both paid and free weapons can be spent using this system.


[h3][Weapon Enhancement System][/h3][list][*]Every enhancement attempt grants EXP towards your weapon's enhancement level. The EXP needed per level is listed in the first table below.

[*]Each material weapon grants a certain amount of EXP based on its rank and enhancement level. Formulas for how this EXP is calculated are included in the second table, with several examples after that.[/list]
[b]EXP Needed per Enhancement[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/e841ed0eddb47a681999977fbd565826acaf41aa.png[/img]
[list][*]Accumulated material EXP is reset after increasing enhancement level or failing enhancement.

[*]The success rates are calculated according to the below formula, based on the cumulative material EXP and the required enhancement EXP.

Enhancement Success Rate = Cumulative Material EXP / Required Enhancement EXP

[*]Each weapon has a different enhancement material EXP per weapon rank, from Regular to Epic. This is defined in the next table.[/list]
[b]Enhancement Material EXP per Weapon Rank/Enhancement Level[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/cebf5d6898d8121a4d8b501c219ad7c0b751586c.png[/img]
[list][*]If the material weapon is the same as the weapon you're enhancing, you'll get a 100% EXP bonus on top of the base enhancement EXP.[/list]
[b]Example: Material EXP for Rare Weapon[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/f4ce8701de093254d8165924afafe402c12130e5.png[/img]
[list][*]As illustrated above, materials with higher enhancement levels provide more EXP. Bonuses are rounded down to whole numbers.

  - Upon a successful enhancement, one attribute is increased at random. Every attribute has an equal chance of being selected.

  - The available attributes vary by weapon. You can see what attributes are available in the weapon's in-game description.

  - Once an attribute has been maxed out, it will be excluded from attribute selection.

  - When performing dehancement, one enhanced attribute is decreased at random. Every enhanced attribute has an equal chance of being selected.[/list]
We have also prepared a rate disclosure for the Season Random Box. This item can be obtained as a free reward from the Free Pass and as part of a paid season pass.



[h3][Season Random Box][/h3][list][*]When awarded as part of the Season Pass system, the Season Random Box will be used immediately upon obtaining.

[*]You will receive one of the following items. The chance of obtaining each is listed below.[/list]
[b]Season Random Box Rates[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/d6a70df9a62255a40a74b513e1ecea4faa3a3331.png[/img]

Counter-Strike Nexon: Studio has been able to continue its service for the past 7 years thanks to your continuous support and affection.

In order to make our game even more transparent and trustworthy, we plan to perform an overall review of in-game terminology to see whether there has been any unclear communication in our probability-based content. We are also making preparations to implement a real-time probability monitoring system so that Survivors can check the rates.

Starting with this rate disclosure post, we will continue to work hard so that Counter-Strike Nexon: Studio earns even more of your trust. 

Thank you.

- The CSNS Team

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/c31ae6c26449d4a186d464fc64129a177bc3a791.jpg[/img]

Here's a rundown of some of the major updates in today's patch!

[list][b]Content: Zombie Scenario 7-3 (Pursuit: Missed Connections)[/b]
Search the destroyed laboratory for clues! Check out this brand new story today.
	
[b]Content: Zombie Scenario Improvements[/b]
Zombie Scenario has been improved! Check it out today!
	
[b]Content: Zombie Content Update[/b]
From updates to mutations to changes to Zombie Z mode's unlock level, see all the updates coming to Zombie content!

[b]Promotion: 2021 New Epic Weapon Promotion (2/17 - 3/31)[/b]
During the event, Epic Decoders with the letter <C> as a possible reward will be sold in the shop![/list]

Check out the Expanded Info section below for details.



[h1]Expanded Info[/h1]
 
[h2]Content[/h2]

[u][h3]Zombie Scenario 7-3 - Pursuit: Missed Connections[/h3][/u]Ever since she escaped from the Panic Room, Erica has suffered from mysterious bouts of debilitating pain. Time passed in vain without being able to find the cause. One day, David Black receives a message from Soi out of the blue. Soi claims that there is information about Erica's condition and suggests that Black go to Rex Laboratory to search for a cure. When Black and Erica get there, however, the laboratory is in shambles after an attack. Now they must search the lab for any signs of Soi and a cure.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/3fb42c15dccc847efd406addf2b8864e0b552cbc.png[/img]
 

[u][h3]Zombie Scenario Improvements[/h3][/u]
[b]Introducing Elite Monsters[/b][list][*]When you play Zombie Scenario on Normal difficulty or higher, there is a chance for new elite monsters to appear.
[*]Elite monsters have more powerful stats than normal zombies, as well as enhancement effects. The higher the difficulty is when you encounter them, the more powerful their abilities become.
[*]If you clear the scenario after defeating an elite monster, you can get Add-On and Part items.[/list]

[b]Introducing the Add-On System[/b][list][*]New item type, Add-Ons, can be obtained by defeating elite monsters.
[*]Add-Ons are consumable items which, when used, apply their effects to the next Scenario Mode match. You can view your Add-On items in the mode-exclusive section of your inventory.
[*]You can equip Add-Ons in the lobby before playing Zombie Scenario Mode. When the match starts, 1 of each equipped Add-On will be consumed, and the Add-Ons' effects will be applied to that match.
[*]You can press the M key during the match to see the currently equipped Add-Ons.[/list]

[b]Other System Changes[/b][list][*]The Round Re-Challenge item no longer has a cooldown. Instead, there is now a limit on how many times it can be used per match based on difficulty. You can see how many uses you have left by pressing Tab during the match.
[*]Easy and Normal: No limit
[*]Hard: Up to 15 uses
[*]Very Hard: Up to 10 uses
[*]Hell: Up to 5 uses
[*]Inferno: Up to 3 uses
[*]In Zombie Scenario maps on Very Hard or above difficulty, when you discard a weapon, the weapon will now disappear immediately.
[*]You can view special conditions and rewars for each difficulty with the Difficulty Guide button in the Zombie Scenario Mode lobby.
[*]The number of parts you can get from the daily reward boxes have been doubled.
[*]Poor Reward Box: Part Grades 1-3 x2f
[*]Regular Reward Box: Part Grades 1-3 x6
[*]Intermediate Reward Box: Part Grades 1-3 x6 and Part Grades 2-5 x4
[*]Advanced Reward Box: Part Grades 1-3 x6, Part Grades 2-5 x4, and Part Grades 3-6 x4
[*]Removed the instant kill effect from the skills of some bosses.[/list]

[b]Get the details in the Zombie Scenario Improvement preview![/b]



[u][h3]Zombie Content Update[/h3][/u]
[b]Updated Mutation[/b][list][*]Hunter's Instinct: Slightly increases combat power against players marked as your target.[/list]

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/d68efd3f6c4c85058304f2ecf369fd8f8ab25cd6.jpg[/img] 

Here's a rundown of some of the major updates in today's patch!

[list][b]Content: Season 8: Ice Kingdom Release[/b]
Introducing Season Pass items to remind you of the hard frozen land and fluttering snowflakes!
	
[b]Content: Zombie Update[/b]
Season 8 Zombie Mode has been newly updated! Check it out!
	
[b]Content: [Trial] Zombie League Season 3[/b]
Check out our latest changes, ranging from Zombie League Season 3 to the rewards.

[b]New Sale: Zombie Z Starter Package (Available Starting 1/27) [/b]
Introducing a new box filled with weapons to help you in Zombie Z Mode. Get it from the Shop![/list]

Check out the Expanded Info section below for details.



[h1]Expanded Info[/h1]
 
[h2]Contents[/h2]

[u][h3]Season 8: Ice Kingdom[/h3][/u]
[b]Season Information[/b][list][*]A season is a reward system that runs for a set period of time. Finish missions and events during a Season to earn Season Badges which raise your Season Rank. You'll receive rewards based on your rank throughout the season.[/list]
[b]Season Rank[/b][list][*]Season Rank shows how much progress players have made by participating in missions and events in the game. You can earn rare rewards that are only available for that season every time you raise your Season Rank. Season Rank and Season Badges are reset at the start of each season.[/list]
[b]Season Rewards[/b][list][*]Rewards are immediately given based on the ranks you reach each season.
[*]If you purchase a Season Pass, you'll get both the Season Pass rewards and the free rewards.
[*]Rewards unique to a specific season can only be earned during that season.[/list]
[b]Growing Weapon[/b][list][*]Bear Buster (Stage 1)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/e0efa7667c5b3e2710cb21f86b150164c776644d.png[/img]
Fires blasts of breath from twin bear cub cannons. Landing enough breath attacks allows you to detonate a blast of compressed breath, knocking enemies back.

[*]Bear Fury Mk. 1 (Stage 2)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/2828b492fbc3c2a337e5e69b53fe725aefe0a495.png[/img]
 Allows you to release a blast of compressed breath to charge.

[*]Bear Fury Mk. 2 (Stage 3)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/2626f7ad43a253afdc5873eb1fe7ecbcfa6def65.png[/img]
Allows you to release a blast of compressed breath to charge.

[*]Bear Fury Mk. 3 (Stage 4)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/0980aa546b6d0361ae0405fa346499be46311711.png[/img]
This weapon generates powerful snowstorms. It fires a powerful short-range snowstorm and activates an electric current that surrounds its user with powerful kinetic energy. After a certain number of shots, it builds up a charge to let you use the jet pack up to 2 times.

[*]When you receive each stage (stages 1-4) weapon, you will still keep the previous stage's weapon.[/list]
[b]Zombie Costumes[/b][list][*]Snowman Monster Aksha
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/ed7da60d37fa5dddc3345e9b047b630ac235b4c6.png[/img]
Able to use Snowman Monster Aksha Zombie. This will change the appearance of your Aksha Zombie.

[*]Ice Queen Rusty Wing
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/58b96a155cc8837057aa6ee6b146d153dc9cf193.png[/img]
Able to use Ice Queen Rusty Wing. This will change the appearance of your Rusty Wing Zombie.[/list]
[b]Weapon Paints[/b][list][*]Snowflake Weapon Paint (FAMAS, AUG Guardian, Bouncer, Dual Sword Phantom Slayer, and Plasma Gun)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/0d17044468a62bb048bb5ddb5d0947bf57bbecbf.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/55d147cb5163765dcb8922de786e29cf3ec7064c.png[/img]
 [*]Cracked Weapon Paint (Holy Sword Divine Order, Pyton Desperado, Jackhammer, Hunter-Killer X-90, and MP5)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/50788e54d122e30783d60e8f03f028bdbbf28714.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/7c1b27c7489575d91259ad2283e62f5206ca9d8c.png[/img][/list]
[b]Costumes[/b][list][*]Ice Sword, Polar Bear Backpack, Ice Dragon Backpack, Snowman Sprite, Snowman Helmet, and Enchanted Snowflake.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/4c8c75d83020e4dff58d13f0f37d9dfee8e29c56.png[/img][/list]
[b]Sprays[/b][list][*]Ice Queen Rusty Wing, Snowman Monster Aksha, Snowman Leader Soi, Snowman Super Soldier Jennifer, and Ice Kingdom Venom Sting Sprays
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/c353aff886a6461ff3268145f7977a4d279c5800.png[/img][/list]

[*]Season 8 Conqueror Medal (Highest Rank Reached)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/5f713902579422b81ca7041a5fd536bd06b2bb0a.png[/img]

[u][h3]Zombie Content Update[/h3][/u]For details, please refer to the Season 8 Zombie Mode Update Preview.

[b]Zombie Content Update[/b][list][*]Zombie Boost Items
- There are three zombie-exclusive power-ups that can appear when zombies die.
- Green: Increases maximum HP by 10%
- Blue: Reduces zombie skill cooldown by 10%
- Yellow: Increases Movement Speed by 5%
- Zombies drop 1 of the above power-ups upon death. Zombie players can pick up the power-up by approaching within 2m.
- You can have the effects of all 3 power-ups at once. The same power-up can be stacked up to 2 times.
- These effects last until the end of the round or death.
- These power-ups can be found in Zombie Hero and Zombie Z.

[*]Death Information Window and Revenge Bonus System
- Death Information Window Improvements: Upon death, a pop-up will display information about the player who killed you.
- Revenge Bonus System: Marks players who killed you this round and grants bonus points upon taking revenge.
- The Death Information Window and Revenge Bonus System can be found in Zombie Hero, Zombie Z, and Zombie Evolution.

[*]New Zombie Mutations
- Painful Memories: Marks the player that killed you and decreases the damage taken from that player by 50%.
- Supply Contamination: Press E to place 1 Zombie Bomb on a human team Supply Box. When a human approaches, the Zombie Bomb explodes and inflicts damage.

[*]Zombie Z Improvements
- In Zombie Z Mode, if you do not have the Specialist mutation by Lv. 30, your Lv. 30 mutation is guaranteed to be Specialist.[/list]


[u][h3][Trial] Zombie League Season 3 (1/27 - 3/24)[/h3][/u]
[b]Changes from Previous Season[/b][list][*]Hall of Fame shows the top 500 players -> only the top 100 players
[*]Hall of Fame button changed to be slightly fancier and larger
[*]First play points added: Upon obtaining League Points for the first time each day, get an additional 10 points
[*]Bronze-rank players gain play time and points even after getting kicked or leaving the match early 
[*]Additional points are granted based on the number of players in a match[/list]
[b]Additional Information[/b][list][*]You can check your league status under My Info.
[*]You can review score and weapon information for the top 100 players in the Hall of Fame.
[*]League Ranks: Master > Diamond > Platinum > Gold > Silver > Bronze
[*]Advance your league rank by getting League Points from playing zombie modes.
[*]You can only earn League Points for your first 2 hours of zombie mode play each day.
[*]* Zombie League Season 3 is a [Trial] season. Its rules, such as its progression period, rewards, etc., may be adjusted in the future.
[*]* The Season Pass and Zombie League Season are separate systems with different progression periods.
[*]* Zombie League = Zombie Hero + Zombie Evolution + Zombie Z + Studio Zombie + Zombie (AI)
[*]* Master Rank is the only rank you must advance through competition.
[*]* There is no minimum player requirements for earning League Points, but playing with more players grants a higher bonus.
[*]* You cannot get League Points in private, password-protected rooms.
[*]* You cannot get League Points if abnormal activity or cheating is detected, such as:
- Not participating in gameplay, or killing or infecting such players.
- Abnormal activity as it pertains to Studio devices and map structures.
[*]* We plan to keep making improvements to the League Points formula. Please keep an eye out for future announcements.[/list]
[b]League Rewards[/b][list][*]Master: Zombie League Master Zombification + Lightning Fury (15 Days) + Kalael (15 Days) + Medea (15 Days)

notes.title: [Notice] Auction House Improved!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/b6f7445dbfb588ce0bfa03b6731e7439cd7ae329.jpg[/img]

[h1]Auction House Improvements![/h1]
[h3]Bringing a new level of convenience and security to the auction system![/h3]


[h2]Improved Search System[/h2]
[b]Weapon Paint Filter[/b][list][*] Now you can search for weapons with weapon paint applied.
[*] You can even filter for items with multiple weapon paints on them.[/list]

[h2]Recent Transaction History Display[/h2]
[b]Transaction Chart[/b][list][*] You can now view charts displaying recent transaction history.
[*] The chart can be seen from the Bid Auction and Auction Listing windows.
[*]* Chart displays a weapon's average auction price by day.[/list]

[h2]Price Limit Expansion System[/h2]
[b]Price Limits Automatically Expand[/b][list][*]Weapons that have no transactions after a certain amount of time will have their upper/lower price limit expanded.
  - This will help players who have weapons that they could not sell because the limit was too high or low.
  - Unique quality and lower weapons that have had no transactions for 2 days will have their upper/lower price limit expanded by 10%.
  - This price expansion can happen up to 3 times.
  - Once the weapon has had active transactions again, upper/lower price limits will be set again based on those prices.[/list]

We have more Auction House improvements planned for the future. And we're also optimizing how we set prices for enhancement weapons based on market prices. 


[h3]Additionally, the following weapons have been added to the Mileage Auction!
[/h3][list][*] Desert Eagle 50C Gold

notes.title: Adieu 2020 & New Zombie Content Update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/9f5ecad1efc0200b15e208703654bd057e52e5d0.jpg[/img]

Adieu 2020, a new zombie content update, and rich, year-end events have finally arrived! Get into the game now and prepare for Season 8 that's also coming in the first month of 2021! More detailed information regarding the new updates and events can be found below:[list][*][b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/273110/announcements/detail/2918861082705850968]CLICK HERE TO CHECK IT OUT NOW![/url][/b][/list]

[h2]Major Updates[/h2]
[h3]1. A New Variant Zombie, 'Draugr,' Added[/h3]A new zombie with excellent defense and movement skills using swords has been added![list][*]It is able to use its sword to neutralize damage, projectiles, and even reduce knockback and stiffness.
[*]It's able to teleport forward to damage humans in the path and pull them to one place.[/list]
There are a number of other changes that have been made additionally with today's balance adjustments so be sure to check out the patch notes!

[h3]2. Adieu 2020, Daily Missions Clear Event[/h3]When you log in to the game or collect points through play, you will be rewarded with Transcendence Decoders and winning designs from each country that was held through the Summer 2020 Weapon Paint Design Contest! New and returning users should participate as they can receive up to 1.5 times more mission points during this time!

[h3]3. New Transcendence Classes[/h3]New classes have been released! Meet the new classes 'Leader Soi' and 'Super Soldier Jennifer' now through Class Decoders! Don't miss this chance of getting it in 4x chances held until January 27th!


Join now and experience the excitement of Draugr today! Merry Christmas and a Happy New Year Counter-Strike Nexon: Studio Fans! Thank you for your continuous love and support for CSNS throughout 2020.

- The CSNS Team

notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: December 23rd
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/490038044bd7dc699500c1c0f29391d11de14bf2.jpg[/img]

Here's a rundown of some of the major changes in today's update!

[list][b]Content: Added the New Zombie Draugr[/b]
A new zombie has been released in Zombie Evolution! With the power to switch between offense and defense, this zombie is perfect for breaking through the enemy line!
	
[b]Content: Zombie Evolution & Zombie Z Rebalance[/b]
A new change comes to zombie modes! Read on to learn how they've been rebalanced.
	
[b]Content: New Inferno Difficulty Map for Zombie Scenario[/b]
Total War has been updated with Inferno difficulty! We plan to add Inferno difficulty to more maps in the future, so have fun.

[b]Content: Medal System Improvement Part 2 Information[/b]
The Medal System has been further improved! 3 new medals have also been added, so be sure to check them out.

[b]Promotion: Transcendence Class Promotion (12/23 - 1/27)[/b]
New Transcendence Classes, Leader Soi and Super Soldier Jennifer, have been released! Get them from Class Decoders today![/list]

Check out the Expanded Info section below for details.



[h1]Expanded Info[/h1]
 
[h2]Contents[/h2]

[u][h3]New Zombie: Draugr[/h3][/u][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/017e1b1e64001c2a59feeda07cfe11a0e958d352.png[/img]
A new zombie exclusive to Zombie Evolution has been released! With the power to switch between offense and defense, this zombie is perfect for breaking through the enemy line!

[b]Introduction[/b][list][*]Draugr is a powerful mutant zombie class that uses a sword. It has a very long attack range, but slow attack speed. Hold right-click to charge up to 3 stages. Range and damage increase according to the charge stage.[/list]

[b]Skill[/b][list][*]Deflect: Block enemy projectiles with your sword. While using this skill, the effects of knockback and stun against you are reduced. Use the skill again to deactivate it. The gauge gradually drains while using the skill, and refills when not using it.

[*]Dimension Slash: Channel your focus and teleport forward, dealing damage to all humans in your path and pulling nearby humans in. Cannot move through obstacles.[/list]


[u][h3]Zombie Evolution & Zombie Z Rebalance[/h3][/u]A new change comes to zombie modes!

[b]Zombie Evolution Mode[/b][list][*]1. Human Skill Limit Change: After learning 2 skills, you can use virus to learn more skills. Doing so will replace the first skill you already learned with the new skill.

[*]2. Added Human Team Banshee skills.
  - Vampire Bats Skill: While the skill is in effect, vampire bats attack when you hit an enemy, inflicting additional damage and healing you for a portion of all damage dealt.
  - Banshee Buff: Marks Zombies in the direction you are facing in red.

[*]3. Increased the amount of virus required to use skills while you are Human from 2 to 3.

[*]4. Slightly increased the periodic virus gain when Humans survive.

[*]5. Adjusted Human skill balance.
  - Aksha: Reduced the cumulative damage required for the Discharge skill and increased the attack power boost to up to 250%.
  - Rusty Wing: Slightly increased the Glide skill's cooldown.
  - Deimos: Slightly reduced the Shock skill's cooldown.
  - Venom Guard: Reduced the Zombie Explosion skill's cooldown.

[*]6. Reduced the number of Virus Essences generated upon a zombie death from up to 6 to 5.

[*]7. Reduced the amount of virus obtained from Virus Essence when you are a zombie from 50 to 35.

[*]8. Increased the amount of virus obtained when a zombie kills a human from 120 to 150.

[*]9. Increased the virus level required to transform into a mutant zombie from 7 to 9.

[*]10. Increased the virus level consumed to transform into a mutant zombie from 6 to 9.

[*]11. Respawn time now increases even when dying from normal headshots, not just from Deadly Shot.

[*]12. Adjusted Brutus and Arachne balance.
  - Slightly increased Brutus defense.
  - Slightly increased Brutus HP.
  - Slightly reduced Arachne HP.
  - Slightly increased Arachne armor.
  - Reduced Arachne's Web Walk skill cooldown from 6 to 5 sec.[/list]

[b]Zombie Z Mode[/b][list][*]1. Mutation Changes
  - Contact Infection: Damages nearby humans every second. The damage increases every round.
  - Icarus: Has a 2-sec cooldown after using Glide.

[*]2. Zombie Z Mode Unlock Levels Adjusted
  - Changed the unlock level for some zombies and weapons.

[*]3. Additional Changes
  - Fixed the issue where you could attack while using Venom Guard's Self-Destruct skill.
  - Round settings can now be selected in 2-round increments with a minimum of 5 rounds and maximum of 17 rounds.[/list]


[u][h3]New Inferno Difficulty Map for Zombie Scenario[/h3][/u][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/3f215453bf479427d28a2912e78c506f884d0e68.jpg[/img]
A new Zombie Scenario Inferno difficulty map has been added! Play it now! 
[list][*]Featured Map: Pursue: Total War[/list]


[u][h3]Medal System Improvement Part 2[/h3][/u][list][*]1. Changed player count criteria for achieving medals.
  - Player count requirements, which were different per medal, are now 1 or more players by default.
  - Several medals, which require a higher player count due to the medal's nature, will stay the same. This information is mentioned in each medal's description.

[*]2. Added medal colors according to Honor Points.
  - Added medal colors for 1500-1999 points, as well as 2000-2999 points.
  - Medal colors can be checked under the Help button on the top right side of the Medals page.

[*]3. Added the option to not display medal stages.
  - Added the option to not display the stage for earned medals.
  - You can activate/deactivate this feature in the Display Medal section under the Medals page.

[*]4. Improved notation of obtainable Achievement Points/Honor Points.
  - Changed the notation for unobtained Achievement Points/Honor Points to look engraved.
  - Removed all Honor wording that was displayed before the medal names in the Medals page.

[*]5. Added the feature to check medal stages.
  - For medals that have medal stages, you can select each stage and check the achievement goals and rewards in advance.

[*]6. Added 3 new medals.
  - Welcome Medal: Reach 10 cumulative logins.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/0773fc33fd6e7fd5e188951ff7a107d9e4a5b35c.png[/img]
  - Not Missing a Beat Medal: Reach 5 consecutive logins.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/e1ddb5682981f44e4ca33214c8e244a101a0264d.png[/img]
  - Hacker Medal: Decode 30 decoders.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/1366732e8562e6f7a901fef0dc8d57f92fe85f8a.png[/img]

[*]7. Added Achievement Shop items.
  - Kill Taunt
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/873d9fbde0535a88dc9bc3460aabcfa337a77dc5.png[/img]
(Animated) Giggling Kill Taunt. Shows a special image on the death recap of enemies you kill in Original and Deathmatch modes.
  - Zombification
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/bccb37dd16867fd1683c3912f8c4055310f6e143.png[/img]
Nine Lives Zombification. Changes the revival effect when you revive as a zombie in Zombie Mode.
  - Nameplate
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/fdc5a892dfc5e7b564d57d34df94adba4254348f.png[/img]
(Animated) Burning Nameplate. Customizes how your name appears by applying the Burning Nameplate.[/list]


[u][h3]Updates to the New/Welcome Back Supply Box[/h3][/u][list][*]The contents of the CSer Settlement Support Weapon Box, which is one of the New/Welcome Back Supply Box items, have been updated as below.

notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: November 25th
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/8ae980e72a4d024dd0e3d1774746020ef6b381c4.jpg[/img]

Here's a rundown of some of the major changes in today's update!

[list][b]Content: Scenario TX Update[/b]
This is a "shooting RPG" based on Studio Mode. Hunt monsters and obtain various items to grow stronger, all in an isometric view.
	
[b]Content: Medal System Improvement Information[/b]
The medal system has been improved. Please refer to the details below for changes to the medal page, stages, Achievement Shop, etc.
	
[b]Content: New "Inferno" Difficulty for Zombie Scenario[/b]
Zombie Scenario is now even harder! This time, you're up against the Inferno difficulty, which is even tougher than the existing Hell difficulty. Monsters will have greater attack power, HP, speed, etc.

[b]Balance Update Information[/b]
The balance of Zombie Z/Zombie Evolution has been updated. Please see below for details.

[b]Promotion: Magic Lance Scarlet Rose Promotion (11/25 - 12/23) [/b]
During the promotion, enjoy 3x drop rates for the Transcendence Weapons, Magic Lance Scarlet Rose and Barrett M95 White Tiger. Once the promotion is over, the Barrett M95 White Tiger will become permanently available.[/list]

Check out the Expanded Info section below for details.



[h1]Expanded Info[/h1]
 
[h2]Contents[/h2]

[u][h3]Studio - Scenario TX Update[/h3][/u]This is a "shooting RPG" based on Studio Mode. Hunt monsters and obtain various items to grow stronger, all in an isometric view.

[b]Details[/b][list][*] Items exclusive to Scenario TX, obtained from eliminating monsters, can be obtained permanently.
[*] Scenario TX supports individual saving per class. Enjoy various gameplay experiences with each class.
[*] Enjoy Scenario TX gameplay utilizing about 80 different skills!
[*] You can become even more powerful through the Scenario TX's Expert advancement system, exclusively for Lv. 30.[/list]

[b]Scenario TX Hunting Map Creation[/b][list][*] You can create hunting maps for Scenario TX with even just basic blocks, without separate devices.
[*] Anyone can freely play the hunting maps.
[*] Hunt monsters and obtain items in various hunting grounds created by the community![/list]

[b]Scenario TX Missions[/b][list][*] A new form of scenario where the official Scenario TX lore is applied, featuring boss monsters.
[*] Challenge Scenario TX missions with the Mission Points you collected from clearing hunting maps!
[*] Hunt boss monsters to obtain exclusive loot.[/list]


[u][h3]Medal System Improvement Information[/h3][/u]The medal system has been improved. Please refer to the details below for changes to the medal page, stages, Achievement Shop, etc.

[b]Medal Page[/b][list][*] You can view the medal page by selecting Medals under My Info.
[*] The search feature has been improved. You can now search by medal descriptions, not just medal names.
[*] You can easily check each medal's status through Medal Collection View and Medal Detail View.[/list]

[b]Medal Stage Expansion[/b][list][*] When you complete a stage 1 medal, you can challenge the game for the stage 2 medal.
[*] Upon winning a medal, you can gain Honor Points or Achievement Points.[/list]

[b]Achievement Shop[/b][list][*] The Achievement Shop is open. There, you can spend Achievement Points to purchase items.[/list]


[u][h3]New "Inferno" Difficulty for Zombie Scenario[/h3][/u]Zombie Scenario is now even harder! This time, you're up against the Inferno difficulty, which is even tougher than the existing Hell difficulty. Monsters will have greater attack power, HP, speed, etc.

[b]2 Zombie Scenario Maps with Difficulty Expanded to Inferno[/b][list][*] Pursuit: Ep. Carlito
[*] Track: Last Clue[/list]

[b]Notice[/b][list][*] Inferno Difficulty is only available on certain maps. Maps that can be played on Inferno difficulty are listed on the map selection screen.
[*] When you play with a Map Playlist, you can select Inferno difficulty only when all selected maps are playable on Inferno difficulty.
[*] We plan to regularly add Inferno difficulty to more maps in the future.[/list]


[u][h3]Zombie Z/Zombie Evolution Balance Update Information[/h3][/u]
[b]1. Zombie Karma Gain Increased[/b][list][*] The Karma zombies gain from killing humans has been doubled.
[*] The Karma zombies gain from killing humans while certain zombie skills are active has been tripled.[/list]

[b]2. Zombie Z Karma Sub-Effects Improved[/b][list][*] Mid-Point Before Reaching Karma Stage 1 Goal:
  - Zombies can select a zombie class 5 levels higher than your level.
[*] Mid-Point Before Reaching Karma Stage 2 Goal:
  - Zombies can select a zombie class 10 levels higher than your level.
[*] Mid-Point Before Reaching Karma Stage 3 Goal:
  - Zombies can select any class and can obtain all zombie mutations.[/list]

[b]3. Zombie Team Karma Main Per-Stage Effects Improved[/b][list][*] Zombie Team Stage 1 Karma Effect: Immune to status effects for 4 sec (ignore stuns and knockback).
[*] Zombie Team Stage 2 Karma Effect: Invincible for 6 sec (ignore damage, stuns, and knockback) and can move
[*] Zombie Team Stage 3 Karma Effect: Play as Zombie Hero, Invincible for 7 sec (ignore damage, stuns, and knockback)[/list]

[b]4. Zombie Z Mode Unlock Level Adjustment[/b][list][*] Item Unlock Level Adjustments[/list]

[b]5. Zombie Z Mode Hellhound and Trinity Grenade Purchase Price Changes[/b][list][*]1) Hellhound

notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: October 28th
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/20fff6c089b850687ab088a0a333c45166d8acdb.jpg[/img]

Here's a rundown of some of the major changes in today's update!

[list][b]Content: Difficulty System Revamp[/b]
The difficulty stages have been simplified from the previous 12 stages to 5 stages.

[b]Event: Free Daily Rewards Item Update (10/28 - 11/25)[/b]
The Free Daily Rewards list has been updated. As the 20-day cumulative special reward, you will receive Sigma Weapon Paint that can be applied to the Epic Weapon, Gungnir.
	
[b]Event: Halloween Celebration Events (10/28 - 11/11)[/b]
Various Halloween celebration events will be held.

[Candy Event] When you play Zombie Mode, you can receive Baskets of Candy. Collect 3 candies of the same color and exchange them for items. This time around, the Hopeful Chest includes a Gold Transcendence Red Dragon Cannon as a special item. Don't miss it!

[Halloween Ticket Collection Event] When you collect tickets by playing the game, you can receive the Halloween Damage Skin or the Mnemonic Weapon Paint, which is a weapon paint for Hunter-Killer X-90.

[Halloween Pumpkin Grenade Event] Deal random damage with the Pumpkin Grenade.
	
[b]Promotion: Season 7 New Transcendence Class Promotion (10/28 - 11/11)[/b]
You can get the new Transcendence Classes, "Boss David Black" and "Special Agent Criss", from decoders during the promotion. When you get Boss David Black, you can get Black's Sunglasses (Permanent). When you get Special Agent Criss, you can get Criss' Military Cap (Permanent).[/list]

Check out the Expanded Info section below for details.



[h1]Expanded Info[/h1]
 
[h2]Contents[/h2]

[u][h3]Difficulty System Revamp[/h3][/u]The old 12 difficulty stages have been simplified to 5 stages. With this change, VIP perks and scenario map clear rewards have also been updated. You can check the updated map clear rewards by pressing the Check Main Reward button in the Lobby.

[b]Difficulty Changes[/b][list][*] Old Difficulties: Easy 1-2, Regular, Hard 1-9
[*] New Difficulties: Easy, Normal, Hard, Very Hard, and Hell[/list]

[b]VIP Perk Changes[/b][list][*] Silver: Hard clear reward + Regular Reward Box 2 times
[*] Gold: Hard clear reward + Regular Reward Box 3 times
[*] Platinum: Very Hard clear reward + Intermediate Reward Box 3 times
[*] Diamond: Very Hard clear reward + Intermediate Reward Box 4 times
[*] VIP: Hell clear reward + Advanced Reward Box 5 times
[*] VVIP: Hell clear reward + Advanced Reward Box 7 times[/list]

[u][h3]Miscellaneous Fixes[/h3][/u][list][*] Fixed the bug where some images displayed in a different language
[*] Fixed the bug where new character images did not display on the message block
[*] Fixed the bug where the notice only displayed in English
[*] Fixed other minor bugs[/list] 


[h2]Events[/h2]

[u][h3]Halloween Celebration Candy Event (10/28 - 11/11)[/h3][/u]Obtain Baskets of Candy by playing Zombie Mode during the event. Open the Baskets of Candy to collect candy and get various rewards.

[b]Requirements[/b][list][*] 1 Basket of Candy given each time you reach 3 minutes of playtime in eligible modes during the event.
[*] You can obtain up to 30 Baskets of Candy a day.
[*] Eligible Modes: Zombie Hero, Zombie Z, Zombie Evolution, and Zombie Scenario[/list]

[b]How to Obtain and Use Candy[/b][list][*] Use the Basket of Candy to get 1 random Green, Pink, Blue, or Red Candy.
[*] Collect 3 of the same colored candy and use them to get rewards.[/list]

[b]Rewards[/b][list][*] Green Candy x3: 1,000 Mileage Coupon
[*] Pink Candy x3: Starlight Rolling Shooter (Permanent)
[*] Red Candy x3: Unique Decoder x1
[*] Blue Candy x3: Hopeful Chest x1[/list]

[b]Notice[/b][list][*] You can only participate in rooms with 4 or more players.
[*] You cannot participate in Studio Mode.
[*] You can obtain up to 30 Baskets of Candy a day.
[*] All Candy and Basket of Candy items will be removed during the maintenance on November 11th.[/list]


[u][h3]Halloween Ticket Collection Event (10/28 - 11/11)[/h3][/u]You can receive CSN:S Event Tickets when you complete certain missions during the event. You can receive various rewards by collecting tickets.

[b]Ticket Acquiring Conditions[/b][list][*] Daily login: 5 tickets
[*] Reach 30 minutes of login: 1 ticket (repeatable)
[*] Score 10 zombie kills in Random Rules Zombie Hero Halloween Assault: 15 tickets
[*] Score 10 zombie assists in Random Rules Zombie Hero Halloween Assault: 10 tickets
[*] Score 10 zombie kills in Random Rules Zombie Hero Italy: 15 tickets
[*] Score 10 zombie assists in Random Rules Zombie Hero Italy: 10 tickets
[*] Complete class Exploration 1 time: 5 tickets
[*] Complete class Exploration 2 times: 10 tickets[/list]

[b]Rewards for Total Number of Tickets Obtained[/b][list][*] Total 555 tickets: Halloween Damage Skin (30 Days)
