notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: April 16th
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/e80b2e8d98d31ce3d8b1919f9351b96d1025d0c8.jpg[/img]

Here's a rundown of some of the major changes in today's update!

[list][b]Content: Exploration System[/b]
We've added the brand-new Exploration system, where your classes bring back items even while you're logged out. Check it out by pressing the "Exploration" button at the bottom of the Lobby screen.
  
[b]Event: Old-Time Costume Box Event (4/16 - 4/29)[/b]
You can get an Old-Time Costume Box every time you reach playtime milestones during the event. You can also get additional rewards based on the total number of boxes you get.
 
[b]Event: Transcendence Erica and Gerard Release Event (4/16 - 4/29)[/b]
During the event, you can get rewards for playing Zombie Scenario maps where Erica and Gerard appear as NPCs.
 
[b]Event: Old-Time Brand Weapon 11 Event (4/16 - 5/13)[/b]
During the event, Brand 11 weapons will be stronger.

[b]Event: Exploration Slot Expansion Coupon Giveaway (4/16 - 4/29)[/b]
You will receive an Exploration Slot Expansion Coupon (14 Days) when you log in and reach 10 minutes of playtime during the event.
 
[b]Shop: Season 5 Transcendence Class Promotion (4/16 - 4/29)[/b]
The new Transcendence Classes, Private Erica and Drill Instructor Gerard, can be obtained from decoders during the promotion. You can get Erica's Beret (Permanent) if you get Private Erica, and you can get Gerard's Peaked Cap (Permanent) if you get Drill Instructor Gerard.[/list]

Check out the Expanded Info section below for details.


[u][h1]Expanded Info[/h1][/u]
[h1]Contents[/h1]
[b]New Content: Exploration System[/b]
The Exploration system is a new mode where your classes will bring back items even while you are logged out.
Check it out by pressing the "Exploration" button at the bottom of the Lobby screen.
[list][*] Exploration System Overview
[list][*] You can select and send 3 classes to an exploration area.
[*] The exploration success rate changes based on the area, the level, and the exploration levels of the classes.
[*] The duration changes based on difficulty. (Easy: 2 hours, Normal: 4 hours, and Hard: 8 hours)
[*] You'll receive the base reward when the exploration ends. If you complete the mission, you'll get an additional reward.
[*] Please be careful, as the reward will be reset if you do not claim it within 24 hours after completing the exploration.[/list]
[*] Starting Exploration
When you press the button in the Lobby, the "Exploration" window will appear. The Exploration window has 3 parts.
[list][*]Exploration Slots: 1 area will be provided by default. You can open up to 2 additional slots by using Exploration Slot Expansion Coupons, for a total of 3 slots.
[list][*] Exploration area information will be updated every day at midnight.[/list]
[*] Exploration Settings: You can select the difficulty for the currently selected area, and set the 3 classes to dispatch.
[list][*] You must fill all 3 class slots to depart. There are minimum and maximum success rates for each difficulty.
[*] When the exploration area changes, there is a chance to get the "Bonus Class" mark. If you send the Bonus Class, the exploration success rate increases.
[*] You can change the exploration area randomly by pressing the button on the top left. However, using this option will cost Mileage.
[*] To cancel an exploration that is already in progress, select the exploration area and press the X button on the top right. The assigned classes will not need to rest.[/list]
[*] Classes Owned: You can check the status of the classes you have.
[list][*] Each class has a different exploration level. Temporary classes cannot be used for exploration.
[*] Classes that complete an exploration once will need to rest. They cannot go on another exploration that day.
[*] Classes on exploration can be used in other game modes without restrictions.[/list][/list]
[*] Exploration Level Enhancement
In the Enhance screen, you can raise the exploration level of the classes you own.
[list][*] When enhancing, you can use classes, costumes, and sprays as material.
[*] Temporary items can also be used as material. You will receive the same rewards as you would from dismantling the item.[/list][/list]

[b]Other Changes[/b]
[list][*] Changed Quick Start to recommend the appropriate mode based on player patterns.
[*] Added a feature to restrict weapons in Continuous Maps.
[*] Added an option to hide the Studio creator.
[*] Fixed other minor bugs.[/list][/list]
 

[h1]Events[/h1]
[b]Old-Time Costume Box Event (4/16 - 4/29)[/b]
You can get an Old-Time Costume Box every time you reach playtime milestones during the event. You can also get additional rewards based on the total number of boxes you get.
[list][*] How to Get Old-Time Costume Boxes
[list][*] You can obtain 1 Old-Time Costume Box when you reach 11 minutes of playtime in any mode, excluding Studio Mode.
[*] You can obtain up to 11 rewards a day. You must be in a room with 4 or more players to make progress.[/list]
[*] Old-Time Costume Box Pileup Rewards
You can get additional rewards based on the number of boxes you get.
[list][*] 11: SKULL-11 (Permanent) + Weapon Paint (x1)
[*] 55: JANUS-11 (Permanent) + Weapon Paint (x1) and THANATOS-11 (Permanent) + Weapon Paint (x1)
[*] 99: TURBULENT-11 (Permanent) + Weapon Paint (x1), CROW-11 (Permanent) + Weapon Paint (x1), and BALROG-XI (Permanent) + Weapon Paint (x1)[/list]
[*] Old-Time Costume Box Rates
[list][*] Costume x1 (Permanent) - 91.5% (Includes 12 costumes)
[list][*] Cat Fish, Alice Bunny Ears, Dao Mask, Bazzi Mask, Polar Bear Head, Fierce Penguin, Indian Warbonnet, Indian shield, Dinosaur Head, Dinosaur Buddy, Pharaoh Mask, and Mummy Doll[/list]
[*] Unique Decoder x3 - 2%
[*] Class Decoder x3 - 2%
[*] Rare Decoder x15 - 4.5%[/list]
[*] Notice
[list][*] Unused Old-Time Costume Box items will be removed during maintenance on 4/29.[/list][/list]

[b]Transcendence Erica and Gerard Release Event (4/16 - 4/29)[/b]
During the event, you can get rewards for playing the designated Zombie Scenario maps.
[list][*] Featured Maps

[*] Track: Envy Mask[/list]
[*] Celebration Event 1
[list][*] When you clear a featured map, you can obtain 2 Old-Time Costume Boxes.
[*] Each account can only earn the reward once per map, up to 4 total.[/list]

[*] Rewards for Celebration Events 1 and 2 are counted separately. If you have a new Transcendence Class equipped, you can participate in both simultaneously. Can obtain up to 10 boxes total.[/list][/list]

[*] Rewards for Celebration Events 1 and 2 are counted separately. If you have a new Transcendence Class equipped, you can participate in both simultaneously. Can obtain up to 10 boxes total.[/list][/list]

[b]Old-Time Brand Weapon 11 Event (4/16 - 5/13)[/b]
During the event, the following weapons will become stronger.
[list][*] Weapons Affected
[list][*] SKULL-11, Balrog-XI, Janus-11, Thanatos-11, CROW-11, Tubulent-11[/list]
[*] Notice

[b]Exploration Slot Expansion Coupon Giveaway (4/16 - 4/29)[/b]
You will receive an Exploration Slot Expansion Coupon (14 Days) when you log in and reach 10 minutes of playtime during the event.
[list][*] Notice

[*] Mission 3 – Score 5 cumulative zombie kills in Zombie Z mode + Login to the game 5 times

[b]1-Day Weapon Giveaway (4/16 - 4/29)[/b]
You will receive durational (1 Day) weapons on your first login each day during the event period. (Once per day per account.)

notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: April 1st
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/43f2bb6621c3125876fdf16fd9ae3c2a9861bf1d.jpg[/img]

Here's a rundown of some of the major changes in today's update!
[list][b]Contents: New Maps + Studio Mode's Kingdom Collaboration[/b] 
The new maps Joseon Marketplace and Researcher's Log Supplement #Joseon have been added. You can also now use the Season 5 theme, Joseon, in Studio. Obtain the Joseon theme for free by logging in during the giveaway period!
  
[b]Event: Spring Seed Event (4/1 - 4/16)[/b]
Get Seeds when you first log in each day during the event. Then, use the Seed to get an immediate reward, or grow it into a Sprout or Fruit for even better rewards!

[b]Event: New Map Event (4/1 - 4/16)[/b]
Get 3x EXP when you play the new Joseon Marketplace map during the event. You can also get additional rewards for reaching certain playtime milestones!

[b]Event: Season 5 Kingdom Theme Studio Contest (4/1 - 4/29)[/b]
Participate in the Season 5 Kingdom Theme Studio Contest! Create maps using the Kingdom theme for a chance at great rewards. Refer to the separate contest notice for details. Also, participate in the Theme Package Giveaway and Studio Creation Feedback Event, which are running alongside the contest!

[b]Shop: Transcendence Weapon Re-Sale Promotion (4/1 - 4/16)[/b]
During the promotion period, you can obtain the Transcendence weapons Thunder Ghost Walker and Dual Sword Phantom Slayer from decoders. Also, new weapon packages have been added to the Shop.[/list]
Check out the Expanded Info section below for details.


[u][h1]Expanded Info[/h1][/u]
[h1]Contents[/h1]
[b]2 New Maps[/b]
Brand new Kingdom collaboration maps have been added!
[list][*] Available Modes
[list][*] Joseon Marketplace: Zombie, Zombie Hero, Zombie Z, Team Deathmatch, and Deathmatch
[*] Researcher's Log Supplement #Joseon: Studio[/list][/list]

[b]Studio Mode - Kingdom Collaboration Content[/b]
You can now use the Season 5 theme, Joseon, in Studio! Get the Joseon theme for free by logging in during the giveaway period, without needing to make a separate purchase!
[list][*] Items Included
[list][*] Joseon-themed blocks, NPCs, and zombies[/list][/list]


[h1]Events[/h1]
[b]Spring Seed Event (4/1 - 4/16)[/b]
Get Seeds when you first log in each day during the event. Then, use the Seed to get an immediate reward, or grow it into a Sprout or Fruit for even better rewards!
[list][*] Seed Growth Stages and Requirements
[list][*] Seed: granted upon your first login each day during the event
[*] Sprout: reach 30 minutes of playtime in Zombie Hero/Zombie Z Mode while you have the Seed
[*] Fruit: get 30 zombie kills or assists in Zombie Hero/Zombie Z Mode while you have the Sprout[/list]
[*] Rewards for Each Growth Stage
[list][*] Seed: grants Grade 3 Parts Reward Box x3 upon use.
[*] Sprout: grants Rare Decoder x5 upon use.
[*] Fruit: grants a random number of Rare Decoders and Harvested Fruit x1 upon use. The number of decoders will be random. (x1, x5, x10, x25, x50, or x100)
[*] Harvested Fruit: collect a stack of 10 Harvested Fruit get the Dual Sword Infernal Hunter (Permanent) upon use.[/list]
[*] Notice
[list][*] You must possess the previous stage's item to grow it into the next stage.
[*] Seeds, Sprouts, and Fruit will be removed at 00:00 (UTC +2) each day.
[*] Harvested Fruit is not removed each day but will be removed during maintenance on April 16th.
[*] Seed growth progress only happens in rooms with 8 or more players. Seed growth progress will not occur in Studio Mode.[/list][/list]

[b]New Map Event (4/1 - 4/16)[/b]
Get 3x EXP when you play the new Joseon Marketplace map during the event. You can also get additional rewards for reaching certain playtime milestones!
[list][*] Event Rewards
[list][*] Earn 3x EXP
[*] Obtain a Sprout Headband upon reaching 10 minutes of playtime[/list]
[*] Notice
[list][*] You can only make progress in rooms with 4 or more players.[/list][/list]

[b]Season 5 Kingdom Theme Studio Contest (4/1 - 4/29)[/b]
Participate in the Season 5 Kingdom Theme Studio Contest! Create maps using the Kingdom theme for a chance at great rewards. Refer to the separate contest notice for details.
[list][*] Contest Theme
[list][*] Create a Studio map using the Kingdom theme.[/list]
[*] Contest Schedule (UTC +2)
[list][*] Contest Participation Application Period: 4/1 - 4/29
[*] Candidate Announcements and Voting: 5/6 - 5/14
[*] Final Winner Announcements: 5/25
[*] Reward Distribution: 5/27[/list][/list]

[b]Contest Celebration Studio Theme Package Giveaway (4/1 - 4/26)[/b]
Leave a request as a comment under the Steam Discussion notice to get theme package items for Studio maps. Refer to that notice for details on how to participate.
[list][*] Package Details
[list][*] MapleStory Theme Package, Soccer Theme Package, Space Theme Package, China Theme Package, Christmas Theme Package[/list]
[*] Notice
[list][*] Items will be given to those who make a request by Sunday of each week during the event. If there is no maintenance that week, reward distribution may be delayed.[/list][/list]

[b]Studio Creation Feedback Event (4/1 - 4/13)[/b]
We're giving a small token of thanks to those who leave feedback on the Studio Creation Mode during the event.
Feel free to leave your honest feedback on the mode, including what you like, what you want to see improved, what ideas you have, etc.

2) Leave feedback on how to improve Studio Creation Mode in English, as a reply to the Notice
3) Include your in-game nickname so we know who to give the reward to[/list]

[*] Python Desperado Event Ticket
[*] Hunter Killer X-12 Event Ticket[/list][/list]

notes.title: [Notice] Information on the Recent Bug
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/dec6f53768fe95ef5dd1d1eda2708d1623babdee.jpg[/img]

Hello, Survivors, who have showered CSNS with unceasing love, 

We would like to fill you in on the details of a recent bug and the actions we've taken to address it. Before we get into the details, we want to express our sincerest apologies for the inconvenience and disappointment the bug may have caused you.

[list][*][b]Bug Details[/b]
[list][*] We discovered a bug that allowed players to duplicate enhancement material parts.[/list]

[*] [b]Actions Taken So Far[/b]
[olist][*] Discovered the bug around 10:30 CET on 3/22.
[*] Performed an emergency maintenance at 15:00 that same day, blocking both further duplications from occurring and the usage of enhancement materials.
[*] Investigated players who exploited the duplication bug and the number of items they duplicated (found a confirmed total of 61 players).[/olist]
[*] [b]4/1 Maintenance Actions[/b]
[olist][*]After the 4/1 maintenance, you will be able to use enhancement materials again.
[*] As an apology for the inconvenience the bug may have caused you, we plan to give the following as compensation:
[list][*] Compensation Redemption: Log in between the end of maintenance on 4/1 (Wed) and midnight CEST on 4/14 (Wed)
[*] Compensation Items: Transcendence Decoder x3[/list]
[*] All materials wrongfully gained by the bug will be removed.
[*] If the materials were already used, EXP will be deducted from enhanced weapons based on the materials used. EXP deductions will be applied only to values changed after the maintenance on 3/18.
[*] Players who exploited the bug will be restricted from playing the game for up to 30 days, depending on the number of times they used the exploit.
[list][*] 2 times: Restricted from playing the game for 1 day
[*] 3 times: Restricted from playing the game for 7 days
[*] 4 or more times: Restricted from playing the game for 14 days[/list][/olist][/list]
We will do everything in our power to provide a stable, bug-free service in the future. We apologize once again for the inconvenience caused by the bug.

Here's a rundown of some of the major changes in today's update!

[list][b]New Map and Zombie Mode Balance Adjustment[/b]
You can play the new map, Joseon Village. Several balance adjustments will be applied during Season 5.

[b]Candy Event (3/18 - 4/1)[/b]
Obtain Baskets of Candy by meeting certain requirements during the event. Open the Baskets of Candy to get candy, then exchange candy for various items.

The Bonus Disassembly Event allows you to disassemble all kinds of weapons. 

[b]Reinforced Rewards for New/Returning Players Event Extended (3/18 - 6/10)[/b]
Random Rules maps for the Zombie Hero are now available! In these maps, the rules of the game change each round. When the Crash rule is triggered, two random rules will be applied for the duration of the round.

[b]Season 5 Transcendence Weapon Promotion: x3 Rate Boost (3/18 - 4/1)[/b]
During the promotion, the rates for the new Transcendence Weapon, Lightning Fury, will be increased x3.[/list]

Check out the Expanded Info section below for details.


[u][h1]Expanded Info[/h1][/u]
[h1]Contents[/h1]
[b]New Map - Joseon Village[/b]
A new map, Joseon Village, has been added as part of the Kingdom collaboration.
[list][*] Available Modes: Zombie, Zombie Hero, Zombie Z, Team Deathmatch, and Deathmatch[/list]

[list][*] Applied During:
[list][*] Season 5[/list]

[*] Infecting humans as a zombie now grants EXP. EXP gain drops off after the 4th infected human in a single round.
[*] The EXP obtained from the Intellectual mutation has been reduced.[/list][/list]

[list][*] The Quick Entry feature has been added to the Studio Lobby.

notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: March 4th
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/43f2bb6621c3125876fdf16fd9ae3c2a9861bf1d.jpg[/img]

Here's a rundown of some of the major changes in today's update!
[list][b]Mental Math Event (3/4 - 3/18)[/b]
You can earn random numbers by meeting the requirements in Zombie Hero or Zombie Z modes. Based on the numbers that you get, you can receive rewards like Mileage.

[b]Zombie Hero: Random Rules Event (3/4 - 3/18)[/b]
Random Rules maps for the Zombie Hero are now available! In these maps, the rules of the game change each round. When the Crash rule is triggered, two random rules will be applied for the duration of the round	

[b]Starlight Rolling Shooter Rate-Up Promotion (3/4 - 3/18)[/b]
During the promotion, the rates for the new Starlight Rolling Shooter weapon from Unique and Unique Premium Decoders will be increased x5![/list]
Check out the Expanded Info section below for details.


[u][h1]Expanded Info[/h1][/u]
[h1]Events[/h1]
[b]Mental Math Event (3/4 ~ 3/18)[/b]
You can earn random numbers by meeting the requirements in Zombie Hero or Zombie Z modes. Based on the numbers that you get, you can receive rewards like Mileage.
[list][*] How to Get Numbers
[list][*] You have a chance to get numbers by scoring kills, or assists on zombies, or humans in Zombie Hero, or Zombie Z modes.
[*] The numbers range from 1 - 10.
[*] The numbers you get are entered automatically into the equation shown below, in the order of A, B, and C. The equation is completed once when you collect 3 numbers.
[list][*] Equation: (A + B) x C[/list][/list]
[*] Rewards for Completing Equation
[list][*] When the equation is completed, you'll get Mileage equaling the result.[/list]
 [*] Rewards for Completing Equation Multiple Times
[list][*] You can receive a variety of rewards based on the number of times you've completed the equation.
[list][*] Completed 20 Times: Rare Decoder x20
[*] Completed 50 Times: Unique Decoder x10
[*] Completed 80 Times: Transcendence Decoder x5
[*] Completed 100 Times: Jiangshi Zombie (Permanent)[/list][/list][*] Notice
[list][*] You can complete the equation no more than 10 times per day.
[*] You can only make progress in rooms with 8 or more players.
[*] You are unable to participate in Studio Mode.[/list][/list]

[b]Zombie Hero: Random Rules Event (3/4 - 3/18)[/b]
In Random Rules maps for the Zombie Hero mode, the rules of the game change every round. The rules will be displayed for 3 seconds prior to the beginning of the round, and you can check them at any time by pressing the L key during the match.
[list][*] Featured Maps
[list][*] Assault, Italy, Falls, Estate, Militia, Vertigo, Cantera[/list][/list]


[h1]Shop[/h1]
[b]Starlight Rolling Shooter Rate-Up Promotion (3/4 - 3/18)[/b]

notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: February 19th
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/43f2bb6621c3125876fdf16fd9ae3c2a9861bf1d.jpg[/img]

Here's a rundown of some of the major changes in today's update!
[list][b]Season 5 Kingdom Collaboration[/b]
Season 5 is built around a collaboration with the drama Kingdom. 
This time, we're enhancing the perks of the Season Pass and updating Zombie Mode. Check out the mysterious weapons, costumes, and other items based on the Joseon theme!
 
[b]Season 5 Kingdom Collaboration: Lee-Chang and Yeong-Shin Class Promotion (2/19 - 3/18)[/b]
 Lee-Chang and Yeong-Shin, the two main characters of Kingdom, will appear as the new Transcendence Classes. The Lee-Chang and Yeong-Shin classes are equipped with a unique synergy effect that enhances Season 5 weapons. These classes can be obtained not from Decoders, but from packages.

[b]Various Events[/b]
There are tons of events celebrating the Season 5 collaboration with Kingdom. 
You can earn all kinds of rewards simply by playing the game and participating in events, like the Golden Zombie Event, Zombie Z Newbie Event, Heart Attack Event, and more! [/list]
Check out the Expanded Info section below for details.


[u][h1]Expanded Info[/h1][/u]
[h1]Contents[/h1]
[b]Season 5 Kingdom Collaboration (2/19 - 5/13)[/b]
Season 5 is built around a collaboration with the drama Kingdom.

You can obtain Season Badges from Missions, Events, and other activities during the season. All kinds of rewards will be given when you collect these badges and level up your grade. Purchasing the Season Pass will grant you additional rewards! 

Check out the mysterious weapons, costumes, and other items based on the Joseon theme!


[b]Season 5 Zombie Mode Update[/b]
For Season 5, we've made the following changes to Zombie Mode.
[list][*] You can level down in Zombie Z mode.
[list][*] Press the L key to level down, which will remove 1 random mutation. If there are no mutations that can be removed, 1 point will be deducted.[/list]
[*] The balance of Banshee and Voodoo Zombies has been changed.
[list][*] Banshee
[list][*] Damage taken reduced by 70 while using the Pulling skill.
[*] Range and pulling force increased for the Pulling skill.[/list][/list][list][*] Voodoo Zombie
[list][*] The Heal skill now recovers 1,800 HP every 1.5 seconds over 6 seconds.
[*] Cooldown for the Heal skill reduced to 12 seconds.
[*] Increased amount of HP recovered automatically to 800.
[*] Slightly increased Movement Speed.[/list][/list]
[*] The weapons obtained from the Season 5 Pass will be enhanced when used in Zombie Z mode.
[list][*] This enhancement effect will end when Season 5 ends.[/list][/list]

[b]Season Pass Improvements[/b]
The following changes have been applied to the Season Pass.
[list][*] The amount of Season Badges distributed will be approximately doubled compared to Season 4, so that players will be able to reach season ranks much faster.

[*] The difficulty of the daily missions has been adjusted.
[list][*] The difficulty of particularly challenging daily missions has been adjusted further.
[*] The chance of getting missions to score kills using rifles, machine guns, sub-machine guns, and pistols has been lowered.
[*] Missions to participate in Team Deathmatch, Gun Deathmatch, All-Star Mode, Zombie Escape Mode, and the New Zombie Shelter for 10 minutes have been removed.[/list][/list]

[b]Weapon Synergy Effects with Classes[/b]
The new Transcendence Classes Lee-Chang and Yeong-Shin will gain enhancement effects when they are equipped with Season 5 weapons.
[list][*] Weapons Affected
[list][*] Hwando, Timed Bomb, Scythe, Arquebus, Reflex Bow, Matchlock Pistol, Moon Glaive, Blistering Bolt Repeater[/list]
[*] Enhancement Effect
[list][*] Increased Damage
[*] Matchlock Pistol – Has a 10% chance to instant kill by default. This rate is increased to 15% when equipped by Lee-Chang or Yeong-Shin
[*] Blistering Bolt Repeater (Lee-Chang) – Default ammo count +5. Charge time reduced by 1 second for alt fire
[*] Blistering Bolt Repeater (Yeong-Shin) - Number of alt fire projectiles +1. Rate of fire delay reduction for alt fire (0.7s -> 0.55s)[/list][/list]

[b]Other Changes[/b]
[list][*] The Shield skill for the Cyborg class has been changed to not take damage from allies
[*] The effect caused when hit by the Heaven Splitter will no longer block line of sight
[*] The explosion sound from the Magnum Launcher's alt fire has been fixed
[*] The issue where the Studio Monsters still attacked the players using the Conceal skill in New Zombie Shelter has been fixed
[*] The issue regarding incorrect variable values for World Settings from the Lua Script has been fixed
[*] Other miscellaneous crashes and minor bugs have been fixed[/list]


[h1]Events[/h1]
[b]Zombie Z Newbie Event (2/19 - 3/4)[/b]
You can earn reward weapons per stage by reaching the requirements of the play missions during the event period.
[list][*] Conditions
[list][*] Mission 1 - Login to the game once during the event period
[*] Mission 2 – Score 10 cumulative zombie kills in Zombie Z mode + Login to the game 2 times
[*] Mission 3 – Score 30 cumulative zombie kills in Zombie Z mode + Login to the game 5 times
[*] Mission 4 – Score 40 cumulative zombie kills in Zombie Z mode + Login to the game 8 times
[*] Mission 5 – Score 50 cumulative zombie kills in Zombie Z mode + Login to the game 10 times[/list]
[*] Rewards
[list][*] Mission 1 - M950 +8, Claymore Mine MDS, Arm Torch, Rail Cannon (Grade 5 Gun Boost + Grade 6 Speed Up)
[*] Mission 2 – Plasma Gun +6, Vendetta +6
[*] Mission 3 - BALROG-XI (Grade 5 Gun Boost + Grade 6 Speed Up), Hunter Killer X-90 (Grade 5 Gun Boost + Grade 6 Rage Down)
[*] Mission 4 – BOUNCER, Broad Divine (Grade 5 Gun Boost + Grade 6 Heal Disruptor)
[*] Mission 5 
[list][*] Select 1 from the 3 following weapons (Permanent): M950 +8, Plasma Gun +6, Vendetta +6
[*] Select 1 from the 7 following weapons (Permanent): Claymore Mine MDS, Arm Torch, BOUNCER, BALROG-XI (Grade 5 Gun Boost + Grade 6 Speed Up), Rail Cannon (Grade 5 Gun Boost + Grade 6 Speed Up), Hunter Killer X-90 (Grade 5 Gun Boost + Grade 6 Rage Down), Broad Divine (Grade 5 Gun Boost + Grade 6 Heal Disruptor)[/list][/list]
[*] Notes
[list][*] The weapons given as rewards from Missions 1 - 4 will be removed during maintenance on March 4th.
[*] You are unable to participate in Studio Mode.
[*] Only counts in rooms with four or more players.[/list][/list]

[b]Season 5 Kingdom Collaboration Special Item Giveaway (2/19 - 3/18)[/b]
You can earn a special item celebrating the collaboration when you first log in to the game during the event. Each account is only able to claim the item once.
[list][*] Rewards
[list][*] Kingdom Poster (Lee-Chang) Spray (Permanent)[/list][/list]

[b]Season 5 Kingdom Collaboration Badge Giveaway (2/19 - 5/13)[/b]
You can earn Season Badges for reaching the requirements during Season 5.
[list][*] Conditions
[list][*] Reach a total play time of 30 minutes / 60 minutes / 90 minutes / 120 minutes / 150 minutes per each day[/list]
[*] Rewards
[list][*] Obtain x3 / x3 / x3 / x3 / x12 Season Badges according to total play time (Up to a maximum of 24 per day)
[*]Can be used before level 16 in Zombie Z. (Actual level differs per weapon.)[/list][/list]

[b]Season 5 Golden Zombie Kill Rewards Event (2/19 - 5/13)[/b]
The reward items for killing Golden Zombies have been changed. You can earn rewards based on the total number of Golden Zombie kills in Zombie Scenario during the event.
[list][*] Conditions and Rewards
[list][*] 1 cumulative Golden Zombie kill - SG552 Lycanthrope +6 (10 Days)
[*] 2 cumulative Golden Zombie kills - Dual Beretta Gunslinger (10 Days)
[*] 3 cumulative Golden Zombie kills - M4A1 Dark Knight (Permanent)
[*] 5 cumulative Golden Zombie kills - D.Eagle Crimson Hunter (Permanent)
[*] 7 cumulative Golden Zombie kills - M4A1 Dark Knight (Permanent)
[*] 9 cumulative Golden Zombie kills - D.Eagle Crimson Hunter (Permanent)
[*] 12 cumulative Golden Zombie kills - M4A1 Dark Knight (Permanent)
[*] 15 cumulative Golden Zombie kills - D.Eagle Crimson Hunter (Permanent)
[*] 20 cumulative Golden Zombie kills - M4A1 Dark Knight (Permanent)
[*] 25 cumulative Golden Zombie kills - D.Eagle Crimson Hunter (Permanent)
[*] 30 cumulative Golden Zombie kills - SG552 Lycanthrope (Permanent)[/list]
[*] Notice
[list][*] You must have hit a Golden Zombie at least once to have it counted as a kill.
[*] Each account can only earn the reward once.
[*] You can only score up to a maximum of 3 cumulative kills per day.
[*] The Golden Zombies randomly appear after playing for more than 3 minutes in rooms at regular difficulty or higher.[/list][/list]

[b]Heart Attack Event (2/19 - 3/18)[/b]
You can obtain the Heart Grenade when you first log in during the event. You can earn rewards for reaching the requirements using the Heart Grenades.
[list][*] Heart Grenade
[list][*] Can only be used during the event, and will be removed during maintenance on March 4th.
[*] Enemies will take random damage from Heart Grenades.
[list][*] 50% Chance - Default damage
[*] 40% Chance – Double damage
[*] 10% Chance - Instant kill[/list][/list]
[*] Requirements
[list][*] Score zombie kills in Zombie Hero or Zombie Z modes using the Heart Grenade[/list]
[*] Rewards
[list][*] Obtain 1 item at random from the list below (Each item has a different probablity.)
[*] 100 Mileage Coupon
[*] Left Heart Spray
[*] Right Heart Spray
[*] Heart of Love
[*] Grade 1 Parts Reward Box
[*] Grade 2 Parts Reward Box 
[*] Grade 3 Parts Reward Box 
[*] Grade 4 Parts Reward Box 
[*] Grade 5 Parts Reward Box 
[*] Grade 6 Parts Reward Box 
[*] Unique Decoder
[*] Rare Decoder 
[*] Unique Premium Decoder[/list]
[*] Notice
[list][*] You can only obtain rewards up to 10 times per day.
[*] Only counts in rooms with 4 or more players.[/list][/list]

[b]Free Daily Rewards Event (2/19 - 3/18)[/b]
The Free Daily Rewards list has been updated.
[list][*] Regular Players
[list][*] Conditions
[list][*] Play the game for more than 10 minutes[/list]
[*] Rewards
[list][*] Daily Reward: 50 Mileage
[*] 3 Day Cumulative Reward: Grade 4 Parts Reward Box (x15)
[*] 7 Day Cumulative Reward: Grade 4 Parts Reward Box (x20)
[*] 15 Day Cumulative Reward: Grade 4 Parts Reward Box (x25)
[*] 20 Day Cumulative Reward: Grade 5 Parts Reward Box (x7)
[*] 25 Day Cumulative Reward: Grade 5 Parts Reward Box (x8)[/list][/list]
[*] New and Returning Players
[list][*] Conditions
[list][*] Survivors who have not logged in for the past 30 days or have logged in for the very first time during the event must reach 10 minutes of play time[/list]
[*] Rewards
[list][*] Daily Reward: Parts Weapon Selection Box (x1)
[*] 1 Day Cumulative Reward: Grade 4 Parts Reward Box (x5)
[*] 3 Day Cumulative Reward: Grade 4 Parts Reward Box (x10)
[*] 5 Day Cumulative Reward: Grade 4 Parts Reward Box (x15)
[*] 7 Day Cumulative Reward: Grade 5 Parts Reward Box (x5)
[*] 15 Day Cumulative Reward: Grade 5 Parts Reward Box (x6)[/list][/list][/list]


[h1]Shop[/h1]
[b]Season 5 Kingdom Collaboration: Lee-Chang and Yeong-Shin Class Promotion (2/19 - 3/18)[/b]
You can purchase package items containing the Transcendence Classes Lee-Chang and Yeong-Shin from the shop during the promotion.
[list][*] Promotion Items

[*] Yeong-Shin Class + Kingdom Poster Spray (Group)[/list]

notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: January 22th
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/592b32a06bf3e048b2bdacab8828b6a8c124a001.jpg[/img]

Here's a rundown of some of the major changes in today's update!
[list][b]New Epic Weapon: Heaven Splitter[/b]
Heaven Splitter, the 3rd Epic Weapon, has been added to the game! Not only does it have amazing splash damage, but it also increases your mobility each time you use a mine, a perk you can use to your advantage!

[b]Epic Fragment Giveaway/Collecting Events[/b]
Collect Epic Fragments to fill up the gauge and get various rewards, such as Parts and Transcendence Weapons. If you fill the gauge to 100%, you can get the Epic Weapon Heaven Splitter. Get Epic Fragments by either using the Epic Decoder or from event rewards.

[b]New Year Zombie Scenario Golden Zombie Rate-Up Update (1/22 - 2/19)[/b]
In celebration of the New Year, the odds of a Golden Zombie appearing in Zombie Scenario will be doubled![/list]
Check out the Expanded Info section below for details and other changes.

[h3]The content was corrected on Feb 5th.
  : Changed the period of <2020 Epic Weapon Promotion>[/h3]

[u][h1]Expanded Info[/h1][/u]
[h1]Events[/h1]
[b]Epic Fragment Giveaway (1/22 - 3/4)[/b]
Collect Epic Fragments during the event period!
[list][*] Epic Fragment Giveaway
Obtain Epic Fragments each day by logging into the game! (Once per day per account.)
[list][*] Day 1: Epic Fragment x1
[*] Day 2: Epic Fragment x2
[*] Day 3: Epic Fragment x3
[*] Day 4: Epic Fragment x4
[*] Day 5: Epic Fragment x5
[*] Day 6: Epic Fragment x6
[*] Day 7: Epic Fragment x7 (restarts from Day 1 rewards after you reach Day 7)[/list] 
[*] Epic Fragment Box Giveaway
Earn Epic Fragment Boxes, each of which contains 1-4 Epic Fragments, by meeting the requirements listed below.
[list][*] Requirements
[list][*] Log into the game and earn 3 Epic Fragment Boxes for every 30 minutes of playtime (up to a maximum of 150 minutes per day)
[*] Get 1 Epic Fragment Box each time you score a zombie kill in Zombie Z/Zombie Hero modes (up to 30 kills per day)
[*] Get 2 Epic Fragment Boxes each time you score a Golden Zombie kill in Zombie Scenario mode (up to 3 times per day)[/list]
[*] Notice
[list][*] Up to 600 Epic Fragment Boxes can be earned during the event period.
[*] Only counts in rooms with 8 or more players.
[*] Any Epic Fragment Boxes that haven't been used by the maintenance on 3/4 will be replaced with 15 Mileage each.[/list][/list][/list]


[b]Epic Fragment Collecting Event (1/22 - 3/4)[/b]
Earn a variety of rewards using Epic Fragments earned during the event.
[list][*] Epic Fragment Collecting Event
You can get the new Epic Weapon 'Heaven Splitter' by collecting Epic Fragments during the event period and filling the gauge to 100%.
[*] You can get additional rewards by meeting specific gauge milestones.
[list][*] 3% (80 Fragments): Grade 3 Parts Reward Box x5
[*] 5% (160 Fragments): Grade 3 Parts Reward Box x10
[*] 10% (320 Fragments): Grade 4 Parts Reward Box x10
[*] 20% (640 Fragments): Grade 5 Parts Reward Box x5
[*] 40% (1,280 Fragments): Bronze Box x1
 - Bronze Box (Select): Thunder Ghost Walker / Infinity Laser Fist
[*] 60% (1,920 Fragments): Silver Box x1
 - Silver Box (Select): Dual Sword Phantom Slayer/ Barrett M95 White Tiger
[*] 80% (2,560 Fragments): Gold Box x1
 - Gold Box (Select): Dual Beretta Gunslinger / Trinity Grenade / X-TRACKER
[*] 100% (3,200 Fragments): Epic Box x1
 - Epic Box: Heaven Splitter
[*] Bonus (3,600 Fragments): Epic Swag Box x1
 - Epic Swag Box: Scorching Auto-Shotgun + 16 types of Grade 6 Parts[/list]
[*] Notice
[list][*] Rewards can only be obtained once per account and are given immediately upon reaching each milestone.
[*] You need to click the button to claim the reward for reaching 100%.
[*] All Epic Boxes and Epic Swag Boxes that haven't been used by the maintenance on 3/4 will be automatically used and exchanged.
[*] Bronze/Silver/Gold Boxes that haven't been used by the maintenance on 6/10 will be removed.[/list][/list]


[b]	Epic Fragment Collecting Reward Giveaway (3/4 - 3/18)[/b]
Epic Fragments that haven't been used by the time the collecting event has ended will be replaced with Mileage as shown in the amounts below
[list][list][*] 100 - 299 Fragments: 1,500 Mileage
[*] 300 - 599 Fragments: 3,000 Mileage
[*] 600 - 1,199 Fragments: 6,000 Mileage
[*] 1,200 - 1,799 Fragments: 12,000 Mileage
[*] 1,800 - 2,399 Fragments: 18,000 Mileage
[*] 2,400 - 2,999 Fragments: 24,000 Mileage
[*] 3,000 - 3,499 Fragments: 30,000 Mileage
[*] 3,500+ Fragments: 35,000 Mileage[/list]
[*] Notice
[list][*] Rewards can be obtained from after the maintenance on 3/4 until the maintenance on 3/18.
[*] There are no rewards for less than 100 Fragments.[/list][/list]


[b]New Year Zombie Scenario Golden Zombie Appearance Boost Event (1/22 - 2/19)[/b]
The odds of a Golden Zombie appearing in Zombie Scenario mode will be doubled!
[list][*] Golden Zombie Appearance Conditions
[list][*] Play for 3 minutes or more in a room that is Normal or higher[/list][/list]


[b]Reinforced Rewards for New/Returning Players Event (1/22 - 3/18)[/b]
New and Returning players will get bonus events during the event! Normally, they get 6 types of durational weapons, but they'll get 4 types of +6 Transcendence Weapons during the event!
[list][*] Conditions
[list][*] Must be a new player or a player who hasn't logged into the game for at least 30 days
[*] Must play for at least 10 minutes after logging into the game[/list] 
[*] Items Given
[list][*] Transcendence Fernando + Refined Holy Water Grenade (100 Days)
[*] Transcendence Blair + Dark Legacy Luger (100 Days)
[*] Settlement Supply Weapon Box x1 (10 of 30 Day durational weapons)
[list][*] Additional weapons (4): +6 Blade Runebreaker, +6 Newcomen, +6 Guillotine, +6 Black Dragon Cannon[/list][/list][/list]


[b]Free Daily Rewards Event (1/22 - 2/19)[/b]
The Free Daily Rewards reward lists have been updated.
[list][*] Regular Players
[list][*] Conditions
[list][*]Play the game for more than 10 minutes[/list]
[*] Rewards

[*] New and Returning Players
[list][*] Conditions

[*] 1 Day Cumulative Reward: Grade 4 Parts Reward Box (x5)

[*] 10 Day Cumulative Reward: Grade 5 Parts Reward Box (x5)
[*] 15 Day Cumulative Reward: Grade 5 Parts Reward Box (x6)[/list][/list][/list]


[h1]Shop[/h1]
[b]2020 Epic Weapon Promotion (1/22 - 3/4)[/b]
Get the new Epic Weapon 'Heaven Splitter' from the Epic Decoder during the promotion period!
[list][*] Rates

[*] Obtain Epic Fragment Box (Premium) (Advanced Epic Fragment Box) Event

[*] Notice
[list][*] All boxes and decoders that haven't been used by the maintenance on 3/4 will be replaced with Mileage.

notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: January 2nd
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/592b32a06bf3e048b2bdacab8828b6a8c124a001.jpg[/img]

Here's a rundown of some of the major changes in today's update!
[list][b]New Game Mode: Manhunt[/b]
The new game mode ‘Manhunt’ has been added. Become a Human and fix the generators to secure your escape while hiding from the prowling zombie, or become a Zombie and ensure that no human leaves alive!

[b]New Transcendence Classes: Queen & Cyborg[/b]
Season 4 Transcendence Classes Queen and Cyborg can be obtained from the Class Decoders, as well as Premium Class Decoders for the duration of the promotion. A giveaway promotion, as well as a promotion that boosts drop rates will take place at the same time, so don't miss out on your opportunity to obtain the new Transcendence Classes!

[b]Enhancement System Revamp and New +6 Enhancement Weapons[/b]
The enhancement system has been revamped. The maximum enhancement has been increased to +9, and you can now employ unused weapons as enhancement materials. Additionally, the Warhammer Storm Giant and the Dual UZI can now be enhanced to +6.

[b]2020 New Year! Surprise Mileage Auction (1/2 - 1/15)[/b]
You can buy and sell items on the Mileage Auction from 12:00 - 23:59 each day between 1/2 after maintenance until 1/15. Also, special items will appear from 20:00 - 21:00 each day between 1/2 - 1/12 (CET). Don't miss out on a weekend full of rare items!
[/list]
There are also other events, and updates to the Family system. Check out the Expanded Info section below for details!



[u][h1]Expanded Info[/h1][/u]
[h1]Contents[/h1]
[b]New Game Mode: Manhunt[/b]
The new game mode ‘Manhunt’, and a map associated with the mode has been added. Become a Human and fix the generators to secure your escape while hiding from the prowling zombie, or become a Zombie and ensure that no human leaves alive! 


[b]New +6 Enhancement Weapons[/b]
2 new weapons that can be enhanced to +6 have been added.
[list][*] Warhammer Storm Giant
[*] Dual UZI[/list]

[b]Enhancement System Revamp[/b]
The Enhancement System has been revamped. The changes are as described below.
[list][*] Changes to the Enhancement Method
[list][*] You can add Enhancement EXP to a weapon by using other weapons as enhancement materials. You can attempt to enhance a weapon with at least 1 Enhancement EXP, and your odds of success will vary according to how much Enhancement EXP you've accumulated. Temporary or rental weapons may not be used as materials.[/list]
[*] The maximum enhancement has been increased to +9. The weapons that can be enhanced up to +9 are listed below. However, the 'Damage' enhancement value for +9 weapons are applied only in Zombie, or Zombie Scenario Modes.
[list][*] Weapons whose max enhancement increased to from +8 to +9: WA2000 / Thompson Chicago / KSG-12 / RPG-7 / WA2000 Gold Edition / KSG-12 Gold Edition
[*] Weapons whose enhancement increased to +9 from +6: Volcano / Ripper / Savery / Crimson Hunter / Dark Knight / Paladin[/list]
[*] Convenience Features Added
[list][*] Enhancement suffix deleted
[*] Enhancement search feature added[/list]
[*] The names of Anti-Enhancement material items have been changed. Use these materials during enhancement to lower the enhancement level by 1.
[list][*] (Prior to the change) Anti-Enhancement (Anti-ENH)
[*] (After the change) Dehancement (DEH)[/list][/list]

[b]Family Content[/b]
The UI for the Family content has been revamped, and rewards have been added.
[list][*] Bonus for Playing Games with Family
You are able to obtain rewards based on the accumulated play time of the family members.

[*] Rewards
[list][*] Reach 60 hours played: Grade 3 Parts Reward Box x10
[*] Reach 80 hours played: Rare Decoder x5
[*] Reach 100 hours played: Grade 4 Parts Reward Box x5
[*] Reach 120 hours played: Rare Decoder x10
[*] Reach 140 hours played: Grade 5 Parts Reward Box x3[/list]
[*] Notice
[list][*] The play time accumulates only when you play in rooms with 2 or more players.
[*] The play time accumulates 10% faster if you play together with your family members.
[*] The accumulated play time gets reset each week. (Monday 00:00)
[*] The rewards are given only to the players who are registered as family members at the moment the play times are reached.[/list]
[*] Concurrent Player Bonus
You are able to obtain rewards based on the number of Family members currently online.
[list][*] Rewards (Given Cumulatively)
[list][*] 2 members or more: Brick Piece T50
[*] 4 members or more: Claymore Mine MDS
[*] 7 members or more: Bouncer
[*] 10 members or more: Star Chaser AR[/list]
[*] Player is unable to take ownership, as these are event weapons[/list]
[*] UI Improvement
[list][*] New family members are able to check their member benefits.
[*]The markings to distinguish family members in game will become reinforced.[/list][/list]

[b]2nd Decoder System Revamp[/b]
Building upon the past revamp from November 27, 2019, the 2nd round of revamp has been applied for the Decoder System.
[list][*] The sale of Top 50 and Top 50 Unlimited Decoders will be discontinued. Additionally, Rare and Unique Decoders have been added to the game.
[list][*] Unique Decoder : You are able to obtain Unique - Advanced grade weapons.
[*] Rare Decoder : You are able to obtain Rare - Regular grade weapons.[/list]
[*] The design of the Decoders will be changed.
[*] The cycle for which the list of passes are given out from the VIP System will be applied as shown below.
[list][*] VVIP Grade - When new items having a Transcendence grade or higher are added
[*] VIP Pass - When the items of the Transcendence Decoder are changed 
[*] Diamond Grade - When classes having a Unique grade or lower are added
[*] Platinum Grade - When the items of the Unique Decoder are changed
[*] Gold Grade - When the items of the Rare Decoder are changed[/list]
[*] The display in Hideout will be changed.
[*] The rewards for leveling up will be changed.
[list][*] The Top 30 Brand Decoder will be changed to Rare Decoder.
[*] The Top 50 Decoder will be changed to Unique Decoder.
[*] The Top 50 Unlimited Decoder will be changed to Unique Premium Decoder.
[*] The Top 30 C and C Decoder will be changed to Class Decoder.[/list][/list]

[b]Changes to the New and Returning Player Supplies[/b]
The items contained in the supply package given to new players, or players who have not logged in for more than 30 days have been changed.


[b]Bug Fix[/b]
The issue where the weapon Hellhound was interfering the view has been fixed.

You are able to obtain rewards every day based on the play time of the Manhunt Mode during the event.

notes.title: [Notice] Regarding Decoder System Revamp & 11/27 Decoder Rates
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/82dea62b618a20c78eaa2c8a91a6100edebc25a1.jpg[/img]

[b]Greetings from the CSN:S Team.[/b]

Here's a notice regarding the Decoder System Revamp, as well as the 11/27 Decoder rates.

There's an increase in the types of weapons, as well as a deviation in terms of performance for weapons in identical grades as we have go through more and more updates, gradually making it difficult to determine the performance level of the weapons. Therefore, we wish to revamp the Decoder system so it would be more intuitive to determine which weapons are good, as well as making it more straightforward to determine the source of acquisition of those weapons. Previously owned or purchased Decoders will remain until they expire, so you have nothing to worry about.


[b][Decoder System Revamped][/b]
After 11/27, the existing Top 50 Decoders that were sold will gradually be stopped being sold, and a new grade system will be applied to the newly sold Decoders. 
[list][*]  The weapons included in the Decoders will be distinguished as disclosed below. 
The weapons in each of the groups were selected based on performance as well as popularity, and are subject to change from updates.
[list][*]  Transcendence Group 1 – Transcendence Weapons with outstanding performance
[*]  Transcendence Group 2 – Transcendence Weapons
[*]  Unique Group 1 – Unique, or Parts Weapons that can be enhanced up to +6
[*] D.	Unique Group 2 – Unique Weapons
[*] E.	Rare Group – Brand Weapons[/list][/list]
[list][*] The Decoders are largely classified into 3 categories according to the highest grade of the weapons included.
[list][*] Transcendence Decoder: Can obtain up to Transcendence Weapons as the highest grade
[*] Unique Decoder: Can obtain up to Unique Weapons as the highest grade
[*]Rare Decoder: Can obtain up to Rare Weapons as the highest grade[/list][/list]
[list][*] All Decoders are classified into 2 types: Regular/Premium. 
Durational items do not appear from Premium Decoders, and the lowest grade of the weapons is 1 grade higher than regular Decoders.
[list]Ex. Transcendence (Regular) Decoder: Can obtain weapons of Rare - Transcendence grades
Ex. Transcendence Premium Decoder: Can obtain weapons of Unique - Transcendence grades[/list][/list]

 If you are using OS mentioned above, it will either be impossible to play the game properly, or the game process may get blocked from vaccine programs after February 2nd, 2020. The minimum recommended specs for CSN:S suggests that players run the game on Windows 7 or higher.  Therefore, [b][u]please use OS of Windows 7 or higher, or run the most recent update[/u][/b] for flawless gameplay.

Thank you.

The CSN:S Team

notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: November 27th
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/28f20a13819908445ffee6aeb88b49f068133fc4.jpg[/img]

Here's a rundown of some of the changes in today's update!

Some of you may have been confused to discover that the game's title was recently changed from Zombies to Studio. In our never-ending struggle to keep the game fresh and provide a better, funner experience, we have been developing the game in a much broader direction. Our new focus includes allowing players themselves to participate in content creation. Of course we fully intend to continue to improve and expand upon our existing Zombie modes as well. As always, we are extremely grateful for your continued support.

[b]Studio Feature Expansion – Scenario T[/b]
Scenario T is the very first studio update since the game was retitled. Scenario T is a Zombie Scenario in Studio Mode. Use the newly added features to create maps with RPG mechanics.

[b]New Item: Season 4 Transcendence Weapon, the Hellhound, and Etc.[/b]
The Hellhound is a new type of weapon that automatically patrols the vicinity of its user. It is usable alongside your primary weapon, unleashing a wide variety of new strategies! In addition to the Hellhound, 3 kinds of ZS boxes, each filled with a variety of items, that you can purchase with points. Additionally, the Small medical kit has been can now be purchased in bundles of 30.

[b]Decoder Improvement[/b]
We improved the Decoder system so that it would be more straightforward to understand the source of acquisition of the weapons based on their grades. Please refer to the separate notice for details. 

In addition to the announcements above, there have been changes to the Zombie Meta, and the Zombie Scenario has been revamped as well. Please refer to the [Details] section below for details.


[u][h1]Expanded Info[/h1][/u][h1][b]Contents[/b][/h1][b]Studio Feature Expansion – Scenario T[/b]
This is a 'Zombie Scenario' in Studio Mode. Utilize the newly added features to create maps involving RPG mechanics, such as leveling up and farming items.
[list][*] Monsters
[list][*] 3 kinds of new monsters have been added.
[*] The creator is able to control many different types of monsters at the same time using the script.
[*] The grades of monsters can be configured. The grades are differentiated into 5 stages (Regular, Rare, Unique, Champion, Named).
[*] EXP, as well as items exclusive to the Scenario T can be obtained by defeating monsters.[/list]
[*] Weapons
[list][*] The weapons are differentiated into 4 grades (Regular, Rare, Unique, Transcendence). Additional attributes are applied at random for weapons having higher grades.
[*] Weapons can be obtained from rewards for defeating the monsters, as well as shops located in the map.
[*] Weapons have levels and attributes. These attributes can be configured using the script.
[*] Caution: Weapon usage is restricted for the weapons not possessed in the players' inventory.[/list]
[*] Sample Maps
[list][*] 2 sample maps have been included in the updated to experience the new features at your convenience.
[*] Scenario T01 – Missing Advance Troops (Tutorial Map)
[*] Scenario T02 – Sewer Depths (Play Map)[/list][/list]

[b]Decoder Improvement[/b]
The Decoder system has been improved to better convey how weapons of particular grades are acquired. Going forward, Transcendence Weapons will be obtained from Transcendence Decoders, or Transcendence Premium Decoders. Please refer to the separate notice for further details.


[b]Zombie Scenario Revamped[/b]
There's been various changes to the Zombie Scenario.
[list][*] The Appearance of Golden Zombies in Zombie Scenario Mode
[list][*] Golden Zombies will randomly appear. You'll be made aware of their appearances through the notification messages.
[*] The Golden Zombies will appear randomly upon playing for more than 3 minutes in rooms with a regular difficulty or higher.[/list]
[*] Rewards Revamped
[list][*] Rewards can be obtained for scoring Golden Zombie kills. The types of rewards vary according to the event details. Please refer to the Event category for details.
[*] Golden Zombie Kill Rewards Event - 11/27 After Maintenance - 01/22/2020 (Accumulate up to a maximum of 3 kills per day)
[*] Golden Zombie Loot Addition Event – 11/27 After Maintenance - Permanent
[*] Each player in the room will be able to obtain 1 loot.[/list]
[*] The reward will disappear if it is not claimed within a certain time.
[list][*] The Scenario points have been adjusted, lowering the previous difficulty for obtaining the Reward Boxes.[/list][/list]

[b]Zombie Related Changes[/b]
The information disclosed below have been changed.
[list][*] The new Zombie Mode map ‘Alcatraz-Z’ has been added.
[*] The Sound Effects for Zombie Mode has been revamped.
[*] The unlocking level for certain weapons in Zombie Z has been slightly lowered.
[*] Aksha's skill stats have been changed for balance adjustment purposes.[/list]

[b]New Medal: 2 of Hide and Seek Mode[/b]
2 types of medals that can be obtained from the Studio Hide and Seek Mode have been added.
[list][*] Super Seeker : A medal awarded to those who played as a seeker 200 times.
[*] Method Actor : A medal awarded to those who played a total of 500 times as an object[/list][/list]


[h1][b]Events[/b][/h1][b]Play the Scenario T Event (11/27 - 12/11)[/b]
You can earn rewards through raffle for reaching the requirements by playing the Scenario T Sample Maps during the event period. You'll automatically be participated into the event upon reaching the set requirements.

[*] Play the Scenario T02: Sewer Depths for more than 10 minutes, and recommend it more than once

[b]Zombie Hero: Random Rules Event[/b]

 Random Rules maps for the Zombie Hero are now available! In these maps, the rules of the game change each round. When the Crash rule is triggered, two random rules will be applied for the duration of the round.  12 new rules have been added. Additionally, there have been changes to 19 of the existing rules ranging from unnoticeable to extremely significant. You’ll have to adapt if you want to survive!

notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: October 30th
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/0d4d33e00db4ad5a1a59921b9ee0d5af92f90f58.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Updated Content[/b][/h1]
[b]Season 4 Halloween Content Update[/b]
 Season 4 is here with a spooky Halloween theme! Check out all the new Season 4 items, such as the Season 4 Weapon, Ghost Knight, and the new classes, Wraith Bride Ritsuka and Ripper Henry.


[b]Studio - New Feature Update[/b]
3 new features have been added to the Studio.

A. Cheer Feature
You can gift Cheer Cubes to the creators of maps that you enjoy using the Cheer feature.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/90cf35ff7af7fa909386ef9b8336bce3f1210b9e.png[/img]
[list]1) How to Cheer the Map Creators
Find the Cheer button to the top left of the screen when looking at the Map Info in Studio Mode. You can also use the Cheer feature in-game if the creator has a Cheer Message Board placed in the map.

2) Gifting Cheer Cubes
 You can send the creator a message, or convert the Cube Fragments in your possession to Cubes to gift to the creator from the Cheer window. Cube Fragments can be earned by purchasing cash items.

3) Using Cubes
 The creator can use the Cubes they get to exchange them for Mileage.[/list]

B. Shop Feature
 Players on the map can use blocks such as the Coin Checker block, Item Buying block, and Weapon Shop blocks to use Cheer Cubes and Points as they would use Coins. The Points and Cubes used on the map will be saved to that map for the creator.
[list]1) The creator is unable to use Cheer Cube Fragments or Points on maps they created themselves.

2) Using Cubes Saved on a Map
 Just as with the Cheer feature, the creator can exchange the Cubes for Mileage. Be aware that Cubes expire over time if not used.

3) Using Points Saved on a Map
 The creator can retrieve the points on the map after paying a small fee. The points will be refreshed every day at midnight, and there's a limit to how many can be retrieved per day. As with Cubes, these points expire over time if not used.[/list]

C. Studio Player Event
 We've added the Event Ticket item, which creators can use to host 30-day events on their own maps. Please note that the Event Ticket is an experimental item that will be given out only in a limited fashion. Please refer to the ‘Who Wants to Make Their Creation Maps Go Viral?! (10/30 - 11/13)’ event notice for details.

[list]1) Hosting an Event
 Using an Event Ticket on one of your maps allows you to host an event on it. The event will be applied according to the duration and conditions configured with the ticket, and such values cannot be changed once applied. Moreover, tickets can only be applied to maps listed as Public. Using multiple tickets allows you to increase the number of winners. Be warned that you won't be able to use additional tickets once the event is applied.

2) Checking and Participating in Events
 Check out the maps with events going on by sorting and filtering from the Studio screen. Maps with an event in progress will have an event tag attached, and be displayed at the top of the list even if they have low recommendations.

 Hover your mouse over maps with an event in progress to check the participation conditions. If a map has a ‘Give a recommendation’ condition, the condition can be satisfied from the pop-up menu displayed when you play the map for more than 3 minutes.

3) Checking Event Winners
 You can find information on the event winners from the Cheer pop-up window after selecting the map.[/list]


[b]Hide and Seek Mode Revamped[/b]
 New changes have been applied to Hide and Seek Mode, and 3 new medals have been added.
[list][*] Changes
[list][*] We're adding a feature to turn yourself invisible to allies and spectators. Select this option by clicking the check box when you choose an Object to transform into.
[*] Selective Random Decoration Block: A block that transforms randomly into one Object from a selected list has been added.
[*] Configurable Category Added: Restrict the type of objects that a player can transform into, as well as configure the damage taken by the Seeker
[*] 3 Medals for Hide and Seek Added[/list]
[*] New Medals (3 Kinds): Can only be earned in rooms with four or more players
[list][*] Award-Winning Actor
 A medal awarded to those who received Golden Thumbs Up a total of 100 times
[*] Hawkeye
 A medal awarded to those who killed objects a total of 100 times as a seeker
[*] Fortune's Favored
A medal awarded to those who killed objects a total of 200 times during Burning Time[/list][/list]


[b]Zombie Scenario Mode Revamped[/b]
The Scenario Reward Boxes, as well as the Clear Rewards have been changed, and 7 new medals have been added.
[list][*] New Medals (7 Kinds): Can only be earned in rooms with four or more players
[list][*] Mechanical Engineer
A medal awarded to those who defeated Colossus 100 times.
[*] Brought a Bigger Boat
A medal awarded to those who defeated Megalodon 100 times.
[*] Season 2 Veteran
A medal given to those who have cleared all of the Zombie Scenario Season 2.
[*] Season 3 Veteran
A medal given to those who have cleared all of the Zombie Scenario Season 3.
[*] Season 4 Veteran
A medal given to those who have cleared all of the Zombie Scenario Season 4.
[*] Season 5 Veteran
A medal given to those who have cleared all of the Zombie Scenario Season 5.
[*] Season 6 Veteran
A medal given to those who have cleared all of the Zombie Scenario Season 6.[/list][/list]


[b]Partner Mode Revamped[/b]
New changes have been applied to Partner Mode.
[list][*] Changes
[list][*] The new map Villa has been added.
[*] The attacking location (respawn) can now be selected, and the target location (bombsite) will be randomly selected.
[*] Sub-objectives have been added that will provide combat support upon completion, such as weapons, ammo, recovery items, armor, and movement speed buff effects.[/list][/list]


[b]Quality-of-Life Improvements[/b]
The changes below have been applied to make the overall game experience better for players.
[list][*] Changes
[list][*] The list of recommended weapons in Zombie Z and Zombie Modes has been improved.
[*] You can check the Accolades obtained from the round in battle results.[/list][/list]

notes.title: [Update] Patch Notes: October 2nd
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/6770740/e7b6e769f0f44bde4b85ec761297ec6165c91da8.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Contents[/b][/h1]
[b]Partner Mode[/b]
Partner Mode, where you cooperate with AI Partners, has been added.
You can check the details in the Preview section.
[list]1. A list of maps available to be played will be displayed when you select Partner Mode. Only Demolition is supported at present, but we plan to add a variety of other modes in future updates. (Minimum of 2 players required)

2. You can select your Partner at the beginning of the game. Each partner is unique, with different personalities and abilities.
[list][*] AI Abilities: Partner's overall intelligence and skill.
[*] Reflexes: How fast the Partner reacts. The higher the value, the quicker the Partner reacts.
[*] Combat Power: Measurement of combat skills. The higher the value, the better the Partner is in combat.
[*] HP: Amount of HP. Partner dies when HP reaches 0.
[*] Movement Speed: How fast the Partner moves. The higher the value, the faster they move.[/list]
3. Give commands to your partner using the Z key.	[/list]


[b]Zombie Meta Change[/b]
Zombie Meta has been changed, and new medals have been added as well.	
[list][*] 28 Medals Added
[*] Zombie Fixes
[list][*] Zombie Armor: Overall HP increased
[*] New game option added in Zombie Mode
[*] Zombie skill balance fixed
[list][*] The Light Zombie's Conceal skill has been changed to slow movement speed temporarily upon use, and then restore to normal speed if the zombie is not attacked
[*] Rusty Wing's Glide skill has been changed to lower speed upon use[/list]
[*] Zombie Z Balance Fix
[list][*] EXP required for level ups increased: 22,500 -> 25,000 EXP per each level up
[*] Zombie Z Weapon Adjustment
[*] 3 New Mutations Added: Intellectual, Zombie Bomb Giveaway, Revenge[/list][/list][/list]


[b]Vote Kick System Revamp[/b]
The Vote Kick system has been improved.
You can check the details in the Preview section.

1. Vote Kick system has been separated from the Report and Manner Systems
[list][*] The Vote Kick system does not affect Manner points.
[*] If a vote to kick has been called, players in the room will be notified via chat.
[*] The status of the vote can be checked with the icon displayed in the View Advanced Multiplayer Func. Window (Tab or Caps Lock key).[/list]
2. Vote Kick system changes
[list][*] You can call for a vote to kick if 3 minutes have passed since the start of the game, or you've played for more than 3 minutes in the room.
[*] You can call for the vote from the View Advanced Multiplayer Func. Window (Caps Lock key). You can only open it when the option is available.
[*] There is a limit to how many votes can be called, and you can use it once per player.
[*] A player who was voted to be kicked may not enter the room again.[/list]


[b]Studio Features Added[/b]
New features have been added to the Studio.
You can check the details in the Preview section.
[list][*] Studio Save feature added: The save feature can be used in play modes that allow scripts.
[*] Studio block added: Kartrider contents have been added.
[*] Studio guide added: API description has been updated.[/list]


[b]Hide and Seek Mode Revamped[/b]
[list][*] Option to turn Outlines on/off provided
[*] Decorations included in the Studio Package have been added as objects that players can transform into
[*] Fixed position lock to remain upon 2nd Transformation[/list] 



[h1][b]Events[/b][/h1]
Daily Missions for CSNZ x Kartrider Collaboration Celebration Event (10/2 - 10/30)
You can earn Event Points for completing Daily Missions during the event, and earn rewards based on your total points.
[list][*] Conditions
[list][*] Play Hide and Seek 2 times - 10P
[*] Play Random Rules Zombie Hero 2 times - 20P
[*] Play Zombie Z 2 times - 30P
[*] Kill 2 Objects in Hide and Seek - 40P
[*] You must play for more than 3 minutes in rooms with 8 or more players, and you can earn up to a maximum of 100P[/list][/list]
[list][*]Rewards (once per account)	
[list][*]100P: Lightning Dao-1 (Permanent) + Lightning Bazzi-1 (Permanent)
[*] 200P: Top 30 Class Decoder x5
[*] 300P: Grade 3 Parts Reward Box x2 + Parts Weapon Selection Box x2
[*] 400P: Top 50 Decoder x5
[*] 500P: Top 50 Unlimited Decoder x3

[b]Survivors,[/b]

Here's a rundown of today's CSN:Z updates!
Check out these fresh events, straight from the oven!


[h1][b]Updated Content[/b][/h1]

[h1]Gun Deathmatch Weapons Have Been Fixed![/h1]
The Eruptor and Black Dragon Cannon have been removed from circulation, and the Double Barrel Shotgun and Triple Barrel Shotgun have been implemented.

[b]Survivors![/b]

We’ve heard your calls, and we understand. The GM team only interacts with you in the forums, or whenever you can catch them in-game! We’re looking to change that. So we’ve decided to host something special for you all. 

That’s right, starting next week, [NX]FANGZORZ, [NX]Stincky, and [NX]Redd will irregularly dive in-game and host GM events!

These events will be announced on the forums well in advance of their hosted date, and players will also be notified in-game whenever possible. Pay close attention to the pinned threads!

So, the CSN:Z Team has a few questions for you all. We would like to hear your opinions on a few aspects of these future events.
[*]Which mode would you like to play with the GMs?
[*]What times or timezones would you like to see the GMs accommodate?
[*]If we’re going to give you an item as a reward for participating, what’s the most valuable reward to you?
[*]If there is no reward, would you still participate in these events?
[/list]
Our GM team is fired up and raring to go! We hope you feel the exact same way.

Best Regards,
The CSN:Z Team

notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/ece767dd910f29148e711d79edcb740c473c6c5f.jpg[/img]

[b]Survivors,[/b]

We've just finished maintenance, so here's a breakdown of today's CSN:Z update!

[quote]
[h1][b]Updated Content[/b][/h1]

[h1]Overview of New Original & Standard Settings[/h1]
The weapon usage restrictions that have been used and managed per country are now unified as New Original.

The affected modes are identical to those in the current live version.


[h1]Level Adjustment for Zombie Z Black Dragon Cannon[/h1]
In Zombie Z mode, the Black Dragon Cannon level will be changed from existing level 28 to 20!


[h1]The New Team Deathmatch Map [Secret Storage] is Open![/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/64459581f4b44077dc707079ef88694984617b64.png[/img]
You've all been waiting a long time for a new map, right? Get hype for this new Team Deathmatch map!


[h1]Daily Rewards Have Been Updated! (June 12 – July 10)[/h1]
You're all familiar with the wonderful gifts from the Daily Rewards when you log in each day, right? Well, the Daily Rewards have gotten a makeover.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/7cb412747977d49b0d59af62c3b2e2ddfdb314dc.png[/img]
[b]How to Earn Rewards[/b]
[*]Reach 10 minutes of in-game play after logging in to receive your rewards.
[/list]
[b]Daily Rewards[/b]
[*]Event Decoder x1
[/list]
[b]Cumulative Rewards[/b]
[*]5 Days: Event Decoder x5
[*]7 Days: Event Decoder x7
[*]10 Days: Event Decoder x10
[*]15 Days: Event Decoder x15
[*]20 Days: Event Decoder x20
[/list]
Log in each day for 10 minutes of action, and claim yourself some Event Decoders while you're at it!


[h1]Conquer the Magnum Launcher & Dual Sword Phantom Slayer Event! (June 12 – June 26)[/h1]
You'll get a reward for reaching 30 minutes of play time each day during the event!

[b]Cumulative Rewards[/b]
[*]1 Day Total: Select 1 of the 4 Reward Weapons
[*]2 Days Total: Select 1 of the +5 Reward Weapons
[*]3 Days Total: Select 1 of the 6 Reward Weapons
[*]4 Days Total: Select 1 of either the Magnum Launcher (10 Days), or the Dual Sword Phantom Slayer (10 Days)
[*]5 Days Total: Select 1 of the 6 Reward Weapons
[*]6 Days Total: Select 1 of the 6 Reward Weapons
[*]7 Days Total: Select 1 of the 6 Reward Weapons
[*]8 Days Total: Select 1 of either the Magnum Launcher (10 Days), or the Dual Sword Phantom Slayer (10 Days)
[/list]
[b]Reward Weapons[/b]
[*]Blade Rune Breaker (10 Days)
[*]Magnum Drill (10 Days)
[*]SG552 Lycanthrope (10 Days)
[*]Guillotine (10 Days)
[*]Gae Bolg (10 Days)
[*]Desert Eagle Crimson Hunter (10 Days)
[*]Red Dragon Cannon (10 Days)
[*]Python Desperado (10 Days)
[*]M4A1 Dark Knight (10 Days)
[*]AK47 Paladin (10 Days)
[*]Black Dragon Cannon (10 Days)
[/list]
[b]Notes[/b]
[*]The time for this event only counts in rooms with eight or more players.
[*]Each account can complete this event only once.
[/list]
Make sure you don't miss out on this chance to rack up tons of free weapons!


[h1]Daily Decoder Package A/B Sales (June 12 – June 26)[/h1]
You've all shown us a lot of support by purchasing decoders.

We'd like to offer you a new way to get decoders, for a short time!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/25249eda331f62405316c25a2d58c58edd72fa13.png[/img]
[b]Daily Decoder Package A[/b]
[*]Get a Top 50 Decoder when you log in each day. (Up to a maximum of 7 times)
[*]Get 5 additional Top 50 Decoders when you log in all 7 days.
[/list]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/e543ad792a079d7492aa15b3d5d6e7bdfc619233.png[/img]
[b]Daily Decoder Package B[/b]
[*]Get 2 Top 50 Decoders when you log in each day. (Up to a maximum of 7 times)
[*]Get 10 additional Top 50 Decoders when you log in all 7 days.
[/list]
[b]YOU MUST KNOW[/b]
[*]These items can be purchased only once per account, and cannot be gifted!
[*]The effect will not stack with the Daily Decoder Package A/B item effect.
[*]Therefore, DO NOT PURCHASE THIS ITEM TWICE.
[/list]
Don't be shy about participating in this awesome event!
Rack up tons of additional decoders for free by simply logging in regularly!


[h1]Earn New Medals in Team Deathmatch Event (June 12 – June 26)[/h1]
New medals will be awarded to those who place in the Top 100 for kill counts in Team Deathmatch mode during the event.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/166d1badd692425203040628ca71a3761afbc23a.png[/img]

[*]Honor Points: 0 Points (May be changed later)

[/list]
[b]Notes[/b]
[*]The Top 100 list will be arranged based on cumulative scores prior to maintenance on 6/26 (Wed).
[*]Medals will be given after maintenance on 6/26 (Wed).
[*]Each account can participate only once, and it only counts in rooms with eight or more players.
[/list]

[h1]Season 2 Transcendence Weapon [Infinity Laser Fist] Sales Promotion! (June 12 – June 26)[/h1]
You've all waited long enough! The weapon you saw in GM Yuri's update video, the Season 2 Transcendence Weapon, is finally here!
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/e2522ea044d9fc3eda869bfe53edf7fd39ac926b.png[/img]

[*]Top 50 Unlimited Premium Decoder (3%)
[*]Top 50 Premium Decoder (0.45%)
[/list]

Let's watch [Huxley]'s YouTube video for this new weapon here!
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=r0NW6T764Qk To help your chances of scoring an [Infinity Laser Fist], we're selling bigger bundles of items during the promotion.

[b]Notes[/b]
[*]All unused Top 50 Unlimited Premium Decoders and Top 50 Premium Decoders will be removed during maintenance on 6/26 (Wed).
[*]Each removed Top 50 Unlimited Premium Decoder will be replaced with 500 Mileage, and each Top 50 Premium Decoder will be replaced with 50 Mileage.
[*]Make sure to use them before time runs out!
[/list]

[h1]Season 2 Transcendence Weapon [Infinity Laser Fist] Guaranteed Giveaway! (June 12 – June 26)[/h1]
We've also prepared a guaranteed giveaway this time as for those who aren't fans of probability and still want their [Infinity Laser Fist]!
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/e8f0084871898f1f1fe90b6d8a22a577b747d9e6.png[/img]
[b]How can I get it?[/b]
[*]You'll earn 6 Guaranteed Points for using a Top 50 Unlimited Premium Decoder.
[*]You'll earn 1 Guaranteed Points for using a Top 50 Premium Decoder.
[*]You'll get the Season 2 Transcendence Weapon [Infinity Laser Fist] for reaching 300 Guaranteed Points!
[/list]
[b]Notes[/b]
[*]Don't forget that each account is able to receive the reward only once in this event!
[/list][/quote]

Please continue to enjoy the game so we can bring you bigger and better content!

See you all for the next patch!

Best regards,
The CSN:Z Team

As you all know, the Season system is a great way to earn more items.

[quote]
[h1]As a follow-up to the Windrider from the previous season, you'll be able to claim a weapon called the Stinger as the big item for Season 2.[/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/24b828d51c8d4e96fc6966b184fa5ffe52957bed.png[/img]

It may resemble the Gae Bolg, but it's much more powerful.

As a matter of fact, it's a weapon designed to destroy the hearts of vampires from the medieval period. It fires 3 rounds of special stakes that cannot be removed once stuck.


[h1]There's also the Season 2 Spray![/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/623d869ac2286763e5b8cbf6e7260023ae8f5e0a.png[/img]

The 3 sprays available in Season 2 are the [Black Anarchist Spray], [Sheriff Gerard Spray], and [Pioneer's Crest Spray].

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/89bd3c5c8d892a61ba53a1f2c8b4549171fd19a0.png[/img]


[h1]There are 2 new Zombie Skins as well![/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/edb99dcf728e4ec5ea524f38f731c2ea4d8f15a1.png[/img]

One is the [Scarecrow Blotter], and the other is the [Cowgirl Light Zombie]. Freakish indeed, but don't forget, this IS a zombie game.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/2ef57007f55c5e994176b9d11deff4f7e36aa2cf.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/4eeea260139508dd97a1cef54ef6bf80c8a629d4.png[/img]


[h1]2 new classes with new appearances have been added, too![/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/670ba135851699912a607439876b1bbd38460aef.png[/img]

Behold, [Anarchist David] and [Sheriff Gerard]! [Anarchist David] still manages to keep up his notoriety, despite having returned to the 20th century.

And now [Sheriff Gerard] finds himself with a sheriff's star and on the trail of David Black the anarchist.


[h1]We don't need to mention the newly added Season 2 Badges, right?[/h1]
These are the [Season Pass Medal] and the [Season Rank Achievement Medal]. You're sure to feel powerful once you earn these!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/9ae2ac23dbce01f754ca7990d805261b5bb502a2.png[/img]


[h1]Season 2 exclusive weapons and costumes have been updated.[/h1]
Costumes like the [Lantern], [Sheriff's Hat], [Leather Auxiliary Bag], [Anarchist's Hat], [Lasso], and [Tomahawk] have been added.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/5297c4da42fff0e13039649d123c82bb5072ed64.png[/img]

[h1]These fancy weapons from the Season 2 Pass rewards will take you right back to the days of the 20th century.[/h1]
Why don't you all chase down an anarchist yourself, after arming yourselves with weapons like the [Elegant Winchester M1887], [Elegant Double Barrel Shotgun], [Elegant Mosin-nagant], [Elegant Python], [Elegant Mauser C96], [Elegant Hunting Dagger], and the [Elegant Aeolis]?

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/3c29e5f75922514b972bf1790351c1e4ae19b382.png[/img]

Don't miss out on the Season 2 Pass, filled with all sorts of awesome weapons, items, and costumes!
[/quote]

Most importantly, don't forget that you won't be able to get your hands on these items once Season 2 is over!

We'll be back with more information next time!

Best regards,
The CSN:Z Team
