notes.title: Weekly Patch Note / June 14, 2017
notes.content:
[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/01/Weekly-Patch_EN-1029x346.jpg[/img]

Survivors,

Let’s check our update for this week!

[h1][b]Zombie Scenario Season 6-2: Ep. Victor[/b][/h1]

Go back to a time when research on anti-virus showed progress. The sudden escape of 'Phobos' results in the initiation of a capture mission. It falls to Victor, the most trusted Commander.

He successfully leads the troops to complete the mission, then goes on to a transport mission. Without even realizing it, they fall into the eye of a massive conspiracy.

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/06/0614_EN_ASSET-1.png[/img]

[h1][b]Now Available: Victor Class (Permanent)[/b][/h1]

‘Victor’, the protagonist of Zombie Scenario 6-2! Enjoy Zombie Scenario 6-2 with him for an even more realistic gameplay!

Meet ‘Victor’ at an affordable price, we hope you enjoy the Zombie Scenario 6-2 Victor story!

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/06/170602_CSS-693_600x400.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Zombie Scenario Season 6-2: Challenge Event.[/b][/h1]

Clear Zombie Scenario 6-2 during the event period to obtain different rewards according to difficulty!

[b]WHEN[/b]
[*]From today to July 12th (before maintenance)
[/list]
[b]DETAIL[/b]
[*]You enter the event by playing in a room with more than 4 people.
[*]The rewards can be obtained only once during the event period.
[*]You have to play for at least 5 minutes to obtain the rewards.
[/list]
[b]REWARD[/b]
[*]Hard-4: 30,000 Game Points
[*]Hard-5: 50,000 Game Points
[*]Hard-6: 100,000 Game Points
[*]Hard-7 or above: 5 x Top 50 Decoder.
[/list]
Enjoy the newly updated Zombie Scenario, and obtain bonus items!

[h1][b]3rd Party View System Applied[/b][/h1]

From this version on, the 3rd Party View system will be applied! Check out your own character in-game with the 3rd Party View system!

[b]WHEN[/b]
[*]The 3rd Party View system can be accessed while you wait before a game starts, before a round starts, and after the results screen is displayed, before you exit to the lobby. (There are a few modes in which it won't be available!)
[/list]
[h1][b]Now Available: Transcendence Class![/b][/h1]

It's finally here!

We're releasing a new class - the ‘Transcendence class’!

[b]DOROTHY DARK KNIGHT (TRANSCENDENCE CLASS)[/b]
[*]A member of the secret special group, she has supernatural powers.
[/list]
[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/06/0607_Asset_06.png[/img]

[b]FLORA PALADIN (TRANSCENDENCE CLASS)[/b]
[*]A member of the secret special group. She has supernatural powers.
[/list]
[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/06/0607_Asset_05.png[/img]

[b]WHEN[/b]
[*]From today to July 12th (before maintenance)
[/list]
[i]Note: They can be obtained from the Top 30 Class & Costume Decoder during the event period![/i]

[h1][b]Now Available: Top 30 Class & Costume Decoder![/b][/h1]

Thank you for all the love you've shown to ‘Costume Box 1 & 2’. We're releasing a new Decoder to replace ‘Costume Box 1 & 2’. It will be called the Top 30 Class & Costume Decoder (Top 30 C and C Decoder).

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/06/0607_Asset_07.png[/img]

The Top 30 Class & Costume Decoder has been designed to let you acquire the most popular Top 30 Classes and Costumes.

In particular, the new Transcendence classes ‘Dorothy Dark Knight’ and ‘Flora Paladin’ can only be acquired by using the Top 30 Class & Costume Decoder.

[b]WHEN[/b]
[*]From today to July 12th (before maintenance)
[/list]
Enjoy CSN:Z even more with the new Transcendence class via Top 30 class & Costume Decoders!

[h1][b]Put Your Gears On! Dark Knight Mask And Paladin Crown Event![/b][/h1]

In short, in this event you can get the Dark Knight Mask and Paladin.

[b]WHEN[/b]
[*]From today to July 12th (before maintenance)
[/list]

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/06/0607_Asset_08.png[/img]

[b]HOW[/b]
[*]All users who buy and use 50 Top 30 Class & Costume Decoders will randomly obtain either a Dark Knight Mask or a Paladin Crown.
[*]All users who buy and use 50 more Top 30 Class & Costume Decoders will additionally obtain the other equipment that they did not obtain the first time.
[/list]
[i]Note: Buy and use 100 Top 30 Class & Costume Decoders to own both the Dark Knight Mask and the Paladin Crown![/i]

[h1][b]ALL DLCs: -50% DISCOUNT.[/b][/h1]

Needless to say.

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/06/03_DLCs.png[/img]

[b]WHEN[/b]
[*]From June 15th to June 17th. (48 hours)
[/list]
[h1][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h1]
[*]Fixed a bug that kept the Blade Rune Breaker from being disassembled.
[*]Fixed a bug that kept users from proceeding with the mission in Clinical Trial. (We offer our sincerest apologies for the time it took to solve this issue, and as compensation, we are providing 3 x Top 30 Brand Decoder to all survivors.)
[*]Fixed Voodoo Zombie's texture color issue.
[/list]
This is pretty much everything.
We will get back to you on the next maintenance day.

Kind Regards,
The CSN:Z Team

notes.title: Weekly Patch Note / May 24, 2017
notes.content:
[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/01/Weekly-Patch_EN-1029x346.jpg[/img]

Survivors,

Let’s check out our update for this week!

[h1][b]8 Times Higher = 8 Times Better[/b][/h1]

During the event period, you’ll have an 8x higher chance to receive the new weapon (War Fan) from the decoder!

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/05/0524_01.png[/img]

[b]WHEN[/b]
[*]From today’s maintenance until June 7.
[/list]
[h1][b]Math for Mileage![/b][/h1]

During the event period, you can receive Top 50 Decoders and a Chinese Zombie as a reward by collecting numbers and letters from Zombie Hero mode and Zombie mode!

[b]HOW[/b]
[*]First, get a zombie kill or human kill in the Zombie Hero or Zombie mode.
[*]Then, get a zombie kill assist or human kill assist in the same mode.
[*]Afterwards, you will receive a series of random numbers and letters.
[*]Start your calculation with the numbers and letters you’ve collected.
[*]Finally, construct a correct answer!
[/list]

[i]Example: If correct answer is 1234…[/i]
[*]Enter ‘math(9*9*9*2)-(9*8*2)-(5*8*2)’ into the channel’s chat. If you’re correct, your reward will be delivered to your account!
[/list]

[b]WHERE IS THE ANSWER?[/b]
[*]Type 'mathinfo' in the chatting line.
[/list]

[b]REWARD[/b]
[*]Lv2. Mileage Coupon. (Daily)
[*]Chinese Zombie (Permanent) + 10x Top 50 Decoder. (After completing it 7 times.)
[/list]

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/05/0524_02.png[/img]

[b]DETAILS[/b]
[*]You can collect numbers and letters with at least 4 or more players in the same room.
[*]You can collect a maximum of 10 identical numbers and letters.
[*]Once the limit of 10 identical numbers or letters is reached, they will no longer be added.
[*]If your answer has decimal points, decimal numbers will not be counted as an answer.
[*]The answer to be calculated will differ for each player. The answer will always be between 1000 and 10000.
[*]The event, as well as your collected numbers and letters, will be reset at 00:00 each day. You can participate in this event only once per day. (However, you can participate again the following day.)
[*]The correct answer will be displayed through an in-game message.
[/list]
[h1][b]Sale - Permanent Maverick Series Weapon![/b][/h1]

Permanent Maverick series weapons and other weapons are on now sale at an amazing price! Grab ‘em while you can! 

[b]WHEN[/b]
[*]From today’s maintenance until June 7.
[/list]
[b]DETAILS[/b]
[*]M950
[*]Petrol Boomer
[*]AWP-Z
[*]M1887 Maverick
[*]K1A Maverick
[*]Galil Maverick
[*]M60E4 Maverick
[*]Crowbar Maverick
[*]SPAS-12 Maverick

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/05/0524_03.png[/img]

[/list]
Well, that’s all for this week.
We’ll get back to you on the day of our next maintenance (June 7).

Kind Regards,
CSN:Z Team

notes.title: Weekly Patch Note / May 17, 2017
notes.content:
[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/01/Weekly-Patch_EN-1029x346.jpg[/img]

Survivors,

Let’s check out our update for this week!

[h1][b]Removed some items[/b][/h1]

We have removed some enhancement and manufacturing related items from in-game shop.

[h1][b]New anti-cheat patch update[/b][/h1]

We have applied new anti-cheat patch today during the maintenance. Hope it helps your sound gaming environment.
[*]We are also waiting for your hacking/abusing report.
[*]If you have a hacked program or file, please contact our customer service or GMs.
[*]It will make CSN:Z better.
[/list]
[h1][b]Mileage Auction System: News[/b][/h1]

We finished discussion finally. Mileage auction system comes back in July or August. We have two target date so we can't say when exactly. However, your mileage auction system will be back in July or August.

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/02/0215_04_MileageAuction-1.png[/img]
[*]We removed some abusing point from Mileage Auction system already.
[*]It looks totally same like old mileage auction system but there were some changes inside.
[*]We are testing this new mileage auction internally and will let you know when the time comes.
[/list]

[h1][b]Don't be fooled by fake videos and screenshots.[/b][/h1]

We have seen some fake videos from Youtube and it was hilarious experience but made me sad at the same time.
[*]They made poor quality fake videos and screenshots. We checked their system logs and found that they never had million number of items and decoders.
[*]They were making fun of you. It made me so sad.
[*]Please don't be fooled by their fake outcomes.
[/list]

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/05/fnR0kt0.png[/img]

[h1][b]Server system update[/b][/h1]
[*]We have installed new server patch that makes our servers stable and sustainable.
[/list]
Well, that’s all for now.
We will get back to you on the next maintenance day.

Kind Regards,
CSN:Z Team

notes.title: [NOTICE] Global Weapon Paint Contest: Final Result
notes.content:
[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/12/EN-Notice.jpg[/img]

Survivors,

As you know, we have been hosting the ‘Global Weapon Paint Contest’ for the last couple of weeks, and we’ve finally come to a decision.

Firstly, we would like to thank all participants in this event. Making the final decision was very tough.

We checked every design that you sent us, and we selected top 10 designs and sent to dev team.

The dev team also spent tons of time deciding, and now we’re finally ready to announce the winners.

[h1][b]Top 10 Designs[/b][/h1]

Here are top 10 most-liked designs! The creators will receive Top 50 Unlimited Decoder x30.

notes.title: Weekly Patch Note / April 26, 2017
notes.content:
[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/01/Weekly-Patch_EN-1029x346.jpg[/img]

Survivors,

How was our last update? Maybe it made you to collect newly released transcendence weapon? I hope you had that weapon already!

Let’s check our update for this week!

[h1][b]Exciting Zombie Scenario (Revenge) Event![/b][/h1]

Yes, good-old event strikes back! Through this event, you can get a new weapon easily. There’s no reason not to participate this event.

[b]WHEN[/b]
[*]You can acquire this weapon from April 26 to May 10.
[/list]
[b]REWARD[/b]
[*]You can get a weapon as a reward (ULTIMAX-100) if you clear Exciting Revenge during the event period.
[/list]
[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/0426_Asset_01.png[/img]

[b]HOW[/b]
[*]You have to clear at least Hard-6 or higher. (Difficulty)
[*]Minimum participation time is 5 minute or longer.
[*]You have to play this with at least 4 or more players at the same time.
[*]Your reward item(ULTIMAX-100) will be given only once during the event period.
[/list]
[b]NOTE[/b]
[*]Players moving speed is increased and you will have unlimited ammo.
[*]You will encounter max 3 monsters in every 60 seconds.
[*]All dropping weapons in the Exciting, will be used at event map only.
[*]In Exciting map, you will not be able to acquire Zombie evolution, ribbon, mission, accumulated statistics, and league points.
[/list]
[h1][b]Now Available: Thanatos-3 / Thanatos-5 / Thanatos-7 (Permanent)[/b][/h1]

Before I tell you something about this weapon, I must say this again.

“We will bring Mileage Auction system back sooner or later.”

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/0426_Asset_02.png[/img]

[b]WHAT[/b]

[*]You can purchase Thanatos-3, Thanatos-5 and Thanatos-7 permanent items with competitive price.
[/list]
[i]Note: Why do we remind you to bring Mileage Auction System back in the near future? Well, let’s think about it.[/i]

[h1][b]System[/b][/h1]

What are changed now?
[*]We have replaced all “Red Cross” image in-game upon Red Cross protection law.
[*]We have expanded user inventory slots from 440 to 540.
[*]We have implemented stronger anti-cheat updated for today’s maintenance time.
[/list]
[h1][b]Etc.,[/b][/h1]
[*]Top 50 Unlimited Premium Decoder and Top 50 Premium Decoder will be removed from the shop on May 10 after the maintenance.
[*]We have been doing our patch update twice per month, normally. If we have no specific update, it would not be changed. Please refer.
[/list]
Kind Regards,
CSN:Z Team

notes.title: [NOTICE] Global Weapon Paint Design Contest (Voting Started)
notes.content:
[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/12/EN-Notice.jpg[/img]

Survivors,

As we previously announced, submissions for the design contest have been officially closed. Now it’s time for voting!

[h1][b]HOW TO VOTE[/b][/h1]
[*]Please visit our ‘Artwork(Most Recent)’ page (If you can't see, please click the link below) on Steam and take a look at the user-submitted ‘Cyclone’ weapon designs.
[*]If you like a design, click the thumbs up button.
[*]If you don’t like a design, click the thumbs down button. Please note that you will not see a tally of downvotes.
[*]You can upvote multiple designs. (Example for Design No.1, No. 2, and No. 3)
[*]If there is a tie for most votes, the CSN:Z developer will choose the winner.
[/list]
[i]Note: If there are any designs that violate intellectual property laws, they will be automatically disqualified from the contest and removed from the contest page.[/i]

[h1][b]RESULT[/b][/h1]
[*]Your rank will be decided based on the number of upvotes.
[*]We will send the Top 3 designs to the CSN:Z developer, and they will decide the final ranking. (Top 1, Top 2, and Top 3)
[*]The CSN:Z developer will give us the final result, which we will then announce.
[/list]
[h1][b]WHEN[/b][/h1]
[*]Voting will start today and will last until April 28 at 12:00 PM.
[/list]
[h1][b]VIEW[/b][/h1]

-

We hope you all enjoy the contest. We can’t wait to see the results!

Kind Regards,
CSN:Z Team

notes.title: Weekly Patch Note / April 12, 2017
notes.content:
[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/01/Weekly-Patch_EN-1029x346.jpg[/img]

Survivors,

Your wait is over! We have been preparing quite a bit of content for this week. We know that you have been eager to learn about something new on CSN:Z. For those eagerly awaiting people, today is the day. Let’s check out the full update notes now.

[h1][b]Now Available: Blade Runebreaker.[/b][/h1]

Blade Runebreaker is our new melee weapon. The Blade Runebreaker can be obtained from the new decoders.

A blade that bears a mysterious, ancient power that provide sharpness and strength. The power can be amplified and has the ability to emit a powerful analyzer.

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/0412_Asset_01.png[/img]

You can take full advantage of this weapon's high damage, high stun power, and the longest melee range attack.

[b]WHEN[/b]
[*]You can acquire this weapon from April 12th to May 10th.
[/list]
[b]HOW[/b]
[*]Through newly introduced decoders. (Please see below)
[/list]

[h1][b]New Top 50 Unlimited / Premium Decoder is now available.[/b][/h1]

This is it.

We are proud to introduce the new Top 50 Premium Unlimited decoder today. This decoder is guaranteed to have the best item with permanent period of time. You can get the [Blade Runebreaker] item through this.

notes.title: Weekly Patch Note / March 29, 2017
notes.content:
[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/01/Weekly-Patch_EN-1029x346.jpg[/img]

Survivors,

It’s been a long time! We are finally back with item and event updates! We have many things to tell you, but first let’s check out the full update notes!

[h1][b]Letter Collection Event![/b][/h1]

Good old letter collection event has finally come back!

[b]WHEN[/b]
[*]Starting from March 29th to April 12th.
[/list]
[b]HOW[/b]
[*]During the event period you can get an alphabet item or Joker in the game [*]when you kill enemies.
[*]You can get 5 Joker items, if you joined this event for more than 10 days.
[*]You can get a reward weapon through the alphabet item you got from the game.
[*]This event will be activated when you play with at least 4 or more players in the same room.
[*]You can’t get an event item through melee weapon with bots.
[*]You can also get the same alphabet item as a reward.
[*]If you collect all required alphabet letters, the reward will be injected right away.
[*]Please check your inventory space before you participate in this event, otherwise the item will not be properly injected if your inventory space is full.
[*]Your collected alphabet and joker items will be removed when the event finishes on April 12th.
[/list]
[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/03/0329_02.png[/img]

[h1][b]100,000 Zombie Killing Event.[/b][/h1]

Yes, we are bringing you this challenging event once again to Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies.

[b]WHEN[/b]
[*]Starting from March 29th to April 12th.
[/list]
[b]HOW[/b]
[*]You can get a reward when you achieve 100,000 personal zombie kills during the event period.
[*]Reward items will be delivered when you achieve 100,000 kills.
[*]Your kill count will appear in the chat window every 100 kills.
[*]You can participate in this event only once per account.
[/list]
[b]REWARD[/b]
[*]30 x Item Duration Extenders.
[/list]
[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/03/0329_05.png[/img]

[h1][b]Perfect Pick Recipe: Crow-3[/b][/h1]

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/03/0329_04.png[/img]

[b]WHEN[/b]
[*]Starting from March 29th to April 12th.
[/list]
[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/03/0329_03.png[/img]

[b]HOW[/b]
[*]You can buy this item from our in-game shop.
[/list]
[h1][b]Global Weapon Paint Design Contest.[/b][/h1]

As you already know, we are currently doing this event. [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/273110/announcements/detail/233465047945291105]Please check the announcement[/url] we previously uploaded and participate in this event!

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/03/0329_03_0.png[/img]

[b]WHAT[/b]
[*]You can design your own ‘Cyclone’ item and send it back to us through e-mail. (csnz-event@nexoneu.com)
[/list]
[h1][b]Mileage Auction System? (Q & A Session!)[/b][/h1]

Well, I have seen many questions and concerns about CSN:Z these days. Therefore I would like to address a couple of comments we have been receiving.

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/02/0215_04_MileageAuction-1.png[/img]

[h1][i]Q. Mileage Auction will not come back to the game.[/i][/h1]

A. You are incorrect. Like we stated in a [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/273110/announcements/detail/233464319214699449]past announcement[/url], we are fixing and developing some content inside the auction system. We will bring it back to you when it is ready.

[h1][i]Q. When will Mileage Auction come back to the game?[/i][/h1]

A. Like we said, when we're ready for deployment. As a matter of fact, we are discussing when to release the mileage auction system again, so please don't worry. We will let you know when we are prepared.

[h1][i]Q. Do you have mileage decoder yet?[/i][/h1]

A. Like we have said in the past, the mileage decoder opening function will be removed in the near future.

Please use them before it expires.

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/10/1005_02_IMD.png[/img]

[h1][i]Q. Something new?[/i][/h1]

A. Yes, we are preparing for that. Please look forward to our new update on [u]April 12.[/u]

Okay, this is pretty much everything for this week. We will get back to you with better content next time.

Kind Regards,
CSN:Z Team

Yes, we are bringing you this challenging event once again to Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies.

[b]WHEN[/b]
[*]Starting from March 29th to April 12th.
[/list]
[b]HOW[/b]
[*]You can get a reward when you achieve 100,000 personal zombie kills during the event period.
[*]Reward items will be delivered when you achieve 100,000 kills.
[*]Your kill count will appear in the chat window every 100 kills.
[*]You can participate in this event only once per account.
[/list]
[b]REWARD[/b]
[*]30 x Item Duration Extenders.
[/list]
[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/03/0329_05.png[/img]

[h1][b]Perfect Pick Recipe: Crow-3[/b][/h1]

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/03/0329_04.png[/img]

[b]WHEN[/b]
[*]Starting from March 29th to April 12th.
[/list]
[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/03/0329_03.png[/img]

[b]HOW[/b]
[*]You can buy this item from our in-game shop.
[/list]
[h1][b]Global Weapon Paint Design Contest.[/b][/h1]

As you already know, we are currently doing this event. [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/273110/announcements/detail/233465047945291105]Please check the announcement[/url] we previously uploaded and participate in this event!

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/03/0329_03_0.png[/img]

[b]WHAT[/b]
[*]You can design your own ‘Cyclone’ item and send it back to us through e-mail. (csnz-event@nexoneu.com)
[/list]
[h1][b]Mileage Auction System? (Q & A Session!)[/b][/h1]

Well, I have seen many questions and concerns about CSN:Z these days. Therefore I would like to address a couple of comments we have been receiving.

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/02/0215_04_MileageAuction-1.png[/img]

[h1][i]Q. Mileage Auction will not come back to the game.[/i][/h1]

A. You are incorrect. Like we stated in a [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/273110/announcements/detail/233464319214699449]past announcement[/url], we are fixing and developing some content inside the auction system. We will bring it back to you when it is ready.

[h1][i]Q. When will Mileage Auction come back to the game?[/i][/h1]

A. Like we said, when we're ready for deployment. As a matter of fact, we are discussing when to release the mileage auction system again, so please don't worry. We will let you know when we are prepared.

[h1][i]Q. Do you have mileage decoder yet?[/i][/h1]

A. Like we have said in the past, the mileage decoder opening function will be removed in the near future.

Please use them before it expires.

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/10/1005_02_IMD.png[/img]

[h1][i]Q. Something new?[/i][/h1]

A. Yes, we are preparing for that. Please look forward to our new update on [u]April 12.[/u]

Okay, this is pretty much everything for this week. We will get back to you with better content next time.

Kind Regards,
CSN:Z Team

notes.title: [NOTICE] Global Weapon Paint Design Contest.
notes.content:
[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/01/Notice_EN-1029x346.jpg[/img]

Survivors,

We are proud announce that we are going to begin ‘Global Weapon Paint Design Contest’ starting today. (March 16th to April 12th)

[h1][b]WHAT WEAPON?[/b][/h1]
[*]We are going to design our own Cyclone.
[/list]
[h1][b]WHEN?[/b][/h1]
[*]From March 16th to April 12th – You can submit your own design file to us.
[*]From April 12th to April 23th – You can vote your favorite one. (At our ‘[url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/273110/images/]Artwork[/url]’ site.)
[/list]
[h1][b]HOW TO JOIN?[/b][/h1]

Please design your own cyclone and send it to a@b.com until April 12th.
[*]You have to write your Steam ID and your CSN:Z IGN (In-game name) in your e-mail with your design file(s).
[*]Design files sent through e-mail without your information OR sending your information without a design file are not valid entries and will not be considered as potential winners.
[*]If your design file is not qualified by us, your design file will not be shown to the public when we upload the design.
[/list]
[h1][b]HOW TO DESIGN?[/b][/h1]

Please see the below sample and you can paint a splendid color or design an excellent pattern on it and send it to us with your Steam ID and your CSN:Z IGN.

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/03/Cyclone-1024x768.png[/img]

[b]DESIGN YOUR OWN CYCLONE WITH THIS RENDER![/b]

Above is a sample, so please use this. This is our weapon for this contest.

[h1][b]DETAIL[/b][/h1]
[*]Your design file has to be PNG format.
[*]Design file must be 3000 x 2250.
[*]Your given design must not be violated other designs or any copyrights.
[*]Nexon Europe will have all the rights for your submitted design(s).
[*]You cannot insist any of your rights for your submitted design(s).
[*]CSN:Z developer will select your design and use your design for the Cyclone weapon.
[*]The designed weapon could be purchasing through our in-game shop and we can write your IGN on the weapon, if CSN:Z developer wants.
[/list]
[h1][b]REWARD[/b][/h1]
[*]1st Winner: Steam Cash (500 Euro) + Global Weapon Paint Design Contest Weapon (Total 6 weapons) + each Counter-Strike Online branches’ 1st Winning Weapon Design. (Total 6 pcs)
[*]2nd Winner: Steam Cash (300 Euro) + Global Weapon Paint Design Contest Weapon (Total 6 weapons) + each Counter-Strike Online branches’ 1st Winning Weapon Design. (Total 6 pcs)
[*]3rd Winner: Steam Cash (100 Euro) + Global Weapon Paint Design Contest Weapon (Total 6 weapons) + each Counter-Strike Online branches’ 1st Winning Weapon Design. (Total 6 pcs)
[*]The top 10 most voted for design creators will receive 30 x Top 50 unlimited decoder.
[/list]
We will inject or deliver the reward when we release your design weapon as a commercial item through our in-game shop.

[h1][b]TERMS AND CONDITION[/b][/h1]

[table]
[tr]
[th]NO PURCHASE NECESSARY TO ENTER OR TO WIN. A PURCHASE DOES NOT IMPROVE THE CHANCES OF WINNING.

I. Organizer
The organizer of the event is NEXON Europe GmbH.

II. Entry requirements
1. All natural persons aged eighteen (18) years or over upon the entering of the event, residing in the territories where the game Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies (the “Game”) is being serviced, are entitled to take part. Employees of the organizer and of companies affiliated with the organizer are not permitted to take part.
2. To enter the event the participant must (i) be a registered user of the organizer’s services, (ii) be a holder of an account for the Game, and (iii) be a holder of a Game character.
3. Each participant may enter the event only once within the period set out in article III.1.

III. How to enter
1. The event will begin on March 15, 2017 and end on April 12, 2017.
2. The participant may enter the event by: (i) submitting a weapon paint item design; and (ii) submitting the weapon paint design to the following email address: csnz-event@nexoneu.com .
3. The participant hereby assures the organizer that the submitted weapon paint item design will not infringe any intellectual property rights or any other rights of any third parties, is not subject to any acquisition of rights from third parties and with the submission the participant assigns any and all intellectual property rights related to the submitted weapon paint item design to the organizer in perpetuity.
4. Only participants completing and agreeing to the above stated conditions, within the stated period, will be included in the selection of the prizes.

IV. Data Protection
In order to receive the prize the winners will have to provide the organizer with his/her in-game character name. The information will be processed in accordance with the organizer’s Privacy Policy that the participants have agreed to when registering as a user, to the extent that the following paragraphs do not derogate from the Privacy Policy.

V. Determination and notification of winners
1. Only those participants who have participated in the event by completing the requirements in article II. and III for entry within the event period will be included in the selection of winners.
2. The 1st place, 2nd place, 3rd place winner and top ten (10) winners (including the 1st, 2nd and 3rd place winners) will be chosen by the result of a poll, and be awarded in accordance with article VI.1 below.
3. The winners will be announced on May 10, 2017 from and among all participants eligible for entry as per article II. and III. above. Only one prize per winner is permitted. The announcement will be made on May 10, 2017, where the winners’ character name will be published.

VI. Prizes
1. The prizes will be distributed as follows:
• 1st: Five hundred (500) Euros of Steam (digital) Cash + six (6 ) types of Global Weapons + six (6) types of National Weapon Skin (1st Class Winning skin).
• 2nd: Three hundred (300) Euros of Steam (digital) Cash + six (6) types of Global Weapons + six (6) types of National Weapon Skin (1st Class Winning skin).
• 3rd: One hundred (100) Euros of Steam (digital) Cash + six (6) types of Global Weapons + six (6) types of National Weapon Skin (1st Class Winning skin).
• Top 10 Winners: Thirty (30) x Top 50 Unlimited Decoders (per winner).
2. Prizes cannot be paid out in cash or transferred to other persons. If the delivery of the prize would fail due to the incorrect information provided by the participant, the organizer shall have no responsibility for the failed delivery.

VII. Changes to event rules
1. The organizer reserves the right to change the event rules at any time or to terminate or suspend the event without prior notice for reasonable causes, such as force majeure or other causes beyond the organizer’s control in connection with the event.
2. The organizer is entitled to exclude participants from the event in case the participant violates these Terms and Conditions of the event.

VIII. Miscellaneous
1. By participating in the event, the participants waives any and all intellectual property rights related to the submitted weapon paint item designs and furthermore agrees to the organizer printing the winners’ in-game name on the winning weapon paint item design when commercializing the item design.
2. Should individual provisions of the event rules be or become invalid then this will have no impact on the validity of the remaining provisions. The invalid provisions shall be replaced by a provision appropriate for the individual case at hand that most closely corresponds with the purpose of the invalid provisions.
3. Should the participants and/or the prize winners damage or harm the organizer and their respective officers, employees, directors, affiliates and subsidiaries due to their actions, including but not limited to the breach of these Terms and Conditions they agree to indemnify the organizer for the damages or harm caused.
4. Any and all disputes, claims and causes in connection with the event shall be resolved by applying the laws of Germany.
5. The organizer’s decisions in regards of the determination of the winners are final in all matters relating to this event.[/th]
[/tr]
[/table]


Every participant must agree to the Terms and Conditions. Please do not send any design(s) if you disagree with our Terms and Conditions for this contest.

Kind Regards,
CSN:Z Team

notes.title: Weekly Patch Note / March 8, 2017
notes.content:
[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/01/Weekly-Patch_EN-1029x346.jpg[/img]

Survivors,

Let’s check out the full update notes:

[h1][b]Permanent Characters Are Now Available![/b][/h1]

We are listening your opinions!

We have newly updated permanent characters in our in-game shop! Let’s meet our new permanent characters!

David Black, Gerard, Alin, Ling Ling, and Dominique are waiting for you!

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/03/0308_01.png[/img]

[h1][b]Play Time Event! What Will Your Reward Be?[/b][/h1]

Starting from today, you are eligible to get a reward for this event. How to participate in this event? Just play Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies from 19:00 to 24:00 (CET)! Based upon your play time, rewards will be delivered to you automatically!

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/03/0308_02.png[/img]

[*]30 minutes of play time: Top 30 Brand Decoder x 1
[*]60 minutes of play time: Top 30 Brand Decoder x 2
[*]90 minutes of play time: Top 30 Brand Decoder x 3
[*]120 minutes of play time: Top 30 Brand Decoder x 4
[*]150 minutes of play time: Top 50 Decoder x 1
[/list]
Oops, this event will be finished by March 29th.

A Free decoder chance is waiting for you!

[h1][b]Improved Top 50 And Top 50 Unlimited Decoder.[/b][/h1]

We have added a new weapon called ‘Tornado’ into Top 50 and Top 50 unlimited decoders.

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/03/0308_03.png[/img]

Tornado is a futuristic assault rifle that can fire 70 rounds of laser beams. The emitted laser will deal more damage over time. The technology that this weapon uses is unknown.

This weapon has 3 modes, the second and third modes will activate automatically when the weapon is fired for long enough.
If the user stops shooting for too long, the weapon will switch back to the first mode.
The longer the weapon is fired, the more damage it will deal.

Bottom line… what are you waiting for?

[h1][b]Enjoy Double? Triple? No… 8x Chance Event![/b][/h1]

The celebration is just beginning.

Starting from today to April 12th, you will have 8x the chance to get a ‘Tornado’ weapon from the decoder.

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/03/17.03.08_CSS-501_694x120_EN.jpg[/img]

8 times, yes 8 times higher chance to get ‘Tornado’ through our decoder.

[h1][b]SD Light Zombie Boss Event Map.[/b][/h1]

From today to April 12th, a new Zombie boss will appear in the 6th stage of Nightmare map.

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/03/0308_05.png[/img]

She is a Zombie, but she is cute and more elegant than before.

Please welcome cute SD style Light Zombie in the Nightmare map

[h1][b]Mileage Auction Has Closed.[/b][/h1]

As we announced previously, the mileage auction system has closed today. However we are going to bring back this system soon.

We would want to say good-bye for now because we will see this updated feature again in the near future.

We will fix some bugs in the system and will get back to you soon.

[h1][b]For Those Who Lost Their Items Or Mileages While Auctioning.[/b][/h1]

Today, we have injected your lost mileage and item into your account. Please check this out. We checked all player's game log and we found someone had an error. Therefore we injected your lost item and mileage.

[h1][b]Do You Have Mileage Decoder Yet?[/b][/h1]

Like we said in the past, the mileage decoder opening function will be removed in the near future.

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/03/0308_06.png[/img]

Please use them before it expires.

Okay, this is pretty much everything for this week and we will get back to you with better content next time.

Kind Regards,
CSN:Z Team

notes.title: Weekly Patch Note / February 22, 2017
notes.content:
[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/01/Weekly-Patch_EN-1029x346.jpg[/img]

Survivors,

Let’s check out the full update notes:

[h1][b]New Perfect Pick Recipe Sets[/b][/h1]

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/02/0222_Banner_01.png[/img]

A New Perfect Pick Recipe is coming! You can find it in our in-game shop.

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/273110/announcements/detail/233463050427313476]Click here for more information[/url]

[h1][b]Mileage Auction System? Wow! But Lack Of Mileage…[/b][/h1]

Please worry not. We heard you and were thinking about some sort of mileage giveaway event before February ends.

Therefore there’ll be the ‘Random Mileage Giveaway’ event!

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/02/170125_CSS-474_694x120_EN.jpg[/img]

Starting today after the maintenance, you can get a free mileage randomly when you connect to the game from 16:00 to 18:00 (CET). You will not be able to receive your free mileage afterwards!

This event will close on March 8. before the maintenance.

If you leave a good review for our game on our Steam page, we will prepare another free giveaway event!

So please leave a positive review!

[h1][b]Good-Bye: Starter Pack DLC On Steam[/b][/h1]

We have removed the Starter Pack DLC on Steam. It has been showing pretty good performance for all beginners of Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies for a long time. However, that DLC is getting older and older, so we decided to remove it.

But don’t worry!

We are currently discussing about creating a new help box for beginners with the developer and we will implement it sooner or later.

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/02/starter_en.jpg[/img]

Now it’s time to say ‘Goodbye for good, old friend‘.

Bye bye Starter Pack DLC!

[h1][b]Anti-Cheat Module Updated[/b][/h1]

As you know many players were blocked by our old anti-cheat system. We are updating this system so you won’t face any problems with it in the future.

We will keep listening your opinions and suggestions, so please show your constant and continuous support for Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies!

Kind Regards,
CSN:Z Team

notes.title: Introducing New Decoders.
notes.content:
[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/01/Now-available_EN-1029x346.jpg[/img]

Survivors,

We are bringing new decoders! You can see our new decoders from our shop right away. We designed this item for your better enjoyment. Please see what we have added today!

[h1][b]Top 50 Unlimited Decoder.[/b][/h1]

This is a totally innovative decoder. You can get a [u]PERMANENT[/u] weapon through this decoder! This decoder generates [u]PERMANENT weapons only.[/u] In addition, the most sought after weapons are all available in this decoder.

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/02/0215_01_Top50UNLMTD.png[/img]

[b]WHAT’S INSIDE?[/b]

Magnum Drill, Warhammer Storm Giant, SG552 Lycanthrope, M4A1 Dark Knight, AK-47 Paladin, Reaper, Desert Eagle Crimson Hunter, AWP Elven Ranger, Gae Bolg, Guillotine, Black Dragon Cannon, Crossbow Advance, Air Buster, and more!

Our GM tested this item. They bought 30 decoders and opened them all. The result was totally shock and awe. I don’t want to say everything. It’s your turn to find out.

[h1][b]Top 50 Decoder.[/b][/h1]

If you don’t want to have a permanent weapon from Top 50 Unlimited Decoder, this would be a great alternative choice for you! It’s way cheaper than Top 50 Unlimited Decoder, but you can get a taste of the same weapons found in Top 50 Unlimited Decoder. In addition, if you are really lucky, you are able to get a permanent weapon by chance.

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/02/0215_02_Top50.png[/img]

[b]WHAT’S INSIDE?[/b]

Magnum Drill, Warhammer Storm Giant, SG552 Lycanthrope, M4A1 Dark Knight, AK-47 Paladin, Reaper, Desert Eagle Crimson Hunter, AWP Elven Ranger, Gae Bolg, Guillotine, Black Dragon Cannon, Crossbow Advance, Air Buster and more!

I hope this helps you to understand our patch for today!

Kind Regards,
CSN:Z Team

notes.title: Let’s enjoy Mileage Auction System.
notes.content:
[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/01/Special_EN-1029x346.jpg[/img]

Mileage Auction System.

Mileage Auction System is a brand new concept for Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies. Let’s check this out carefully and enjoy CSN:Z with this newly introduced system!

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/02/0215_03_MileageAuction-1024x795.png[/img]

[b]HOW[/b]
[*]You can enjoy Mileage Auction system when you click the button below.
[/list]
[b]DETAIL[/b]
[*]All permanent weapons are eligible for Mileage Auction system. (Few weapons are not eligible for Auction Market.)
[*]Changing weapon list for free: Top 25 and Normal = Every 10 seconds.
[*]Auction Closing Time: Top 25 = 60 minutes / Normal = 20 minutes.
[*]Auction Closing Time Extension: If someone bids, it will be automatically extended.
[*]Bid starting price (Top 25) = Starting from 500 / Minimum price 500.
[*]Bid starting price (Normal) = Starting from 500 / Minimum price 100.
[*]Level limit: Mileage Auction market can be used after Lv. 6 (Staff Sergeant).
[/list]
[b]YOU HAVE TO KNOW[/b]
[*]Registering Auction and Bidding Auction cannot be attempted multiple times simultaneously.
[*]Auction list can be organized randomly, and you can refresh it in every 10 seconds.
[*]You can buy a registered auction item instantly with the ‘Buy Now’ price.
[*]When registering your auction item, 30% of the commission price will automatically be added to the bidding price. i.e.) If your minimum bidding price is 10,000 mileage, the first biddable price will automatically be adjusted to 7,000 mileage.
[*]If your registered item has not been purchased, it will be automatically returned to original holder.
[*]Once you've registered your item on the auction market, it can not be canceled before the auction time is finished.
[/list]
Kind Regards,
CSN:Z Team

notes.content:

Survivors,

Let’s check out the full update notes:

[h1][b]Mileage Auction System.[/b][/h1]

Your wait is over. After a long discussion with the developer, we are bringing this to you much earlier than we expected!

This is just the beginning.

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/02/0215_04_MileageAuction-1.png[/img]

[h1][b]Introducing New Decoders.[/b][/h1]

It is so much fun to surprise you. I am proud to introduce our new decoders.

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/02/0215_07_Brand.png[/img]

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/273110/announcements/detail/233461781530771306]Click here for more information.[/url]

[h1][b]Dual Infinity Final (Permanent) + Weapon Paint: Lace[/b][/h1]

Well, it's time to have new weapon paint color and the permanent weapon! Dual Infinity Final (Permanent) is now available. Let's check this out!

We set the discount rate which is nearly -50% per package so you will have significant advantage through this package item. (1 WEEK EXCLUSIVE!)

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/02/0215_05_DIFWL.png[/img]

[h1][b]Crazy Zombie Hero Event![/b][/h1]

From today until March 8th, you can enjoy Crazy Zombie Hero Event. In this event, humans can acquire an item and use it. Your primary / secondary weapon’s ammo will be automatically re-supplied as well. As a zombie, skill recharging time (cool-time) will be reduced and zombie bomb will be automatically re-supplied.

[h1][b]Exciting Zombie Scenario Event![/b][/h1]

Like Crazy Zombie Hero event, Exciting Zombie Scenario Event will be held from today until March 8th. In the exciting revenge map, you can get a high-class weapon and your movement speed will also be increased. There will be 3 summoned bonus monsters and each one of the monsters have 5 random weapons.

I hope it helps you to play Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies!

Kind Regards,

notes.title: A decoder will be removed from the game.
notes.content:
[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/12/EN-Notice.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]A decoder will be removed from the game.[/b][/h1]

Survivors,

At the end of 2016 we hosted a "Good-bye" sale for the Supreme Decoders. We're no longer going to see them in CSN:Z.

However, with the New Year we also decided it's time for us to innovate the in-game formula and so we're also removing Mileage Decoders from the game altogether.

We know it comes as a surprise, but we do love surprises a lot!

You probably wonder what's going to happen now. How are we supposed to complete our Bingo Boards without Mileage?

Worry not, Survivors: with the Mileage Decoders going, something new and special is taking its place! Something that will potentially also address other in-game matters indirectly!

Mileage Decoder will be removed from the game on February 8th after the maintenance. After maintenance, you can open your purchased/stored Mileage Decoders but you are unable to buy Mileage Decoders anymore.

We will not close the Mileage opening function before the end of July 2017 and you will be informed again in a later stage about the date for the closing of the Mileage opening function.

We hope this helps and let us know if you have any questions on this.

Kind Regards,
CSN:Z Team

This good old event is back! From today to February 15th, you can get a reward upon your contribution for destroying Zombie Balloon in game!

[b]HOW[/b]
[*]If you destroy Zombie Balloon, EXP/Points buff will be applied when the match finished.
[*]If you participate in the Zombie Balloon event more than 10 times, you will receive a random amount of Item Duration Extender coupons.

[*]In the Bot original / Bot death match / Bot team death match / Bot Zombie / Original League mode / Zombie Team League mode, there will be no Zombie Balloon event.

notes.title: Good-Bye, [NX]BlindFire!
notes.content:
Survivors,

The new year brought a lot of news to CSN:Z, and for sure there will be many more in the future. One of these news involves me personally and considering my role in the CSN:Z Team i think it's right for you, the Community, to be informed in regards of what's going to happen next.

For more than two years i've been part of the CSN:Z project, since well before its Official Release at the end of 2014. We can say i'm one of the members of the original Team that helped in bringing you this version of the game. But time goes by and for me it's the moment to stand aside.

Depending on how much each one of you was personally involved into CSN:Z, its growth so far and the Team behind it, this announcement could come as simply one of the many we posted, or as a drastic change.
But worry not, as my colleagues will make sure you won't see i'm missing. You're bound to see [NX]Flow, [NX]Lazy and [NX]Stincky way more often in the main forum of this Community Hub starting from February.

However, i'm not leaving without a blast of some sort. 

In the past weeks i've been pushing specifically for certain points of the endless amount of feedback you shared in the Community Hub and, while i'm unable to give you certain dates, i can reassure you many "big things" are (finally) coming. You'll see what i mean when the time comes. I won't be here to witness your reaction, not officially at least, but consider them also as my parting gift to all of you.

Always remember your feedback is valuable. The famous "Suggestions List" counts more than 900 entries as you're reading this. There are boundaries to what can be done and what can not, but that doesn't mean your ideas are not appropriately discussed by our Developers.

A little side note: many of you are aware of me hosting weekly co-op runs in Zombie Scenario mode to have some fun together. Logically, that will no longer be possible.

Enjoy the CSN:Z experience, Survivors.
Do not let the Zombies get you!

Best Regards,
[NX]BlindFire

notes.content:
[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/12/EN-Special-1029x346.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Unveil The Forces Behind The Terrorist Group And Return Safely![/b][/h1]

The world is in chaos because of terrorism and zombies. The Intelligence Agency doubts the relationship between the Asian Red Army and the zombies so they send Ji Yoon Choi to infiltrate the Asian Red Army. However after a while, the AI loses contact with Ji Yoon Choi....

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2017/01/0111_ZS6-1-724x1024.jpg[/img]

In this chapter, Ji Yoon Choi is chasing a possible terrorist leader and Ritsuka and Mei are chasing Ji Yoon Choi for different purposes. Unveil the forces behind the terrorist group and return safely!

[h1][b]Zombie Scenario Season 6-1 Update Event Part 1![/b][/h1]

During the event period, you can get double EXP and points in the Zombie Scenario mode!

[b]WHEN[/b]
[*]From January 11th to February 15th.
[/list]
[b]REWARD[/b]
[*]Double EXP and Points.
[/list]
[b]HOW[/b]
[*]Play Zombie Scenario mode!
[/list]
[h1][b]Zombie Scenario Season 6-1 Update Event Part 2![/b][/h1]

Clear Zombie Scenario Season 6-1 with [Hard-6] difficulty or higher and get your rewards!

[b]WHEN[/b]
[*]From January 11th to February 15th.
[/list]
[b]REWARD[/b]
[*]100,000 points
[/list]
[b]HOW[/b]
[*]Play Zombie Scenario Season 6-1 with [Hard-6] difficulty or higher.
[*]Play with at least 4 or more players together in the same room.
[*]You can get the reward only once during the event period.
[*]You have to play at least 3 or more minutes otherwise you are not eligible to get a reward.
[/list]

notes.title: Get your FREE Mileage Decoders and Finding Zombie Event!
notes.content:
[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/05/CSNZ_GenericBanners_SP_1029x346_EN_Thib007-1029x346.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Get Your FREE Mileage Decoders! (Peak Time Event)[/b][/h1]

Sadly, Transcendence Piece event has completed. However, there is a very good chance to get your mileage decoders for free. Stack up your free mileage decoders and consume them when the time comes along.

[b]REWARD[/b]
[*]3 Mileage Decoders
[/list]

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/10/1005_02_IMD.png[/img]

[b]HOW[/b]
[*]Connect to the game between 16:00 – 18:00 (CET) and play CSN:Z for at least 110 minutes.
[/list]
[b]DETAIL[/b]
[*]You will have a reward if you connect to the game from 16:00 to 18:00 and play CSN:Z for at least 110 minutes until 23:59:59 on the same day.
[*]If you are not connect to the game from 16:00 to 18:00 but played CSN:Z for 110 minutes or more, you will not be deemed as a winner of this event.
[*]Even if you connect to the game from 16:00 to 18:00 but didn't play CSN:Z for at least 110 minutes, you will also not be deemed as a winner of this event.
[/list]
[h1][b]Finding Zombie Event![/b][/h1]

Where’s your ammunition? Your ammunition is vital for combat so please get your ammunition over here!

[b]REWARD[/b]
[*]A reward item will be randomly selected in the box and will be given to you.
[/list]
[b]BOX[/b]
[*]Grade 1 – 4 Bronze Box
[*]Grade 1 – 4 Silver Box
[*]Grade 1 – 4 Gold Box
[*]High Class Gold Box
[/list]
[b]HOW[/b]
[*]You can participate in this event through an event button at the bottom of the screen.
[*]If you found a zombie, your reward level will increase +1 and you can shoot again if you have another bullet.
[*]If you found a human, your reward level will decrease -1 and it will be finished.
[*]If you give up the event, you will acquire current the reward and it will be finished.
[*]If you acquire the reward, your event status will be reset.
[/list]
Let’s enjoy this event and get the boxes!!!

Kind Regards,
CSN:Z Team

notes.content:
[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/05/CSNZ_GenericBanners_SP_1029x346_EN_Thib007-1029x346.jpg[/img]

What will come in this week? Let’s check this out![/b][/h1]

[h1][b]Transcendence Piece Event Is Finally Coming Back![/b][/h1]

Well, well, well… finally the time has come. Yes, we are going to have year-end Transcendence piece event. I think this will be the last opportunity to get your transcendence weapon in this year.

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/12/1207_TR_Weapons.png[/img]

[b]WHEN[/b]
[*]From December 7th to December 21st.
[/list]

[b]HOW CAN I GET TRANSCENDENCE PIECES?[/b]
[*]During the event period, a transcendence piece will appear at random from Mileage Decoders.
[*]During the event period, you will get 1 transcendence piece when you log in to the game. (Only once per day.)
[*]During the event period, you will get 1 transcendence piece every 30 minutes. (Max 4 pieces per day.)
[/list]
[b]HOW TO USE TRANSCENDENCE PIECES?[/b]
[*]If you get more than 888 transcendence pieces, you can select M4A1 Dark Knight or AK47 Paladin when you use transcendence pieces.
[/list]
[b]WAIT! WHAT ARE THE TRANSCENDENCE WEAPONS?[/b]
[*]Super strong power is being applied for the AK47 and M4A1.
[*]If you get this item in your inventory, additional EXP will be applied.
[/list]

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/12/1207_TR_Weapons2.png[/img]

[b]ANYTHING ELSE THAT I MUST KNOW?[/b]
[*]After the event period, all transcendence pieces will be removed.
[*]Please secure enough inventory spaces for smooth item injection.
[*]After the event period, remaining transcendence pieces will be replaced with the other items based upon your remaining transcendence pieces amount. (Please see below table)
[*]Even if you have more than 800 transcendence pieces, you will get a same reward items as those who have 800 transcendence pieces.
[/list]
[table]
[tr]
[th][h1][i]Number of Transcendence Piece(s)[/i][/h1][/th]
[th][h1][i]Replaceable items[/i][/h1][/th]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td]1 - 100[/td]
[td]50 x Item duration extender coupon + 1 x 72 day-Permanent Durable + 1 x Random S-Grade Blueprint.[/td][/tr]
[tr]
[td]101 - 200[/td]
[td]150 x Item duration extender coupon + 2 x 72 day-Permanent Durable + 2 x Random S-Grade Blueprint.[/td][/tr]
[tr]
[td]201 - 300[/td]
[td]250 x Item duration extender coupon + 3 x 72 day-Permanent Durable + 3 x Random S-Grade Blueprint.[/td][/tr]
[tr]
[td]301 - 400[/td]
[td]350 x Item duration extender coupon + 4 x 72 day-Permanent Durable + 4 x Random S-Grade Blueprint.[/td][/tr]
[tr]
[td]401 - 500[/td]
[td]450 x Item duration extender coupon + 5 x 72 day-Permanent Durable + 5 x Random S-Grade Blueprint.[/td][/tr]

notes.title: New Dedicated South American And Turkish Server. (BR/PT/TR)
notes.content:
[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/05/CSNZ_GenericBanners_N_1029x346_EN_Thib007-1029x346.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]New Dedicated South American And Turkish Server[/b][/h1]

Survivors,

We have been listening to your opinion for a long time and we acknowledge that some of our South American and Turkish players are experiencing lags and frame dropping issues these days.

After careful consideration, we made a decision to launch a high-end dedicated server for smoother gaming and to accommodating the fast growing number of South American and Turkish players.

[b][u]WHAT’S SO SPECIAL ABOUT THIS DEDICATED SERVER?[/u][/b]

If you are into gaming on your computer in the South America or Turkey region, then you have probably dealt with the frustration of trying to play Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies on a slow connection. Few things in life are more frustrating than playing one of your favorite games poorly as a result of a bad connection, lag, or other connectivity issues.

As such, we decided to launch our new dedicated server for you.

This dedicated server allows you to have a dedicated, reliable connection that you can use outside of your home internet connection for gaming without lag or connectivity problems.

[b][u]WHEN WILL THE DEDICATED SERVER BE AVAILABLE?[/u][/b]

It will be available on December 7.

[b][u]PLAY COUNTER-STRIKE NEXON: ZOMBIES, MUCH FASTER THAN BEFORE.[/u][/b]

We are going to closely manage this dedicated server at first, which will allow us to check South American and Turkish player’s network environment and the ongoing connectivity issue.

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/273110/discussions/0/152390648075393879/]Visit Forum.[/url]

Here’s the thing that you should know:
[*]This dedicated server will provide 3-months of servicing period.
[*]Connection speed will vary upon your connected area or region.
[*]We will make a post in the discussion section where you can leave a comment for the dedicated server.
: Your Steam account.
: Connected area or region. Ex) Vila Birigui, Rondonópolis, Brazil
: Average FPS.
: Average Ping.
: Broadband or Wireless. Ex) 100 bps Wired Fiber Cable connection.
: Comment. Ex) When the match finished, frame dropped significantly.
[*]Your feedback and comments will be so helpful in improving your ongoing connectivity issue.
[/list]
During this testing period, your feedback would be helpful for us to provide higher quality service.

Hope to see you in a game more often.

Kind regards,
CSN:Z Team

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/05/CSNZ_GenericBanners_N_1029x346_ES_Thib007-1029x346.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Nuevos Servidores Dedicados En Sudamérica Y Turquía.[/b][/h1]

Sobrevivientes:

Hemos estado escuchando sus opiniones desde hace mucho tiempo y reconocimos que algunos de nuestros jugadores sudamericanos y turcos están experimentando retrasos y pérdida de frames últimamente.

Después de considerarlo cuidadosamente, hemos tomado la decisión de poner en marcha un servidor dedicado de alta gama para hacer que el juego sea más rápido y acomodar al gran número de jugadores sudamericanos y turcos que va en crecimiento.

[b][u]¿QUÉ TIENE DE ESPECIAL ESTE SERVIDOR DEDICADO?[/u][/b]

Si estás en juego en tu computadora en la región de Sur América o Turquía, entonces es probable que hayas tenido que lidiar con la frustración de tratar de jugar Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies en una conexión lenta. Pocas cosas en la vida son más frustrantes que jugar uno de tus juegos favoritos con deficiencias a causa de una mala conexión, retraso (lag) u otros problemas de conectividad.

notes.title: Who Stands Last?
notes.content:
[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/05/CSNZ_GenericBanners_SP_1029x346_EN_Thib007-1029x346.jpg[/img]

Survivors,

Please check this out. As you know, we have updated Zombie Shelter mode and now it’s mission time.

That’s the only thing you have to do in this event period.

[*]10 Accumulated surviving days: Normal Enhancement Material. X 10
[*]20 Accumulated surviving days: Normal Enhancement Material. X 20
[*]30 Accumulated surviving days: Special Enhancement Material. X 1
[*]50 Accumulated surviving days: Special Enhancement Material. X 5
[*]100 Accumulated surviving days: Special Enhancement Material. X 10
[/list]
[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/11/1123_Image_01-1.png[/img]

[b]WHEN[/b]
[*]November 23rd to December 7th.
[/list]
[b]DETAIL[/b]
[*]During the event period, your surviving day(s) will be accumulated and you can participate in this event only once.
[*]If you successfully finish this event, reward items will be injected to your account immediately.
[*]If your inventory is full, your reward might not be properly injected, therefore please check your inventory before you participate in the event.
[/list]
Kind regards,
CSN:Z Team

notes.title: [WINNERS] [NX]BlindFire's Halloween Killing Spree!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/924813710d1822448c4697c8e31e8f6f03f4d694.jpg[/img]

Survivors,

Thank you all, once again, for joining this special Event! 
Running around with a chainsaw was exceptionally fun and helped me recover from eating all of those candies (the CSN:Z Team is still mad at me).

Today, rewards were injected to the winners according to the goal scored in the various Event Rooms.
Let's have a short recap:

[quote]
[h1][b]REWARDS[/b][/h1]

All players in the Event Room will be eligible for a reward based on the total amount of kills scored by [NX]BlindFire by the end of that round, with 100 kills as the best possible result: 

[list]
[*]0-99 Kills: No Reward 
[*]100 Kills: 1x Transcendence Decoder + 3x Mileage Coupon (500 Points) 
[*]101-103 Kills: 2x Mileage Coupon (500 Points) 
[*]104-110 Kills: 1x Mileage Coupon (500 Points) 
[*]111+ Kills: No Reward
[/list]
[/quote]
Source: 
http://steamcommunity.com/games/273110/announcements/detail/527312601037148997
Congratulations, Survivors!
You should find your Mileage Coupon(s) waiting for you as soon as you log in.

[b]A special note for those who managed to score the "100 Kills" Goal:[/b] you'll be able to use your Transcendence Decoder as soon as they'll be made available in-game again.
This is, unfortunately, a side effect of their time-limited availability in the in-game Shop, but worry not: your Transcendence Decoder will patiently sit in your inventory until that moment.

Last, but not least, an important reminder that could be cause of some confusion otherwise: some of you could be expecting a reward that never came.
The cause is most likely the following:

[quote]
[h1][b]RESTRICTIONS[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Users are allowed to join the Event Room (regardless of it being successful or not) only 1 time during the whole Event period. This is needed to let as many players as possible experience the Event. 
[*]If you join the Event Room more than once, you won't get any reward at all, even if you won one or more rounds. Be aware.
[/list]
[/quote]
Source: 
http://steamcommunity.com/games/273110/announcements/detail/527312601037148997
I'm sorry to say that, no matter my warnings and notices in-game, various users tried to sneak inside the Event Room more than once, and some of them managed to. 
This resulted in those specific users losing all of the rewards earned during the Event.


Best Regards,
[NX]BlindFire

notes.title: New Perfect Pick Recipe Set: HK-121 & CROW-9.
notes.content:
[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/05/CSNZ_GenericBanners_NAV_1029x346_EN_Thib007-1029x346.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Perfect Pick Recipe: HK-121[/b][/h1]

HK-121 is a general-purpose machine gun in Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies. Introduced in 2010, this is a Germany GPMG fed with 120 rounds of 7.62 NATO. It is equipped with a low power lens scope for middle range engagement. It has an upgraded variant that can be obtained through Upgrade Event.

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/11/1109_HK121_CHA.png[/img]

[b]WHEN[/b]
[*]From November 9 to November 23.
[/list]
This weapon can be upgraded to HK-121 Custom. Do you want to upgrade this weapon? Read this!

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/273110/announcements/detail/338162230919064976]How to upgrade my HK-121 to HK-121 Custom version?[/url]

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/11/1109_HKCUS.png[/img]

[h1][b]Perfect Pick Recipe: CROW-9[/b][/h1]

A special gauntlet served as the melee weapon with a strong destructive power. Secondary mode centered in the middle of the gauge CROW Reload System operation during attacks by right-clicking produces knocking them back during the attack of the zombies with a powerful destructive force to the front.

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/11/1109_CROW9_CHA.png[/img]

[b]WHEN[/b]
[*]From November 9 to November 23.
[/list]
Kind Regards,
CSN:Z Team

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/05/CSNZ_GenericBanners_NAV_1029x346_EN_Thib007-1029x346.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Perfect Pick Recipe: HK-121[/b][/h1]

HK-121 is a general-purpose machine gun in Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies. Introduced in 2010, this is a Germany GPMG fed with 120 rounds of 7.62 NATO. It is equipped with a low power lens scope for middle range engagement. It has an upgraded variant that can be obtained through Upgrade Event.

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/11/1109_HK121_CHA.png[/img]

[b]WHEN[/b]
[*]From November 9 to November 23.
[/list]
This weapon can be upgraded to HK-121 Custom. Do you want to upgrade this weapon? Read this!

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/273110/announcements/detail/338162230919064976]How to upgrade my HK-121 to HK-121 Custom version?[/url]

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/11/1109_HKCUS.png[/img]

[h1][b]Perfect Pick Recipe: CROW-9[/b][/h1]

A special gauntlet served as the melee weapon with a strong destructive power. Secondary mode centered in the middle of the gauge CROW Reload System operation during attacks by right-clicking produces knocking them back during the attack of the zombies with a powerful destructive force to the front.

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/11/1109_CROW9_CHA.png[/img]

[b]WHEN[/b]
[*]From November 9 to November 23.
[/list]
Kind Regards,
CSN:Z Team

notes.title: Weapon Securing Event / Bingo All Clean Event / Experiencing High-Class Weapons!
notes.content:
[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/05/CSNZ_GenericBanners_SP_1029x346_EN_Thib007-1029x346.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Bingo All Clean Event.[/b][/h1]

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/11/1109_CameraGun.png[/img]

[b]REWARD[/b]
[*]Lightning HMG-1 (a.k.a “Camera Gun”)
[/list]
[b]WHEN[/b]
[*]November 9 to November 23.
[/list]
[b]DETAIL[/b]
[*]During the event, you can reset your event only once.
[*]When you reset your event, your Bingo plate will be reset and Bingo clear reward will be changed to “Lightning HMG-1”.
[*]During the event period, clearing reward will be changed per day for free during the event period.
[/list]
[h1][b]Secure The Weapon For Fighting Against Zombies![/b][/h1]

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/11/1109_HK121_3D_CUSTOM.png[/img]

[b]REWARD[/b]
[*]HK-121 Custom (Permanent)
[/list]
[b]WHEN[/b]
[*]November 9 to November 23.
[/list]
[b]HOW[/b]
[*]Earn 5,000 kill points through HK-121.
[/list]
[b]DETAIL[/b]
[*]Only HK-121 original version holders can participate in this event.
[*]If you do not have enough space in your item inventory, items will not be properly delivered.
[*]Please check your item inventory before you participate in this event.
[*]This event will be applied if at least 4 or more players are in the same room.
[*]During the event period, you can upgrade your weapon only once.
[/list]
[h1][b]Experience! High-Class Weapons![/b][/h1]

[b]WHEN[/b]
[*]November 9 to December 7.
[/list]
[b]HOW[/b]
[*]Play [‘Gun Deathmatch’ mode] in ‘Bunny Yard’ or ‘Parking Lot’ map.
[/list]
[b]DETAIL[/b]
[*]Find 5 High-Class weapons in a random place when the round starts and make a big triumph!
[*]You'll earn High-Class weapons by scoring kills.
[*]If you are abusing any bugs in this mode or any benefits through bugs and hacks, you will be punished according to rules and regulations.
[/list]
Kind regards,
CSN:Z Team

notes.title: [ISSUE] SERVER INSTABILITY (November 3rd, 2016)
notes.content:
[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/05/CSNZ_GenericBanners_N_1029x346_EN_Thib007.jpg[/img]

Survivors,

As some of you may have noticed, our game servers experienced instability issues as of today's afternoon (CET) and they still are.

[h1][b]ISSUE[/b][/h1]

As you're reading this, while at first glance it would seem like the cause of it could be related to an issue with the Steam Network, we're carefully and constantly monitoring the situation on our end as well in order to be able to provide a solution.

[H1][B]THANK YOU FOR YOUR DEEP UNDERSTANDING.[/B][/H1]

In the meanwhile, we thank you for your patience and understanding, and we trust in your cooperation until the issue is finally solved.

Kind Regards,
CSN:Z Team

notes.title: GM EVENT: [NX]BlindFire's Halloween Killing Spree!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/924813710d1822448c4697c8e31e8f6f03f4d694.jpg[/img]

Survivors,

He has been quiet for a while now, but turns out [NX]BlindFire started doing “Trick or Treat” with the whole CSN:Z Team in his own way: sneaking around stealing candies.

As he had the brilliant idea of eating them all without asking, he's now on a strange mood. He seems full of energy but way too much, to be honest, to the point that he's not feeling too well.

Survivors, you have to help him! On his way out he stole quite the supplies from Henry's storage, so you can expect sweet rewards if you succeed!

However, he's extremely unstable... Oh, and he got a chainsaw.

[h1][b]WHEN[/b][/h1]
[*]November 1, 2 and 3 from 3:40pm to 5:00pm CET in the EU Server. 
[/list]

[h1][b]HOW[/b][/h1]
[*]Channel and Room Number will be announced via in-game notice and will be switched after each round.
[*]Event will take place in Deathmatch Mode on „Large” maps only (max 32 players each round)
[*][NX]BlindFire is immortal and will only use a chainsaw, however there are no weapons restrictions for users. 
[*]Time limit is 10 minutes per round (120 kills max).
[*]Round is valid if [NX]BlindFire is present in the room from start to finish.
[/list]

[h1][b]YOUR GOAL[/b][/h1]
[*]Help [NX]BlindFire reaching at least 100 kills before the end of the round. Teamwork is essential!
[*]If [NX]BlindFire exceeds 100 kills, your reward will sharply decrease (round automatically ends if [NX]BlindFire reaches 120 kills)
[*]You can check [NX]BlindFire's current kill count by either holding Tab or by checking the interface at the top of your screen (he's most likely going to be the top killer in the room, let's be honest)
[*]When reaching respectively 50 and 100 kills, [NX]BlindFire will completely stop for 20 seconds each time to help with the flow of the Event.
[*]When reaching respectively 103 and 110 kills, [NX]BlindFire will completely stop for 10 seconds each time to help further with the flow of the Event.
[*]It's up to you all to ensure he doesn't score kills too fast... or too slow. How? The easiest way is attempting to avoid/steal kills from him, or go suicidal and get killed on purpose.
[/list]

[h1][b]RESTRICTIONS[/b][/h1]
[*]Users are allowed to join the Event Room (regardless of it being successful or not) only 1 time during the whole Event period. This is needed to let as many players as possible experience the Event.
[*]If you join the Event Room more than once, you won't get any reward at all, even if you won one or more rounds. Be aware.
[/list]

[h1][b]REWARDS[/b][/h1]

All players in the Event Room will be eligible for a reward based on the total amount of kills scored by [NX]BlindFire by the end of that round, with 100 kills as the best possible result:

[*]0-99 Kills: No Reward
[*]100 Kills: 1x Transcendence Decoder + 3x Mileage Coupon (500 Points)
[*]101-103 Kills: 2x Mileage Coupon (500 Points)
[*]104-110 Kills: 1x Mileage Coupon (500 Points)
[*]111+ Kills: No Reward
[/list]
[h1][b]ANNOUNCEMENT[/b][/h1]
[*]Winners will get their rewards on November 9th after the Maintenance!
[/list]
Kind Regards, 
CSN:Z Team

You know about this item already. We removed this item in order to have a sound gaming environment last week. You will see this item as a perfect pick recipe today.

[h1][b]New Map: Rest[/b][/h1]

Rest is a map designed and released exclusive to Zombie 3: Origin but is also available in other Zombie Mods. This map takes place in an ancient graveyard with tombs.

[h1][b]30% Discount Coupon For Costume Box Items.[/b][/h1]

It’s time to make up your characters! Add some tails and put some hats on your head.

[h1][b]Exciting Zombie Scenario (Revenge)[/b][/h1]

Let’s play in the new Zombie Scenario revenge map. There will be adjusted rules and regulations. Enjoy unstoppable ammunition and improved movement speed there!

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/273110/announcements/detail/527312139202218397]Click here for more information.[/url]

[h1][b]Injecting Removed Vulcanus-3.[/b][/h1]

As you know, today is the day we will inject your Vulcanus-3 back that was removed from your inventory last week. We are giving it back to your account. After today’s maintenance, you will see your removed Vulcanus-3 in your storage. Thanks for your understanding.

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/10/1026_Vulacnus-3_PPR_02.png[/img]

There’s a matchmaking/quick launch button in the lobby (greener one) it hadn’t been working for some tme. Last week, we have fixed this button and it now works.

Kind Regards,
CSN:Z Team

notes.title: The Vulcanus-3: Trick or Treat?
notes.content:
[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/05/CSNZ_GenericBanners_NAV_1029x346_EN_Thib007-1029x346.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]The Vulcanus-3: trick or treat? Pre-experiencing the Vulcanus-3 before its official release![/b][/h1]

Dear Survivors,

Some of you noticed it already, some others didn't: Vulcanus-3 was added to Blueprints Grade-1 with the latest update.

Usually, the release of similar weapons is announced with the introduction of a Perfect Pick Recipe Set to let you get your hands on them as soon as possible but for this once we wanted to give you, literally, a chance to experience the newest member of the Vulcanus series before its "official" release, in the most classic crafting way!

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/temp/2016/vulcanus3.png[/img]

We're confident that the little thrill of surprise for getting the Vulcanus-3 was worth it, for those lucky ones who already got it!

But do not despair: for those who don't want to try their luck, the Vulcanus-3 Perfect Pick Recipe is due to come in the near future!


Best Regards,
The CSN:Z Team

notes.title: Old And Classic Weapon Remastered And The Other Events.
notes.content:
[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/05/CSNZ_GenericBanners_SP_1029x346_EN_Thib007-1029x346.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Remastered Classic Weapons.[/b][/h1]

Some of the players are underestimating our old classic weapons. Our top-notch gunsmith has remastered some good, classic weapons.

[b]WHAT[/b]
[*]AK-47: Damage is increased in Zombie Mode and Zombie Scenario.
[*]M4A1: Damage is increased in Zombie Mode and Zombie Scenario.
[*]AWP: Damage is increased in Zombie Mode and Zombie Scenario.
[*]XM1014: Damage is increased in Zombie Mode and Zombie Scenario.
[/list]
[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/10/1012_02_CWP.png[/img]

[h1][b]100,000 Zombie Kills Event.[/b][/h1]

In the past, we have had a similar event, but that event was not only for you, but also for every member of the Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies. This time, you make your own achievement!

[b]REWARDS[/b]
[*]30 x Item Duration Extender Coupon
[*]Rewards will be injected automatically when your zombie kill count reaches 100,000.
[/list]
[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/10/1012_03_IDE.png[/img]

[b]GOAL[/b]
[*]Kill 100,000 Zombies by yourself.
[/list]
[b]WHEN[/b]
[*]From October 12th to November 2nd.
[/list]
[h1][b]Zombie DNA Update.[/b][/h1]

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/1_en.jpg[/img]

We have still another update for Zombies. We have added and removed a couple of skills and abilities from Zombies. Let’s check this out now!

[u]Banshee Zombie[/u]
[*]Rigidity and knockback resistance have been slightly increased.
[*]The moving speed has been slightly decreased.
[*]Pulling skill changes:
[*]This skill changes Banshee zombie's status to damaged immunity status.
[*]The skill makes the bat fly straight and passes allies.
[*]When the character aims at the target, this skill pulls all enemies around the target.
[*]According to the evolution level, the skill speed and skill range are increased.
[/list]
[u]Psycho Zombie[/u]
[*]The skill is changed to 'smoke screen.'
[*]Smoke screen skill changes:
[*]The skill effect is changed and smoke screen duration time has been reduced.
[*]The zombie's damage rate from humans will be reduced when the zombie is in the smoke screen.
[*]When skill is over, the Psycho Zombie's HP recovers as much as the amount of absorbed damage in the smoke screen.
[*]When the character uses smoke screen on the same location again, the higher damage reduction rate will be applied.
[*]According to the evolution level, the skill's damage reduction rate and smoke screen area will be applied differently.
[/list]
[u]Host zombie spawn rule changes[/u]
[*]Before the game starts, it will inform the character that he/she will change to a host zombie in the game.
[*]The character can change to a host zombie whenever he/she wants by pressing the E key. The character will not change to a host zombie right away when the game starts.
[*]When the character doesn't change to host zombie, it will change by force.
[*]Even if the host zombie infects another host (human status), it will not be counted in the points.
[/list]
[u]Charging condition changes[/u]
[*]The maximum charging rate that can be obtained by zombie kill is reduced to +40% from +100%. (+10% increases every 1 kill)
[*]When there is a human around, the rising rate of maximum charging rate is increased from +60% to +120%.
[*]The charging rate whenever a human joins the group is increased to +10% from +5%.
[/list]
[u]Primary weapon[/u]
[*]Four kinds of hero weapon damages are increased.
[*]4 kinds of sidekick weapon damages are increased.
[/list]
[u]Secondary weapon[/u]
[*]The damage of secondary weapon 1 for hero / sidekick is increased.
[/list]
[i]Note: Some of the old weapon's zombie targeting damage will be increased to balance the human vs zombie.[/i]

[u]Zombie assist score and ribbon[/u]
[*]When a zombie failed to infect a human but helped other zombies, this will give the zombie +1 assist point and a ribbon.
[*]Tis but a Zombie Bomb ribbon: The human gets infected within 4 sec. due to zombie bomb x 15 times (Give +1 assist point whenever the character achieves 1 time).
[*]Tanker Ribbon : Gets 3,000 damage from human x30 (Give +1 assist point whenever the character achieves 1 time).
[/list]
[h1][b]GP Decoder Event.[/b][/h1]

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/10/1005_02_IMD.png[/img]

The beloved GP Decoder event is back! You can purchase GP Decoder from the shop with your GP.

[b]WHEN[/b]
