notes.title: Old And Classic Weapon Remastered And The Other Events.
notes.content:
[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/05/CSNZ_GenericBanners_SP_1029x346_EN_Thib007-1029x346.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Remastered Classic Weapons.[/b][/h1]

Some of the players are underestimating our old classic weapons. Our top-notch gunsmith has remastered some good, classic weapons.

[b]WHAT[/b]
[*]AK-47: Damage is increased in Zombie Mode and Zombie Scenario.
[*]M4A1: Damage is increased in Zombie Mode and Zombie Scenario.
[*]AWP: Damage is increased in Zombie Mode and Zombie Scenario.
[*]XM1014: Damage is increased in Zombie Mode and Zombie Scenario.
[/list]
[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/10/1012_02_CWP.png[/img]

[h1][b]100,000 Zombie Kills Event.[/b][/h1]

In the past, we have had a similar event, but that event was not only for you, but also for every member of the Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies. This time, you make your own achievement!

[b]REWARDS[/b]
[*]30 x Item Duration Extender Coupon
[*]Rewards will be injected automatically when your zombie kill count reaches 100,000.
[/list]
[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/10/1012_03_IDE.png[/img]

[b]GOAL[/b]
[*]Kill 100,000 Zombies by yourself.
[/list]
[b]WHEN[/b]
[*]From October 12th to November 2nd.
[/list]
[h1][b]Zombie DNA Update.[/b][/h1]

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/1_en.jpg[/img]

We have still another update for Zombies. We have added and removed a couple of skills and abilities from Zombies. Let’s check this out now!

[u]Banshee Zombie[/u]
[*]Rigidity and knockback resistance have been slightly increased.
[*]The moving speed has been slightly decreased.
[*]Pulling skill changes:
[*]This skill changes Banshee zombie's status to damaged immunity status.
[*]The skill makes the bat fly straight and passes allies.
[*]When the character aims at the target, this skill pulls all enemies around the target.
[*]According to the evolution level, the skill speed and skill range are increased.
[/list]
[u]Psycho Zombie[/u]
[*]The skill is changed to 'smoke screen.'
[*]Smoke screen skill changes:
[*]The skill effect is changed and smoke screen duration time has been reduced.
[*]The zombie's damage rate from humans will be reduced when the zombie is in the smoke screen.
[*]When skill is over, the Psycho Zombie's HP recovers as much as the amount of absorbed damage in the smoke screen.
[*]When the character uses smoke screen on the same location again, the higher damage reduction rate will be applied.
[*]According to the evolution level, the skill's damage reduction rate and smoke screen area will be applied differently.
[/list]
[u]Host zombie spawn rule changes[/u]
[*]Before the game starts, it will inform the character that he/she will change to a host zombie in the game.
[*]The character can change to a host zombie whenever he/she wants by pressing the E key. The character will not change to a host zombie right away when the game starts.
[*]When the character doesn't change to host zombie, it will change by force.
[*]Even if the host zombie infects another host (human status), it will not be counted in the points.
[/list]
[u]Charging condition changes[/u]
[*]The maximum charging rate that can be obtained by zombie kill is reduced to +40% from +100%. (+10% increases every 1 kill)
[*]When there is a human around, the rising rate of maximum charging rate is increased from +60% to +120%.
[*]The charging rate whenever a human joins the group is increased to +10% from +5%.
[/list]
[u]Primary weapon[/u]
[*]Four kinds of hero weapon damages are increased.
[*]4 kinds of sidekick weapon damages are increased.
[/list]
[u]Secondary weapon[/u]
[*]The damage of secondary weapon 1 for hero / sidekick is increased.
[/list]
[i]Note: Some of the old weapon's zombie targeting damage will be increased to balance the human vs zombie.[/i]

[u]Zombie assist score and ribbon[/u]
[*]When a zombie failed to infect a human but helped other zombies, this will give the zombie +1 assist point and a ribbon.
[*]Tis but a Zombie Bomb ribbon: The human gets infected within 4 sec. due to zombie bomb x 15 times (Give +1 assist point whenever the character achieves 1 time).
[*]Tanker Ribbon : Gets 3,000 damage from human x30 (Give +1 assist point whenever the character achieves 1 time).
[/list]
[h1][b]GP Decoder Event.[/b][/h1]

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/10/1005_02_IMD.png[/img]

The beloved GP Decoder event is back! You can purchase GP Decoder from the shop with your GP.

[b]WHEN[/b]
[*]From October 12th to October 19th.
[/list]
[b]WHAT[/b]
[*]You can acquire GP decoders by exchanging your GP.
[/list]
[b]HOW[/b]
[*]Level 15 – 29: 1 GP decoder with 5,000 GP per day.
[*]Level 30 – 49: 1 GP decoder with 10,000 GP per day.
[*]Level 50 or higher: 1 GP decoder with 15,000 GP per day.
[*]For example, if you are level 50 or higher, 3 GP decoders with 30,000 GP per day in total.
[/list]
Purchase GP decoders will disappear after certain period, so you’d best use any in your inventory before they expire.

Kind regards,
CSN:Z Team

notes.content:
[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/05/CSNZ_GenericBanners_NAV_1029x346_EN_Thib007-1029x346.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Blood on your weapons![/b][/h1]

Finally, it’s time to wrap your weapon! We decided to release the ‘Blood’ weapon paint starting today.

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/09/0921_Blood_On_Your_Weapons-2.png[/img]

[b]WHAT[/b]
[*]Player can paint the selected weapons with Blood paint.
[*]SKULL-1, SKULL-3, SKULL-5 can be painted with this item.
[/list]
[h1][b]SKULL-1 Perfect Pick Recipe Set.[/b][/h1]

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/09/0921_SKULL-1_PPR_SET.png[/img]

[b]WHEN[/b]
[*]From September 21st to October 5th.
[/list]

[h1][b]SKULL-3 Perfect Pick Recipe Set.[/b][/h1]

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/09/0921_SKULL-3_PPR_SET.png[/img]

[b]WHEN[/b]
[*]From September 21st to October 5th.
[/list]
[h1][i]Note: Currently, SKULL-3 Perfect Pick Recipe's image in game shop shows 'Blood' covered image but it is SKULL-3 Perfect Pick Recipe without 'Blood' weapon paint. Please be careful when you purchase this item.[/i][/h1]

[h1][b]SKULL-1 Perfect Pick Recipe Set + Blood Weapon Paint.[/b][/h1]

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/09/0921_SKULL-1_PPRBLOOD_SET.png[/img]

[b]WHEN[/b]
[*]From September 21st to October 5th.
[/list]
[b]ELEMENTS[/b]
[*]10 x SKULL-1 Perfect Pick Recipe Set + 1 x Blood Weapon Paint.
[/list]

[h1][b]SKULL-3 Perfect Pick Recipe Set + Blood Weapon Paint.[/b][/h1]

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/09/0921_SKULL-3_PPRBLOOD_SET.png[/img]

[b]WHEN[/b]
[*]From September 21st to October 5.th
[/list]
[b]ELEMENTS[/b]
[*]10 x SKULL-3 Perfect Pick Recipe Set + 1 x Blood Weapon Paint.
[/list]
[h1][b]New Zombie Escape Map.[/b][/h1]

After the zombie virus outbreak, a group of survivors composed of civilians, soldiers, and cops await for a signal in a secluded warehouse in the forest. After confirmation of an extraction team heading to their location, they must proceed to the outskirts of the forest in order to meet the rescue team. However, unwelcome visitors are waiting.

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/09/Rhizome_Grey_Frame-768x461.png[/img]

[b]OBJECTIVE[/b]
[*]Humans: Head to the rendezvous point at the outskirts of the forest within the time limit.
[*]Zombies: Infect all the humans, or get to the extraction point before them.
[/list]
[b]TIPS[/b]
[*]Strafing and Russian walk skills are really recommended to pass some areas quickly, especially the mill part.
[*]AWP-Z is also highly recommended to pass the big waterfall part quickly.
[*]There are several paths leading to the Osprey. Make sure to defend them all to avoid being ambushed by zombies.
[/list]
Kind Regards,
CSN:Z Team

notes.content:
[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/05/CSNZ_GenericBanners_SP_1029x346_EN_Thib007-1029x346.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Division Zombie Hero Event.[/b][/h1]

What is the Division Zombie Hero? You will want to know what will come today.

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/09/Division_Italy.png[/img]

[b]OBJECTIVE[/b]
[*]Human: Survive the zombie attack for the remaining time limit or eliminate all zombies.
[*]Zombie: Infect all remaining humans into zombies.
[/list]
[b]WHAT[/b]
[*]Added ‘Division Italy’ map.
[*] A zombie killed by humans will be resurrected immediately in the place they died and the dead zombie will be divided into two other schizonts.
[*]Players will be divided into bot and player and the divided bot will attack humans like Bot Zombies.
[*]A max of 20 players can play at the same time.
[/list]
[b]TIPS[/b]
[*]At the start, the humans can choose a hero.
[*]Zombies start with their own schizont.
[*]Upon death, you and your schizont divide into two other schizonts.
[*]Can divide up to 2 times, and will die permanently upon its 3rd time.
[*]In the event mode, evolution, stats, medals, and accolades do not get counted.
[/list]
[b]WHEN[/b]
[*]From September 21st to October 12th.
[/list]
Kind regards,
CSN:Z Team

notes.title: Weapon Upgrade Event!
notes.content:
[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/05/CSNZ_GenericBanners_SP_1029x346_EN_Thib007-1029x346.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]How Do You Get The Weapon For The Upgrade Event?[/b][/h1]

You can upgrade three weapons during this event period. However, you will likely have many questions about the event even if you've played it before. Please read carefully to check how you can do this without a problem.

[b]WEAPONS[/b]

[*]Infinity Silver
[*]Dual Infinity
[*]Kriss Super V
[/list]
[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/08/0831_WPUGEVNT.png[/img]

[b]HOW TO GET THE WEAPON?[/b]

[*][b]Infinity Silver:[/b] As you can see, we are giving you a free Infinity Silver for the upgrading event from August 24th to September 14th. It’s free! You can freely upgrade this weapon!
[*][b]Dual Infinity:[/b] You can purchase this weapon August 31st to September 14th as a perfect pick recipe set! Let’s check out the in-game shop!
[*][b]Kriss Super V:[/b] You can get this weapon from Mileage Decoders.
[/list]
[b]WHEN[/b]
[*]From August 31st to September 14th.
[/list]

[b]HOW[/b]
[*]You must play with at least 4 or more players in the same room.
[*]You need 5000 kill points to upgrade Primary Weapons, while only 3000 kill points are needed for Secondary Weapons.
[*][b]Infinity Silver:[/b] In Scenario mode (Human/Zombie), it can be upgraded to Infinity Red by scoring 3000 kills.
[*][b]Infinity Silver:[/b] In Zombie modes (Original/Mutant/Hero/Darkness), it can be upgraded to Infinity Black by scoring 300 kills.
[/list]


Please do not miss this chance and play Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies with free Infinity Silver at least!

Kind regards,
CSN:Z Team

notes.title: NEXT WAVE - GM EVENT COMES BACK ON THE STAGE!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/924813710d1822448c4697c8e31e8f6f03f4d694.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]GM EVENT #1: All against [NX]BlindFire![/b][/h1]

[NX]BlindFire is ready to challenge again the CSN:Z Survivors in a fierce Deathmatch!

[b]WHEN[/b]
[list]
August 18th at 4pm CEST in the EU Server. 
[/list]
[b]HOW[/b]
[list]
[*]Channel will be announced before making the room to allow interested users to gather.
[*]Room will be created shortly after.
[*]Quickly get in the Event Room, available slots are limited!
[*]Room and Channel are switched every round, a total of 3 rounds are hosted.
[*]Event will take place in Deathmatch Mode.
[*]Map will be randomly selected.
[*]There are no Weapons Restrictions.
[*][NX]BlindFire is immortal and has unlimited ammo.
[*]Time limit is 10 minutes per round.
[*]Kill limit is 120 per round.
[*]Max 32 players are allowed in the Event room. (round starts when the room is full)
[*][NX]BlindFire has a headstart of +20 points over the final score to balance the results.
[*]The top 3 users with the highest kill count will see their efforts combined against [NX]BlindFire's total kills +20.
[*]If total kills from top 3 users are more than [NX]BlindFire's kills + 20, the round is won.
[*]Round is valid if [NX]BlindFire is present in the room from start to finish.
[*]The round ends when either the 120 kill limit is reached, or the 10 minutes run out. Depending on which occurs first.
[*]Kill farming, alliances and similar tactics invalidate the ongoing round.
[*]Each user is allowed to join only two rounds of the Event during the same day. If more than 2 Event rounds are joined during the same day, that user won't get any extra reward from them.
[/list]
[b]REWARDS[/b]
[list]
[*]For each round won, all players in the room during that round will get 1 x 500 Mileage Points Coupon!
[/list]
[b]ANNOUNCEMENT[/b]
[list]
[*]Winners will get their rewards on August 31 after the Maintenance!
[/list]

[h1][b]GM EVENT #2: [NX]BlindFire's helping hand![/b][/h1]

[NX]BlindFire joins again the fight to assist the Survivors with the Zombie outbreak! From completing Scenario Maps at the hardest Difficulty to helping with ongoing Events, this time he means business!

[i]NOTE: This is a weekly Event with no set end date. [/i]

[b]WHEN[/b]
[list]
[*]Starting from August 25th, every Thrusday at 4pm CEST on EU servers.
[/list]
[b]HOW[/b]
[list]
[i][b]REGULAR EVENT:[/b][/i]

[*]Channel will be announced before making the room to allow interested users to gather.
[*]Room will be created shortly after.
[*]Event will last approximately 60 minutes.
[*]Slots in the Room are limited.
[*]Event will take place in Zombie Scenario mode on HARD-9 Difficulty.
[*]Maps are selected in a chronological order until time runs out.
[*]After each map completed, the room will be switched.
[*]There are no Weapons Restrictions.
[*][NX]BlindFire is immortal and has unlimited ammo.
[*][NX]BlindFire is a walking arsenal and will distribute powerful weapons to use during the battle.
[*]Users are invited to join only one round of the Event during a given day to allow other users in.
[*]If you already used your Scenario Daily Reward Box for that day on your own, you can still join the Event for a fun run.

[i][b]OPTIONAL EVENT:[/b][/i]
[*]Depending on other ongoing Events, [NX]BlindFire can propose to the survivors little variations to possibly help even further.
[*]Users in the channel/room are free to disagree and proceed with the Regular Event.
[/list]
[i]NOTE: If most of the users agree and the variations include changing difficulty of the match or, even more, switching game mode, it won't be possible to get the Zombie Scenario Daily Reward Box [Hard-9].[/i]

[b]REWARDS[/b]
[list]
[*][b]REGULAR EVENT:[/b] Zombie Scenario Daily Reward Box [Hard-9] x1.
If you already used/upgraded your Scenario Daily Reward Box for that day, you won't get a reward!
[*][b]OPTIONAL EVENT:[/b] No set reward.
[/list]
[b]ANNOUNCEMENT[/b]
[list]
[*][b]REGULAR EVENT:[/b] Users in the room will automatically get the Daily Reward Box [Hard-9] when the match is over. (if entitled to get one for that day)
[*][b]OPTIONAL EVENT:[/b] No set reward.
[/list]
[h1][b]GM EVENT #3: The bigger they are...[/b][/h1]

The harder they fall! ...IF they fall! [NX]BlindFire claims he refined the genetic sample he used to turn Giant Zombies into unstoppable killing machines and is ready to challenge the Survivors again. We thought he went mad, but it's worse than that. Please, stop him!

[b]WHEN[/b]
[list]
[*]August 24th at 4pm CEST in the EU Server.
[/list]
[b]HOW[/b]
[list]
[*]Channel will be announced before making the room to allow interested users to gather.
[*]Room will be created shortly after.
[*]Quickly get in the Event Room, available slots are limited!
[*]Room and Channel are switched every round, a total of 2 rounds are hosted.
[*]Event will take place in Giant Zombie Mode.
[*]Event will take place in the Forsaken map.
[*]There are no Weapons Restrictions.
[*]Time limit is 20 minutes per round.
[*]Score limit is 280 per round.
[*][NX]BlindFire has specific advantages depending on his role:
[*][b]Human:[/b][NX]BlindFire is immortal and has unlimited ammo.
[*][b]Giant Zombie:[/b] [NX]BlindFire is a regular Giant Zombie until evolution to stage 2.
[*]Kill Giant Zombies as they appear, but be aware: if [NX]BlindFire turns into one of them, you'll have to kill him before his inevitable evolution!
[*]If you manage to kill him before he evolves, you scored a valid kill.
[*]If Giant [NX]BlindFire successfully evolves, he will become immortal for 60 seconds and invalidate the kill attempt.
[*]When his immortality runs out, you'll be able to kill him but it won't count toward the goal.
[*]It is possible for [NX]BlindFire to turn into a Giant Zombie multiple times in the same round, so you'll have multiple chances to kill him before his evolution.
[*]The round ends when either the 280 points limit is reached, or the 20 minutes run out. Depending on which occurs first.
[*]Letting others kill you when playing as Giant Zombies to force new Zombie selections will invalidate the ongoing round.
[*]Each user is allowed to join only one round of the Event during the same day. If more than one Event round is joined during the same day, that user won't get any extra reward.
[/list]
[b]REWARDS[/b]
[list]
[*]All players in the Event Room will be rewarded accordingly to the number of valid kills scored on Giant [NX]BlindFire:
[*][b]Tier 1:[/b] at least 1 valid kill = 1x 500 Mileage Points Coupon
[*][b]Tier 2:[/b] 4 or more valid kills = 3x 500 Mileage Points Coupon
[*]Rewards from the two Tiers stack! If you reach Tier 2 you will win a total of 4 Mileage Coupons!
[/list]
[b]ANNOUNCEMENT[/b]
[list]
[*]Winners will get their rewards on August 31 after the Maintenance!
[/list]
Kind Regards, 
CSN:Z Team

notes.title: Weekly Patch Note / August 17, 2016.
notes.content:
[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/05/CSNZ_GenericBanners_WPN_1029x346_EN_Thib007-1029x346.jpg[/img]

Survivors,

We're in the middle of August. However, the temperature is dropping day by day and now we need to start preparing for the winter. Your Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies team is also preparing for autumn and winter content now. When the snow falls, you will see what we have been preparing for.

Check out the full update notes:

notes.title: Improved Transcendence and Mileage Decoders! Plus new Crazy maps!
notes.content:
[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/05/CSNZ_GenericBanners_NAV_1029x346_EN_Thib007-1029x346.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Improved Transcendence Decoders came back![/b][/h1]

We got tons of requests from you guys, and this is what we came up with. We have improved the Transcendence Decoder, and today is the day we introduce it to you! Starting today we have added two more items. The Transcendence Decoder is getting stronger and stronger.

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/08/0810_TD.png[/img]

[b]CHANGES[/b]
[list]
[*]Add new weapons: Crimson Hunter and Chain Grenade.
[/list]

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/08/0810_Crimson.png[/img]
[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/08/0810_CGrenade.png[/img]

[b]WHEN[/b]
[list]
[*]From August 10th to August 31st.
[/list]
[i]Note: Unused Transcendence Decoders will be removed on September 7th and automatically replaced by 5 Item Duration Extenders per every 1 Transcendence Decoder. (For example, if you have 5 unused Transcendence Decoders, they will be gone on September 7th and you will get 25 Item Duration Extenders.)[/i]

[h1][b]Improved Mileage Decoders![/b][/h1]

The Mileage Decoders also got some changes. We thought that this may be way stronger than the Transcendence Decoders, but it is up to you to decide. Tell us what you think about the recent adjustment (or improvement) of the mileage decoder!

[b]CHANGES[/b]
[list]
[*]Remove all 18 painting items from Mileage Decoder.
[*]Add Brick Piece T50 weapon.
[*]Add new weapons from existing DLC.
[*]OZ’s Trio: Tin Man’s Machine Gun, Cowardly Lion’s Pistol, Scarecrow’s Pickaxe
[*]Journey to the West: Zhubajie minigun, Ruyi stick, Sha wujing Dual handgun.
[*]Dragon Pack: AK-47 dragon, M4A1 dragon, Dragon knife
[/list]
[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/08/0810_BrickPieceT50.png[/img]
[b]WHEN[/b]
[list]
[*]From August 10th.
[/list]
[h1][b]New contents: Crazy Zombie Hero![/b][/h1]

Limited duration! We just removed the stress-driven rules and left in the fun parts of the Zombie Hero! Enjoy Crazy Zombie Hero!

[b]WHEN[/b]
[list]
[*]From August 10th to September 7th.
[/list]
[b]WHAT[/b]
[list]
[*]Adjusted new rules will be applied for Zombie Hero mode.
[/list]
[b]HOW[/b]
[list]
[*]HUMAN: will use acquired items and your primary and secondary weapon ammunition will be reloaded automatically.
[*]ZOMBIE: will have faster cooldown time and Zombie bomb will be reloaded automatically.
[*]These rules will be applied to Crazy ITALY and Crazy DUST only. However you can also play original ITALY and DUST.
[*]You can also participate in an event in the Crazy ITALY and Crazy DUST and acquire EXP and Points.
[/list]
[i]Note: Zombie Evolution, Medal, Miniature Medal, Mission, Statistics Accumulation, and league points will not be awarded in the Crazy ITALY and Crazy DUST maps.[/i]

Kind Regards,
CSN:Z Team

How can you get your free Transcendence Decoder during the event period? You can check the conditions here.

[list]

[/list]

[*]If players log in to the game on the 12th and 13th of August, they will get 1 free Transcendence Decoder per day for free.

notes.title: Weekly Patch Note / July 20, 2016.
notes.content:
[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/05/CSNZ_GenericBanners_WPN_1029x346_EN_Thib007-1029x346.jpg[/img]

Survivors,

It’s hot outside. Everything is hot, and so we also want to be hot. Let’s enjoy our hot items and hot events! We hope that you enjoyed last week's exclusive 'Last Flight' map. And now, we have even more excitement coming your way! Kill zombies to get the wing of the infamous 'Crono Wing'!

Check out the full update notes:

[h1][b]Letter Collection Event.[/b][/h1]

Your beloved letter collection event is being prepared! Unveiling rare weapons is always exciting! Let’s participate in our letter collection event and get rare weapons through collecting a letter!

[b]WHEN[/b]
[list]
[*]From July 20th to August 3rd
[/list]
[b]HOW[/b]
[list]
[*]When you kill your enemy, there is a chance for you to get alphabet letters or a Joker.
[*]You will earn 5 Jokers if you attend more than 10 days during the event period.
[*]There is also a chance that you can earn 10 Jokers through Mileage Decoders during the event period.
[*]You can only earn the alphabet letters when there are at least 4 or more players in the game room.
[/list]
[b]REWARD[/b]
[list]
[*]Horse Axe
[*]Serpent Blade
[*]Battle Hunting Dagger
[*]Battle Galil
[*]Battle FAMAS
[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/07/Serpent_HorseAxe.png[/img]
[/list]
[i]Note: Unused Jokers and alphabet letters will be removed from your inventory and the mileage decoders on August 10.[/i]

[h1][b]Coin Event Comes Back On The Stage.[/b][/h1]

During the event period, you can participate in this event, which offers a fancy item through the event result.

[b]WHEN[/b]
[list]
[*]From July 20th to August 3rd
[/list]
[b]HOW[/b]
[list]
[*]When you play 30 minutes in CSN:Z, you can get a coin. (There must be at least 4 players in the same room)
[*]You can earn a maximum of 3 coins and you have to use it continuously. (Otherwise, you are unable to earn the coins)
[/list]
[b]REWARD[/b]
[list]
[*]Supreme Decoder x 10 pcs (3 players)
[*]Mileage Decoder x 50 pcs (5 players)
[*]Mileage Decoder x 30 pcs (10 players)
[*]Costume Box season 2 x 3 pcs (20 players)
[*]Perfect Enhancement Box x 1 pcs (20 players)
[/list]
[h1][b]Double Mileage Chance Event.[/b][/h1]

From today to August 10th, you will earn double mileage when you use a Mileage Decoder. Surely, your happiness becomes double too.

[h1][b]Single Crow-7 Is Now Available.[/b][/h1]

Crow-7 Pre-order pack is unavailable today, but it’s a little early to say you're disappointed. Now you can check out our in-game shop and you will find a single Crow-7 is now opened.

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/07/Crow-7-Now-Available.png[/img]

[h1][b]GM Event Rewards Injected.[/b][/h1]

Did you enjoy our GM event last week? Your GM Event reward has been injected on your account today. Let’s check out your inventory.

[h1][b]GM Event For This Week.[/b][/h1]

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/273110/announcements/]Click here for more info.[/url]

Kind Regards,
CSN:Z Team

notes.title: GM Event For This Week!
notes.content:
[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/05/CSNZ_GenericBanners_SP_1029x346_EN_Thib007-1029x346.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]EVENT #02: [NX]BlindFire's Helping Hand![/b][/h1]

[NX]BlindFire joins the fight against the Zombies to finally uncover the mysteries behind the infection! Stand with him as he pushes through the hardest Zombie Scenario battles and seasons, from the beginning to the inevitable end!

[b]WHEN[/b]
[list]
[*]July 20th and 27th, at 4 PM CEST in the EU Server.
[/list]
[b]HOW[/b]
[list]
[*]Be sure NOT to use/upgrade your Scenario Daily Reward Box if you plan to join!
[*]Quickly get in the notified Room! Available slots are limited!
[*]Win Zombie Scenario Mode on Hard-9 difficulty with the help of [NX]BlindFire!
[*][NX]BlindFire is a valuable ally: he won't die to the zombies!
[*]The Event will last 1 hour, after each completed Scenario map the room will be switched.
[/list]
[i]Note: There are no weapon restrictions and maps are selected in a chronological order.[/i]

[b]REWARDS[/b]
[list]
[*]Zombie Scenario Daily Reward Box [Hard-9] x 1
[*]If you already used/upgraded your Daily Reward Box you won't get a reward!
[/list]
[b]ANNOUNCEMENT[/b]
[list]
[*]Users in the room will automatically get the Daily Reward Box [Hard-9] when the match is over!
[/list]
[h1][b]EVENT #03: The Bigger They Are...[/b][/h1]

The harder they fall! ...IF they fall! [NX]BlindFire has finally found the perfect genetic sample to turn Giant Zombies into unstoppable killing machines! He's gone mad, you have to stop him!

[b]WHEN[/b]
[list]
[*]July 21st and 28th, at 4 PM CEST in the EU Server.
[/list]
[b]HOW[/b]
[list]
[*]A total of 3 rounds will take place and the room will be changed after each one of them.
[*]Quickly get in the notified Room! Available slots are limited!
[*]Kill the players turning into Giant Zombies, but be aware: if [NX]BlindFire turns into a Giant Zombie you'll have to kill him before he manages to evolve!
[*]If giant [NX]BlindFire evolves successfully, he will turn immortal for a set amount of time (60 seconds)!
[*]Kills achieved after his immortality runs out do NOT count toward the goal.
[*]While human, attacks from Giant Zombies won't be able to hurt [NX]BlindFire!
[/list]
[i]Note: A time limit for each round will be applied and there are no weapon restrictions.[/i]

[b]REWARDS[/b]
[list]
[*]If, by the end of the round, the Survivors successfully managed to kill giant [NX]BlindFire before he evolved at least once, all players in the room will get 1 x 500 Mileage Coupon!
[*]If, by the end of the round, the Survivors successfully managed to kill giant [NX]BlindFire before he evolved at least 3 times, all players in the room will get additional 3 x 500 Mileage Coupon!
[/list]
[b]ANNOUNCEMENT[/b]
[list]
[*]Winners will be announced the August 10th, and they'll get the rewards after the maintenance on August 10th.
[/list]
Kind Regards,
CSN:Z Team

notes.title: EVENT RULES UPDATE - All against [NX]BlindFire
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6770740/924813710d1822448c4697c8e31e8f6f03f4d694.jpg[/img]
Dear Survivors,

Yesterday it was the first day of the GM Event "All against [NX]BlindFire" and for as much as we wanted for it to go perfectly smooth, inconvenients happened.

Specifically, the balance of the Event overall was clearly shifted toward our dear GM, preventing users from having a fair chance at winning. This is not what the CSN:Z Team planned: the idea at the base of the Event is that of having an enjoyable and fun experience in a match which sees a GM roaming around killing everyone on sight for a good 10 minutes, while players struggle to get as many kills as possible in order to beat him.

But this proved to be impossible if efforts of the users are not combined as the Event's Title suggests.

Thanks to the tests performed by [NX]BlindFire during the Event itself and the 'unfortunate users' who had to suffer from his uncontrolled killing rampage yesterday, we came up with a better solution.
Please read below for the reviewed Event Rules:

[h1][b] RULES:[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Rounds last 10 minutes each and the kill limit is set at 120, a total of 6 rounds will take place and rooms will be switched every 2 rounds.
[*]EU Channel will be shared before making the actual Event Room in it, to allow all interested users to gather and have a chance to join.
[*]Map will be randomly selected and there will be no weapon restriction.
[*][NX]BlindFire is immortal and has unlimited ammo.
[*]A round is considered completed whenever the 10 minutes run out, or the 120 kills limit has been reached. Depending on which of the two occurs first.
[*]When a round is over, the top 3 players who managed to score the most kills will see their kill counts for that round combined and then compared to that of [NX]BlindFire alone.
[*]If the combined kills are more than the ones scored by [NX]BlindFire, the round is won and all users in the room will get a reward.
[*]If the resulting kills are less than the ones scored by [NX]BlindFire, the round is lost.
[*]Tactics like kill farming or similar are still not tolerated and will completely invalidate the ongoing round as a penalty.
[*][NX]BlindFire's presence is required from start to end in the Match for it to be valid. In case of unexpected technical issues, the ongoing round will be simply restarted.
[/list]
[i][h1]Note: Time/Date of the Event and its rewards are NOT subject to changes.[/h1][/i]
We will keep monitoring the situation and refine even more the Rules in case it's needed.

[h1][b]15th July Note:[/b][/h1]
[i]During today's Event, we'll be performing some more tests to balance it further.
Tests will see the following variables addressed:
[b]- Kill Limit
- Calculation of the win condition[/b]

We do believe that involving you and your performances actively in this process will make us capable of reaching a good level of balance and fairness, turning this into a fun and, possibly, rewarding experience.

As for previous days: all hosted rounds will count as valid in case no technical issues occur! Testing won't invalidate them![/i]


Best Regards,
The CSN:Z Team

notes.title: Have You Played Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies?
notes.content:
Have You Played? is an endless stream of game retrospectives. One a day, every day of the year, perhaps for all time.

If you ever enjoyed digging through Fileplanet or the PC Gamer cover disc, playing every strange little Half-Life or Quake mod you could find, I think you might quite enjoy Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies [Steam page]. No, no hear me out.

Nexon’s free-to-play spin-off takes basic Counter-Strike, throws in a load of zombies, mutants, and ghosts, throws them all in a bag and shakes then pours out a collection of strange and unexpected mod-feeling modes. I’ve spent a fair few hours just poking around and honestly, I swear it’s worth a go.

… [visit site to read more]

notes.title: Upgrade weapons and earn rewards in multiple events!
notes.content:
[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/05/CSNZ_GenericBanners_SP_1029x346_EN_Thib007-1029x346.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]6 Upgradeable weapons![/b][/h1]

We listened to your opinion! The most popular event is back!
Upgrade: Katana, Crossbow, Tactical Knife, Dual Infinity, Spas-12, and Gilboa!

[b]WHEN[/b]
22.06.2016 - 06.07.2016 (For 2 weeks)

[b]HOW[/b]
- Acquire a default weapon from the shop and enter a room with at least 4 players.
- Collect 5,000 kill points for a primary weapon or 3,000 kill points for a secondary weapon and your weapon will become upgraded.
- You can check on your upgrading progress, which is visible in the game chat as you earn points.

[b]REWARDS[/b]
- Katana → Dual Katana (Permanent)
- Crossbow → Crossbow Advance (Permanent)
- Tactical Knife → Double Tactical Knife (Permanent) → Triple Tactical Knife (Permanent)
- Dual Infinity → Dual Infinity Custom (Permanent) → Dual Infinity Final (Permanent)
- Spas-12 → Spas-12 Deluxe (Permanent) → Spas-12 Superior (Permanent)
- Gilboa → Gilboa Viper (Permanent)

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/06/210616_JIRA-2242_notice.png[/img]

[h1][b]Special missions reward.[/b][/h1]

Earn an extra weapon for completing special missions.

[b]WHEN[/b]
22.06.2016 - 06.07.2016 (For 2 weeks)

[b]HOW[/b]
Successfully complete 10 Special missions before the event ends

[b]REWARDS[/b]
Permanent weapon: PJ MK3A1 (Jackhammer)

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/06/1-1.png[/img]

[h1][b]Time Bomb Event.[/b][/h1]

Log in to the game for free decoders and more!

[b]WHEN[/b]
22.06.2016 - 29.06.2016

[b]HOW[/b]
- Log in during the event and receive 1x Time Bomb each day
- When you log in the following day, the safe will open automatically and you will receive a reward item. However, if you don't log in on the following day, the safe will explode and the reward item will disappear.

[b]REWARDS[/b]
One of the following rewards:
-10,000 Game Points
- A-Grade Blueprint x3
- Mileage Decoder x1
- Mileage Decoder x 5
- Mileage Decoder x 10
- Mileage Decoder x 50

[h1][b]Zombie Balloon Event.[/b][/h1]

Shoot down zombie balloons and get rewarded!

[b]WHEN[/b]
22.06.2016 - 13.07.2016

[b]HOW[/b]
Attack or destroy a balloon to participate in the event

[b]REWARDS[/b]
- Destroy Zombie Balloon: receive EXP/Points buff after the match.
* Buff can be applied max 3 times. (Max 300% buff)
- Attack Zombie Balloon 10x in different matches: receive Item Duration Extenders. (Min 1 to Max 5)

[b]NOTE[/b]
- You can get an Item Duration Extender only one time per day and you can participate in the event every day.
- The Zombie Balloon destroy count will be reset at 24:00.
- If you have no inventory space, the item will not be added. Please join this event after you secure enough space in your inventory
- Zombie Balloon will NOT appear in the following modes: Bot Original, Bot Deathmatch, and Bot Team Deathmatch
- Zombie Balloon will appear in the following maps: Italy, Assault, Militia, Estate, Dust, Dust2, and Mouse Hole.

[h1][b]Return of the M/B Box Event.[/b][/h1]

It’s way stronger and way more generous than before.

[b]WHEN[/b]
- S-BOX: 10 / 11 / 12 of June from 00:00 to 24:00 (CEST)
- J-BOX: 17 / 18 / 19 of June from 00:00 to 24:00 (CEST)
- M-Box: 24 / 25 / 26 of June from 00:00 to 24:00 (CEST)
- B-Box: 01 / 02 / 03 of July from 00:00 to 24:00 (CEST)

[b]HOW[/b]
- Play with at least 4 or more players in the same room.

[b]REWARDS[/b]
- 30 min playing: 1 Brand box item.
- 60 min playing: 1 Brand box item.
- In total, you will have 2 brand boxes per day and 6 boxes in total. (Maximum Box count: 6 S-Boxes, 6 J-Boxes, 6 M-Boxes and 6 B-Boxes)

notes.title: Weekly Patch Note 15.06.2016
notes.content:
[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/05/CSNZ_GenericBanners_WPN_1029x346_EN_Thib007-1029x346.jpg[/img]

Survivors,

This week’s patch is a special one as we prepared the biggest update in a while.

Get ready to check this expansion’s new powerful zombies, additional map, greatest weapon-giveaway of all time, plenty of other events, new crafting weapons, and DLC Bundle!

Check out the full update notes:

[h1][b]Hero Zombie Update[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]2 New strong zombies released for Zombie Hero mode: male and female
[*]Metatronic zombie with 2 skills: Immortality and HP Buff
[/list]

[table]
[tr]
[th][h1][i]Icon[/i][/h1][/th]
[th][h1][i]Name[/i][/h1][/th]
[th][h1][i]Description[/i][/h1][/th]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td][img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/06/Immortality_Meta.png[/img][/td]
[td][h1]Immortality[/h1][/td]
[td]If your HP drops to a certain amount, you will be invulnerable for 5 seconds.[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td][img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/06/HP_Buff_Meta.png[/img][/td]
[td][h1]HP Buff[/h1][/td]
[td]Bestows 2000 extra health points for itself and nearby zombies for 8 seconds.[/td][/tr][/table]
[list]
[*]Lilith zombie with 2 skills: Teleport and HP Buff
[/list]
[table]
[tr]
[th][h1][i]Icon[/i][/h1][/th]
[th][h1][i]Name[/i][/h1][/th]
[th][h1][i]Description[/i][/h1][/th]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td][img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/06/Teleport_01_Lilith.png[/img][img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/06/Teleport_02_Lilith.png[/img][/td]
[td][h1]Teleport[/h1][/td]
[td]Mark the current location (lasts for 18 seconds), and then teleport back from other places.[/td]
[/tr]
[tr]
[td][img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/06/HP_Buff_Meta.png[/img][/td]
[td][h1]HP Buff[/h1][/td]
[td]Bestows 2000 extra health points for itself and nearby zombies for 8 seconds.[/td][/tr][/table]

[h1][b]New Zombie Escape 'RISING' Map[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Zombie Escape 'Rising' map
[*]A human camp is damaged by the chasing zombies. Climb safely to the roof and navigate through a building under construction to escape. You are evacuating via a helicopter.
[/list]
[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/06/01_Map.png[/img]

[h1][b]Vulcanus-9 And Vulcanus-11 Perfect Pick Recipes[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Vulcanus-9 and Vulcanus-11 now available in Perfect Pick Recipes Sets.
[*]You have also a chance to craft Vulcanus-9 through Grade-5 Blueprint.
[*]You also have a chance to craft Vulcanus-11 through Grade-2 Blueprint.
[*]Period of Perfect Pick Recipes being sold: From the 15th of June to the 29th of June.
[/list]

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/06/01_Vulcanuse.png[/img]


[h1][b]-70% DLC Steam Sales[/b][/h1]

4 DLCs for Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies now available in a unique limited time bundle. [url=http://store.steampowered.com/bundle/639/]Buy them together here for a 70% discount.[/url]

[url=http://store.steampowered.com/bundle/639/] DLCs included[/url]:
[list]
[*]Dragon Set + Permanent Character
[*]Journey to the West + Permanent Character
[*]Oz's Trio
[*]Rivals DLC
[/list]


[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/06/03_DLCs.png[/img]
[list]
[*]When
- The 15th of June to the 3rd of July
[/list]
[h1][b]Return Of The S/J/M/B Box Event![/b][/h1]

We listened to your feedback!
It's way stronger and way more generous than before.
[list]
[*]WHEN?
- S-BOX: 10th / 11th / 12th of June from 00:00 to 24:00 (CEST, EDT = 18:00 PM to 18:00 PM, PDT = 15:00 PM to 15:00 PM)
- J-BOX: 17th / 18th / 19th of June from 00:00 to 24:00 (CEST, EDT = 18:00 PM to 18:00 PM, PDT = 15:00 PM to 15:00 PM)
- M-Box: 24th / 25th / 26th of June from 00:00 to 24:00 (CEST, EDT = 18:00 PM to 18:00 PM, PDT = 15:00 PM to 15:00 PM)
- B-Box: 01st / 02nd / 03rd of July from 00:00 to 24:00 (CEST, EDT = 18:00 PM to 18:00 PM, PDT = 15:00 PM to 15:00 PM)

[*]HOW
- Play against at least 4 or more players in the same room.

In total, you will have 2 brand boxes per day and 6 boxes in total. (Maximum Box count: 6 S-Boxes, 6 J-Boxes, 6 M-Boxes and 6 B-Boxes)

[h1][b]Get Your ‘Zombie Slaughter Pack’![/b][/h1]

Testing Gae Bolg, Free Supreme Decoders, Mileage Decoders, and Discount Coupon all in one event!
[url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/273110/announcements/detail/577965585313506896]Click here for more info.[/url]

If you want to acquire more decoders, this will be the easiest way.
[url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/273110/announcements/detail/577965585313506896]Click here for more info.[/url]

notes.title: Weekly Patch Note 08.06.2016
notes.content:
[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/05/CSNZ_GenericBanners_WPN_1029x346_EN_Thib007-1029x346.jpg[/img]

Survivors,

Welcome to the next big CSN:Z expansion. June brings plenty of changes to all game areas: comeback of the 2 most wanted buff weapons and plenty of new ones in Mileage Decoder and Perfect Pick Recipes; improvements and rewards for new users and leveling system upgrade for veterans as well as the usual free giveaways.

Check out the full update notes:

[h1][b]Transcendence Piece Event[/b][/h1]

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/06/02_0608_image.png[/img]

[b]WHEN[/b]
⋅ 8 to 29 of June (For 3 weeks)
[b]HOW[/b]
⋅ You can get the Transcendence Piece item from Mileage Decoder during the event period.
⋅ Once you have collected 888 of the pieces you can exchange them for either the M4A1 Dark Knight or AK-47 Paladin.
⋅ After this event, remaining Transcendence Pieces will be replaced with the other items.

[h1][b]Vulcanus Pre-order Pack[/b][/h1]

[b]WHEN[/b]
⋅ 8 to 15 of June
[b]AMOUNT[/b]
⋅ Only 100 EA for the first 100 buyers.
[b]DETAIL[/b]
⋅ Mileage Decoder Supply Boxes supply Decoders upon logging in to the game. (For example, 5 Decoders x 10 days = 50 Decoders maximum for 10 days)
⋅ Mileage Decoder Growth Box. (500% EXP/GP Bonus / 10 days)
⋅ VULCANUS-9 (100 days)
⋅ VULCANUS-11 (100 days)
⋅ Every account can buy it one time only.
⋅ Enjoy first purchaser premium 1 week earlier than others.

http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=699851344

[h1][b]Improved Mileage Decoder[/b][/h1]

Add Permanent Blair + Fernando + Heavy Zombie Knife. (Not including Silver Luger and Holy Water Grenade)
Add new weapons: Lightning AR-1, Lightning AR-2, and Needler

[h1][b]Revamped Tutorial for new users*[/b][/h1]

New users can receive free weapons after completing the tutorial mode where they learn about the basics of the game mechanics and compete with zombie opponents.

[b]Weapons to win[/b]
⋅ BALROG-VII (15 days) + Grade-1 and Grade-2 Blueprints [S] + 2x Durables (30 days) + 6400 Game Points
⋅ SKULL-VII (15 days) + Grade-3 and Grade-4 Blueprints [S] + 2x Durables (30 days) + 6400 Game Points
⋅ JANUS-VII (15 days) + Grade-5 and Grade-6 Blueprints [S] + 2x Durables (30 days) + 6400 Game Points
⋅ This reward will only be given the first time you complete the mission.

[h1][b]Zombie Mode Play Event[/b][/h1]

New users can receive the following weapons and other rewards when they clear any Zombie mode:

[b]WHO?:[/b] You are considered a new user if you’re under level 5 or within 30 days of character creation you can receive:
When you clear Zombie mode for the first time
⋅ BALROG-XI (15 days) + Grade-1, Grade-2 and Grade-3 Blueprints [S] + 3x Durables (30 days) + 9600 Game Points + 5x Special Enhancement Material.
When you clear Zombie mode a second time
⋅ SKULL-IX (15 days) + Grade-4, Grade-5 and Grade-6 Blueprints [S] + 3x Durables (30 days) + 9600 Game Points + 10x Special Enhancement Material.

[h1][b]Maximum level of account has been increased from 72 to 250[/b][/h1]

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/06/01_0608_image.png[/img]

New levels are unlocked with new rank icons. You can finally rank up to General of the Armies title and reach level cap at 250! You will get ‘General of the Armies’ at level 78!
New Valor medals have been added.
New Honor Missions and medals have been added.

[h1][b]‘Be the first 50’ event[/b][/h1]

Be one of the first 50 players who reach level 78.
[url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/273110/announcements/detail/576839053952030036]Click here for more detail.[/url]

[h1][b]The more, the merrier![/b][/h1]

The more you play, the more you get!
[url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/273110/announcements/detail/576839053952030036]Click here for more detail.[/url]

[h1][b]Return of the S/J/M/B Box Event[/b][/h1]

It’s way stronger and way more generous than before.
[url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/273110/announcements/detail/576839053952030036]Click here for more detail.[/url]

notes.title: THANATOS-1 & 3 and Festive Football!
notes.content:
[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/05/CSNZ_GenericBanners_NAV_1029x346_EN_Thib007-1029x346.jpg[/img]

From now on, you have the chance to acquire 2 new THANATOS weapons. 
Be vigilant, as on the 1st of June these two weapons will no longer be available through Perfect Recipes!

[h1][b]Perfect Pick Recipes[/b][/h1]

[b]THANATOS-1[/b]
[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/05/0525_005-1-768x354.png[/img]

A pistol using 7 rounds of .50AE bullets, developed by the Aegis Research Institute. It is equipped with the THANATOS Blade System, which when the special exploding projectiles hit the enemy, pierces through and decreases moving speed, giving critical damage to zombies.

[b]THANATOS-3[/b]
[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/05/0525_006-768x375.png[/img]
[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/05/Thanatos-3_3D_02-768x287.png[/img]

A submachine gun that holds 60 rounds of 4.6mm bullets, developed by the Aegis Research Institute. It is equipped with the THANATOS Blade System, which gives additional damage with the numerous blades equipped on the weapon by flying around the enemy after being fired and doling out extra damage.

[h1][b]Soccer Jersey Characters[/b][/h1]

[b]Ji Yoon Choi (Permanent)[/b]

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/05/0525_007.png[/img]

Allows you to use Ji Yoon Choi, a counter-terrorist character, dressed in a soccer uniform. When used in Football mode, a starting bonus of Stamina Level +1 and Agility Level +1 will be applied.

[b]Yuri (Permanent)[/b]

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/05/0525_008.png[/img]

Allows you to use Yuri, a terrorist character, dressed in a soccer uniform. When used in Football mode, a starting bonus of Stamina Level +1 and Agility level +1 will be applied.

[b]Asia Red Army (30 days)[/b]

Allows you to use an Asian Red Army Soldier, a terrorist character, dressed in a soccer uniform. When used in Football mode, a starting bonus of STR Level +1 will be applied.

[b]Max Thacker (30 days)[/b]

Allows you to use a Max Thacker, a counter-terrorist character, dressed in a soccer uniform. When used in Football mode, a starting bonus of STR Level +1 will be applied.

[h1][b]5 New Soccer Skills[/b][/h1]

You can use these items in Football Mode only. Select these Shot abilities in the Upgrade window from 25.05.2016 to 08.06.2016

[b]Spirit Shot[/b]

Summon ghost balls which move together with the real ball towards the target direction. You can get it for free when you log in during the event.

[b]Tornado Shot[/b]

Once you use the shot, big tornadoes will appear around the ball and fly toward the target. You can get it for free when you log in during the event.

[b]Summoning Shot[/b]

Once you use the shot, a Summoned character will appear and fly toward the target. You can get it for free when you log in during the event.

[b]Night Hawk Shot[/b]

Kick the ball high into the air and watch it slam down towards the goal. 
[i][u]You can acquire this item from the game shop.[/u][/i]

[b]Cannon Shot[/b]

Fires a powerful cannon-like shot straight towards your target.
[i][u]You can acquire this item from the game shop.[/u][/i]

CSN:Z Team

[h1][b]EVENT DURATION[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]STARTS: 25th of May 2016 (09:00AM CEST/12:00AM PDT/03:00AM EDT)
[*]ENDS: 8th of June 2016 (09:00AM CEST/12:00AM PDT/03:00AM EDT)
[*]M134 Minigun → M134 Predator (Permanent)
[*]Combat Knife → Knife Combat Master (Permanent)
[*]Double Barrel Shotgun → Triple Barrel Shotgun (Permanent)
[*]SL8 → SL8 Custom (Permanent)
[/list]

[h1][b]HOW[/b][/h1]
[list]

[*]You can check on your upgrading progress, which is visible in the game chat as you earn points.
[/list]

Once you use the shot, big tornadoes will appear around the ball and fly toward the target. You can get it for free when you log in during the event.

[b]Summoning Shot[/b]

Once you use the shot, a Summoned character will appear and fly toward the target. You can get it for free when you log in during the event.

[b]Night Hawk Shot[/b]

Kick the ball high into the air and watch it slam down towards the goal. 
[u]You can acquire this item from the game shop.[/u]

[b]Cannon Shot[/b]

Fires a powerful cannon-like shot straight towards your target.
[u]You can acquire this item from the game shop.[/u]

notes.title: [UPDATE] New Characters Strike Back!
notes.content:
For a while, Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies has not had any new characters. There were a number of reasons for this, but one of them might have been that the last new characters, Carlito and Walter, didn't do so well - and also because it kind of felt like the characters didn't interest you very much.

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/05/1.png[/img]
[i]"These... these are not tears!"[/i]

So, this time I have prepared some very special guys for you!
Meet 'Blair' and 'Fernando'!

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/05/2.png[/img]

[h1][b]Blair[/b][/h1]

Blair, a hunter who is originally from Ireland, was well-known as a problem solver for off-the-record requests. However, when her fame reached its peak, she vanished from this world without a trace. After she went missing, rumors about zombies swept all across Europe and many thought this wasn't just a coincidence.

If her looks remind you of 'Black Widow' from Marvel Comics, I have to say that it's just your imagination. That would not be the case....

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/05/3.png[/img]
[i]"Do... they look alike? Um…. Well…. You're just imagining things!”[/i]

But Blair alone is not so flashy, right? As such we have quite daringly decided to offer Blair and the Silver Medal Luger together, making the [Blair & Silver Luger] set.

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/05/4.png[/img]

The [Blair & Silver Luger] set has a Duration, and it can be purchased with cash. Unfortunately, the Duration cannot be extended. Blair is valid for 7 days, and the Silver Medal Luger for 14 days.

[h1][b]Fernando[/b][/h1]

After graduating from a seminary school in Spain, Fernando wandered all over Europe as an exorcist. He and His Holy Water Grenade were well known due to his many deeds. It is recorded that he was killed while performing an exorcism in Germany, but it seems like this theory was not so well received.

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/05/5.png[/img]
[i]"Are you saying that I'm dead? Here goes my Desert Eagle of Fury!!"[/i]

Of course, Fernando alone wouldn't be a fair match next to the [Blair & Silver Luger] set. So we have also decided to sell Fernando with the Holy Water Grenade, as the [Fernando & Holy Water Grenade] set!

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/05/6.png[/img]

The [Fernando & Holy Water Grenade] has a Duration, and it can be purchased with cash. Unfortunately, the Duration for this item cannot be extended either. Fernando is valid for 7 days, and the Holy Water Grenade for 14 days.

The most useful function of the Holy Water is ignoring the Light Zombies' ability to cloak. When blasted with the Holy Water, they cannot hide, no matter how much they try. An even better function is preventing the zombies from recovering for a certain amount of time. Zombies by default are able to recover HP when they stay still without being hit for 3 seconds or more, but when hit with the Holy Water, the zombies' HP takes damage over time.

The zombie has to waste about 8 seconds, trying to recover HP before it can go catch some humans before the round ends.

I really hope you purchase these great weapons while you can!

Having prepared so much last time, there isn't much new for this week. For the time being, this is all for this week; check back next week for improved contents!

[h1][b]Removal of Supreme Decoder and CSN:Z Boost Package 1[/b][/h1]

Those two items have been removed today. I hope to see them in our in-game shop soon.

Oh right, you know that the May [Weapon of the Month] is AWP? When you get down to it, nothing can beat AWP. Please use it! Plus, it's free!!!

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/05/7.png[/img]

Bye everyone, see you next week!

notes.title: [Event Update] Weapon Of The Month!
notes.content:
[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/banner_en-3.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]Weapon Of The Month![/b][/h1]

Following the K3 from the month before, AWP has been selected as the 'Weapon of the Month'!

Wouldn't you agree that AWP is the most iconic weapon in the Counter-Strike franchise? It's a gun boasting destruction, eliminating anyone in your sights with deadly aim and reflexes!

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/1-6.png[/img]

This sniper rifle can deal massive damage, which even ignores armor, and holds 10 rounds of .338 Lapua ammunition. The best of the best, AWP! There isn't any competition!

However!

However!

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/2-7.png[/img]

The AWP selected as the 'Weapon of the Month' boasts of even greater force. (...)
(What is this madness!!)

The AWP selected as 'Weapon of the Month' will deal more damage in Zombie Scenarios! AWP may have a lower rate of fire compared to the previous 'Weapon of the Month' K3, thus decreasing the overall damage output, but it's one of my favorite weapons!

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/3-5.png[/img]

Enjoy AWP, Natasha's favorite weapon, as 'Weapon of the Month'!
[list]
[*]All users can use 'Weapon of the Month,' and it will be switched with one of the basic weapons in your inventory.
[*]You can check it out under Inventory [Event] > [Weapon of the Month]
[*][Weapon of the Month] will be given out automatically in Zombie and Zombie Scenario modes.
[*]It can be accessed in the Buy Menu whether the gun is a [Weapon of the Month] or not.
[/list]

Moreover, the 'Weapon of the Month,' AWP can be used from midnight of 1st May to midnight of 30th May (CEST).

notes.title: [EVENT] Decoder Chance-Up Event!
notes.content:
Spring is upon us. Well, maybe not for all regions, but it has gone fully into spring where I am. It would be a nice idea to go outside, now that the sun is shining and the wind blows gently, but how about spending your time with Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies instead?

[h1][b]Decoder Chance-Up Event![/b][/h1]

During the event period, the chance to acquire these 4 specific weapons is doubled! Then, shall we see which weapons are included in this event?

[h1][b]Slasher[/b][/h1]

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/1-5.png[/img]

A version of the Ripper with lower stats, which inevitably causes it to be shoved all the way back into the darkest depths of your inventory. (There's a lore that when a ripper-pro uses the slasher, he'll instantly become a noob, and vice versa, when a slasher-pro uses the ripper, he'll instantly become great...)

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/2-6.png[/img]

There's different actions for the left and right mouse buttons, so make sure to check how both attacks work!

[h1][b]Thunderbolt[/b][/h1]

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/3-4.png[/img]

Thunderbolt is a railgun, which accelerates its projectile with an electromagnetic field. It boasts tremendous power and penetration, but it is heavy and doesn't have any auto-fire capabilities. But that power! This is a weapon that would come in handy for the zombie scenario and various zombie modes. There just isn't any other weapon that comes close to taking care of those bosses quite like the Thunderbolt.

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/4-4.png[/img]

Well, it's a bit disappointing that it doesn't have any knock-back power, but it makes up for that with its power and stun effect!

[h1][b]Newcomen[/b][/h1]

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/5-3.png[/img]

We've talked a lot within the team about whether to release this next gun in the game or not... but for the sake of fun, we've decided to unveil it to the players! Meet the Newcomen. Well... let's just say that this gun is borderline OP. (OP as in every zombie players would run away from the players that have this gun out.)

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/6-2.png[/img]

It's a submachine gun that uses 30 rounds of 4.6mm ammunition, but it can fire all 30 rounds at once, using the power of its steam engine. The sheer destruction! (All the bullets are fired at once by clicking the right mouse button.) Need I say more? Newcomen will be available for all!

[h1][b]Savery[/b][/h1]

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/7.png[/img]

Savery is a weapon that has been seen before! It has been about a year, and due to the positive feedback, we've decided to reimplement the gun into the game. This gun also uses a steam engine to fire bullets, just like the Newcomen. Isn't its power guaranteed?

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/8-1.png[/img]

The best thing about Savery is that its accuracy is 100%. It basically fills in the area where AWP-Z lacked. The gun does not have any firing animation, so it excels in the rate of fire department, and with its 100% accuracy, it can also be fired on the move. Isn't it great? The event will grant you double the chances to acquire these 4 weapons.

This event runs from post-maintenance on 27th April to pre-maintenance 4th May, through the Decoders.

[h1][b]Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies Baseball Event![/b][/h1]

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/1_en.png[/img]

Baseball is fun. Imagine a situation where you have a runner on 3rd base on the bottom of 9th inning with a full count.... How exciting is that?

Now you can experience the same baseball game through Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies!

The Baseball event runs from post-maintenance on 27th April to pre-maintenance, 11th May.

How do you participate? Well, we thought you might ask, so we've prepared a little guide for all of you.

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/02_9_en.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*]Play Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies for 20 minutes and receive 1 'Baseball' event item. (You must play in a room with 4 players or more!)
[*]Click on the 'Baseball Event' on the bottom, and swing by clicking on the [Baseball Bat] button!
[*]Every time a runner comes home, you earn 1 point!
[*]Depending on the points you earned, you'll receive a corresponding number of Event Decoders!
[*]One more thing! The decoders are given out on the first log-in session the next day (after midnight), depending on the points acquired the day before!
[/list]
Be sure to use your rewarded Event Decoder from the Baseball Event, as it is only available for 1 day. Take advantage of it before time runs out!

Isn't that easy? We're always trying to host events that basically hand out free stuff! We hope that you will think well of us!

[h1][b]Regarding Transcendence Decoder And GP Decoder Availability.[/b][/h1]

We acknowledged that some of you have encountered a problem where you can't use Transcendence Decoders and GP Decoders in your inventory after we removed those items from the in-game shop.

Luckily, the Transcendence Decoder issue was resolved on 20th of April, so now you can activate the Transcendence Decoder in your inventory but the GP Decoder still has an issue. Today, we re-enable the GP Decoder activation setting, so now you can use your stored GP Decoders freely.

It is important for you to know about the GP Decoder duration.

Your stored GP Decoders will be available starting today and removed by 25th of May, just before we do maintenance in the morning. Therefore, please use every GP Decoder in your inventory before 25th of May.

We hope to bring you more content in the weeks to come! Then, until next week!

Bye!

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/3-3.png[/img]

notes.title: [EVENT] Decoder Chance-Up Event!
notes.content:
Spring is upon us. Well, maybe not for all regions, but it has gone fully into spring where I am. It would be a nice idea to go outside, now that the sun is shining and the wind blows gently, but how about spending your time with Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies instead?

[h1][b]Decoder Chance-Up Event![/b][/h1]

During the event period, the chance to acquire these 4 specific weapons is doubled! Then, shall we see which weapons are included in this event?

[h1][b]Slasher[/b][/h1]

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/1-5.png[/img]

A version of the Ripper with lower stats, which inevitably causes it to be shoved all the way back into the darkest depths of your inventory. (There's a lore that when a ripper-pro uses the slasher, he'll instantly become a noob, and vice versa, when a slasher-pro uses the ripper, he'll instantly become great...)

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/2-6.png[/img]

There's different actions for the left and right mouse buttons, so make sure to check how both attacks work!

[h1][b]Thunderbolt[/b][/h1]

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/3-4.png[/img]

Thunderbolt is a railgun, which accelerates its projectile with an electromagnetic field. It boasts tremendous power and penetration, but it is heavy and doesn't have any auto-fire capabilities. But that power! This is a weapon that would come in handy for the zombie scenario and various zombie modes. There just isn't any other weapon that comes close to taking care of those bosses quite like the Thunderbolt.

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/4-4.png[/img]

Well, it's a bit disappointing that it doesn't have any knock-back power, but it makes up for that with its power and stun effect!

[h1][b]Newcomen[/b][/h1]

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/5-3.png[/img]

We've talked a lot within the team about whether to release this next gun in the game or not... but for the sake of fun, we've decided to unveil it to the players! Meet the Newcomen. Well... let's just say that this gun is borderline OP. (OP as in every zombie players would run away from the players that have this gun out.)

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/6-2.png[/img]

It's a submachine gun that uses 30 rounds of 4.6mm ammunition, but it can fire all 30 rounds at once, using the power of its steam engine. The sheer destruction! (All the bullets are fired at once by clicking the right mouse button.) Need I say more? Newcomen will be available for all!

[h1][b]Savery[/b][/h1]

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/7.png[/img]

Savery is a weapon that has been seen before! It has been about a year, and due to the positive feedback, we've decided to reimplement the gun into the game. This gun also uses a steam engine to fire bullets, just like the Newcomen. Isn't its power guaranteed?

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/8-1.png[/img]

The best thing about Savery is that its accuracy is 100%. It basically fills in the area where AWP-Z lacked. The gun does not have any firing animation, so it excels in the rate of fire department, and with its 100% accuracy, it can also be fired on the move. Isn't it great? The event will grant you double the chances to acquire these 4 weapons.

This event runs from post-maintenance on 27th April to pre-maintenance 4th May, through the Decoders.

[h1][b]Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies Baseball Event![/b][/h1]

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/1_en.png[/img]

Baseball is fun. Imagine a situation where you have a runner on 3rd base on the bottom of 9th inning with a full count.... How exciting is that?

Now you can experience the same baseball game through Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies!

The Baseball event runs from post-maintenance on 27th April to pre-maintenance, 11th May.

How do you participate? Well, we thought you might ask, so we've prepared a little guide for all of you.

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/02_9_en.jpg[/img]
[list]
[*]Play Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies for 20 minutes and receive 1 'Baseball' event item. (You must play in a room with 4 players or more!)
[*]Click on the 'Baseball Event' on the bottom, and swing by clicking on the [Baseball Bat] button!
[*]Every time a runner comes home, you earn 1 point!
[*]Depending on the points you earned, you'll receive a corresponding number of Event Decoders!
[*]One more thing! The decoders are given out on the first log-in session the next day (after midnight), depending on the points acquired the day before!
[/list]
Be sure to use your rewarded Event Decoder from the Baseball Event, as it is only available for 1 day. Take advantage of it before time runs out!

Isn't that easy? We're always trying to host events that basically hand out free stuff! We hope that you will think well of us!

[h1][b]Regarding Transcendence Decoder And GP Decoder Availability.[/b][/h1]

We acknowledged that some of you have encountered a problem where you can't use Transcendence Decoders and GP Decoders in your inventory after we removed those items from the in-game shop.

Luckily, the Transcendence Decoder issue was resolved on 20th of April, so now you can activate the Transcendence Decoder in your inventory but the GP Decoder still has an issue. Today, we re-enable the GP Decoder activation setting, so now you can use your stored GP Decoders freely.

It is important for you to know about the GP Decoder duration.

Your stored GP Decoders will be available starting today and removed by 25th of May, just before we do maintenance in the morning. Therefore, please use every GP Decoder in your inventory before 25th of May.

We hope to bring you more content in the weeks to come! Then, until next week!

Bye!

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/3-3.png[/img]

notes.title: [NOTICE] "unknown software exception (0xc0000417)" affecting the ES client.
notes.content:
Dear Survivors,

We're aware of the situation concerning the 'unknown software exception (0xc0000417)' issue most of our users are experiencing following our latest update while playing on the ES client.
We're deeply sorry for this unexpected issue and the inconvenience it is causing to all of you. 
We are working on it as our top priority, and we have already successfully identified the cause of it. A fix will be made available as soon as possible.
In the meanwhile, we invite all of you to cooperate by not starting further threads about this matter in the forums, and use the existing ones still active for discussion.

A temporary, unofficial workaround appears to be that of changing the language of your Steam Clients to English from 'Settings > Interface', but we understand this is not feasible or granted to work for all of you. So, please, proceed with caution if you choose to do so.

We will be using this notice to share further updates about the situation.
Thank you for your patience and understanding.

The CSN:Z Team

notes.title: [Event Update] Get Your Decoder By Participating In The Baseball Event!
notes.content:
[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/banner_en-2.jpg[/img]

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/3-3.png[/img]

My passion for events cannot be measured! This is an event that we've all put our hearts into, so that you, the players, can enjoy!

[h1][b]Participate In The Event And Claim Your Decoder Today![/b][/h1]

During the event period, a [Baseball] can be acquired every 20 minutes if you play in a room with 4 or more players. Upon acquiring 1 or more [Baseball], points can be acquired by using the Baseball Bat in the Event! Depending on the points, an Event Decoder can be claimed!

Ah, don't forget that the Decoders are given out depending on the points acquired the previous day (points compiled from 00:00 until 24:00 CEST each day).

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/1_en.png[/img]

The event will start from 27th April, 09:00 and end on 11th May 09:00 (CEST)! Remember to participate in the event and get your own free Decoder!

[h1][b]Decoder Chance-Up Event! My Decoder Is Twice As Effective![/b][/h1]

From 27th April, 09:00 to 11th May, 09:00 (CEST), the chance of acquiring one of the 4 weapons is doubled!

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/2-5.png[/img]

I wonder which weapon you will get. Aren't you curious?

[h1][b]Supreme Decoder Event Over The Weekend![/b][/h1]

As you know, we are always considering our players' happiness. Therefore, I am preparing a new event for you. This will be the best event in CSN:Z history.

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/decoder.png[/img]

If you are logged into the game on 29th and 30th of April, you will get 1 Supreme Decoder for free. Of course, there are some conditions in order to get this wonderful item.

Please read the below conditions carefully:
[list]
[*]During the event period, you wil get 1 Supreme Decoder per account when you log into the game.
[*]You can only get the decoder from 18:00 to 20:00 (CEST and PST).
[*]This event will be held on 29th and 30th of April, so you are able to get a total of 2 Supreme Decoders for free during the event period.
[*]You must play CSN:Z for at least 30 minutes, otherwise, you will not get a reward.
[/list]

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/weapons.png[/img]

I hope everyone participates in this event on 29th and 30th of April to play CSN:Z with free Supreme Decoders!

[b]To be continued! Event never stops![/b]

notes.title: [Update] 30% Discount Coupons for all items are released! It's Enhancement Time! Put the force back into your lives!
notes.content:
Dear Survivors,

It looks like winter is finally over, and the weather is warming up to the point where some people are wearing T-shirts on the streets. We hope that the cold, cold winter has departed and the warm spring has arrived in the hearts of Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies players!

[h1][b]30% Discount Coupons For All Items Are Released![/b][/h1]

We are giving out 30% Discount Coupons for all items! When you log in for the first time during the event, you will receive 10x 30% Discount Coupons for all items! We are giving out 10 coupons!

This event will start from the 20th of April, 09:00 CEST to 4th of May, 09:00 CEST! With this 30% Discount Coupon, there will be no pressure to buy expensive items!

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/7_en.png[/img]

Purchase all cash items in store at a 30% discounted price!
You wouldn't miss this big chance, would you?

[h1][b] Supreme Decoder is back![/b][/h1]

Don’t let the odds rattle you, my fellow single survivors! It’s always a bit of an ordeal the first time. And now, I can proudly announce that we are bringing the Supreme Decoder back! 

[img]http://csoimage.nexoneu.com/csnz/game/promotion/others160217/decoder.png[/img]

Each time you open the Supreme Decoder, you have an 85% chance to win BALROG, SKULL, JANUS, Maverick series or Salamander, M32 MGL, AT4-CS, Leviathan. Any of these weapons will be at minimum 70 Day versions. 

This Decoder will be available from 20th April to 4th May so DO NOT MISS THIS OPPORTUNITY! 

Check out what you will get through this Supreme Decoder: 

[img]http://csoimage.nexoneu.com/csnz/game/promotion/others160217/weapons.png[/img]

[h1][b]May Is The Month Of Events! The Giveaway Events Are Here![/b][/h1]

As you know, it's not weird to call May the month of events. We have prepared events which will satisfy all your needs! Take a look at the bottom for a brief explanation of the events, and if you need more details, feel free to click on the links! We've prepared a detailed explanation of the events for you!

[url=http://www.csnzombies.com/event-update-participate-in-weekly-events-and-receive-free-items/]If you want to find out, click here! (ENGLISH)[/url]

[h1][b]It's Upgrade Time![/b][/h1]

From April 20th, after maintenance, to April 27th, before maintenance, the chance of upgrading increases depending on the play time!
[list]
[*]Enhancement Buff Stage 1: Play for 30 minutes in order to get this buff!
[*]Enhancement Buff Stage 2: Play for 60 minutes in order to get this buff!
[/list]
[h1][b]Two Upgrade Attendance Events![/b][/h1]

The Upgrade Attendance Event consists of two parts. First, if you log in during the event period, a perfect reinforced material will be randomly given out! And second, if you play 1 hour each day for 7 days, a perfect reinforced material will be randomly given out!

[h1][i]If you log in during the event period…[/i][/h1]

We'll randomly distribute one of the Reinforced Parts below!

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/5-2.png[/img]
[list]
[*]If you log on during the event period, we'll supply you with 1 random perfect upgrade material.
[*]Attendance can be done once per day.
[*]This can be done only in A class rooms with 4 or more players.
[*]If there is no space in your inventory, the item will not be given out.
[/list]
[h1][i]If you play 1 hour per day for 7 days…[/i][/h1]

We'll randomly distribute one of the Perfect Reinforced Parts below!

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/6-1.png[/img]

Well, as always, there are some prerequisites. Something that you all know by now!
[list]
[*]If you play one hour per day for 7 days during the event period, we'll give out one random Perfect Reinforced Part.
[*]The log-in does not have to be consecutive. You just have to play 1 hour per day, for 7 days total to get your Perfect Reinforced Parts.
[*]This can be done only in A class room with 4 or more players.
[*]If there is no space in your inventory, the item will not be given out. So make sure that you have space before you begin with the event.
[/list]
This event will start from the 20th of April 00:00 (CEST) to 27th of April 00:00 (CEST)!

You all must have been wondering what happened to the Bingo items due to a lack of news, but do not fear, since the new bingo exclusive weapons have been released.

Shall we find out what those are?

[h1][b]Coil Machine Gun[/b][/h1]

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/1-4.png[/img]

The stubby appearance of the Coil Machine Gun may remind you of the Avalanche, but the Coil Machine Gun is categorized as machine a gun. The magazine comes with 100 rounds and the gun fires at 600 rounds per minute. With a full load, it comes in at a staggering 9kg. The rounds fired from the Coil Machine Gun will create an electrical field upon a hit, and will deal AoE damage and apply shock to the enemies.

However, this is only limited to biological targets, and will result in a blue electrical field on-hit. The electrical field will damage nearby targets with splash damage, but it's so minuscule that it can be ignored.

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/2-3.png[/img]

But... the gun has good rate of fire and accuracy, so it is a weapon that I would personally recommend! (And the knock-back power is a bonus!)

[h1][b]Sapientia[/b][/h1]

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/3-2.png[/img]

This is a new pistol which uses special 'holy' bullets. Appearance-wise, it looks similar to the Anaconda.

However, it uses the special 'holy' bullets, which explode on impact to damage any nearby zombies. It can also damage your opponent over time.

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/4-3.png[/img]

As I've said before, Sapientia is based on the Anaconda, and it (as expected) out-performs the Anaconda.

Moreover, the Holy effect will ease your search for hidden Light zombies. For a pistol, it is a decent performer in the Zombie Scenarios. (Not to mention its sheer penetration power!)

If you haven't yet found a pistol that suits your needs, I would recommend picking up a Sapientia!

We, the Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies team, wish you the best of luck! We'll be back next week with more in store!

Until then, bye!

notes.title: [Event Update] It’s Enhancement Time! Put The Force Back Into Your Lives!
notes.content:
[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/banner_en-1-1024x346.jpg[/img]

In order to give you all a better Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies experience, I've had a lengthy time to think about what I could do after the previous notice. So, I've decided to give you all better chances in upgrading your gear!

Depending on your play time, upgrade chances will increase! Enhancement Attendance Event!Don't miss your chance to get your hands on a stronger weapon!

Don't miss your chance to get your hands on a stronger weapon!

[img]http://www.csnzombies.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/1-3.png[/img]

How should you participate in this event? Well, let me just show you the way!

[list]
[*]Upgrade Buff Stage 1: Play for 30 minutes in order to get this buff!
[*]Upgrade Buff Stage 2: Play for 60 minutes in order to get this buff!
[/list]
