-- Enjoy daily boosts of EXP in two blocks of time each day.
-- Trial Weapons are back for Zombie Scenario! Try out 2 free high powered guns for zombie slaying.
-- Don’t look too foolish with our 1st of April events!


[h1][b]LOG IN! – Free Decoders from Battlefield Supply[/b][/h1]
[b]From 1st through 30th April[/b], redeeming your daily Battlefield Supply reward will get you free Decoders! On the 3rd reward day, the prize is 1x Decoder. On the 7th reward day, the prize is 2x Decoders.

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0401/en2-1.jpg[/img]


[h1][b]LOG IN! – Free one-time gift of Decoders[/b][/h1]
[b]From 1st through 30th April[/b], CSN:Z is giving every player that logs in a FREE package of 30x Decoders! This is a system loaded with great prizes, and we want every player of CSN:Z to enjoy trying it out, on the house.

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0401/2-2.jpg[/img]

Please note that this reward is a one-time gift awarded on the first login made during the event period.


[h1][b]LOG IN! – Free one-time gift of Bingo Mileage[/b][/h1]
[b]From 1st through 30th April[/b], CSN:Z is giving every player that logs in a coupon for 200 free Bingo Mileage! When playing Bingo, Mileage is used to perform the different available actions on your board such as resetting the rewards selection or changing what range of Bingo numbers may be selected.

Please note that this reward is a one-time gift awarded on the first login made during the event period.


[h1][b]PLAY! – Grow your rewards with CSN:Z’s Seed Event[/b][/h1]
[b]From 1st through 15th April[/b], log in each day to receive a Seed. The rewards it offers aren’t very nourishing, but playing matches of CSN:Z will help it grow into some much more fulfilling prizes!

Play for 60 minutes to grow the Seed into a Sapling, and play for another 90 minutes to earn a Fruit item. Spring gardening can be hard work, but when there are Crafting Blueprints in Saplings and Decoders in those Fruit items, it can be worth the effort!

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0401/2-3.png[/img]

The Seed Event can be repeated each day. Seed, Sapling, and Fruit items will be removed from your inventory at midnight CEST (Noon for US eastern time zone) if you have not yet redeemed the items for prizes.


[h1][b]PLAY! – Daily EXP +50% Boost[/b][/h1]
[b]From 1st through 30th April[/b], enjoy a bonus +50% to EXP earned from finished matches, twice each day! 
The +50% EXP bonus is active during 18:00 – 20:00 CEST and 02:00 – 06:00 CEST (1PM – 5PM and 9PM – 1AM US eastern time zone).

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0401/2-4.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]PLAY! – New Trial Weapons for Zombie Scenario[/b][/h1]
[b]From 1st through 30th April[/b], your inventory will have some high powered Zombie killing weaponry for free! These Trial Weapons can be used in specific maps of Zombie Scenario mode throughout the event period without any Crafting or time limits.

[b]--Zombie Scenario Map “Angra Nest” gets the SKULL-5[/b]
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0401/2-6.jpg[/img]
[b]--Zombie Scenario Map “Panic Room” gets the SUKLL-6[/b]
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0401/2-7.jpg[/img]

These are the final maps of Chapter 2 and Chapter 3, so you may need to rely on the firepower of these Trial Weapons to survive! Good luck.


[h1][b]EVENT! – Reversed Map Item[/b][/h1]
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0401/2-8.jpg[/img]
[b]Only on 1st April[/b], players will receive a special Map Reversing item that will create some new challenges in the following Original maps by reversing the CT and TR spawn areas:
-- Dust 2
-- Inferno
-- Nuke
-- Train

However, the zones where CT and TR players buy their guns and equipment are NOT reversed. The heat is on to not only complete your team’s objective, but to hustle across the map and buy your guns and gear before the round is over!


[h1][b]LOG IN! – Free Fake Sprays[/b][/h1]
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0401/2-9.jpg[/img]
[b]From 1st through 5th April[/b], log in each day to receive a free 30Day Fake Spray.
-- Lighting SMG-1
-- Gold SL8
-- AT4CS
-- Terrorist
-- Counter-Terrorist

Leave your mark with these Sprays and see if you can fool your fellow CSN:Z players!


Let us know what you think in the comments and CSN:Z Forums. Make sure to also follow our official pages online for info about updates and everything CSN:Z!

notes.title: NEW CONTENT – Decoders, Cleaner Crafting, and MORE! (1/2)
notes.content:
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0401/en1.jpg[/img]
There is a lot of great stuff from the latest Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies update, but some of our players might be very excited just by seeing ‘Decoder’!

Relax, breathe, and read on to learn all about what you will find in the latest CSN:Z update.

[i]Click for [url=http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0401/fr1.html]Français[/url] , [url=http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0401/de1.html]Deutsch[/url] ,[url=http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0401/it1.html]Italiano[/url] ,[url=http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0401/pl1.html]Polski[/url] , [url=http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0401/tr1.html]Türkçe[/url] , [url=http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0401/ru1.html]Pусский[/url] .[/i]

[h1][b]Quick rundown![/b][/h1]
-- Decoder is here and there are a lot of new weapons and items to be won from it.
-- Bingo is paired with Decoder to make sure you’re always on a path to earning great prizes.
-- Crafting and Synthesize menus have been improved to make the process simpler.
-- Full Turkish language support for CSN:Z.
-- D3D can be selected in video options for users who prefer it. 

[h1][b]NEW! – DECODER[/b][/h1]
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0401/1-1.jpg[/img]

A Decoder can unlock some great weapons and items, ones that you will not find anywhere else, and there are plenty of new goodies to be had! It is as simple as using the Decoder to find out what reward was encrypted within it.

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0401/en1-2.jpg[/img]
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0401/new_character.png[/img]

[h1][b]‘But Nexon, we wanted C-BOX!’[/b][/h1]

Our fans from Counter-Strike Online will feel right at home with our Decoder system. The process has been rebalanced but with goals of making the process both simpler and more fun for our players. A major part of this design is matching the new Bingo system with Decoders.

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0401/en1-3.jpg[/img]

Decoder use racks up ‘Mileage’ that can be used in CSN:Z’s new Bingo board for collecting Bingo numbers. As you collect numbers on your Bingo board, completing vertical, horizontal, and diagonal lines will unlock rewards with a full board completion awarding a grand prize!

[b]Please note that Mileage may be earned from other various CSN:Z functions and features in future updates to the game.[/b]

There are a lot of new items to be found in Decoders... a lot. Keep checking back with CSN:Z to learn about when the rewards could be changing!


If only there were an incredible amount of events and free rewards for our players to celebrate the arrival of Decoders…
[b]If only learning about such events and rewards were as easy as clicking on a link in this page. If only![/b]
http://steamcommunity.com/games/273110/announcements/detail/129817471115947393

[h1][b]UPDATED! – Improved Crafting and Supply Menus[/b][/h1]
Crafting and Synthesis are a vital combination for getting your hands on new weapons in CSN:Z. With these menus being so important, they both have been given an update to streamline both Crafting and Synthesis.

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0401/en1-4.jpg[/img]

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0401/en1-5.jpg[/img]

The major details of these changes:
[b]•Menus now auto-fill your needed and best-choice materials with one click.
•The odds of success are now displayed.
•Using the Repeat option will no longer require interaction to accept each result.[/b]

We hope these changes make the Craft menus faster for our existing players, and easier to understand for newcomers just joining CSN:Z!

[h1][b]NEW! – Turkish Language Support[/b][/h1]
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0401/1-6.jpg[/img]

[b]With the 1st April update[/b], Turkish is now a fully supported language in CSN:Z!

You can choose this language, or any of the other languages CSN:Z supports, from the Language page of the Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies Properties window.

[h1][b]UPDATED! - D3D Video Settings Available[/b][/h1]
Thank you for sharing your feedback with us! The 1st April update adds ‘D3D’ back as a renderer option in CSN:Z for those who prefer it over ‘OpenGL’.

Please note that after choosing D3D, the CSN:Z game will need to be closed and restarted in order for it to switch to the D3D renderer.

notes.title: [EVENT] Group Photo! – Win Free Crafting Bundles
notes.content:
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/steam/main_banner/2015/0312/en.jpg[/img]
[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=406955756]Click here for Français, Deutsch, Italiano, Polski, Türkçe, Pусский.​ [/url] 

To help show off the many Costume items of CSN:Z, players can win Crafting Bundles by hopping into a Family group photo together with our latest event!

Work together with your Family members to take a group photo of everyone wearing their favorite Costume items. Arrange as many Family members that can fit on screen together, make sure their nametags are all visible, and capture the image with either the Steam screenshot button (F12) or CSN:Z’s screenshot function (F5).

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/steam/main_banner/2015/0312/img_for_notice.png[/img]

[b]Upload the picture to the Artwork section of CSN:Z’s Community Hub. Make sure your Family members, other CSN:Z Friends, and anyone you know on Steam is visiting your upload to click ‘Like’! Entries with the most ‘Likes’ will be the winners of this event. [/b]

Want some new Costumes to show off your best in our Group Photo Event? Or have you just wanted a giant fish to wear on your back? Now is a great time to load up on Costumes!

[h1]From 12th through 18th March, buying 3 Costume Boxes will award you another Costume Box for free! Every 3 purchased Costume Boxes will award a bonus Costume Box for free, making it easier to try and complete that Cat Set you’ve wanted.[/h1]


[b]Winners will be selected on 20.03.2015 @ 11:00 CET (06:00 AM Eastern Standard Time).[/b] The following rewards are available to win in this event. Every eligible player in a winning screenshot will receive rewards matching their winning placement:

1st Place – [S] Tier Blueprint Packages x3
2nd Place – [S] Tier Blueprint Packages x2 
3rd Place – [S] Tier Blueprint Packages x1
4th Place – [A] Tier Blueprint Packages x3 
5th Place – [A] Tier Blueprint Packages x2 

[h1]Very Important! Screenshots are only eligible if players follow these instructions![/h1]

•[b]Screenshots must be submitted to the ARTWORK section of the CSN:Z Steam Community Hub![/b] http://steamcommunity.com/app/273110/images/ , [b]all submissions must have “[Group Photo]” added to the title of their upload.[/b]
•All players in the screenshot must be wearing a Costume item, but we will accept creative ways of editing the screenshot to add Costume items on those who are missing them!
•Only players in the screenshot, with their character name clearly legible in the screenshot, will be eligible to receive any reward.
•Editing a photo to add in players who were not originally present is not permitted.
•A Family can win only once; additional entries for the same Family will not be rewarded with prizes!

[b]Winners will be selected on 20.03.2015 @ 11:00 CET (06:00 AM Eastern Standard Time).[/b] The following rewards are available to win in this event. Every eligible player in a winning screenshot will receive rewards matching their winning placement:

1st Place – [S] Tier Blueprint Packages x3
2nd Place – [S] Tier Blueprint Packages x2 
3rd Place – [S] Tier Blueprint Packages x1
4th Place – [A] Tier Blueprint Packages x3 
5th Place – [A] Tier Blueprint Packages x2 

[h1]Very Important! Screenshots are only eligible if players follow these instructions![/h1]

•[b]Screenshots must be submitted to the ARTWORK section of the CSN:Z Steam Community Hub![/b] http://steamcommunity.com/app/273110/images/ , [b]all submissions must have “[Group Photo]” added to the title of their upload.[/b]
•All players in the screenshot must be wearing a Costume item, but we will accept creative ways of editing the screenshot to add Costume items on those who are missing them!
•Only players in the screenshot, with their character name clearly legible in the screenshot, will be eligible to receive any reward.
•Editing a photo to add in players who were not originally present is not permitted.
•A Family can win only once; additional entries for the same Family will not be rewarded with prizes!

notes.title: NEW GUNS – M1 Garand and M32 MGL
notes.content:
There is a Zombie War going on, time to bring out some heavy hitting weaponry! (As if anyone needs an excuse to have fun with a grenade launcher.)

Check out the two latest weapons added to CSN:Z. If you really want to get your hands on these weapons NOW, the Perfect Pick Recipe Bundles in the Shop are what you’re looking for.

[h1]M1 Garand[/h1]
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/temp/2015/0312/Pic01.jpg[/img]
This rifle is both historic and capable of dealing a whole lot of damage despite its age. Make those shots count as it only holds 8 rounds per clip and can only be reloaded once all rounds have been fired!
 
[h1]M32 MGL[/h1]
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/temp/2015/0312/Pic02.jpg[/img]
Since when is subtlety needed in a Zombie War, or a Zombie Scenario? This grenade launcher uses a revolving cylinder to let its operator unleash repeated explosive attacks against enemies living and living-dead. You can also right-click when using the M32 MGL to land longer, more precise shots.


If a powerful rifle or raining down grenades is your style of fighting, visit the Shop to get Perfect Pick Recipe Bundles for either or both of the latest CSN:Z weapons!

notes.title: NEW CONTENT – Prepare for WAR!
notes.content:
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/steam/main_banner/2015/0226/en.jpg[/img]
Until now, the battle between Human and Zombie has been a chaotic fray of hot lead and decaying flesh. It was not clear who could be trusted when your best friend in the foxhole could turn on you in the next round of combat.

It is time that this gruesome fight between Living and Living-Dead break out into a full blown WAR.

[h1]NEW! – Zombie War[/h1]

Fans of Zombie PvP action will need to bring their best into the latest mode for Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies. In Zombie War, set teams are formed instead of randomized selection picking who will begin combat as a Zombie, letting you and your team play at your most fearsome and competitive!

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0226/1.jpg[/img]
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0226/2.jpg[/img]

When the round begins, the Human team is able to move through the map and secure the best places to dig in and defend. While Humans put their best strategies in motion, the Zombies are nowhere to be found… until the timer counts down to Zero. Once the timer reaches zero the Zombie team spawns into the map and the Zombie War begins! Once half of the rounds are completed, teams switch sides between Human and Zombie for the remainder of the match.

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0226/3.jpg[/img]
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0226/4.jpg[/img]

Forming set teams is not the only difference. Both Zombies and Humans stay dead for each round, and in the final 30 seconds of the round each side gets a boost to make those final moments count! Good luck hiding out the entire round when Zombies can see through walls in those final moments.

Don’t hold back! This is the time to bring your best strategies and team mates together for a real WAR!

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0226/5.jpg[/img]

[h1]EVENT! – Rewards of WAR[/h1]

What does a good Zombie War need besides bodies to fill the front lines? Weapons, lots of weapons! Playing in the all new Zombie War mode will earn you free Crafting Bundles to make sure your armory is fully stocked.

[b]From 26th February to 12th March, play 30 minutes of Zombie War and receive the following Crafting Bundle:[/b]
-- 3x Random [A] Blueprint
-- 3x 24-30 Day Durable
-- 19,200 Points

[b]If you play an additional 30 minutes in that same day, you will receive an additional Crafting Bundle containing the following:[/b]
-- 1x Random [S] Blueprint
-- 1x 24-30 Day Durable
-- 6,400 Points

[I]Both sets of rewards can be earned once per day. A Zombie War match must have 4 or more players in order for its time to count towards the event.[/I]

[h1]NEW! – New Weapons, New Perfect Pick Recipe Bundles[/h1]

To help get pumped for war, there’s two new weapons for you to Craft and bring to the battlefield!

[b]M60E4 Maverick[/b] (Machinegun)

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0226/6.png[/img]

[b]Mauser C96[/b] (Pistol)

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0226/7.png[/img]

Following the 26th February Update, you can get your hands on these brand new weapons. If you’re looking to get your hands on these new weapons NOW check out the latest Perfect Pick Recipe Bundles in the shop featuring these two new armaments! Using the weapon’s Perfect Pick Recipe and its matching Crafting materials will guarantee the outcome of Crafting is the Recipe’s weapon!

notes.title: Read All About PvP 2.0!
notes.content:
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/steam/main_banner/2015/0226/2_en.jpg  [/img]

Let us be clear and direct: this update is not touching gun stats! Save your pitchforks for another time, please.

We are making improvements to how PvP modes of Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies show combat info, and also how accomplishments made in-game can be showcased. These changes are designed to make the fun of shooting your Zombie and Non-Zombie friends a more rewarding experience!

[h1]NEW! – Assists[/h1]

Have you ever emptied magazines to pick away at an enemy’s health, only for someone to get a lucky shot and score the kill? With the PvP 2.0 update, the game will now identify when a kill had assistance!
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0226/8.jpg[/img]

Assists will help everyone know who has been pulling their weight on the team. But, simply ‘knowing’ may not be enough for some, which will be helped by…

[h1]NEW! – Valor[/h1]

Earn recognition for your hard work in matches with the new Valor system! Each Valor to be unlocked is tied to combat and objectives performed in CSN:Z game modes. While Missions and Medals cover a broad range of goals, Valor is all about the BATTLES you have waged.

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0226/9.jpg[/img]

What must be done to earn Valor is hidden, but we trust our players are clever enough to get the hang of it quickly! At least, concerning combat before PvP 2.0, and not the new additions of…

[h1]UPDATED! – Action Report[/h1]

Headshots? Revenge kills? We hope everyone remembers those, but PvP 2.0 is expanding on these staples of combat!
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0226/14.png[/img] 

With the PvP 2.0 update, a much more diverse range of combat accomplishments are being recognized. Scoring the first kill of a match deserves recognition, but picking on the worst of the enemy team member gets recognition (for better or worse) in PvP 2.0. 

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0226/13.png[/img]

There are plenty more, including those incredible kill streaks, but you’ll have to get in game to find them! After adding all this new content it’d be great if players knew more about…

[h1]NEW! – MVP Report[/h1]

CSN:Z now showcases the top performers for the game mode’s objectives, helping highlight players and their efforts. 

[img]http://i.imgur.com/iYb2UUt.jpg[/img]

We hope this will both help players feel pride about their skill for being MVP, and make everyone else a little jealous of not being MVP. And should that jealousy turn into some well-deserved in-game payback, you will want to know all about the pain you inflicted with…

[h1]UPDATED! – Combat Info[/h1]

When respawning, CSN:Z can tell you some essential info about the kills you scored during your last life or round. This information is being expanded and will provide more detail with the PvP 2.0 update.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/07Rs49X.jpg[/img]

Changes are being made to both help the information be clearer, but also to provide more juicy details. Enjoy knowing not just which weapon dealt the killing blows on your enemies, but which body parts of your own the enemy was attacking the hardest! 



With the PvP 2.0 update, The CSN:Z Team hopes you will get more excitement out of every kill scored and greater reward with each objective completed. 

Let us know what you think in the comments and CSN:Z Forums. Make sure to also follow our official pages online for info about updates and everything CSN:Z!

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0226/8.jpg[/img]

Assists will help everyone know who has been pulling their weight on the team. But, simply ‘knowing’ may not be enough for some, which will be helped by…

[h1]NEW! – Valor[/h1]

Earn recognition for your hard work in matches with the new Valor system! Each Valor to be unlocked is tied to combat and objectives performed in CSN:Z game modes. While Missions and Medals cover a broad range of goals, Valor is all about the BATTLES you have waged.

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0226/9.jpg[/img]

What must be done to earn Valor is hidden, but we trust our players are clever enough to get the hang of it quickly! At least, concerning combat before PvP 2.0, and not the new additions of…

[h1]UPDATED! – Action Report[/h1]

Headshots? Revenge kills? We hope everyone remembers those, but PvP 2.0 is expanding on these staples of combat!
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0226/14.png[/img] 

With the PvP 2.0 update, a much more diverse range of combat accomplishments are being recognized. Scoring the first kill of a match deserves recognition, but picking on the worst of the enemy team member gets recognition (for better or worse) in PvP 2.0. 

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0226/13.png[/img]

There are plenty more, including those incredible kill streaks, but you’ll have to get in game to find them! After adding all this new content it’d be great if players knew more about…

[h1]NEW! – MVP Report[/h1]

CSN:Z now showcases the top performers for the game mode’s objectives, helping highlight players and their efforts. 

[img]http://i.imgur.com/iYb2UUt.jpg[/img]

We hope this will both help players feel pride about their skill for being MVP, and make everyone else a little jealous of not being MVP. And should that jealousy turn into some well-deserved in-game payback, you will want to know all about the pain you inflicted with…

[h1]UPDATED! – Combat Info[/h1]

When respawning, CSN:Z can tell you some essential info about the kills you scored during your last life or round. This information is being expanded and will provide more detail with the PvP 2.0 update.

[img]http://i.imgur.com/07Rs49X.jpg[/img]

Changes are being made to both help the information be clearer, but also to provide more juicy details. Enjoy knowing not just which weapon dealt the killing blows on your enemies, but which body parts of your own the enemy was attacking the hardest! 



With the PvP 2.0 update, The CSN:Z Team hopes you will get more excitement out of every kill scored and greater reward with each objective completed. 

Let us know what you think in the comments and CSN:Z Forums. Make sure to also follow our official pages online for info about updates and everything CSN:Z!

notes.content:
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/steam/main_banner/2015/0212/en.jpg[/img]

Sure, it may not have the gift-giving power of Christmas or the costumes of Halloween, but the power of LOVE is an incredible force! And nothing says ‘love’ to your sweetheart like bonding over Zombie slaying action in CSN:Z.

[h1]NEW GUNS AND PERFECT PICK RECIPE BUNDLES[/h1]

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0212/1.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Report #14: Ruins
notes.content:
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/temp/2015/0130/3.jpg[/img]

This is the story behind Counter Strike Nexon: Zombies 
Expose the truth behind the mysterious appearance of zombies and the outbreak of the Z-Virus in the CS world. 
Make sure to follow all of the reports we publish in order to get to the bottom of the story. 
**************
Report #14: Ruins

Their fighting led them into a ruins. They tried their best to fight against the Vanguard Company, but they couldn't beat their firepower. HQ instantly sent a cargo helicopter upon Victor's back up request, but they needed enough time to carry the samples securely.
Several soldiers volunteered to complete the mission. They risked themselves to protect the samples while fighting against the Vanguard Company. With their sacrifices, troops were able to deliver the samples securely to the chopper.

notes.title: Report #13: Hellfire
notes.content:
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/temp/2015/0130/2.jpg[/img]

This is the story behind Counter Strike Nexon: Zombies 
Expose the truth behind the mysterious appearance of zombies and the outbreak of the Z-Virus in the CS world. 
Make sure to follow all of the reports we publish in order to get to the bottom of the story. 
************** 
[h1]Report #13: Hellfire[/h1]

After severe combat in a sandstorm, Victor learned the origin of the unknown enemies. He heard through a Comanche Recording Device that the enemies were from the Vanguard Company. However, Victor knew that engaging against a munitions corporation would be a suicidal act... So, his troops escaped the combat zone, re-equipped themselves, and started their journey to request back up. After destroying a Comanche, the 3rd Squad tried to break through to the occupied city to join the main troops.

But rumor has it that there is a parent company behind them.
They are involved in a lot of illegal activities, like funding terrorists.
They have been upgraded with top technology. As a result, their vitality and firepower have been increased substantially. It seems as though Dr. Rex left the Vanguard Company right after he finished his job.

notes.content:
There are new weapons in CSN:Z with our latest update, and if you purchase a Perfect Pick Recipe bundle from the Item Shop, it can get your hands on those new guns, guaranteed!

This rifle has lasted through two world wars and conflicts beyond, but must now take on enemies that keep rising from the dead! With its design of using an internal magazine, each round is loaded directly into the weapon instead of loading a new entire magazine. 

[h1]•SPAS-12 Maverick[/h1]
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/temp/2015/0204/PPick_SPAS12Mav.jpg[/img]

All of these weapons can be crafted via existing Blueprints, [b]but only the Perfect Pick Recipe will guarantee the outcome from crafting![/b] Grab a Perfect Pick Recipe Bundle to try out the newest additions to CSN:Z’s arsenal.

notes.title: FEBRUARY IS ENHANCED – Check out the latest in CSN:Z!
notes.content:
Keep an eye on CSN:Z in the next few days, you're going to LOVE what we have lined up!

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/steam/main_banner/2015/0129/en.jpg[/img]

[h1]EXPANSION OF ENHANCEMENT[/h1]

Before the 29th January update, the highest a weapon could be enhanced was +5. After the update, players can reach +8 with the latest changes made to CSN:Z’s Enhancement System!
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0129/1.jpg[/img]

[b]Use the all new Special Enhancement Material to get both better chances of Enhancement success and the ability to apply Enhancements from +6 to +8! [/b]
In addition, should failure occur with the Special Enhancement Material, you can collect leftover parts to earn yourself the all new Perfect Enhancement Material! This rare Enhancement Material grants both 100% success rate and knowing exactly which attribute will be improved.

Now is the best time to start enhancing your inventory of weapons, especially with the lineup of events that will be available!

[h1]ENHANCEMENT GIVEAWAY EVENTS[/h1]

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0129/2.jpg[/img]
This is an Enhanced month for CSN:Z!  We’re giving away plenty of Enhancement Materials and Enhanceable Weapons to every player with the following events:

 • [b]Daily Reward Giveaway[/b]
From 29th January to 26th February, receive 5x Normal Enhancement Materials and 2x Special Enhancement Materials every day when logging in.
• [b]Free Weapon Giveaway[/b]
From 29th January to 26th February, receive a free 3 Day Enhanceable Weapon after being in-game for 30, 60, and then 90 minutes. The weapon awarded is random, but will always be a weapon you can enhance.

notes.title: Reach 999+ Days = GET PERMANENT WEAPON
notes.content:
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/temp/2015/0113/1.jpg[/img]                    [img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/temp/2015/0113/2.jpg[/img]

[h1]Now everyone can get every [b]WEAPON PERMANENT[/b] way easier.[/h1]
If any of your weapon reaches 999+ days duration, you can convert it to [b]PERMANENT[/b] with one click.

The latest 8th January update to CSN:Z has added a new way to get your hands the weapons you love for PERMANENT. The Item Extension system has been improved to allow weapons with longer durations to be converted to Permanent with no items or cost required!

Now every time you craft a weapon can get you closer to that PERMANENT status! No crafting attempt is wasted. And while trying you can still receive permanent weapon instantly!

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/temp/2015/0113/3.jpg[/img]
 
If there is an item in your inventory with 999 or more days of duration, notice the ‘Extend’ button has changed for the weapon as it appears in your inventory. Click it, and you can set it as PERMANENT instantly!

[h1][b]Perfect Pick Recipe Promotion[/b][/h1]

How does Henry turn Blueprints and Durables into weaponry? That Gunsmith isn’t sharing his secrets, but now you can getting your hands on the newest weaponry in CSN:Z instantly!
   
Introducing the [b]“Perfect Pick Recipe”[/b], a Crafting material that will guarantee the outcome of crafting be a specific weapon if included with its needed components. You can find this Recipe in the shop, included in Crafting bundles that contain all components needed to craft one of the new CSN:Z weapons!

For the 8th January Update, the following Perfect Pick Recipe bundles can be found in the shop:

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/temp/2015/0113/4.jpg[/img] [img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/temp/2015/0113/5.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]•MG42[/b][/h1]
Does it belong in a museum? Not when the dead keep rising! This weapon made its mark on history during World War II and an incredible rate of fire may just keep you alive against hundreds of Zombies barreling down on you.

[h1][b]•AT4CS[/b][/h1]
Even the odds against the Bosses of Zombie Scenario mode with some incredible firepower! Of course, the CSN:Z Team won’t judge you for wanting to have a rocket launcher just-because. 

Perfect Pick Recipe bundles for the MG42 and AT4CS will not be around forever! Visit the shop to pick up a bundle today to get your hands on these great offers while they are still available.

notes.title: [PART 2/2] ALL ZOMBIES PERMANENTLY FREE
notes.content:
[h1]ICE BREAKER[/h1]

From 8th to 29th January, those freezing winter temperatures may yield some incredible prizes in CSN:Z, including all new classes for PERMANENT.

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0108/7.jpg[/img]
Every day, you’ll be given a block of ice with a reward inside. How well you can break open the ice will improve the value of the rewards waiting for you.

[b]Stage 1[/b]
Play for 30 minutes or more first and you may be awarded a Lv. 3 EXP Coupon or a Lv. 3 Point Coupon, or instead the Ice Block may upgrade to Stage 2…

[b]Stage 2[/b]
Play for 30 minutes or more first and you may be awarded 3x Crafting Bundles (Blueprint [A], 3x 24-30 Durables, and 19,200 Points), or the Ice Block may be upgraded to Stage 3…

[b]Stage 3[/b]
Your Ice Block has taken a lot of damage! Use it immediately and earn one of the following rewards:
• 3x Crafting Bundles ( Blueprint [S], 3x 24-30 Durables, and 19,200 Points)
• PERMANENT Male Class Keith Ichan
• PERMANENT Male Class Spade.

Make sure to log in every day to get your Stage 1 Ice Block to try and earn those top quality Crafting materials or PERMANENT Keith Ichan and Spade Male Classes!
(NOTE: Ice Blocks are removed from your inventory each day at 00:00 CET \ 18:00 US Eastern). 

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0108/8.jpg[/img]

[h1]MAKE DURATION WEAPONS PERMANENT[/h1]

The 8th January update is not just for the undead. The CSN:Z Team is introducing a new way to increase your collection of PERMANENT weapons.
When a limited duration weapon has 999 or more days of duration in your Inventory, you can then set it as PERMANENT with the push of a button. It is then forever your weapon in CSN:Z!

Every day added to your favorite weapon, whether through Crafting or Item Extension Coupons, takes you closer to its PERMANENT status!

[h1]FREE POWERFUL GUNS IN ZOMBIE SCENARIO, SEASON 3[/h1]

What’s always great to hear when staring down a few thousand Zombies?
FREE GUNS !

Starting 8th January and ending 29th January, three Zombie Scenario maps of Season 3 have some incredible firepower unlocked for free. 

Check out the new Free Trial Weapons!

[b]-       First Contact : BALROG-VII (Machinegun)[/b]
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0108/12.jpg[/img]

[b]-       Enemy Behind : JANUS- 11 (Shotgun)[/b]
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0108/13.jpg[/img]

[b]-       Panic Room : SKULL-6 (Machinegun)[/b]
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0108/14.jpg[/img]

There’s no Crafting, points purchase, or cash purchase required to play with these guns. They are already in your inventory on 8th January!

The weapons will only work in their respective Zombie Scenario map, and you must have enough Dollars earned in the match to select them from the Buy menu in-game.

[h1]INTRODUCING: JANUS-3[/h1]

What’s better than a Tommy Gun?
A Tommy Gun equipped with the JANUS Transformation System that can unleash an unlimited ammo barrage during its transformation!
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0108/16.jpg[/img]

The JANUS series is being expanded with CSN:Z’s 8th January update, and is one of the possible weapons to be crafted from the Grade-3 Blueprint.

[h1]UPDATED BATTLEFIELD SUPPLY REWARDS[/h1]

You’ll find new rewards waiting for you in the Battlefield Supply, remember to redeem your reward every day to earn yourself a 20 Day 

UTS-15 Shotgun for the 6th reward and 20 Day Dual Infinity Pistols for the 7th rewards.
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0108/10_en.jpg[/img]

In addition, there’s some new high value Random Rewards to be had every time you redeem your Battlefield Supply Reward, including:
•[b]M4A1 RED PERMANENT[/b]
•Blueprint [S]
•5x 72 Day-Permanent Durables
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0108/11.jpg[/img]


Let us know how you’re enjoying the latest update to CSN:Z on the Steam Forums, Facebook, and Twitter!
https://www.facebook.com/en.CSNZ
https://www.facebook.com/pl.CSNZ
https://twitter.com/CSN_Z

notes.content:
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/steam/main_banner/2015/0108/en.jpg[/img]

[h1]5 NEW PLAYABLE ZOMBIE CLASSES[/h1]

It’s a new year, and that means it’s time to bring some new fear to the hearts of the living... five flavors of fear in fact!

[b]PSYCHO [/b]
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0108/4_1.jpg[/img]
What is worse than a hoard of attacking Zombies? Not seeing them coming. A well placed Smokescreen from the Psycho Zombie can really throw off the living. 

[b]VENOM STING [/b]
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0108/1.jpg[/img]
 Agility and precision come together with this Zombie menace. Float like a butterfly, sting like a bee. An undead bee?

[b]VENOM GUARD[/b]
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0108/2.jpg[/img]
For the Zombie enthusiast who truly wants to soak up the lead: excelling at enduring attacks and healing after barrages of gunfire.

[b]BANSHEE[/b]
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0108/3.jpg[/img]
Some of her devilish tricks can disrupt even the best Human encampment. Pull foolish targets away from safety, or disguise yourself as a Human to score some truly humiliating kills.

[b]STAMPER[/b]
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0108/4.jpg[/img]
When a guy brings an Iron Maiden to a gun fight and you know he’s serious about pain. Plant the Stamper’s Iron Maiden to disrupt enemies, block gunfire, and even help reach new heights.

[h1]ZOMBIES, FREE FOR ALL[/h1]

The latest CSN:Z update is making some huge changes to the war between the living and the living-dead. 
Starting 8th January, all Zombie Classes are becoming default items for all CSN:Z players. Players no longer need to purchase their preferred Zombie combatants, as they are now permanent in every player’s inventory!
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0108/5.jpg[/img]

In addition, a large number of PvP Zombie items are also set as default for all CSN:Z Players.
•Hammer, Nata Knife, and Flame Grenade weapons.
•Superior DNA, Persistent Survival, and Bomb Expert items.

And, yes, this includes the five Zombie classes new to the frontlines with our 8th January update!

[h1]INTRODUCING: THE PERFECT PICK RECIPE[/h1]

New weaponry is coming to the warzones of CSN:Z, and with the new Perfect Pick Recipe for Crafting you can get your hands on the latest and greatest armaments against living or dead foes alike!

The 8th January update for CSN:Z is adding new Crafting Bundles to the Item Shop. These bundles include the Perfect Pick Recipe in addition to all the Materials and Points needed to turn a Blueprint into a weapon.  Using the Perfect Pick Recipe while crafting will guarantee that only the recipe’s specific weapon will be crafted. Visit the Item Shop to get these bundles for the new MG42 and AT4CS!
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0108/9.jpg[/img]

[h1]BOOST TO MISSION REWARDS[/h1]

CSN:Z’s update for 8th January is giving a needed boost to the Random Rewards possible from the Missions menu. Daily, Special, and Weekly Missions now offer better quality Blueprints when choosing a Random Reward as the mission prize.

[h1]RANK UP REWARD REBALANCE[/h1]

The 8th January update is also working to improve how your efforts are rewarded for the EXP earned slaying Zombies and Humans alike. 

Not only are newcomers to CSN:Z getting better rewards for making new accounts, but all of the rank rewards are getting attention!
You earn these rewards by opening the Level Up Box from your Inventory. Each Level Up Box contains rewards, and the next rank’s Level Up Box for you to work towards.

Among the rewards are more crafting materials, male classes found in the Item Shop, and items to help you stay alive in Zombie Scenario. There are other rewards to be had, including the occasional JANUS\BALROG\SKULL weapons for certain ranks!

[h1]CRAFTING OUTCOME REBALANCE[/h1]

Henry and the CSN:Z Team have kept a close eye on Crafting at the end of 2014. Players may recall details about high-powered weapon series getting attention in their Crafting frequency for our 2014 Xmas updates!

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2015/0108/15.jpg[/img]

There’s been more work behind the scenes for our 8th January update. While we can’t divulge the secrets of the process (Henry may be taking that to his grave…) please stop by the Craft menu to check out our work towards getting the right weapons in your zombie-slaying hands.

Need a refresher? Check our Henry’s Crafting Essentials Guide:
http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=353139785

Let us know how you’re enjoying the latest update to CSN:Z on the Steam Forums, Facebook, and Twitter!
https://www.facebook.com/en.CSNZ
https://www.facebook.com/pl.CSNZ
https://twitter.com/CSN_Z

notes.content:

Dear soldiers, 

We would like to invite you to join a new adventure in Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies, where you can compete globally with users from all over the world.

The Turkey service will be available on Steam from 22nd December 2014. 
The fully localized client will be released in the first quarter of 2015. To show our gratitude for your support, we have prepared great gifts for all formal Counter-Strike Online players.

notes.title: Merry CSN:Z Giveaways – SKULL Series PERMANENT and festive Xmas Series Weapons!
notes.content:
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/temp/2014/1212/Dec2014SKULL.jpg[/img]

The Christmas season has many traditions with both the prospect of surprise gifts and obnoxious decorations amongst them. Starting on 20th December, CSN:Z will do its part to celebrate such time honored traditions, but without the deceivingly wrapped socks or suspicious holiday fruitcake.

[h1]PERMANENT SKULL-SERIES WEAPON GIVEAWAY[/h1]

[b]Starting on 20th December and ending 7th January[/b], each day between 14:00 CET and 22:00 CET, there will be players randomly selected to receive PERMANENT SKULL series weapons for free! (That’s 08:00 to 16:00 EST for our USA players.)

All of our current SKULL Series weapons will be given away repeatedly during the event (1, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 11). 

[img]http://s17.postimg.org/oyk86tr3j/image.png[/img]

While the event is active, 9 players will each be awarded a single random SKULL Series weapon for PERMANENT, repeated every 2 hours. Hundreds of players will get their hands on these Zombie slaying weapons!

Winners of weapons will be stated in game as they are selected via text announcements made by the game server in the chat log.

[h1]FREE CHRISTMAS WEAPONS DAILY[/h1]

Seeing as skulls are not common Christmas decorations, The CSN:Z Team needed to compensate with some large caliber festive firearm decorating. 

[img]http://s18.postimg.org/kvw3esn09/image.png[/img]

[b]From 20th December through 7th January[/b], CSN:Z will be awarding players a Christmas weapon each day. By being logged in at 18:00, 20:00, and 22:00 CET (That’s 09:00, 11:00, and 13:00 EST for our USA players.), you will receive one of the following weapons randomly: 

-- Christmas M95 
-- Christmas MG3 
-- Christmas M134 
-- Christmas MG36 
-- Christmas Winchester 
-- Christmas Spray

Xmas items awarded are for 1 Day duration, but you can receive more prizes at the awarding times every day of the event! Keep playing CSN:Z from 20th December through 7th January to keep your stocking stuffed with these special Xmas series items.

Make sure to follow CSN:Z on Steam, Facebook, and Twitter for the latest updates.
https://www.facebook.com/en.CSNZ
https://twitter.com/CSN_Z

notes.title: Merry CSN:Z
notes.content:
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/steam/main_banner/2014/1216/en.jpg[/img]

Merry Christmas, CSN:Z! New PERMANENT Female Classes, Free PERMANENT SKULL Series Weapons, 50% Off Sale, and More!

Have you been logging in every day for your free Blueprint [S] and crafting materials? How many weapons have you upgraded to earn your free PERMANENT upgraded variant? The whole CSN:Z Team hopes you’ve been enjoying our big events for the end of 2014, but there’s still more for December!

[h1]NEW PERMANENT FEMALE CLASSES[/h1]
[img]http://s21.postimg.org/t8nl2jwhj/image.png[/img]

[img]http://s30.postimg.org/ackfbhtk1/image.png[/img]

CSN:Z is getting some new dangerous combatants for December: Ritsuka is joining forces with the Terrorists, and Ji Yoon Choi is enlisting with the Counter-Terrorists.

Starting 16th December, these two skilled warriors are available for PERMANENT durations in the Item Shop for a cash purchase.
You can purchase them individually or get both Ritsuka and Ji Yoon Choi in a combined bundle. These classes will not be available forever, so get them while you can! 

[h1]50% OFF FOR THE HOLIDAYS[/h1]
Starting 16th December and ending 31st December, take advantage of 50% off select cash items in the Item Shop! Gift your friends in CSN:Z with crafting bundles for some seasonal generosity, or just grab some for yourself with any Steam Wallet Cards you get in your Christmas stocking this year. It’s a great time to stock up on those 30x Crafting Bundles to build a merry arsenal.
NOTE: 50% off sale does not apply to classes Ritsuka, Ji Yoon Choi, or the bundle containing these classes.

[h1]PERMANENT SKULL-SERIES WEAPON GIVEAWAY[/h1]
Some CSN:Z players are going to be very lucky this holiday season…

Starting on 20th December and ending 7th January, each day between 14:00 CET and 22:00 CET, there will be players randomly selected to receive PERMANENT SKULL series weapons for free! (That’s 08:00 to 16:00 EST for our USA players.)

Every 2 hours during the event’s active time, 9 players will each be awarded a single random SKULL series weapon for PERMANENT. Hundreds of lucky players will get a free PERMANENT SKULL series weapon just for playing CSN:Z this holiday season!

[img]http://s17.postimg.org/oyk86tr3j/image.png[/img]

Santa isn’t the only one bringing goodies and gifts this December, and his presents won’t be half as good for killing Zombies. Make sure to drop by every day of the event for the best chances to be selected!

[h1]FREE CHRISTMAS WEAPONS DAILY[/h1]
Hanging Christmas lights can be dangerous, especially if the conditions are icy! Play it safe and decorate guns with CSN:Z instead.

From 20th December through 7th January, CSN:Z will be awarding players a Christmas weapon each day. By being logged in at 18:00, 20:00, and 22:00 CET, you will receive one of the following weapons randomly:

-- Christmas M95
-- Christmas MG3
-- Christmas M134
-- Christmas MG36
-- Christmas Winchester
-- Christmas Spray

[img]http://s18.postimg.org/kvw3esn09/image.png[/img]

For our USA players, these times are 12:00, 14:00, and 16:00 EST.

Stop by CSN:Z daily to celebrate the season with irresponsibly decorated high caliber firearms!

[h1]Xmas Crafter Booster! – 6x more likely to get BALROG, JANUS and SKULL Weapons![/h1]
Did you ask for a BALROG-XI, JANUS-7, or SKULL-9 from Santa this year? Probably should have left the milk and cookies out for Henry instead. He’s hitting the workbench hard this holiday season to get even more BALROG, JANUS, and SKULL weapons in your hands for Christmas! 

From 16th December you will far more likely receive BALROG, JANUS and SKULL weapons from crafting. During this event, the odds of crafting one of these powerful weapons will be SIX TIMES more likely! 
[img]http://s13.postimg.org/m6frvjbpj/image.png[/img]

notes.title: Report #12: Sandstorm
notes.content:
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/promotion/2014/1114/4.jpg[/img]

This is the story behind Counter Strike Nexon: Zombies 
Expose the truth behind the mysterious appearance of zombies and the outbreak of the Z-Virus in the CS world. 
Make sure to follow all of the reports we publish in order to get to the bottom of the story. 
************** 
[h1]Report #12: Sandstorm[/h1]

While the [b]Investigation Team[/b] was fighting against zombies and bosses, the Transport Team was carrying the Sample of [b]Prototype Phobos[/b] across the desert. On their way, they were attacked by unknown enemies who had both elite soldiers and air weapons. 

[b]Victor[/b] decided they had better split up into two groups. The group who were carrying the Sample retreated to the back, and the other group had to fight against the enemies. 

Surprisingly, they also brought a [b]Comanche[/b] to attack, but troops succeeded to destroy it by securing the abandoned building.

notes.title: Permanent Weapon Upgrades, New Classes, and More!
notes.content:
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/steam/main_banner/2014/1128/en.jpg[/img]

Avoid the crowds this holiday shopping weekend and score some amazing deals in Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies! Of course, this isn’t just a weekend to take advantage of retail stores, online games, and Gabe Newell offering incredible discounts. For our players in the USA, this weekend is also a time to give thanks.

What better way to give thanks than with new guns, new features, and some great events for scoring free rewards?

[h1]PERMANENT UPGRADEABLE WEAPONS [/h1]
[From 27th November to 30th December]

Blueprints can now craft new weapons, and these weapons can be upgraded into even more powerful versions. After all, why stop at Double Barrels when you can upgrade to Triple Barrels? That’s just science.
By scoring kills with below, you can upgrade them into new and improved versions.

The following are the points required to complete each upgrade:
-[b]Minigun[/b]: 3,000 kill points will upgrade to a Minigun Predator
-[b]Combat Knife[/b]: 1,000 kill points will upgrade to a Master Combat Knife
-[b]Kriss Super V[/b]: 2,000 kill points will upgrade to a Double Kriss Super V
-[b]Double Barrel[/b]: 1,000 kill points will upgrade to a Triple Barrel
-[b]SL8[/b]: 2,000 kill points will upgrade to an SL8 Custom
-[b]Dual Infinity[/b]: 2,000 kill points will upgrade to a Dual Infinity Custom 
-[b]Dual Infinity Custom[/b]: 3,000 kill points will upgrade to a Dual Infinity Final

Please observe the following rules and details concerning weapon upgrading:
-Zombie Modes (Original, Mutant, Hero) award 15 for killing a Zombie, and 5 for killing a Human.
-Zombie Scenario awards 1 point for each kill.


[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2014/1127/14.jpg[/img]

…But it’s not just an upgrade. [u]If you complete an upgrade on a weapon you’ve crafted, that weapon will become permanent![/u] As it’s always been in CSN:Z, this means you can put those free crafting materials you earn towards these new permanent weapons.

[h1]BLACK FRIDAY SALE – 70% OFF CASH ITEMS[/h1]

Now is the time to stock up on Crafting bundles and Classes from [b]27th November through 4th December[/b] with [u]70% off of select Cash Items[/u].
Remember, you can pick up Crafting bundles in 10x and 30x amounts that offer even further savings over buying bundles individually.

[h1]DAILY FREE [S] CLASS BLUEPRINT[/h1]

…But it’s not just a free permanent upgrade. We’re giving away [S] Class Blueprints every day from[b] 27th November through 14th December[/b]. Drop in to CSN:Z every day to collect the top tier of Blueprints available in the game and try to get yourself the new upgradeable weapons!

[h1]CRAFT YOUR WAY TO FREE UPGRADABLE WEAPONS[/h1]

…But can there still be even more to these upgradable weapons?
Yes! From [b]27th November to 30th December[/b], successfully performing 7 Craftings with [S] Blueprints will immediately award you a 10 Day upgradable weapon of your choice. 

This event can be repeated, making it even easier to get yourself some PERMANENT upgraded weapons throughout this holiday season!

[h1]NEW CLASSES + 300,000 POINTS BUNDLES[/h1]
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2014/1127/3.jpg[/img]
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2014/1127/4.jpg[/img]
There are some new faces on the battlefield with CSN:Z’s latest update: Vigilante for TR, and Thunder Squad for CT.

Picking up these new classes from the Item Shop doesn’t just allow you to use a new look while fighting over hostages, these classes also offer a 10% bonus to EXP and Points rewards for using them in matches. On top of this 10% bonus, a whopping 300,000 Points is bundled with the purchased class to let the owner of these new warriors grab some Medical Kits, too!

[h1]SERIOUS SCENARIO SLAUGHTER! – Free Balrog, Janus, and SKULL Weapons for Zombie Scenario maps[/h1]
It’s nearly the holidays, so take a load off in CSN:Z! At least it will be a vacation for you because the Zombies won’t know what hit them with our latest event.

From [b]27th November through 30th December[/b], you can use some of the best Zombie slaying weapons in the game for specific Zombie Scenario maps at no cost and as much as you want.

Season 2, Poisonous Wound – BALROG-IX (Melee) 
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2014/1127/2.jpg [/img]
Season 2, Decoy – SKULL-5 (Rifle) 
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2014/1127/10.jpg[/img]
Season 2, Angra Nest – JANUS-7 (Machine Gun)
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2014/1127/11.jpg[/img]

Each weapon can only be used in its respective Zombie Scenario map, and these weapons will be removed 30th December.

[h1]BIG HEADS, EASY TARGETS[/h1]
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2014/1127/13.jpg[/img]

Big Headed Zombies! From 27.11 to 15.12, log into the game and receive Soi's Big Head Solution (3D) item. When you have this item and create a Zombie Scenario mode room, all Zombies, including bosses, will appear with large heads.

Aiming has never been so easy!

[h1]CHECK OUT THESE NEW ITEMS[/h1]

You’ll also encounter some new items in CSN:Z with this latest update to help you have a great time while filling zombies with lead.
--Special Mission Reset: if you end up assigned a Special Mission that you’re not fond of, use this item to receive a new Special Mission instantly! You can find this in the Item Shop for Points.
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2014/1127/5.jpg[/img]
-- Item Extension Coupon: add days of duration to items already in your inventory to help keep your favorite guns around longer. This new item is obtained by disassembling items in the Craft menu.
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2014/1127/6.jpg[/img]
--Detailed Damage Display: with this item in your inventory, both damage dealt and received will be outlined in detail on your HUD during gameplay.  You can find this in the Item Shop for Points.
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2014/1127/7.jpg[/img]
--Nickname Change: whether your friends all want to use themed names, or you’re having second thoughts about “pwnMSTR1337”, a Nickname Change item allows you to assign a new name to your character. You can find this item in the Item Shop for Cash.
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2014/1127/8.jpg[/img]

[h1]BIGTIME BATTLEFIELD SUPPLY[/h1]

Make sure to stop by every day from [b]November 27th through December 30th [/b]to get some huge gifts from CSN:Z and the Battlefield Supply system.
For the holidays, Battlefield Supply has been updated to award the Zombie class Deimos for 20 days on the 6th day, and the PKM Machine Gun for 20 days on the 7th day.
That’s not all, because it wouldn’t be proper festivities without some surprises! In addition, from November 27th through December 30th there are three incredible prizes added to Random Reward;
--72 Day-Permanent Durable (1x)
--The MG3 Machine Gun for 90 Days
-- …and the badass [b]AWP RED[/b] Sniper Rifle for PERMANENT duration!
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2014/1127/12.jpg[/img]
Every day of collecting your Battlefield Supply Reward is another chance you could get some great loot this holiday season!

[h1]GROZA ENHANCEABLE![/h1]

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2014/1127/9.jpg[/img]
Starting 27th November, you can now apply Enhancements to the Groza rifle when it is in your inventory.  Pick up bundles of Normal Enhancement Material from the Item Shop for Points and try boosting the Groza’s stats if you craft it!

notes.title: Welcome packages for new players
notes.content:
Dear Survivors,
We are happy to welcome all of the new players to Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies.
Every new user who logs into the game after 27th November will receive the following items to get prepared for the battle and go through Zombie Scenario with less difficulties.

[h1]50 Round Retry[/h1]
-	If you've failed a mission during Scenario Mode, press the R key to start the round again with all members at their optimum state.

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/client/announcemnet/2014/1127/notice/1.jpg[/img]

[h1]50 Battle Revival[/h1]
-	Press the R key when you die in Scenario Mode and you will respawn.

notes.title: PATCH NOTES - 11-27 Content Update
notes.content:
In addition to new content added to Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies for the end of year holidays, changes have been made to address feedback and problems reported by the CSN:Z Community.


Design Changes: 
•If you leave a Family, now only 2 days are required before being able to join a new Family (instead of 2 weeks).
•Upgrading a Zombie Class now only requires 5 skills to be raised to at least Level 5 first.
•Rankings for new players have been rebalanced, with less EXP required per rank through Lv. 10.
--NOTE: This design change may result in your rank level being higher following the update.
•Recipe slots have been removed from the Crafting menu as the CSN:Z Team makes further changes to improve Crafting.

Bug Fixes: 
•Added support for 1366x768 and 1360x768 game resolutions during gameplay.
•Set CSN:Z window to a borderless mode when game is launched on smaller sized windows desktops.
•Corrected incorrect name of Zombie Scenario boss from “Seize” to “Siege”.
•Corrected reward notifications for certain Scenario maps stating the wrong map completed.

Other Details: 
•Made general improvements to text through game for all supported languages.

notes.title: Report #11: Dead End
notes.content:
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/promotion/2014/1114/3.jpg[/img]
This is the story behind Counter Strike Nexon: Zombies 
Expose the truth behind the mysterious appearance of zombies and the outbreak of the Z-Virus in the CS world. 
Make sure to follow all of the reports we publish in order to get to the bottom of the story.
**************
[h1]Report #11: Dead End[/h1] 
Right after the Investigation Team finished combatting Siege Type Phobos, other troops finally succeeded to capture Siege Type Oberon, who had escaped from the laboratory. 

Survivors were assembled in the construction site to secure the area, but Siege Type Oberon absorbed Siege Type Dione and escaped from them. Survivors had to fight against Siege Type Oberon again, and this time they succeeded to kill it. Troops successfully eliminated all Siege Type Bosses from the lab, and the nightmare in the Lost City was finally over.
 
Siege Type Oberon’s capability to absorb other zombies was astonishing, and in fact, the most amazing ability discovered so far. No other information concerning Siege Type Oberon could be found.

notes.title: Want free Permanent Guns? Just Name It!
notes.content:
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/steam/main_banner/2014/1117/en.jpg[/img]

Feeling a little sluggish as the days get shorter, the temperature drops, and all that extra Halloween candy is bogging you down?
[h1]Bet some free permanent guns and crafting materials would perk you right up![/h1]

Not to worry, CSN:Z is going to make it easy. Take a break from the autumn chill to get yourself the 4 new Battle series weapons [b](Glock 18C, FAMAS, Galil, and Hunting Dagger)[/b] and top grade crafting materials [b]( [S] Grade-2 Blueprint, [S] Grade-3 Blueprint, and 72-Permanent Durable)![/b]

Playing in our Just Name It! event is as easy as, well, playing! Collect letters to complete the names of the prizes as you play Original, Zombie Scenario, or any of the game modes in CSN:Z. Letters are awarded to you randomly as you score PvE or PvP kills in any mode.

Redeem all of the needed letters to complete the name of the prize and it’s yours to keep. Some prizes will use the same letters, or will require more than one of the same letter, requiring you to collect more than one of some letters to complete the whole list of prizes.

“Com’on Nexon! I don’t like RNG; it’s out to get me!”
Don’t you fret! In addition to the letters, Joker Pieces are included in this event can help tip the odds in your favor. A Joker Piece can be used in place of any letter to help you complete a prize’s name.
[b]Joker Pieces[/b] can be obtained in the same way as letters, or by logging in on at least 10 of the days during this event to receive 5 Joker Pieces instantly! Don’t forget to stop by CSN:Z every day to get those 5 Joker Pieces.

Make sure to take a break from the cold to collect those letters, as the Just Name It! event is only lasting from [b]November 20th through December 3rd.[/b] We recommend extra socks and hot cocoa for staying cozy as you mow down Zombies with your new permanent Battle series weapons.

But hey, that November chill has been affecting The CSN:Z Team, too! Removing discounts is a lot of work, and it's too cold for changing prices. [h1][b]We're extending our -50% sale in the Cash Shop all the way to November 27th[/b], keeping the discounts on both Crafting bundles and Classes around a little longer. Stock up and bundle up![/h1]

notes.title: Report #9 Last Clue
notes.content:
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/promotion/2014/1114/1.jpg[/img]
This is the story behind Counter Strike Nexon: Zombies 
Expose the truth behind the mysterious appearance of zombies and the outbreak of the Z-Virus in the CS world. 
Make sure to follow all of the reports we publish in order to get to the bottom of the story.
**************
Report #9: Last Clue
By the time Counter-Terrorist Forces dispatched the extraction forces after receiving a back up request from the leading team, it was too late. They had already been eradicated, and there were no survivors. 

Andrey's journal was found in the hands of his cold, dead body, a record which he protected right until the end. Inside, a lot of information was found about Lost City incidents. Andrey also recorded what Dr. Rex mumbled at the last battle on the roof top, and it helped the extraction forces to find Dr. Rex's Laboratory. 

The extraction forces decided to take the risk and head to Dr. Rex's Laboratory, in hopes of finding the leading team’s trail. When Dr. Rex heard the news that the extraction forces are trying to break into his laboratory, he released the Prototype Phobos and escaped the laboratory.

After severe battle, the extraction forces eliminated the Prototype Phobos and secured the Sample.

Prototype Phobos was the first massive, named, type boss that the extraction forces fought. It was still a prototype, nevertheless, it was powerful. As a result of a lengthy mutation, it had very hard skin which was nearly impossible to penetrate, as well as remarkable speed and power. It was one of the finest Zombies.

notes.title: [NOTICE] Daily Crafting Boost Issues - Compensation Nov. 18th
notes.content:
UPDATE:

On Tuesday November 18th, The CSN:Z Team plans to compensate players for the days in which they were eligible for the event's items but failed to receive them.

For this compensation, each day (Saturday, Sunday, Monday) will be measured with the Central Europe Timezone (CET). 
As reference for the US, this means the 24hour window for each daily event login will be tracked from 6pm Eastern Standard Time (EST).

We apologize for this inconvenience and thank everyone for their continued support. This announcement will be updated again when rewards have been issued to eligible players.

----------------------------------

This weekend, CSN:Z featured an event for awarding crafting bundle to players who log in on each day from November 14th through November 17th. Players have reported issues with this event, where players failed to receive the bundle of crafting items every day of the event.

The CSN:Z Team will investigate the issue and award compensation to those who were eligible for the 'Daily Crafting Boost' bundle but failed to receive it. This compensation will be issued at a future date and we will update the community when that date is known.

Those who were affected should have received double the bundle for every day they failed to receive it; 6x Blueprints, 6x Durables, and 38,400 points per day affected.

UPDATE: Compensation was sent to on 11/18/2014 @5PM CET. All the items should be available in your inventory.

notes.title: CSN:Z New Zombies, 50% Sale and events!
notes.content:
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/steam/main_banner/2014/1105/en.jpg[/img]

It seems like only yesterday we officially launched Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies, because really, we’re just getting started! Fans of CSN:Z have been voicing their wishes, loud and clear, on our forums, Facebook, and Twitter. We've worked to address some of those reports and requests in our latest update, in addition to expanding on our exclusive Zombie classes and ways to earn guns through new events!

[h1]BIG CASH SHOP SAVINGS[/h1]
After a great first month, it's about time we celebrated with some discounts on the Crafting and Class items available in our Shop!
At least, we see it as good enough a reason to get some big sales up for everyone to enjoy.

From November 5th through November 19th, pick up Crafting bundles in the shop at 50% off! We're also offering a whopping 75% off of the Chinese Devils and National Liberation CT and TR classes, which both include 200,000 points when purchased!

[h1]NEW ZOMBIE CLASSES[/h1]
Some truly fearsome creatures are joining the ranks of the undead with the latest update. Meet Deimos and Ganymede.

[h1]VOTE-TO-KICK[/h1]
With the Vote-To-Kick item, players can now employ a little more control over troublesome players during gameplay.

Vote-To-Kick can be purchased for Points in the Item Shop. We'll post a Guide that covers all the details of how Vote Kicking works in the CSN:Z Community Hub. Check it out to learn more!

[h1]COSTUME CLOCK IN EVENT[/h1] 
We’re bringing back the Clock In Event. It’s as easy as logging in, but with a new prize! 5th - 19th November

The Costume Box may contain a Costume item (Pumpkin Head, Ghost Back, Angel Halo, Angel Wings, Devil Horn, Devil Wings, or Devil Tail [at 3 Days or Permanent]), or a random amount of points (2,000 – 10,000 Points).

Awards are issued at login, at the 1 hour mark, and at the 2 hour mark. All time counts towards the event, whether you’re playing in a match or organizing your Buy Menu Favorites!

[h1]BATTLEFIELD SUPPLY[/h1] 
With the latest update, Battlefield Supply has been updated to offer a full arsenal of weaponry! Just log in each day, click the “Receive Reward” button, and earn free items. 5th November - 3rd December

What would we do without zombies in CSN:Z? All the maps of Season 2 Zombie Scenario will be unlocked after the 5th November.

Hurry up and pick your favorite map in the exciting zombie quests of Zombie Scenario!

notes.title: Report #8: The Lost City
notes.content:
[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/promotion/2014/1028/banner4.jpg[/img]
This is the story behind Counter Strike Nexon: Zombies 
Expose the truth behind the mysterious appearance of zombies and the outbreak of the Z-Virus in the CS world. 
Make sure to follow all of the reports we publish in order to get to the bottom of the story. 
**************

[h1]Report #8: The Lost City[/h1]
The Leading Team fought against zombies in the [b]Lost City[/b], a large number of whom weren’t easy to force to retreat. They built a wall to slow down the zombies, but it wasn't enough. 

The Leading Team called for back up, but they couldn't reach HQ. While they were re-organizing their troops in the safe area, they spotted two strange people. Members of the team tried to talk to them, but the two ran away, leaving some radio equipment behind. 

[b]Leading Team forces[/b] collected the equipment, but they didn't know whether the equipment would help or hurt them, so they took the risk and set it up anyway on the roof. Over the airwaves, they heard a mysterious voice introduced himself as Dr. Rex. Within an instant, the zombies were there and successfully infected the team.

The Lost City was once a small town in North America. There were many factories and warehouses, but most were closed as a result of a long recession. Since the Lost City was abandoned, it was the perfect place for Dr. Rex to carry out his research. 

[b]Erika[/b] was originally from the extraction team, but she was saved by [b]David Black[/b]. Erika was the only survivor of the Lost City.

David thinks it was not just a coincidence. He is certain that there is something special about Erika, for her to have joined AFC with him.

notes.content:

[h1]Report #7: Aegis Institute[/h1]
When Counter-Terrorists realized that zombies had been mass produced by Dr. Rex, they decided to put an end to it. They founded [b]Aegis Institute[/b] for zombie research and invented anti-zombie weapons. In addition, they assembled the [b]Annihilation Forces[/b] to declare war against the zombies. 

[b]Aegis Institute[/b] consists of top scientists from around the world who are not only experts in science, but also in weapons. They are trying their best to produce anti-zombie weapons for the forces, as well as finding the cure. 

[b]Senior Researcher[/b] Soy might be young, but she has valuable expertise in producing massive weapons. She is currently developing ammo that is so powerful that it can stop zombies for good. Her invention is expected to be one of the most powerful weapons at Aegis Institute.

No one seems sure about Dr. Rex. If the rumor is true, that he is helping the Counter-Terrorists, than at least he is not an enemy.

[b]Aegis Institute[/b] was maintaining neutrality between Counter-Terrorists and Terrorists from the beginning. This kind of action made it possible for those two factions to carry out their missions. 

Especially for AFC David Black and PMC Gerard, the main forces who made it possible to carry out co-op operations.

[h1]Report #6: Beginning of the Nightmare[/h1]
In order to succeed with the Super Soldier Project, Dr. Rex started to create a massive number of zombies in a closed factory, called Abyss 3, at the outskirts of the city. notes.title: Ranking System - How it works
notes.content:
Dear Survivors,
We know that you are curious about Ranking System details.
Please find answers to your questions in the FAQ section below, that we’ve prepared for you.

[h1]What is the League Ranking System?[/h1]
- Players will be assigned to certain groups based on their current levels. 
The group will be assembled with similar level players, and they will have to compete against each other in the group.
Players who have reached high ranks will be promoted to higher level groups, and players who are in lower levels will be demoted to the lower level groups.

[h1]How is the league formed?[/h1]
- There are a total of 4 leagues, according to the League Modes: 
Original League, Zombie League, Zombie Scenario League, and Death Match League.
Each league will have 5 groups, each group will have 
4 small groups, except Headquarters.
Headquarters is where the highest level players compete.

[h1]How many players can join a group?[/h1]
- Normally 20 players will be in a group to compete each other.

[h1]When do I get promoted?[/h1]
- You will either be promoted or demoted once a week (every Monday, 06:00 CET). 1st - 3rd Rank players will be promoted to the next group, and the 3 lowest level players will be demoted.

[h1]What is the Hall of Fame?[/h1]
- The player who ranked 1st in the Headquarters League will be recorded in the Hall of Fame.

[h1]How can I check my friend's ranking?[/h1]
- You can check your friend's ranking by using the search function or by right-clicking on their nickname.

[h1]How can I check other players' rankings?[/h1]
- Press the Tab key during the game, and you will be able to see emblem images for each group.

notes.title: Report #5: Dr. Rex's Zombie Research
notes.content:
[b][img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/promotion/2014/1028/banner1.jpg[/img][/b]
This is the story behind Counter Strike Nexon: Zombies 
Expose the truth behind the mysterious appearance of zombies and the outbreak of the Z-Virus in the CS world. 
Make sure to follow all of the reports we publish in order to get to the bottom of the story. 
**************

[h1]Report #5: Dr. Rex's Zombie Research[/h1]
After some time of obsessing over his research, Dr. Rex lost all sense of reality. His obsession neared him closer and closer to lunacy, until his plunge into the deep end after his failure on the 1st Super Solider Project.
He couldn't accept his failure.
It wasn't easy for him to continue his research, since his lab was destroyed by terrorists. After that harsh blow, he got yet another one when the government stopped funding his research entirely. He was the only one left to support himself now. He had to spend every last piece of money he had for his research.
 
When Dr. Rex could no longer acquire test subjects from official routes, he had to continue his research with other corpses, until one day, he finally created Heavy Zombies.
Heavy Zombies had different parts from several corpses.
Light Zombies were created from the weakest bodies. Originally, its purpose was to test the Enhancement Limits.
The Dr. Rex Virus started to mutate.
There was no change in the strength of those infected, however, their flexibility and agility were enhanced.
Dr. Rex found that the results differ depending on the test subject.
And he used that fact to further his research.

notes.title: Report #4: The Rex Virus
notes.content:
This is the story behind Counter Strike Nexon: Zombies
Expose the truth behind the mysterious appearance of zombies and the outbreak of the Z-Virus in the CS world.
Make sure to follow all of the reports we publish in order to get to the bottom of the story.
**************
[h1]Report #4: The Rex Virus[/h1]
[b][img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/promotion/20141021/4.jpg[/img][/b]
After hitting a roadblock in his research for the Super Soldier Project, one day, Dr. Rex received a private report from an anonymous informer. This report revealed that mutant, powerful animated corpses, referred to as zombies, had existed in Europe decades ago.
Dr. Rex was invigorated by the private report. He sent his team to bring back the excavated bodies, set up a secret laboratory below ground, and began studying the corpses. 
He continued, obsessively, for months with his horrible study.
Dr. Rex eventually succeeded in formulating the Rex Virus, which enhances the strongest power in the human body, without any pain to that human.
However, there was a side effect... Upon infection by the virus, the human would become a zombie. These zombies had no self-consciousness and their sole purpose was to murder all humans – regardless of their association with Terrorists or Counter-Terrorists.
For Dr. Rex, consciousness was an important prerequisite for using his high-tech battle gear, so he couldn’t have mindless zombies being equipped with that much power.
In the end, he decided that his experiment had failed and sealed the secret underground laboratory for good.

[h1]Report #3: The Rex Laboratory and the Super Soldier Project[/h1]

The Rex Laboratory is most commonly known as an institute for the production of American military weapons, but there is more going on behind closed doors.

[b]Dr. Steve Rex[/b], the director of the institute, is one of the foremost authorities in the field of bio-engineering and mechanical engineering, and is leading the classified Super Soldier Project.

[b][img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/promotion/20141021/3.jpg[/img][/b]

[h1]Report #3: The Rex Laboratory and the Super Soldier Project[/h1]

The Rex Laboratory is most commonly known as an institute for the production of American military weapons, but there is more going on behind closed doors.

[b]Dr. Steve Rex[/b], the director of the institute, is one of the foremost authorities in the field of bio-engineering and mechanical engineering, and is leading the classified Super Soldier Project.

Dr. Rex is developing very powerful “[b]Super Soldiers[/b]” in a classified area, whose sole purpose are to defeat Terrorists.

However, due to limited strength and endurance, none of the soldiers have been able to control Dr. Rex's high-tech battle gear. As a result, it has been impossible to complete the Super Soldier Project.

Dr. Rex assessed that the human body has limited capacities and he is looking for a way to overcome this obstacle.

notes.content:
This is the story behind Counter Strike Nexon: Zombies

Expose the truth behind the mysterious appearance of zombies and the outbreak of the Z-Virus in the CS world.
Make sure to follow all of the reports we publish in order to get to the bottom of the story.

      [img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/promotion/20141021/2.jpg[/img]

[h1]Report #2: The appearance of Terrorists and Counter-Terrorists[/h1]

There seemed to be a moment of peace after the Cold War era, but the imbalanced distribution of power across the globe caused both political and economic crises to occur simultaneously.

After receiving excessive benefits and choosing not to distribute them proportionately, the government began facing harsh backlash from Terrorist organizations.

The main goal of the Terrorists was to break down the government's power in order for society to start anew, on fair and even ground. However, the peace they envisioned was inevitably corrupted and threatened. To stop the Terrorists, Counter-Terrorist forces were founded in each country.

Conflicts between Terrorists and Counter-Terrorists gradually intensified…
In this war-like atmosphere, officials began investing more in War Technology research.
