notes.title: Report #1: The Heorgen Case
notes.content:
[b]This is the story behind Counter Strike Nexon: Zombies[/b]

Expose the truth behind the mysterious appearance of zombies and the outbreak of the Z-Virus in the CS world.

Make sure to follow all of the reports we publish in order to get to the bottom of the story.

[img]http://csnzimage.nexoneu.com/promotion/20141021/1.jpg[/img]
*****************************************************************************************************

[h1]Report #1: The Heorgen Case[/h1]

For generations, the isolated townspeople of Heorgen survived under tyrannical rulers. In an attempt to overthrow the oppressive regime, an illicit spiritual group was founded.

This group met regularly in cellars, and focused their energies on worshipping witches, whom they believed could deliver them from their seemingly endless subjugation. However, they were eventually discovered.

The leaders, to maintain their harsh and pervasive authority over the people, sent torturers to infiltrate the gathering place and brutally murder the worshippers. The mutilated bodies were displayed in the town square for months in order to further instill fear in the townspeople and to deter similar assemblies from founding.

Over time, a mutant bacteria appeared upon one of the twisted corpses. This bacteria originally caused the muscles of the rotting body to pulsate slowly, but over time its movements became stronger, and more apparent. The corpse began standing, was destructive and fearless, and its mental state was nothing more than that of an aggressive wasp.

The first to be attacked by this animated corpse were the torturers. They were bitten and bludgeoned to death.
Then, the same bacterial mutation occurred in one of the corpses of the former torturers, and then them all, and that is how the virus began spreading from one body to another. Eventually, all the dead bodies rose up and terrorized the town. Before long, the town was covered in walking dead. There were no survivors.

The European Union took drastic action to stop the critical incident in [b]Heorgen. [/b]
These walking dead were officially categorized as 'zombies', and to prevent the widespread risk of infection, the EU isolated the town completely, and intelligence officials classified this as a top secret case. 
Furthermore, high-ranking troops who had taken oaths of secrecy were dispatched to the remote town and ordered to destroy the zombies at all costs.

From that point on, all records referring to those zombies and to the town of Heorgen were completely destroyed.

notes.title: CSN:Z Steam Achievements – Further Work Needed
notes.content:
Our most recent update to CSN:Z had addressed a number of issues to follow up on player reports and improve the overall experience. One of which was Steam Achievements failing to award for CSN:Z.

Players alerted us to these issues persisting with Steam Achievements, and we’ve confirmed that this is not an issue on the player’s end and additional work is needed to correct this bug on our end.

The CSN:Z Team aims to have a fix CSN:Z’s Steam Achievements in early November. We are confident that your progress in CSN:Z from launch will be reflected in the Steam Achievements you should have earned.

notes.title: [Maintenance] 16.10.2014, COMPLETED! Servers are Open
notes.content:
We are going to perform a short maintenance on 16.10.2014 from 06:00 – 07:00 CEST. 

An update to CSN:Z is being released today to help address player reported issues and some further polish to the overall game.
We hope this resolves problems that players have been facing and improves the experience overall for everyone. Make sure to stop by the discussion forums to let us know how things are shaping up when you get a chance to play following the update!

Design Changes: 
•Increased the minimum possible damage to walls and obstructions in Zombie Scenario to improve how much time is required to pass blockades.
•Gifting in Shop has been re-enabled.
• Automatic selection of High-performance GPU on systems where multiple graphic cards are available

Bug Fixes: 
•Gifting to a player who is offline now fully processes.
•Applied fixes to properly enable Steam Achievement activation.
•Applied fixes to address potential crashing issues in Zombie Scenario.
•MP7A1 Extended Mag, SCAR 5.56 Limited , and XM-8 Carbine Limited can now be disassembled.
•Applied fixes to address lobby window displaying at incorrect resolutions.
•Improved Hackshield compatibility to address false-positive kicking.

Other Details: 
•Improved various text issues across all supported languages to address phrasing and display issues.
• Corrected Family Point Message 

-> upcoming next updates (not a final list):
- Full support for Norwegian Krone and Canadian Dollar
- Reconfiguration of Crafting Point Mechanics (need more time for testing and analysis) 
- Further improvements to Russian Servers
- Reported bug fixes

Regards, 
CSN:Z Team

notes.title: The Competitive Edge – Matchmaking Server
notes.content:
Let’s be honest, there’s an elephant in the room that needs addressing. And, no, CSN:Z is not introducing a pachyderm themed addition but then again there are some truly unique styles of play in FUN mode...

Counter-strike has a deep history with competitive FPS gaming, and while CSN:Z offers everything from the original CS to Zombie Escaping there’s a feature not getting put through its paces.

[h1]Time to get introduced to Matchmaking Server![/h1]

How you’ll play in the Matchmaking Server is a little different than the usual, but not by a whole lot. A key difference to understand is that game rooms are not freely selectable but instead are assigned by the server itself.

When in a Matchmaking Server you’ll see a “Play Game” tab near the top of the menu, and within this page of the Matchmaking Server you can select which mode of play you’ll be assigned to. For now we only offer Original mode gameplay to help players focus on understanding the basics of how the server works at CSN:Z’s launch. Clicking on the “Original” mode image will get you stated.

As this is an environment focused on competitive matches, it is to your benefit to get a good team assembled as the opposition may be just as organized! This is done with the Clan system in CSN:Z, which allows you to form a group of trusted team mates for exclusively the Matchmaking Server. It is separate from the Family system, so members of your Clan can be recruited from within or beyond a Family if you are a part of one.

To create a Clan, join the Matchmaking Server and choose the “Create Clan” button. You can invite members into your Clan both in any server by right clicking a player’s name from the lobby and choosing to send a Clan Invite.

Got a Clan? Got a Party formed in Matchmaking Server? Once you’ve been paired with an opposing team, the pressure is on as your performance is uniquely tracked in the Matchmaking Server! See where you stand by clicking the “Home” tab while in the Matchmaking Server, or see how others are ramping up their efforts in the Season Ranking tab.

[u]There’s no cost to create a Clan either![/u] Drop in on the Matchmaking Server and rise through the ranks of the best in CSN:Z.

notes.title: CSN:Z Trading Cards are now Live!
notes.content:
[h1]With CSN:Z being published exclusively on Steam, we felt it was a given that CSN:Z supports its [b]Trading Card system[/b].[/h1]

Please review the following FAQ to understand how this system works and what it gives to Steam users.

[b]What are Steam Trading Cards?[/b]
•	Steam Trading Cards are virtual cards earned by playing games on Steam. Collect a set of cards to earn items that help you customize your profile and show off your interest in CSN:Z.

[b]How does someone receive a card in Counter Strike Nexon: Zombies?[/b]
•	As CSN:Z is a Free-to-Play game, Trading Cards can be obtained after having made cash purchases in its Shop. Spending more in the CSN:Z shop on cash purchases enables more Trading Cards to be obtainable.

Once you've earned a possible Trading Card drop in CSN:Z, playing the game will randomly add cards to your Steam inventory automatically.

•	CSN:Z Trading Cards can also be traded with other Steam users, and purchased from the Steam Community Market if others are offering to sell them.

[b]What are Steam Badges?[/b]
•	Once you’ve collected a full set of cards (9 available in CSN:Z) you can craft them into a game badge. A badge is an icon on your profile (and it is tied to your account) that represents the trading card sets you've collected.

[b]How to craft a badge?[/b]
•	From your Profile page, click on the "Badges" link near the top of the right column or select "Badges" from your profile name drop down in the Steam menu. From your Badges page, the "Badges in Progress" tab will show which badges are ready to be crafted. Select a ready to craft badge to view its details and click on the blue "Craft a Badge" button.

[b]Are there different type of badges?[/b]
•	Each game has 6 types of badges: 5 levels of the standard badge, and the foil badge. When you craft a game's badge the first time, you'll receive the level 1 version of the badge. Crafting it again will upgrade the badge to level 2, and so on, up till level 5. Once you reach level 5, you cannot craft that game's cards into a badge again. The foil badge for a game can only be crafted once.

[b]How do I craft a foil badge?[/b]
•	In addition to the 5 levels of the standard badge, each trading card set has a foil badge. You earn the foil badge by completing a set of foil versions of the cards for that set. Foil cards are rarer than the standard cards, and thus the foil badge is much more difficult  to obtain.  

[b]Do I get anything from crafting a badge?[/b]
•	All badges give you XP which contributes to your Steam Level, a summary of your badge collection. Each level of a badge is worth 100 points of experience (so a level 5 badge is worth 500 experience.) If your Steam Level increases, the limit on the size of your friends list will be increased by five, and potentially you'll unlock the ability to customize your profile with showcases.

•	Most importantly crafting game badges earns you marketable game related items like:
[list]
	[*][b]CSN:Z emoticons [/b]- Steam emoticons can be used anywhere on Steam where you can type, like chat, discussion boards, and profiles (Note: emoticons do not function for CSN:Z's in-game channel and room chat), 
	[*][b]CSN:Z profile backgrounds[/b] that can be used to customize your profile with a background image. (5 in CSN:Z – 2 common, 2 uncommon, 1 rare). 
Level up your badge by collecting the set again and earn more items!
[/list]

[b]What is and how can I get a booster pack?[/b]
•	Once you have received all of your random card drops, you become eligible for a booster pack, which is a set of 3 trading cards that may include both basic and foil cards. Booster packs are granted randomly to eligible users as more badges are crafted by members of the community. Make sure you log in to Steam each week to maintain eligibility. 

[h1]Note: We also added Steam’s [b]CSN:Z avatars[/b] that can be used by anyone for free for their Steam Profile. [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/273110/Avatar/List]Check out the available avatars here[/url][/h1]

CSN:Z Team

•	Most importantly crafting game badges earns you marketable game related items like:
[list]
	[*][b]CSN:Z emoticons [/b]- Steam emoticons can be used anywhere on Steam where you can type, like chat, discussion boards, and profiles (Note: emoticons do not function for CSN:Z's in-game channel and room chat), 
	[*][b]CSN:Z profile backgrounds[/b] that can be used to customize your profile with a background image. (5 in CSN:Z – 2 common, 2 uncommon, 1 rare). 
Level up your badge by collecting the set again and earn more items!
[/list]

[b]What is and how can I get a booster pack?[/b]
•	Once you have received all of your random card drops, you become eligible for a booster pack, which is a set of 3 trading cards that may include both basic and foil cards. Booster packs are granted randomly to eligible users as more badges are crafted by members of the community. Make sure you log in to Steam each week to maintain eligibility. 

[h1]Note: We also added Steam’s [b]CSN:Z avatars[/b] that can be used by anyone for free for their Steam Profile. [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/273110/Avatar/List]Check out the available avatars here[/url][/h1]

CSN:Z Team

notes.title: Gifting Items Fix
notes.content:
Dear players,

We received reports from some players that the items they wanted to gift to their friends would never reach them. 

Fortunately, we managed to find the exact root of the issue:
[b]If the gift is sent while the other player is offline, the item will not be delivered at all.[/b] Right now we're working on an appropriate fix and we will patch the client as soon as possible after the weekend with rest of the fixes. Rest assured however that as soon as we patch the problem, we will manually resend all of the items; you won't have to do anything on your end. Additionally we will send a compensation for all affected players. You will be able to find those gifted items in the [My Info] tab of the [Storage]. 

We're sorry for the inconvenience. 

Thanks to your open feedback, we are able to catch all of the problems that might have slipped past our eyes, and find solutions.

We are very grateful for your support of CSN:Z and appreciate your patience as we continue to work on improving the game and resolving all issues. 

Regards, 
CSN:Z Team

notes.title: Shop Error – Weapon Package Grade-6 Compensation

Compensation for this error will be issued tomorrow on October 8th at roughly 8:00AM (CEST). We are very grateful for those who are supporting CSN:Z on our launch day and appreciate your patience as we resolve this shop issue.

notes.title: Now Available on Steam - Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies
notes.content:
Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies is Now Available on Steam!

Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies is a Free to Play MMOFPS offering competitive PvP and PvE action including content from the original Counter-Strike and all new game modes, maps, weapons, and hordes of Zombies!

notes.title: Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies is now Available!
notes.content:
[h1]Welcome to Official Launch of CSN:Z![/h1]

We hope you are ready to enjoy the game and events.

For those who had the chance to join in on the Open Beta of CSN:Z, you’ll notice changes have been made with the latest version of CSN:Z available at launch. Take a look over the following list to get a quick outline of what changes you can expect.

To everyone else who’s joining CSN:Z for the first time with our official launch, you are still welcome to look over the following changes, as The CSN:Z Team really can’t stop you from doing so.

[b]Design Changes:[/b]
•Synthesis of Crafting materials no longer requires a fee of Points.
•Disassembly of items no longer requires a fee of Points.
•Leaving a match in progress no longer incurs a penalty of points.
•Lobby UI is now permanently in windowed mode. Video settings for fullscreen and different resolutions are applied when entering gameplay.
•Length of chat messages increased to 60.
•List of Daily Missions updated to include more 

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
•Quick Start button now correctly searches for matching game rooms when player is not already inside a channel.
•Music no longer missing from Challenge maps.
•Non-functional Find option for rooms list has been removed.
•Buy Menu for Terrorist SMGs no longer shows an MG or other incorrect weapons for its 2nd slot.

[b]Other Details:[/b]
•Improved instructions for Crafting menus to help players learn about different grades of quality for Crafting materials.
•Added color coding to game mode names to help players browsing through the list of game rooms.
•Altered appearance of buttons for in game Buy menu to direct players to important functions.
•Changed which pages appear first for Crafting and Mission menus to help direct users to most commonly used pages.
•Secondary Password system disabled for Crafting menus.

notes.title: Smarter Crafting - Synthesis
notes.content:
Not all [b]Crafting materials[/b] are alike! This isn’t some snowflake comparison being made here, the [b]Durables[/b] and [b]Blueprints[/b] you collect impact both the odds of a successful Crafting and how long that weapon will last should it be successful.

Durables state the range of possible durations right in the name and description. With Blueprints, its grade will state how likely it will be successful ([b]S[/b] and [b]A[/b] being very high, [b]E[/b] and [b]D[/b] being very low).

Of course you want to hand over the best Crafting materials to Henry, but what’s a Zombie killing mercenary to do with poor quality materials?
[b]Synthesize![/b]  It’s not just a corporate buzz word.

Visit the Synthesis section of the Crafting menu to turn low-odds, short duration materials into higher quality goods. The Synthesis menu will let you combine identical Durables and Blueprints into better quality materials. All you need are spare, identical materials to get the process going!

Synthesize your Crafting materials to meet your needs, whether its grabbing a gun for the weekend or working your way up to the highest qualities of Durables and Materials for your Zombie Killing duties!

notes.title: More than just GIGN! Characters of CSN:Z
notes.content:
You’ll find all the [b]original characters of Counter-Strike[/b] available for use, but have you taken notice of the new and exclusive faces of CSN:Z? Only in CSN:Z can you play as both male and female characters, heroes and villains straight from the stories of Zombie Scenario!

Gerard, Natasha, and Mei join the fight with the Counter-Terrorism forces. Jennifer, David Black, and Yuri have aligned with the Terrorists in this new Zombie filled world.

These are not the only fresh faces you can expect to find in CSN:Z. Such new characters may play a part in the Zombie Apocalypse, one way or another, but if you pick them up from the shop they can take up the fight in any game mode!

Get back in the fight with new and classic characters on [b]October 7th![/b]
 
We tried to get Henry to join the fight but he seems more interested in crafting the guns than using them on Zombies, his loss.

notes.title: Zombie Classes
notes.content:
Zombies come in all shapes and sizes just like the Humans they used to be. You may see plenty of the shambling, lurching, run of the mill walking dead but some rise above and show off their true Zombie talents!

In Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies, dying doesn't mean you have to blend in with the crowd. There are a number of Zombie classes you can choose to match your style of turning Humans to the winning team.

[b]Regular:[/b] Sometimes you don’t want to give up the classics. These Zombies are a way for newcomers to get familiar with Zombie on Human combat and also a solid choice for the more experienced who know how to coordinate on an undead team.
For Mutant and Hero gameplay modes, Regular Zombies can employ their skill for a burst of speed to close in on Humans who may have dug in deep but didn't check if it was safe to reload.

[b]Light:[/b] A class of Zombie for when patience can truly pay off. Bullets might do a harsher number on Light zombies, knocking them back further than Regular Zombies, but as their name implies these gruesome corpses are light on their feet and offer better base speed and jump height abilities. For Mutant and Hero gameplay modes, Light Zombies can turn invisible for a limited time! A prepared Human will know how to reveal your location, so plan ahead how to spring a truly surprising attack

[b]Heavy:[/b] Naturally complimenting the Light class of Zombie. Even if living large means slower movement and shorter jumps, topped off with being an oversized all-too visible target, the Heavy Zombie class is valuable in the fray for advancing against enemy fire better than the Regular class of Zombie. Shrugging off the knockback of gunfire isn’t the only perk for this class.
For Mutant and Hero gameplay modes, Heavy Zombies can leave traps to ensnare Humans making them easy pickings.

[b]Voodoo:[/b] Help out your fellow Zombie! It can be rough for the undead on the battlefield, what with taking a few hundred rounds of lead from stubbornly camping machine guns, and the Voodoo class of Zombie has just what a bullet-riddled team needs. 
For Mutant and Hero gameplay modes, Voodoo Zombies can restore HP and Armor to team members in close proximity.
Even if just a simple scratch is enough to turn a Human undead, Zombies need to work together as a team to overcome walls of suppressive fire.

Find the class that lets you be the best Zombie you can be!

notes.title: Thank you for joining CSN:Z Open Beta! - Official Launch on 7th October!
notes.content:
Dear Survivors,

[b]Thank you for participating in the CSN:Z Open Beta! [/b]

Our CSN:Z Open Beta has ended, but what a few days it has been!(servers will be shut down at 6pm CET) Three days may not be enough time to take in all the maps, modes, guns, and everything else CSN:Z has to offer, but those few days have been incredibly important to the team.

Problems came up, and we're not going to pretend they weren't frustrating, but discovering these issues now can help create a smoother launch of Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies.

Also, we're truly excited to see such a huge interest in our game. Even though this was just a short Beta period, Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies managed to become one of the top 30 played games on Steam!

Working together with the community and making it the game you want it to be is something we promised on our Steam page and something we will continue to follow even after the final release.

Speaking of [b]The Official Launch: We will be ready to start the Zombie Apocalypse on 7th October [/b]and we have something special for all the survivors that wish to join us on that day. We prepared lots of rewards for newcomers and welcome back packages for all those who supported us during the OBT! Prepare yourself for the horde!

Before the game launches, you will be able to receive even more rewards! For all the OBT participants, we will be holding a feedback event! You only need to leave your game review on the Steam Page and post your feedback in [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/273110/discussions/0/613936673597809716/]topic in the Community hub. [/url](Note: Winners will be picked randomly from the most useful user reviews and feedback.)

notes.content:
With loads of Zombie PvP and PvE action, matched with the competitive Counter-Strike FPS experience, topped off with an incredible amount of content… what else is left?!

[h1]Free stuff, of course![/h1]

Read up on our OBT events below:
1)	[b]Craft Your Weapon![/b]
•	How to participate?: Log in once from 23rd to 25th September (CEST).
•	Reward: 3x 30 Day Durables, 3x Random Grade Blueprint [S]

2)	[b]Item Shower[/b]
•	How to participate?: Log in once per day from 23rd to 25th September (CEST).
•	Reward: Light Zombie, Large Medical Kit, M134 Mini Gun

3)	[b]Special Treat [/b]
•	How to participate?: Log in on 23rd September (CEST), and again on the CSN:Z official launch date (to be announced).
•	Reward: 1x Nickname Change Coupon on the CSN:Z launch date.

We also have the best deal ever for 3 days only!

Bulk up your Zombie game with the Merciless Destroyer (10 Days) + Heavy Zombie (10 Days) + Fire & Curse (10 Days) Set! [i]If you buy this discounted set during the OBT, you will be eligible to receive it again after the launch FOR FREE! [/i]

[b]Moreover, we'll throw in an additional package with the Grade-1 Blueprint [S] + Permanent Durables, and 25,600 points at launch as part of this special offer![/b]

notes.title: New Regions for CSN:Z - Ukraine, Mexico, and More
notes.content:
Feedback from the growing CSN:Z Community showed some very strong interest from regions we had initially failed to include under CSN:Z's allowed regions. We made it a priority to review and evaluate what could be done to get more areas of the globe included in the CSN:Z fun!

The following are regions which can now access CSN:Z
•Ukraine
•Mexico
•Serbia
•Bosnia and Herzegovina
•Georgia

We apologize for not including these countries the first time around. This list also won't make everyone happy, as not every region that wanted access could be included at this time. 
We'll still be reviewing such feedback, and will continue to evaluate what areas CSN:Z may be able to expand to in the future.

notes.title: Lots of Weapons, Lots of Questions
notes.content:
The Team has been keeping an eye on the growing CSN:Z community and seen some growing concerns that truly need some official statements: Weapons, how to get them, and how it will tie into cash shop.

We are very close to Open Beta and surely there will be far more questions once that is live, never mind what may arise just from posting this announcement! 
This is a quick run-down of the essentials for getting familiar with what CSN:Z is bringing to Steam. Please toss us your questions on Facebook, Twitter, and our own Community Hub here on Steam.

•[b]Crafting Focus – For Free and Purchase[/b]
Is there a Cash Shop in CSN:Z? Yes.
Do you buy guns there? [u]No.[/u]
Guns are obtained via the Crafting system in CSN:Z, by combining ‘Blueprints’ (what weapons are possible), ‘Durables’ (range of duration), and game points to initiate the process. 
All of these components can be obtained for free just by playing the game. But, as one could guess, also obtainable from the Cash shop directly.

•[b]Classic Guns – Complete Loadout at Start[/b]
From the moment you sign up in CSN:Z, you’ve got every weapon from the Original Counter-Strike in your inventory, permanently. No Crafting or shopping required as [i]these are default weapons for your arsenal[/i].

•[b]Duration – Permanent Available[/b]
What Durables component you use in Crafting a gun will determine its duration, and Permanent is possible from the right Durables. [i]Players are not required to make a purchase in the Cash shop to get new, permanent weapons in CSN:Z![/i]

While this info is pretty brief for a game as large as CSN:Z, hopefully it will still give everyone in our growing CSN:Z Community a better idea of what to expect at Launch. We’ll also be happy to field your questions and concerns as best we can.

notes.title: Family System – Create, Collaborate, Conquer
notes.content:
Not everyone can settle for just chaotic, unorganized, unstructured zombie killing by the thousands. For some, there must be structure and comradery that brings out the best in a team. In Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies, the [b]Family system[/b] not only lets like-minded players join forces but also support each other as well.

If you’ve played online FPS competitively before this concept is likely familiar to you, often called a Clan system. Do not settle for such low expectations! The [b]Family system[/b] is more than just a means of pitting team against team for ranking. Forming and building a Family lets you grow stronger in CSN:Z.

There’s great fun in amassing a small army (and for some, great fun in micromanaging that army) but with the Family system you’re rewarded for sticking together and able to keep other [b]Family members[/b] well stocked for combat. 

Complete Family Exclusive [b]challenges[/b], coordinate to complete Family [b]Missions for rewards[/b], and share the wealth with the Family Bank! 
There’s often a black sheep in families, but with CSN:Z’s family system you can share resources with them generously. Or because you’re tired of them being dead weight when fighting the undead.

Find out if blood is thicker than water in the Open Beta! September 23rd!

notes.title: The Classic & Melee Weapons – What Set the Standard
notes.content:
The [b]Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies[/b] team is working hard to deliver a remarkable addition to the CS library on Steam. It’s not just-zombies when there’s so many modes, maps, and new additions to such an amazing competitive FPS franchise.

But that is not enough for many, and we agree. CSN:Z would not be a member of the Counter-Strike family without its downright iconic selection of weaponry! We’ve got you covered.

[b]All weapons and equipment from the original Counter-Strike are in CSN:Z.[/b] AWP? FAMAS? Dual Berettas? Even if you’re somehow aching to storm the bomb with a TMP it is all here More than that, it is easy to setup a match to play with only those classic weapons both in the original CS maps and maps exclusive to CSN:Z.

Far more than just a means of self-defense, [b]melee weapons[/b] have been around ever since human civilization first found its roots and remains an effective form of combat to this day. It is safe to assume the idea of a sharp blade in your hand may outlast human civilization itself should the Zombies have their way!

Melee weapons are diverse, can fit specific needs, and can be downright artistic in design. In Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies there is no shortage of options for cutting enemies down who dare to fall within arm’s reach. It’s important to offer so many options! With both Counter-Terrorists and Terrorists bringing one to battle regardless of the mode it is a vital piece of your loadout.

[i]Plus you run faster while holding a knife. Everyone knows that.[/i]

Some might be familiar faces to those joining CSN:Z, such as the Balisong, a trusty Hunting Dagger,  or even a Katana or two. Choices for melee combat can be practical as well! A damn big Hammer can work to knock back Zombies more effectively than other weapons, for example.

However, it only takes a little exploration to see how fast the options open up to you for slicing and bashing your enemies, alive or formally-alive. The SKULL-9 is a huge axe to let you split some skulls or nail crowds with large swings. Nata knives sport a long finely sharpened blade, and the lucky few can wield one in each hand… Or just give up subtlety entirely with the BALROG-IX to throw some truly explosive punches. Literally.

[h1]Get up close and personal this Sept 23rd in the CSN:Z Beta![/h1]

notes.title: Maps - From Aztec to Vostok
notes.content:
We've heard you, the burning question in the minds of Counter-Strike fans who learnt the news of Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies coming to Steam. “Is such-and-such map from the original CS going to be in it?” No one could blame fans for wanting their favorites to be represented in a game with ‘Counter-Strike’ in the title, what with some preferring their dosage of [b]DE_Dust[/b] to be 24/7.

Did you know there’s over [b]70 maps[/b] in CSN:Z?! Environments that span the globe, vivid and varied battlegrounds that can let you switch up the routine every time you sit down to play. We even offer an option to setup quick map-rotations so you can sample from such a large offering with even greater ease.
How about maps to fit specific, challenging modes of play? AWP and Melee only maps that were created with just those entertaining styles of combat in mind. Many of the maps are designed for the unique modes in the game, so fighting against Zombies isn't shoehorned into a map that wouldn't be ideal for it.

What about maps which deviate from the norm? For a game loaded with Zombies, it suddenly doesn't seem so strange to find yourself in a war zone where you’re the size of rats or are facing off in a boxing ring.
However, many may have just been skimming this announcement for the big answer to the big question: Yes. 

[h1]
All of the original maps from Counter-Strike are available and will be Free to Play. Come check it out on the 23rd with CSN:Z’s Open Beta! 
[/h1]

notes.title: Zombie Shelter – Build, Secure, Defend, Survive
notes.content:
Those who manage to survive the first few days of a Zombie apocalypse must face some difficult choices. One of the most important decisions is whether to run for safety, or dig in deep and hold your ground. In [b]Zombie Shelter[/b] you can experience the later and learn if you have what it takes to maintain a fortress against the undead.

Gameplay cycles between day and night, where the light offers opportunities to scavenge supplies and expand your shelter but darkness belongs to the dead. [b]Build and secure[/b] your shelter with what daylight is available, but don’t get too confident as dying while carrying resources will affect the whole team! Grab your fill of lumber and iron, but if you can’t get those materials back to the [b]Shelter[/b] they’re just wasted on your corpse.

Make use of Generators, barriers, and even lookout towers to make your Shelter not only secure but also formidable!

Becoming a master craftsmen while under attack by Zombies is one feat to boast about, but if you’re ready for a new challenge try out the maps which pit Human against Human… against Zombie! Some don’t like to play nice, and for those jerks Zombie Shelter lets you fight against an opposing team of Humans while Zombies attack anything living. Only one Shelter will survive.

[h1]
Put your survival skills to the test this Sept 23rd when the Beta is open!
[/h1]

notes.title: Zombie Mutation – Class-Based, Zombie VS Human Combat
notes.content:
Maybe you've heard about it from friends, or maybe you've done a little research of your own, but do you really know what sort of trouble you'll face from the undead of Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies?
Zombies come in all sorts of sizes and shapes (and flavors?), and the skills they have can really catch unprepared Humans off guard.

[h1]Zombie Mutation is one of the PvP Zombie VS Human gameplay modes in CSN:Z. [/h1]

As a Human, there's some support in your favor for a change! Supply Boxes are dropped throughout the map rewarding whoever nabs it with weapons or bonuses to turn the undead tide. However, it is support very-much needed in the face of such powerful monstrous [b]Zombie classes.[/b]

As if walking corpses were trouble enough, you will face Zombie Classes that excel in speed, armor, reach, team-support, and more! Feeling oh-so confident with the corner your squad has locked down? It only takes one quick push by a [b]Light class Zombie[/b] with her [b]Invisibility skill[/b] to ruin everything your team worked hard to secure.

Or maybe the Humans are better on the move and can keep distance between the Zombies to outlast a round. A surprise introduction to the [b]Stamper class[/b] and its choice of weaponized torture device can not only slow down your movement speed for easy pickings but also block your shots.

Still feeling confident about outlasting the Zombie apocalypse? Oops-- the Zombies can regenerate health if Humans let them retreat. And, oops again-- those Zombies who are best at killing are rewarded by [b]mutating[/b] into even stronger versions of their class for earning enough kills in a single round.

There's TEN zombie classes in addition to the regular class of walking corpse you may already be familiar with. [b]Zombie Mutation[/b] will truly separate the survivors from the stooges as you take on so many different Zombies and their powerful abilities.

Will you be ready for the Beta? On the 23rd of September you may have more Zombie on your hands than you can handle!

notes.title: Zombie Scenario – Intense PvE Action!
notes.content:
[b]The dead [/b]are walking, cities are falling, and you’re low on ammo: how did it all come to this? Grab your friends and team up against the undead as you uncover the stories behind the Zombie Apocalypse!

[b]Zombie Scenario[/b] is a PvE mode of play where teams of Humans band together to take down the undead and beyond, detailing stories of characters you’ll find in CSN:Z. There are multiple scenarios, and in each scenario there are different maps to play. 

Just like a good story you won’t want to skip straight to the ending! New maps unlock as you progress through each scenario, just play to learn more of each Scenario’s story.

Each map of Zombie Scenario can be different than the last. Some are straightforward action, challenging both your firepower and agility in surviving waves of the undead.
Other maps test how solid of a team the Humans can be, requiring coordination to complete goals while Zombies do their best to cut you down.

Thousands of Zombies? Challenging and diverse maps? Stories of betrayal and evil? That’s not all [b]Zombie Scenario[/b] has to offer.

Some damn big[b] bosses[/b] are waiting for you, literally. Zombies don’t play fair when your team is charged with taking down towering and horrific enemies in chaotic boss fights. Keep that finger on the trigger and your head on a swivel!

You’ll get your chance to explore the undead stories of Zombie Scenario in Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies' Open Beta.
It’s coming in already on 23.09.14!

notes.title: Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies' Open Beta
notes.content:
[h1]New details of modes, maps, and guns emerge for this highly anticipated zombie shooter, available for Beta testing from 23rd September[/h1]

We are pleased to announce the launching plan for the highly anticipated free-to-play Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies, as the Steam page for the game goes live. [h1][b]The game will have its Open Beta on 23rd September[/b][/h1]
It comes with a variety of modes, maps, guns, and character options in which to destroy the undead hordes.

A huge number of modes will be available, featuring both PvP and PvE gameplay. Possess and use, to a dangerous effect, the various unique abilities in Zombie Hero; lead a team of survivors to build and defend a base against continuous waves of zombies in Shelter Mode; or advance through intense Zombie Scenarios that will throw players into boss fights, among other activities. Even outside of zombies, there are more than 20 modes to explore, such as Beast Mode, Bazooka Mode, and Football Mode. Veteran fans of the Counter-Strike series will also surely be glad to see a number of offerings from the original iteration, such as Bomb Defusal and Hostage Rescue.

All-time favourite classic maps will be included in the game, such as the unforgettable de_dust, along with a selection of new maps, such as Big Tree, Camouflage, Rex and Greesia, and 60 others. The arsenal of weapons available will also be significantly larger and more diverse in Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies, with essentials ranging from sniper and assault rifles to more compact PDWs and SMGs. For players willing to be a little more adventurous, weapons such as Dragon Claws, energy pistols, and sci-fi styled machine rifles are available in zombie modes.

A wide variety of characters are available, both male and female, terrorist and counter-terrorist. Players can select characters merely based on style, or they may choose a character with which to explore the story elements surrounding the zombie outbreaks and terrorist attacks unique to Counter-Strike Nexon: Zombies. 

[i]“Both fans of Counter-Strike and players who are new to the game will have a full-blown shooter experience in a well-restored legendary FPS”[/i] said Kenny Chang, Nexon Europe CEO. [i]“New weapons, new modes, and new elements inspiring new styles of play, mixed with everything that made the game such a classic in the first place are some things that we’re really looking forward to bringing to Steam.”[/i]
